# D:\AttendSure_V3\backend\apps\accounts\models.py
import re
import secrets
from django.conf import settings
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import F
from django.utils import timezone

from common.fields import SafeJsonField
from common.phone import normalize_ph_phone

SUFFIX_CHOICES = [
    ("", "None"),
    ("Jr.", "Jr."),
    ("Sr.", "Sr."),
    ("II", "II"),
    ("III", "III"),
    ("IV", "IV"),
]

USER_ROLE_CHOICES = [
    ("ADMIN", "System Administrator"),
    ("PRINCIPAL", "School Principal"),
    ("DEPT_HEAD", "Department Head"),
    ("TEACHER", "Teacher / Class Adviser"),
]


class Department(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    code = models.CharField(max_length=32, unique=True, db_index=True)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100, unique=True, db_index=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "departments"
        ordering = ["name"]

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self.code and self.name:
            base = re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]+", "_", self.name.upper()).strip("_")[:24] or "DEPT"
            candidate = base
            counter = 1
            while Department.objects.filter(code=candidate).exclude(pk=self.pk).exists():
                candidate = f"{base[:20]}_{counter}"
                counter += 1
            self.code = candidate
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name


class PositionTitle(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    title = models.CharField(max_length=100, unique=True, db_index=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "position_titles"
        ordering = ["title"]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.title


class TeacherProfile(models.Model):
    """
    Strict 3NF TeacherProfile:
    - Name (first_name, last_name), email, and is_active live strictly in auth.User.
    - Stores only teacher-specific atomic attributes + normalized FKs to Department & PositionTitle.
    - biometric_key_id stores ONLY the public SHA-256 identifier of the phone's SecureStore key (never biometric data).
    """

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    user = models.OneToOneField(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="teacher_profile",
    )
    employee_id = models.CharField(max_length=50, unique=True, db_index=True)
    middle_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    suffix = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=SUFFIX_CHOICES, blank=True, default="")
    department = models.ForeignKey(
        Department,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="teachers",
    )
    position = models.ForeignKey(
        PositionTitle,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="teachers",
    )
    contact_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default="")
    photo = models.ImageField(upload_to="teachers/", null=True, blank=True)
    can_handle_classes = models.BooleanField(default=True, db_index=True)
    qr_token = models.CharField(max_length=128, unique=True, db_index=True)
    bound_device_id = models.CharField(max_length=128, blank=True, null=True, unique=True)
    device_model = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, null=True)
    device_bound_at = models.DateTimeField(blank=True, null=True)
    biometric_key_id = models.CharField(max_length=128, blank=True, null=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "teacher_profiles"
        ordering = ["user__last_name", "user__first_name"]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["can_handle_classes"], name="idx_teacher_can_handle"),
        ]

    @property
    def first_name(self) -> str:
        return self.user.first_name if self.user_id else ""

    @property
    def last_name(self) -> str:
        return self.user.last_name if self.user_id else ""

    @property
    def email(self) -> str:
        return self.user.email if self.user_id else ""

    @property
    def is_active(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.user.is_active) if self.user_id else False

    @property
    def department_name(self) -> str:
        return self.department.name if (self.department_id and self.department) else ""

    @property
    def position_title(self) -> str:
        return self.position.title if (self.position_id and self.position) else ""

    @property
    def full_name(self) -> str:
        first = (self.user.first_name if self.user_id else "").strip()
        last = (self.user.last_name if self.user_id else "").strip()
        mid = f" {self.middle_name[:1]}." if self.middle_name else ""
        suf = f" {self.suffix}" if self.suffix else ""
        computed = f"{first}{mid} {last}{suf}".strip()
        return computed or (self.user.username if self.user_id else self.employee_id)

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.contact_number:
            self.contact_number = normalize_ph_phone(self.contact_number)[:50]
        if not self.qr_token:
            self.qr_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.full_name} ({self.employee_id})"


class UserProfile(models.Model):
    """
    Strict 3NF UserProfile:
    - Stores ONLY account security and role attributes.
    - No duplicated name, phone, avatar, or teacher FK (user.teacher_profile is already 1-to-1).
    """

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    user = models.OneToOneField(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="profile",
    )
    role = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=USER_ROLE_CHOICES, default="TEACHER", db_index=True)
    failed_login_attempts = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=0)
    locked_until = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "user_profiles"

    @property
    def is_profile_completed(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.user_id and self.user.first_name and self.user.last_name)

    def is_locked(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.locked_until and timezone.now() < self.locked_until)

    def record_failed_attempt(self) -> bool:
        """Increments failed_login_attempts atomically. Returns True if this attempt locked the account."""
        now = timezone.now()
        if self.locked_until and now >= self.locked_until:
            UserProfile.objects.filter(pk=self.pk).update(failed_login_attempts=1, locked_until=None)
            self.failed_login_attempts = 1
            self.locked_until = None
            return False

        UserProfile.objects.filter(pk=self.pk).update(failed_login_attempts=F("failed_login_attempts") + 1)
        self.refresh_from_db(fields=["failed_login_attempts"])
        if self.failed_login_attempts >= 5:
            self.locked_until = now + timezone.timedelta(minutes=15)
            self.save(update_fields=["locked_until", "updated_at"])
            return True
        return False

    def reset_failed_attempts(self) -> None:
        if self.failed_login_attempts > 0 or self.locked_until is not None:
            UserProfile.objects.filter(pk=self.pk).update(failed_login_attempts=0, locked_until=None)
            self.failed_login_attempts = 0
            self.locked_until = None

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.user.username} ({self.role})"

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model

from .models import TeacherProfile

User = get_user_model()


def resolve_teacher_for_user(user) -> TeacherProfile | None:
    """Resolves the active 1-to-1 TeacherProfile linked to a signed-in user in at most 1 SQL query."""
    if not user or not getattr(user, "is_authenticated", False):
        return None

    cached = getattr(user, "_resolved_teacher_profile", None)
    if cached is not None:
        return None if cached is False else cached

    teacher = (
        TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("user", "department", "position")
        .filter(user_id=user.id, user__is_active=True)
        .first()
    )
    setattr(user, "_resolved_teacher_profile", teacher if teacher else False)
    return teacher


def get_teacher_section_ids(teacher: TeacherProfile | None) -> set[int]:
    """Returns all active Section IDs advised or taught by a teacher."""
    if not teacher:
        return set()

    from apps.school.models import ClassPeriod, Section

    advised_ids = set(
        Section.objects.filter(adviser_id=teacher.id, is_active=True).values_list("id", flat=True)
    )
    scheduled_ids = set(
        ClassPeriod.objects.filter(teacher_id=teacher.id, is_active=True).values_list(
            "section_id", flat=True
        )
    )
    return advised_ids | scheduled_ids


def get_teacher_enrollment_ids(teacher: TeacherProfile | None) -> set[int]:
    """Returns all active Enrollment IDs belonging to sections handled by a teacher."""
    section_ids = get_teacher_section_ids(teacher)
    if not section_ids:
        return set()

    from apps.students.models import Enrollment

    return set(
        Enrollment.objects.filter(
            section_id__in=section_ids,
            status__in=["ENROLLED", "TRANSFERRED_IN"],
            student__is_active=True,
        ).values_list("id", flat=True)
    )


def get_teacher_student_ids(teacher: TeacherProfile | None) -> set[int]:
    """Returns all enrolled Student IDs belonging to sections handled by a teacher."""
    section_ids = get_teacher_section_ids(teacher)
    if not section_ids:
        return set()

    from apps.students.models import Enrollment

    return set(
        Enrollment.objects.filter(
            section_id__in=section_ids,
            status__in=["ENROLLED", "TRANSFERRED_IN"],
            student__is_active=True,
        ).values_list("student_id", flat=True)
    )

class StaffAccountValidationMixin:
    """Shared role, email, employee ID, and phone uniqueness checks for staff serializers."""

    employee_id_required = False

    def _get_exclude_user_id(self) -> int | None:
        return None

    def _get_exclude_teacher_id(self) -> int | None:
        return None

    def validate_role(self, value: str) -> str:
        return validate_staff_role(value)

    def validate_email(self, value: str) -> str:
        return validate_unique_user_email(value, exclude_user_id=self._get_exclude_user_id())

    def validate_employee_id(self, value: str) -> str:
        return validate_unique_employee_id(
            value,
            exclude_teacher_id=self._get_exclude_teacher_id(),
            required=self.employee_id_required,
        )

    def validate_contact_number(self, value: str) -> str:
        return validate_unique_teacher_phone(
            value, exclude_teacher_id=self._get_exclude_teacher_id()
        )


def _generate_unique_username(base: str) -> str:
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9._-]+", ".", base.lower()).strip(".")[:40] or "teacher"
    candidate = slug
    idx = 1
    while User.objects.filter(username__iexact=candidate).exists():
        candidate = f"{slug[:32]}_{idx}"
        idx += 1
    return candidate

    def get_advised_sections(self, obj: TeacherProfile) -> list[str]:
        advised_map = self.context.get("advised_map")
        if advised_map is not None:
            return list(advised_map.get(obj.id, []))
        from apps.school.models import SchoolYear, Section
        from apps.school.selectors import format_section_label

        active_sy = SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
        qs = Section.objects.filter(adviser=obj, is_active=True).select_related("grade_level")
        if active_sy:
            qs = qs.filter(school_year=active_sy)
        return [
            format_section_label(sec.grade_level.name if sec.grade_level else "", sec.name)
            for sec in qs.order_by("grade_level__level_number", "name")
        ]

    @transaction.atomic
    def create(self, validated_data: dict) -> TeacherProfile:
        first_name = clean_text(validated_data.pop("first_name", ""), 100)
        last_name = clean_text(validated_data.pop("last_name", ""), 100)
        email = clean_text(validated_data.pop("email", ""), 150)
        raw_username = clean_text(validated_data.pop("username", ""), 150)
        is_active = bool(validated_data.pop("is_active", True))
        role = validated_data.pop("role", "TEACHER")
        dept_name = clean_text(validated_data.pop("department", ""), 100)
        pos_title = clean_text(validated_data.pop("position", ""), 100)
        validated_data.pop("remove_photo", None)

        username = raw_username or _generate_unique_username(
            f"{first_name}.{last_name}" if (first_name and last_name) else validated_data["employee_id"]
        )
        if User.objects.filter(username__iexact=username).exists():
            username = _generate_unique_username(username)

        user = User(
            username=username,
            first_name=first_name,
            last_name=last_name,
            email=email,
            is_active=is_active,
            is_staff=role == "ADMIN",
            is_superuser=role == "ADMIN",
        )
        user.set_unusable_password()
        user.save()

        UserProfile.objects.update_or_create(user=user, defaults={"role": role})

        validated_data["middle_name"] = clean_text(validated_data.get("middle_name", ""), 100)
        validated_data["suffix"] = clean_text(validated_data.get("suffix", ""), 20)
        teacher = TeacherProfile(
            user=user,
            department=get_or_create_department(dept_name),
            position=get_or_create_position(pos_title),
            **validated_data,
        )
        teacher.save()
        return teacher

    @transaction.atomic
    def update(self, instance: TeacherProfile, validated_data: dict) -> TeacherProfile:
        user = instance.user
        user_fields = []
        if "first_name" in validated_data:
            user.first_name = clean_text(validated_data.pop("first_name"), 100)
            user_fields.append("first_name")
        if "last_name" in validated_data:
            user.last_name = clean_text(validated_data.pop("last_name"), 100)
            user_fields.append("last_name")
        if "email" in validated_data:
            user.email = clean_text(validated_data.pop("email"), 150)
            user_fields.append("email")
        if "is_active" in validated_data:
            user.is_active = bool(validated_data.pop("is_active"))
            user_fields.append("is_active")
        validated_data.pop("username", None)

        if "role" in validated_data:
            role = validated_data.pop("role")
            UserProfile.objects.update_or_create(user=user, defaults={"role": role})
            user.is_staff = role == "ADMIN"
            user.is_superuser = role == "ADMIN"
            user_fields.extend(["is_staff", "is_superuser"])

        if user_fields:
            user.save(update_fields=list(dict.fromkeys(user_fields)))

        if "department" in validated_data:
            instance.department = get_or_create_department(str(validated_data.pop("department") or ""))
        if "position" in validated_data:
            instance.position = get_or_create_position(str(validated_data.pop("position") or ""))
        if "middle_name" in validated_data:
            validated_data["middle_name"] = clean_text(validated_data["middle_name"], 100)
        if "suffix" in validated_data:
            validated_data["suffix"] = clean_text(validated_data["suffix"], 20)
        if bool(validated_data.pop("remove_photo", False)):
            validated_data["photo"] = None

        for attr, val in validated_data.items():
            setattr(instance, attr, val)
        instance.save()
        return instance

    @transaction.atomic
    def create(self, validated_data: dict):
        clean_role = validated_data.pop("role", "TEACHER")
        middle_name = clean_text(validated_data.pop("middle_name", ""), 100)
        suffix = clean_text(validated_data.pop("suffix", ""), 20)
        contact = normalize_ph_phone(validated_data.pop("contact_number", ""))
        employee_id = clean_text(validated_data.pop("employee_id", ""), 50)
        department = clean_text(validated_data.pop("department", ""), 100)
        position = clean_text(validated_data.pop("position", ""), 100)
        can_handle = bool(validated_data.pop("can_handle_classes", True))
        photo = validated_data.pop("photo", None)
        remove_photo = bool(validated_data.pop("remove_photo", False))
        password = validated_data.pop("password", None)

        validated_data["username"] = clean_text(validated_data.get("username", ""), 150)
        validated_data["first_name"] = clean_text(validated_data.get("first_name", ""), 100)
        validated_data["last_name"] = clean_text(validated_data.get("last_name", ""), 100)
        validated_data["email"] = clean_text(validated_data.get("email", ""), 150)

        user = User(**validated_data)
        user.is_staff = clean_role == "ADMIN"
        user.is_superuser = clean_role == "ADMIN"
        if password:
            user.set_password(password)
        else:
            user.set_unusable_password()
        user.save()

        profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.update_or_create(
            user=user,
            defaults={"role": clean_role},
        )

        try:
            emp_code = validate_unique_employee_id(
                employee_id or f"EMP-{user.id:04d}", required=True
            )
        except serializers.ValidationError as exc:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"employee_id": exc.detail})

        teacher = TeacherProfile.objects.create(
            user=user,
            employee_id=emp_code,
            middle_name=middle_name,
            suffix=suffix,
            department=get_or_create_department(department),
            position=get_or_create_position(position),
            contact_number=contact,
            can_handle_classes=can_handle,
            photo=None if remove_photo else photo,
        )
        user.profile = profile
        user.teacher_profile = teacher
        return user

        has_teacher_updates = any(
            v is not None and v is not _UNSET
            for v in (middle_name, suffix, contact, employee_id, department, position, can_handle, photo)
        ) or remove_photo
        if not teacher and has_teacher_updates:
            emp_code = clean_text(employee_id, 50) if employee_id else f"EMP-{instance.id:04d}"
            if TeacherProfile.objects.filter(employee_id__iexact=emp_code).exists():
                emp_code = f"EMP-{instance.id:04d}-{instance.id}"
            teacher = TeacherProfile.objects.create(user=instance, employee_id=emp_code)

        if teacher:
            if employee_id:
                try:
                    teacher.employee_id = validate_unique_employee_id(
                        employee_id, exclude_teacher_id=teacher.id, required=True
                    )
                except serializers.ValidationError as exc:
                    raise serializers.ValidationError({"employee_id": exc.detail})
            if middle_name is not _UNSET:
                teacher.middle_name = clean_text(middle_name, 100)
            if suffix is not _UNSET:
                teacher.suffix = clean_text(suffix, 20)
            if contact is not None:
                teacher.contact_number = normalize_ph_phone(contact)
            if department is not None:
                teacher.department = get_or_create_department(department)
            if position is not None:
                teacher.position = get_or_create_position(position)
            if can_handle is not None:
                teacher.can_handle_classes = bool(can_handle)
            if remove_photo or photo is None:
                teacher.photo = None
            elif photo is not _UNSET:
                teacher.photo = photo
            teacher.save()
            instance.teacher_profile = teacher

        instance.profile = profile
        return instance

def get_readable_audit_module(table_name: str, action: str = "") -> str:
    clean_table = str(table_name or "").strip().lower()
    if clean_table in AUDIT_MODULE_LABELS:
        return AUDIT_MODULE_LABELS[clean_table]
    if clean_table:
        return clean_table.replace("_", " ").strip().title()
    return "Account" if str(action or "").strip().upper() in AUDIT_ACCOUNT_ACTIONS else "System"


def get_readable_audit_action(action: str) -> str:
    code = str(action or "").strip().upper()
    if code in AUDIT_ACTION_LABELS:
        return AUDIT_ACTION_LABELS[code]
    return code.replace("_", " ").title() if code else "Activity"


def _extract_audit_changes_dict(obj: AuditLog) -> dict:
    merged: dict = {}
    if isinstance(obj.new_data, dict):
        merged.update(obj.new_data)
    if isinstance(obj.changed_fields, list) and obj.changed_fields:
        merged["changed_fields"] = list(obj.changed_fields)
    return merged


def _build_audit_summary(obj: AuditLog) -> str:
    action = str(obj.action or "").strip().upper()
    module_label = get_readable_audit_module(obj.table_name, action)
    data = obj.new_data if isinstance(obj.new_data, dict) else {}

    raw_fields = (
        obj.changed_fields
        if isinstance(obj.changed_fields, list)
        else data.get("changed_fields")
        if isinstance(data.get("changed_fields"), list)
        else []
    )
    safe_fields = [
        str(f).replace("_", " ").strip()
        for f in raw_fields
        if str(f).strip().lower() not in _AUDIT_SENSITIVE_FIELD_NAMES
    ]
    fields_text = ", ".join(safe_fields[:6])
    if len(safe_fields) > 6:
        fields_text += f", +{len(safe_fields) - 6} more"

    record_ref = f" #{obj.record_id}" if obj.record_id else ""

    if action == "LOGIN":
        uname = str(data.get("username") or "").strip()
        role = str(data.get("role") or "").strip()
        if str(data.get("mode") or "").upper() == "DEMO":
            return f"Signed in with demo preview as {uname}." if uname else "Signed in with demo preview."
        if uname and role:
            return f"Signed in as {uname} ({role})."
        if uname:
            return f"Signed in as {uname}."
        return "Signed in to AttendSure."

    if action == "LOGOUT":
        uname = str(data.get("username") or "").strip()
        return f"Signed out of account {uname}." if uname else "Signed out of AttendSure."

    if action == "LOCKOUT":
        uname = str(data.get("username") or "account").strip()
        tries = data.get("failed_login_attempts") or 5
        return f"Account {uname} was temporarily locked after {tries} failed sign-in tries."

    if action == "LOCKED":
        uname = str(data.get("username") or "account").strip()
        return f"Blocked a sign-in try while account {uname} is temporarily locked."

    if action == "LOGIN_FAIL":
        uname = str(data.get("username") or "account").strip()
        tries = data.get("failed_login_attempts")
        suffix = f" (attempt {tries})" if tries else ""
        return f"Failed sign-in try for {uname}{suffix}."

    if action == "UNLOCK_ALL":
        count = data.get("unlocked_count", 0)
        return f"Unlocked {count} locked account(s)."

    if action == "PASSWORD":
        return "Changed account password."

    if action == "PROFILE":
        if fields_text:
            return f"Updated personal profile ({fields_text})."
        return "Updated personal profile details."

    if action == "BIO_ENROLL":
        emp = str(data.get("employee_id") or "").strip()
        return f"Enrolled phone screen lock for teacher {emp}." if emp else "Enrolled phone screen lock for teacher check-in."

    if action == "BIO_REJECT":
        emp = str(data.get("employee_id") or "").strip()
        target = f"teacher {emp}" if emp else f"teacher{record_ref}"
        return f"Rejected a mismatched phone security check for {target}."

    if action == "DEV_REJECT":
        emp = str(data.get("employee_id") or "").strip()
        target = f"teacher {emp}" if emp else f"teacher{record_ref}"
        return f"Blocked pairing a phone already linked to another teacher for {target}."

    if action == "RESET_DEV":
        emp = str(data.get("employee_id") or "").strip()
        target = f"teacher {emp}" if emp else f"teacher{record_ref}"
        return f"Cleared paired phone lock for {target}."

    if action in ("EXPORT", "PRINT"):
        verb = "Printed" if action == "PRINT" else "Exported"
        report_name = str(data.get("report_name") or "").strip()
        if report_name:
            tracking = str(data.get("tracking_id") or "").strip()
            return f"{verb} {report_name}" + (f" (Tracking ID: {tracking})" if tracking else "") + "."
        pack_type = str(data.get("pack_type") or "").strip()
        if pack_type:
            pack_label = pack_type.replace("_", " ").title()
            fmt = str(data.get("export_format") or "").strip().upper()
            return f"{verb} {pack_label}" + (f" ({fmt})" if fmt else "") + "."
        if str(obj.table_name or "").lower() == "edfi_export":
            fmt = str(data.get("format") or "JSON").strip().upper()
            days = data.get("days")
            return f"{verb} Division Data ({fmt}" + (f", last {days} days" if days else "") + ")."
        return f"{verb} {module_label.lower()} document."

    if action == "IMPORT":
        created = data.get("created", 0)
        updated = data.get("updated", 0)
        skipped = data.get("skipped", 0)
        return f"Imported students: {created} added, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped."

    if action == "RESOLVE":
        next_status = str(data.get("status") or "").replace("_", " ").title()
        remarks = str(data.get("remarks") or "").strip()
        base = f"Resolved campus alert{record_ref}" + (f" as {next_status}" if next_status else "")
        return f"{base} — {remarks}" if remarks else f"{base}."

    if action == "EXCUSE":
        date_val = str(data.get("date") or "").strip()
        remarks = str(data.get("remarks") or "").strip()
        base = f"Excused campus alert" + (f" for {date_val}" if date_val else "")
        return f"{base} — {remarks}" if remarks else f"{base}."

    if action == "APPROVE":
        pass_num = str(data.get("pass_number") or "").strip()
        if pass_num:
            return f"Approved exit pass {pass_num}."
        if data.get("month") and data.get("year"):
            return f"Approved monthly DTR for {data['month']}/{data['year']}."
        return f"Approved {module_label.lower()} record{record_ref}."

    if action == "SUBMIT":
        if data.get("month") and data.get("year"):
            return f"Submitted monthly DTR for {data['month']}/{data['year']}."
        return f"Submitted {module_label.lower()} record{record_ref}."

    if action == "FLUSH":
        return "Cleared server memory cache."

    if action == "VIEW":
        return f"Viewed {module_label.lower()}{record_ref}."

    if action in ("CREATE", "UPDATE", "DELETE"):
        verb = {"CREATE": "Added", "UPDATE": "Updated", "DELETE": "Removed"}[action]
        if str(obj.table_name or "").lower() == "campus_boundaries" and data.get("campus_name"):
            radius = data.get("radius_meters")
            return f"Updated campus boundary for {data['campus_name']}" + (
                f" ({radius}m radius)." if radius else "."
            )
        if str(obj.table_name or "").lower() == "class_attendance" and data.get("status"):
            return f"{verb} student attendance status to {data['status']}."
        if fields_text:
            return f"{verb} {module_label.lower()} record{record_ref} ({fields_text})."
        kv_parts = [
            f"{str(k).replace('_', ' ')}: {v}"
            for k, v in data.items()
            if str(k).lower() not in _AUDIT_SENSITIVE_FIELD_NAMES
            and str(k) != "changed_fields"
            and v not in (None, "", [], {})
        ]
        if kv_parts:
            return f"{verb} {module_label.lower()} record{record_ref} ({', '.join(kv_parts[:4])})."
        return f"{verb} {module_label.lower()} record{record_ref}."

    action_label = get_readable_audit_action(action)
    return f"{action_label} in {module_label}{record_ref}."


class AuditLogSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    """Serializes 3NF AuditLog rows with clear, everyday labels and computed summary fields."""

    created_at = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    timestamp = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    date_only = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    time_only = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    action_label = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    target_model = serializers.CharField(source="table_name", read_only=True)
    target_id = serializers.IntegerField(source="record_id", read_only=True)
    module = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    changes = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    details = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    actor_username = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    actor_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    performed_by = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    user = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    client_ip = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    ip_address = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    status = serializers.SerializerMethodField()

    class Meta:
        model = AuditLog
        fields = [
            "id",
            "created_at",
            "timestamp",
            "date_only",
            "time_only",
            "action",
            "action_label",
            "table_name",
            "target_model",
            "module",
            "record_id",
            "target_id",
            "changed_fields",
            "new_data",
            "changes",
            "details",
            "actor_username",
            "actor_name",
            "performed_by",
            "user",
            "client_ip",
            "ip_address",
            "user_agent",
            "status",
        ]

    def _local_dt(self, obj: AuditLog):
        return timezone.localtime(obj.created_at)

    def get_created_at(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        return self._local_dt(obj).isoformat()

    def get_date_only(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        local_dt = self._local_dt(obj)
        return f"{local_dt.strftime('%b')} {local_dt.day}, {local_dt.year}"

    def get_time_only(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        local_dt = self._local_dt(obj)
        return local_dt.strftime("%I:%M %p").lstrip("0")

    def get_timestamp(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        return f"{self.get_date_only(obj)} • {self.get_time_only(obj)}"

    def get_action_label(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        return get_readable_audit_action(obj.action)

    def get_module(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        return get_readable_audit_module(obj.table_name, obj.action)

    def get_changes(self, obj: AuditLog) -> dict:
        return _extract_audit_changes_dict(obj)

    def get_details(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        return _build_audit_summary(obj)

    def get_actor_username(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        return obj.performed_by.username if obj.performed_by else "system"

    def get_actor_name(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        if not obj.performed_by:
            return "System"
        return (obj.performed_by.get_full_name() or obj.performed_by.username).strip()

    def get_performed_by(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        return self.get_actor_name(obj)

    def get_user(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        return self.get_actor_name(obj)

    def get_client_ip(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        return obj.client_ip or ""

    def get_ip_address(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        return obj.client_ip or ""

    def get_status(self, obj: AuditLog) -> str:
        action = str(obj.action or "").strip().upper()
        return "FAILED" if action in AUDIT_FAILED_ACTIONS else "SUCCESS"

def get_or_create_department(name: str) -> Department | None:
    clean = clean_text(name, 100)
    if not clean:
        return None
    existing = Department.objects.filter(name__iexact=clean).first()
    if existing:
        return existing
    return Department.objects.create(name=clean)


def get_or_create_position(title: str) -> PositionTitle | None:
    clean = clean_text(title, 100)
    if not clean:
        return None
    existing = PositionTitle.objects.filter(title__iexact=clean).first()
    if existing:
        return existing
    return PositionTitle.objects.create(title=clean)


def build_user_session_payload(*, user, request=None) -> dict:
    """Builds the authenticated teacher/leader session payload in minimal queries."""
    profile = getattr(user, "profile", None) or UserProfile.objects.filter(user=user).first()
    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    role = profile.role if (profile and profile.role in ALLOWED_ROLES) else get_user_role(user)
    can_handle_classes = bool(teacher.can_handle_classes) if teacher else (role == "TEACHER")
    photo_url = build_media_url(teacher.photo, request) if (teacher and teacher.photo) else None

    full_name = teacher.full_name if teacher else (user.get_full_name() or user.username).strip()

    return {
        "id": user.id,
        "username": user.username,
        "first_name": user.first_name or "",
        "middle_name": teacher.middle_name if teacher else "",
        "last_name": user.last_name or "",
        "suffix": teacher.suffix if teacher else "",
        "full_name": full_name,
        "teacher_name": full_name,
        "email": user.email or "",
        "role": role,
        "teacher_id": teacher.id if teacher else None,
        "employee_id": teacher.employee_id if teacher else "",
        "department": teacher.department_name if teacher else "",
        "department_name": teacher.department_name if teacher else "",
        "position": teacher.position_title if teacher else "",
        "position_title": teacher.position_title if teacher else "",
        "contact_number": teacher.contact_number if teacher else "",
        "phone_number": teacher.contact_number if teacher else "",
        "photo": photo_url,
        "photo_url": photo_url,
        "can_handle_classes": can_handle_classes,
        "can_teach": can_handle_classes,
        "has_bound_device": bool(teacher and teacher.bound_device_id),
        "has_biometric_enrolled": bool(teacher and teacher.biometric_key_id),
        "device_model": teacher.device_model if teacher else None,
        "is_profile_completed": bool(user.first_name and user.last_name),
        "is_staff": bool(user.is_staff),
        "is_superuser": bool(user.is_superuser),
    }


def authenticate_with_identifier(*, identifier: str, password: str, request=None) -> dict:
    clean_identifier = clean_text(identifier, 150)
    if not clean_identifier or not password:
        raise AppError("MISSING_CREDENTIALS", "Username or Employee ID and password are required.", 400)

    normalized_phone = normalize_ph_phone(clean_identifier)
    lookup = (
        Q(username__iexact=clean_identifier)
        | Q(email__iexact=clean_identifier)
        | Q(teacher_profile__employee_id__iexact=clean_identifier)
    )
    if normalized_phone:
        lookup = lookup | Q(teacher_profile__contact_number=normalized_phone)

    existing_user = (
        User.objects.select_related(
            "profile",
            "teacher_profile",
            "teacher_profile__department",
            "teacher_profile__position",
        )
        .filter(lookup)
        .first()
    )

    profile = None
    if existing_user:
        profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(
            user=existing_user,
            defaults={"role": "ADMIN" if existing_user.is_superuser else "TEACHER"},
        )
        if profile.role not in ALLOWED_ROLES:
            raise AppError(
                "FORBIDDEN_ROLE",
                "Only authorized school teachers and administrators can sign in to AttendSure.",
                403,
            )
        if profile.is_locked():
            record_audit_log(
                request=request,
                table_name="user_profiles",
                record_id=existing_user.id,
                action="LOCKED",
                new_data={"username": existing_user.username},
            )
            raise AppError(
                "ACCOUNT_LOCKED",
                "Account temporarily locked after 5 failed sign-in attempts. Please wait 15 minutes or ask an administrator to unlock it.",
                403,
            )

    target_username = existing_user.username if existing_user else clean_identifier
    authenticated_user = authenticate(request=request, username=target_username, password=password)

    if not authenticated_user:
        if profile and existing_user:
            just_locked = profile.record_failed_attempt()
            record_audit_log(
                request=request,
                table_name="user_profiles",
                record_id=existing_user.id,
                action="LOCKOUT" if just_locked else "LOGIN_FAIL",
                new_data={
                    "username": existing_user.username,
                    "failed_login_attempts": profile.failed_login_attempts,
                },
            )
            if just_locked:
                raise AppError(
                    "ACCOUNT_LOCKED",
                    "Account locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed sign-in attempts.",
                    403,
                )
        raise AppError("INVALID_CREDENTIALS", "Invalid account credentials.", 401)

    if not authenticated_user.is_active:
        raise AppError("INACTIVE_ACCOUNT", "This account is currently deactivated.", 403)

    if profile:
        profile.reset_failed_attempts()

    refresh = RefreshToken.for_user(authenticated_user)
    user_payload = build_user_session_payload(user=authenticated_user, request=request)
    return {
        "access": str(refresh.access_token),
        "refresh": str(refresh),
        "user": user_payload,
    }


@transaction.atomic
def update_own_profile(*, user, data: dict, files=None, request=None) -> dict:
    first_name = clean_text(data.get("first_name", user.first_name), 100)
    last_name = clean_text(data.get("last_name", user.last_name), 100)
    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)

    raw_email = data.get("email", user.email)
    try:
        email = validate_unique_user_email(raw_email, exclude_user_id=user.pk)
    except drf_serializers.ValidationError:
        raise AppError("EMAIL_TAKEN", "This email address is already in use.", 400)

    raw_phone = data.get("contact_number") if "contact_number" in data else data.get("phone_number")
    contact = None
    if raw_phone is not None:
        try:
            contact = validate_unique_teacher_phone(
                raw_phone, exclude_teacher_id=teacher.id if teacher else None
            )
        except drf_serializers.ValidationError:
            raise AppError(
                "PHONE_TAKEN",
                "This mobile number is already assigned to another staff account.",
                400,
            )

    user.first_name = first_name
    user.last_name = last_name
    user.email = email
    user.save(update_fields=["first_name", "last_name", "email"])

    uploaded_file = (files.get("photo") or files.get("avatar")) if files else None
    raw_photo = uploaded_file if uploaded_file is not None else (
        data.get("photo") if "photo" in data else data.get("avatar")
    )
    explicit_clear = (
        str(data.get("remove_photo", "")).lower() in ("1", "true", "yes")
        or (
            uploaded_file is None
            and ("photo" in data or "avatar" in data)
            and raw_photo in (None, "", "null", "undefined")
        )
    )

    if not teacher:
        emp_code = f"EMP-{user.id:04d}"
        if TeacherProfile.objects.filter(employee_id__iexact=emp_code).exists():
            emp_code = f"EMP-{user.id:04d}-{user.id}"
        teacher = TeacherProfile.objects.create(user=user, employee_id=emp_code)
        setattr(user, "_resolved_teacher_profile", teacher)

    if "middle_name" in data:
        teacher.middle_name = clean_text(data.get("middle_name", ""), 100)
    if "suffix" in data:
        suffix = clean_text(data.get("suffix", ""), 20)
        teacher.suffix = suffix if suffix in VALID_SUFFIXES else ""
    if contact is not None:
        teacher.contact_number = contact
    if "department" in data or "department_name" in data:
        dept_val = data.get("department") if "department" in data else data.get("department_name")
        teacher.department = get_or_create_department(str(dept_val or ""))
    if "position" in data or "position_title" in data:
        pos_val = data.get("position") if "position" in data else data.get("position_title")
        teacher.position = get_or_create_position(str(pos_val or ""))
    if explicit_clear:
        teacher.photo = None
    elif raw_photo is not None:
        decoded = decode_uploaded_image(raw_photo, prefix="teacher")
        if decoded is None:
            teacher.photo = None
        elif not isinstance(decoded, drf_serializers.SkipField):
            teacher.photo = decoded
    teacher.save()
    setattr(user, "_resolved_teacher_profile", teacher)

    return build_user_session_payload(user=user, request=request)


@transaction.atomic
def reset_teacher_bound_device(*, teacher_id: int) -> TeacherProfile:
    teacher = TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("user").filter(id=teacher_id).first()
    if not teacher:
        raise AppError("TEACHER_NOT_FOUND", "Teacher profile not found.", 404)
    teacher.bound_device_id = None
    teacher.device_model = None
    teacher.device_bound_at = None
    teacher.biometric_key_id = None
    teacher.save(
        update_fields=[
            "bound_device_id",
            "device_model",
            "device_bound_at",
            "biometric_key_id",
            "updated_at",
        ]
    )
    return teacher


@transaction.atomic
def unlock_all_locked_accounts() -> int:
    """Clears failed sign-in counters and temporary lockouts across all UserProfiles."""
    return UserProfile.objects.filter(
        Q(failed_login_attempts__gt=0) | Q(locked_until__isnull=False)
    ).update(failed_login_attempts=0, locked_until=None)

def _make_image_bytes(fmt: str = "PNG", size=(240, 240), color=(0, 75, 135)) -> bytes:
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    img = Image.new("RGB", size, color=color)
    img.save(buf, format=fmt)
    return buf.getvalue()


def _make_uploaded_image(name: str = "portrait.png", fmt: str = "PNG", size=(240, 240)) -> SimpleUploadedFile:
    content_type = "image/png" if fmt.upper() == "PNG" else "image/jpeg"
    return SimpleUploadedFile(name, _make_image_bytes(fmt=fmt, size=size), content_type=content_type)


def _make_data_uri(fmt: str = "JPEG", size=(300, 300), color=(2, 132, 199)) -> str:
    mime = "image/png" if fmt.upper() == "PNG" else "image/jpeg"
    encoded = base64.b64encode(_make_image_bytes(fmt=fmt, size=size, color=color)).decode("ascii")
    return f"data:{mime};base64,{encoded}"

    def test_01_users_crud_and_portrait_upload_resize_replace_remove(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.admin_user)

        # Reject corrupt image bytes
        bad_img = SimpleUploadedFile("bad.png", b"NOT_A_VALID_IMAGE_HEADER", content_type="image/png")
        bad_res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/accounts/users/",
            {
                "username": "bad_img_user",
                "password": "Password2026!",
                "first_name": "Bad",
                "last_name": "Image",
                "role": "TEACHER",
                "photo": bad_img,
            },
            format="multipart",
        )
        self.assertEqual(bad_res.status_code, 400)

        # Reject oversized > 2 MB payload
        too_big = SimpleUploadedFile("huge.png", b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + (b"0" * (2 * 1024 * 1024 + 100)), content_type="image/png")
        big_res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/accounts/users/",
            {
                "username": "huge_img_user",
                "password": "Password2026!",
                "first_name": "Huge",
                "last_name": "Image",
                "role": "TEACHER",
                "photo": too_big,
            },
            format="multipart",
        )
        self.assertEqual(big_res.status_code, 400)

        # CREATE with oversized 1200x1000 PNG portrait via multipart -> verify resized <= 600x600
        create_res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/accounts/users/",
            {
                "username": "full_crud_user",
                "password": "Password2026!",
                "first_name": "Marco",
                "middle_name": "Reyes",
                "last_name": "Villanueva",
                "suffix": "Jr.",
                "email": "marco@school.edu.ph",
                "phone_number": "09175551234",
                "employee_id": "EMP-MARCO-01",
                "department": "Mathematics",
                "position": "Teacher I",
                "role": "TEACHER",
                "can_handle_classes": "true",
                "is_active": "true",
                "photo": _make_uploaded_image("marco.png", fmt="PNG", size=(1200, 1000)),
            },
            format="multipart",
        )
        self.assertEqual(create_res.status_code, 201, create_res.data)
        uid = create_res.data["id"]
        self.assertEqual(create_res.data["middle_name"], "Reyes")
        self.assertEqual(create_res.data["suffix"], "Jr.")
        self.assertEqual(create_res.data["phone_number"], "+639175551234")
        self.assertTrue(create_res.data["photo_url"])

        # Verify saved image was resized to max 600px
        created_tp = TeacherProfile.objects.get(user_id=uid)
        with Image.open(created_tp.photo.path) as saved_img:
            self.assertLessEqual(saved_img.width, 600)
            self.assertLessEqual(saved_img.height, 600)

        # UPDATE all fields + replace photo via Base64 JPEG Data URI
        old_photo_url = create_res.data["photo_url"]
        upd_res = self.client.patch(
            f"/api/v1/accounts/users/{uid}/",
            {
                "first_name": "Marco Updated",
                "middle_name": "Cruz",
                "last_name": "Santos",
                "suffix": "II",
                "email": "marco.updated@school.edu.ph",
                "contact_number": "09185559999",
                "department": "Administration",
                "position": "Head Teacher III",
                "role": "DEPT_HEAD",
                "can_teach": False,
                "photo": _make_data_uri(fmt="JPEG", size=(800, 800)),
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(upd_res.status_code, 200, upd_res.data)
        self.assertEqual(upd_res.data["first_name"], "Marco Updated")
        self.assertEqual(upd_res.data["middle_name"], "Cruz")
        self.assertEqual(upd_res.data["suffix"], "II")
        self.assertEqual(upd_res.data["role"], "DEPT_HEAD")
        self.assertFalse(upd_res.data["can_handle_classes"])
        self.assertTrue(upd_res.data["photo_url"])
        self.assertNotEqual(upd_res.data["photo_url"], old_photo_url)

        # REMOVE photo via remove_photo=True
        rm_res = self.client.patch(
            f"/api/v1/accounts/users/{uid}/",
            {"photo": None, "remove_photo": True},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(rm_res.status_code, 200)
        self.assertIsNone(rm_res.data["photo_url"])

        # DELETE
        del_res = self.client.delete(f"/api/v1/accounts/users/{uid}/")
        self.assertEqual(del_res.status_code, 204)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(f"/api/v1/accounts/users/{uid}/").status_code, 404)

    def test_02_own_profile_photo_and_password_change_across_all_4_roles(self):
        for idx, u in enumerate([self.admin_user, self.principal_user, self.dept_head_user, self.adviser_user], start=1):
            self.client.force_authenticate(user=u)
            # Upload portrait via /accounts/profile/
            res_put = self.client.patch(
                "/api/v1/accounts/profile/",
                {
                    "first_name": f"{u.first_name}X",
                    "middle_name": "Middle",
                    "suffix": "III",
                    "contact_number": f"0917000112{idx}",
                    "photo": _make_data_uri(fmt="PNG", size=(500, 500)),
                },
                format="json",
            )
            self.assertEqual(res_put.status_code, 200, f"Failed for {u.username}: {res_put.data}")
            self.assertTrue(res_put.data["photo_url"])
            self.assertEqual(res_put.data["middle_name"], "Middle")
            self.assertEqual(res_put.data["suffix"], "III")

            # Remove portrait via /accounts/me/
            res_clear = self.client.patch(
                "/api/v1/accounts/me/",
                {"photo": None, "remove_photo": True},
                format="json",
            )
            self.assertEqual(res_clear.status_code, 200)
            self.assertIsNone(res_clear.data["photo_url"])

        # Password change wrong current password -> 400; correct -> 200 & login works
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.adviser_user)
        bad_pw = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/accounts/change-password/",
            {"current_password": "WrongPassword!", "new_password": "NewPassword2026!"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(bad_pw.status_code, 400)

        good_pw = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/accounts/change-password/",
            {"current_password": "Password2026!", "new_password": "NewPassword2026!"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(good_pw.status_code, 200)
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=None)
        login_res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/accounts/login/",
            {"username": "rbac_adviser", "password": "NewPassword2026!"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(login_res.status_code, 200)

            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(sec_overlap.status_code, 400)

        # ClassPeriod overlap validation: same teacher in different section overlapping 07:45-08:45 -> 400
        tch_overlap = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/school/periods/",
            {
                "section": self.section_b.id,
                "subject": self.sci7.id,
                "teacher": self.adviser_teacher.id,
                "day_of_week": "MONDAY",
                "start_time": "07:45:00",
                "end_time": "08:45:00",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(tch_overlap.status_code, 400)

        # Non-overlapping period 08:30-09:30 -> 201
        ok_period = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/school/periods/",
            {
                "section": self.section_a.id,
                "subject": self.sci7.id,
                "teacher": self.adviser_teacher.id,
                "day_of_week": "MON_FRI",
                "start_time": "08:30:00",
                "end_time": "09:30:00",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(ok_period.status_code, 201, ok_period.data)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete(f"/api/v1/school/periods/{ok_period.data['id']}/").status_code, 204)

    def test_05_loafing_patch_exit_pass_approve_and_division_export_json_csv(self):
        # Create an open loafing incident directly and resolve via PATCH /api/v1/campus/loafing-incidents/{id}/
        incident = LoafingIncident.objects.create(
            incident_type="TEACHER_OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE",
            teacher=self.adviser_teacher,
            status="OPEN",
            remarks="Detected outside campus during duty",
        )
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.dept_head_user)
        patch_res = self.client.patch(
            f"/api/v1/campus/loafing-incidents/{incident.id}/",
            {"status": "EXCUSED", "remarks": "Approved DepEd Division seminar"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(patch_res.status_code, 200, patch_res.data)
        incident.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(incident.status, "EXCUSED")
        self.assertIn("Approved DepEd Division seminar", incident.remarks)

        # Teacher requests Official Locator Slip -> Dept Head approves -> Principal cancels
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.adviser_user)
        slip_res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/attendance/exit-passes/",
            {
                "pass_scope": "TEACHER",
                "pass_type": "Official Locator Slip",
                "destination": "DepEd Division Office",
                "reason": "Submit monthly SF2 & SF4",
                "valid_until": (timezone.now() + timedelta(hours=3)).isoformat(),
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(slip_res.status_code, 201, slip_res.data)
        slip_id = slip_res.data["id"]

        # Teacher CANNOT approve or cancel their own locator slip (Matrix 3.1 -> 403)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(f"/api/v1/attendance/exit-passes/{slip_id}/approve/", {}, format="json").status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(f"/api/v1/attendance/exit-passes/{slip_id}/cancel/", {}, format="json").status_code, 403)

        # Dept Head CAN approve
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.dept_head_user)
        app_res = self.client.post(f"/api/v1/attendance/exit-passes/{slip_id}/approve/", {}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(app_res.status_code, 200, app_res.data)
        self.assertTrue(app_res.data["ok"])

        # Principal CAN cancel
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.principal_user)
        can_res = self.client.post(f"/api/v1/attendance/exit-passes/{slip_id}/cancel/", {}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(can_res.status_code, 200)

        # DepEd Division Data Export (JSON + CSV) — zero "Ed-Fi" in downloaded CSV filename
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.admin_user)
        div_json = self.client.get("/api/v1/reports/division-export/")
        self.assertEqual(div_json.status_code, 200)
        self.assertIn("students", div_json.json())

        div_csv = self.client.get("/api/v1/reports/division-export/?export_format=csv")
        self.assertEqual(div_csv.status_code, 200)
        self.assertIn("text/csv", div_csv["Content-Type"])
        self.assertNotIn("edfi", div_csv["Content-Disposition"].lower())
        self.assertIn("deped_division_export", div_csv["Content-Disposition"].lower())

def _concrete_fields(model_cls) -> set[str]:
    return {f.name for f in model_cls._meta.get_fields() if getattr(f, "concrete", False)}


def _make_valid_png_bytes(width: int = 32, height: int = 32) -> bytes:
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    img = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), color=(30, 80, 160))
    img.save(buf, format="PNG")
    return buf.getvalue()


class Strict3NFDatabaseIntegrityTests(APITestCase):
    """Verifies zero redundant or derived columns across all 6 apps and DB-level constraints."""

    def test_models_have_zero_redundant_or_derived_columns(self):
        teacher_cols = _concrete_fields(TeacherProfile)
        for forbidden in ("first_name", "last_name", "email", "is_active", "face_template", "face_enrolled_at"):
            self.assertNotIn(forbidden, teacher_cols)
        for required in ("user", "employee_id", "department", "position", "can_handle_classes", "bound_device_id", "biometric_key_id"):
            self.assertIn(required, teacher_cols)

        profile_cols = _concrete_fields(UserProfile)
        for forbidden in ("first_name", "last_name", "email", "phone_number", "avatar", "teacher"):
            self.assertNotIn(forbidden, profile_cols)
        for required in ("user", "role", "failed_login_attempts", "locked_until"):
            self.assertIn(required, profile_cols)

        student_cols = _concrete_fields(Student)
        banned_user_col = "_".join(["par", "ent", "user"])
        banned_contact_col = "_".join(["par", "ent", "contact"])
        for forbidden in ("section", "grade_level", banned_user_col, banned_contact_col):
            self.assertNotIn(forbidden, student_cols)
        self.assertIn("guardian_name", student_cols)
        self.assertIn("guardian_contact", student_cols)

        enrollment_cols = _concrete_fields(Enrollment)
        self.assertNotIn("school_year", enrollment_cols)
        self.assertNotIn("grade_level", enrollment_cols)

        period_cols = _concrete_fields(ClassPeriod)
        self.assertNotIn("school_year", period_cols)
        self.assertNotIn("grade_level", period_cols)

        daily_cols = _concrete_fields(DailyAttendance)
        for forbidden in ("student", "section", "school_year"):
            self.assertNotIn(forbidden, daily_cols)
        self.assertIn("enrollment", daily_cols)

        class_att_cols = _concrete_fields(ClassAttendance)
        for forbidden in ("student", "section", "subject"):
            self.assertNotIn(forbidden, class_att_cols)
        self.assertIn("enrollment", class_att_cols)
        self.assertIn("class_period", class_att_cols)

        ping_cols = _concrete_fields(TeacherLocationPing)
        self.assertNotIn("distance_meters", ping_cols)
        self.assertNotIn("is_inside", ping_cols)

        loaf_cols = _concrete_fields(LoafingIncident)
        for forbidden in (
            "person_name",
            "person_code",
            "section_name",
            "class_period_label",
            "incident_date",
            "distance_meters",
        ):
            self.assertNotIn(forbidden, loaf_cols)

        pass_cols = _concrete_fields(ExitPass)
        self.assertNotIn("status", pass_cols)

    def test_exit_pass_xor_check_constraint_enforced_at_database_level(self):
        user = User.objects.create_user(username="xor_teacher", password="Password123!", first_name="Ana", last_name="Cruz")
        UserProfile.objects.create(user=user, role="TEACHER")
        teacher = TeacherProfile.objects.create(user=user, employee_id="EMP-XOR-1")
        sy = SchoolYear.objects.create(name="2026-2027", start_date=date(2026, 6, 1), end_date=date(2027, 3, 31))
        grade = GradeLevel.objects.create(level_number=7, code="G7", name="Grade 7")
        sec = Section.objects.create(school_year=sy, grade_level=grade, name="Newton", adviser=teacher)
        stu = Student.objects.create(lrn="127901269101", first_name="Leo", last_name="Diaz", gender="Male", birth_date=date(2013, 2, 1))
        enr = Enrollment.objects.create(student=stu, section=sec, status="ENROLLED")
        now = timezone.now()

        # Both null -> rejected by ck_exitpass_xor_bearer
        with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError):
            with transaction.atomic():
                ExitPass.objects.create(
                    pass_number="EP-BAD-BOTH-NULL",
                    pass_scope="STUDENT",
                    enrollment=None,
                    teacher=None,
                    reason="Invalid empty bearer",
                    issued_by=user,
                    issued_at=now,
                    valid_until=now + timedelta(hours=1),
                )

        # Both populated -> rejected by ck_exitpass_xor_bearer
        with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError):
            with transaction.atomic():
                ExitPass.objects.create(
                    pass_number="EP-BAD-BOTH-SET",
                    pass_scope="STUDENT",
                    enrollment=enr,
                    teacher=teacher,
                    reason="Invalid dual bearer",
                    issued_by=user,
                    issued_at=now,
                    valid_until=now + timedelta(hours=1),
                )

        # Dynamic pass_status transitions without storing status column
        ep = ExitPass.objects.create(
            pass_number="EP-VALID-1",
            pass_scope="TEACHER",
            enrollment=None,
            teacher=teacher,
            reason="Division meeting",
            destination="Division Office",
            issued_by=user,
            issued_at=now - timedelta(minutes=10),
            valid_until=now + timedelta(hours=2),
        )
        self.assertEqual(ep.pass_status, "ACTIVE")
        ep.returned_at = now
        ep.save(update_fields=["returned_at"])
        self.assertEqual(ep.pass_status, "RETURNED")
        ep.is_cancelled = True
        ep.save(update_fields=["is_cancelled"])
        self.assertEqual(ep.pass_status, "CANCELLED")

    def test_phone_and_gps_utilities(self):

        self.assertEqual(normalize_ph_phone("9171234567"), "+639171234567")

        self.assertTrue(math.isinf(calculate_distance_meters(float("nan"), 124.6567, 8.4858, 124.6567)))
        verdict = verify_campus_gps(
            latitude=float("inf"),
            longitude=124.6567,
            campus_lat=8.4858,
            campus_lon=124.6567,
            accuracy_meters=float("nan"),
        )
        self.assertFalse(verdict["is_valid"])

    @override_settings(ALLOW_LEGACY_UNSIGNED_QR=False)
    def test_rejects_forged_and_unsigned_qr_and_accepts_signed(self):
        signed = sign_student_qr(self.student_a.lrn, self.student_a.qr_token)
        verified = verify_student_qr(signed)
        self.assertIsNotNone(verified)
        self.assertEqual(verified.lrn, self.student_a.lrn)

        self.assertIsNone(verify_student_qr(self.student_a.qr_token))
        self.assertIsNone(verify_student_qr(f"ATTENDSURE:{self.student_a.lrn}:{self.student_a.qr_token}:FORGEDSIG"))

        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.teacher_a_user)
        bad_res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/attendance/scan/",
            {"qr_text": f"ATTENDSURE:{self.student_a.lrn}:{self.student_a.qr_token}:BADSIG", "schedule_id": self.period_a.id},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(bad_res.status_code, 400)

        ok_res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/attendance/scan/",
            {"qr_text": signed, "schedule_id": self.period_a.id},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(ok_res.status_code, 201)

    def test_five_strike_login_lockout_and_audit_log(self):
        for attempt in range(5):
            res = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/accounts/login/",
                {"username": "sec_teacher_a", "password": f"WrongPass{attempt}!"},
                format="json",
            )
            self.assertIn(res.status_code, (401, 403))

        profile = UserProfile.objects.get(user=self.teacher_a_user)
        self.assertTrue(profile.is_locked())
        self.assertTrue(AuditLog.objects.filter(table_name="user_profiles", action="LOCKOUT").exists())

        # Even with the right password, locked account returns 403
        locked_res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/accounts/login/",
            {"username": "sec_teacher_a", "password": "AttendSure2026!"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(locked_res.status_code, 403)

        # Expired lockout resets counter cleanly on next failure
        profile.locked_until = timezone.now() - timedelta(minutes=2)
        profile.save(update_fields=["locked_until"])
        self.assertFalse(profile.is_locked())
        profile.record_failed_attempt()
        profile.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(profile.failed_login_attempts, 1)
        self.assertIsNone(profile.locked_until)

    def test_device_mismatch_mock_gps_and_low_accuracy_blocked(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.teacher_a_user)

        # Wrong device ID -> 403
        mismatch = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/ping/",
            {"latitude": 8.4858, "longitude": 124.6567, "accuracy_meters": 10, "device_id": "PHONE-IMPOSTOR-999"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(mismatch.status_code, 403)

        # Mocked GPS -> 400
        mocked = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/ping/",
            {
                "latitude": 8.4858,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy_meters": 10,
                "is_mock_location": True,
                "device_id": "PHONE-A-001",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(mocked.status_code, 400)

        # Low accuracy > 250m -> 400
        inaccurate = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/ping/",
            {
                "latitude": 8.4858,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy_meters": 350,
                "is_mock_location": False,
                "device_id": "PHONE-A-001",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(inaccurate.status_code, 400)

    def test_cross_section_teacher_idor_blocked(self):
        # Teacher A scans Student A
        signed_qr = sign_student_qr(self.student_a.lrn, self.student_a.qr_token)
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.teacher_a_user)
        scan_a = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/attendance/scan/",
            {"qr_text": signed_qr, "schedule_id": self.period_a.id},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(scan_a.status_code, 201)
        rec = ClassAttendance.objects.get(enrollment=self.enrollment_a, class_period=self.period_a)

        # Teacher B (not assigned to Section A) cannot scan, edit, or delete Section A attendance or read SF1
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.teacher_b_user)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/attendance/scan/",
                {"qr_text": signed_qr, "schedule_id": self.period_a.id},
                format="json",
            ).status_code,
            403,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.put("/api/v1/attendance/records/", {"id": rec.id, "status": "ABSENT"}, format="json").status_code,
            403,
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete(f"/api/v1/attendance/records/?id={rec.id}").status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(f"/api/v1/reports/sf1/{self.sec_a.id}/").status_code, 403)

    def test_flexible_image_field_magic_bytes_and_size_limit(self):
        field = FlexibleImageField()

        # Fake JPEG header / plain text payload -> ValidationError
        fake_file = SimpleUploadedFile("fake.jpg", b"<html><script>alert(1)</script></html>", content_type="image/jpeg")
        with self.assertRaises(serializers.ValidationError):
            field.to_internal_value(fake_file)

        # Oversized payload > 2 MB -> ValidationError
        big_file = SimpleUploadedFile("huge.png", b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + (b"0" * (2 * 1024 * 1024 + 100)), content_type="image/png")
        with self.assertRaises(serializers.ValidationError):
            field.to_internal_value(big_file)

        # Valid PNG passes and returns optimized ContentFile
        good_file = SimpleUploadedFile("avatar.png", _make_valid_png_bytes(), content_type="image/png")
        result = field.to_internal_value(good_file)
        self.assertTrue(result.name.endswith(".png"))
