    def test_teacher_outside_geofence_creates_alert_and_returning_auto_resolves(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.teacher_user)

        # 1. Check in inside campus
        checkin = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            {
                "action": "TIME_IN",
                "latitude": 8.4858,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy_meters": 10,
                "face_verified_on_device": True,
                "device_id": "GEO-PHONE-1",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(checkin.status_code, 201)
        self.assertEqual(checkin.data["zone_status"], "INSIDE")
        self.assertTrue(TeacherDailyAttendance.objects.filter(teacher=self.teacher).exists())

        # 2. Ping ~500m outside boundary without ExitPass -> LOAFING_ALERT + OPEN incident
        outside = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/ping/",
            {
                "latitude": 8.4905,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy_meters": 12,
                "device_id": "GEO-PHONE-1",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(outside.status_code, 201)
        self.assertEqual(outside.data["zone_status"], "LOAFING_ALERT")
        inc_id = outside.data["loafing_incident_id"]
        self.assertIsNotNone(inc_id)
        incident = LoafingIncident.objects.get(id=inc_id)
        self.assertEqual(incident.incident_type, "TEACHER_OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE")
        self.assertEqual(incident.status, "OPEN")

        # 3. Return inside campus -> auto-resolves open incident to RETURNED
        returned = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/ping/",
            {
                "latitude": 8.4858,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy_meters": 10,
                "device_id": "GEO-PHONE-1",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(returned.status_code, 201)
        self.assertEqual(returned.data["zone_status"], "INSIDE")
        incident.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(incident.status, "RETURNED")
        self.assertIsNotNone(incident.resolved_at)

    def test_teacher_outside_with_active_exit_pass_is_authorized_and_leader_can_resolve(self):
        now = timezone.now()
        # Teacher is clocked in on duty today before leaving on an official pass
        TeacherDailyAttendance.objects.create(
            teacher=self.teacher,
            boundary=self.boundary,
            attendance_date=timezone.localdate(),
            time_in=now - timedelta(hours=1),
            status="ON_TIME",
        )
        ExitPass.objects.create(
            pass_number="EP-GEO-AUTH",
            pass_scope="TEACHER",
            teacher=self.teacher,
            reason="Division briefing",
            destination="Division Office",
            issued_by=self.principal_user,
            issued_at=now - timedelta(minutes=15),
            valid_until=now + timedelta(hours=3),
        )

        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.teacher_user)
        authorized = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/ping/",
            {
                "latitude": 8.4910,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy_meters": 10,
                "device_id": "GEO-PHONE-1",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(authorized.status_code, 201)
        self.assertEqual(authorized.data["zone_status"], "AUTHORIZED_OUTSIDE")
        self.assertIsNone(authorized.data["loafing_incident_id"])
        self.assertEqual(LoafingIncident.objects.count(), 0)

        # Cancel pass -> next outside ping while clocked in raises LOAFING_ALERT
        ExitPass.objects.filter(pass_number="EP-GEO-AUTH").update(is_cancelled=True)
        alert = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/ping/",
            {
                "latitude": 8.4910,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy_meters": 10,
                "device_id": "GEO-PHONE-1",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(alert.data["zone_status"], "LOAFING_ALERT")
        inc_id = alert.data["loafing_incident_id"]

        # Non-leader teacher blocked from resolving (403)
        denied = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v1/campus/loafing/{inc_id}/resolve/",
            {"status": "EXCUSED", "remarks": "Self-excuse attempt"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(denied.status_code, 403)

        # Principal resolves incident (200)
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.principal_user)
        resolved = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v1/campus/loafing/{inc_id}/resolve/",
            {"status": "CONFIRMED_LOAFING", "remarks": "Confirmed unexcused absence"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(resolved.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(resolved.data["incident"]["status"], "CONFIRMED_LOAFING")

    def test_pre_clockin_outside_ping_is_off_duty_and_stale_pings_not_counted_today(self):
        from apps.campus.selectors import get_campus_boundary_overview
        from apps.reports.selectors import get_monthly_dtr_data

        # 1. Pre-clock-in foreground ping outside campus during school duty hours
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.teacher_user)
        pre_ping = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/ping/",
            {
                "latitude": 8.4950,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy_meters": 12,
                "device_id": "GEO-PHONE-1",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(pre_ping.status_code, 201)
        self.assertEqual(pre_ping.data["zone_status"], "OFF_DUTY")
        self.assertIsNone(pre_ping.data["loafing_incident_id"])
        self.assertEqual(LoafingIncident.objects.count(), 0)

        overview = get_campus_boundary_overview(user=self.principal_user)
        row = next(r for r in overview["teacher_list"] if r["teacher_id"] == self.teacher.id)
        self.assertTrue(row["is_online"])
        self.assertEqual(row["zone_status"], "OFF_DUTY")
        self.assertEqual(row["status"], "AWAY_OFF_DUTY")
        self.assertFalse(row["is_inside"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(row["distance_meters"])
        self.assertEqual(overview["verified_inside"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(overview["outside_count"], 1)

        # 2. Stale INSIDE ping from yesterday must NEVER show teacher as Inside Campus today
        TeacherLocationPing.objects.filter(teacher=self.teacher).delete()
        yesterday_dt = timezone.now() - timedelta(days=1)
        TeacherLocationPing.objects.create(
            teacher=self.teacher,
            boundary=self.boundary,
            latitude=8.4858,
            longitude=124.6567,
            accuracy_meters=8,
            zone_status="INSIDE",
            device_id="GEO-PHONE-1",
            recorded_at=yesterday_dt,
        )
        stale_overview = get_campus_boundary_overview(user=self.principal_user)
        stale_row = next(r for r in stale_overview["teacher_list"] if r["teacher_id"] == self.teacher.id)
        self.assertFalse(stale_row["is_online"])
        self.assertFalse(stale_row["is_inside"])
        self.assertIsNone(stale_row["distance_meters"])
        self.assertIsNone(stale_row["latitude"])
        self.assertIsNone(stale_row["longitude"])
        self.assertEqual(stale_row["zone_status"], "OFF_DUTY")
        self.assertEqual(stale_row["status"], "OFFLINE")
        self.assertEqual(
            stale_row["last_seen"],
            timezone.localtime(yesterday_dt).strftime("%b %d, %I:%M %p"),
        )
        self.assertEqual(stale_overview["verified_inside"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(stale_overview["outside_count"], 0)

        # 3. DTR verified check-in consistency: passive INSIDE ping without daily check-in must NOT inflate days_present
        TeacherLocationPing.objects.filter(teacher=self.teacher).delete()
        TeacherDailyAttendance.objects.filter(teacher=self.teacher).delete()
        local_today = timezone.localdate()
        tz = timezone.get_current_timezone()
        day_unverified = date(local_today.year, local_today.month, 2)
        day_verified = date(local_today.year, local_today.month, 3)

        # Unverified day: only a passive INSIDE ping
        TeacherLocationPing.objects.create(
            teacher=self.teacher,
            boundary=self.boundary,
            latitude=8.4858,
            longitude=124.6567,
            accuracy_meters=8,
            zone_status="INSIDE",
            recorded_at=timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(day_unverified, time(8, 15)), tz),
        )
        # Verified day: actual TeacherDailyAttendance check-in + afternoon INSIDE ping
        TeacherDailyAttendance.objects.create(
            teacher=self.teacher,
            boundary=self.boundary,
            attendance_date=day_verified,
            time_in=timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(day_verified, time(7, 45)), tz),
            status="ON_TIME",
        )
        TeacherLocationPing.objects.create(
            teacher=self.teacher,
            boundary=self.boundary,
            latitude=8.4858,
            longitude=124.6567,
            accuracy_meters=8,
            zone_status="INSIDE",
            recorded_at=timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(day_verified, time(16, 30)), tz),
        )

        dtr = get_monthly_dtr_data(
            user=self.teacher_user,
            month=local_today.month,
            year=local_today.year,
        )
        self.assertEqual(dtr["days_present"], 1)
        row_unverified = next(r for r in dtr["rows"] if r["day"] == 2)
        row_verified = next(r for r in dtr["rows"] if r["day"] == 3)
        self.assertNotEqual(row_unverified["status"], "PRESENT")
        self.assertEqual(row_unverified["am_arrival"], "")
        self.assertEqual(row_verified["status"], "PRESENT")
        self.assertEqual(row_verified["am_arrival"], "07:45")
        self.assertEqual(row_verified["pm_arrival"], "04:30")

    def test_student_cutting_class_and_expired_exit_pass_detection(self):
        today = timezone.localdate()
        now = timezone.now()

        # Student attended Period 1 but skipped Period 2 without an ExitPass
        ClassAttendance.objects.create(
            enrollment=self.enrollment,
            class_period=self.period1,
            attendance_date=today,
            scanned_at=now,
            status="PRESENT",
            recorded_by=self.teacher,
        )
        DailyAttendance.objects.create(
            enrollment=self.enrollment,
            attendance_date=today,
            status="PRESENT",
            recorded_by=self.teacher,
        )
        # Also create an overdue unreturned teacher exit pass
        ExitPass.objects.create(
            pass_number="EP-OVERDUE-1",
            pass_scope="TEACHER",
            teacher=self.teacher,
            reason="Errand",
            destination="Bank",
            issued_by=self.principal_user,
            issued_at=now - timedelta(hours=3),
            valid_until=now - timedelta(hours=1),
        )

        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.principal_user)
        audit = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/attendance/loafing-audit/",
            {"date": str(today), "section_id": self.section.id},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(audit.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(audit.data["created_cutting_incidents"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(audit.data["created_expired_pass_incidents"], 1)
        self.assertTrue(
            LoafingIncident.objects.filter(
                incident_type="STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS",
                enrollment=self.enrollment,
                class_period=self.period2,
            ).exists()
        )
        self.assertTrue(
            LoafingIncident.objects.filter(
                incident_type="EXPIRED_EXIT_PASS",
                teacher=self.teacher,
            ).exists()
        )

    def test_duplicate_bound_device_returns_403_instead_of_500(self):
        # self.teacher already owns "GEO-PHONE-1"; self.principal has no bound device yet.
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.principal_user)
        for endpoint, payload in (
            (
                "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
                {
                    "action": "TIME_IN",
                    "latitude": 8.4858,
                    "longitude": 124.6567,
                    "accuracy_meters": 10,
                    "face_verified_on_device": True,
                    "device_id": "GEO-PHONE-1",
                },
            ),
            (
                "/api/v1/campus/ping/",
                {
                    "latitude": 8.4858,
                    "longitude": 124.6567,
                    "accuracy_meters": 10,
                    "device_id": "GEO-PHONE-1",
                },
            ),
        ):
            res = self.client.post(endpoint, payload, format="json")
            self.assertEqual(res.status_code, 403)
            self.assertEqual(res.data["error_code"], "DEVICE_ALREADY_BOUND")
            self.principal.refresh_from_db()
            self.assertIsNone(self.principal.bound_device_id)
            self.teacher.refresh_from_db()
            self.assertEqual(self.teacher.bound_device_id, "GEO-PHONE-1")

    def test_biometric_key_enrollment_mismatch_and_device_reset(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.teacher_user)
        key_a = "a" * 64
        key_b = "b" * 64

        # 1. Rejected when on-device biometric verification reports False
        failed_bio = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            {
                "action": "TIME_IN",
                "latitude": 8.4858,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy_meters": 10,
                "biometric_verified_on_device": False,
                "biometric_key_id": key_a,
                "device_id": "GEO-PHONE-1",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(failed_bio.status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(failed_bio.data["error_code"], "BIOMETRIC_CHECK_FAILED")

        # 2. First check-in enrolls biometric_key_id
        now_ms = int(time_module.time() * 1000)
        first_in = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            {
                "action": "TIME_IN",
                "latitude": 8.4858,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy_meters": 10,
                "biometric_verified_on_device": True,
                "biometric_key_id": key_a,
                "biometric_proof": "f" * 64,
                "biometric_timestamp_ms": now_ms,
                "device_id": "GEO-PHONE-1",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(first_in.status_code, 201)
        self.assertTrue(first_in.data["biometric_enrolled"])
        self.assertTrue(first_in.data["just_enrolled_biometric"])
        self.teacher.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.teacher.biometric_key_id, key_a)
        self.assertTrue(AuditLog.objects.filter(table_name="teacher_profiles", action="BIO_ENROLL").exists())

        # 3. Matching key succeeds on TIME_OUT
        out_ok = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            {
                "action": "TIME_OUT",
                "latitude": 8.4858,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy_meters": 10,
                "biometric_verified_on_device": True,
                "biometric_key_id": key_a,
                "biometric_proof": "e" * 64,
                "biometric_timestamp_ms": int(time_module.time() * 1000),
                "device_id": "GEO-PHONE-1",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(out_ok.status_code, 201)
        self.assertFalse(out_ok.data["just_enrolled_biometric"])

        # 4. Mismatched biometric_key_id returns 403 BIOMETRIC_MISMATCH + AuditLog
        mismatch = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            {
                "action": "TIME_IN",
                "latitude": 8.4858,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy_meters": 10,
                "biometric_verified_on_device": True,
                "biometric_key_id": key_b,
                "biometric_proof": "d" * 64,
                "biometric_timestamp_ms": int(time_module.time() * 1000),
                "device_id": "GEO-PHONE-1",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(mismatch.status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(mismatch.data["error_code"], "BIOMETRIC_MISMATCH")
        self.assertTrue(AuditLog.objects.filter(table_name="teacher_profiles", action="BIO_REJECT").exists())

        # 5. Principal resets phone lock -> clears bound_device_id AND biometric_key_id
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.principal_user)
        reset_res = self.client.post(f"/api/v1/accounts/teachers/{self.teacher.id}/reset-device/", {}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(reset_res.status_code, 200)
        self.teacher.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertIsNone(self.teacher.bound_device_id)
        self.assertIsNone(self.teacher.biometric_key_id)

        # 6. Teacher pairs replacement phone & new biometric key cleanly
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.teacher_user)
        rebind = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            {
                "action": "TIME_IN",
                "latitude": 8.4858,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "accuracy_meters": 10,
                "biometric_verified_on_device": True,
                "biometric_key_id": key_b,
                "biometric_proof": "c" * 64,
                "biometric_timestamp_ms": int(time_module.time() * 1000),
                "device_id": "GEO-PHONE-NEW-2",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(rebind.status_code, 201)
        self.teacher.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.teacher.bound_device_id, "GEO-PHONE-NEW-2")
        self.assertEqual(self.teacher.biometric_key_id, key_b)


class PerformanceBoundedQueryTests(APITestCase):
    """Proves O(1) bounded SQL queries (zero N+1) on CampusOverviewView and OfflineQrSyncView."""

    def setUp(self):
        cache.clear()
        self.admin_user = User.objects.create_user(
            username="perf_admin", password="AttendSure2026!", first_name="Perf", last_name="Admin", is_staff=True, is_superuser=True
        )
        UserProfile.objects.create(user=self.admin_user, role="ADMIN")
        self.admin_teacher = TeacherProfile.objects.create(user=self.admin_user, employee_id="EMP-PERF-ADM")

        self.boundary = CampusBoundary.objects.create(
            campus_name="Perf Campus",
            center_latitude=Decimal("8.485800"),
            center_longitude=Decimal("124.656700"),
            radius_meters=150,
            is_active=True,
        )
        self.sy = SchoolYear.objects.create(
            name="2026-2027", start_date=date(2026, 6, 1), end_date=date(2027, 3, 31), is_active=True
        )
        self.grade = GradeLevel.objects.create(level_number=7, code="G7", name="Grade 7")
        self.section = Section.objects.create(
            school_year=self.sy, grade_level=self.grade, name="PerfSec", adviser=self.admin_teacher
        )
        self.subject = Subject.objects.create(code="PERF1", title="Perf Subject", grade_level=self.grade)
        self.period = ClassPeriod.objects.create(
            schedule_code="PERF-P1",
            section=self.section,
            subject=self.subject,
            teacher=self.admin_teacher,
            start_time=time(8, 0),
            end_time=time(9, 0),
        )

    def _create_teachers_with_pings(self, start_idx: int, count: int):
        now = timezone.now()
        for i in range(start_idx, start_idx + count):
            u = User.objects.create_user(username=f"perf_t_{i}", password="Password123!", first_name="T", last_name=f"User{i}")
            UserProfile.objects.create(user=u, role="TEACHER")
            tp = TeacherProfile.objects.create(user=u, employee_id=f"EMP-PERF-{i:03d}")
            TeacherLocationPing.objects.create(
                teacher=tp,
                boundary=self.boundary,
                latitude=Decimal("8.485810"),
                longitude=Decimal("124.656710"),
                accuracy_meters=8.0,
                zone_status="INSIDE",
                recorded_at=now,
            )

    def test_campus_overview_executes_in_constant_bounded_queries(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.admin_user)

        self._create_teachers_with_pings(1, 2)
        cache.clear()
        with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx_small:
            res_small = self.client.get("/api/v1/campus/overview/")
        self.assertEqual(res_small.status_code, 200)

        self._create_teachers_with_pings(3, 10)
        cache.clear()
        with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx_large:
            res_large = self.client.get("/api/v1/campus/overview/")
        self.assertEqual(res_large.status_code, 200)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(res_large.data["teacher_list"]), 12)

        # Constant O(1) query count regardless of 6x more teachers!
        self.assertLessEqual(len(ctx_large), len(ctx_small))
        self.assertLessEqual(len(ctx_large), 12)

    def test_offline_qr_sync_executes_in_constant_bounded_queries_and_is_idempotent(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.admin_user)
        now_iso = timezone.now().isoformat()

        def make_scans(start_idx: int, count: int) -> list[dict]:
            payloads = []
            for i in range(start_idx, start_idx + count):
                st = Student.objects.create(
                    lrn=f"12790126{i:04d}",
                    first_name="Batch",
                    last_name=f"Learner{i}",
                    gender="Male",
                    birth_date=date(2013, 1, 10),
                )
                Enrollment.objects.create(student=st, section=self.section, status="ENROLLED")
                payloads.append(
                    {
                        "qr_token": sign_student_qr(st.lrn, st.qr_token),
                        "schedule_id": self.period.id,
                        "scanned_at": now_iso,
                        "client_scan_uuid": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                    }
                )
            return payloads

        small_batch = make_scans(100, 2)
        with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx_small:
            res_small = self.client.post("/api/v1/attendance/offline-sync/", {"scans": small_batch}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(res_small.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(res_small.data["synced_count"], 2)

        large_batch = make_scans(200, 12)
        with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx_large:
            res_large = self.client.post("/api/v1/attendance/offline-sync/", {"scans": large_batch}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(res_large.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(res_large.data["synced_count"], 12)

        # Constant O(1) SQL count for 2 scans vs 12 scans (zero N+1 growth)!
        self.assertLessEqual(len(ctx_large), len(ctx_small))
        self.assertLessEqual(len(ctx_large), 12)

        # Re-submitting same UUIDs is strictly idempotent
        replay = self.client.post("/api/v1/attendance/offline-sync/", {"scans": large_batch}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(replay.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(replay.data["synced_count"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(replay.data["duplicate_count"], 12)

    def test_seed_competition_demo_is_idempotent_and_staff_only(self):
        call_command("seed_competition_demo", verbosity=0)
        first_students = Student.objects.count()
        call_command("seed_competition_demo", verbosity=0)
        second_students = Student.objects.count()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(first_students, 24)
        self.assertEqual(first_students, second_students)
        roles = set(UserProfile.objects.values_list("role", flat=True))
        self.assertTrue(roles.issubset({"ADMIN", "PRINCIPAL", "DEPT_HEAD", "TEACHER"}))

class LoginThrottle(AnonRateThrottle):
    scope = "login"


class AccountWriteThrottle(UserRateThrottle):
    rate = "30/minute"


def _format_audit_row(item: AuditLog) -> dict:
    return AuditLogSerializer(item).data


def _is_judge_demo_enabled() -> bool:
    return bool(getattr(settings, "DEBUG", False) or getattr(settings, "ENABLE_JUDGE_DEMO", False))


class LoginView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.AllowAny]
    throttle_classes = [LoginThrottle]

    def post(self, request):
        identifier = str(
            request.data.get("username")
            or request.data.get("identifier")
            or request.data.get("email")
            or ""
        ).strip()[:150]
        password = str(request.data.get("password") or "")

        payload = authenticate_with_identifier(
            identifier=identifier,
            password=password,
            request=request,
        )
        user_id = payload.get("user", {}).get("id")
        if user_id:
            drf_token, _ = Token.objects.get_or_create(user_id=user_id)
            payload["token"] = drf_token.key

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="auth_user",
            record_id=user_id or 0,
            action="LOGIN",
            new_data={
                "username": payload["user"]["username"],
                "role": payload["user"]["role"],
            },
        )
        return Response(payload, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class LogoutView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.AllowAny]

    def post(self, request):
        raw_refresh = str(request.data.get("refresh") or "").strip()
        if raw_refresh:
            try:
                RefreshToken(raw_refresh).blacklist()
            except TokenError:
                pass

        if request.user and request.user.is_authenticated:
            Token.objects.filter(user_id=request.user.id).delete()
            record_audit_log(
                request=request,
                table_name="auth_user",
                record_id=request.user.id,
                action="LOGOUT",
                new_data={"username": request.user.username},
            )
        return Response({"ok": True, "message": "Signed out."}, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

class DemoLoginView(APIView):
    """Signs in an existing active staff account ONLY when DEBUG or ENABLE_JUDGE_DEMO is True."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.AllowAny]
    throttle_classes = [LoginThrottle]

    ROLE_MAP = {
        "ADMIN": ("demo_admin", ["ADMIN"]),
        "PRINCIPAL": ("demo_principal", ["PRINCIPAL", "ADMIN"]),
        "DEPT_HEAD": ("demo_dept_head", ["DEPT_HEAD", "PRINCIPAL"]),
        "TEACHER": ("demo_teacher", ["TEACHER"]),
    }

    def post(self, request):
        if not _is_judge_demo_enabled():
            return Response(
                {"error": "Demo sign-in is turned off in production."},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )

        role_key = str(request.data.get("role") or "ADMIN").strip().upper()
        if role_key not in ALLOWED_ROLES:
            raise AppError(
                "INVALID_ROLE",
                "Invalid role selected. Allowed roles are ADMIN, PRINCIPAL, DEPT_HEAD, and TEACHER.",
                400,
            )

        preferred_username, allowed_roles = self.ROLE_MAP[role_key]
        base_qs = User.objects.select_related(
            "profile",
            "teacher_profile",
            "teacher_profile__department",
            "teacher_profile__position",
        ).filter(is_active=True)

        user_obj = base_qs.filter(username__iexact=preferred_username).first()
        if not user_obj:
            user_obj = base_qs.filter(profile__role__in=allowed_roles).order_by("id").first()
        if not user_obj:
            raise AppError(
                "ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND",
                "No active staff account exists in the database for this role yet.",
                404,
            )

        refresh = RefreshToken.for_user(user_obj)
        drf_token, _ = Token.objects.get_or_create(user_id=user_obj.id)
        session_user = build_user_session_payload(user=user_obj, request=request)

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="auth_user",
            record_id=user_obj.id,
            action="LOGIN",
            new_data={"username": user_obj.username, "mode": "DEMO"},
        )
        return Response(
            {
                "access": str(refresh.access_token),
                "refresh": str(refresh),
                "token": drf_token.key,
                "user": session_user,
            }
        )


class CurrentUserView(APIView):
    """Reads and updates the signed-in user's own profile."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    parser_classes = [MultiPartParser, FormParser, JSONParser]

    def get(self, request):
        return Response(build_user_session_payload(user=request.user, request=request))

    def put(self, request):
        payload = update_own_profile(
            user=request.user,
            data=request.data,
            files=request.FILES,
            request=request,
        )
        changed_keys = [
            strip_tags(str(k))[:50]
            for k in (request.data.keys() if hasattr(request.data, "keys") else ["profile"])
            if str(k) not in ("password", "csrfmiddlewaretoken")
        ]
        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="teacher_profiles",
            record_id=request.user.id,
            action="PROFILE",
            changed_fields=changed_keys or ["profile"],
        )
        return Response(payload)

    def patch(self, request):
        return self.put(request)


CurrentProfileView = CurrentUserView


class ChangePasswordView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    throttle_classes = [AccountWriteThrottle]

    def post(self, request):
        current_password = str(
            request.data.get("current_password") or request.data.get("old_password") or ""
        )
        new_password = str(request.data.get("new_password") or "")
        if not current_password or not new_password:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Both current password and new password are required."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )
        if not request.user.check_password(current_password):
            return Response(
                {"error": "Current password is incorrect."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )
        try:
            validate_password(new_password, user=request.user)
        except DjangoValidationError as exc:
            return Response({"error": " ".join(exc.messages)}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        request.user.set_password(new_password)
        request.user.save(update_fields=["password"])

        # Rotate DRF token so older sessions using the old token are signed out
        Token.objects.filter(user_id=request.user.id).delete()
        new_token = Token.objects.create(user=request.user)

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="auth_user",
            record_id=request.user.id,
            action="PASSWORD",
        )
        return Response({"ok": True, "message": "Password updated.", "token": new_token.key})


def _parse_int_id(raw) -> int | None:
    text = str(raw or "").strip()
    return int(text) if (text and text.isascii() and text.isdigit()) else None


class FieldAvailabilityView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    throttle_classes = [UserRateThrottle]

    def get(self, request):
        from apps.school.models import Room, Subject
        from apps.students.models import Student

        field = str(request.query_params.get("field") or "").strip().lower()
        value = str(request.query_params.get("value") or "").strip()[:150]
        exclude_id = _parse_int_id(request.query_params.get("exclude_id"))
        exclude_user_id = _parse_int_id(request.query_params.get("exclude_user_id"))
        exclude_teacher_id = _parse_int_id(request.query_params.get("exclude_teacher_id"))

        if not field or not value:
            return Response({"available": True, "is_taken": False, "field": field, "message": ""})

        taken = False
        message = ""

        if field == "username":
            qs = User.objects.filter(username__iexact=value)
            if exclude_user_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_user_id)
            elif exclude_teacher_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(teacher_profile__id=exclude_teacher_id)
            elif exclude_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_id)
            taken = qs.exists()
            if taken:
                message = "This username is already taken."
        elif field == "email":
            qs = User.objects.filter(email__iexact=value)
            if exclude_user_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_user_id)
            elif exclude_teacher_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(teacher_profile__id=exclude_teacher_id)
            elif exclude_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_id)
            taken = qs.exists()
            if taken:
                message = "This email address is already in use."
        elif field == "employee_id":
            qs = TeacherProfile.objects.filter(employee_id__iexact=value)
            if exclude_teacher_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_teacher_id)
            elif exclude_user_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(user_id=exclude_user_id)
            elif exclude_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_id)
            taken = qs.exists()
            if taken:
                message = "This Employee ID is already assigned."
        elif field in ("phone", "phone_number", "contact_number"):
            norm = normalize_ph_phone(value)
            if norm:
                qs = TeacherProfile.objects.filter(contact_number=norm)
                if exclude_teacher_id:
                    qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_teacher_id)
                elif exclude_user_id:
                    qs = qs.exclude(user_id=exclude_user_id)
                elif exclude_id:
                    qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_id)
                taken = qs.exists()
                if taken:
                    message = "This mobile number is already assigned to another staff account."
        elif field == "lrn":
            digits = re.sub(r"\D+", "", value)
            if len(digits) == 12:
                qs = Student.objects.filter(lrn=digits)
                if exclude_id:
                    qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_id)
                existing_student = qs.only("id", "first_name", "middle_name", "last_name", "suffix", "lrn").first()
                if existing_student:
                    taken = True
                    if is_school_leader(request.user):
                        message = f"LRN {digits} is already registered to {existing_student.full_name}."
                    else:
                        message = f"LRN {digits} is already registered to another student."
        elif field == "subject_code":
            qs = Subject.objects.filter(code__iexact=value)
            if exclude_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_id)
            taken = qs.exists()
            if taken:
                message = "A subject with this code already exists."
        elif field == "room_name":
            qs = Room.objects.filter(name__iexact=value)
            if exclude_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=exclude_id)
            taken = qs.exists()
            if taken:
                message = "A classroom with this name already exists."
        else:
            return Response({"available": True, "is_taken": False, "field": field, "message": ""})

        return Response(
            {
                "available": not taken,
                "is_taken": taken,
                "field": field,
                "message": message,
            }
        )


ValidateFieldView = FieldAvailabilityView


class ResetBoundDeviceView(APIView):
    """Clears the phone lock on a teacher profile so a new phone can be linked."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsAdminOrPrincipal]
    throttle_classes = [AccountWriteThrottle]

    def post(self, request, pk: int | None = None, **kwargs):
        target_id = pk or kwargs.get("teacher_id") or request.data.get("teacher_id")
        if not target_id or not str(target_id).isascii() or not str(target_id).isdigit():
            raise AppError("INVALID_ID", "A valid teacher ID is required.", 400)

        teacher = reset_teacher_bound_device(teacher_id=int(target_id))
        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name=teacher._meta.db_table,
            record_id=teacher.id,
            action="RESET_DEV",
            new_data={"employee_id": teacher.employee_id},
        )
        return Response({"ok": True, "message": f"Phone lock cleared for {teacher.full_name}."})

class TeacherDropdownView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        from apps.school.models import SchoolYear, Section
        from apps.school.selectors import format_section_label

        qs = (
            TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("user", "department", "position")
            .only(
                "id",
                "employee_id",
                "middle_name",
                "suffix",
                "contact_number",
                "photo",
                "can_handle_classes",
                "user__id",
                "user__username",
                "user__first_name",
                "user__last_name",
                "user__email",
                "user__is_active",
                "department__id",
                "department__name",
                "position__id",
                "position__title",
            )
            .filter(user__is_active=True)
            .order_by("user__last_name", "user__first_name")
        )

        active_sy = SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
        sec_qs = Section.objects.filter(is_active=True, adviser__isnull=False).select_related("grade_level")
        if active_sy:
            sec_qs = sec_qs.filter(school_year=active_sy)

        advised_map: dict[int, list[str]] = {}
        for sec in sec_qs.order_by("grade_level__level_number", "name"):
            label = format_section_label(sec.grade_level.name if sec.grade_level else "", sec.name)
            advised_map.setdefault(sec.adviser_id, []).append(label)

        return Response(
            TeacherDropdownSerializer(
                qs,
                many=True,
                context={"request": request, "advised_map": advised_map},
            ).data
        )


class TeacherProfileViewSet(AuditedModelViewSet):
    serializer_class = TeacherProfileSerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    parser_classes = [MultiPartParser, FormParser, JSONParser]

    def get_queryset(self):
        qs = TeacherProfile.objects.select_related(
            "user",
            "user__profile",
            "department",
            "position",
        ).order_by("user__last_name", "user__first_name")

        if not is_school_leader(self.request.user):
            return qs.filter(user_id=self.request.user.id)

        search = str(self.request.query_params.get("search") or "").strip()[:100]
        if search:
            qs = qs.filter(
                Q(employee_id__icontains=search)
                | Q(user__first_name__icontains=search)
                | Q(user__last_name__icontains=search)
                | Q(department__name__icontains=search)
            )

        active_only = str(self.request.query_params.get("is_active") or "").strip().lower()
        if active_only in ("1", "true", "yes"):
            qs = qs.filter(user__is_active=True)

        return qs

    def check_permissions(self, request):
        super().check_permissions(request)
        if request.method not in permissions.SAFE_METHODS:
            if getattr(self, "action", None) == "reset_device":
                if not is_admin_or_principal(request.user):
                    self.permission_denied(
                        request,
                        message="Only System Admins or School Principals can reset phone locks.",
                    )
            elif not is_system_admin(request.user):
                self.permission_denied(
                    request,
                    message="Only System Admins can add, edit, or delete teacher records.",
                )

    @action(
        detail=True,
        methods=["post"],
        url_path="reset-device",
        permission_classes=[permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsAdminOrPrincipal],
    )
    def reset_device(self, request, pk=None):
        teacher = self.get_object()
        reset_teacher_bound_device(teacher_id=teacher.id)
        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name=teacher._meta.db_table,
            record_id=teacher.id,
            action="RESET_DEV",
            new_data={"employee_id": teacher.employee_id},
        )
        return Response({"ok": True, "message": f"Phone lock cleared for {teacher.full_name}."})

class UserAccountViewSet(AuditedModelViewSet):
    serializer_class = UserAccountSerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    parser_classes = [MultiPartParser, FormParser, JSONParser]

    def get_queryset(self):
        qs = User.objects.select_related(
            "profile",
            "teacher_profile",
            "teacher_profile__department",
            "teacher_profile__position",
        ).order_by("username")

        if get_user_role(self.request.user) != "ADMIN" and not self.request.user.is_superuser:
            return qs.filter(id=self.request.user.id)

        search = str(self.request.query_params.get("search") or "").strip()[:100]
        if search:
            qs = qs.filter(
                Q(username__icontains=search)
                | Q(first_name__icontains=search)
                | Q(last_name__icontains=search)
                | Q(email__icontains=search)
            )
        return qs

    def check_permissions(self, request):
        super().check_permissions(request)
        if not is_system_admin(request.user):
            self.permission_denied(
                request, message="Only System Admins can view or manage staff user accounts."
            )

    def destroy(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        instance = self.get_object()
        if instance.id == request.user.id:
            raise AppError("CANNOT_DELETE_SELF", "You cannot delete your own active account.", 400)
        return super().destroy(request, *args, **kwargs)


class AuditLogListView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsAdminOrPrincipal]

    def get(self, request):
        limit_raw = str(request.query_params.get("limit") or "100").strip()
        limit = min(int(limit_raw), 500) if (limit_raw.isascii() and limit_raw.isdigit()) else 100

        qs = AuditLog.objects.select_related("performed_by").only(
            "id",
            "table_name",
            "record_id",
            "action",
            "client_ip",
            "user_agent",
            "changed_fields",
            "new_data",
            "created_at",
            "performed_by__id",
            "performed_by__username",
            "performed_by__first_name",
            "performed_by__last_name",
        )

        action_filter = str(request.query_params.get("action") or "").strip().upper()[:16]
        if action_filter and action_filter != "ALL":
            qs = qs.filter(action__iexact=action_filter)

        date_filter = str(request.query_params.get("date") or "").strip()
        if date_filter:
            try:
                parsed_date = datetime.strptime(date_filter, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
            except ValueError:
                parsed_date = None
            if parsed_date is not None:
                tz = timezone.get_current_timezone()
                start_dt = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(parsed_date, dt_time.min), tz)
                end_dt = start_dt + timedelta(days=1)
                qs = qs.filter(created_at__gte=start_dt, created_at__lt=end_dt)

        search_term = str(request.query_params.get("search") or "").strip()[:100]
        if search_term:
            search_q = (
                Q(performed_by__username__icontains=search_term)
                | Q(performed_by__first_name__icontains=search_term)
                | Q(performed_by__last_name__icontains=search_term)
                | Q(table_name__icontains=search_term)
                | Q(client_ip__icontains=search_term)
                | Q(action__icontains=search_term)
            )
            if search_term.isascii() and search_term.isdigit():
                search_q |= Q(record_id=int(search_term))
            lowered = search_term.lower()
            matched_tables = [
                tbl for tbl, label in AUDIT_MODULE_LABELS.items() if lowered in label.lower()
            ]
            if matched_tables:
                search_q |= Q(table_name__in=matched_tables)
            qs = qs.filter(search_q)

        logs = qs.order_by("-created_at")[:limit]
        results = AuditLogSerializer(logs, many=True).data
        return Response(
            {
                "results": results,
                "records": results,
                "count": len(results),
                "is_admin": is_admin_or_principal(request.user),
            }
        )

from datetime import datetime, time as dt_time
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Q
from django.utils import timezone

from apps.accounts.selectors import get_teacher_section_ids, resolve_teacher_for_user
from apps.campus.models import LoafingIncident
from apps.school.models import ClassPeriod, period_runs_on_weekday
from apps.students.models import Enrollment
from common.permissions import is_school_leader
from .models import ClassAttendance, DailyAttendance, ExitPass


@transaction.atomic
def detect_daily_student_cutting(
    *,
    target_date=None,
    section_id: int | None = None,
    user=None,
    force_all_periods: bool = False,
) -> dict:
    """
    Bulk, zero-N+1 student cutting detector for:
    1. STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS: student marked PRESENT/LATE in an earlier period today (or DailyAttendance)
       but cutting a subsequent active class period without an active ExitPass.
    2. EXPIRED_EXIT_PASS: unreturned, uncancelled ExitPass whose valid_until has already passed.
    """
    now = timezone.now()
    local_now = timezone.localtime(now)
    audit_date = target_date or local_now.date()
    audit_weekday = audit_date.isoweekday()
    is_past_date = audit_date < local_now.date()

    allowed_section_ids: set[int] | None = None
    if user is not None and not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        allowed_section_ids = get_teacher_section_ids(teacher) if teacher else set()

    # 1. Fetch active enrollments scoped by section / teacher permissions
    enr_qs = Enrollment.objects.filter(
        status__in=["ENROLLED", "TRANSFERRED_IN"],
        student__is_active=True,
    ).select_related("student", "section", "section__grade_level")
    if section_id:
        enr_qs = enr_qs.filter(section_id=section_id)
    if allowed_section_ids is not None:
        enr_qs = enr_qs.filter(section_id__in=allowed_section_ids)

    enrollments = list(enr_qs)
    enrollment_ids = [e.id for e in enrollments]
    section_ids = {e.section_id for e in enrollments}

    created_cutting = 0
    created_expired = 0

    if enrollment_ids:
        # 2. Fetch active class periods for relevant sections in 1 query,
        # then keep only periods scheduled to meet on audit_date's weekday.
        periods = [
            p
            for p in ClassPeriod.objects.filter(section_id__in=section_ids, is_active=True)
            .select_related("subject", "section")
            .order_by("section_id", "start_time", "id")
            if period_runs_on_weekday(p.day_of_week, audit_weekday)
        ]
        periods_by_section: dict[int, list[ClassPeriod]] = {}
        period_ids = []
        for p in periods:
            periods_by_section.setdefault(p.section_id, []).append(p)
            period_ids.append(p.id)

        eligible_section_ids = {
            sec_id for sec_id, sec_periods in periods_by_section.items() if len(sec_periods) >= 2
        }

        if eligible_section_ids:
            # 3. Fetch all ClassAttendance and DailyAttendance rows for audit_date in 2 queries
            class_rows = list(
                ClassAttendance.objects.filter(
                    attendance_date=audit_date,
                    enrollment_id__in=enrollment_ids,
                    class_period_id__in=period_ids,
                ).values("enrollment_id", "class_period_id", "status", "class_period__start_time")
            )
            daily_present_ids = set(
                DailyAttendance.objects.filter(
                    attendance_date=audit_date,
                    enrollment_id__in=enrollment_ids,
                    status__in=["PRESENT", "LATE"],
                ).values_list("enrollment_id", flat=True)
            )

            # Build lookup maps
            present_or_excused_pairs: set[tuple[int, int]] = set()
            explicit_absent_pairs: set[tuple[int, int]] = set()
            earliest_present_time: dict[int, dt_time] = {}
            started_period_ids: set[int] = set()

            for row in class_rows:
                enr_id = row["enrollment_id"]
                pid = row["class_period_id"]
                st = row["status"]
                started_period_ids.add(pid)
                if st in ("PRESENT", "LATE", "EXCUSED"):
                    present_or_excused_pairs.add((enr_id, pid))
                    if st in ("PRESENT", "LATE"):
                        daily_present_ids.add(enr_id)
                        p_start = row["class_period__start_time"]
                        if p_start is not None:
                            prev = earliest_present_time.get(enr_id)
                            if prev is None or p_start < prev:
                                earliest_present_time[enr_id] = p_start
                elif st == "ABSENT":
                    explicit_absent_pairs.add((enr_id, pid))

            # 4. Fetch non-cancelled ExitPasses for these enrollments that could overlap audit_date (1 query)
            day_start = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(audit_date, dt_time.min))
            day_end = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(audit_date, dt_time.max))
            student_passes_by_enr: dict[int, list[ExitPass]] = {}
            for ep in ExitPass.objects.filter(
                pass_scope="STUDENT",
                enrollment_id__in=enrollment_ids,
                is_cancelled=False,
                issued_at__lte=day_end,
                valid_until__gte=day_start,
            ):
                student_passes_by_enr.setdefault(ep.enrollment_id, []).append(ep)

            # 5. Fetch already-logged STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS incidents for audit_date (1 query)
            existing_cutting_pairs = set(
                LoafingIncident.objects.filter(
                    incident_type="STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS",
                    detected_at__date=audit_date,
                    enrollment_id__in=enrollment_ids,
                ).values_list("enrollment_id", "class_period_id")
            )

            new_incidents: list[LoafingIncident] = []
            current_tz = timezone.get_current_timezone()

            for enr in enrollments:
                if enr.id not in daily_present_ids:
                    continue
                sec_periods = periods_by_section.get(enr.section_id, [])
                if len(sec_periods) < 2:
                    continue

                first_seen_time = earliest_present_time.get(enr.id)
                enr_passes = student_passes_by_enr.get(enr.id, [])

                for period in sec_periods:
                    if (enr.id, period.id) in present_or_excused_pairs:
                        continue
                    if (enr.id, period.id) in existing_cutting_pairs:
                        continue

                    # Only flag periods that follow an earlier presence (or where roll-call ran / time passed)
                    is_subsequent = first_seen_time is not None and period.start_time > first_seen_time
                    period_elapsed = (
                        force_all_periods
                        or is_past_date
                        or (period.id in started_period_ids)
                        or ((enr.id, period.id) in explicit_absent_pairs)
                        or (local_now.time() >= period.start_time)
                    )
                    if not (is_subsequent or period_elapsed):
                        continue
                    if first_seen_time is not None and period.start_time < first_seen_time and period.id not in started_period_ids:
                        continue

                    # Check if an active ExitPass covers this period
                    period_start_dt = timezone.make_aware(
                        datetime.combine(audit_date, period.start_time), current_tz
                    )
                    period_end_dt = timezone.make_aware(
                        datetime.combine(audit_date, period.end_time), current_tz
                    )
                    covered_by_pass = any(
                        ep.issued_at <= period_end_dt
                        and ep.valid_until >= period_start_dt
                        and (ep.returned_at is None or ep.returned_at >= period_start_dt)
                        for ep in enr_passes
                    )
                    if covered_by_pass:
                        continue

                    subj_label = period.subject.code if period.subject_id else "Class"
                    new_incidents.append(
                        LoafingIncident(
                            incident_type="STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS",
                            status="OPEN",
                            enrollment=enr,
                            class_period=period,
                            detected_at=now,
                            remarks=f"Present earlier on {audit_date} but missing from {subj_label} without an exit pass.",
                        )
                    )
                    existing_cutting_pairs.add((enr.id, period.id))

            if new_incidents:
                LoafingIncident.objects.bulk_create(new_incidents)
                created_cutting = len(new_incidents)

    # 6. Detect EXPIRED_EXIT_PASS incidents (overdue, unreturned, uncancelled passes)
    overdue_qs = ExitPass.objects.filter(
        is_cancelled=False,
        returned_at__isnull=True,
        valid_until__lt=now,
    ).select_related("enrollment", "teacher")
    if allowed_section_ids is not None:
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        overdue_qs = overdue_qs.filter(
            Q(enrollment__section_id__in=allowed_section_ids)
            | (Q(teacher=teacher) if teacher else Q(pk__isnull=True))
        )

    overdue_passes = list(overdue_qs[:200])
    if overdue_passes:
        overdue_ids = [ep.id for ep in overdue_passes]
        existing_pass_incidents = set(
            LoafingIncident.objects.filter(
                incident_type="EXPIRED_EXIT_PASS",
                exit_pass_id__in=overdue_ids,
            ).values_list("exit_pass_id", flat=True)
        )
        expired_incidents = [
            LoafingIncident(
                incident_type="EXPIRED_EXIT_PASS",
                status="OPEN",
                teacher=ep.teacher,
                enrollment=ep.enrollment,
                exit_pass=ep,
                detected_at=now,
                remarks=f"Exit pass #{ep.pass_number} expired without a recorded return.",
            )
            for ep in overdue_passes
            if ep.id not in existing_pass_incidents
        ]
        if expired_incidents:
            LoafingIncident.objects.bulk_create(expired_incidents)
            created_expired = len(expired_incidents)

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "audit_date": str(audit_date),
        "created_cutting_incidents": created_cutting,
        "created_expired_pass_incidents": created_expired,
        "total_created": created_cutting + created_expired,
    }


# Backwards-compatible alias for existing callers and tests
detect_daily_student_loafing = detect_daily_student_cutting

import uuid
from django.conf import settings
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import CheckConstraint, Q, UniqueConstraint
from django.utils import timezone

ATTENDANCE_STATUS_CHOICES = [
    ("PRESENT", "Present"),
    ("LATE", "Late"),
    ("ABSENT", "Absent"),
    ("EXCUSED", "Excused"),
]

SCAN_METHOD_CHOICES = [
    ("QR", "Built-In Camera QR Scan"),
    ("MANUAL", "Manual Class List Entry"),
]

PASS_SCOPE_CHOICES = [
    ("STUDENT", "Student"),
    ("TEACHER", "Teacher"),
]


class DailyAttendance(models.Model):
    """
    Strict 3NF DailyAttendance:
    - Links to Enrollment (which determines Student, Section, GradeLevel, and SchoolYear).
    - Zero redundant student, section, or school_year columns.
    """

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    enrollment = models.ForeignKey(
        "students.Enrollment",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="daily_attendances",
    )
    attendance_date = models.DateField(default=timezone.localdate, db_index=True)
    time_in = models.TimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    status = models.CharField(max_length=12, choices=ATTENDANCE_STATUS_CHOICES, default="PRESENT", db_index=True)
    recorded_by = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.TeacherProfile",
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="recorded_daily_attendances",
    )
    remarks = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, default="")
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "daily_attendance"
        constraints = [
            UniqueConstraint(fields=["enrollment", "attendance_date"], name="uq_daily_att_enrollment_date")
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["attendance_date", "status"], name="idx_dailyatt_date_status"),
        ]


class ClassAttendance(models.Model):
    """
    Strict 3NF ClassAttendance:
    - Links strictly to Enrollment + ClassPeriod + attendance_date.
    - Zero redundant student, section, or subject columns.
    """

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    enrollment = models.ForeignKey(
        "students.Enrollment",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="class_attendances",
    )

        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="attendance_records",
    )
    attendance_date = models.DateField(default=timezone.localdate, db_index=True)
    scanned_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now, db_index=True)
    status = models.CharField(max_length=12, choices=ATTENDANCE_STATUS_CHOICES, default="PRESENT")
    scan_method = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=SCAN_METHOD_CHOICES, default="QR")
    recorded_by = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.TeacherProfile",
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="recorded_class_scans",
    )
    client_scan_uuid = models.UUIDField(unique=True, null=True, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "class_attendance"
        constraints = [
            UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["enrollment", "class_period", "attendance_date"],
                name="uq_class_att_enrollment_period_date",
            )
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["class_period", "attendance_date"], name="idx_clsatt_period_date"),
            models.Index(fields=["attendance_date", "status"], name="idx_clsatt_date_status"),
        ]


class ExitPass(models.Model):
    """
    Strict 3NF ExitPass:
    - CheckConstraint guarantees exactly one bearer: either enrollment (STUDENT) or teacher (TEACHER).
    - No stored time-dependent status column; pass_status is computed dynamically from
      is_cancelled, returned_at, and valid_until vs current time.
    """

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    pass_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, unique=True, db_index=True)
    pass_scope = models.CharField(max_length=12, choices=PASS_SCOPE_CHOICES, db_index=True)
    enrollment = models.ForeignKey(
        "students.Enrollment",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="exit_passes",
    )
    teacher = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.TeacherProfile",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="exit_passes",
    )
    pass_type = models.CharField(max_length=60, default="Exit Permit")
    reason = models.TextField()
    destination = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, default="")
    attachment = models.FileField(upload_to="exit_passes/", null=True, blank=True)
    issued_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="issued_exit_passes",
    )
    issued_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    valid_until = models.DateTimeField()
    returned_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    is_cancelled = models.BooleanField(default=False)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "exit_passes"
        ordering = ["-issued_at"]
        constraints = [
            CheckConstraint(
                condition=(
                    (Q(pass_scope="STUDENT", enrollment__isnull=False, teacher__isnull=True))
                    | (Q(pass_scope="TEACHER", teacher__isnull=False, enrollment__isnull=True))
                ),
                name="ck_exitpass_xor_bearer",
            )
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(
                fields=["is_cancelled", "returned_at", "valid_until"],
                name="idx_exitpass_state_window",
            ),
        ]

    @property
    def pass_status(self) -> str:
        if self.is_cancelled:
            return "CANCELLED"
        if self.returned_at is not None:
            return "RETURNED"
        if self.valid_until and timezone.now() > self.valid_until:
            return "OVERDUE"
        return "ACTIVE"

    @property
    def is_currently_valid(self) -> bool:
        now = timezone.now()
        return (
            not self.is_cancelled
            and self.returned_at is None
            and self.issued_at <= now <= self.valid_until
        )

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if not self.pass_number:
            self.pass_number = f"EP-{timezone.localdate().strftime('%Y%m%d')}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6].upper()}"
        if not self.pass_scope:
            self.pass_scope = "STUDENT" if self.enrollment_id else "TEACHER"
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

from django.db.models import Count, Q
from django.utils import timezone

    get_teacher_enrollment_ids,
    get_teacher_section_ids,
    resolve_teacher_for_user,
)
