def format_class_list_items(
    enrollments,
    request=None,
    period_logs=None,
    daily_logs=None,
    period_id=None,
    period_record_ids=None,
) -> list[dict]:
    period_logs = period_logs or {}
    daily_logs = daily_logs or {}
    period_record_ids = period_record_ids or {}
    items = []
    for enr in enrollments:
        st = enr.student
        items.append(
            {
                "id": st.id,
                "student_id": st.id,
                "enrollment_id": enr.id,
                "lrn": st.lrn,
                "full_name": st.full_name,
                "name": st.full_name,
                "gender": st.gender,
                "sex": st.gender,
                "photo_url": build_media_url(st.photo, request),
                "attendance_status": (
                    (period_logs.get((period_id, enr.id)) if period_id else period_logs.get(enr.id))
                    or daily_logs.get(enr.id)
                    or "UNSCANNED"
                ),
                "attendance_record_id": (
                    period_record_ids.get((period_id, enr.id))
                    if period_id
                    else period_record_ids.get(enr.id)
                ),
                "guardian_contact": st.guardian_contact,
                "qr_token": st.qr_token,
                "qr_payload": sign_student_qr(st.lrn, st.qr_token),
            }
        )
    return items


def get_assigned_classes_with_class_lists(
    *,
    user,
    view_all: bool = False,
    include_students: bool = True,
    request=None,
) -> list[dict]:
    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    leader = is_school_leader(user)
    today = timezone.localdate()

    periods_qs = ClassPeriod.objects.none()
    extra_sections_qs = Section.objects.none()

    if teacher and not view_all:
        own_periods = ClassPeriod.objects.filter(
            Q(teacher=teacher) | Q(section__adviser=teacher),
            is_active=True,
        ).distinct()
        own_advisory = Section.objects.filter(adviser=teacher, is_active=True)

        if own_periods.exists() or own_advisory.exists():
            periods_qs = own_periods
            extra_sections_qs = own_advisory
        elif leader:
            periods_qs = ClassPeriod.objects.filter(is_active=True)
            extra_sections_qs = Section.objects.filter(is_active=True)
    elif leader:
        periods_qs = ClassPeriod.objects.filter(is_active=True)
        extra_sections_qs = Section.objects.filter(is_active=True)

    periods = list(
        periods_qs.select_related(
            "section", "section__grade_level", "subject", "teacher", "teacher__user"
        ).order_by("start_time")
    )
    covered_section_ids = {p.section_id for p in periods if p.section_id}
    extra_sections = list(
        extra_sections_qs.exclude(id__in=covered_section_ids)
        .select_related("grade_level")
        .order_by("grade_level__level_number", "name")
    )

    all_section_ids = covered_section_ids | {s.id for s in extra_sections}
    if not all_section_ids:
        return []

    if not include_students:
        counts_by_sec = dict(
            Enrollment.objects.filter(
                section_id__in=all_section_ids, status="ENROLLED", student__is_active=True
            )
            .values("section_id")
            .annotate(cnt=Count("id"))
            .values_list("section_id", "cnt")
        )
        results = []
        for p in periods:
            if not p.section:
                continue
            start_s = str(p.start_time)[:5] if p.start_time else ""
            end_s = str(p.end_time)[:5] if p.end_time else ""
            cnt = counts_by_sec.get(p.section_id, 0)
            results.append(
                {
                    "id": p.id,
                    "schedule_id": p.id,
                    "section_id": p.section_id,
                    "name": p.section.name,
                    "section_name": p.section.name,
                    "grade_level": p.section.grade_level.name if p.section.grade_level else "",
                    "subject_code": p.subject.code if p.subject else "",
                    "subject_title": p.subject.title if p.subject else "",
                    "room": p.section.room_name,
                    "start_time": start_s,
                    "end_time": end_s,
                    "time_display": f"{start_s} - {end_s}".strip(" -"),
                    "total_students": cnt,
                    "students": [],
                    "is_adviser": bool(teacher and p.section.adviser_id == teacher.id),
                }
            )
        return results

    enrollments = list(
        Enrollment.objects.filter(
            section_id__in=all_section_ids, status="ENROLLED", student__is_active=True
        )
        .select_related("student")
        .order_by("student__last_name", "student__first_name")
    )
    enr_by_sec: dict[int, list[Enrollment]] = {}
    all_enr_ids = []
    for enr in enrollments:
        enr_by_sec.setdefault(enr.section_id, []).append(enr)
        all_enr_ids.append(enr.id)

    period_logs = {}
    period_record_ids = {}
    for row in ClassAttendance.objects.filter(
        attendance_date=today,
        enrollment_id__in=all_enr_ids,
    ).values("id", "class_period_id", "enrollment_id", "status"):
        key = (row["class_period_id"], row["enrollment_id"])
        period_logs[key] = row["status"]
        period_record_ids[key] = row["id"]

    daily_logs = dict(
        DailyAttendance.objects.filter(
            attendance_date=today,
            enrollment_id__in=all_enr_ids,
        ).values_list("enrollment_id", "status")
    )

    results = []
    for p in periods:
        if not p.section:
            continue
        class_list = format_class_list_items(
            enr_by_sec.get(p.section_id, []),
            request=request,
            period_logs=period_logs,
            daily_logs=daily_logs,
            period_id=p.id,
            period_record_ids=period_record_ids,
        )
        start_s = str(p.start_time)[:5] if p.start_time else ""
        end_s = str(p.end_time)[:5] if p.end_time else ""
        results.append(
            {
                "id": p.id,
                "schedule_id": p.id,
                "section_id": p.section_id,
                "name": p.section.name,
                "section_name": p.section.name,
                "grade_level": p.section.grade_level.name if p.section.grade_level else "",
                "subject_code": p.subject.code if p.subject else "",
                "subject_name": p.subject.title if p.subject else "",
                "subject_title": p.subject.title if p.subject else "",
                "room": p.section.room_name,
                "start_time": start_s,
                "end_time": end_s,
                "time_display": f"{start_s} - {end_s}".strip(" -"),
                "total_students": len(class_list),
                "students": class_list,
                "is_adviser": bool(teacher and p.section.adviser_id == teacher.id),
            }
        )

    for sec in extra_sections:
        class_list = format_class_list_items(
            enr_by_sec.get(sec.id, []), request=request, daily_logs=daily_logs
        )
        results.append(
            {
                "id": sec.id,
                "schedule_id": sec.id,
                "section_id": sec.id,
                "name": sec.name,
                "section_name": sec.name,
                "grade_level": sec.grade_level.name if sec.grade_level else "",
                "subject_code": "ADV",
                "subject_name": "Advisory Homeroom",
                "subject_title": "Advisory Homeroom",
                "room": sec.room_name,
                "start_time": "",
                "end_time": "",
                "time_display": "Homeroom",
                "total_students": len(class_list),
                "students": class_list,
                "is_adviser": bool(teacher and sec.adviser_id == teacher.id),
            }
        )

    return results


def get_section_class_list(*, user, section_id: int | None = None, request=None) -> list[dict]:
    if not section_id:
        return get_assigned_classes_with_class_lists(user=user, request=request)

    if not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        if not teacher or section_id not in get_teacher_section_ids(teacher):
            return []

    today = timezone.localdate()
    enrollments = list(
        Enrollment.objects.filter(
            section_id=section_id, status="ENROLLED", student__is_active=True
        )
        .select_related("student")
        .order_by("student__last_name", "student__first_name")
    )
    enr_ids = [e.id for e in enrollments]

    period_logs = dict(
        ClassAttendance.objects.filter(enrollment_id__in=enr_ids, attendance_date=today).values_list(
            "enrollment_id", "status"
        )
    )
    daily_logs = dict(
        DailyAttendance.objects.filter(enrollment_id__in=enr_ids, attendance_date=today).values_list(
            "enrollment_id", "status"
        )
    )
    return format_class_list_items(
        enrollments, request=request, period_logs=period_logs, daily_logs=daily_logs
    )


def get_adviser_matrix(*, user, section_id: int | None = None, target_date=None, request=None) -> dict:
    today = timezone.localdate()
    active_date = target_date or today
    active_weekday = active_date.isoweekday()
    now_time = timezone.localtime().time()
    is_past_date = active_date < today
    is_future_date = active_date > today
    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    leader = is_school_leader(user)

    advisory_ids = (
        set(Section.objects.filter(adviser=teacher, is_active=True).values_list("id", flat=True))
        if teacher
        else set()
    )

    if leader:
        sections_qs = (
            Section.objects.filter(is_active=True)
            .select_related("grade_level")
            .order_by("grade_level__level_number", "name")
        )
    elif teacher:
        sections_qs = (
            Section.objects.filter(id__in=get_teacher_section_ids(teacher), is_active=True)
            .select_related("grade_level")
            .order_by("grade_level__level_number", "name")
        )
    else:
        sections_qs = Section.objects.none()

    available = [
        {
            "id": s.id,
            "name": s.name,
            "grade_level": s.grade_level.name if s.grade_level else "",
            "is_adviser": s.id in advisory_ids,
        }
        for s in sections_qs
    ]

    target = (
        sections_qs.filter(id=section_id).first()
        if section_id
        else (sections_qs.filter(id__in=advisory_ids).first() or sections_qs.first())
    )
    if not target:
        return {
            "date": str(active_date),
            "has_advisory_class": False,
            "is_adviser": False,
            "available_sections": available,
            "schedules": [],
            "matrix": [],
        }

    periods = [
        p
        for p in ClassPeriod.objects.filter(section=target, is_active=True)
        .select_related("subject", "teacher", "teacher__user")
        .order_by("start_time")
        if period_runs_on_weekday(p.day_of_week, active_weekday)
    ]
    period_ids = [p.id for p in periods]
    enrollments = list(
        Enrollment.objects.filter(section=target, status="ENROLLED", student__is_active=True)
        .select_related("student")
        .order_by("student__last_name", "student__first_name")
    )
    enr_ids = [e.id for e in enrollments]

    log_map: dict[tuple[int, int], tuple[str, str]] = {}
    first_seen_map: dict[int, str] = {}
    started_period_ids: set[int] = set()

    on_campus_enr_ids = set(
        DailyAttendance.objects.filter(
            attendance_date=active_date,
            enrollment_id__in=enr_ids,
            status__in=["PRESENT", "LATE"],
        ).values_list("enrollment_id", flat=True)
    )

    attendance_rows = (
        ClassAttendance.objects.filter(
            attendance_date=active_date,
            enrollment_id__in=enr_ids,
            class_period_id__in=period_ids,
        )
        .values("enrollment_id", "class_period_id", "status", "scanned_at", "class_period__subject__code")
        .order_by("scanned_at")
    )

    for row in attendance_rows:
        started_period_ids.add(row["class_period_id"])
        t_str = timezone.localtime(row["scanned_at"]).strftime("%I:%M %p") if row["scanned_at"] else ""
        st_code = row["status"]
        log_map[(row["enrollment_id"], row["class_period_id"])] = (st_code, t_str)

        if st_code in ("PRESENT", "LATE"):
            on_campus_enr_ids.add(row["enrollment_id"])
            if row["enrollment_id"] not in first_seen_map:
                subj_code = row["class_period__subject__code"] or "CLASS"
                first_seen_map[row["enrollment_id"]] = f"{t_str} ({subj_code})" if t_str else subj_code

    matrix = []
    total_periods = len(periods)

    for idx, enr in enumerate(enrollments, start=1):
        st = enr.student
        attended = cutting = 0
        in_campus = enr.id in on_campus_enr_ids
        subj_cells = []

        for p in periods:
            rec = log_map.get((enr.id, p.id))
            if rec:
                st_status, scan_t = rec
                if st_status in ("PRESENT", "LATE", "EXCUSED"):
                    attended += 1
                elif st_status == "ABSENT" and in_campus:
                    st_status = "CUTTING"
                    cutting += 1
            else:
                scan_t = ""
                period_elapsed = (
                    p.id in started_period_ids
                    or is_past_date
                    or (not is_future_date and bool(p.start_time and now_time >= p.start_time))
                )
                if in_campus and period_elapsed:
                    st_status = "CUTTING"
                    cutting += 1
                else:
                    st_status = "UNSCANNED"

            subj_cells.append(
                {
                    "schedule_id": p.id,
                    "subject_code": p.subject.code if p.subject else "SUB",
                    "status": st_status,
                    "time": scan_t,
                }
            )

        campus_status = first_seen_map.get(enr.id) or ("Present Today" if in_campus else "Not Seen Yet")

        matrix.append(
            {
                "number": idx,
                "student_id": st.id,
                "enrollment_id": enr.id,
                "student_name": st.full_name,
                "lrn": st.lrn,
                "photo_url": build_media_url(st.photo, request),
                "campus_status": campus_status,
                "presence_state": "ACTIVE" if in_campus else "NONE",
                "attended_count": attended,
                "cutting_count": cutting,
                "total_subjects": total_periods,
                "compliance_rate": round((attended / total_periods) * 100) if total_periods else 0,
                "subjects": subj_cells,
            }
        )

    schedules_list = [
        {
            "schedule_id": p.id,
            "subject_code": p.subject.code if p.subject else "",
            "subject_name": p.subject.title if p.subject else "",
            "teacher_name": p.teacher.full_name if p.teacher else "Unassigned",
            "time_window": f"{str(p.start_time)[:5]} - {str(p.end_time)[:5]}" if p.start_time else "",
        }
        for p in periods
    ]

    return {
        "date": str(active_date),
        "has_advisory_class": True,
        "is_adviser": target.id in advisory_ids,
        "section_id": target.id,
        "section_name": target.name,
        "grade_level": target.grade_level.name if target.grade_level else "",
        "total_students": len(enrollments),
        "available_sections": available,
        "schedules": schedules_list,
        "matrix": matrix,
    }


def get_attendance_logs(
    *,
    user,
    target_date,
    section_id: int | None = None,
    period_id: int | None = None,
) -> list[dict]:
    qs = (
        ClassAttendance.objects.filter(attendance_date=target_date)
        .select_related(
            "enrollment",
            "enrollment__student",
            "class_period",
            "class_period__subject",
            "class_period__section",
            "class_period__section__grade_level",
        )
        .order_by("-scanned_at")
    )

    if not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        if not teacher:
            return []
        qs = qs.filter(enrollment_id__in=get_teacher_enrollment_ids(teacher))

    if section_id:
        qs = qs.filter(class_period__section_id=section_id)
    if period_id:
        qs = qs.filter(class_period_id=period_id)

    return [
        {
            "id": item.id,
            "enrollment_id": item.enrollment_id,
            "student_id": item.enrollment.student_id,
            "student_name": item.enrollment.student.full_name,
            "lrn": item.enrollment.student.lrn,
            "schedule_id": item.class_period_id,
            "subject_code": item.class_period.subject.code if (item.class_period and item.class_period.subject) else "",
            "section": format_section_label(
                item.class_period.section.grade_level.name
                if (item.class_period and item.class_period.section and item.class_period.section.grade_level)
                else "",
                item.class_period.section.name if (item.class_period and item.class_period.section) else "",
            ),
            "attendance_date": str(item.attendance_date),
            "status": item.status,
            "scan_method": item.scan_method,
            "scanned_at": timezone.localtime(item.scanned_at).strftime("%I:%M:%S %p"),
        }
        for item in qs[:300]
    ]


def get_exit_passes_for_user(*, user, status_filter: str = "ALL", search: str = ""):
    now = timezone.now()
    qs = ExitPass.objects.select_related(
        "enrollment",
        "enrollment__student",
        "enrollment__section",
        "enrollment__section__grade_level",
        "teacher",
        "teacher__user",
        "issued_by",
    ).order_by("-issued_at")

    if status_filter and status_filter.upper() != "ALL":
        clean_st = status_filter.upper()
        if clean_st == "ACTIVE":
            qs = qs.filter(is_cancelled=False, returned_at__isnull=True, valid_until__gte=now)
        elif clean_st == "RETURNED":
            qs = qs.filter(is_cancelled=False, returned_at__isnull=False)
        elif clean_st in ("OVERDUE", "EXPIRED"):
            qs = qs.filter(is_cancelled=False, returned_at__isnull=True, valid_until__lt=now)
        elif clean_st in ("CANCELLED", "DECLINED"):
            qs = qs.filter(is_cancelled=True)

    if search:
        qs = qs.filter(
            Q(pass_number__icontains=search)
            | Q(enrollment__student__first_name__icontains=search)
            | Q(enrollment__student__last_name__icontains=search)
            | Q(teacher__user__first_name__icontains=search)
            | Q(teacher__user__last_name__icontains=search)
            | Q(reason__icontains=search)
            | Q(destination__icontains=search)
        )

    if not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        if not teacher:
            return qs.none()
        qs = qs.filter(
            Q(teacher=teacher)
            | Q(issued_by=user)
            | Q(enrollment_id__in=get_teacher_enrollment_ids(teacher))
        )
    return qs

import os
from datetime import timedelta
from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework import serializers

    get_teacher_enrollment_ids,

ALLOWED_PROOF_EXTS = {".pdf", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp"}
MAX_PROOF_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024


class ExitPassProofField(serializers.Field):
    """Validates PDF or image proof files up to 2 MB and blocks unsafe file content."""

    def to_representation(self, value):
        return build_media_url(value, self.context.get("request"))

    def to_internal_value(self, data):
        if data in (None, "", "null", "undefined"):
            return None

        if hasattr(data, "read"):
            safe_name = os.path.basename(str(getattr(data, "name", "") or ""))
            ext = os.path.splitext(safe_name)[1].lower()
            if ext not in ALLOWED_PROOF_EXTS:
                raise serializers.ValidationError("Allowed file types: PDF, JPG, PNG, or WEBP.")
            size = getattr(data, "size", 0) or 0
            if size <= 0 or size > MAX_PROOF_BYTES:
                raise serializers.ValidationError("Proof file must be under 2 MB.")
            if ext == ".pdf":
                sample = data.read(4096)
                data.seek(0)
                if not sample.startswith(b"%PDF-"):
                    raise serializers.ValidationError("Uploaded PDF file is invalid or damaged.")
                lowered = sample.lower()
                if b"/javascript" in lowered or b"/js" in lowered:
                    raise serializers.ValidationError("PDF files with active scripts are blocked.")
                data.name = safe_name
                return data
            return decode_uploaded_image(data, prefix="exit_proof")

        if isinstance(data, str) and data.strip().startswith("data:image"):
            decoded = decode_uploaded_image(data, prefix="exit_proof")
            if not isinstance(decoded, serializers.SkipField):
                return decoded

        raise serializers.SkipField()


class ExitPassSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    pass_status = serializers.CharField(read_only=True)
    status = serializers.CharField(source="pass_status", read_only=True)
    bearer_type = serializers.CharField(source="pass_scope", read_only=True)
    person_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    student = serializers.IntegerField(source="enrollment.student_id", read_only=True, allow_null=True)
    student_id = serializers.IntegerField(required=False, allow_null=True, write_only=True)
    student_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    student_lrn = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    section_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    teacher_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    teacher_employee_id = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    issued_by_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    valid_from = serializers.DateTimeField(source="issued_at", required=False)
    valid_to = serializers.DateTimeField(source="valid_until", required=False)
    attachment = ExitPassProofField(required=False, allow_null=True)
    attachment_url = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    guardian_notice = serializers.SerializerMethodField()

    class Meta:
        model = ExitPass
        fields = [
            "id",
            "pass_number",
            "pass_scope",
            "bearer_type",
            "person_name",
            "enrollment",
            "student",
            "student_id",
            "student_name",
            "student_lrn",
            "section_name",
            "teacher",
            "teacher_name",
            "teacher_employee_id",
            "pass_type",
            "reason",
            "destination",
            "attachment",
            "attachment_url",
            "issued_by",
            "issued_by_name",
            "issued_at",
            "valid_from",
            "valid_until",
            "valid_to",
            "returned_at",
            "is_cancelled",
            "pass_status",
            "status",
            "guardian_notice",
        ]
        read_only_fields = ["id", "pass_number", "issued_by", "returned_at", "is_cancelled"]
        extra_kwargs = {
            "pass_scope": {"required": False},
            "issued_at": {"required": False},
            "valid_until": {"required": False},
        }

    def get_person_name(self, obj: ExitPass) -> str:
        if obj.pass_scope == "STUDENT" and obj.enrollment_id and obj.enrollment:
            return obj.enrollment.student.full_name
        if obj.teacher_id and obj.teacher:
            return obj.teacher.full_name
        if obj.enrollment_id and obj.enrollment:
            return obj.enrollment.student.full_name
        return ""

    def get_student_name(self, obj: ExitPass) -> str:
        return obj.enrollment.student.full_name if (obj.enrollment_id and obj.enrollment) else ""

    def get_student_lrn(self, obj: ExitPass) -> str:
        return obj.enrollment.student.lrn if (obj.enrollment_id and obj.enrollment) else ""

    def get_section_name(self, obj: ExitPass) -> str:
        if obj.enrollment_id and obj.enrollment and obj.enrollment.section:
            return obj.enrollment.section.name
        return ""

    def get_teacher_name(self, obj: ExitPass) -> str:
        return obj.teacher.full_name if (obj.teacher_id and obj.teacher) else ""

    def get_teacher_employee_id(self, obj: ExitPass) -> str:
        return obj.teacher.employee_id if (obj.teacher_id and obj.teacher) else ""

    def get_issued_by_name(self, obj: ExitPass) -> str:
        if not obj.issued_by:
            return "School Staff"
        return (obj.issued_by.get_full_name() or obj.issued_by.username).strip()

    def get_attachment_url(self, obj: ExitPass):
        return build_media_url(obj.attachment, self.context.get("request"))

    def get_guardian_notice(self, obj: ExitPass) -> str:
        holder = self.get_person_name(obj) or "The pass holder"
        valid_str = (
            timezone.localtime(obj.valid_until).strftime("%I:%M %p").lstrip("0")
            if obj.valid_until
            else ""
        )
        dest_ctx = f" to {obj.destination}" if obj.destination else ""
        if obj.returned_at:
            ret_str = timezone.localtime(obj.returned_at).strftime("%I:%M %p").lstrip("0")
            return f"{holder} returned safely to campus at {ret_str} (Pass #{obj.pass_number})."
        if obj.is_cancelled:
            return f"Exit pass #{obj.pass_number} for {holder} was cancelled."
        return (
            f"{holder} was issued an official exit pass ({obj.pass_type or 'Campus Pass'}){dest_ctx}, "
            f"valid until {valid_str or 'scheduled return'}."
        )

    def to_internal_value(self, data):
        mutable = {k: data.get(k) for k in data.keys()} if hasattr(data, "keys") else dict(data)
        empty_vals = ("", "null", "none", "undefined")

        if "teacher" in mutable and str(mutable["teacher"]).strip().lower() in empty_vals:
            mutable["teacher"] = None
        if not mutable.get("teacher") and "teacher_id" in mutable:
            if str(mutable["teacher_id"]).strip().lower() not in empty_vals:
                mutable["teacher"] = mutable["teacher_id"]

        if "enrollment" in mutable and str(mutable["enrollment"]).strip().lower() in empty_vals:
            mutable["enrollment"] = None
        if "student_id" not in mutable and "student" in mutable:
            if str(mutable["student"]).strip().lower() not in empty_vals:
                mutable["student_id"] = mutable["student"]
        if "student_id" in mutable and str(mutable["student_id"]).strip().lower() in empty_vals:
            mutable["student_id"] = None

        if "pass_scope" not in mutable and "bearer_type" in mutable:
            raw_scope = str(mutable["bearer_type"]).strip().upper()
            if raw_scope in ("STUDENT", "TEACHER"):
                mutable["pass_scope"] = raw_scope

        if "attachment" not in mutable and "proof_file" in mutable:
            mutable["attachment"] = mutable["proof_file"]

        for txt_key in ("reason", "destination", "pass_type"):
            if txt_key in mutable and isinstance(mutable[txt_key], str):
                mutable[txt_key] = clean_text(mutable[txt_key], 300)

        return super().to_internal_value(mutable)

    def validate(self, attrs):
        issued_at = attrs.get("issued_at", self.instance.issued_at if self.instance else timezone.now())
        valid_until = attrs.get(
            "valid_until",
            self.instance.valid_until if self.instance else (issued_at + timedelta(hours=4)),
        )
        if valid_until <= issued_at:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"valid_until": "Return time must be after exit time."})
        if not self.instance:
            attrs["issued_at"] = issued_at
            attrs["valid_until"] = valid_until
        return attrs

    def create(self, validated_data):
        request = self.context["request"]
        user = request.user
        leader = is_school_leader(user)
        own_teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)

        student_id = validated_data.pop("student_id", None)
        enrollment = validated_data.get("enrollment")
        target_teacher = validated_data.get("teacher")

        if not enrollment and student_id:
            enrollment = (
                Enrollment.objects.select_related("student", "section")
                .filter(student_id=student_id, status="ENROLLED")
                .order_by("-section__school_year__is_active", "-id")
                .first()
            )
            if not enrollment:
                raise serializers.ValidationError(
                    {"student_id": "Selected student is not enrolled in an active class."}
                )

        if enrollment:
            if not leader and (
                not own_teacher
                or not own_teacher.can_handle_classes
                or enrollment.id not in get_teacher_enrollment_ids(own_teacher)
            ):
                raise AppError(
                    "FORBIDDEN",
                    "You can only create exit passes for students in your assigned classes.",
                    403,
                )
            validated_data["pass_scope"] = "STUDENT"
            validated_data["enrollment"] = enrollment
            validated_data["teacher"] = None
        else:
            validated_data["pass_scope"] = "TEACHER"
            validated_data["enrollment"] = None
            if not leader:
                if not own_teacher:
                    raise AppError("NO_TEACHER_PROFILE", "A teacher profile is required.", 403)
                validated_data["teacher"] = own_teacher
            else:
                validated_data["teacher"] = (
                    target_teacher
                    or own_teacher
                    or TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("user")
                    .filter(user__is_active=True)
                    .first()
                )
                if not validated_data["teacher"]:
                    raise serializers.ValidationError({"teacher": "Select an active teacher for this pass."})

        return ExitPass.objects.create(**validated_data, issued_by=user)

    def update(self, instance, validated_data):
        validated_data.pop("student_id", None)
        if validated_data.get("enrollment") is not None:
            validated_data["pass_scope"] = "STUDENT"
            validated_data["teacher"] = None
        elif validated_data.get("teacher") is not None:
            validated_data["pass_scope"] = "TEACHER"
            validated_data["enrollment"] = None
        return super().update(instance, validated_data)

def _invalidate_live_attendance_caches(user_id: int | None = None, adviser_user_id: int | None = None) -> None:
    keys = ["dashboard:leader", "reports:system_status"]
    if user_id:
        keys.append(f"dashboard:teacher:{user_id}")
    if adviser_user_id:
        keys.append(f"dashboard:teacher:{adviser_user_id}")
    cache.delete_many(keys)


def determine_arrival_status(period: ClassPeriod | None, scanned_at, grace_minutes: int = 15) -> str:
    if not period or not period.start_time:
        return "PRESENT"
    local_dt = timezone.localtime(scanned_at)
    cutoff = timezone.make_aware(
        datetime.combine(local_dt.date(), period.start_time),
        timezone.get_current_timezone(),
    ) + timedelta(minutes=grace_minutes)
    return "LATE" if local_dt > cutoff else "PRESENT"


def _parse_uuid(raw_val) -> uuid_lib.UUID | None:
    if not raw_val:
        return None
    try:
        return uuid_lib.UUID(str(raw_val).strip())
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None


@transaction.atomic
def record_student_qr_scan(
    *,
    user,
    raw_qr: str,
    period_id: int | None = None,
    client_scan_uuid=None,
    latitude=None,
    longitude=None,
    accuracy=None,
    is_mock_location: bool = False,
    request=None,
) -> dict:
    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    leader = is_school_leader(user)
    if not leader and (not teacher or not teacher.can_handle_classes):
        raise AppError(
            "FORBIDDEN",
            "Only assigned classroom teachers and school leaders can scan student QR cards.",
            403,
        )

    if is_mock_location:
        raise AppError(
            "INVALID_GPS",
            "A mock location setting appears to be turned on. Please disable mock locations in your phone settings and try again.",
            400,
        )

    if latitude is not None and longitude is not None and not leader:
        c_lat, c_lon, radius, _ = get_active_campus_coords()
        gps = verify_campus_gps(
            latitude=latitude,
            longitude=longitude,
            campus_lat=c_lat,
            campus_lon=c_lon,
            radius_meters=radius,
            accuracy_meters=accuracy,
            is_mock_location=is_mock_location,
        )
        if not gps["is_valid"]:
            raise AppError("INVALID_GPS", gps["reason"], 400)
        if not gps["is_inside"]:
            raise AppError("OUTSIDE_CAMPUS", gps["reason"], 403)

    clean_raw = str(raw_qr or "").strip()
    if clean_raw.upper().startswith("ATTENDSURE:TEACHER:") or "ATTENDSURE_TEACHER_PASS" in clean_raw.upper():
        raise AppError(
            "TEACHER_QR_SCANNED",
            "That is a Teacher ID Pass. Please scan a Student QR card.",
            400,
        )

    qr_data = verify_student_qr(clean_raw)
    if not qr_data:
        raise AppError(
            "INVALID_QR",
            "We could not verify this QR card. Please ask the student to present their official AttendSure QR ID.",
            400,
        )

    student = Student.objects.filter(
        qr_token=qr_data.qr_token,
        lrn__iexact=qr_data.lrn,
        is_active=True,
    ).first()
    if not student:
        raise AppError(
            "STUDENT_NOT_FOUND",
            "This QR card is not linked to an active student yet. Please check with the class adviser or school admin.",
            404,
        )

    enrollment = (
        Enrollment.objects.filter(student=student, status="ENROLLED")
        .select_related("section", "section__grade_level", "section__adviser")
        .order_by("-section__school_year__is_active", "-id")
        .first()
    )
    if not enrollment or not enrollment.section:
        raise AppError(
            "NOT_ENROLLED",
            f"{student.full_name} is not enrolled in an active section yet. Assign a section under Students first.",
            400,
        )

    section = enrollment.section
    section_label = format_section_label(
        section.grade_level.name if section.grade_level else "", section.name
    )

    period_qs = ClassPeriod.objects.filter(section=section, is_active=True).select_related(
        "subject", "teacher"
    )
    active_period = None
    if period_id:
        active_period = period_qs.filter(id=period_id).first()
    if not active_period and teacher:
        active_period = period_qs.filter(teacher=teacher).first()

    is_adviser = bool(teacher and section.adviser_id == teacher.id)
    if not (
        leader
        or is_adviser
        or (active_period and teacher and active_period.teacher_id == teacher.id)
    ):
        raise AppError(
            "FORBIDDEN_SECTION",
            f"You are not listed as a teacher or adviser for {section_label}. Switch to one of your assigned classes to scan.",
            403,
        )

    target_period = active_period or period_qs.order_by("start_time").first()
    if not target_period:
        homeroom_subj, _ = Subject.objects.get_or_create(
            code="HOMEROOM",
            defaults={
                "title": "Advisory Homeroom",
                "grade_level": section.grade_level,
                "units": 1,
            },
        )
        target_period = ClassPeriod.objects.create(
            schedule_code=f"HR-{section.id}",
            section=section,
            subject=homeroom_subj,
            teacher=section.adviser or teacher,
            day_of_week="ALL_WEEKDAYS",
            start_time=dt_time(7, 30),
            end_time=dt_time(8, 30),
            is_active=True,
        )

    now = timezone.now()
    local_now = timezone.localtime(now)
    today = local_now.date()

    missed_count = (
        ClassPeriod.objects.filter(
            section=section, is_active=True, start_time__lt=target_period.start_time
        )
        .exclude(
            attendance_records__enrollment=enrollment,
            attendance_records__attendance_date=today,
            attendance_records__status__in=["PRESENT", "LATE", "EXCUSED"],
        )
        .count()
    )
    note = (
        f"Cutting class check: missed {missed_count} earlier class period(s) today."
        if missed_count > 0
        else ""
    )

    arrival_status = determine_arrival_status(target_period, now)
    recorder = teacher or target_period.teacher
    parsed_uuid = _parse_uuid(client_scan_uuid)

    record, created = ClassAttendance.objects.get_or_create(
        enrollment=enrollment,
        class_period=target_period,
        attendance_date=today,
        defaults={
            "recorded_by": recorder,
            "scanned_at": now,
            "scan_method": "QR",
            "status": arrival_status,
            "client_scan_uuid": parsed_uuid,
        },
    )

    if created:
        DailyAttendance.objects.update_or_create(
            enrollment=enrollment,
            attendance_date=today,
            defaults={
                "time_in": local_now.time(),
                "status": arrival_status,
                "recorded_by": recorder,
                "remarks": (note or "QR attendance")[:255],
            },
        )

    adviser_uid = section.adviser.user_id if (section.adviser_id and section.adviser) else None
    _invalidate_live_attendance_caches(user_id=user.id, adviser_user_id=adviser_uid)

    local_scan_dt = timezone.localtime(record.scanned_at)
    subj_title = target_period.subject.title if (target_period and target_period.subject_id) else "Class"
    adviser_ctx = (
        f" (Adviser: {section.adviser.full_name})"
        if (section.adviser_id and section.adviser)
        else ""
    )
    time_short = local_scan_dt.strftime("%I:%M %p").lstrip("0")
    guardian_notice = (
        f"{student.full_name} arrived late for {subj_title} in {section_label}{adviser_ctx} at {time_short}."
        if record.status == "LATE"
        else f"{student.full_name} arrived safely for {subj_title} in {section_label}{adviser_ctx} at {time_short}."
    )
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "success": True,
        "is_duplicate": not created,
        "student_id": student.id,
        "enrollment_id": enrollment.id,
        "period_id": target_period.id,
        "student_name": student.full_name,
        "lrn": student.lrn,
        "section": section_label,
        "status": record.status,
        "scanned_at": local_scan_dt.strftime("%I:%M:%S %p"),
        "scanned_at_iso": local_scan_dt.isoformat(),
        "attendance_note": note,
        "guardian_notice": guardian_notice,
        "photo_url": build_media_url(student.photo, request),
    }


@transaction.atomic
def sync_offline_qr_scans(*, user, raw_scans: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """
    High-speed O(1) SQL batch processor for offline camera QR queues.
    Pre-fetches all lookup dictionaries and inserts new rows with bulk_create(ignore_conflicts=True).
    """
    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    leader = is_school_leader(user)
    if not leader and (not teacher or not teacher.can_handle_classes):
        raise AppError(
            "FORBIDDEN",
            "Only assigned classroom teachers and school leaders can sync offline scans.",
            403,
        )

    allowed_section_ids = None if leader else get_teacher_section_ids(teacher)

    parsed_entries = []
    tokens = set()
    lrns = set()
    client_uuids = set()

    batch = raw_scans[:500]
    for item in batch:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        qr_data = verify_student_qr(item.get("qr_token") or item.get("qr_text") or item.get("code") or "")
        if not qr_data:
            continue
        scan_dt = parse_datetime(str(item.get("scanned_at") or "")) or timezone.now()
        if timezone.is_naive(scan_dt):
            scan_dt = timezone.make_aware(scan_dt, timezone.get_current_timezone())
        scan_uuid = _parse_uuid(item.get("client_scan_uuid"))
        if scan_uuid:
            client_uuids.add(scan_uuid)

        raw_pid = item.get("schedule_id") or item.get("period_id")
        pid = int(raw_pid) if (raw_pid and str(raw_pid).isdigit()) else None

        tokens.add(qr_data.qr_token)
        lrns.add(qr_data.lrn)
        parsed_entries.append(
            {
                "qr": qr_data,
                "period_id": pid,
                "scanned_at": scan_dt,
                "scan_date": timezone.localtime(scan_dt).date(),
                "client_scan_uuid": scan_uuid,
            }
        )

    rejected = len(batch) - len(parsed_entries)
    if not parsed_entries:
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "success": True,
            "synced_count": 0,
            "duplicate_count": 0,
            "rejected_count": rejected,
        }

    student_by_pair: dict[tuple[str, str], Student] = {
        (st.lrn.lower(), st.qr_token): st
        for st in Student.objects.filter(qr_token__in=tokens, lrn__in=lrns, is_active=True)
    }
    student_ids = [st.id for st in student_by_pair.values()]

    enrollment_by_student: dict[int, Enrollment] = {}
    for enr in (
        Enrollment.objects.filter(student_id__in=student_ids, status="ENROLLED")
        .select_related("section", "section__adviser")
        .order_by("-section__school_year__is_active", "-id")
    ):
        enrollment_by_student.setdefault(enr.student_id, enr)

    section_ids = {enr.section_id for enr in enrollment_by_student.values()}

    period_by_id: dict[int, ClassPeriod] = {}
    first_period_by_sec: dict[int, ClassPeriod] = {}
    for cp in (
        ClassPeriod.objects.filter(section_id__in=section_ids, is_active=True)
        .order_by("section_id", "start_time", "id")
    ):
        period_by_id[cp.id] = cp
        first_period_by_sec.setdefault(cp.section_id, cp)

    enr_ids = [enr.id for enr in enrollment_by_student.values()]
    scan_dates = {e["scan_date"] for e in parsed_entries}

    existing_class_keys = set(
        ClassAttendance.objects.filter(
            enrollment_id__in=enr_ids,
            attendance_date__in=scan_dates,
        ).values_list("enrollment_id", "class_period_id", "attendance_date")
    )
    existing_uuids = (
        set(
            ClassAttendance.objects.filter(client_scan_uuid__in=client_uuids).values_list(
                "client_scan_uuid", flat=True
            )
        )
        if client_uuids
        else set()
    )

    existing_daily_keys = set(
        DailyAttendance.objects.filter(
            enrollment_id__in=enr_ids,
            attendance_date__in=scan_dates,
        ).values_list("enrollment_id", "attendance_date")
    )

    new_class_rows: list[ClassAttendance] = []
    new_daily_rows: list[DailyAttendance] = []
    seen_batch_class_keys = set(existing_class_keys)
    seen_batch_daily_keys = set(existing_daily_keys)
    seen_batch_uuids = set(existing_uuids)
    duplicates = 0

    for entry in parsed_entries:
        st = student_by_pair.get((entry["qr"].lrn.lower(), entry["qr"].qr_token))
        if not st:
            rejected += 1
            continue

        enr = enrollment_by_student.get(st.id)
        if not enr:
            rejected += 1
            continue

        if allowed_section_ids is not None and enr.section_id not in allowed_section_ids:
            rejected += 1
            continue

        pid = entry["period_id"]
        period = (
            period_by_id.get(pid)
            if (pid and period_by_id.get(pid) and period_by_id[pid].section_id == enr.section_id)
            else first_period_by_sec.get(enr.section_id)
        )
        if not period:
            rejected += 1
            continue

        scan_uuid = entry["client_scan_uuid"]
        class_key = (enr.id, period.id, entry["scan_date"])
        if class_key in seen_batch_class_keys or (scan_uuid and scan_uuid in seen_batch_uuids):
            duplicates += 1
            continue

        status_val = determine_arrival_status(period, entry["scanned_at"])
        recorder_id = teacher.id if teacher else period.teacher_id

        new_class_rows.append(
            ClassAttendance(
                enrollment_id=enr.id,
                class_period_id=period.id,
                attendance_date=entry["scan_date"],
                scanned_at=entry["scanned_at"],
                scan_method="QR",
                status=status_val,
                recorded_by_id=recorder_id,
                client_scan_uuid=scan_uuid,
            )
        )
        seen_batch_class_keys.add(class_key)
        if scan_uuid:
            seen_batch_uuids.add(scan_uuid)

        daily_key = (enr.id, entry["scan_date"])
        if daily_key not in seen_batch_daily_keys:
            new_daily_rows.append(
                DailyAttendance(
                    enrollment_id=enr.id,
                    attendance_date=entry["scan_date"],
                    time_in=timezone.localtime(entry["scanned_at"]).time(),
                    status=status_val,
                    recorded_by_id=recorder_id,
                    remarks="Synced from offline camera QR queue.",
                )
            )
            seen_batch_daily_keys.add(daily_key)

    if new_class_rows:
        ClassAttendance.objects.bulk_create(new_class_rows, ignore_conflicts=True)
    if new_daily_rows:
        DailyAttendance.objects.bulk_create(new_daily_rows, ignore_conflicts=True)

    adviser_user_ids = {
        enr.section.adviser.user_id
        for enr in enrollment_by_student.values()
        if enr.section and enr.section.adviser_id and enr.section.adviser and enr.section.adviser.user_id
    }
    cache_keys = ["dashboard:leader", f"dashboard:teacher:{user.id}", "reports:system_status"]
    cache_keys.extend(f"dashboard:teacher:{uid}" for uid in adviser_user_ids)
    cache.delete_many(cache_keys)

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "success": True,
        "synced_count": len(new_class_rows),
        "duplicate_count": duplicates,
        "rejected_count": rejected,
    }


@transaction.atomic
def save_manual_attendance(
    *, user, student_id: int, status_code: str, period_id: int | None = None, date_str: str | None = None
) -> ClassAttendance:
    clean_status = status_code.upper().strip()
    if clean_status not in {"PRESENT", "LATE", "ABSENT", "EXCUSED"}:
        raise AppError("INVALID_STATUS", "Status must be PRESENT, LATE, ABSENT, or EXCUSED.", 400)

    student = Student.objects.filter(id=student_id, is_active=True).first()
    if not student:
        raise AppError("STUDENT_NOT_FOUND", "Student not found.", 404)

    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    if not is_school_leader(user) and (
        not teacher or student.id not in get_teacher_student_ids(teacher)
    ):
        raise AppError(
            "FORBIDDEN",
            "You can only update attendance for students in your assigned classes.",
            403,
        )

    enr = (
        Enrollment.objects.filter(student=student, status="ENROLLED")
        .select_related("section", "section__adviser")
        .order_by("-section__school_year__is_active", "-id")
        .first()
    )
    if not enr:
        raise AppError("NOT_ENROLLED", "Student has no active section enrollment.", 400)

    period = (
        ClassPeriod.objects.filter(id=period_id, section=enr.section).first()
        if period_id
        else ClassPeriod.objects.filter(section=enr.section, is_active=True).order_by("start_time").first()
    )
    if not period:
        raise AppError("NO_SCHEDULE", "No active class period found.", 400)

    target_date = timezone.localdate()
    if date_str:
        try:
            target_date = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        except ValueError:
            pass

    recorder = teacher or period.teacher or TeacherProfile.objects.filter(user__is_active=True).order_by("id").first()
    now = timezone.now()

    log, _ = ClassAttendance.objects.update_or_create(
        enrollment=enr,
        class_period=period,
        attendance_date=target_date,
        defaults={
            "recorded_by": recorder,
            "status": clean_status,
            "scan_method": "MANUAL",
            "scanned_at": now,
        },
    )
    DailyAttendance.objects.update_or_create(
        enrollment=enr,
        attendance_date=target_date,
        defaults={
            "time_in": timezone.localtime(now).time() if clean_status in ("PRESENT", "LATE") else None,
            "status": clean_status,
            "recorded_by": recorder,
            "remarks": "Manual teacher update.",
        },
    )
    adviser_uid = enr.section.adviser.user_id if (enr.section and enr.section.adviser_id and enr.section.adviser) else None
    _invalidate_live_attendance_caches(user_id=user.id, adviser_user_id=adviser_uid)
    return log


@transaction.atomic
def update_exit_pass_lifecycle(*, user, exit_pass: ExitPass, action_name: str) -> ExitPass:
    clean_action = action_name.upper().strip()
    if clean_action == "APPROVE":
        if not is_school_leader(user):
            raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "Only school leaders can approve official locator slips.", 403)
        if exit_pass.is_cancelled:
            raise AppError("PASS_CANCELLED", "Cancelled passes cannot be approved.", 400)
        exit_pass.issued_by = user
        exit_pass.save(update_fields=["issued_by"])
        _invalidate_live_attendance_caches(user_id=user.id)
        return exit_pass

    if clean_action == "RETURN":
        if exit_pass.is_cancelled:
            raise AppError("PASS_CANCELLED", "Cancelled exit passes cannot be marked returned.", 400)
        exit_pass.returned_at = timezone.now()
        exit_pass.save(update_fields=["returned_at"])
        _invalidate_live_attendance_caches(user_id=user.id)
        return exit_pass

    if clean_action == "CANCEL":
        if exit_pass.pass_scope == "TEACHER" and not is_school_leader(user):
            raise AppError(
                "FORBIDDEN",
                "Only school leaders can cancel a teacher official locator slip.",
                403,
            )
        if not is_school_leader(user) and exit_pass.issued_by_id != user.id:
            raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "Only school leaders or the issuer can cancel an exit pass.", 403)
        exit_pass.is_cancelled = True
        exit_pass.save(update_fields=["is_cancelled"])
        _invalidate_live_attendance_caches(user_id=user.id)
        return exit_pass

    raise AppError("INVALID_ACTION", "Unsupported exit pass action.", 400)

    def test_expand_schedule_days_and_weekday_matching(self):
        self.assertEqual(expand_schedule_days("ALL_WEEKDAYS"), {1, 2, 3, 4, 5})
        self.assertEqual(expand_schedule_days("MWF"), {1, 3, 5})
        self.assertEqual(expand_schedule_days("TTH"), {2, 4})
        for day_num in range(1, 8):
            self.assertEqual(expand_schedule_days(str(day_num)), {day_num})

        monday = date(2026, 11, 23)  # ISO weekday 1
        tuesday = date(2026, 11, 24)  # ISO weekday 2
        saturday = date(2026, 11, 28)  # ISO weekday 6

        self.assertTrue(period_runs_on_weekday("MWF", monday.isoweekday()))
        self.assertFalse(period_runs_on_weekday("MWF", tuesday.isoweekday()))
        self.assertTrue(period_runs_on_weekday("TTH", tuesday.isoweekday()))
        self.assertFalse(period_runs_on_weekday("TTH", monday.isoweekday()))
        self.assertFalse(period_runs_on_weekday("ALL_WEEKDAYS", saturday.isoweekday()))
        self.assertTrue(period_runs_on_weekday("6", saturday.isoweekday()))

    def test_class_period_serializer_allows_same_time_on_different_weekdays_and_blocks_overlap(self):
        ClassPeriod.objects.create(
            schedule_code="MWF-AM",
            section=self.section,
            subject=self.subj_math,
            teacher=self.adviser,
            day_of_week="MWF",
            start_time=time(8, 0),
            end_time=time(9, 0),
            is_active=True,
        )

        # Same time on TTH has zero weekday overlap -> valid
        tth_serializer = ClassPeriodSerializer(
            data={
                "schedule_code": "TTH-AM",
                "section": self.section.id,
                "subject": self.subj_pe.id,
                "teacher": self.adviser.id,
                "day_of_week": "TTH",
                "start_time": "08:00:00",
                "end_time": "09:00:00",
                "is_active": True,
            }
        )
        self.assertTrue(tth_serializer.is_valid(), tth_serializer.errors)

        # Overlapping time on Monday ("1") intersects MWF -> rejected
        mon_conflict = ClassPeriodSerializer(
            data={
                "schedule_code": "MON-CONFLICT",
                "section": self.section.id,
                "subject": self.subj_sci.id,
                "teacher": self.adviser.id,
                "day_of_week": "1",
                "start_time": "08:30:00",
                "end_time": "09:30:00",
                "is_active": True,
            }
        )
        self.assertFalse(mon_conflict.is_valid())

    def test_mwf_morning_present_not_flagged_for_tth_afternoon_class(self):
        mwf_morning = ClassPeriod.objects.create(
            schedule_code="MWF-M1",
            section=self.section,
            subject=self.subj_math,
            teacher=self.adviser,
            day_of_week="MWF",
            start_time=time(7, 30),
            end_time=time(8, 30),
            is_active=True,
        )
        tth_afternoon = ClassPeriod.objects.create(
            schedule_code="TTH-PM",
            section=self.section,
            subject=self.subj_pe,
            teacher=self.adviser,
            day_of_week="TTH",
            start_time=time(13, 30),
            end_time=time(14, 30),
            is_active=True,
        )

        # Monday, Wednesday, and Friday dates in the same week
        for mwf_date in (date(2026, 11, 23), date(2026, 11, 25), date(2026, 11, 27)):
            scanned_dt = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(mwf_date, time(7, 35)))
            ClassAttendance.objects.create(
                enrollment=self.enrollment,
                class_period=mwf_morning,
                attendance_date=mwf_date,
                scanned_at=scanned_dt,
                status="PRESENT",
                recorded_by=self.adviser,
            )
            DailyAttendance.objects.create(
                enrollment=self.enrollment,
                attendance_date=mwf_date,
                time_in=time(7, 35),
                status="PRESENT",
                recorded_by=self.adviser,
            )

            result = detect_daily_student_loafing(
                target_date=mwf_date,
                section_id=self.section.id,
                user=self.adviser_user,
                force_all_periods=True,
            )
            self.assertEqual(result["created_cutting_incidents"], 0)

        self.assertFalse(
            LoafingIncident.objects.filter(
                incident_type="STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS",
                enrollment=self.enrollment,
                class_period=tth_afternoon,
            ).exists()
        )
        self.assertEqual(LoafingIncident.objects.filter(incident_type="STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS").count(), 0)

    def test_present_in_period1_missing_scheduled_period2_flags_cutting_only_for_matching_day(self):
        mwf_period1 = ClassPeriod.objects.create(
            schedule_code="MWF-P1",
            section=self.section,
            subject=self.subj_math,
            teacher=self.adviser,
            day_of_week="MWF",
            start_time=time(7, 30),
            end_time=time(8, 30),
            is_active=True,
        )
        mwf_period2 = ClassPeriod.objects.create(
            schedule_code="MWF-P2",
            section=self.section,
            subject=self.subj_sci,
            teacher=self.adviser,
            day_of_week="MWF",
            start_time=time(8, 30),
            end_time=time(9, 30),
            is_active=True,
        )
        tth_afternoon = ClassPeriod.objects.create(
            schedule_code="TTH-PM2",
            section=self.section,
            subject=self.subj_pe,
            teacher=self.adviser,
            day_of_week="TTH",
            start_time=time(13, 30),
            end_time=time(14, 30),
            is_active=True,
        )

        monday = date(2026, 11, 23)
        scanned_dt = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(monday, time(7, 35)))
        ClassAttendance.objects.create(
            enrollment=self.enrollment,
            class_period=mwf_period1,
            attendance_date=monday,
            scanned_at=scanned_dt,
            status="PRESENT",
            recorded_by=self.adviser,
        )
        DailyAttendance.objects.create(
            enrollment=self.enrollment,
            attendance_date=monday,
            time_in=time(7, 35),
            status="PRESENT",
            recorded_by=self.adviser,
        )

        result = detect_daily_student_loafing(
            target_date=monday,
            section_id=self.section.id,
            user=self.adviser_user,
        )
        self.assertEqual(result["created_cutting_incidents"], 1)
        self.assertTrue(
            LoafingIncident.objects.filter(
                incident_type="STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS",
                enrollment=self.enrollment,
                class_period=mwf_period2,
            ).exists()
        )
        self.assertFalse(
            LoafingIncident.objects.filter(
                incident_type="STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS",
                enrollment=self.enrollment,
                class_period=tth_afternoon,
            ).exists()
        )

        # Verify an active exit pass prevents a cutting alert on another MWF day
        wednesday = date(2026, 11, 25)
        wed_scan_dt = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(wednesday, time(7, 35)))
        ClassAttendance.objects.create(
            enrollment=self.enrollment,
            class_period=mwf_period1,
            attendance_date=wednesday,
            scanned_at=wed_scan_dt,
            status="PRESENT",
            recorded_by=self.adviser,
        )
        DailyAttendance.objects.create(
            enrollment=self.enrollment,
            attendance_date=wednesday,
            time_in=time(7, 35),
            status="PRESENT",
            recorded_by=self.adviser,
        )
        ExitPass.objects.create(
            pass_number="EP-CLINIC-WED",
            pass_scope="STUDENT",
            enrollment=self.enrollment,
            reason="School clinic checkup",
            destination="School Clinic",
            issued_by=self.adviser_user,
            issued_at=timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(wednesday, time(8, 20))),
            valid_until=timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(wednesday, time(9, 45))),
        )
        wed_result = detect_daily_student_loafing(
            target_date=wednesday,
            section_id=self.section.id,
            user=self.adviser_user,
        )
        self.assertEqual(wed_result["created_cutting_incidents"], 0)

    def test_get_adviser_matrix_filters_subjects_by_target_date_weekday(self):
        ClassPeriod.objects.create(
            schedule_code="MAT-MWF-1",
            section=self.section,
            subject=self.subj_math,
            teacher=self.adviser,
            day_of_week="MWF",
            start_time=time(7, 30),
            end_time=time(8, 30),
            is_active=True,
        )
        ClassPeriod.objects.create(
            schedule_code="MAT-MWF-2",
            section=self.section,
            subject=self.subj_sci,
            teacher=self.adviser,
            day_of_week="MWF",
            start_time=time(8, 30),
            end_time=time(9, 30),
            is_active=True,
        )
        ClassPeriod.objects.create(
            schedule_code="MAT-TTH-1",
            section=self.section,
            subject=self.subj_pe,
            teacher=self.adviser,
            day_of_week="TTH",
            start_time=time(7, 30),
            end_time=time(8, 30),
            is_active=True,
        )
        ClassPeriod.objects.create(
            schedule_code="MAT-TTH-2",
            section=self.section,
            subject=self.subj_tle,
            teacher=self.adviser,
            day_of_week="TTH",
            start_time=time(8, 30),
            end_time=time(9, 30),
            is_active=True,
        )

        monday = date(2026, 11, 23)
        tuesday = date(2026, 11, 24)
        saturday = date(2026, 11, 28)

        mon_data = get_adviser_matrix(
            user=self.adviser_user,
            section_id=self.section.id,
            target_date=monday,
        )
        self.assertEqual([s["subject_code"] for s in mon_data["schedules"]], ["MATH8", "SCI8"])
        self.assertEqual(len(mon_data["matrix"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual([c["subject_code"] for c in mon_data["matrix"][0]["subjects"]], ["MATH8", "SCI8"])
        self.assertEqual(mon_data["matrix"][0]["total_subjects"], 2)

        tue_data = get_adviser_matrix(
            user=self.adviser_user,
            section_id=self.section.id,
            target_date=tuesday,
        )
        self.assertEqual([s["subject_code"] for s in tue_data["schedules"]], ["PE8", "TLE8"])
        self.assertEqual([c["subject_code"] for c in tue_data["matrix"][0]["subjects"]], ["PE8", "TLE8"])
        self.assertEqual(tue_data["matrix"][0]["total_subjects"], 2)

        sat_data = get_adviser_matrix(
            user=self.adviser_user,
            section_id=self.section.id,
            target_date=saturday,
        )
        self.assertEqual(sat_data["schedules"], [])
        self.assertEqual(sat_data["matrix"][0]["total_subjects"], 0)

        # Also verify the API endpoint supports ?date=YYYY-MM-DD
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.adviser_user)
        mon_resp = self.client.get(
            f"/api/v1/attendance/adviser-matrix/?section_id={self.section.id}&date={monday.isoformat()}"
        )
        self.assertEqual(mon_resp.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual([s["subject_code"] for s in mon_resp.data["schedules"]], ["MATH8", "SCI8"])

        tue_resp = self.client.get(
            f"/api/v1/attendance/adviser-matrix/?section_id={self.section.id}&date={tuesday.isoformat()}"
        )
        self.assertEqual(tue_resp.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual([s["subject_code"] for s in tue_resp.data["schedules"]], ["PE8", "TLE8"])

class ScanThrottle(UserRateThrottle):
    scope = "scan_ping"


class ScanStudentQrView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsTeacherOrLeader]
    throttle_classes = [ScanThrottle]

    def post(self, request):
        raw_qr = (
            request.data.get("qr_text")
            or request.data.get("code")
            or request.data.get("raw_identifier")
            or request.data.get("qr_token")
            or ""
        )
        period_id = request.data.get("schedule_id") or request.data.get("period_id")
        result = record_student_qr_scan(
            user=request.user,
            raw_qr=str(raw_qr),
            period_id=int(period_id) if (period_id and str(period_id).isdigit()) else None,
            client_scan_uuid=request.data.get("client_scan_uuid"),
            latitude=request.data.get("latitude"),
            longitude=request.data.get("longitude"),
            accuracy=request.data.get("accuracy"),
            is_mock_location=bool(request.data.get("is_mock_location", False)),
            request=request,
        )
        code = status.HTTP_200_OK if result["is_duplicate"] else status.HTTP_201_CREATED
        return Response(result, status=code)


class OfflineQrSyncView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsTeacherOrLeader]
    throttle_classes = [ScanThrottle]

    def post(self, request):
        scans = request.data.get("scans") or []
        if not isinstance(scans, list) or not scans:
            return Response({"error": "Non-empty scans list is required."}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        return Response(sync_offline_qr_scans(user=request.user, raw_scans=scans))


class StudentLoafingAuditView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def post(self, request):
        date_str = request.data.get("date")
        target_date = None
        if date_str:
            try:
                target_date = datetime.strptime(str(date_str), "%Y-%m-%d").date()

class ClassAttendanceView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def get(self, request):
        date_str = request.query_params.get("date")
        target_date = timezone.localdate()
        if date_str:
            try:
                target_date = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
            except ValueError:
                pass
        sec_id = request.query_params.get("section_id")
        per_id = request.query_params.get("schedule_id") or request.query_params.get("period_id")
        records = get_attendance_logs(
            user=request.user,
            target_date=target_date,
            section_id=int(sec_id) if (sec_id and str(sec_id).isdigit()) else None,
            period_id=int(per_id) if (per_id and str(per_id).isdigit()) else None,
        )
        return Response({"records": records, "total": len(records)})

    def post(self, request):
        student_id = request.data.get("student_id")
        if not student_id or not str(student_id).isdigit():
            return Response({"error": "Valid student_id is required."}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        per_id = request.data.get("schedule_id") or request.data.get("period_id")
        log = save_manual_attendance(
            user=request.user,
            student_id=int(student_id),
            status_code=str(request.data.get("status", "PRESENT")),
            period_id=int(per_id) if (per_id and str(per_id).isdigit()) else None,
            date_str=request.data.get("attendance_date"),
        )
        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name=log._meta.db_table,
            record_id=log.id,
            action="CREATE",
            new_data={"enrollment_id": log.enrollment_id, "status": log.status},
        )
        return Response({"ok": True, "success": True, "id": log.id, "status": log.status}, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    def put(self, request):
        rec_id = request.data.get("id") or request.query_params.get("id")
        if rec_id is not None and str(rec_id).strip() != "":
            if not str(rec_id).isdigit():
                return Response({"error": "Valid attendance record id is required."}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
            existing = ClassAttendance.objects.select_related("enrollment").filter(id=int(rec_id)).first()
            if not existing:
                return Response({"error": "Attendance record not found."}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)
            log = save_manual_attendance(
                user=request.user,
                student_id=existing.enrollment.student_id,
                status_code=str(request.data.get("status", existing.status)),
                period_id=existing.class_period_id,
                date_str=str(existing.attendance_date),
            )
            record_audit_log(
                request=request,
                table_name=log._meta.db_table,
                record_id=log.id,
                action="UPDATE",
                new_data={"enrollment_id": log.enrollment_id, "status": log.status},
            )
            return Response({"ok": True, "success": True, "id": log.id, "status": log.status})
        return self.post(request)

    def patch(self, request):
        return self.put(request)

    def delete(self, request):
        rec_id = request.data.get("id") or request.query_params.get("id")
        if not rec_id or not str(rec_id).isdigit():
            return Response({"error": "Valid attendance record id is required."}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        existing = ClassAttendance.objects.select_related("enrollment__section__adviser").filter(id=int(rec_id)).first()
        if not existing:
            return Response({"error": "Attendance record not found."}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)

        if not is_school_leader(request.user):
            teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(request.user)
            if not teacher or existing.enrollment_id not in get_teacher_enrollment_ids(teacher):
                return Response(
                    {"error": "You can only remove attendance for your assigned students."},
                    status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                )

        enr_id = existing.enrollment_id
        att_date = existing.attendance_date
        rec_pk = existing.id
        adviser_uid = (
            existing.enrollment.section.adviser.user_id
            if (
                existing.enrollment
                and existing.enrollment.section
                and existing.enrollment.section.adviser_id
                and existing.enrollment.section.adviser
            )
            else None
        )
        existing.delete()

        remaining = (
            ClassAttendance.objects.filter(enrollment_id=enr_id, attendance_date=att_date)
            .order_by("-scanned_at")
            .first()
        )
        if remaining:
            DailyAttendance.objects.filter(enrollment_id=enr_id, attendance_date=att_date).update(
                status=remaining.status
            )
        else:
            DailyAttendance.objects.filter(enrollment_id=enr_id, attendance_date=att_date).delete()

        _invalidate_live_attendance_caches(user_id=request.user.id, adviser_user_id=adviser_uid)

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name=ClassAttendance._meta.db_table,
            record_id=rec_pk,
            action="DELETE",
            new_data={"enrollment_id": enr_id, "attendance_date": str(att_date)},
        )
        return Response({"ok": True, "success": True, "message": "Attendance record removed."})

class ExitPassViewSet(AuditedModelViewSet):
    serializer_class = ExitPassSerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def get_queryset(self):
        return get_exit_passes_for_user(
            user=self.request.user,
            status_filter=self.request.query_params.get("status", "ALL"),
            search=self.request.query_params.get("search", "").strip(),
        )

    def _assert_can_modify_pass(self, instance):
        user = self.request.user
        if is_school_leader(user):
            return
        own_teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        if instance.issued_by_id != user.id and (not own_teacher or instance.teacher_id != own_teacher.id):
            raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "You can only edit or remove exit passes you issued.", 403)
        if instance.returned_at is not None:
            raise AppError("PASS_LOCKED", "Returned exit passes cannot be modified.", 400)

    def perform_update(self, serializer):
        self._assert_can_modify_pass(serializer.instance)
        super().perform_update(serializer)

    def perform_destroy(self, instance):
        self._assert_can_modify_pass(instance)
        super().perform_destroy(instance)

    @action(
        detail=True,
        methods=["post"],
        url_path="approve",
        permission_classes=[permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsSchoolLeader],
    )
    def approve(self, request, pk=None):
        updated = update_exit_pass_lifecycle(user=request.user, exit_pass=self.get_object(), action_name="APPROVE")
        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name=updated._meta.db_table,
            record_id=updated.id,
            action="APPROVE",
            new_data={"pass_number": updated.pass_number, "pass_scope": updated.pass_scope},
        )
        return Response(
            {
                "ok": True,
                "success": True,
                "approved": True,
                "pass_status": updated.pass_status,
                "status": updated.pass_status,
                "issued_by_name": (request.user.get_full_name() or request.user.username).strip(),
            }
        )

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"], url_path="mark-returned")
    def mark_returned(self, request, pk=None):
        updated = update_exit_pass_lifecycle(user=request.user, exit_pass=self.get_object(), action_name="RETURN")
        return Response({"ok": True, "success": True, "pass_status": updated.pass_status, "status": updated.pass_status})

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"], url_path="mark-used")
    def mark_used(self, request, pk=None):
        return self.mark_returned(request, pk=pk)

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"], url_path="cancel")
    def cancel(self, request, pk=None):
        updated = update_exit_pass_lifecycle(user=request.user, exit_pass=self.get_object(), action_name="CANCEL")
        return Response({"ok": True, "success": True, "pass_status": updated.pass_status, "status": updated.pass_status})

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"], url_path="decline")
    def decline(self, request, pk=None):
        return self.cancel(request, pk=pk)

class CampusBoundary(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    campus_name = models.CharField(max_length=150, unique=True, default="Main Campus")
    center_latitude = models.DecimalField(max_digits=9, decimal_places=6, default=Decimal("8.485800"))
    center_longitude = models.DecimalField(max_digits=9, decimal_places=6, default=Decimal("124.656700"))
    radius_meters = models.PositiveIntegerField(default=150)
    loafing_grace_minutes = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(default=10)
    duty_start_time = models.TimeField(default=dt_time(7, 30))
    duty_end_time = models.TimeField(default=dt_time(17, 0))
    enforce_geofence_checkin = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True, db_index=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "campus_boundaries"

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.campus_name} ({self.radius_meters}m)"
