class TeacherLocationPing(models.Model):
    """
    Strict 3NF TeacherLocationPing:
    - Never stores distance_meters or is_inside as columns!
    - Both are computed dynamically from (latitude, longitude) and boundary coordinates.
    """

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    teacher = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.TeacherProfile",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="location_pings",
    )
    boundary = models.ForeignKey(
        CampusBoundary,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="location_pings",
    )
    latitude = models.DecimalField(max_digits=9, decimal_places=6)
    longitude = models.DecimalField(max_digits=9, decimal_places=6)
    accuracy_meters = models.FloatField(default=0.0)
    zone_status = models.CharField(
        max_length=24, choices=ZONE_STATUS_CHOICES, default="INSIDE", db_index=True
    )
    device_id = models.CharField(max_length=128, blank=True, default="")
    recorded_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now, db_index=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "teacher_location_pings"
        ordering = ["-recorded_at"]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["teacher", "-recorded_at"], name="idx_ping_teacher_rec"),
            models.Index(fields=["zone_status", "-recorded_at"], name="idx_ping_zone_rec"),
        ]

    @property
    def distance_meters(self) -> float:
        if not self.boundary_id or not self.boundary:
            return 0.0
        dist = calculate_distance_meters(
            self.latitude,
            self.longitude,
            self.boundary.center_latitude,
            self.boundary.center_longitude,
        )
        return dist if dist != float("inf") else 0.0

    @property
    def is_inside(self) -> bool:
        if self.zone_status == "INSIDE":
            return True
        if self.boundary_id and self.boundary:
            drift = min(max(float(self.accuracy_meters or 0.0), 0.0), 35.0)
            return self.distance_meters <= (self.boundary.radius_meters + drift)
        return False


class LoafingIncident(models.Model):
    """
    Strict 3NF LoafingIncident:
    - Never stores person_name, person_code, section_name, class_period_label, incident_date, or distance_meters.
    - All display attributes are derived via joined 3NF relations.
    """

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    incident_type = models.CharField(
        max_length=30, choices=LOAFING_INCIDENT_TYPE_CHOICES, db_index=True
    )
    status = models.CharField(
        max_length=24, choices=LOAFING_STATUS_CHOICES, default="OPEN", db_index=True
    )
    teacher = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.TeacherProfile",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="loafing_incidents",
    )
    enrollment = models.ForeignKey(
        "students.Enrollment",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="loafing_incidents",
    )
    class_period = models.ForeignKey(
        "school.ClassPeriod",
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="loafing_incidents",
    )
    exit_pass = models.ForeignKey(
        "attendance.ExitPass",
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="loafing_incidents",
    )
    trigger_ping = models.ForeignKey(
        TeacherLocationPing,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="triggered_incidents",
    )
    detected_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now, db_index=True)
    resolved_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)
    remarks = models.TextField(blank=True, default="")
    reviewed_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="reviewed_loafing_incidents",
    )

    class Meta:
        db_table = "loafing_incidents"
        ordering = ["-detected_at"]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["status", "-detected_at"], name="idx_loaf_status_det"),
            models.Index(fields=["incident_type", "-detected_at"], name="idx_loaf_type_det"),
        ]

    @property
    def incident_date(self):
        return timezone.localtime(self.detected_at).date()

    @property
    def distance_meters(self) -> float | None:
        if self.trigger_ping_id and self.trigger_ping:
            return self.trigger_ping.distance_meters
        return None

ONLINE_WINDOW_MINUTES = 5
ACTIVE_BOUNDARY_CACHE_KEY = "campus:active_boundary"


def get_active_campus_boundary() -> CampusBoundary:
    def _load():
        boundary = CampusBoundary.objects.filter(is_active=True).order_by("id").first()
        if not boundary:
            boundary = CampusBoundary.objects.order_by("id").first()
        if not boundary:
            boundary = CampusBoundary.objects.create(campus_name="Main Campus")
        return boundary

    return cache.get_or_set(ACTIVE_BOUNDARY_CACHE_KEY, _load, timeout=30)


def get_active_campus_coords() -> tuple[float, float, int, str]:
    boundary = get_active_campus_boundary()
    return (
        float(boundary.center_latitude),
        float(boundary.center_longitude),
        int(boundary.radius_meters),
        boundary.campus_name,
    )


def format_loafing_incident(inc: LoafingIncident) -> dict:
    if inc.teacher_id and inc.teacher:
        person_name = inc.teacher.full_name
        person_code = inc.teacher.employee_id
        person_role = "TEACHER"
    elif inc.enrollment_id and inc.enrollment and inc.enrollment.student:
        person_name = inc.enrollment.student.full_name
        person_code = inc.enrollment.student.lrn
        person_role = "STUDENT"
    else:
        person_name = "Unknown"
        person_code = ""
        person_role = ""

    section_name = ""
    if inc.enrollment_id and inc.enrollment and inc.enrollment.section:
        sec = inc.enrollment.section
        section_name = format_section_label(
            sec.grade_level.name if sec.grade_level else "",
            sec.name,
        )
    elif inc.class_period_id and inc.class_period and inc.class_period.section:
        sec = inc.class_period.section
        section_name = format_section_label(
            sec.grade_level.name if sec.grade_level else "",
            sec.name,
        )

    period_label = ""
    if inc.class_period_id and inc.class_period and inc.class_period.subject:
        period_label = f"{inc.class_period.subject.code} ({str(inc.class_period.start_time)[:5]}-{str(inc.class_period.end_time)[:5]})"

    local_det = timezone.localtime(inc.detected_at)
    local_res = timezone.localtime(inc.resolved_at) if inc.resolved_at else None

    return {
        "id": inc.id,
        "incident_type": inc.incident_type,
        "status": inc.status,
        "person_role": person_role,
        "person_name": person_name,
        "person_code": person_code,
        "teacher_id": inc.teacher_id,
        "teacher_name": inc.teacher.full_name if inc.teacher_id and inc.teacher else "",
        "enrollment_id": inc.enrollment_id,
        "section_name": section_name,
        "class_period_id": inc.class_period_id,
        "class_period_label": period_label,
        "exit_pass_id": inc.exit_pass_id,
        "distance_meters": inc.distance_meters,
        "incident_date": str(local_det.date()),
        "detected_at": local_det.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p"),
        "detected_time": local_det.strftime("%I:%M %p"),
        "resolved_at": local_res.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p") if local_res else None,
        "remarks": inc.remarks,
        "reviewed_by_name": (
            (inc.reviewed_by.get_full_name() or inc.reviewed_by.username).strip()
            if inc.reviewed_by
            else ""
        ),
    }


def get_campus_boundary_overview(*, user, request=None) -> dict:
    """
    O(1) SQL-query Campus Overview using Subquery/OuterRef for latest teacher ping.
    Only pings recorded TODAY count toward live Inside/Outside Campus status;
    older pings from previous days show as Off Duty / No Ping Today.
    """
    now_dt = timezone.now()
    today = timezone.localdate()
    online_cutoff = now_dt - timedelta(minutes=ONLINE_WINDOW_MINUTES)

    boundary = get_active_campus_boundary()
    lat = float(boundary.center_latitude)
    lon = float(boundary.center_longitude)
    radius = int(boundary.radius_meters)
    name = boundary.campus_name
    leader = is_school_leader(user)

    latest_ping_subquery = Subquery(
        TeacherLocationPing.objects.filter(teacher_id=OuterRef("pk"))
        .order_by("-recorded_at", "-id")
        .values("id")[:1]
    )

    teachers_qs = (
        TeacherProfile.objects.filter(user__is_active=True)
        .select_related("user", "department", "position")
        .annotate(latest_ping_id=latest_ping_subquery)
        .order_by("user__last_name", "user__first_name")
    )

    if not leader:
        teachers_qs = teachers_qs.filter(user_id=user.id)

    teachers = list(teachers_qs)
    latest_ping_ids = [t.latest_ping_id for t in teachers if t.latest_ping_id]

    latest_pings_by_id: dict[int, TeacherLocationPing] = (
        {
            p.id: p
            for p in TeacherLocationPing.objects.filter(id__in=latest_ping_ids).select_related("boundary")
        }
        if latest_ping_ids
        else {}
    )

    clocked_in_today_ids = set(
        TeacherDailyAttendance.objects.filter(
            attendance_date=today,
            time_in__isnull=False,
            time_out__isnull=True,
        ).values_list("teacher_id", flat=True)
    )

    incidents_qs = (
        LoafingIncident.objects.filter(detected_at__date=today)
        .select_related(
            "teacher",
            "teacher__user",
            "enrollment",
            "enrollment__student",
            "enrollment__section",
            "enrollment__section__grade_level",
            "class_period",
            "class_period__subject",
            "class_period__section",
            "class_period__section__grade_level",
            "trigger_ping",
            "trigger_ping__boundary",
            "reviewed_by",
        )
        .order_by("-detected_at")
    )
    if not leader:
        own_teacher = teachers[0] if teachers else None
        if own_teacher:
            incidents_qs = incidents_qs.filter(
                Q(teacher=own_teacher)
                | Q(enrollment__section_id__in=get_teacher_section_ids(own_teacher))
            )
        else:
            incidents_qs = incidents_qs.none()

    incidents_list = [format_loafing_incident(inc) for inc in incidents_qs[:100]]

    teacher_list: list[dict] = []
    online_count = 0
    verified_inside_count = 0
    outside_count = 0

    for t in teachers:
        latest = latest_pings_by_id.get(t.latest_ping_id) if t.latest_ping_id else None
        local_seen = timezone.localtime(latest.recorded_at) if latest else None
        ping_is_today = bool(local_seen and local_seen.date() == today)
        is_online = bool(latest and latest.recorded_at >= online_cutoff)

        inside = bool(ping_is_today and latest and latest.is_inside)
        dist = latest.distance_meters if (ping_is_today and latest) else None
        acc = latest.accuracy_meters if (ping_is_today and latest) else None
        ping_lat = float(latest.latitude) if (ping_is_today and latest) else None
        ping_lon = float(latest.longitude) if (ping_is_today and latest) else None

        if is_online:
            online_count += 1
        if ping_is_today and latest:
            if inside:
                verified_inside_count += 1
            else:
                outside_count += 1

        if not ping_is_today or not latest:
            zone_status = "OFF_DUTY"
            row_status = "OFFLINE"
        elif inside:
            zone_status = "INSIDE"
            row_status = "VERIFIED_INSIDE"
        elif latest.zone_status == "AUTHORIZED_OUTSIDE":
            zone_status = "AUTHORIZED_OUTSIDE"
            row_status = "AUTHORIZED_LEAVE"
        elif latest.zone_status == "LOAFING_ALERT":
            zone_status = "LOAFING_ALERT"
            row_status = "PERIMETER_BREACH"
        else:
            zone_status = "OFF_DUTY"
            row_status = "AWAY_OFF_DUTY" if is_online else "OFFLINE"

        if local_seen:
            last_seen_str = (
                local_seen.strftime("%I:%M:%S %p")
                if ping_is_today
                else local_seen.strftime("%b %d, %I:%M %p")
            )
        else:
            last_seen_str = "No ping yet"

        teacher_list.append(
            {
                "id": t.id,
                "teacher_id": t.id,
                "employee_id": t.employee_id,
                "full_name": t.full_name,
                "teacher_name": t.full_name,
                "department": t.department_name,
                "position": t.position_title,
                "photo_url": build_media_url(t.photo, request),
                "is_online": is_online,
                "is_clocked_in": t.id in clocked_in_today_ids,
                "zone_status": zone_status,
                "status": row_status,
                "is_inside": inside,
                "is_inside_geofence": inside,
                "distance_meters": dist,
                "distance": dist,
                "accuracy_meters": acc,
                "latitude": ping_lat,
                "longitude": ping_lon,
                "last_seen": last_seen_str,
                "recorded_at": local_seen.strftime("%I:%M:%S %p") if (ping_is_today and local_seen) else None,
                "bound_device_id": t.bound_device_id,
                "is_device_bound": bool(t.bound_device_id),
                "device_model": t.device_model or "",
            }
        )

    offline_count = max(len(teachers) - online_count, 0)

    return {
        "campus_name": name,
        "name": name,
        "latitude": lat,
        "longitude": lon,
        "center_latitude": lat,
        "center_longitude": lon,
        "radius_meters": radius,
        "geofence_radius_meters": radius,
        "loafing_grace_minutes": boundary.loafing_grace_minutes,
        "duty_start_time": str(boundary.duty_start_time)[:5],
        "duty_end_time": str(boundary.duty_end_time)[:5],
        "enforce_geofence_checkin": boundary.enforce_geofence_checkin,
        "is_active": boundary.is_active,
        "inside_count": verified_inside_count,
        "verified_inside": verified_inside_count,
        "outside_count": outside_count,
        "online_users_count": online_count,
        "offline_users_count": offline_count,
        "incidents_today": len(incidents_list),
        "open_incidents_count": sum(1 for i in incidents_list if i["status"] == "OPEN"),
        "teacher_list": teacher_list,
        "recent_breaches": incidents_list,
        "loafing_incidents": incidents_list,
    }


def get_campus_audit_history(*, user, request=None) -> dict:
    today = timezone.localdate()
    leader = is_school_leader(user)

    pings_qs = TeacherLocationPing.objects.select_related("teacher", "teacher__user", "boundary").order_by(
        "-recorded_at"
    )
    incidents_qs = LoafingIncident.objects.select_related(
        "teacher",
        "teacher__user",
        "enrollment",
        "enrollment__student",
        "enrollment__section",
        "enrollment__section__grade_level",
        "class_period",
        "class_period__subject",
        "trigger_ping",
        "trigger_ping__boundary",
        "reviewed_by",
    ).order_by("-detected_at")

    tracked_tables = {
        CampusBoundary._meta.db_table,
        SchoolSettings._meta.db_table,
        TeacherLocationPing._meta.db_table,
        LoafingIncident._meta.db_table,
    }
    audit_qs = (
        AuditLog.objects.select_related("performed_by")
        .filter(table_name__in=tracked_tables)
        .order_by("-created_at")
    )

    if not leader:
        own_teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        pings_qs = pings_qs.filter(teacher=own_teacher) if own_teacher else pings_qs.none()
        incidents_qs = (
            incidents_qs.filter(
                Q(teacher=own_teacher)
                | Q(enrollment__section_id__in=get_teacher_section_ids(own_teacher))
            )
            if own_teacher
            else incidents_qs.none()
        )
        audit_qs = audit_qs.filter(performed_by=user)

    if request:
        date_from = request.query_params.get("date_from")
        date_to = request.query_params.get("date_to")
        if date_from:
            pings_qs = pings_qs.filter(recorded_at__date__gte=date_from)
        if date_to:
            pings_qs = pings_qs.filter(recorded_at__date__lte=date_to)
        teacher_id = request.query_params.get("teacher_id")
        if teacher_id and str(teacher_id).isdigit():
            pings_qs = pings_qs.filter(teacher_id=int(teacher_id))
        st_filter = str(request.query_params.get("status") or "").upper()
        if st_filter == "INSIDE":
            pings_qs = pings_qs.filter(zone_status="INSIDE")
        elif st_filter == "OUTSIDE":
            pings_qs = pings_qs.exclude(zone_status="INSIDE")

    zone_labels = {
        "INSIDE": "On Campus",
        "AUTHORIZED_OUTSIDE": "Official Exit Pass",
        "LOAFING_ALERT": "Teacher Loafing Alert",
        "OFF_DUTY": "Off Duty",
    }
    records = []
    for p in pings_qs[:150]:
        local_rec = timezone.localtime(p.recorded_at)
        dist = p.distance_meters
        dist_label = (
            f"{dist / 1000:.2f} km"
            if (dist is not None and dist >= 1000)
            else f"{round(dist)}m" if dist is not None else "—"
        )
        readable_zone = zone_labels.get(p.zone_status, p.zone_status.replace("_", " ").title())
        records.append(
            {
                "id": f"ping-{p.id}",
                "teacher_id": p.teacher_id,
                "teacher_name": p.teacher.full_name,
                "employee_id": p.teacher.employee_id,
                "category": "PING",
                "action": p.zone_status,
                "status": p.zone_status,
                "is_inside": p.is_inside,
                "is_inside_geofence": p.is_inside,
                "latitude": float(p.latitude),
                "longitude": float(p.longitude),
                "distance_meters": dist,
                "distance": dist,
                "accuracy_meters": p.accuracy_meters,
                "device_id": p.device_id,
                "timestamp": local_rec.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p"),
                "date_only": str(local_rec.date()),
                "time_only": local_rec.strftime("%I:%M:%S %p"),
                "details": f"{readable_zone} ({dist_label} from school center)",
            }
        )

    incidents_data = [format_loafing_incident(inc) for inc in incidents_qs[:100]]
    audit_logs = [
        {
            "id": f"audit-{item.id}",
            "record_id": item.id,
            "category": "AUDIT",
            "user": (item.performed_by.get_full_name() or item.performed_by.username)
            if item.performed_by
            else "System",
            "action": item.action,
            "table_name": item.table_name,
            "ip_address": item.client_ip or "",
            "timestamp": timezone.localtime(item.created_at).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p"),
        }
        for item in audit_qs[:60]
    ]

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "count": len(records),
        "records": records,
        "results": records,
        "loafing_incidents": incidents_data,
        "audit_logs": audit_logs,
        "today": str(today),
    }


def get_loafing_incidents_queryset(*, user, incident_type: str = "", status_filter: str = "", date_str: str = ""):
    qs = LoafingIncident.objects.select_related(
        "teacher",
        "teacher__user",
        "enrollment",
        "enrollment__student",
        "enrollment__section",
        "enrollment__section__grade_level",
        "class_period",
        "class_period__subject",
        "class_period__section",
        "class_period__section__grade_level",
        "exit_pass",
        "trigger_ping",
        "trigger_ping__boundary",
        "reviewed_by",
    ).order_by("-detected_at")

    if not is_school_leader(user):
        own_teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        if not own_teacher:
            return qs.none()
        qs = qs.filter(
            Q(teacher=own_teacher)
            | Q(enrollment__section_id__in=get_teacher_section_ids(own_teacher))
        )

    if incident_type and incident_type.upper() != "ALL":
        qs = qs.filter(incident_type=incident_type.upper())
    if status_filter and status_filter.upper() != "ALL":
        qs = qs.filter(status=status_filter.upper())
    if date_str:
        qs = qs.filter(detected_at__date=date_str)
    return qs


def get_emergency_roll_call(*, request=None) -> dict:
    today = timezone.localdate()
    now = timezone.now()

    departed_enr_ids = set(
        ExitPass.objects.filter(
            pass_scope="STUDENT",
            is_cancelled=False,
            returned_at__isnull=True,
            issued_at__date=today,
            valid_until__gte=now,
        ).values_list("enrollment_id", flat=True)
    )

    present_rows = list(
        DailyAttendance.objects.filter(attendance_date=today, status__in=["PRESENT", "LATE"])
        .exclude(enrollment_id__in=departed_enr_ids)
        .select_related(
            "enrollment",
            "enrollment__student",
            "enrollment__section",
            "enrollment__section__grade_level",
        )
    )

    students = []
    for row in present_rows:
        st = row.enrollment.student
        sec = row.enrollment.section
        students.append(
            {
                "student_id": st.id,
                "enrollment_id": row.enrollment_id,
                "lrn": st.lrn,
                "full_name": st.full_name,
                "section": format_section_label(
                    sec.grade_level.name if (sec and sec.grade_level) else "",
                    sec.name if sec else "",
                ),
                "guardian_contact": st.guardian_contact,
                "photo_url": build_media_url(st.photo, request),
            }
        )
    students.sort(key=lambda item: (item["section"], item["full_name"]))

    latest_ping_subquery = Subquery(
        TeacherLocationPing.objects.filter(teacher_id=OuterRef("pk"), recorded_at__date=today)
        .order_by("-recorded_at", "-id")
        .values("zone_status")[:1]
    )
    teachers_inside = (
        TeacherProfile.objects.filter(user__is_active=True)
        .select_related("user", "department")
        .annotate(latest_zone=latest_ping_subquery)
        .filter(latest_zone="INSIDE")
        .order_by("user__last_name", "user__first_name")
    )

    teachers_payload = [
        {
            "teacher_id": t.id,
            "employee_id": t.employee_id,
            "full_name": t.full_name,
            "department": t.department_name,
        }
        for t in teachers_inside
    ]

    return {
        "timestamp": timezone.localtime().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p"),
        "total_people_on_campus": len(students) + len(teachers_payload),
        "students_count": len(students),
        "teachers_count": len(teachers_payload),
        "students": students,
        "teachers": teachers_payload,
    }

from rest_framework import serializers


class CampusBoundaryInputSerializer(serializers.Serializer):
    campus_name = serializers.CharField(max_length=150, required=False, default="Main Campus")
    center_latitude = serializers.FloatField(min_value=-90.0, max_value=90.0)
    center_longitude = serializers.FloatField(min_value=-180.0, max_value=180.0)
    radius_meters = serializers.IntegerField(min_value=20, max_value=5000, default=150)
    loafing_grace_minutes = serializers.IntegerField(min_value=0, max_value=120, required=False, default=10)
    duty_start_time = serializers.TimeField(required=False)
    duty_end_time = serializers.TimeField(required=False)
    enforce_geofence_checkin = serializers.BooleanField(required=False, default=True)

    def to_internal_value(self, data):
        mutable = {k: data.get(k) for k in data.keys()} if hasattr(data, "keys") else dict(data)
        if "campus_name" not in mutable and "name" in mutable:
            mutable["campus_name"] = mutable["name"]
        if "center_latitude" not in mutable and "latitude" in mutable:
            mutable["center_latitude"] = mutable["latitude"]
        if "center_longitude" not in mutable and "longitude" in mutable:
            mutable["center_longitude"] = mutable["longitude"]
        if "radius_meters" not in mutable and "geofence_radius_meters" in mutable:
            mutable["radius_meters"] = mutable["geofence_radius_meters"]
        if "loafing_grace_minutes" not in mutable and "grace_minutes" in mutable:
            mutable["loafing_grace_minutes"] = mutable["grace_minutes"]
        return super().to_internal_value(mutable)

        max_length=128, required=False, allow_blank=True, allow_null=True

        max_length=128, required=False, allow_blank=True, allow_null=True

        max_length=40, required=False, allow_blank=True, allow_null=True
    )
    biometric_timestamp_ms = serializers.IntegerField(required=False, allow_null=True)

    def validate_biometric_proof(self, value):
        if value is None:
            return value
        return str(value).strip()

BIOMETRIC_PROOF_HEX_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$")
BIOMETRIC_PROOF_MAX_DRIFT_MS = 120_000
BIOMETRIC_PROOF_REPLAY_TTL_SECONDS = 300


@transaction.atomic
def update_campus_boundary(
    *,
    request,
    campus_name: str = "Main Campus",
    center_latitude: float,
    center_longitude: float,
    radius_meters: int = 150,
    loafing_grace_minutes: int = 10,
    duty_start_time: dt_time | None = None,
    duty_end_time: dt_time | None = None,
    enforce_geofence_checkin: bool = True,
) -> CampusBoundary:
    if not (20 <= radius_meters <= 5000):
        raise AppError("INVALID_RADIUS", "Campus radius must be between 20 and 5000 meters.", 400)

    clean_name = strip_tags(str(campus_name or "Main Campus")).strip()[:150] or "Main Campus"
    boundary = (
        CampusBoundary.objects.filter(is_active=True).order_by("id").first()
        or CampusBoundary.objects.order_by("id").first()
    )
    if boundary:
        boundary.campus_name = clean_name
        boundary.center_latitude = Decimal(f"{float(center_latitude):.6f}")
        boundary.center_longitude = Decimal(f"{float(center_longitude):.6f}")
        boundary.radius_meters = int(radius_meters)
        boundary.loafing_grace_minutes = int(loafing_grace_minutes)
        if duty_start_time is not None:
            boundary.duty_start_time = duty_start_time
        if duty_end_time is not None:
            boundary.duty_end_time = duty_end_time
        boundary.enforce_geofence_checkin = bool(enforce_geofence_checkin)
        boundary.is_active = True
        boundary.save()
    else:
        boundary = CampusBoundary.objects.create(
            campus_name=clean_name,
            center_latitude=Decimal(f"{float(center_latitude):.6f}"),
            center_longitude=Decimal(f"{float(center_longitude):.6f}"),
            radius_meters=int(radius_meters),
            loafing_grace_minutes=int(loafing_grace_minutes),
            duty_start_time=duty_start_time or dt_time(7, 30),
            duty_end_time=duty_end_time or dt_time(17, 0),
            enforce_geofence_checkin=bool(enforce_geofence_checkin),
            is_active=True,
        )

    school = SchoolSettings.objects.first()
    if school and school.campus_boundary_id != boundary.id:
        school.campus_boundary = boundary
        school.save(update_fields=["campus_boundary", "updated_at"])

    cache.delete_many([ACTIVE_BOUNDARY_CACHE_KEY, "school:metadata:raw", "reports:system_status"])

    record_audit_log(
        request=request,
        table_name=CampusBoundary._meta.db_table,
        record_id=boundary.id,
        action="UPDATE",
        new_data={
            "campus_name": boundary.campus_name,
            "center_latitude": float(boundary.center_latitude),
            "center_longitude": float(boundary.center_longitude),
            "radius_meters": boundary.radius_meters,
        },
    )
    return boundary


def _verify_and_bind_teacher_device(
    *,
    teacher,
    device_id: str,
    device_model: str = "",
    request=None,
    require_device: bool = False,
) -> str:
    clean_device_id = strip_tags(str(device_id or "")).strip()[:128]
    clean_model = strip_tags(str(device_model or "")).strip()[:100]
    if not clean_device_id:
        if require_device:
            raise AppError(
                "DEVICE_ID_REQUIRED",
                "Your phone ID is required to Time In or Time Out. Please restart the AttendSure app and try again.",
                400,
            )
        if teacher.bound_device_id:
            raise AppError(
                "DEVICE_ID_REQUIRED",
                "Your paired phone ID is required to verify your campus location.",
                403,
            )
        return ""

    if not teacher.bound_device_id:
        existing_owner = (
            TeacherProfile.objects.filter(bound_device_id=clean_device_id)
            .exclude(pk=teacher.pk)
            .only("id", "employee_id")
            .first()
        )
        if existing_owner:
            record_audit_log(
                request=request,
                table_name=teacher._meta.db_table,
                record_id=teacher.id,
                action="DEV_REJECT",
                new_data={
                    "employee_id": teacher.employee_id,
                    "existing_owner_id": existing_owner.id,
                },
            )
            raise AppError(
                "DEVICE_ALREADY_BOUND",
                "This phone is already paired with another teacher account. Ask your Principal or Admin to unlink it before pairing here.",
                403,
            )

        teacher.bound_device_id = clean_device_id
        if clean_model:
            teacher.device_model = clean_model
        teacher.device_bound_at = timezone.now()
        try:
            with transaction.atomic():
                teacher.save(
                    update_fields=[
                        "bound_device_id",
                        "device_model",
                        "device_bound_at",
                        "updated_at",
                    ]
                )
        except IntegrityError:
            raise AppError(
                "DEVICE_ALREADY_BOUND",
                "This phone is already paired with another teacher account. Ask your Principal or Admin to unlink it before pairing here.",
                403,
            )
    elif not hmac.compare_digest(str(teacher.bound_device_id), clean_device_id):
        raise AppError(
            "DEVICE_MISMATCH",
            "Your account is paired with your previous phone for attendance protection. If you changed phones, ask your Principal or Admin to clear the old link so you can pair this phone.",
            403,
        )
    return clean_device_id


def _check_existing_teacher_biometric_key(
    *,
    teacher,
    biometric_key_id: str | None,
    biometric_proof: str | None = None,
    biometric_timestamp_ms: int | None = None,
    now_override=None,
    request=None,
) -> str:
    """
    Validates an enrolled 1-to-1 phone security key plus proof format, timestamp freshness,
    and single-use replay protection outside any failing transaction so BIO_REJECT audit logs
    are always saved. Returns the cleaned incoming biometric_key_id.
    """
    clean_key_id = strip_tags(str(biometric_key_id or "")).strip()[:128]
    clean_proof = strip_tags(str(biometric_proof or "")).strip()
    stored_key_id = (teacher.biometric_key_id or "").strip()

    if stored_key_id:
        if not clean_key_id or not hmac.compare_digest(stored_key_id, clean_key_id):
            record_audit_log(
                request=request,
                table_name=teacher._meta.db_table,
                record_id=teacher.id,
                action="BIO_REJECT",
                new_data={
                    "employee_id": teacher.employee_id,
                    "missing_key": not bool(clean_key_id),
                },
            )
            raise AppError(
                "BIOMETRIC_MISMATCH",
                "Your phone's security check did not match the one linked to your account. If you switched phones or reset your screen lock, ask your Principal or Admin to refresh your phone link.",
                403,
            )

    biometric_active = bool(
        stored_key_id or clean_key_id or clean_proof or biometric_timestamp_ms is not None
    )
    if biometric_active:
        if not BIOMETRIC_PROOF_HEX_RE.fullmatch(clean_proof):
            raise AppError(
                "INVALID_BIOMETRIC_PROOF",
                "A valid phone unlock check is required to Time In or Time Out. Please confirm your phone lock and try again.",
                400,
            )

        if biometric_timestamp_ms is None or isinstance(biometric_timestamp_ms, bool):
            raise AppError(
                "BIOMETRIC_PROOF_EXPIRED",
                "Your phone unlock check is missing a timestamp. Please confirm your phone lock again.",
                400,
            )

        try:
            proof_ts_ms = int(biometric_timestamp_ms)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise AppError(
                "BIOMETRIC_PROOF_EXPIRED",
                "Your phone unlock check has an invalid timestamp. Please confirm your phone lock again.",
                400,
            )

        server_now_ms = (
            now_override.timestamp() * 1000.0 if now_override is not None else time.time() * 1000.0
        )
        if abs(server_now_ms - float(proof_ts_ms)) > BIOMETRIC_PROOF_MAX_DRIFT_MS:
            raise AppError(
                "BIOMETRIC_PROOF_EXPIRED",
                "Your phone unlock check expired (must be within 2 minutes). Please confirm your phone lock again.",
                400,
            )

        replay_key = f"bio_proof_used:{teacher.pk}:{clean_proof.lower()}"
        if not cache.add(replay_key, True, timeout=BIOMETRIC_PROOF_REPLAY_TTL_SECONDS):
            raise AppError(
                "BIOMETRIC_PROOF_REPLAYED",
                "This phone unlock check was already used. Please confirm your phone lock again to record a new Time In or Time Out.",
                400,
            )

    return clean_key_id


def _enroll_teacher_biometric_key_if_needed(
    *,
    teacher,
    clean_key_id: str,
    request=None,
) -> bool:
    """
    Enrolls the public SHA-256 key identifier on first verified check-in when empty.
    Stores ONLY the public key digest in TeacherProfile.biometric_key_id (never biometric data).
    """
    if not (teacher.biometric_key_id or "").strip() and clean_key_id:
        teacher.biometric_key_id = clean_key_id
        teacher.save(update_fields=["biometric_key_id", "updated_at"])
        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name=teacher._meta.db_table,
            record_id=teacher.id,
            action="BIO_ENROLL",
            new_data={"employee_id": teacher.employee_id},
        )
        return True
    return False


def _check_anti_spoof_gps_telemetry(*, teacher, validated_data: dict, now) -> None:
    speed = validated_data.get("speed_mps")
    if speed is not None and math.isfinite(float(speed)) and float(speed) > MAX_PLAUSIBLE_SPEED_MPS:
        raise AppError(
            "SPOOFED_GPS_SPEED",
            "Your phone reported an unusual location jump. Please turn off any mock location app and try again.",
            400,
        )

    gps_ts_ms = validated_data.get("gps_timestamp_ms")
    if gps_ts_ms:
        age_seconds = abs((now.timestamp() * 1000.0 - float(gps_ts_ms)) / 1000.0)
        if age_seconds > 120:
            raise AppError(
                "STALE_GPS_FIX",
                "Your phone's GPS reading is older than 2 minutes. Step near a window or outdoors for a fresh signal.",
                400,
            )

    prev_ping = (
        TeacherLocationPing.objects.filter(teacher=teacher)
        .order_by("-recorded_at")
        .only("latitude", "longitude", "recorded_at")
        .first()
    )
    if prev_ping:
        elapsed = (now - prev_ping.recorded_at).total_seconds()
        if 1.0 <= elapsed <= 60.0:
            jump_meters = calculate_distance_meters(
                validated_data["latitude"],
                validated_data["longitude"],
                prev_ping.latitude,
                prev_ping.longitude,
            )
            if (
                math.isfinite(jump_meters)
                and jump_meters > 500
                and (jump_meters / elapsed) > MAX_PLAUSIBLE_SPEED_MPS
            ):
                raise AppError(
                    "GPS_TELEPORT_DETECTED",
                    "Your phone reported a sudden location jump. Please turn off any mock location app and try again.",
                    400,
                )


def record_teacher_gps_ping(
    *,
    user,
    validated_data: dict,
    header_device_id: str = "",
    is_checkin: bool = False,
    is_checkout: bool = False,
    now_override=None,
    request=None,
) -> dict:
    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    if not teacher:
        raise AppError("NO_TEACHER_PROFILE", "No active teacher profile is linked to this account.", 403)
    teacher.refresh_from_db(
        fields=["bound_device_id", "device_model", "device_bound_at", "biometric_key_id"]
    )

    action_str = str(validated_data.get("action") or "").upper()
    do_checkout = is_checkout or action_str in ("TIME_OUT", "TIME_OUT_PM", "CHECK_OUT")
    do_checkin = is_checkin or action_str in ("TIME_IN", "TIME_IN_AM", "TIME_IN_PM", "CHECK_IN")

    if (do_checkin or do_checkout) and (
        validated_data.get("biometric_verified_on_device") is False
        or validated_data.get("face_verified_on_device") is False
        or validated_data.get("face_verified") is False
    ):
        raise AppError(
            "BIOMETRIC_CHECK_FAILED",
            "Phone unlock verification was cancelled or did not finish. Please confirm with your phone lock to continue.",
            403,
        )

    raw_device_id = (
        validated_data.get("device_id")
        or validated_data.get("client_device_id")
        or header_device_id
        or ""
    )
    device_id = _verify_and_bind_teacher_device(
        teacher=teacher,
        device_id=str(raw_device_id),
        device_model=str(validated_data.get("device_model") or ""),
        request=request,
        require_device=(do_checkin or do_checkout),
    )

    clean_biometric_key_id = ""
    if do_checkin or do_checkout:
        clean_biometric_key_id = _check_existing_teacher_biometric_key(
            teacher=teacher,
            biometric_key_id=validated_data.get("biometric_key_id"),
            biometric_proof=validated_data.get("biometric_proof"),
            biometric_timestamp_ms=validated_data.get("biometric_timestamp_ms"),
            now_override=now_override,
            request=request,
        )

    boundary = get_active_campus_boundary()
    raw_acc = (
        validated_data.get("accuracy_meters")
        if validated_data.get("accuracy_meters") is not None
        else validated_data.get("accuracy")
    )
    is_mock = bool(validated_data.get("is_mock_location") or validated_data.get("mocked"))

    gps = verify_campus_gps(
        latitude=validated_data["latitude"],
        longitude=validated_data["longitude"],
        campus_lat=float(boundary.center_latitude),
        campus_lon=float(boundary.center_longitude),
        radius_meters=int(boundary.radius_meters),
        accuracy_meters=raw_acc,
        is_mock_location=is_mock,
    )
    if not gps["is_valid"]:
        raise AppError("INVALID_GPS", gps["reason"], 400)

    now = now_override or timezone.now()
    _check_anti_spoof_gps_telemetry(teacher=teacher, validated_data=validated_data, now=now)

    local_now = timezone.localtime(now)
    today = local_now.date()
    local_time = local_now.time()

    with transaction.atomic():
        has_active_pass = ExitPass.objects.filter(
            pass_scope="TEACHER",
            teacher=teacher,
            is_cancelled=False,
            returned_at__isnull=True,
            issued_at__lte=now,
            valid_until__gte=now,
        ).exists()

        daily_att = TeacherDailyAttendance.objects.filter(teacher=teacher, attendance_date=today).first()
        is_clocked_in = bool(daily_att and daily_att.time_in and not daily_att.time_out)

        if gps["is_inside"]:
            zone_status = "INSIDE"
        elif has_active_pass:
            zone_status = "AUTHORIZED_OUTSIDE"
        elif is_clocked_in:
            zone_status = "LOAFING_ALERT"
        else:
            zone_status = "OFF_DUTY"

        lat_dec = Decimal(f"{float(validated_data['latitude']):.6f}")
        lng_dec = Decimal(f"{float(validated_data['longitude']):.6f}")

        ping = TeacherLocationPing.objects.create(
            teacher=teacher,
            boundary=boundary,
            latitude=lat_dec,
            longitude=lng_dec,
            accuracy_meters=float(raw_acc) if raw_acc is not None else 0.0,
            zone_status=zone_status,
            device_id=device_id,
            recorded_at=now,
        )

        incident_id = None
        if zone_status == "LOAFING_ALERT":
            existing_open = LoafingIncident.objects.filter(
                incident_type="TEACHER_OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE",
                teacher=teacher,
                status="OPEN",
                detected_at__date=today,
            ).first()
            if existing_open:
                existing_open.trigger_ping = ping
                existing_open.save(update_fields=["trigger_ping"])
                incident_id = existing_open.id
            else:
                inc = LoafingIncident.objects.create(
                    incident_type="TEACHER_OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE",
                    status="OPEN",
                    teacher=teacher,
                    trigger_ping=ping,
                    detected_at=now,
                    remarks=f"Location recorded {round(gps['distance_meters'] or 0)}m outside {boundary.campus_name} while timed in on duty without an official exit pass.",
                )
                incident_id = inc.id
        elif zone_status == "INSIDE":
            LoafingIncident.objects.filter(
                incident_type="TEACHER_OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE",
                teacher=teacher,
                status="OPEN",
                detected_at__date=today,
            ).update(status="RETURNED", resolved_at=now)

        if do_checkin and not do_checkout:
            if boundary.enforce_geofence_checkin and not gps["is_inside"] and not has_active_pass:
                raise AppError(
                    "OUTSIDE_CAMPUS",
                    f"Move inside {boundary.campus_name} to Time In (currently {round(gps['distance_meters'] or 0)}m from campus center), or request an Official Locator Slip if on school business.",
                    403,
                )
            grace_dt = timezone.make_aware(
                timezone.datetime.combine(today, boundary.duty_start_time),
                timezone.get_current_timezone(),
            ) + timezone.timedelta(minutes=boundary.loafing_grace_minutes)
            if has_active_pass and not gps["is_inside"]:
                att_status = "ON_OFFICIAL_PASS"
            elif now > grace_dt:
                att_status = "LATE"
            else:
                att_status = "ON_TIME"

            if daily_att:
                if not daily_att.time_in:
                    daily_att.time_in = now
                    daily_att.checkin_latitude = lat_dec
                    daily_att.checkin_longitude = lng_dec
                daily_att.device_id = device_id
                daily_att.face_verified_on_device = True
                daily_att.status = att_status
                daily_att.save()
            else:
                TeacherDailyAttendance.objects.create(
                    teacher=teacher,
                    boundary=boundary,
                    attendance_date=today,
                    time_in=now,
                    checkin_latitude=lat_dec,
                    checkin_longitude=lng_dec,
                    device_id=device_id,
                    face_verified_on_device=True,
                    status=att_status,
                )
        elif do_checkout:
            if boundary.enforce_geofence_checkin and not gps["is_inside"] and not has_active_pass:
                raise AppError(
                    "OUTSIDE_CAMPUS",
                    f"Step inside {boundary.campus_name} to Time Out (currently {round(gps['distance_meters'] or 0)}m from campus center), or request an Official Locator Slip if off campus.",
                    403,
                )
            if daily_att:
                daily_att.time_out = now
                daily_att.checkout_latitude = lat_dec
                daily_att.checkout_longitude = lng_dec
                daily_att.device_id = device_id
                daily_att.save(
                    update_fields=["time_out", "checkout_latitude", "checkout_longitude", "device_id"]
                )

        just_enrolled_biometric = False
        if do_checkin or do_checkout:
            just_enrolled_biometric = _enroll_teacher_biometric_key_if_needed(
                teacher=teacher,
                clean_key_id=clean_biometric_key_id,
                request=request,
            )

    cache.delete_many(["dashboard:leader", f"dashboard:teacher:{user.id}", "reports:system_status"])

    reply_message = gps["reason"]
    if do_checkin and not do_checkout:
        enroll_note = (
            " Your phone is now paired for private, one-tap Time In — zero photos or fingerprint data are stored on the server."
            if just_enrolled_biometric
            else " Verified safely on your phone inside the school boundary."
        )
        reply_message = f"Timed In at {local_now.strftime('%I:%M:%S %p')}.{enroll_note}"
    elif do_checkout:
        reply_message = (
            f"Timed Out at {local_now.strftime('%I:%M:%S %p')}. Duty check is now off — have a safe trip home."
        )

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "success": True,
        "ping_id": ping.id,
        "zone_status": zone_status,
        "is_inside": bool(gps["is_inside"]),
        "is_inside_geofence": bool(gps["is_inside"]),
        "distance_meters": ping.distance_meters,
        "allowed_radius": gps["allowed_radius"],
        "loafing_incident_id": incident_id,
        "biometric_enrolled": bool(teacher.biometric_key_id),
        "just_enrolled_biometric": just_enrolled_biometric,
        "recorded_at": local_now.strftime("%I:%M:%S %p"),
        "message": reply_message,
    }


@transaction.atomic
def resolve_loafing_incident(
    *, request, incident: LoafingIncident, next_status: str, remarks: str = ""
) -> LoafingIncident:
    clean_status = str(next_status or "").strip().upper()
    if clean_status not in {"CONFIRMED_LOAFING", "RETURNED", "EXCUSED"}:
        raise AppError(
            "INVALID_STATUS",
            "Resolution status must be CONFIRMED_LOAFING, RETURNED, or EXCUSED.",
            400,
        )

    incident.status = clean_status
    incident.resolved_at = timezone.now()
    incident.reviewed_by = request.user
    clean_remarks = strip_tags(str(remarks or "")).strip()[:500]
    if clean_remarks:
        incident.remarks = clean_remarks
    incident.save(update_fields=["status", "resolved_at", "reviewed_by", "remarks"])

    cache_keys = ["dashboard:leader", "reports:system_status"]
    if incident.teacher_id and incident.teacher and incident.teacher.user_id:
        cache_keys.append(f"dashboard:teacher:{incident.teacher.user_id}")
    cache.delete_many(cache_keys)

    record_audit_log(
        request=request,
        table_name=incident._meta.db_table,
        record_id=incident.id,
        action="RESOLVE",
        new_data={"status": clean_status, "remarks": clean_remarks},
    )
    return incident

            is_active=True,
        )

    def _checkin_payload(self, **overrides) -> dict:
        payload = {
            "action": "TIME_IN",
            "latitude": 8.4858,
            "longitude": 124.6567,
            "accuracy_meters": 10,
            "device_id": "PHONE-SEC-001",
            "device_model": "Test Phone",
            "biometric_verified_on_device": True,
            "biometric_key_id": "a" * 64,
            "biometric_proof": "1" * 64,
            "biometric_timestamp_ms": int(time_module.time() * 1000),
        }
        payload.update(overrides)
        return payload

    def test_first_time_checkin_and_checkout_reject_empty_device_id(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.teacher_user)

        for action_name in ("TIME_IN", "TIME_OUT"):
            res = self.client.post(
                "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
                self._checkin_payload(action=action_name, device_id=""),
                format="json",
            )
            self.assertEqual(res.status_code, 400, f"{action_name} should reject empty device_id")
            self.assertEqual(res.data["error_code"], "DEVICE_ID_REQUIRED")
            self.teacher.refresh_from_db()
            self.assertIsNone(self.teacher.bound_device_id)

        # Supplying a real device_id succeeds and binds the phone 1-to-1
        ok_res = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            self._checkin_payload(device_id="PHONE-FIRST-BIND", biometric_proof="2" * 64),
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(ok_res.status_code, 201, ok_res.data)
        self.teacher.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.teacher.bound_device_id, "PHONE-FIRST-BIND")

    def test_biometric_proof_format_freshness_and_replay_protection(self):
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.teacher_user)
        now_ms = int(time_module.time() * 1000)

        # 1. Invalid non-hex / short proof rejected with 400
        bad_fmt = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            self._checkin_payload(biometric_proof="not-a-sha256-hex", biometric_timestamp_ms=now_ms),
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(bad_fmt.status_code, 400)
        self.assertEqual(bad_fmt.data["error_code"], "INVALID_BIOMETRIC_PROOF")

        # 2. Missing biometric_timestamp_ms rejected with 400 BIOMETRIC_PROOF_EXPIRED
        missing_ts = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            self._checkin_payload(biometric_proof="3" * 64, biometric_timestamp_ms=None),
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(missing_ts.status_code, 400)
        self.assertEqual(missing_ts.data["error_code"], "BIOMETRIC_PROOF_EXPIRED")

        # 3. Stale timestamp (> 2 minutes old) rejected with 400 BIOMETRIC_PROOF_EXPIRED
        stale = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            self._checkin_payload(
                biometric_proof="4" * 64,
                biometric_timestamp_ms=now_ms - 180_000,
            ),
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(stale.status_code, 400)
        self.assertEqual(stale.data["error_code"], "BIOMETRIC_PROOF_EXPIRED")

        # 4. Future timestamp (> 2 minutes ahead) rejected with 400 BIOMETRIC_PROOF_EXPIRED
        future = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            self._checkin_payload(
                biometric_proof="5" * 64,
                biometric_timestamp_ms=now_ms + 180_000,
            ),
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(future.status_code, 400)
        self.assertEqual(future.data["error_code"], "BIOMETRIC_PROOF_EXPIRED")

        # 5. Fresh valid 64-char hex proof succeeds
        proof_hash = "ab" * 32
        first_ok = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            self._checkin_payload(
                action="TIME_IN",
                biometric_proof=proof_hash,
                biometric_timestamp_ms=now_ms,
            ),
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(first_ok.status_code, 201, first_ok.data)

        # 6. Replaying the exact same proof (even in uppercase) is rejected with 400 BIOMETRIC_PROOF_REPLAYED
        replayed = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            self._checkin_payload(
                action="TIME_OUT",
                biometric_proof=proof_hash.upper(),
                biometric_timestamp_ms=int(time_module.time() * 1000),
            ),
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(replayed.status_code, 400)
        self.assertEqual(replayed.data["error_code"], "BIOMETRIC_PROOF_REPLAYED")

        # 7. Fresh unique proof succeeds on TIME_OUT
        second_ok = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/campus/check-in/",
            self._checkin_payload(
                action="TIME_OUT",
                biometric_proof="cd" * 32,
                biometric_timestamp_ms=int(time_module.time() * 1000),
            ),
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(second_ok.status_code, 201, second_ok.data)

    def test_get_client_ip_ignores_untrusted_forwarded_headers_and_validates_format(self):
        rf = RequestFactory()

        # Untrusted direct caller trying to spoof X-Forwarded-For and CF-Connecting-IP
        spoofed_req = rf.get(
            "/api/v1/accounts/login/",
            REMOTE_ADDR="203.0.113.50",
            HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR="198.51.100.99",
            HTTP_CF_CONNECTING_IP="198.51.100.88",
        )
        self.assertEqual(get_client_ip(spoofed_req), "203.0.113.50")

        # Trusted local reverse proxy honors valid CF-Connecting-IP and X-Forwarded-For
        cf_req = rf.get(
            "/api/v1/accounts/login/",
            REMOTE_ADDR="127.0.0.1",
            HTTP_CF_CONNECTING_IP="198.51.100.88",
            HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR="198.51.100.77",
        )
        self.assertEqual(get_client_ip(cf_req), "198.51.100.88")

        xff_req = rf.get(
            "/api/v1/accounts/login/",
            REMOTE_ADDR="127.0.0.1",
            HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR="198.51.100.77, 10.0.0.1",
        )
        self.assertEqual(get_client_ip(xff_req), "198.51.100.77")

        # Malformed header never crashes GenericIPAddressField on AuditLog
        bad_req = rf.get(
            "/api/v1/accounts/login/",
            REMOTE_ADDR="127.0.0.1",
            HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR="invalid-ip-header; drop table",
        )
        bad_req.user = self.admin_user
        self.assertEqual(get_client_ip(bad_req), "127.0.0.1")
        record_audit_log(
            request=bad_req,
            table_name="auth_user",
            record_id=self.admin_user.id,
            action="LOGIN",
            new_data={"username": self.admin_user.username},
        )
        latest = AuditLog.objects.order_by("-id").first()
        self.assertIsNotNone(latest)
        self.assertEqual(latest.client_ip, "127.0.0.1")

        # Empty/None request defaults safely
        self.assertEqual(get_client_ip(None), "127.0.0.1")

    def test_allowed_hosts_has_no_wildcard_and_keeps_safe_local_hosts(self):
        self.assertNotIn("*", settings.ALLOWED_HOSTS)
        for host in ("localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]", "testserver", "10.0.2.2"):
            self.assertIn(host, settings.ALLOWED_HOSTS)

    def test_audit_log_serializer_and_list_filtering_by_action_date_and_search(self):
        tz = timezone.get_current_timezone()
        day_one = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(date(2026, 11, 20), time(9, 15)), tz)
        day_two = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(date(2026, 11, 25), time(14, 30)), tz)

        log_login = AuditLog.objects.create(
            table_name="",
            record_id=self.admin_user.id,
            action="LOGIN",
            new_data={"username": self.admin_user.username, "role": "ADMIN"},
            performed_by=self.admin_user,
            client_ip="198.51.100.10",
            user_agent="AttendSure-Web",
            created_at=day_one,
        )
        log_lockout = AuditLog.objects.create(
            table_name="user_profiles",
            record_id=self.teacher_user.id,
            action="LOCKOUT",
            new_data={"username": self.teacher_user.username, "failed_login_attempts": 5},
            performed_by=self.teacher_user,
            client_ip="203.0.113.44",
            user_agent="AttendSure-Mobile",
            created_at=day_two,
        )
        log_update = AuditLog.objects.create(
            table_name="campus_boundaries",
            record_id=self.boundary.id,
            action="UPDATE",
            new_data={"campus_name": "Main School Campus", "radius_meters": 200},
            performed_by=self.admin_user,
            client_ip="198.51.100.10",
            user_agent="AttendSure-Web",
            created_at=day_two,
        )

        # Direct serializer checks: readable module fallback, everyday details, computed status
        ser_login = AuditLogSerializer(log_login).data
        self.assertTrue(ser_login["created_at"])
        self.assertEqual(ser_login["module"], "Account")
        self.assertEqual(ser_login["actor_username"], self.admin_user.username)
        self.assertEqual(ser_login["actor_name"], "Clara Admin")
        self.assertEqual(ser_login["status"], "SUCCESS")
        self.assertIn("Signed in", ser_login["details"])
        self.assertNotIn("{", ser_login["details"])

        ser_lock = AuditLogSerializer(log_lockout).data
        self.assertEqual(ser_lock["status"], "FAILED")
        self.assertEqual(ser_lock["target_model"], "user_profiles")
        self.assertEqual(ser_lock["target_id"], self.teacher_user.id)
        self.assertEqual(ser_lock["module"], "Account Security")
        self.assertIn("locked", ser_lock["details"].lower())

        ser_upd = AuditLogSerializer(log_update).data
        self.assertEqual(ser_upd["module"], "Campus Boundary")
        self.assertIn("Main School Campus", ser_upd["details"])
        self.assertEqual(ser_upd["status"], "SUCCESS")

        # API filtering checks
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.admin_user)

        by_action = self.client.get("/api/v1/accounts/audit-logs/", {"action": "LOCKOUT"})
        self.assertEqual(by_action.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(by_action.data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(by_action.data["results"][0]["id"], log_lockout.id)
        self.assertEqual(by_action.data["results"][0]["status"], "FAILED")

        by_date = self.client.get("/api/v1/accounts/audit-logs/", {"date": "2026-11-20"})
        self.assertEqual(by_date.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(by_date.data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(by_date.data["results"][0]["id"], log_login.id)

        # Malformed date never raises 500
        bad_date = self.client.get("/api/v1/accounts/audit-logs/", {"date": "not-a-valid-date"})
        self.assertEqual(bad_date.status_code, 200)

        # Search by username / name / IP / module
        by_search_ip = self.client.get("/api/v1/accounts/audit-logs/", {"search": "203.0.113.44"})
        self.assertEqual(by_search_ip.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(by_search_ip.data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(by_search_ip.data["results"][0]["id"], log_lockout.id)

        by_search_name = self.client.get("/api/v1/accounts/audit-logs/", {"search": "Marco"})
        self.assertEqual(by_search_name.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(by_search_name.data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(by_search_name.data["results"][0]["id"], log_lockout.id)

        by_search_module = self.client.get("/api/v1/accounts/audit-logs/", {"search": "Campus Boundary"})
        self.assertEqual(by_search_module.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(by_search_module.data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(by_search_module.data["results"][0]["id"], log_update.id)

from rest_framework import permissions, status, viewsets
from rest_framework.decorators import action
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.throttling import UserRateThrottle
from rest_framework.views import APIView

from apps.attendance.loafing_detector import detect_daily_student_loafing
from common.permissions import (
    IsAdminOrPrincipalOrReadOnly,
    IsSchoolLeader,
    IsTeacherOrLeader,
    is_school_leader,
)
from .selectors import (
    format_loafing_incident,
    get_campus_audit_history,
    get_campus_boundary_overview,
    get_emergency_roll_call,
    get_loafing_incidents_queryset,
)
from .serializers import CampusBoundaryInputSerializer, TeacherGpsPingSerializer
from .services import record_teacher_gps_ping, resolve_loafing_incident, update_campus_boundary


class GpsPingThrottle(UserRateThrottle):
    scope = "scan_ping"


class CampusOverviewView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsAdminOrPrincipalOrReadOnly]

    def get(self, request):
        return Response(get_campus_boundary_overview(user=request.user, request=request))

    def put(self, request):
        serializer = CampusBoundaryInputSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        update_campus_boundary(request=request, **serializer.validated_data)
        return Response(get_campus_boundary_overview(user=request.user, request=request))

    def post(self, request):
        return self.put(request)

    def patch(self, request):
        return self.put(request)


CampusBoundaryView = CampusOverviewView


class TeacherGpsPingView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsTeacherOrLeader]
    throttle_classes = [GpsPingThrottle]

    def post(self, request):
        serializer = TeacherGpsPingSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        result = record_teacher_gps_ping(
            user=request.user,
            validated_data=serializer.validated_data,
            header_device_id=request.headers.get("X-Device-UUID", ""),
            is_checkin=False,
            request=request,
        )
        return Response(result, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)


class TeacherCheckInView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsTeacherOrLeader]
    throttle_classes = [GpsPingThrottle]

    def post(self, request):
        serializer = TeacherGpsPingSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        action_val = str(serializer.validated_data.get("action") or "CHECK_IN").upper()
        is_checkout = action_val in ("CHECK_OUT", "TIME_OUT", "TIME_OUT_PM")
        result = record_teacher_gps_ping(
            user=request.user,
            validated_data=serializer.validated_data,
            header_device_id=request.headers.get("X-Device-UUID", ""),
            is_checkin=not is_checkout,
            is_checkout=is_checkout,
            request=request,
        )
        return Response(result, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

class BoundaryAuditView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def get(self, request):
        return Response(get_campus_audit_history(user=request.user, request=request))


class LoafingIncidentViewSet(viewsets.ReadOnlyModelViewSet):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def get_queryset(self):
        return get_loafing_incidents_queryset(
            user=self.request.user,
            incident_type=str(self.request.query_params.get("incident_type") or ""),
            status_filter=str(self.request.query_params.get("status") or ""),
            date_str=str(self.request.query_params.get("date") or ""),
        )

    def list(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        items = [format_loafing_incident(inc) for inc in self.get_queryset()[:200]]
        return Response({"ok": True, "count": len(items), "results": items, "incidents": items})

    def retrieve(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        return Response(format_loafing_incident(self.get_object()))

    def update(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        if not is_school_leader(request.user):
            self.permission_denied(
                request,
                message="Only school leaders can resolve or update loafing incidents.",
            )
        incident = self.get_object()
        updated = resolve_loafing_incident(
            request=request,
            incident=incident,
            next_status=str(request.data.get("status") or ""),
            remarks=str(request.data.get("remarks") or ""),
        )
        formatted = format_loafing_incident(updated)
        return Response({"ok": True, **formatted, "incident": formatted})

    def partial_update(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        return self.update(request, *args, **kwargs)

    @action(
        detail=True,
        methods=["post"],
        url_path="resolve",
        permission_classes=[permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsSchoolLeader],
    )
    def resolve(self, request, pk=None):
        incident = self.get_object()
        updated = resolve_loafing_incident(
            request=request,
            incident=incident,
            next_status=str(request.data.get("status") or ""),
            remarks=str(request.data.get("remarks") or ""),
        )
        return Response({"ok": True, "incident": format_loafing_incident(updated)})

    @action(
        detail=False,
        methods=["post"],
        url_path="run-audit",
        permission_classes=[permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsTeacherOrLeader],
    )
    def run_audit(self, request):
        sec_id = request.data.get("section_id")
        parsed_sec = int(sec_id) if (sec_id and str(sec_id).isdigit()) else None
        summary = detect_daily_student_loafing(section_id=parsed_sec, user=request.user)
        return Response(summary, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class CampusAnomalyListView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def get(self, request):
        qs = get_loafing_incidents_queryset(
            user=request.user,
            status_filter=str(request.query_params.get("status") or "OPEN"),
        )
        incidents = [format_loafing_incident(inc) for inc in qs[:100]]
        return Response(
            {
                "ok": True,
                "total": len(incidents),
                "anomalies": incidents,
                "results": incidents,
            }
        )


class EmergencyRollCallView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def get(self, request):
        return Response(get_emergency_roll_call(request=request))

AttendSure - Ed-Fi Data Standard v6.0 Interoperability & Privacy Export Engine
File: backend/apps/reports/edfi.py

Produces standards-compliant Ed-Fi v6.0 JSON bundles with optional pseudonymization
(`anonymize=True`) so districts and ministries can ingest live attendance, class list,
and teacher data without vendor lock-in.
"""

from datetime import timedelta
import hashlib
from django.conf import settings
from django.utils import timezone

from apps.accounts.models import TeacherProfile
from apps.attendance.models import ClassAttendance, DailyAttendance
from apps.school.models import SchoolYear, Section
from apps.school.selectors import get_school_metadata
from apps.students.models import Enrollment, Student


ATTENDANCE_DESCRIPTOR_MAP = {
    "PRESENT": "uri://ed-fi.org/AttendanceEventCategoryDescriptor#In Attendance",
    "LATE": "uri://ed-fi.org/AttendanceEventCategoryDescriptor#Tardy",
    "ABSENT": "uri://ed-fi.org/AttendanceEventCategoryDescriptor#Unexcused Absence",
    "EXCUSED": "uri://ed-fi.org/AttendanceEventCategoryDescriptor#Excused Absence",
}

SEX_DESCRIPTOR_MAP = {
    "M": "uri://ed-fi.org/SexDescriptor#Male",
    "MALE": "uri://ed-fi.org/SexDescriptor#Male",
    "F": "uri://ed-fi.org/SexDescriptor#Female",
    "FEMALE": "uri://ed-fi.org/SexDescriptor#Female",
}


def _pseudonymize(prefix: str, value: str) -> str:
    salt = str(getattr(settings, "SECRET_KEY", "attendsure"))[:16]
    digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{salt}:{prefix}:{value}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16].upper()
    return f"{prefix}-{digest}"


def build_edfi_v6_export(
    *,
    request=None,
    days: int = 30,
    anonymize: bool = False,
) -> dict:
    days = max(1, min(90, int(days)))
    today = timezone.localdate()
    start_date = today - timedelta(days=days - 1)
    meta = get_school_metadata(request)
    active_sy = SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
    sy_name = active_sy.name if active_sy else f"{today.year}-{today.year + 1}"
    school_id_raw = str(meta.get("school_id") or "ATTENDSURE-001")
    school_numeric_id = int(school_id_raw) if school_id_raw.isdigit() else school_id_raw

    sections_qs = Section.objects.filter(is_active=True).select_related(
        "grade_level", "adviser", "adviser__user"
    ).order_by("id")
    students_qs = Student.objects.filter(is_active=True).order_by("id")[:2000]
    enrollments_qs = list(
        Enrollment.objects.filter(
            status__in=["ENROLLED", "TRANSFERRED_IN"], student__is_active=True
        )
        .select_related(
            "student", "section", "section__grade_level", "section__school_year"
        )
        .order_by("id")[:2000]
    )
    teachers_qs = (
        TeacherProfile.objects.filter(user__is_active=True)
        .select_related("user", "department", "position")
        .order_by("id")[:500]
    )

    daily_qs = (
        DailyAttendance.objects.filter(
            attendance_date__gte=start_date, attendance_date__lte=today
        )
        .select_related("enrollment__student", "enrollment__section")
        .order_by("-attendance_date", "id")[:5000]
    )
    class_qs = (
        ClassAttendance.objects.filter(
            attendance_date__gte=start_date, attendance_date__lte=today
        )
        .select_related(
            "enrollment__student",
            "class_period",
            "class_period__section",
            "class_period__subject",
        )
        .order_by("-attendance_date", "-scanned_at")[:5000]
    )

    def student_uid(st: Student) -> str:
        raw = st.lrn or str(st.id)
        return _pseudonymize("STU", raw) if anonymize else raw

    def staff_uid(t: TeacherProfile) -> str:
        raw = t.employee_id or str(t.id)
        return _pseudonymize("STF", raw) if anonymize else raw

    schools_payload = [
        {
            "schoolId": school_numeric_id,
            "nameOfInstitution": meta.get("school_name") or "AttendSure Pilot School",
            "localEducationAgency": meta.get("division") or "District Education Office",
            "region": meta.get("region") or "",
            "schoolTypeDescriptor": "uri://ed-fi.org/SchoolTypeDescriptor#Regular",
            "operationalStatusDescriptor": "uri://ed-fi.org/OperationalStatusDescriptor#Active",
        }
    ]

    sections_payload = [
        {
            "sectionIdentifier": f"SEC-{sec.id}",
            "sectionName": sec.name,
            "gradeLevelDescriptor": (
                f"uri://ed-fi.org/GradeLevelDescriptor#{sec.grade_level.name}"
                if sec.grade_level
                else "uri://ed-fi.org/GradeLevelDescriptor#Ungraded"
            ),
            "schoolReference": {"schoolId": school_numeric_id},
            "adviserStaffUniqueId": staff_uid(sec.adviser) if sec.adviser else None,
        }
        for sec in sections_qs
    ]

    students_payload = []
    for st in students_qs:
        sex_key = str(st.gender or "").strip().upper()
        entry = {
            "studentUniqueId": student_uid(st),
            "sexDescriptor": SEX_DESCRIPTOR_MAP.get(
                sex_key, "uri://ed-fi.org/SexDescriptor#Not Selected"
            ),
            "birthDate": (
                f"{st.birth_date.year}-01-01"
                if (anonymize and st.birth_date)
                else (str(st.birth_date) if st.birth_date else None)
            ),
        }
        if not anonymize:
            entry["firstName"] = st.first_name
            entry["middleName"] = st.middle_name or ""
            entry["lastSurname"] = st.last_name
        students_payload.append(entry)

    enrollments_payload = [
        {
            "studentReference": {"studentUniqueId": student_uid(enr.student)},
            "sectionReference": {
                "schoolId": school_numeric_id,
                "sectionIdentifier": f"SEC-{enr.section_id}" if enr.section_id else "",
            },
            "beginDate": str(enr.enrolled_date),
            "enrollmentStatus": enr.status,
            "schoolYear": (
                enr.section.school_year.name
                if (enr.section and enr.section.school_year)
                else sy_name
            ),
            "isConditionalCashTransferRecipient": bool(enr.is_cct_recipient),
        }
        for enr in enrollments_qs
    ]

    staff_payload = []
    for t in teachers_qs:
        entry = {
            "staffUniqueId": staff_uid(t),
            "positionTitle": t.position_title or "Teacher",
            "department": t.department_name or "",
            "canTeach": bool(t.can_handle_classes),
        }
        if not anonymize:
            entry["firstName"] = t.user.first_name
            entry["lastSurname"] = t.user.last_name
        staff_payload.append(entry)

    school_attendance_events = [
        {
            "studentReference": {"studentUniqueId": student_uid(row.enrollment.student)},
            "schoolReference": {"schoolId": school_numeric_id},
            "eventDate": str(row.attendance_date),
            "attendanceEventCategoryDescriptor": ATTENDANCE_DESCRIPTOR_MAP.get(
                str(row.status).upper(),
                "uri://ed-fi.org/AttendanceEventCategoryDescriptor#In Attendance",
            ),
            "sectionIdentifier": (
                f"SEC-{row.enrollment.section_id}" if row.enrollment.section_id else ""
            ),
            "attendanceEventReason": row.remarks or "",
        }
        for row in daily_qs
    ]

    section_attendance_events = [
        {
            "studentReference": {"studentUniqueId": student_uid(row.enrollment.student)},
            "sectionReference": {
                "schoolId": school_numeric_id,
                "sectionIdentifier": (
                    f"SEC-{row.class_period.section_id}"
                    if (row.class_period and row.class_period.section_id)
                    else ""
                ),
                "subjectCode": (
                    row.class_period.subject.code
                    if (row.class_period and row.class_period.subject)
                    else ""
                ),
            },
            "eventDate": str(row.attendance_date),
            "attendanceEventCategoryDescriptor": ATTENDANCE_DESCRIPTOR_MAP.get(
                str(row.status).upper(),
                "uri://ed-fi.org/AttendanceEventCategoryDescriptor#In Attendance",
            ),
            "sourceMethod": row.scan_method,
            "scannedAt": timezone.localtime(row.scanned_at).isoformat(),
        }
        for row in class_qs
    ]

    return {
        "edFiVersion": "6.0",
        "standard": "Ed-Fi ODS/API Data Standard v6.0",
        "generatedAt": timezone.localtime().isoformat(),
        "privacyMode": "GDPR_PSEUDONYMIZED" if anonymize else "STANDARD_INSTITUTIONAL",
        "complianceFrameworks": [
            "Ed-Fi Data Standard v6.0",
            "GDPR Art. 5 & Art. 25 (Data Minimization / Pseudonymization)",
            "FERPA & COPPA Student Privacy",
            "Philippines Data Privacy Act (RA 10173)",
            "DepEd Official School Forms (SF1/SF2/SF4/CSC Form 48)",
        ],
        "reportingWindow": {
            "startDate": str(start_date),
            "endDate": str(today),
            "days": days,
            "schoolYear": sy_name,
        },
        "recordCounts": {
            "schools": len(schools_payload),
            "sections": len(sections_payload),
            "students": len(students_payload),
            "studentSectionAssociations": len(enrollments_payload),
            "staffs": len(staff_payload),
            "studentSchoolAttendanceEvents": len(school_attendance_events),
            "studentSectionAttendanceEvents": len(section_attendance_events),
        },
        "schools": schools_payload,
        "sections": sections_payload,
        "students": students_payload,
        "studentSectionAssociations": enrollments_payload,
        "staffs": staff_payload,
        "studentSchoolAttendanceEvents": school_attendance_events,
        "studentSectionAttendanceEvents": section_attendance_events,
    }

AttendSure - Printable & Downloadable Class Schedules, Class Lists, QR ID Cards, and Teacher Directory
File: backend/apps/reports/printables.py

Strict RBAC scoping, O(1) prefetched queries, HTML escaping, CSV formula neutralization,
and AuditLog tracking for both Teachers and School Leaders.

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import time
from typing import Any

from django.db.models import Q

from django.utils.html import escape

from apps.accounts.models import TeacherProfile
from apps.accounts.selectors import get_teacher_section_ids, resolve_teacher_for_user

from apps.school.models import ClassPeriod, Section, expand_schedule_days
