from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone
from django.utils.dateparse import parse_date

from apps.accounts.models import TeacherProfile
from apps.accounts.selectors import resolve_teacher_for_user
from apps.campus.models import LoafingIncident, MonthlyTimeRecord
from common.audit import record_audit_log
from common.exceptions import AppError
from common.permissions import get_user_role, is_school_leader
from common.validators import clean_text as _clean_text


@transaction.atomic
def process_monthly_dtr_action(
    *,
    request,
    action: str,
    month: int,
    year: int,
    teacher_id: int | None = None,
    data: dict | None = None,
) -> dict:
    payload = data or {}
    user = request.user
    role = get_user_role(user)
    leader = is_school_leader(user)
    own_teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)

    target_id = teacher_id or payload.get("teacher_id")
    teacher = (
        TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("user")
        .filter(id=int(target_id))
        .first()
        if (target_id and str(target_id).isdigit())
        else own_teacher
    )
    if not teacher:
        raise AppError("TEACHER_NOT_FOUND", "Teacher profile not found.", 404)

    clean_action = str(action or "").strip().upper()

    if clean_action == "SUBMIT_DTR":
        if not leader and (not own_teacher or own_teacher.id != teacher.id):
            raise AppError(
                "FORBIDDEN", "You can only submit your own Daily Time Record.", 403
            )

        dtr, _ = MonthlyTimeRecord.objects.get_or_create(
            teacher=teacher, month=month, year=year
        )
        if dtr.is_dept_head_approved and not leader:
            raise AppError(
                "ALREADY_APPROVED", "Approved DTRs are locked against edits.", 400
            )

        reg = _clean_text(
            payload.get("regular_days_hours") or payload.get("regular_hours"), 100
        )
        sat = _clean_text(
            payload.get("saturdays_hours") or payload.get("saturday_hours"), 100
        )
        if reg:
            dtr.regular_hours = reg
        if sat:
            dtr.saturday_hours = sat
        dtr.is_submitted = True
        dtr.submitted_at = timezone.now()
        dtr.save()

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name=dtr._meta.db_table,
            record_id=dtr.id,
            action="SUBMIT",
            new_data={"month": month, "year": year, "teacher_id": teacher.id},
        )
        return {"ok": True, "message": "Daily Time Record certified and submitted."}

    if clean_action == "APPROVE_DEPT_HEAD":
        if not leader:
            raise AppError(
                "FORBIDDEN",
                "Only Department Heads, Principals, or Admins can approve DTRs.",
                403,
            )

        dtr, _ = MonthlyTimeRecord.objects.get_or_create(
            teacher=teacher, month=month, year=year
        )
        if "regular_days_hours" in payload or "regular_hours" in payload:
            reg = _clean_text(
                payload.get("regular_days_hours") or payload.get("regular_hours"), 100
            )
            if reg:
                dtr.regular_hours = reg
        if "saturdays_hours" in payload or "saturday_hours" in payload:
            sat = _clean_text(
                payload.get("saturdays_hours") or payload.get("saturday_hours"), 100
            )
            if sat:
                dtr.saturday_hours = sat

        dtr.is_submitted = True
        dtr.is_dept_head_approved = True
        dtr.approved_by = user
        dtr.dept_head_approved_at = timezone.now()
        dtr.save()

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name=dtr._meta.db_table,
            record_id=dtr.id,
            action="APPROVE",
            new_data={"month": month, "year": year, "teacher_id": teacher.id},
        )
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "message": f"Official DTR approved for {teacher.full_name}.",
        }

    if clean_action == "EXCUSE_LOAFING":
        if not (user.is_superuser or role in ("ADMIN", "PRINCIPAL")):
            raise AppError(
                "FORBIDDEN",
                "Only the School Principal or System Admin can excuse teacher loafing alerts.",
                403,
            )

        raw_date = str(payload.get("date_str") or "").strip()
        remarks = _clean_text(payload.get("remarks"), 240)
        if not remarks:
            raise AppError(
                "REMARKS_REQUIRED",
                "Official remarks are required to excuse an alert.",
                400,
            )

        incident_dt = parse_date(raw_date)
        if not incident_dt:
            raise AppError(
                "INVALID_DATE", "Valid incident date (YYYY-MM-DD) is required.", 400
            )

        updated_count = LoafingIncident.objects.filter(
            teacher=teacher, detected_at__date=incident_dt
        ).update(
            status="EXCUSED",
            remarks=remarks,
            resolved_at=timezone.now(),
            reviewed_by=user,
        )

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name=LoafingIncident._meta.db_table,
            record_id=teacher.id,
            action="EXCUSE",
            new_data={
                "date": str(incident_dt),
                "remarks": remarks,
                "updated": updated_count,
            },
        )
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "message": f"Teacher loafing alert on {incident_dt} marked as excused.",
        }

    raise AppError("INVALID_ACTION", f"Unsupported DTR action: {clean_action}", 400)

from datetime import date, timedelta

from apps.school.models import Section
from apps.school.selectors import get_school_metadata
from apps.students.models import Enrollment
from common.exceptions import AppError


def compute_age(birth_date: date | None, cutoff: date) -> int | str:
    if not birth_date:
        return ""
    return max(
        0,
        cutoff.year
        - birth_date.year
        - ((cutoff.month, cutoff.day) < (birth_date.month, birth_date.day)),
    )


def generate_sf1_report(
    *, section_id: int, school_year: str | None = None, request=None
) -> dict:
    section = (
        Section.objects.select_related(
            "grade_level", "school_year", "adviser", "adviser__user"
        )
        .filter(id=section_id)
        .first()
    )
    if not section:
        raise AppError("SECTION_NOT_FOUND", f"Section {section_id} not found.", 404)

    sy = section.school_year
    sy_name = str(school_year or (sy.name if sy else "2026-2027"))
    base_yr = (
        int(sy_name.split("-")[0])
        if "-" in sy_name and sy_name.split("-")[0].isdigit()
        else 2026
    )
    june_1 = date(base_yr, 6, 1)
    cutoff = (sy.baseline_cutoff_date if sy else None) or (
        june_1 + timedelta(days=(4 - june_1.weekday()) % 7)
    )

    enrollments = (
        Enrollment.objects.filter(
            section=section, status__in=["ENROLLED", "TRANSFERRED_IN"], student__is_active=True
        )
        .select_related("student", "student__location")
        .order_by("student__last_name", "student__first_name")
    )

    males, females, combined = [], [], []
    for enr in enrollments:
        st = enr.student
        is_male = str(st.gender).upper().startswith("M")
        address = ", ".join(
            filter(
                None,
                [st.house_street_sitio, st.barangay, st.municipality_city, st.province],
            )
        )
        row = {
            "id": st.id,
            "lrn": st.lrn,
            "name": st.full_name,
            "sex": "M" if is_male else "F",
            "gender": st.gender,
            "birth_date": st.birth_date.strftime("%m/%d/%Y") if st.birth_date else "",
            "birthdate": st.birth_date.strftime("%m/%d/%Y") if st.birth_date else "",
            "age": compute_age(st.birth_date, cutoff),
            "mother_tongue": st.mother_tongue,
            "ethnic_group": st.ethnic_group,
            "religion": st.religion,
            "address": address,
            "father_name": st.father_name,
            "mother_maiden_name": st.mother_maiden_name,
            "guardian_name": st.guardian_name,
            "guardian_rel": st.guardian_relationship,
            "guardian_contact": st.guardian_contact,
            "remarks": enr.remarks,
        }
        combined.append(row)
        (males if is_male else females).append(row)

    return {
        **get_school_metadata(request),
        "academic_year": sy_name,
        "grade_level": section.grade_level.name if section.grade_level else "",
        "section_name": section.name,
        "adviser_name": section.adviser.full_name if section.adviser else "",
        "students": combined,
        "males": males,
        "females": females,
        "total_male": len(males),
        "total_female": len(females),
        "total_combined": len(combined),
    }

import calendar
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta

from apps.attendance.models import ClassAttendance, DailyAttendance
from apps.school.models import SchoolHoliday, Section
from apps.school.selectors import get_school_metadata
from apps.students.models import Enrollment
from common.exceptions import AppError

MONTH_NAMES = [
    "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
    "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December",
]
MONTH_ABBR = {name[:3].lower(): idx + 1 for idx, name in enumerate(MONTH_NAMES)}


def resolve_month(raw_month) -> tuple[int, str]:
    clean = str(raw_month or "").strip()
    if not clean:
        return 10, "October"
    if clean.isdigit():
        num = int(clean)
        if 1 <= num <= 12:
            return num, MONTH_NAMES[num - 1]
        raise AppError("INVALID_MONTH", "Month must be between 1 and 12.", 400)
    cap = clean.capitalize()
    if cap in MONTH_NAMES:
        return MONTH_NAMES.index(cap) + 1, cap
    abbr_num = MONTH_ABBR.get(clean[:3].lower())
    if abbr_num:
        return abbr_num, MONTH_NAMES[abbr_num - 1]
    raise AppError("INVALID_MONTH", f"Invalid month '{raw_month}'.", 400)


def _as_date(val) -> date | None:
    if isinstance(val, datetime):
        return val.date()
    return val


def make_metric(m=0, f=0) -> dict:
    return {"m": m, "f": f, "total": m + f}


def has_five_consecutive_absences(att_map: dict, school_day_nums: list[int]) -> bool:
    streak = 0
    for d in school_day_nums:
        if att_map.get(d, "") in ("absent", "x", "a"):
            streak += 1
            if streak >= 5:
                return True
        else:
            streak = 0
    return False


def generate_sf2_report(
    *, section_id: int, month_name: str = "October", year: int = 2026, request=None
) -> dict:
    section = (
        Section.objects.select_related(
            "grade_level", "school_year", "adviser", "adviser__user"
        )
        .filter(id=section_id)
        .first()
    )
    if not section:
        raise AppError("SECTION_NOT_FOUND", f"Section {section_id} not found.", 404)

    year = int(year)
    if not (1900 <= year <= 2100):
        raise AppError("INVALID_YEAR", "Year must be between 1900 and 2100.", 400)
    month_num, clean_month = resolve_month(month_name)
    _, num_days = calendar.monthrange(year, month_num)
    month_start, month_end = date(year, month_num, 1), date(year, month_num, num_days)

    holiday_dates = set(
        SchoolHoliday.objects.filter(
            holiday_date__range=(month_start, month_end)
        ).values_list("holiday_date", flat=True)
    )
    abbr = {0: "M", 1: "T", 2: "W", 3: "TH", 4: "F"}
    school_days, day_nums = [], []
    for d in range(1, num_days + 1):
        dt = date(year, month_num, d)
        if dt.weekday() < 5 and dt not in holiday_dates:
            day_nums.append(d)
            school_days.append(
                {"dateNumber": d, "dayOfWeek": abbr[dt.weekday()], "fullDate": str(dt)}
            )
    school_day_set = set(day_nums)

    enrollments = list(
        Enrollment.objects.filter(section=section, student__is_active=True)
        .select_related("student")
        .order_by("student__last_name", "student__first_name")
    )
    enrollment_ids = [e.id for e in enrollments]

    records_by_enr: dict[int, dict[int, str]] = {}
    if enrollment_ids:
        for row in DailyAttendance.objects.filter(
            enrollment_id__in=enrollment_ids,
            attendance_date__range=(month_start, month_end),
        ).values("enrollment_id", "attendance_date", "status"):
            day_val = row["attendance_date"].day
            if day_val in school_day_set:
                records_by_enr.setdefault(row["enrollment_id"], {})[day_val] = row[
                    "status"
                ].lower()

        for row in (
            ClassAttendance.objects.filter(
                class_period__section=section,
                enrollment_id__in=enrollment_ids,
                attendance_date__range=(month_start, month_end),
            )
            .order_by("scanned_at")
            .values("enrollment_id", "attendance_date", "status")
        ):
            day_val = row["attendance_date"].day
            if day_val in school_day_set:
                records_by_enr.setdefault(row["enrollment_id"], {}).setdefault(
                    day_val, row["status"].lower()
                )

    sy = section.school_year
    sy_start_year = year
    if sy and sy.name and "-" in sy.name and sy.name.split("-")[0].isdigit():
        sy_start_year = int(sy.name.split("-")[0])
    elif sy and sy.start_date:
        sy_start_year = sy.start_date.year
    june_1 = date(sy_start_year, 6, 1)
    cutoff = (
        sy.baseline_cutoff_date
        if (sy and sy.baseline_cutoff_date)
        else (june_1 + timedelta(days=(4 - june_1.weekday()) % 7))
    )

    males, females = [], []
    reg_m = reg_f = 0
    consec_m = consec_f = 0
    june_m = june_f = late_m = late_f = 0
    drop_m = drop_f = tout_m = tout_f = tin_m = tin_f = 0

    for enr in enrollments:
        st = enr.student
        is_m = str(st.gender or "").upper().startswith("M")
        enr_date = _as_date(enr.enrolled_date) or month_start
        exit_dt = _as_date(enr.status_date)
        st_code = str(enr.status or "").upper()

        if enr_date > month_end:
            continue
        if st_code in ("DROPPED", "TRANSFERRED_OUT") and exit_dt and exit_dt < month_start:
            continue

        att = {
            d: v
            for d, v in records_by_enr.get(enr.id, {}).items()
            if d in school_day_set
        }
        rec = {
            "id": st.id,
            "lrn": st.lrn,
            "name": st.full_name,
            "sex": "M" if is_m else "F",
            "attendance": att,
            "total_absent": sum(
                1 for d in day_nums if att.get(d, "") in ("absent", "x", "a")
            ),
            "total_tardy": sum(
                1 for d in day_nums if att.get(d, "") in ("late", "tardy", "t")
            ),
            "remarks": enr.remarks,
        }
        if is_m:
            males.append(rec)
            consec_m += int(has_five_consecutive_absences(att, day_nums))
        else:
            females.append(rec)
            consec_f += int(has_five_consecutive_absences(att, day_nums))

        if enr_date <= cutoff:
            if is_m:
                june_m += 1
            else:
                june_f += 1
        else:
            if is_m:
                late_m += 1
            else:
                late_f += 1

        exited_this_month = False
        if st_code == "DROPPED" and (
            not exit_dt or (month_start <= exit_dt <= month_end)
        ):
            exited_this_month = True
            if is_m:
                drop_m += 1
            else:
                drop_f += 1
        elif st_code == "TRANSFERRED_OUT" and (
            not exit_dt or (month_start <= exit_dt <= month_end)
        ):
            exited_this_month = True
            if is_m:
                tout_m += 1
            else:
                tout_f += 1
        elif st_code == "TRANSFERRED_IN" and (month_start <= enr_date <= month_end):
            if is_m:
                tin_m += 1
            else:
                tin_f += 1

        if not exited_this_month:
            if is_m:
                reg_m += 1
            else:
                reg_f += 1

    n_days = len(school_days) or 1
    present_vals = {"present", "late", "tardy", "excused"}
    ada_m = round(
        sum(
            1
            for m in males
            for d in day_nums
            if m["attendance"].get(d, "") in present_vals
        )
        / n_days,
        1,
    )
    ada_f = round(
        sum(
            1
            for f in females
            for d in day_nums
            if f["attendance"].get(d, "") in present_vals
        )
        / n_days,
        1,
    )
    ada_tot = round(ada_m + ada_f, 1)

    reg_all = reg_m + reg_f
    tot_june = june_m + june_f

    return {
        **get_school_metadata(request),
        "academic_year": section.school_year.name if section.school_year else "",
        "grade_level": section.grade_level.name if section.grade_level else "",
        "section_name": section.name,
        "month": clean_month,
        "year": year,
        "adviser_name": section.adviser.full_name if section.adviser else "",
        "school_days": school_days,
        "has_enrolled_students": len(males) + len(females) > 0,
        "males": males,
        "females": females,
        "metrics": {
            "enrolment_june": make_metric(june_m, june_f),
            "late_enrolment": make_metric(late_m, late_f),
            "registered_end": make_metric(reg_m, reg_f),
            "percentage_enrolment": {
                "m": round((reg_m / june_m) * 100, 1) if june_m else 0.0,
                "f": round((reg_f / june_f) * 100, 1) if june_f else 0.0,
                "total": round((reg_all / tot_june) * 100, 1) if tot_june else 0.0,
            },
            "average_daily_attendance": {"m": ada_m, "f": ada_f, "total": ada_tot},
            "percentage_attendance": {
                "m": round((ada_m / reg_m) * 100, 1) if reg_m else 0.0,
                "f": round((ada_f / reg_f) * 100, 1) if reg_f else 0.0,
                "total": round((ada_tot / reg_all) * 100, 1) if reg_all else 0.0,
            },
            "consecutive_5_absent_count": make_metric(consec_m, consec_f),
            "consecutive_5": make_metric(consec_m, consec_f),
            "drop_out": make_metric(drop_m, drop_f),
            "transferred_out": make_metric(tout_m, tout_f),
            "transferred_in": make_metric(tin_m, tin_f),
        },
    }

import calendar
from datetime import date, datetime
from django.db.models import Q

from apps.attendance.models import ClassAttendance, DailyAttendance
from apps.school.models import GradeLevel, SchoolHoliday, SchoolYear, Section
from apps.school.selectors import get_school_metadata

def make_triplet(m=0, f=0) -> dict:
    total = m + f
    return {
        "m": round(m, 1) if isinstance(m, float) else int(m),
        "f": round(f, 1) if isinstance(f, float) else int(f),
        "total": round(total, 1) if isinstance(total, float) else int(total),
    }


def add_triplets(t1: dict, t2: dict) -> dict:
    return make_triplet(t1["m"] + t2["m"], t1["f"] + t2["f"])


def compute_attendance_pct(ada: dict, reg: dict) -> dict:
    return {
        "m": round((ada["m"] / reg["m"]) * 100, 1) if reg["m"] > 0 else 0.0,
        "f": round((ada["f"] / reg["f"]) * 100, 1) if reg["f"] > 0 else 0.0,
        "total": round((ada["total"] / reg["total"]) * 100, 1)
        if reg["total"] > 0
        else 0.0,
    }


def empty_summary_row(section_id: str, section_name: str, grade_level: str) -> dict:
    zero = make_triplet(0, 0)
    return {
        "section_id": section_id,
        "section_name": section_name,
        "grade_level": grade_level,
        "adviser_name": "",
        "registered_end": dict(zero),
        "daily_average": make_triplet(0.0, 0.0),
        "attendance_percentage": {"m": 0.0, "f": 0.0, "total": 0.0},
        "dropped_out_prev": dict(zero),
        "dropped_out_month": dict(zero),
        "dropped_out_cumulative": dict(zero),
        "transferred_out_prev": dict(zero),
        "transferred_out_month": dict(zero),
        "transferred_out_cumulative": dict(zero),
        "transferred_in_prev": dict(zero),
        "transferred_in_month": dict(zero),
        "transferred_in_cumulative": dict(zero),
    }

def generate_sf4_report(
    *, month_name: str = "October", year: int = 2026, school_year: str = "", request=None
) -> dict:
    month_num, clean_month = resolve_month(month_name)
    year = int(year)
    if not (1900 <= year <= 2100):
        raise AppError("INVALID_YEAR", "Year must be between 1900 and 2100.", 400)
    _, num_days = calendar.monthrange(year, month_num)
    start_dt, end_dt = date(year, month_num, 1), date(year, month_num, num_days)

    holiday_dates = set(
        SchoolHoliday.objects.filter(
            holiday_date__range=(start_dt, end_dt)
        ).values_list("holiday_date", flat=True)
    )
    school_days = [
        date(year, month_num, d)
        for d in range(1, num_days + 1)
        if date(year, month_num, d).weekday() < 5
        and date(year, month_num, d) not in holiday_dates
    ]
    n_days = len(school_days) or 1

    target_sy = None
    if school_year:
        sy_clean = str(school_year).strip()
        target_sy = (
            SchoolYear.objects.filter(id=int(sy_clean)).first()
            if sy_clean.isdigit()
            else SchoolYear.objects.filter(name__iexact=sy_clean).first()
        )
    if target_sy is None:
        target_sy = (
            SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
            or SchoolYear.objects.first()
        )

    sections_qs = Section.objects.select_related(
        "grade_level", "school_year", "adviser", "adviser__user"
    ).filter(is_active=True)
    if target_sy:
        sections_qs = sections_qs.filter(
            Q(school_year=target_sy) | Q(school_year__isnull=True)
        )
    sections = list(sections_qs.order_by("grade_level__level_number", "name"))

    enr_qs = Enrollment.objects.filter(
        section__in=sections, student__is_active=True
    ).select_related("student", "section__school_year")
    if target_sy:
        enr_qs = enr_qs.filter(
            Q(section__school_year=target_sy) | Q(section__school_year__isnull=True)
        )

    enr_by_sec: dict[int, list] = {}
    all_enrollment_ids = set()
    for enr in enr_qs:
        enr_by_sec.setdefault(enr.section_id, []).append(enr)
        all_enrollment_ids.add(enr.id)

    present_codes = ["PRESENT", "LATE", "EXCUSED"]
    present_pairs = set()
    if all_enrollment_ids:
        present_pairs.update(
            DailyAttendance.objects.filter(
                enrollment_id__in=all_enrollment_ids,
                attendance_date__range=(start_dt, end_dt),
                status__in=present_codes,
            ).values_list("enrollment_id", "attendance_date")
        )
        present_pairs.update(
            ClassAttendance.objects.filter(
                class_period__section__in=sections,
                enrollment_id__in=all_enrollment_ids,
                attendance_date__range=(start_dt, end_dt),
                status__in=present_codes,
            ).values_list("enrollment_id", "attendance_date")
        )

    grade_names = list(
        GradeLevel.objects.order_by("level_number").values_list("name", flat=True)
    )
    groups_map: dict[str, list] = {g: [] for g in grade_names if g}

    for sec in sections:
        g_label = (
            sec.grade_level.name if sec.grade_level else "NON-GRADED"
        ).strip() or "NON-GRADED"
        adviser_label = (sec.adviser.full_name if sec.adviser else "Unassigned").upper()

        reg_m = reg_f = att_m = att_f = 0
        drop_prev_m = drop_prev_f = drop_mo_m = drop_mo_f = 0
        tout_prev_m = tout_prev_f = tout_mo_m = tout_mo_f = 0
        tin_prev_m = tin_prev_f = tin_mo_m = tin_mo_f = 0

        for enr in enr_by_sec.get(sec.id, []):
            st = enr.student
            is_m = str(st.gender or "").upper().startswith("M")
            enr_dt = (
                enr.enrolled_date.date()
                if isinstance(enr.enrolled_date, datetime)
                else enr.enrolled_date
            )
            if enr_dt and enr_dt > end_dt:
                continue

            status_val = str(enr.status or "").upper()
            exit_dt = (
                enr.status_date.date()
                if isinstance(enr.status_date, datetime)
                else enr.status_date
            )

            if "DROP" in status_val:
                if exit_dt and exit_dt < start_dt:
                    if is_m:
                        drop_prev_m += 1
                    else:
                        drop_prev_f += 1
                    continue
                if not exit_dt or exit_dt <= end_dt:
                    if is_m:
                        drop_mo_m += 1
                    else:
                        drop_mo_f += 1
            elif "TRANSFERRED" in status_val and "OUT" in status_val:
                if exit_dt and exit_dt < start_dt:
                    if is_m:
                        tout_prev_m += 1
                    else:
                        tout_prev_f += 1
                    continue
                if not exit_dt or exit_dt <= end_dt:
                    if is_m:
                        tout_mo_m += 1
                    else:
                        tout_mo_f += 1

            if "TRANSFERRED" in status_val and "IN" in status_val:
                if enr_dt and enr_dt < start_dt:
                    if is_m:
                        tin_prev_m += 1
                    else:
                        tin_prev_f += 1
                else:
                    if is_m:
                        tin_mo_m += 1
                    else:
                        tin_mo_f += 1

            if status_val not in ("DROPPED", "TRANSFERRED_OUT") or (
                exit_dt and exit_dt > end_dt
            ):
                if is_m:
                    reg_m += 1
                else:
                    reg_f += 1
                for s_day in school_days:
                    if (enr.id, s_day) in present_pairs:
                        if is_m:
                            att_m += 1
                        else:
                            att_f += 1

        reg = make_triplet(reg_m, reg_f)
        ada = make_triplet(round(att_m / n_days, 1), round(att_f / n_days, 1))
        d_prev, d_mo = make_triplet(drop_prev_m, drop_prev_f), make_triplet(
            drop_mo_m, drop_mo_f
        )
        to_prev, to_mo = make_triplet(tout_prev_m, tout_prev_f), make_triplet(
            tout_mo_m, tout_mo_f
        )
        ti_prev, ti_mo = make_triplet(tin_prev_m, tin_prev_f), make_triplet(
            tin_mo_m, tin_mo_f
        )

        groups_map.setdefault(g_label, []).append(
            {
                "section_id": sec.id,
                "section_name": sec.name,
                "grade_level": g_label,
                "adviser_name": adviser_label,
                "registered_end": reg,
                "daily_average": ada,
                "attendance_percentage": compute_attendance_pct(ada, reg),
                "dropped_out_prev": d_prev,
                "dropped_out_month": d_mo,
                "dropped_out_cumulative": add_triplets(d_prev, d_mo),
                "transferred_out_prev": to_prev,
                "transferred_out_month": to_mo,
                "transferred_out_cumulative": add_triplets(to_prev, to_mo),
                "transferred_in_prev": ti_prev,
                "transferred_in_month": ti_mo,
                "transferred_in_cumulative": add_triplets(ti_prev, ti_mo),
            }
        )

    grade_groups = []
    total_summary = empty_summary_row("grand-total", "TOTAL", "ALL")

    for g_label, sec_rows in groups_map.items():
        subtotal = empty_summary_row(f"subtotal-{g_label}", "SUBTOTAL", g_label)
        for row in sec_rows:
            for key in SUMMABLE_KEYS:
                subtotal[key] = add_triplets(subtotal[key], row[key])
        subtotal["attendance_percentage"] = compute_attendance_pct(
            subtotal["daily_average"], subtotal["registered_end"]
        )
        grade_groups.append(
            {
                "grade_level": g_label,
                "sections": sec_rows,
                "subtotal": subtotal,
            }
        )
        for key in SUMMABLE_KEYS:
            total_summary[key] = add_triplets(total_summary[key], subtotal[key])

    total_summary["attendance_percentage"] = compute_attendance_pct(
        total_summary["daily_average"], total_summary["registered_end"]
    )

    active_sy = target_sy or SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
    resolved_sy = (
        active_sy.name
        if active_sy
        else (str(school_year).strip() or f"{year}-{year + 1}")
    )

    return {
        **get_school_metadata(request),
        "school_year": resolved_sy,
        "month": clean_month,
        "year": year,
        "grade_groups": grade_groups,
        "non_graded_summary": None,
        "total_summary": total_summary,
    }

    def test_admin_can_export_all_five_pack_types_in_json_html_csv(self):
        client = self._client(self.admin_user)
        for pack_type in (
            "CLASS_SCHEDULE",
            "CLASS_LIST",
            "QR_ID_CARDS",
            "TEACHER_DIRECTORY",
            "COMPLETE_TEACHER_PACKET",
        ):
            # JSON via POST
            r_json = client.post(
                "/api/v1/reports/print-pack/",
                {"pack_type": pack_type, "scope": "ALL", "export_format": "json"},
                format="json",
            )
            self.assertEqual(r_json.status_code, 200, f"{pack_type} JSON failed: {r_json.content}")
            self.assertEqual(r_json.data["pack_type"], pack_type)
            self.assertEqual(r_json.data["school"]["school_name"], "AttendSure National High School")

            # HTML via GET with CSP + escaping check
            r_html = client.get(
                f"/api/v1/reports/print-pack/?pack_type={pack_type}&scope=ALL&export_format=html"
            )
            self.assertEqual(r_html.status_code, 200, f"{pack_type} HTML failed")
            self.assertIn("text/html", r_html["Content-Type"])
            self.assertEqual(r_html["X-Content-Type-Options"], "nosniff")
            self.assertIn("default-src 'none'", r_html["Content-Security-Policy"])
            html_body = r_html.content.decode("utf-8")
            self.assertNotIn("<script>alert(1)</script>", html_body)
            self.assertNotIn("<b>Lopez</b>", html_body)

            # CSV via POST with formula sanitization check
            r_csv = client.post(
                "/api/v1/reports/print-pack/",
                {"pack_type": pack_type, "scope": "ALL", "export_format": "csv"},
                format="json",
            )
            self.assertEqual(r_csv.status_code, 200, f"{pack_type} CSV failed")
            self.assertIn("text/csv", r_csv["Content-Type"])
            csv_body = r_csv.content.decode("utf-8")
            if pack_type == "CLASS_LIST":
                self.assertIn("'|cmd_injection", csv_body)

        # Verify AuditLog recorded entries
        self.assertGreaterEqual(
            AuditLog.objects.filter(table_name="deped_reports", performed_by=self.admin_user).count(),
            15,
        )

    def test_teacher_own_exports_succeed_and_cross_teacher_requests_return_403(self):
        client_a = self._client(self.teacher_a_user)

        # Teacher A can export own schedule, own class list, own QR cards, and own complete packet
        for pack_type in ("CLASS_SCHEDULE", "CLASS_LIST", "QR_ID_CARDS", "COMPLETE_TEACHER_PACKET"):
            r = client_a.post(
                "/api/v1/reports/print-pack/",
                {"pack_type": pack_type, "scope": "ALL", "export_format": "json"},
                format="json",
            )
            self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 200, f"Teacher A {pack_type} failed: {r.content}")

        # Verify Teacher A only sees own students (never stu_b1)
        r_list = client_a.post(
            "/api/v1/reports/print-pack/",
            {"pack_type": "CLASS_LIST", "scope": "ALL", "export_format": "json"},
            format="json",
        )
        returned_lrns = [
            st["lrn"] for cl in r_list.data["class_lists"] for st in cl["students"]
        ]
        self.assertIn("100000000001", returned_lrns)
        self.assertNotIn("100000000003", returned_lrns)

        # Teacher A requesting Teacher B's teacher_id -> 403
        r_forbid_teacher = client_a.post(
            "/api/v1/reports/print-pack/",
            {
                "pack_type": "CLASS_SCHEDULE",
                "scope": "SELECTED",
                "teacher_ids": [self.teacher_b.id],
                "export_format": "json",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(r_forbid_teacher.status_code, 403)

        # Teacher A requesting Teacher B's section_id -> 403
        r_forbid_sec = client_a.post(
            "/api/v1/reports/print-pack/",
            {
                "pack_type": "CLASS_LIST",
                "scope": "SELECTED",
                "section_ids": [self.sec_b.id],
                "export_format": "json",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(r_forbid_sec.status_code, 403)

        # Teacher A requesting Teacher B's student_id -> 403
        r_forbid_stu = client_a.post(
            "/api/v1/reports/print-pack/",
            {
                "pack_type": "QR_ID_CARDS",
                "scope": "SELECTED",
                "student_ids": [self.stu_b1.id],
                "export_format": "json",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(r_forbid_stu.status_code, 403)

        # Teacher A requesting Teacher B's period_id -> 403
        r_forbid_period = client_a.post(
            "/api/v1/reports/print-pack/",
            {
                "pack_type": "CLASS_SCHEDULE",
                "scope": "SELECTED",
                "period_ids": [self.period_b.id],
                "export_format": "json",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(r_forbid_period.status_code, 403)

        # Teacher A requesting TEACHER_DIRECTORY -> 403
        r_forbid_dir = client_a.post(
            "/api/v1/reports/print-pack/",
            {"pack_type": "TEACHER_DIRECTORY", "scope": "ALL", "export_format": "json"},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(r_forbid_dir.status_code, 403)

def _current_month_name() -> str:
    return timezone.localdate().strftime("%B")


def _is_pos_int(raw: object) -> bool:
    s = str(raw or "").strip()
    return s.isascii() and s.isdigit()


def _parse_int_param(
    raw, *, default: int, name: str, min_val: int, max_val: int
) -> int:
    if raw in (None, ""):
        return default
    try:
        val = int(str(raw).strip())
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise AppError(
            f"INVALID_{name.upper()}", f"{name} must be a whole number.", 400
        )
    if not (min_val <= val <= max_val):
        raise AppError(
            f"INVALID_{name.upper()}",
            f"{name} must be between {min_val} and {max_val}.",
            400,
        )
    return val


def _parse_month_int(raw, default: int) -> int:
    if raw in (None, ""):
        return default
    num, _ = resolve_month(raw)
    return num


def _authorize_section_access(user, section_id: int) -> bool:
    if is_school_leader(user):
        return True
    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    return bool(teacher and section_id in get_teacher_section_ids(teacher))


class DashboardOverviewView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def get(self, request):
        return Response(get_dashboard_overview(user=request.user, request=request))


class Sf1ReportView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def get(self, request, pk: int | None = None):
        raw_id = pk or request.query_params.get("section_id")
        if not _is_pos_int(raw_id):
            return Response(
                {"error": "A valid section ID is required."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )
        sec_id = int(raw_id)
        if not _authorize_section_access(request.user, sec_id):
            return Response(
                {"error": "You do not have access to this class section."},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )
        return Response(
            generate_sf1_report(
                section_id=sec_id,
                school_year=request.query_params.get("school_year"),
                request=request,
            )
        )


class Sf1PrintView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def get(self, request):
        raw_id = request.query_params.get("section_id")
        if not _is_pos_int(raw_id):
            return Response(
                {"error": "A valid section ID is required."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )
        sec_id = int(raw_id)
        if not _authorize_section_access(request.user, sec_id):
            return Response(
                {"error": "You do not have access to this class section."},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )
        context = generate_sf1_report(section_id=sec_id, request=request)
        resp = render(request, "reports/sf1.html", context)
        return apply_html_security_headers(resp)

class MonthlyDtrView(APIView):

    def get(self, request, pk: int | None = None):

        year = _parse_int_param(
            request.query_params.get("year"),
            default=today.year,
            name="year",
            min_val=1900,
            max_val=2100,
        )
        raw_tid = pk or request.query_params.get("teacher_id")
        t_id = int(raw_tid) if _is_pos_int(raw_tid) else None
        list_only = str(request.query_params.get("list", "")).lower() in (
            "1",
            "true",
            "yes",
        )
        return Response(
            get_monthly_dtr_data(
                user=request.user,
                month=month,
                year=year,
                teacher_id=t_id,
                list_only=list_only,
                request=request,
            )
        )

    def post(self, request, pk: int | None = None):
        from .services import process_monthly_dtr_action

        today = timezone.localdate()
        month = _parse_month_int(request.data.get("month"), today.month)
        year = _parse_int_param(
            request.data.get("year"),
            default=today.year,
            name="year",
            min_val=1900,
            max_val=2100,
        )
        raw_tid = pk or request.data.get("teacher_id")
        t_id = int(raw_tid) if _is_pos_int(raw_tid) else None

        result = process_monthly_dtr_action(
            request=request,
            action=str(request.data.get("action") or ""),
            month=month,
            year=year,
            teacher_id=t_id,
            data=request.data,
        )
        return Response(result, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class ReportExportView(APIView):
    """Builds printable HTML exports for SF1, SF2, SF4, and CSC Form 48 (DTR)."""

    permission_classes = [IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def _handle(self, request, params):
        today = timezone.localdate()
        default_month = _current_month_name()
        report_type = (
            str(params.get("report_type") or params.get("type") or "SF1")
            .strip()
            .upper()
        )
        year = _parse_int_param(
            params.get("year"),
            default=today.year,
            name="year",
            min_val=1900,
            max_val=2100,
        )
        raw_sec = params.get("section_id")
        sec_id = int(raw_sec) if _is_pos_int(raw_sec) else None

        wants_json = (
            str(params.get("format") or "").strip().lower() == "json"
            or "application/json" in str(request.headers.get("Accept") or "").lower()
        )

        def _respond(title: str, html: str):
            if wants_json:
                return Response({"title": title, "html": html})
            resp = HttpResponse(html, content_type="text/html; charset=utf-8")
            return apply_html_security_headers(resp)

        if report_type == "SF1":
            if not sec_id:
                raise AppError(
                    "SECTION_REQUIRED",
                    "A valid section ID is required for SF1 export.",
                    400,
                )
            if not _authorize_section_access(request.user, sec_id):
                raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "You do not have access to this class section.", 403)
            context = generate_sf1_report(
                section_id=sec_id,
                school_year=params.get("school_year"),
                request=request,
            )
            html = render_to_string("reports/sf1.html", context, request=request)
            return _respond(f"SF1_{context.get('section_name', sec_id)}", html)

        if report_type == "SF2":
            if not sec_id:
                raise AppError(
                    "SECTION_REQUIRED",
                    "A valid section ID is required for SF2 export.",
                    400,
                )
            if not _authorize_section_access(request.user, sec_id):
                raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "You do not have access to this class section.", 403)
            data = generate_sf2_report(
                section_id=sec_id,
                month_name=params.get("month") or default_month,
                year=year,
                request=request,
            )
            rows_html = "".join(
                f"<tr><td>{escape(r['lrn'])}</td><td>{escape(r['name'])}</td><td>{escape(r['sex'])}</td>"
                f"<td>{r['total_absent']}</td><td>{r['total_tardy']}</td></tr>"
                for r in (data["males"] + data["females"])
            )
            html = (
                f"<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><title>SF2 - {escape(data['section_name'])}</title>"
                "<style>body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}"
                "th,td{border:1px solid #333;padding:4px 6px;text-align:left}</style></head><body>"
                f"<h2>School Form 2 (SF2) — {escape(data['school_name'])}</h2>"
                f"<p>Section: <b>{escape(data['grade_level'])} - {escape(data['section_name'])}</b> | "
                f"Month: <b>{escape(data['month'])} {data['year']}</b> | Adviser: <b>{escape(data['adviser_name'])}</b></p>"
                "<table><thead><tr><th>LRN</th><th>Student Name</th><th>Sex</th><th>Total Absent</th><th>Total Late</th></tr></thead>"
                f"<tbody>{rows_html}</tbody></table></body></html>"
            )
            return _respond(
                f"SF2_{data['section_name']}_{data['month']}_{data['year']}", html
            )

        if report_type == "SF4":
            if not is_school_leader(request.user):
                raise AppError(
                    "FORBIDDEN", "School leadership access is required for SF4 export.", 403
                )
            data = generate_sf4_report(
                month_name=params.get("month") or default_month,
                year=year,
                school_year=params.get("school_year") or "",
                request=request,
            )
            rows_html = ""
            for grp in data.get("grade_groups", []):
                for sec in grp.get("sections", []):
                    rows_html += (
                        f"<tr><td>{escape(grp['grade_level'])}</td><td>{escape(sec['section_name'])}</td>"
                        f"<td>{escape(sec['adviser_name'])}</td><td>{sec['registered_end']['total']}</td>"
                        f"<td>{sec['daily_average']['total']}</td><td>{sec['attendance_percentage']['total']}%</td></tr>"
                    )
            html = (
                f"<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><title>SF4 - {escape(data['month'])} {data['year']}</title>"
                "<style>body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}"
                "th,td{border:1px solid #333;padding:4px 6px;text-align:left}</style></head><body>"
                f"<h2>School Form 4 (SF4) — {escape(data['school_name'])}</h2>"
                f"<p>Month: <b>{escape(data['month'])} {data['year']}</b></p>"
                "<table><thead><tr><th>Grade</th><th>Section</th><th>Adviser</th><th>Enrolled</th><th>Daily Average</th><th>% Attendance</th></tr></thead>"
                f"<tbody>{rows_html}</tbody></table></body></html>"
            )
            return _respond(f"SF4_{data['month']}_{data['year']}", html)

        if report_type == "DTR":
            month_num = _parse_month_int(params.get("month"), today.month)
            raw_tid = params.get("teacher_id")
            t_id = int(raw_tid) if _is_pos_int(raw_tid) else None
            data = get_monthly_dtr_data(
                user=request.user,
                month=month_num,
                year=year,
                teacher_id=t_id,
                request=request,
            )
            rows_html = "".join(
                f"<tr><td>{r['day']}</td><td>{escape(r['am_arrival'])}</td><td>{escape(r['am_departure'])}</td>"
                f"<td>{escape(r['pm_arrival'])}</td><td>{escape(r['pm_departure'])}</td><td>{escape(r['status'])}</td></tr>"
                for r in data["rows"]
                if r["status"] != "OUT_OF_MONTH"
            )
            html = (
                f"<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><title>CSC Form 48 - {escape(data['teacher_name'])}</title>"
                "<style>body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}"
                "th,td{border:1px solid #333;padding:4px 6px;text-align:center}</style></head><body>"
                f"<h2>Civil Service Form No. 48 (DTR) — {escape(data['teacher_name'])}</h2>"
                f"<p>Month: <b>{escape(data['month'])} {data['year']}</b> | Days Present: <b>{data['days_present']}</b></p>"
                "<table><thead><tr><th>Day</th><th>AM In</th><th>AM Out</th><th>PM In</th><th>PM Out</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>"
                f"<tbody>{rows_html}</tbody></table></body></html>"
            )
            return _respond(
                f"CSC_Form_48_{data['teacher_name']}_{data['month']}_{data['year']}",
                html,
            )

        raise AppError(
            "INVALID_REPORT_TYPE", f"Unsupported report type '{report_type}'.", 400
        )

    def get(self, request):
        return self._handle(request, request.query_params)

    def post(self, request):
        return self._handle(request, request.data)


class _PassthroughCsvRenderer(renderers.BaseRenderer):
    media_type = "text/csv"
    format = "csv"

    def render(self, data, accepted_media_type=None, renderer_context=None):
        return data if isinstance(data, (bytes, str)) else str(data)


class PrintPackView(APIView):
    """
    Downloadable & printable pack generator for Class Schedules, Class Lists,
    Student QR ID Cards, Teacher Directory, and Complete Teacher Packets.
    Supports GET and POST with strict RBAC scoping and AuditLog logging.
    """

    permission_classes = [IsTeacherOrLeader]
    renderer_classes = [renderers.JSONRenderer, _PassthroughCsvRenderer]

    def _handle(self, request, params):
        payload = build_print_pack_payload(request=request, params=params)
        pack_type = payload["pack_type"]
        export_format = payload["export_format"]
        scope = payload["scope"]
        action_mode = str(params.get("action_mode") or "").strip().upper()
        audit_action = (
            action_mode
            if action_mode in ("PRINT", "EXPORT")
            else ("PRINT" if export_format == "html" else "EXPORT")
        )

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="deped_reports",
            record_id=0,
            action=audit_action,
            new_data={
                "pack_type": pack_type,
                "scope": scope,
                "export_format": export_format,
                "summary": payload.get("summary", {}),
            },
        )

        stamp = timezone.localtime().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M")
        filename_base = f"AttendSure_{pack_type.lower()}_{stamp}"

        if export_format == "html":
            html = render_print_pack_html(payload)
            wants_json_wrap = (
                str(params.get("wrap_json") or "").strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes")
            )
            if wants_json_wrap:
                return Response(
                    {
                        "title": filename_base,
                        "pack_type": pack_type,
                        "scope": scope,
                        "summary": payload.get("summary", {}),
                        "html": html,
                    }
                )
            resp = HttpResponse(html, content_type="text/html; charset=utf-8")
            resp["Content-Disposition"] = f'inline; filename="{filename_base}.html"'
            return apply_html_security_headers(resp)

        if export_format == "csv":
            csv_text = render_print_pack_csv(payload)
            resp = HttpResponse(csv_text, content_type="text/csv; charset=utf-8")
            resp["Content-Disposition"] = f'attachment; filename="{filename_base}.csv"'
            resp["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
            return resp

        return Response(payload, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

    def get(self, request):
        return self._handle(request, request.query_params)

    def post(self, request):
        return self._handle(request, request.data)


class EdFiExportView(APIView):
    """Exports school, class, teacher, and attendance records in JSON or CSV format."""

    permission_classes = [IsSchoolLeader]
    renderer_classes = [renderers.JSONRenderer, _PassthroughCsvRenderer]
    use_deped_filename = False

    def get(self, request):
        days = _parse_int_param(
            request.query_params.get("days"),
            default=30,
            name="days",
            min_val=1,
            max_val=90,
        )
        anonymize = str(request.query_params.get("anonymize") or "").strip().lower() in (
            "1",
            "true",
            "yes",
        )
        export_fmt = str(
            request.query_params.get("export_format")
            or request.query_params.get("format")
            or "json"
        ).strip().lower()

        payload = build_edfi_v6_export(request=request, days=days, anonymize=anonymize)
        today = timezone.localdate()

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="edfi_export",
            record_id=0,
            action="EXPORT",
            new_data={
                "format": export_fmt,
                "anonymize": anonymize,
                "days": days,
                "events": payload.get("recordCounts", {}).get(
                    "studentSchoolAttendanceEvents", 0
                ),
            },
        )

        if export_fmt == "csv":
            buf = io.StringIO()
            writer = csv.writer(buf)
            writer.writerow(
                [
                    "event_date",
                    "learner_id",
                    "section_identifier",
                    "attendance_status",
                    "reason",
                    "school_id",
                    "school_year",
                ]
            )
            schools_list = payload.get("schools") or []
            school_id = (
                schools_list[0].get("schoolId", "")
                if schools_list
                else payload.get("school", {}).get("schoolId", "")
            )
            school_year = (
                payload.get("reportingWindow", {}).get("schoolYear")
                or payload.get("school", {}).get("schoolYear", "")
            )

            for evt in payload.get("studentSchoolAttendanceEvents", []):
                section_ident = evt.get("sectionIdentifier") or evt.get(
                    "sectionReference", {}
                ).get("sectionIdentifier", "")
                writer.writerow(
                    [
                        sanitize_csv_cell(evt.get("eventDate", "")),
                        sanitize_csv_cell(
                            evt.get("studentReference", {}).get("studentUniqueId", "")
                        ),
                        sanitize_csv_cell(section_ident),
                        sanitize_csv_cell(
                            evt.get("attendanceEventCategoryDescriptor", "")
                        ),
                        sanitize_csv_cell(evt.get("attendanceEventReason", "")),
                        sanitize_csv_cell(school_id),
                        sanitize_csv_cell(school_year),
                    ]
                )
            filename = (
                f"attendsure_deped_division_export_{today}.csv"
                if self.use_deped_filename
                else f"attendsure_division_export_{today}.csv"
            )
            resp = HttpResponse(buf.getvalue(), content_type="text/csv; charset=utf-8")
            resp["Content-Disposition"] = f'attachment; filename="{filename}"'
            resp["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
            return resp

        mode_tag = "masked" if anonymize else "standard"
        filename = (
            f"attendsure_deped_division_export_{mode_tag}_{today}.json"
            if self.use_deped_filename
            else f"attendsure_edfi_v6_{mode_tag}_{today}.json"
        )
        response = JsonResponse(payload)
        response["Content-Disposition"] = f'attachment; filename="{filename}"'
        response["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
        return response

class ReportAuditLogView(APIView):
    """Lists and saves audit log entries whenever SF1, SF2, SF4, or DTR forms are printed or exported."""

    permission_classes = [IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def get(self, request):
        from apps.accounts.models import AuditLog
        from apps.accounts.views import _format_audit_row

        qs = (
            AuditLog.objects.select_related("performed_by")
            .only(
                "id",
                "table_name",
                "record_id",
                "action",
                "client_ip",
                "changed_fields",
                "new_data",
                "created_at",
                "performed_by__id",
                "performed_by__username",
                "performed_by__first_name",
                "performed_by__last_name",
            )
            .filter(table_name__in=["deped_reports", "edfi_export"])
            .order_by("-created_at")
        )
        if not is_school_leader(request.user):
            qs = qs.filter(performed_by_id=request.user.id)
        records = [_format_audit_row(row) for row in qs[:100]]
        return Response({"count": len(records), "records": records, "results": records})

    def post(self, request):
        raw_section = request.data.get("section_id")
        record_id = int(raw_section) if _is_pos_int(raw_section) else 0
        action_code = strip_tags(str(request.data.get("action") or "EXPORT")).strip().upper()[:10]
        report_name = strip_tags(str(request.data.get("report_name") or "School Form")).strip()[:80]
        tracking_id = strip_tags(str(request.data.get("document_tracking_id") or "")).strip()[:80]

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="deped_reports",
            record_id=record_id,
            action=action_code or "EXPORT",
            new_data={"report_name": report_name, "tracking_id": tracking_id},
        )
        return Response({"ok": True, "logged": True}, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

class SystemStatusView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def get(self, request):
        return Response(get_system_status())

    def post(self, request):
        if not is_school_leader(request.user):
            raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "School leadership access is required.", 403)

        action_name = str(request.data.get("action") or "RUN_LOAFING_AUDIT").strip().upper()
        unlocked = 0
        audit_summary = None

        if action_name in ("UNLOCK_ACCOUNTS", "UNLOCK_TEACHERS"):
            unlocked = unlock_all_locked_accounts()
            message = f"Unlocked {unlocked} locked staff account(s)."
        else:
            audit_summary = detect_daily_student_loafing(user=request.user)
            message = (
                f"Attendance check finished for {audit_summary['audit_date']}: "
                f"{audit_summary['created_cutting_incidents']} cutting-class alert(s), "
                f"{audit_summary['created_expired_pass_incidents']} expired exit-pass alert(s)."
            )

        data = dict(get_system_status())
        data["ok"] = True
        data["unlocked_count"] = unlocked
        if audit_summary:
            data["audit_summary"] = audit_summary
        data["message"] = message
        return Response(data)

class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Seeds an idempotent, strict-3NF AttendSure demo dataset for teachers and school leaders."

    @transaction.atomic
    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        today = timezone.localdate()
        now = timezone.localtime()

        self.stdout.write(self.style.NOTICE("Seeding AttendSure 3NF Demo Dataset..."))

        # 1. School Year
        sy, _ = SchoolYear.objects.update_or_create(

        def ensure_staff(
            *,
            username: str,
            first: str,
            middle: str,
            last: str,
            email: str,
            role: str,
            employee_id: str,
            department: Department,

            user, created = User.objects.get_or_create(
                username=username,
                defaults={
                    "first_name": first,
                    "last_name": last,
                    "email": email,
                    "is_active": True,
                    "is_staff": superuser or role in ("ADMIN", "PRINCIPAL"),
                    "is_superuser": superuser,
                },
            )
            if created or not user.check_password(DEMO_PASSWORD):
                user.set_password(DEMO_PASSWORD)
            user.first_name = first
            user.last_name = last
            user.email = email
            user.is_active = True
            user.is_staff = superuser or role in ("ADMIN", "PRINCIPAL")
            user.is_superuser = superuser
            user.save()

            UserProfile.objects.update_or_create(
                user=user,
                defaults={
                    "role": role,
                    "failed_login_attempts": 0,
                    "locked_until": None,
                },
            )

            teacher, _ = TeacherProfile.objects.update_or_create(
                user=user,
                defaults={
                    "employee_id": employee_id,
                    "middle_name": middle,
                    "department": department,
                    "position": position,
                    "contact_number": phone,
                    "can_handle_classes": can_handle_classes,
                    "device_model": device_model,
                },
            )
            return user, teacher

        admin_user, admin_teacher = ensure_staff(

        default_loc, _ = AddressLocation.objects.get_or_create(
            barangay="Macasandig",

        seeded_enrollments = []
        for idx, (
            lrn,

        # 6. 14 Recent School Days of DailyAttendance & ClassAttendance
        school_days = []
        cursor = today
        while len(school_days) < 14:
            if cursor.weekday() < 5 or cursor == today:

            cursor -= timedelta(days=1)

        for day_idx, att_date in enumerate(school_days):
            for st_idx, (enr, sec, pattern) in enumerate(seeded_enrollments):
                if pattern == "critical_sardo":
                    if day_idx in (0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9):
                        st_status = "ABSENT"
                    else:
                        st_status = "LATE"
                elif pattern == "early_warning":
                    if day_idx in (1, 4, 8):
                        st_status = "ABSENT"
                    elif day_idx in (2, 6):
                        st_status = "LATE"
                    else:
                        st_status = "PRESENT"
                elif pattern == "late":
                    st_status = "LATE" if day_idx % 3 == 0 else "PRESENT"
                else:
                    st_status = "PRESENT" if (day_idx + st_idx) % 11 != 0 else "LATE"

                DailyAttendance.objects.update_or_create(

                        "remarks": (

                            else ""
                        ),

                sec_periods = periods_by_section.get(sec.id, [])
                for p_idx, period in enumerate(sec_periods):
                    # Leave one early-warning student missing Period 2 today to illustrate class cutting detection
                    if day_idx == 0 and pattern == "early_warning" and p_idx == 1:
                        continue
                    scan_hour = min(16, period.start_time.hour)
                    scan_minute = min(55, (st_idx * 2 + p_idx * 5) % 50)
                    scanned_dt = timezone.make_aware(
                        datetime.combine(att_date, time(scan_hour, scan_minute, 10))
                    )
                    ClassAttendance.objects.update_or_create(
                        enrollment=enr,
                        class_period=period,
                        attendance_date=att_date,
                        defaults={
                            "recorded_by": period.teacher or adviser_teacher,
                            "scanned_at": scanned_dt,
                            "scan_method": "QR" if st_status != "ABSENT" else "MANUAL",
                            "status": st_status,
                        },
                    )

        # 7. Teacher Daily Attendance, GPS Location Pings & Monthly DTR
        for teacher in (
            principal_teacher,
            adviser_teacher,
            dept_head_teacher,
            admin_teacher,
        ):
            for att_date in school_days[:10]:
                t_in = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(att_date, time(7, 42)))
                t_out = (
                    timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(att_date, time(16, 48)))
                    if att_date < today
                    else None
                )
                TeacherDailyAttendance.objects.update_or_create(
                    teacher=teacher,
                    attendance_date=att_date,
                    defaults={
                        "boundary": boundary,
                        "time_in": t_in,
                        "time_out": t_out,
                        "checkin_latitude": Decimal("8.485812"),
                        "checkin_longitude": Decimal("124.656715"),
                        "checkout_latitude": Decimal("8.485810") if t_out else None,

                        "device_id": f"DEMO-DEVICE-{teacher.employee_id}",
                        "face_verified_on_device": True,

                )
                for ping_time in (time(7, 45), time(12, 2), time(13, 5)):
                    ts = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(att_date, ping_time))
                    if not TeacherLocationPing.objects.filter(

        if not LoafingIncident.objects.filter(

                teacher=dept_head_teacher,

from django.db import models, transaction
from django.db.models import UniqueConstraint
from django.utils import timezone

DAY_OF_WEEK_CHOICES = [
    ("ALL_WEEKDAYS", "Monday to Friday"),
    ("MWF", "Monday, Wednesday, Friday"),
    ("TTH", "Tuesday, Thursday"),
    ("1", "Monday"),
    ("2", "Tuesday"),
    ("3", "Wednesday"),
    ("4", "Thursday"),
    ("5", "Friday"),
    ("6", "Saturday"),
    ("7", "Sunday"),
]

_NAMED_WEEKDAYS = {
    "MON": 1,
    "MONDAY": 1,
    "TUE": 2,
    "TUESDAY": 2,
    "WED": 3,
    "WEDNESDAY": 3,
    "THU": 4,
    "THURSDAY": 4,
    "FRI": 5,
    "FRIDAY": 5,
    "SAT": 6,
    "SATURDAY": 6,
    "SUN": 7,
    "SUNDAY": 7,
}


def expand_schedule_days(day_of_week: str | int | None) -> set[int]:
    """Return the ISO weekday numbers (1=Mon through 7=Sun) for a class period schedule."""
    clean = str(day_of_week or "ALL_WEEKDAYS").strip().upper()
    if clean in {"ALL_WEEKDAYS", "ALL", "WEEKDAYS", "MON-FRI", "MON_FRI"}:
        return {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
    if clean == "MWF":
        return {1, 3, 5}
    if clean == "TTH":
        return {2, 4}
    if clean in _NAMED_WEEKDAYS:
        return {_NAMED_WEEKDAYS[clean]}
    if clean.isdigit():
        val = int(clean)
        if 1 <= val <= 7:
            return {val}

    days: set[int] = set()
    for token in clean.replace("/", ",").split(","):
        part = token.strip()
        if part in _NAMED_WEEKDAYS:
            days.add(_NAMED_WEEKDAYS[part])
        elif part.isdigit() and 1 <= int(part) <= 7:
            days.add(int(part))
    return days or {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}


def period_runs_on_weekday(day_of_week: str | int | None, iso_weekday: int) -> bool:
    """Return True when a class period's day_of_week includes the given ISO weekday (1=Mon..7=Sun)."""
    return iso_weekday in expand_schedule_days(day_of_week)

class SchoolYear(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    name = models.CharField(max_length=20, unique=True, db_index=True)
    start_date = models.DateField()
    baseline_cutoff_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    end_date = models.DateField()
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True, db_index=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "school_years"
        ordering = ["-start_date"]

    @property
    def code(self) -> str:
        return self.name

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        with transaction.atomic():
            if self.is_active:
                SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).exclude(pk=self.pk).update(is_active=False)
            super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.name

        db_table = "grade_levels"
        ordering = ["level_number"]

        if not self.code:
            self.code = f"G{self.level_number}"
        if not self.stage:

        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

        return self.name

class ClassPeriod(models.Model):
    """
    Strict 3NF ClassPeriod:
    - Never stores school_year or grade_level (determined via ClassPeriod -> Section).
    - Atomic day_of_week choice (1..7, ALL_WEEKDAYS, MWF, TTH).
    """

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    schedule_code = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True, default="", db_index=True)
    section = models.ForeignKey(Section, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="class_periods")
    subject = models.ForeignKey(Subject, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="class_periods")
    teacher = models.ForeignKey(
        "accounts.TeacherProfile",
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="assigned_periods",
    )
    day_of_week = models.CharField(
        max_length=16, choices=DAY_OF_WEEK_CHOICES, default="ALL_WEEKDAYS", db_index=True
    )
    start_time = models.TimeField(db_index=True)
    end_time = models.TimeField()
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True, db_index=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "class_periods"
        ordering = ["start_time"]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["teacher", "is_active"], name="idx_period_teacher_active"),
            models.Index(fields=["section", "is_active"], name="idx_period_section_active"),
        ]

    @property
    def room_name(self) -> str:
        return self.section.room_name if (self.section_id and self.section) else ""

    def runs_on_weekday(self, iso_weekday: int) -> bool:
        return period_runs_on_weekday(self.day_of_week, iso_weekday)

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        subj = self.subject.code if self.subject_id else "CLASS"
        sec = self.section.name if self.section_id else ""
        return f"{sec} {subj} ({self.start_time}-{self.end_time})"

from django.core.cache import cache
from django.db.models import Count, Q

from apps.accounts.selectors import get_teacher_section_ids, resolve_teacher_for_user
from common.media import build_media_url, save_base64_logo_to_disk

SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY = "school:metadata:raw"


def format_section_label(grade_name: str, section_name: str) -> str:
    g, s = str(grade_name or "").strip(), str(section_name or "").strip()
    if not g:
        return s
    if not s or g.lower().endswith(s.lower()):
        return g
    return f"{g} - {s}"


def migrate_inline_logos_to_files(school: SchoolSettings) -> SchoolSettings:
    """Replaces raw Base64 logo strings in DB with lightweight /media/ paths."""
    updates = {}
    for field_name in ("school_logo", "left_logo", "right_logo"):
        val = getattr(school, field_name, None)
        if val and isinstance(val, str) and (
            val.startswith("data:image") or val.startswith(("/9j/", "iVBORw0KGgo"))
        ):
            disk_path = save_base64_logo_to_disk(val)
            if disk_path:
                updates[field_name] = disk_path
                setattr(school, field_name, disk_path)

    if updates:
        SchoolSettings.objects.filter(pk=school.pk).update(**updates)
        cache.delete(SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY)
    return school


def get_school_metadata(request=None, school: SchoolSettings | None = None) -> dict:
    raw = cache.get(SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY)
    if raw is None:
        school = school or (
            SchoolSettings.objects.select_related(
                "division_ref",
                "active_school_year",
                "campus_boundary",
                "principal_teacher",
                "principal_teacher__user",
                "principal_teacher__position",
                "principal_teacher__department",
            ).first()
        )
        if not school:
            active_sy = SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
            return {
                "school_id": "",
                "school_name": "",
                "region": "",
                "division": "",
                "district": "",
                "school_year": active_sy.name if active_sy else "",
                "academic_year": active_sy.name if active_sy else "",
                "school_address": "",
                "school_contact": "",
                "school_email": "",
                "website": "",
                "school_head": "",
                "principal_name": "",
                "principal_title": "",
                "superintendent_name": "",
                "left_logo": None,
                "right_logo": None,
                "school_logo": None,
                "latitude": 8.4858,
                "longitude": 124.6567,
                "geofence_radius_meters": 150,
                "weekend_rest_enabled": True,
                "is_configured": False,
            }

        school = migrate_inline_logos_to_files(school)
        div = school.division_ref
        sy = school.active_school_year or SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()

        boundary = school.campus_boundary
        head_name = principal.full_name if principal else ""
        head_title = (
            principal.position_title if (principal and principal.position_title) else "School Principal"
        )

        raw = {
            "school_id": school.school_id,
            "school_name": school.school_name,
            "region": div.region if div else "",
            "division": div.division if div else "",
            "district": div.district if div else "",
            "school_year": sy.name if sy else "",
            "academic_year": sy.name if sy else "",
            "school_address": school.address,
            "school_contact": school.contact_number,
            "school_email": school.email,
            "website": school.website,
            "school_head": head_name.upper(),
            "principal_name": head_name,
            "principal_title": head_title,
            "superintendent_name": school.superintendent_name,
            "left_logo_path": school.left_logo,
            "right_logo_path": school.right_logo,
            "school_logo_path": school.school_logo,
            "latitude": float(boundary.center_latitude) if boundary else 8.4858,
            "longitude": float(boundary.center_longitude) if boundary else 124.6567,
            "geofence_radius_meters": int(boundary.radius_meters) if boundary else 150,
            "weekend_rest_enabled": bool(school.weekend_rest_enabled),
            "is_configured": bool(school.school_name and school.school_id),
        }
        cache.set(SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY, raw, timeout=300)

    return {
        "school_id": raw["school_id"],
        "school_name": raw["school_name"],

def get_sections_for_user(user, *, include_inactive: bool = False):
    qs = Section.objects.all()
    if not (include_inactive and is_school_leader(user)):
        qs = qs.filter(is_active=True)
    qs = (
        qs.select_related("grade_level", "school_year", "adviser", "adviser__user")
        .annotate(
            enrolled_count=Count(
                "enrollments",
                filter=Q(
                    enrollments__status__in=["ENROLLED", "TRANSFERRED_IN"],
                    enrollments__student__is_active=True,
                ),
                distinct=True,
            ),
            active_periods_count=Count(
                "class_periods",
                filter=Q(class_periods__is_active=True),
                distinct=True,
            ),
        )
        .order_by("grade_level__level_number", "name")
    )
    if not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        qs = qs.filter(id__in=get_teacher_section_ids(teacher)) if teacher else qs.none()
    return qs


def get_class_periods_for_user(user, section_id: int | None = None):
    qs = ClassPeriod.objects.select_related(
        "section",
        "section__grade_level",
        "subject",
        "teacher",
        "teacher__user",
    ).order_by("start_time")
    if section_id:
        qs = qs.filter(section_id=section_id)
    if not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        if teacher:
            qs = qs.filter(
                Q(teacher=teacher) | Q(section_id__in=get_teacher_section_ids(teacher))
            ).distinct()
        else:
            qs = qs.none()
    return qs

class RoomSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    building = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True, default="")

    class Meta:
        model = Room
        fields = ["id", "name", "building", "capacity", "room_type", "is_active"]

    def validate_name(self, value: str) -> str:
        clean = _clean_text(value, 100)
        if not clean:
            raise serializers.ValidationError("Classroom name is required.")
        qs = Room.objects.filter(name__iexact=clean)
        if self.instance:
            qs = qs.exclude(pk=self.instance.pk)
        if qs.exists():
            raise serializers.ValidationError("A classroom with this name already exists.")
        return clean

    def to_representation(self, instance: Room) -> dict:
        return {
            "id": instance.id,
            "name": instance.name,
            "building": instance.building_name,
            "capacity": instance.capacity,
            "room_type": instance.room_type,
            "is_active": instance.is_active,
        }

    @transaction.atomic
    def create(self, validated_data):
        b_name = _clean_text(validated_data.pop("building", ""), 100)
        validated_data["name"] = _clean_text(validated_data.get("name", ""), 100)
        if b_name:
            b_obj, _ = Building.objects.get_or_create(name=b_name)
            validated_data["building"] = b_obj
        return super().create(validated_data)

    @transaction.atomic
    def update(self, instance, validated_data):
        if "building" in validated_data:
            b_name = _clean_text(validated_data.pop("building"), 100)
            instance.building = Building.objects.get_or_create(name=b_name)[0] if b_name else None
        if "name" in validated_data:
            validated_data["name"] = _clean_text(validated_data["name"], 100)
        return super().update(instance, validated_data)

class SchoolHolidaySerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):

        if not mutable.get("reason") and mutable.get("title"):
            mutable["reason"] = _clean_text(mutable["title"], 150)
        elif mutable.get("reason"):
            mutable["reason"] = _clean_text(mutable["reason"], 150)
        if "type" in mutable and mutable["type"]:
            mutable["type"] = str(mutable["type"]).strip().upper()
        return super().to_internal_value(mutable)
