class SchoolSettingsSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    school_logo = SchoolLogoField(required=False, allow_null=True)
    left_logo = SchoolLogoField(required=False, allow_null=True)
    right_logo = SchoolLogoField(required=False, allow_null=True)

    region = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True, write_only=True)
    division = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True, write_only=True)
    district = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True, write_only=True)
    academic_year = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True, write_only=True)
    school_year = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True, write_only=True)
    latitude = serializers.FloatField(required=False, write_only=True)
    longitude = serializers.FloatField(required=False, write_only=True)
    geofence_radius_meters = serializers.IntegerField(required=False, write_only=True)

    principal_teacher = serializers.PrimaryKeyRelatedField(
        queryset=TeacherProfile.objects.all(),
        required=False,
        allow_null=True,
    )

    class Meta:
        model = SchoolSettings
        fields = [
            "id",
            "school_id",
            "school_name",
            "region",
            "division",
            "district",
            "school_year",
            "academic_year",
            "address",
            "contact_number",
            "email",
            "website",
            "principal_teacher",
            "superintendent_name",
            "school_logo",
            "left_logo",
            "right_logo",
            "latitude",
            "longitude",
            "geofence_radius_meters",
            "weekend_rest_enabled",
            "updated_at",
        ]
        extra_kwargs = {
            "school_id": {"required": False, "allow_blank": True},
            "school_name": {"required": False, "allow_blank": True},
        }

    def to_internal_value(self, data):
        mutable = {k: data.get(k) for k in data.keys()} if hasattr(data, "keys") else dict(data)
        alias_map = {
            "school_address": "address",
            "school_contact": "contact_number",
            "school_email": "email",
            "radius_meters": "geofence_radius_meters",
            "geofence_radius": "geofence_radius_meters",
            "emblem": "school_logo",
            "main_logo": "school_logo",
        }
        for src_key, dest_key in alias_map.items():
            if src_key in mutable and dest_key not in mutable:
                mutable[dest_key] = mutable[src_key]

        if "principal_teacher" in mutable and str(mutable["principal_teacher"]).strip().lower() in (
            "",
            "null",
            "none",
            "undefined",
        ):
            mutable["principal_teacher"] = None

        for txt_key in ("school_id", "school_name", "address", "superintendent_name", "region", "division", "district"):
            if txt_key in mutable and isinstance(mutable[txt_key], str):
                mutable[txt_key] = _clean_text(mutable[txt_key], 255)

        if "website" in mutable:
            raw_web = str(mutable.get("website") or "").strip()
            mutable["website"] = (
                f"https://{raw_web}"
                if (raw_web and not raw_web.startswith(("http://", "https://")))
                else raw_web
            )

        for coord_key in ("latitude", "longitude"):
            if coord_key in mutable:
                raw_coord = mutable[coord_key]
                if raw_coord in (None, "", "null", "undefined"):
                    mutable.pop(coord_key, None)
                else:
                    try:
                        parsed = float(raw_coord)
                        if not math.isfinite(parsed):
                            raise ValueError("non-finite")
                        mutable[coord_key] = round(parsed, 6)
                    except (TypeError, ValueError):
                        raise serializers.ValidationError({coord_key: f"Invalid {coord_key} value."})

        if "geofence_radius_meters" in mutable:
            raw_rad = mutable["geofence_radius_meters"]
            if raw_rad in (None, "", "null", "undefined"):
                mutable.pop("geofence_radius_meters", None)
            else:
                try:
                    parsed_rad = float(raw_rad)
                    if not math.isfinite(parsed_rad):
                        raise ValueError("non-finite")
                    mutable["geofence_radius_meters"] = max(20, min(5000, int(parsed_rad)))
                except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
                    raise serializers.ValidationError(
                        {"geofence_radius_meters": "Invalid radius in meters."}
                    )

        return super().to_internal_value(mutable)

    def _apply_3nf_relations(self, validated_data: dict, instance: SchoolSettings | None = None):
        has_div = any(k in validated_data for k in ("region", "division", "district"))
        curr_div = instance.division_ref if instance else None
        region = validated_data.pop("region", curr_div.region if curr_div else "")
        division = validated_data.pop("division", curr_div.division if curr_div else "")
        district = validated_data.pop("district", curr_div.district if curr_div else "")
        if has_div and (region or division or district):
            div_obj, _ = AdministrativeDivision.objects.get_or_create(
                region=_clean_text(region, 100),
                division=_clean_text(division, 100),
                district=_clean_text(district, 100),
            )
            validated_data["division_ref"] = div_obj

        sy_name = _clean_text(
            validated_data.pop("school_year", "") or validated_data.pop("academic_year", ""), 20
        )
        if sy_name:
            sy_obj = SchoolYear.objects.filter(name__iexact=sy_name).first()
            if sy_obj:
                validated_data["active_school_year"] = sy_obj
        elif not instance and "active_school_year" not in validated_data:
            active_sy = SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
            if active_sy:
                validated_data["active_school_year"] = active_sy

        has_gps = any(k in validated_data for k in ("latitude", "longitude", "geofence_radius_meters"))
        curr_b = (instance.campus_boundary if instance and instance.campus_boundary else None) or (
            CampusBoundary.objects.filter(is_active=True).first() or CampusBoundary.objects.first()
        )
        lat = validated_data.pop("latitude", float(curr_b.center_latitude) if curr_b else 8.4858)
        lng = validated_data.pop("longitude", float(curr_b.center_longitude) if curr_b else 124.6567)
        rad = validated_data.pop("geofence_radius_meters", curr_b.radius_meters if curr_b else 150)

        if has_gps or not curr_b:
            b_name = _clean_text(
                validated_data.get("school_name")
                or (instance.school_name if instance else "Main Campus"),
                150,
            ) or "Main Campus"
            if curr_b:
                curr_b.campus_name = b_name
                curr_b.center_latitude = Decimal(f"{float(lat):.6f}")
                curr_b.center_longitude = Decimal(f"{float(lng):.6f}")
                curr_b.radius_meters = int(rad)
                curr_b.is_active = True
                curr_b.save()
                validated_data["campus_boundary"] = curr_b
            else:
                validated_data["campus_boundary"] = CampusBoundary.objects.create(
                    campus_name=b_name,
                    center_latitude=Decimal(f"{float(lat):.6f}"),
                    center_longitude=Decimal(f"{float(lng):.6f}"),
                    radius_meters=int(rad),
                    is_active=True,
                )
            cache.delete("campus:active_boundary")

    @transaction.atomic
    def create(self, validated_data):
        if not validated_data.get("school_id"):
            validated_data["school_id"] = "304100"
        self._apply_3nf_relations(validated_data, instance=None)
        return super().create(validated_data)

    @transaction.atomic
    def update(self, instance, validated_data):
        self._apply_3nf_relations(validated_data, instance=instance)
        return super().update(instance, validated_data)

    def to_representation(self, instance: SchoolSettings):
        data = super().to_representation(instance)
        div = instance.division_ref
        sy = instance.active_school_year or SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
        b = instance.campus_boundary or CampusBoundary.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
        p = instance.principal_teacher

        data["region"] = div.region if div else ""
        data["division"] = div.division if div else ""
        data["district"] = div.district if div else ""
        data["school_year"] = sy.name if sy else ""
        data["academic_year"] = sy.name if sy else ""
        data["latitude"] = float(b.center_latitude) if b else 8.4858
        data["longitude"] = float(b.center_longitude) if b else 124.6567
        data["geofence_radius_meters"] = int(b.radius_meters) if b else 150
        data["principal_teacher"] = p.id if p else None
        data["principal_name"] = p.full_name if p else ""
        data["principal_title"] = (
            p.position_title if (p and p.position_title) else "School Principal"
        )
        data["principal_employee_id"] = p.employee_id if p else ""
        data["principal_department"] = p.department_name if p else "Administration"
        data["principal_email"] = p.email if p else ""
        data["principal_contact_number"] = p.contact_number if p else ""
        data["principal_photo_url"] = (
            build_media_url(p.photo, self.context.get("request")) if (p and p.photo) else None
        )
        return data

        if "adviser" not in mutable and "adviser_id" in mutable:

        if "adviser" in mutable and str(mutable["adviser"]).strip().lower() in ("", "null", "none", "undefined"):
            mutable["adviser"] = None
        if "room_name" not in mutable and "room_number" in mutable:
            mutable["room_name"] = _clean_text(mutable.get("room_number", ""), 100)
        if "name" in mutable:

    def get_adviser_photo_url(self, obj):

        return None

    def get_display_label(self, obj) -> str:

    def get_scheduled_subjects_count(self, obj) -> int:
        annotated = getattr(obj, "active_periods_count", None)
        if annotated is not None:
            return int(annotated)
        return ClassPeriod.objects.filter(section_id=obj.id, is_active=True).count()

    def validate(self, attrs):
        allow_multiple = bool(attrs.pop("allow_multiple_advisories", False))
        self._allow_multiple_advisories_used = allow_multiple

        sy = attrs.get("school_year") or (self.instance.school_year if self.instance else None)
        if not sy:
            sy = SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first() or SchoolYear.objects.first()
            if not sy:
                raise serializers.ValidationError(
                    {"school_year": "Create an active School Year before adding sections."}
                )
            attrs["school_year"] = sy

        grade_level = attrs.get("grade_level") or (self.instance.grade_level if self.instance else None)
        name = attrs.get("name") if "name" in attrs else (self.instance.name if self.instance else None)
        adviser = attrs.get("adviser") if "adviser" in attrs else (self.instance.adviser if self.instance else None)
        is_active = attrs.get("is_active") if "is_active" in attrs else (self.instance.is_active if self.instance else True)
        room_name = attrs.get("room_name") if "room_name" in attrs else (self.instance.room_name if self.instance else "")

        result = check_section_conflicts(
            school_year=sy,
            grade_level_id=grade_level.id if grade_level else None,
            name=name or "",
            adviser=adviser,
            room_name=room_name or "",
            exclude_id=self.instance.pk if self.instance else None,
            is_active=bool(is_active),
        )

        if result["name_taken"]:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"name": result["name_message"]})

        adv_info = result["adviser_conflict"]
        if adviser is not None and not adv_info["can_handle_classes"]:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"adviser": adv_info["message"]})

        adviser_changed_or_new = (
            (not self.instance)
            or (self.instance.adviser_id != (adviser.id if adviser else None))
            or (self.instance.school_year_id != sy.id)
            or (bool(is_active) and not self.instance.is_active)
        )
        if adv_info["has_existing_advisory"] and adviser_changed_or_new and not allow_multiple:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"adviser": adv_info["message"]})

        return attrs

    @transaction.atomic
    def create(self, validated_data):
        section = super().create(validated_data)
        sync_uniform_subjects_for_section(section)
        return section


class ClassPeriodSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    section_name = serializers.CharField(source="section.name", read_only=True)
    grade_level_name = serializers.CharField(source="section.grade_level.name", read_only=True, default="")
    subject_code = serializers.CharField(source="subject.code", read_only=True)
    subject_title = serializers.CharField(source="subject.title", read_only=True)
    room_name = serializers.CharField(read_only=True)
    days_of_week = serializers.CharField(source="day_of_week", required=False)
    teacher_id = serializers.IntegerField(read_only=True)
    teacher_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    teacher_employee_id = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    teacher_photo_url = serializers.SerializerMethodField()

    class Meta:
        model = ClassPeriod
        fields = [
            "id",
            "schedule_code",
            "section",
            "section_name",
            "grade_level_name",
            "subject",
            "subject_code",
            "subject_title",
            "teacher",
            "teacher_id",
            "teacher_name",
            "teacher_employee_id",
            "teacher_photo_url",
            "room_name",
            "day_of_week",
            "days_of_week",
            "start_time",
            "end_time",
            "is_active",
        ]

    def to_internal_value(self, data):
        mutable = {k: data.get(k) for k in data.keys()} if hasattr(data, "keys") else dict(data)
        if "teacher" not in mutable and "teacher_id" in mutable:
            mutable["teacher"] = mutable["teacher_id"]
        if "section" not in mutable and "section_id" in mutable:
            mutable["section"] = mutable["section_id"]
        if "subject" not in mutable and "subject_id" in mutable:
            mutable["subject"] = mutable["subject_id"]
        raw_dow = mutable.get("day_of_week") or mutable.get("days_of_week")
        if raw_dow is not None:
            mutable["day_of_week"] = normalize_day_of_week(raw_dow)
            mutable.pop("days_of_week", None)
        return super().to_internal_value(mutable)

    def _expand_days(self, dow: str) -> set[int]:
        return expand_schedule_days(dow)

    def validate(self, attrs):
        section = attrs.get("section") if "section" in attrs else (self.instance.section if self.instance else None)
        teacher = attrs.get("teacher") if "teacher" in attrs else (self.instance.teacher if self.instance else None)
        day_of_week = attrs.get("day_of_week") if "day_of_week" in attrs else (self.instance.day_of_week if self.instance else "ALL_WEEKDAYS")
        start_time = attrs.get("start_time") if "start_time" in attrs else (self.instance.start_time if self.instance else None)
        end_time = attrs.get("end_time") if "end_time" in attrs else (self.instance.end_time if self.instance else None)
        is_active = attrs.get("is_active") if "is_active" in attrs else (self.instance.is_active if self.instance else True)

        result = check_class_period_conflicts(
            section=section,
            teacher=teacher,
            day_of_week=day_of_week,
            start_time=start_time,
            end_time=end_time,
            exclude_id=self.instance.pk if self.instance else None,
            is_active=bool(is_active),
        )
        if result["time_error"]:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"end_time": result["time_error"]})
        if result["teacher_conflict"]:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"teacher": result["teacher_conflict"]})
        if result["section_conflict"]:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"start_time": result["section_conflict"]})
        if result["room_conflict"]:
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"room_name": result["room_conflict"]})

        return attrs

    def get_teacher_name(self, obj) -> str:
        return obj.teacher.full_name if obj.teacher else "Unassigned"

    def get_teacher_employee_id(self, obj) -> str:
        return obj.teacher.employee_id if obj.teacher else ""

    def get_teacher_photo_url(self, obj):
        if obj.teacher and obj.teacher.photo:
            return build_media_url(obj.teacher.photo, self.context.get("request"))
        return None

from datetime import time
from .models import ClassPeriod, SchoolYear, Section, Subject, expand_schedule_days
from .selectors import format_section_label


def parse_schedule_time(raw_value) -> time | None:
    if isinstance(raw_value, time):
        return raw_value
    raw = str(raw_value or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return None
    parts = raw.split(":")
    try:
        hour = int(parts[0])
        minute = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0
        second = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0
        return time(hour, minute, second)
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        return None


def check_section_conflicts(
    *,
    school_year: SchoolYear | None,
    grade_level_id: int | None = None,
    name: str = "",
    adviser=None,
    room_name: str = "",
    exclude_id: int | None = None,
    is_active: bool = True,
) -> dict:
    sy = school_year or SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first() or SchoolYear.objects.first()
    clean_name = str(name or "").strip()
    clean_room = str(room_name or "").strip()

    name_taken = False
    name_message = ""
    if sy and grade_level_id and clean_name:
        dup_qs = Section.objects.filter(
            school_year=sy,
            grade_level_id=grade_level_id,
            name__iexact=clean_name,
        )
        if exclude_id:
            dup_qs = dup_qs.exclude(pk=exclude_id)
        if dup_qs.exists():
            name_taken = True
            name_message = "A section with this name already exists for this grade level and school year."

    adviser_conflict = {
        "has_existing_advisory": False,
        "existing_sections": [],
        "can_handle_classes": True,
        "message": "",
    }
    if adviser is not None:
        if not adviser.can_handle_classes:
            adviser_conflict = {
                "has_existing_advisory": False,
                "existing_sections": [],
                "can_handle_classes": False,
                "message": "Non-teaching staff cannot be assigned as a homeroom class adviser. Choose a teaching teacher instead.",
            }
        elif sy and is_active:
            existing_qs = (
                Section.objects.filter(
                    school_year=sy,
                    adviser=adviser,
                    is_active=True,
                )
                .select_related("grade_level")
                .order_by("grade_level__level_number", "name")
            )
            if exclude_id:
                existing_qs = existing_qs.exclude(pk=exclude_id)
            existing_labels = [
                format_section_label(
                    sec.grade_level.name if sec.grade_level else "",
                    sec.name,
                )
                for sec in existing_qs
            ]
            if existing_labels:
                joined = ", ".join(existing_labels)
                adviser_conflict = {
                    "has_existing_advisory": True,
                    "existing_sections": existing_labels,
                    "can_handle_classes": True,
                    "message": (
                        f"This teacher is already the adviser of {joined} for {sy.name}. "
                        "Turn on 'Allow second advisory class' if this is an approved double-shift, "
                        "multigrade, or temporary assignment."
                    ),
                }

    room_in_use_by_sections: list[str] = []
    if sy and clean_room:
        room_qs = (
            Section.objects.filter(
                school_year=sy,
                is_active=True,
                room_name__iexact=clean_room,
            )
            .select_related("grade_level")
            .order_by("grade_level__level_number", "name")
        )
        if exclude_id:
            room_qs = room_qs.exclude(pk=exclude_id)
        room_in_use_by_sections = [
            format_section_label(
                sec.grade_level.name if sec.grade_level else "",
                sec.name,
            )
            for sec in room_qs
        ]

    return {
        "type": "section",
        "name_taken": name_taken,
        "name_message": name_message,
        "adviser_conflict": adviser_conflict,
        "room_in_use_by_sections": room_in_use_by_sections,
        "room_message": (
            f"{clean_room} is also set as the homeroom for {', '.join(room_in_use_by_sections)}. "
            "Make sure their class schedules do not overlap (for example, AM/PM shifts)."
            if room_in_use_by_sections
            else ""
        ),
        "has_hard_conflict": bool(name_taken or not adviser_conflict["can_handle_classes"]),
    }


def check_class_period_conflicts(
    *,
    section: Section | None,
    teacher=None,
    day_of_week: str | int | None = "ALL_WEEKDAYS",
    start_time: time | None = None,
    end_time: time | None = None,
    exclude_id: int | None = None,
    is_active: bool = True,
) -> dict:
    time_error: str | None = None
    section_conflict: str | None = None
    teacher_conflict: str | None = None
    room_conflict: str | None = None

    if teacher is not None and not teacher.can_handle_classes:
        teacher_conflict = (
            "Non-teaching staff cannot be assigned to teach a scheduled class period. "
            "Choose a teaching teacher instead."
        )

    if start_time and end_time and end_time <= start_time:
        time_error = "End time must be later than start time."

    if is_active and start_time and end_time and not time_error:
        target_days = expand_schedule_days(day_of_week)
        base_qs = ClassPeriod.objects.select_related(
            "subject",
            "section",
            "section__grade_level",
            "teacher",
            "teacher__user",
        ).filter(
            is_active=True,
            section__is_active=True,
            start_time__lt=end_time,
            end_time__gt=start_time,
        )
        if section and section.school_year_id:
            base_qs = base_qs.filter(section__school_year_id=section.school_year_id)
        if exclude_id:
            base_qs = base_qs.exclude(pk=exclude_id)

        if section:
            sec_label = format_section_label(
                section.grade_level.name if section.grade_level_id else "",
                section.name,
            )
            for other in base_qs.filter(section=section):
                if expand_schedule_days(other.day_of_week) & target_days:
                    win = f"{other.start_time.strftime('%H:%M')}-{other.end_time.strftime('%H:%M')}"
                    section_conflict = (
                        f"Schedule clash in {sec_label}: {other.subject.code} already meets at {win}."
                    )
                    break

        if teacher and not teacher_conflict:
            for other in base_qs.filter(teacher=teacher):
                if expand_schedule_days(other.day_of_week) & target_days:
                    other_sec = format_section_label(
                        other.section.grade_level.name if other.section.grade_level_id else "",
                        other.section.name,
                    )
                    win = f"{other.start_time.strftime('%H:%M')}-{other.end_time.strftime('%H:%M')}"
                    teacher_conflict = (
                        f"Teacher double-booking: {teacher.full_name} is already teaching "
                        f"{other_sec} ({other.subject.code}, {win})."
                    )
                    break

        clean_room = (section.room_name or "").strip() if section else ""
        if section and clean_room:
            for other in base_qs.filter(section__room_name__iexact=clean_room).exclude(section=section):
                if expand_schedule_days(other.day_of_week) & target_days:
                    other_sec = format_section_label(
                        other.section.grade_level.name if other.section.grade_level_id else "",
                        other.section.name,
                    )
                    win = f"{other.start_time.strftime('%H:%M')}-{other.end_time.strftime('%H:%M')}"
                    room_conflict = (
                        f"Room double-booking: {clean_room} is already used by {other_sec} "
                        f"for {other.subject.code} ({win})."
                    )
                    break

    return {
        "type": "period",
        "has_conflict": bool(time_error or section_conflict or teacher_conflict or room_conflict),
        "time_error": time_error,
        "section_conflict": section_conflict,
        "teacher_conflict": teacher_conflict,
        "room_conflict": room_conflict,
    }


def normalize_day_of_week(raw_value: str | int | None) -> str:
    clean = str(raw_value or "ALL_WEEKDAYS").strip().upper()
    mapping = {
        "MON-FRI": "ALL_WEEKDAYS",
        "ALL": "ALL_WEEKDAYS",
        "ALL_WEEKDAYS": "ALL_WEEKDAYS",
        "WEEKDAYS": "ALL_WEEKDAYS",
        "MWF": "MWF",
        "TTH": "TTH",
        "MON": "1",
        "MONDAY": "1",
        "1": "1",
        "TUE": "2",
        "TUESDAY": "2",
        "2": "2",
        "WED": "3",
        "WEDNESDAY": "3",
        "3": "3",
        "THU": "4",
        "THURSDAY": "4",
        "4": "4",
        "FRI": "5",
        "FRIDAY": "5",
        "5": "5",
        "SAT": "6",
        "SATURDAY": "6",
        "6": "6",
        "SUN": "7",
        "SUNDAY": "7",
        "7": "7",
    }
    return mapping.get(clean, "ALL_WEEKDAYS")


def sync_uniform_subjects_for_section(section: Section) -> None:
    if not section or not section.grade_level_id:
        return
    subjects = list(Subject.objects.filter(grade_level_id=section.grade_level_id).order_by("id"))
    existing_ids = set(ClassPeriod.objects.filter(section=section).values_list("subject_id", flat=True))
    to_create = []
    for idx, subj in enumerate(subjects):
        if subj.id in existing_ids:
            continue
        start_hr = min(7 + idx, 16)
        to_create.append(
            ClassPeriod(
                schedule_code=f"{section.id}-{subj.code}"[:64],
                section=section,
                subject=subj,
                day_of_week="ALL_WEEKDAYS",
                start_time=time(start_hr, 30),
                end_time=time(min(start_hr + 1, 17), 30),
                is_active=True,
            )
        )
    if to_create:
        ClassPeriod.objects.bulk_create(to_create)

    def test_deped_second_advisory_requires_explicit_override_and_logs_audit(self):
        # 1. Assigning teacher_1 to a 2nd advisory section fails with 400 by default
        blocked = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/school/sections/",
            {
                "name": "Galileo",
                "grade_level": self.grade7.id,
                "adviser": self.teacher_1.id,
                "room_name": "Room 102",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(blocked.status_code, 400)
        self.assertIn("Allow second advisory class", str(blocked.data))
        self.assertIn("Grade 7 - Newton", str(blocked.data))

        # 2. Turning on allow_multiple_advisories=True succeeds and writes AuditLog
        allowed = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/school/sections/",
            {
                "name": "Galileo",
                "grade_level": self.grade7.id,
                "adviser": self.teacher_1.id,
                "room_name": "Room 102",
                "allow_multiple_advisories": True,
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(allowed.status_code, 201, allowed.data)
        sec_id = allowed.data["id"]

        self.assertTrue(
            AuditLog.objects.filter(
                table_name="sections",
                record_id=sec_id,
                action="CREATE",
            ).exists()
        )

        # 3. Updating unrelated field (capacity) on that section succeeds without re-blocking
        patch_cap = self.client.patch(
            f"/api/v1/school/sections/{sec_id}/",
            {"capacity": 48},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(patch_cap.status_code, 200, patch_cap.data)

        # 4. Updating another section to assign teacher_1 without override fails, with override succeeds
        patch_blocked = self.client.patch(
            f"/api/v1/school/sections/{self.section_darwin.id}/",
            {"adviser": self.teacher_1.id},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(patch_blocked.status_code, 400)

        patch_allowed = self.client.patch(
            f"/api/v1/school/sections/{self.section_darwin.id}/",
            {"adviser": self.teacher_1.id, "allow_multiple_advisories": True},
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(patch_allowed.status_code, 200, patch_allowed.data)

                "section": self.section_newton.id,

                "teacher": self.teacher_1.id,
                "day_of_week": "MWF",
                "start_time": "08:00",
                "end_time": "09:00",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(first.status_code, 201, first.data)

        # Darwin also uses Room 101 on ALL_WEEKDAYS 08:30-09:30 with a different teacher -> room conflict (400)
        room_clash = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/school/periods/",
            {
                "section": self.section_darwin.id,
                "subject": self.subj_eng.id,

                "end_time": "09:30",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(room_clash.status_code, 400)
        self.assertIn("Room 101", str(room_clash.data))

        # Darwin uses Room 101 on TTH 08:00-09:00 (non-intersecting days vs MWF) -> succeeds (201)

    def test_live_check_conflict_endpoint_for_sections_and_periods_and_teacher_dropdown(self):
        # Verify teacher dropdown exposes advised_sections
        dropdown = self.client.get("/api/v1/accounts/teachers/dropdown/")
        self.assertEqual(dropdown.status_code, 200)
        t1_row = next((t for t in dropdown.data if t["id"] == self.teacher_1.id), None)
        self.assertIsNotNone(t1_row)
        self.assertIn("Grade 7 - Newton", t1_row["advised_sections"])

        # Mode A: type=section detects duplicate name, existing adviser, and shared room
        sec_check = self.client.get(
            "/api/v1/school/check-conflict/",
            {
                "type": "section",
                "grade_level": self.grade7.id,
                "name": "newton",
                "adviser_id": self.teacher_1.id,
                "room_name": "Room 101",
            },
        )
        self.assertEqual(sec_check.status_code, 200)
        self.assertTrue(sec_check.data["name_taken"])
        self.assertTrue(sec_check.data["adviser_conflict"]["has_existing_advisory"])
        self.assertIn("Grade 7 - Newton", sec_check.data["adviser_conflict"]["existing_sections"])
        self.assertTrue(sec_check.data["adviser_conflict"]["can_handle_classes"])
        self.assertIn("Grade 7 - Newton", sec_check.data["room_in_use_by_sections"])

        # Mode A with exclude_id=section_newton.id -> own name and own advisory excluded cleanly
        sec_self = self.client.get(
            "/api/v1/school/check-conflict/",
            {
                "type": "section",
                "grade_level": self.grade7.id,
                "name": "Newton",
                "adviser_id": self.teacher_1.id,
                "room_name": "Room 101",
                "exclude_id": self.section_newton.id,
            },
        )
        self.assertEqual(sec_self.status_code, 200)
        self.assertFalse(sec_self.data["name_taken"])
        self.assertFalse(sec_self.data["adviser_conflict"]["has_existing_advisory"])
        self.assertEqual(sec_self.data["room_in_use_by_sections"], ["Grade 7 - Darwin"])

        # Mode A with non-teaching staff -> can_handle_classes is False
        sec_nt = self.client.get(
            "/api/v1/school/check-conflict/",
            {"type": "section", "adviser_id": self.nonteaching.id},
        )
        self.assertEqual(sec_nt.status_code, 200)
        self.assertFalse(sec_nt.data["adviser_conflict"]["can_handle_classes"])

        # Mode B: type=period detects section clash, teacher clash, and room clash
        p1 = ClassPeriod.objects.create(
            schedule_code="CHK-P1",
            section=self.section_newton,
            subject=self.subj_math,
            teacher=self.teacher_1,
            day_of_week="MWF",
            start_time=time(7, 30),
            end_time=time(8, 30),
            is_active=True,
        )

        # Same section + same teacher on MWF overlapping time
        per_clash = self.client.get(
            "/api/v1/school/check-conflict/",
            {
                "type": "period",
                "section_id": self.section_newton.id,
                "subject_id": self.subj_eng.id,
                "teacher_id": self.teacher_1.id,
                "day_of_week": "MWF",
                "start_time": "08:00",
                "end_time": "09:00",
            },
        )
        self.assertEqual(per_clash.status_code, 200)
        self.assertTrue(per_clash.data["has_conflict"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(per_clash.data["section_conflict"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(per_clash.data["teacher_conflict"])

        # Different section sharing Room 101 on Monday -> room conflict
        room_clash = self.client.get(
            "/api/v1/school/check-conflict/",
            {
                "type": "period",
                "section_id": self.section_darwin.id,
                "subject_id": self.subj_eng.id,
                "teacher_id": self.teacher_2.id,
                "day_of_week": "1",
                "start_time": "07:45",
                "end_time": "08:45",
            },
        )
        self.assertEqual(room_clash.status_code, 200)
        self.assertTrue(room_clash.data["has_conflict"])
        self.assertIsNone(room_clash.data["section_conflict"])
        self.assertIsNone(room_clash.data["teacher_conflict"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(room_clash.data["room_conflict"])

        # Same room on TTH (non-intersecting vs MWF) -> zero conflicts
        tth_clear = self.client.get(
            "/api/v1/school/check-conflict/",
            {
                "type": "period",
                "section_id": self.section_darwin.id,
                "subject_id": self.subj_eng.id,
                "teacher_id": self.teacher_2.id,
                "day_of_week": "TTH",
                "start_time": "07:30",
                "end_time": "08:30",
            },
        )
        self.assertEqual(tth_clear.status_code, 200)
        self.assertFalse(tth_clear.data["has_conflict"])

        # Editing p1 itself with exclude_id=p1.id -> zero conflicts
        self_edit = self.client.get(
            "/api/v1/school/check-conflict/",
            {
                "type": "period",
                "section_id": self.section_newton.id,

                "day_of_week": "MWF",
                "start_time": "07:30",
                "end_time": "08:30",
                "exclude_id": p1.id,
            },
        )
        self.assertEqual(self_edit.status_code, 200)
        self.assertFalse(self_edit.data["has_conflict"])

    def test_validate_field_and_uniqueness_checks_while_allowing_sibling_guardian_contact(self):
        existing_student = Student.objects.create(

            ("username", "CONFLICT_TEACHER1", {"exclude_user_id": self.teacher_1_user.id}),
            ("email", "MARIA.SANTOS@school.edu.ph", {"exclude_teacher_id": self.teacher_1.id}),
            ("employee_id", "emp-conf-t1", {"exclude_teacher_id": self.teacher_1.id}),
            ("contact_number", "09171001002", {"exclude_teacher_id": self.teacher_1.id}),
            ("lrn", "127901269701", {"exclude_id": existing_student.id}),
            ("subject_code", "math7", {"exclude_id": self.subj_math.id}),
            ("room_name", "room 101", {"exclude_id": self.room101.id}),
        ]
        for field_name, val, exclude_params in checks:
            taken_res = self.client.get(
                "/api/v1/accounts/validate-field/",
                {"field": field_name, "value": val},
            )
            self.assertEqual(taken_res.status_code, 200)
            self.assertTrue(taken_res.data["is_taken"], f"Expected {field_name}={val} to be taken")
            self.assertFalse(taken_res.data["available"])

            avail_res = self.client.get(
                "/api/v1/accounts/validate-field/",
                {"field": field_name, "value": val, **exclude_params},
            )
            self.assertEqual(avail_res.status_code, 200)
            self.assertFalse(avail_res.data["is_taken"], f"Expected {field_name}={val} with exclude to be available")
            self.assertTrue(avail_res.data["available"])

                "role": "TEACHER",
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(dup_phone_user.status_code, 400)

        dup_email_teacher = self.client.post(
            "/api/v1/accounts/teachers/",
            {

            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(dup_email_teacher.status_code, 400)

    def test_enrolling_student_automatically_inherits_section_periods_and_class_lists(self):

                "guardian_name": "Rosa Mendoza",

                "section_id": self.section_newton.id,

            format="json",
        )

        )

    def test_transparent_png_logo_upload_preserves_alpha_and_trims_padding(self):
        import base64
        import io
        import os
        from django.conf import settings
        from PIL import Image

        # Create a 200x120 transparent PNG with a centered 80x40 blue emblem and huge empty padding
        canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (200, 120), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        for y in range(40, 80):
            for x in range(60, 140):
                canvas.putpixel((x, y), (0, 75, 135, 255))

        buf = io.BytesIO()
        canvas.save(buf, format="PNG")
        data_url = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode("ascii")

        resp = self.client.put(
            "/api/v1/school/settings/",
            {
                "school_name": "Macasandig National High School",
                "left_logo": data_url,
                "right_logo": data_url,
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 200, resp.data)
        left_url = resp.data.get("left_logo") or ""
        self.assertTrue(left_url.endswith(".png"), f"Expected transparent PNG, got: {left_url}")

        rel_path = left_url.split("/media/", 1)[-1]
        full_path = os.path.join(settings.MEDIA_ROOT, rel_path)
        self.assertTrue(os.path.exists(full_path))

        try:
            with Image.open(full_path) as saved:
                self.assertEqual(saved.format, "PNG")
                self.assertEqual(saved.mode, "RGBA")
                # Corners remain transparent (alpha == 0), NOT turned solid black
                self.assertEqual(saved.getpixel((0, 0))[3], 0)
                # Empty transparent padding was auto-trimmed cleanly (80x40 + small margin << 200x120)
                self.assertLess(saved.size[0], 110)
                self.assertLess(saved.size[1], 70)
        finally:
            for url in (resp.data.get("left_logo"), resp.data.get("right_logo")):
                if url and "/media/" in url:
                    p = os.path.join(settings.MEDIA_ROOT, url.split("/media/", 1)[-1])
                    if os.path.exists(p):
                        os.remove(p)

WEEKEND_REST_CACHE_KEY = "school:calendar:weekend_rest_enabled"


def _wants_fresh_cache(request) -> bool:
    flag = str(request.query_params.get("nocache", "")).strip().lower()
    return flag in ("1", "true", "yes")


class PublicSchoolBrandingView(APIView):
    """Returns non-sensitive public school letterhead info for Web & Mobile Sign-In screens."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.AllowAny]

    def get(self, request):
        if _wants_fresh_cache(request):
            cache.delete(SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY)

        school = SchoolSettings.objects.select_related(
            "division_ref",
            "active_school_year",
            "campus_boundary",
            "principal_teacher",
            "principal_teacher__user",
            "principal_teacher__position",
        ).first()
        meta = get_school_metadata(request, school=school)
        sid = str(meta.get("school_id") or "").strip()

        return Response(
            {
                "school_id": sid,
                "deped_school_id": sid,
                "school_name": meta.get("school_name", ""),
                "region": meta.get("region", ""),
                "division": meta.get("division", ""),
                "district": meta.get("district", ""),
                "address": meta.get("school_address", ""),
                "contact_number": meta.get("school_contact", ""),
                "email": meta.get("school_email", ""),
                "principal_name": meta.get("principal_name", ""),
                "principal_title": meta.get("principal_title", ""),
                "school_year": meta.get("school_year", ""),
                "academic_year": meta.get("academic_year", ""),
                "school_logo": meta.get("school_logo"),
                "left_logo": meta.get("left_logo"),
                "right_logo": meta.get("right_logo"),
                "is_configured": bool(meta.get("is_configured", False)),
            }
        )


class SchoolSettingsView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsSystemAdminOrReadOnly]

    def get(self, request):
        if _wants_fresh_cache(request):
            cache.delete(SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY)

        school = SchoolSettings.objects.select_related(
            "division_ref",
            "active_school_year",
            "campus_boundary",
            "principal_teacher",
            "principal_teacher__user",
            "principal_teacher__position",
            "principal_teacher__department",
        ).first()
        if not school:
            meta = get_school_metadata(request)
            meta["deped_school_id"] = meta.get("school_id", "")
            return Response(meta)

        school = migrate_inline_logos_to_files(school)
        serialized = dict(SchoolSettingsSerializer(school, context={"request": request}).data)
        meta = get_school_metadata(request, school=school)
        merged = {**meta, **{k: v for k, v in serialized.items() if v not in (None, "")}}
        merged["deped_school_id"] = merged.get("school_id", "")
        for logo_key in ("school_logo", "left_logo", "right_logo"):
            if meta.get(logo_key):
                merged[logo_key] = meta[logo_key]
        return Response(merged)

    @transaction.atomic
    def put(self, request):
        school = SchoolSettings.objects.select_related(
            "division_ref",
            "active_school_year",
            "campus_boundary",
            "principal_teacher",
            "principal_teacher__user",
        ).first()
        raw_payload = (
            {k: request.data.get(k) for k in request.data.keys()}
            if hasattr(request.data, "keys")
            else dict(request.data)
        )
        if not raw_payload.get("school_id") and raw_payload.get("deped_school_id"):
            raw_payload["school_id"] = str(raw_payload["deped_school_id"]).strip()[:50]

        if school:
            serializer = SchoolSettingsSerializer(
                school, data=raw_payload, partial=True, context={"request": request}
            )
        else:
            if not str(raw_payload.get("school_name") or "").strip():
                return Response(
                    {"error": "School name is required."},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                )
            serializer = SchoolSettingsSerializer(data=raw_payload, context={"request": request})

        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        saved = migrate_inline_logos_to_files(serializer.save())
        cache.delete_many([SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY, "reports:system_status", "campus:active_boundary"])

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name=saved._meta.db_table,
            record_id=saved.pk,
            action="UPDATE",
            changed_fields=list(raw_payload.keys()),
        )
        return self.get(request)

    def post(self, request):
        return self.put(request)

    def patch(self, request):
        return self.put(request)

    def delete(self, request):
        school = SchoolSettings.objects.first()
        field = str(request.query_params.get("field") or request.data.get("field") or "").strip()
        if school and field in ("school_logo", "left_logo", "right_logo"):
            setattr(school, field, None)
            school.save(update_fields=[field, "updated_at"])
            cache.delete_many([SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY, "reports:system_status"])
            record_audit_log(
                request=request,
                table_name=school._meta.db_table,
                record_id=school.pk,
                action="DELETE",
                changed_fields=[field],
            )
            return self.get(request)
        return Response(
            {"error": "Specify school_logo, left_logo, or right_logo."},
            status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
        )


class SchoolHolidayViewSet(AuditedModelViewSet):
    queryset = SchoolHoliday.objects.order_by("holiday_date")
    serializer_class = SchoolHolidaySerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsSystemAdminOrReadOnly]

    def _get_weekend_rest(self) -> bool:
        cached = cache.get(WEEKEND_REST_CACHE_KEY)
        if cached is not None:
            return bool(cached)
        school = SchoolSettings.objects.only("weekend_rest_enabled").first()
        val = bool(school.weekend_rest_enabled) if school else True
        cache.set(WEEKEND_REST_CACHE_KEY, val, timeout=300)
        return val

    def list(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        response = super().list(request, *args, **kwargs)
        if isinstance(response.data, dict):
            response.data["weekend_rest_enabled"] = self._get_weekend_rest()
            if "results" in response.data and "exceptions" not in response.data:
                response.data["exceptions"] = response.data["results"]
        return response

    def patch(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        if "pk" not in kwargs:
            return self.partial_update_settings(request)
        return super().partial_update(request, *args, **kwargs)

    def partial_update_settings(self, request):
        if not is_system_admin(request.user):
            return Response(
                {"error": "System administrator access required."},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )
        val = request.data.get("weekend_rest_enabled")
        if val is not None:
            enabled = (
                bool(val)
                if isinstance(val, bool)
                else str(val).strip().lower() in ("true", "1", "yes")
            )
            SchoolSettings.objects.all().update(weekend_rest_enabled=enabled)
            cache.set(WEEKEND_REST_CACHE_KEY, enabled, timeout=300)
            cache.delete(SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY)
            record_audit_log(
                request=request,
                table_name=SchoolHoliday._meta.db_table,
                record_id=0,
                action="UPDATE",
                new_data={"weekend_rest_enabled": enabled},
            )
            return Response({"ok": True, "weekend_rest_enabled": enabled})
        return Response({"ok": True, "weekend_rest_enabled": self._get_weekend_rest()})

def _parse_optional_int(raw) -> int | None:
    text = str(raw or "").strip()
    return int(text) if (text and text.isascii() and text.isdigit()) else None


class AcademicConflictCheckView(APIView):
    """
    Live conflict preview endpoint for sections, advisers, rooms, and class schedules.
    GET /api/v1/school/check-conflict/?type=section|period&...
    """

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsTeacherOrLeader]

    def get(self, request):
        mode = str(request.query_params.get("type") or "period").strip().lower()
        exclude_id = _parse_optional_int(request.query_params.get("exclude_id"))

        if mode == "section":
            sy_id = _parse_optional_int(request.query_params.get("school_year"))
            school_year = SchoolYear.objects.filter(id=sy_id).first() if sy_id else None
            grade_level_id = _parse_optional_int(
                request.query_params.get("grade_level") or request.query_params.get("grade_level_id")
            )
            name = str(request.query_params.get("name") or "").strip()[:100]
            room_name = str(
                request.query_params.get("room_name") or request.query_params.get("room_number") or ""
            ).strip()[:100]
            adviser_id = _parse_optional_int(
                request.query_params.get("adviser_id") or request.query_params.get("adviser")
            )
            adviser = (
                TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("user").filter(id=adviser_id).first()
                if adviser_id
                else None
            )
            result = check_section_conflicts(
                school_year=school_year,
                grade_level_id=grade_level_id,
                name=name,
                adviser=adviser,
                room_name=room_name,
                exclude_id=exclude_id,
            )
            return Response(result, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

        if mode == "period":
            section_id = _parse_optional_int(
                request.query_params.get("section_id") or request.query_params.get("section")
            )
            teacher_id = _parse_optional_int(
                request.query_params.get("teacher_id") or request.query_params.get("teacher")
            )
            section = (
                Section.objects.select_related("grade_level", "school_year").filter(id=section_id).first()
                if section_id
                else None
            )
            teacher = (
                TeacherProfile.objects.select_related("user").filter(id=teacher_id).first()
                if teacher_id
                else None
            )
            raw_dow = request.query_params.get("day_of_week") or request.query_params.get("days_of_week") or "ALL_WEEKDAYS"
            day_of_week = normalize_day_of_week(raw_dow)
            start_time = parse_schedule_time(request.query_params.get("start_time"))
            end_time = parse_schedule_time(request.query_params.get("end_time"))

            result = check_class_period_conflicts(
                section=section,
                teacher=teacher,
                day_of_week=day_of_week,
                start_time=start_time,
                end_time=end_time,
                exclude_id=exclude_id,
            )
            return Response(result, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

        return Response(
            {"error": "Supported check types are 'section' and 'period'."},
            status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
        )

    ("TRANSFERRED_OUT", "Transferred Out"),

class Student(models.Model):
    """
    Strict 3NF Student entity:
    - Never stores section or grade_level directly (managed exclusively via Enrollment).
    - Never stores user accounts for guardians; guardian_name & guardian_contact are plain text for DepEd SF1.
    """

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    lrn = models.CharField(max_length=12, unique=True, db_index=True)
    first_name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    middle_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    last_name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    suffix = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True, default="")
    gender = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=GENDER_CHOICES)
    birth_date = models.DateField()

    mother_tongue = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    ethnic_group = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    religion = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    house_street_sitio = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, default="")
    location = models.ForeignKey(
        AddressLocation,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="students",
    )

    father_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, default="")
    mother_maiden_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, default="")
    guardian_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, default="")
    guardian_relationship = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default="")
    guardian_contact = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default="")

    photo = models.ImageField(upload_to="students/", null=True, blank=True)
    qr_token = models.CharField(max_length=128, unique=True, db_index=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True, db_index=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "students"
        ordering = ["last_name", "first_name"]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["is_active", "last_name", "first_name"], name="idx_stu_active_name"),
        ]

    @property
    def sex(self) -> str:
        return self.gender

    @sex.setter
    def sex(self, value: str) -> None:
        self.gender = value

    @property
    def birthdate(self):
        return self.birth_date

    @birthdate.setter
    def birthdate(self, value) -> None:
        self.birth_date = value

    @property
    def barangay(self) -> str:
        return self.location.barangay if (self.location_id and self.location) else ""

    @property
    def municipality_city(self) -> str:
        return self.location.municipality_city if (self.location_id and self.location) else ""

    @property
    def province(self) -> str:
        return self.location.province if (self.location_id and self.location) else ""

    def set_address_location(self, barangay: str = "", municipality_city: str = "", province: str = "") -> None:
        b = str(barangay or "").strip()[:100]
        m = str(municipality_city or "").strip()[:100]
        p = str(province or "").strip()[:100]
        if b or m or p:
            loc, _ = AddressLocation.objects.get_or_create(
                barangay=b, municipality_city=m, province=p
            )
            self.location = loc
        else:
            self.location = None

    @property
    def full_name(self) -> str:
        mid = f" {self.middle_name[:1]}." if self.middle_name else ""
        suf = f" {self.suffix}" if self.suffix else ""
        return f"{self.last_name}, {self.first_name}{mid}{suf}".strip()

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.guardian_contact:
            self.guardian_contact = normalize_ph_phone(self.guardian_contact)[:50]
        if not self.qr_token:
            self.qr_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.full_name} ({self.lrn})"


class Enrollment(models.Model):
    """
    Strict 3NF Enrollment:
    - Never stores school_year or grade_level (uniquely determined via Enrollment -> Section).
    """

    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    student = models.ForeignKey(Student, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="enrollments")
    section = models.ForeignKey("school.Section", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="enrollments")
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=ENROLLMENT_STATUS_CHOICES, default="ENROLLED", db_index=True)
    enrolled_date = models.DateField(default=timezone.localdate)
    enrollment_type = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=ENROLLMENT_TYPE_CHOICES, default="REGULAR")
    status_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    status_reason_code = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default="")
    transferred_school = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, default="")
    is_cct_recipient = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    cct_id_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default="")
    remarks = models.TextField(blank=True, default="")
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "enrollments"
        constraints = [
            UniqueConstraint(fields=["student", "section"], name="uq_enrollment_student_section")
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["section", "status"], name="idx_enr_section_status"),
            models.Index(fields=["student", "status"], name="idx_enr_student_status"),
        ]

    @property
    def school_year(self):
        return self.section.school_year if (self.section_id and self.section) else None

    @property
    def grade_level(self):
        return self.section.grade_level if (self.section_id and self.section) else None

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if isinstance(self.enrolled_date, datetime):
            self.enrolled_date = (
                timezone.localtime(self.enrolled_date).date()
                if timezone.is_aware(self.enrolled_date)
                else self.enrolled_date.date()
            )
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.student_id} -> {self.section_id} ({self.status})"

from django.db.models import Count, Prefetch, Q

from apps.accounts.selectors import (
    get_teacher_section_ids,
    get_teacher_student_ids,
    resolve_teacher_for_user,
)
from apps.school.selectors import format_section_label
from common.media import build_media_url
from common.permissions import is_school_leader
from common.qr_signer import sign_student_qr
from .models import Enrollment, Student


def get_students_for_user(*, user, search: str = "", section_id: int | None = None):
    active_enrollments = Prefetch(
        "enrollments",
        queryset=Enrollment.objects.select_related(
            "section",
            "section__grade_level",
            "section__school_year",
        )
        .annotate(
            active_periods_count=Count(
                "section__class_periods",
                filter=Q(section__class_periods__is_active=True),
                distinct=True,
            )
        )
        .order_by("-section__school_year__is_active", "-id"),
    )

    qs = (
        Student.objects.select_related("location")
        .prefetch_related(active_enrollments)
        .order_by("last_name", "first_name")
    )

    if search:
        qs = qs.filter(
            Q(lrn__icontains=search)
            | Q(first_name__icontains=search)
            | Q(last_name__icontains=search)
        )
    if section_id:
        qs = qs.filter(enrollments__section_id=section_id, enrollments__status="ENROLLED")
    if not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        if not teacher or not teacher.can_handle_classes:
            return qs.none()
        qs = qs.filter(id__in=get_teacher_student_ids(teacher))
    return qs.distinct()


def get_enrollments_for_user(*, user, section_id: int | None = None):
    qs = Enrollment.objects.select_related(
        "student",
        "section",
        "section__grade_level",
        "section__school_year",
    ).order_by("-id")
    if section_id:
        qs = qs.filter(section_id=section_id)
    if not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        qs = qs.filter(section_id__in=get_teacher_section_ids(teacher)) if teacher else qs.none()
    return qs


def get_signed_qr_cards(*, user=None, section_id: int | None = None, request=None) -> list[dict]:
    enr_qs = Enrollment.objects.filter(status="ENROLLED", student__is_active=True).select_related(
        "student", "section", "section__grade_level"
    )
    if user and not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        enr_qs = enr_qs.filter(section_id__in=get_teacher_section_ids(teacher)) if teacher else enr_qs.none()
    if section_id:
        enr_qs = enr_qs.filter(section_id=section_id)

    cards = []
    for enr in enr_qs.order_by(
        "section__grade_level__level_number", "section__name", "student__last_name"
    )[:500]:
        st = enr.student
        sec = enr.section
        cards.append(
            {
                "id": st.id,
                "student_id": st.id,
                "enrollment_id": enr.id,
                "lrn": st.lrn,
                "full_name": st.full_name,
                "gender": st.gender,
                "sex": st.gender,
                "section_id": sec.id if sec else None,
                "section_name": sec.name if sec else "",
                "grade_level": sec.grade_level.name if (sec and sec.grade_level) else "",
                "section_label": format_section_label(
                    sec.grade_level.name if (sec and sec.grade_level) else "",
                    sec.name if sec else "",
                ),
                "photo_url": build_media_url(st.photo, request),
                "guardian_contact": st.guardian_contact,
                "qr_token": st.qr_token,
                "qr_payload": sign_student_qr(st.lrn, st.qr_token),
            }
        )
    return cards

class StudentSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    full_name = serializers.CharField(read_only=True)
    sex = serializers.CharField(source="gender", required=False)
    birthdate = serializers.DateField(source="birth_date", required=False)

        choices=["ENROLLED", "TRANSFERRED_IN", "TRANSFERRED_OUT", "DROPPED"],
        required=False,
        write_only=True,
    )

    current_section_id = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    current_enrollment_id = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    grade_level_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    section_display_label = serializers.SerializerMethodField()

            "section_display_label",
            "scheduled_subjects_count",
            "section_id",
            "enrollment_status",
        ]
        read_only_fields = ["id", "qr_token"]
        extra_kwargs = {
            "lrn": {"validators": []},
            "gender": {"required": False},
            "birth_date": {"required": False},
        }

    def to_internal_value(self, data):
        mutable = {k: data.get(k) for k in data.keys()} if hasattr(data, "keys") else dict(data)
        raw_gender = mutable.get("gender") if "gender" in mutable else mutable.get("sex")
        if raw_gender is not None:
            g_upper = str(raw_gender).strip().upper()
            normalized_g = "Female" if g_upper in ("F", "FEMALE") else "Male"
            mutable["gender"] = normalized_g
            mutable.pop("sex", None)

        if "birth_date" not in mutable and "birthdate" in mutable:
            mutable["birth_date"] = mutable.pop("birthdate")
        else:
            mutable.pop("birthdate", None)

        if "enrollment_status" in mutable:
            raw_es = str(mutable["enrollment_status"] or "").strip().upper()
            if not raw_es or raw_es in ("NONE", "NULL", "UNASSIGNED"):
                mutable.pop("enrollment_status", None)
            else:
                mutable["enrollment_status"] = raw_es

        for field_name in (
            "first_name",
            "middle_name",
            "last_name",
            "suffix",
            "mother_tongue",
            "ethnic_group",
            "religion",
            "house_street_sitio",
            "father_name",
            "mother_maiden_name",
            "guardian_name",
            "guardian_relationship",
            "guardian_contact",
            "barangay",
            "municipality_city",
            "province",
        ):
            if field_name in mutable and isinstance(mutable[field_name], str):
                mutable[field_name] = _clean_text(mutable[field_name], 200)

        if "lrn" in mutable and mutable["lrn"] is not None:
            mutable["lrn"] = re.sub(r"\D+", "", str(mutable["lrn"]))[:12]

        return super().to_internal_value(mutable)

    def validate_lrn(self, value: str) -> str:
        digits = re.sub(r"\D+", "", str(value or ""))
        if len(digits) != 12:
            raise serializers.ValidationError("LRN must be exactly 12 digits.")
        qs = Student.objects.filter(lrn=digits)
        if self.instance:
            qs = qs.exclude(pk=self.instance.pk)
        if qs.exists():
            raise serializers.ValidationError("This 12-digit LRN is already registered to another student.")
        return digits

    def validate_guardian_contact(self, value: str) -> str:
        # Siblings may share the same parent/guardian mobile number; normalize format only.
        return normalize_ph_phone(value)[:50] if value else ""

    def validate_section_id(self, value):
        if value is not None and not Section.objects.filter(id=value).exists():
            raise serializers.ValidationError("Selected section does not exist.")
        return value

    def validate(self, attrs):
        if not self.instance:
            if not attrs.get("gender"):
                attrs["gender"] = "Male"
            if not attrs.get("birth_date"):
                raise serializers.ValidationError({"birth_date": "Birth date is required."})
        return attrs

    def get_photo_url(self, obj):
        return build_media_url(obj.photo, self.context.get("request"))

    def get_qr_payload(self, obj) -> str:
        return sign_student_qr(obj.lrn, obj.qr_token)

    def _active_enrollment(self, obj):
        fallback = None
        for enr in obj.enrollments.all():
            if enr.section:
                if enr.section.school_year and enr.section.school_year.is_active:
                    return enr
                fallback = fallback or enr
        return fallback

    def get_current_section(self, obj) -> str:
        enr = self._active_enrollment(obj)
        return enr.section.name if (enr and enr.section) else "Unassigned"

    def get_current_section_id(self, obj) -> int | None:
        enr = self._active_enrollment(obj)
        return enr.section_id if enr else None

    def get_current_enrollment_id(self, obj) -> int | None:
        enr = self._active_enrollment(obj)
        return enr.id if enr else None

    def get_grade_level_name(self, obj) -> str:
        enr = self._active_enrollment(obj)
        return enr.section.grade_level.name if (enr and enr.section and enr.section.grade_level) else ""

    def get_section_display_label(self, obj) -> str:
        enr = self._active_enrollment(obj)
        if enr and enr.section:
            return format_section_label(
                enr.section.grade_level.name if enr.section.grade_level else "",
                enr.section.name,
            )
        return "Unassigned"

    def get_scheduled_subjects_count(self, obj) -> int:
        enr = self._active_enrollment(obj)
        if not enr or not enr.section_id:
            return 0
        annotated = getattr(enr, "active_periods_count", None)
        if annotated is not None:
            return int(annotated)
        return ClassPeriod.objects.filter(section_id=enr.section_id, is_active=True).count()

    def to_representation(self, instance):
        data = super().to_representation(instance)
        enr = self._active_enrollment(instance)
        data["enrollment_status"] = enr.status if enr else "UNASSIGNED"
        return data

    @transaction.atomic
    def create(self, validated_data):
        section_id = validated_data.pop("section_id", None)
        enrollment_status = validated_data.pop("enrollment_status", None)
        validated_data.pop("remove_photo", None)
        barangay = validated_data.pop("barangay", "")
        city = validated_data.pop("municipality_city", "")
        province = validated_data.pop("province", "")

        student = Student(**validated_data)
        student.set_address_location(barangay=barangay, municipality_city=city, province=province)
        student.save()
        sync_student_enrollment(
            student=student,
            section_id=section_id,
            enrollment_status=enrollment_status,
        )
        return student

    @transaction.atomic
    def update(self, instance, validated_data):
        section_id = validated_data.pop("section_id", None)
        enrollment_status = validated_data.pop("enrollment_status", None)
        remove_photo = bool(validated_data.pop("remove_photo", False))
        if remove_photo:
            validated_data["photo"] = None

        has_loc_change = any(k in validated_data for k in ("barangay", "municipality_city", "province"))
        barangay = validated_data.pop("barangay", instance.barangay)
        city = validated_data.pop("municipality_city", instance.municipality_city)
        province = validated_data.pop("province", instance.province)

        for attr, val in validated_data.items():
            setattr(instance, attr, val)
        if has_loc_change:
            instance.set_address_location(barangay=barangay, municipality_city=city, province=province)
        instance.save()
        sync_student_enrollment(
            student=instance,
            section_id=section_id,
            enrollment_status=enrollment_status,
        )
        return instance


class EnrollmentSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    student_name = serializers.CharField(source="student.full_name", read_only=True)
    lrn = serializers.CharField(source="student.lrn", read_only=True)
    section_name = serializers.CharField(source="section.name", read_only=True)
    grade_level_name = serializers.CharField(source="section.grade_level.name", read_only=True)
    school_year = serializers.PrimaryKeyRelatedField(source="section.school_year", read_only=True)
    school_year_name = serializers.CharField(source="section.school_year.name", read_only=True)
    enrollment_date = serializers.DateField(source="enrolled_date", required=False)

    class Meta:
        model = Enrollment
        fields = [
            "id",
            "student",
            "student_name",
            "lrn",
            "section",
            "section_name",
            "grade_level_name",
            "school_year",
            "school_year_name",
            "enrolled_date",
            "enrollment_date",
            "status",
            "status_date",
            "remarks",
        ]
        extra_kwargs = {"enrolled_date": {"required": False}}
        validators = []

    def validate(self, attrs):
        student = attrs.get("student") or (self.instance.student if self.instance else None)
        section = attrs.get("section") or (self.instance.section if self.instance else None)
        if student and section:
            dup = Enrollment.objects.filter(student=student, section__school_year=section.school_year)
            if self.instance:
                dup = dup.exclude(pk=self.instance.pk)
            if dup.exists():
                raise serializers.ValidationError(
                    {"student": "This student is already enrolled for the selected school year."}
                )

        if not self.instance and not attrs.get("enrolled_date"):
            attrs["enrolled_date"] = timezone.localdate()
        return attrs
