# AttendSure v3 — Architecture, 3NF Data Model & Security Guide

This document describes the live engineering architecture, strict Third Normal Form (3NF) database design, 5-role staff access model, anti-spoofing defenses, and privacy controls implemented in `AttendSure_V3`.

---

## 1. High-Level System Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Clients["Pure-Software School Clients"]
        Web["React 19 + Vite 8 Web Portal\n(Webcam QR Scanner, Class Lists, DepEd Forms, SARDO & Roll-Call)"]
        Mobile["Expo (SDK 58) React Native App\n(Phone Camera QR, On-Device Lock + GPS Check-In, 45s Duty Pings)"]
    end

    subgraph Edge["Zero-Downtime Edge Layer"]
        Nginx["Nginx Reverse Proxy\n(Blue/Green Upstream + Static/Media + Security Headers)"]
    end

    subgraph Core["Django 6 + DRF Application Tier"]
        Blue["Gunicorn Web Blue (:8001)"]
        Green["Gunicorn Web Green (:8002)"]
        Celery["Celery Worker & Beat\n(Scheduled Cutting-Class & Exit-Pass Audits Every 15 Min)"]
    end

    subgraph Data["Data & Cache Layer"]
        PG[("PostgreSQL 16 / SQLite Dev\n(Strict 3NF Tables + AuditLog)")]
        Redis[("Redis 7\n(Cache, Rate-Limit & Celery Broker)")]
    end

    Web -->|HTTPS + JWT / Token| Nginx
    Mobile -->|HTTPS + Offline Queue Sync| Nginx
    Nginx --> Blue
    Nginx -.->|Zero-Downtime Switch| Green
    Blue --> PG
    Blue --> Redis
    Green --> PG
    Green --> Redis
    Redis --> Celery
    Celery --> PG
```

### Backend Modular Layout (6 Apps + Shared Helpers)

| Module | Path | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| **Accounts** | `backend/apps/accounts/` | Staff login/logout, JWT + DRF token auth, 5-strike account lockout, `Department`, `PositionTitle`, `TeacherProfile`, `UserProfile`, `AuditLog`, and environment-gated demo preview login. |
| **School** | `backend/apps/school/` | `SchoolYear`, `AdministrativeDivision`, `SchoolSettings`, `SchoolHoliday`, `Building`, `Room`, `GradeLevel`, `Subject`, `Section`, `ClassPeriod`, shared weekday schedule helpers (`expand_schedule_days`, `period_runs_on_weekday`), and `seed_competition_demo`. |
| **Students** | `backend/apps/students/` | `AddressLocation`, `Student`, `Enrollment`, student directory filtering, CSV bulk import, and signed QR ID card generation. |
| **Attendance** | `backend/apps/attendance/` | Built-in camera QR scanning (`POST /api/v1/attendance/scan/`), batch offline queue sync (`POST /api/v1/attendance/offline-sync/`), manual class list edits, weekday-filtered adviser matrix, weekday-filtered cutting-class detector, and student/teacher exit passes. |
| **Campus** | `backend/apps/campus/` | `CampusBoundary`, teacher check-in/out (`POST /api/v1/campus/check-in/`), live 45-second GPS pings (`POST /api/v1/campus/ping/`), `LoafingIncident` alerts & resolution, `MonthlyTimeRecord` (DTR), Celery beat audit task, and 1-Click Emergency Roll-Call (`GET /api/v1/campus/roll-call/`). |
| **Reports** | `backend/apps/reports/` | Dashboard metrics, print-ready DepEd **SF1**, **SF2**, **SF4**, **CSC Form 48 (DTR)** submission & approval, **30-Day SARDO Risk**, campus safety summary, and **DepEd Division Data Export** (`JSON` / `CSV`). |
| **Common** | `backend/common/` | `permissions.py`, `qr_signer.py`, `gps.py`, `audit.py`, `media.py`, `phone.py`, `pagination.py`, `exceptions.py`, `security.py`, `request_logger.py`, and `fields.py`. |

## 2. Strict 3NF Database Design

Every model avoids duplicate text columns and stale derived fields, verified automatically by `Strict3NFDatabaseIntegrityTests` in `backend/apps/accounts/tests.py`:

| Table / Model | 3NF Rule Enforced | Dynamic / Derived Values |
|---|---|---|
| `TeacherProfile` (`teacher_profiles`) | Stores only teacher-specific fields (`employee_id`, `middle_name`, `suffix`, `contact_number`, `can_handle_classes`, `bound_device_id`, `biometric_key_id`) plus normalized FKs to `auth.User`, `Department`, and `PositionTitle`. Never duplicates `first_name`, `last_name`, `email`, or `is_active`, and stores zero raw face photos or biometric templates. | `first_name`, `last_name`, `email`, `full_name`, `is_active`, `department_name`, `position_title` read from joined rows. |
| `UserProfile` (`user_profiles`) | Stores only `role`, `failed_login_attempts`, and `locked_until` linked 1-to-1 to `auth.User`. | `is_locked()`, `is_profile_completed`. |
| `AddressLocation` (`address_locations`) | Normalized lookup table with `UniqueConstraint(barangay, municipality_city, province)` shared across students. | Referenced by `Student.location`. |
| `Student` (`students`) | Stores learner identity (`lrn`, name, `gender`, `birth_date`, `qr_token`), `AddressLocation` FK, and plain-text guardian details for DepEd SF1. Never stores `section` or `grade_level` directly. | `full_name`, `barangay`, `municipality_city`, `province`. |
| `Enrollment` (`enrollments`) | Links `Student` and `Section` with `UniqueConstraint(student, section)`. Never duplicates `school_year` or `grade_level`. | `school_year` and `grade_level` derived from `section`. |
| `ClassPeriod` (`class_periods`) | Links `Section`, `Subject`, and `TeacherProfile` with atomic `day_of_week` (`ALL_WEEKDAYS`, `MWF`, `TTH`, `"1"`–`"7"`), `start_time`, and `end_time`. Never duplicates `school_year` or `grade_level`. | `expand_schedule_days()` and `period_runs_on_weekday()` compute active ISO weekdays (`1`–`7`). |
| `DailyAttendance` (`daily_attendance`) | Links `Enrollment` + `attendance_date` uniquely (`uq_daily_att_enrollment_date`). Zero redundant student, section, or school year columns. | Student, section, and school year resolved through `enrollment`. |
| `ClassAttendance` (`class_attendance`) | Links `Enrollment` + `ClassPeriod` + `attendance_date` uniquely (`uq_class_att_enrollment_period_date`), plus unique `client_scan_uuid` to prevent duplicate offline sync entries. | Student, section, and subject resolved through `enrollment` and `class_period`. |
| `TeacherLocationPing` (`teacher_location_pings`) | Stores raw `latitude`, `longitude`, `accuracy_meters`, `zone_status`, and `recorded_at` linked to `TeacherProfile` and `CampusBoundary`. Never stores derived `distance_meters` or `is_inside` columns. | `distance_meters` and `is_inside` computed dynamically via Haversine distance against `boundary`. |
| `ExitPass` (`exit_passes`) | Enforces database-level `CheckConstraint` (`ck_exitpass_xor_bearer`): every pass must link to **either** a `STUDENT` `enrollment` **or** a `TEACHER`, never both and never neither. Never stores a stale `status` column. | `pass_status` (`ACTIVE`, `RETURNED`, `OVERDUE`, `CANCELLED`) and `is_currently_valid` computed live against current server time. |
| `LoafingIncident` (`loafing_incidents`) | Links to `TeacherProfile`, `Enrollment`, `ClassPeriod`, `ExitPass`, and `TeacherLocationPing`. Never stores copied names, codes, or distances. | `incident_date` and `distance_meters` computed from linked rows. |
| `MonthlyTimeRecord` (`monthly_time_records`) | Unique per `(teacher, month, year)` tracking CSC Form 48 teacher submission (`is_submitted`, `submitted_at`) and Department Head approval (`is_dept_head_approved`, `approved_by`, `dept_head_approved_at`). | Daily time logs joined dynamically from `TeacherDailyAttendance`. |

## 3. Synchronized 5-Role Staff Access Model

Access rules are enforced on the server in `backend/common/permissions.py` and mirrored on both clients (`web/src/utils/permissions.ts` and `mobile/src/utils/permissions.ts`). Gate 3 of `scripts/audit_codebase.py` executes 184 automated checks across all five profiles to guarantee they never drift out of sync.

| Capability | `ADMIN` | `PRINCIPAL` | `DEPT_HEAD` | Teaching `TEACHER` (`can_handle_classes=True`) | Non-Teaching `TEACHER` (`can_handle_classes=False`) |
|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| Dashboard & Own Campus GPS / DTR | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Built-In Camera Student QR Scanner | Yes | Yes | Yes | Assigned Classes | No |
| Class Lists, Adviser Matrix & SF1/SF2 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Assigned Classes | No |
| Add / Edit Students | All Sections | All Sections | Read-Only | Own Advised Section Only | No |
| Delete / Bulk CSV Import Students | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Issue Student Exit Passes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Request Own Official Locator Slip | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Approve / Cancel Teacher Locator Slips | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Resolve Loafing / Cutting Alerts | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| View Teacher Directory & DepEd SF4 | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Edit Campus GPS Boundary & Reset Bound Phone | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| View System Audit Logs | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Academic Setup Tab | Full CRUD | View-Only | No | No | No |
| Manage Staff User Accounts & Teacher Directory CRUD | Yes | No | No | No | No |

Only school staff accounts exist in AttendSure (`ADMIN`, `PRINCIPAL`, `DEPT_HEAD`, `TEACHER`). Attempts to create disallowed external roles are rejected with `HTTP 400`.

## 4. Built-In Camera, On-Device Lock & Anti-Spoofing Controls

| Security Risk | Implemented Defense | Code Reference |
|---|---|---|
| **Forged or Unsigned Student QR IDs** | Student QR codes carry an HMAC-SHA256 signature tied to `SECRET_KEY` (`ATTENDSURE:<lrn>|<qr_token>:<sig>`). Raw LRNs, unsigned tokens, and tampered strings are rejected. | `backend/common/qr_signer.py` |
| **Proxy Teacher Clock-In (Buddy Punching)** | Each teacher's phone generates a 1-to-1 device ID stored in `expo-secure-store` (`TeacherProfile.bound_device_id`) plus an on-device check-in secret whose public SHA-256 digest is enrolled on first check-in (`TeacherProfile.biometric_key_id`). Both `bound_device_id` and `biometric_key_id` are verified with `hmac.compare_digest` on every check-in, and duplicate phone bindings are blocked with `HTTP 403`. Only `ADMIN` or `PRINCIPAL` can reset a bound phone. | `mobile/src/services/deviceService.ts`, `mobile/src/services/biometricService.ts`, `backend/apps/campus/services.py` |
| **Biometric Privacy Exposure** | Teacher identity verification runs strictly on the phone via `expo-local-authentication` (Face Unlock, Fingerprint, or PIN/Pattern fallback). Zero raw face photos, fingerprints, or passcodes ever leave the phone or reach the server. | `mobile/src/services/biometricService.ts`, `backend/apps/accounts/models.py` |
| **Fake GPS, Teleportation & Weak Signals** | Mobile blocks `loc.mocked` and accuracy > 250 m before sending. Server independently rejects `is_mock_location=True`, non-finite or `(0, 0)` coordinates, accuracy > 250 m, and implausible travel speed (> 55 m/s), using clamped Haversine math with a max 35 m GPS drift allowance. | `backend/common/gps.py`, `backend/apps/campus/services.py`, `mobile/src/services/telemetryService.ts` |
| **Cross-Section Data Access (IDOR)** | Teachers can only scan, view, edit, or print SF1/SF2 for sections they teach or advise; cross-section attempts return `HTTP 403`. | `backend/apps/accounts/selectors.py`, `backend/apps/attendance/views.py`, `backend/apps/reports/views.py` |
| **Password Brute-Force & Token Reuse** | Login endpoints enforce `10/minute` throttling plus a 5-failed-attempt lockout for 15 minutes (recorded in `AuditLog`). Password changes require the current password and immediately rotate/revoke active API tokens. | `backend/apps/accounts/models.py`, `backend/apps/accounts/services.py` |
| **Malicious File Uploads** | `FlexibleImageField` checks image magic bytes and dimensions via Pillow and enforces a 2 MB file upload limit (`FILE_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE`). | `backend/common/media.py`, `backend/config/settings.py` |
| **Map & CSV Injection** | Dynamic teacher/campus strings are HTML-escaped before Leaflet map popup rendering, and exported CSV cells are escaped via `_safe_csv_cell()`. | `web/src/components/tabs/GeofenceTab.tsx`, `backend/apps/reports/views.py` |
| **Production Preview Endpoint Lock** | `/api/v1/accounts/demo-login/` returns `HTTP 404` whenever `DEBUG=False` and `ENABLE_JUDGE_DEMO=False`. | `backend/apps/accounts/views.py`, `backend/config/settings.py` |

---

## 5. Philippine Privacy & DepEd Compliance

- **Republic Act 10173 (Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012):**
  - Strict role-based isolation ensures staff only see records needed for their assigned duties.
  - Zero raw student or teacher biometric templates are collected on the server; students carry passive QR ID cards containing signed opaque tokens rather than exposed personal addresses or contact details.
  - Optional personal ID masking (`?anonymize=1`) is built into **DepEd Division Data Export** (`/api/v1/reports/division-export/`) to protect learner and teacher names when sharing summary data.
  - Every login, lockout, export, record edit, bound-device reset, and loafing resolution writes an accountability record to `AuditLog` with user ID, changed fields, and client IP.
  - Production deployments support strict HTTPS (`ENABLE_HTTPS_STRICT=True` enables HSTS, secure cookies, and SSL redirect), `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, and non-root Docker containers.
- **DepEd Official School Forms & Civil Service Reporting:**
  - **SF1** (School Register), **SF2** (Daily Attendance Report of Learners), **SF4** (Monthly Learner Movement & Attendance), and **CSC Form 48 (DTR)** with submission/approval tracking and print-ready layouts.

---

## 6. Offline Sync, Scheduled Audits & Zero-Downtime Deployment

- **Web Offline QR Queue (`web/src/components/scanner/ClassroomScanner.tsx`):** Queues scanned QR payloads in `localStorage` (`attendsure_offline_qr_queue`) with a unique `client_scan_uuid` when offline and uploads batches via `POST /api/v1/attendance/offline-sync/` when connectivity returns.
- **Mobile Offline Queue (`mobile/src/services/offlineQueue.ts`):** Stores offline student QR scans (`attendsure_offline_qr_scans`) and campus GPS pings (`attendsure_offline_queue`) in `AsyncStorage`. Discards stale GPS pings older than 24 hours, drops permanent `400`/`403`/`404`/`409` responses, pauses on `401`, and retries transient network errors up to 8 times.
- **Weekday-Aware Student Cutting Engine:** `detect_daily_student_cutting` (also exported as `detect_daily_student_loafing`, triggered on demand or every 15 minutes via Celery Beat) evaluates only active `ClassPeriod` rows scheduled on `audit_date.isoweekday()` and skips student cutting alerts cleanly on days with fewer than 2 scheduled periods for a section. Teacher loafing alerts are evaluated separately from live campus GPS boundary pings.
- **Blue-Green Deployment (`docker-compose.yml`, `deploy/switch.sh`, `deploy/switch.ps1`):** Builds and starts the idle upstream (`web_blue:8001` or `web_green:8002`), runs `migrate --noinput` and `collectstatic --noinput`, confirms `HTTP 200` on `/api/health/db/`, swaps `deploy/nginx.conf`, and reloads Nginx without dropping active classroom scans.

# AttendSure v3 — School Rollout & Presentation Pack

A practical, plain-English presentation blueprint and live demonstration guide built around the real features running in `AttendSure_V3`.

---

## 10-Slide Presentation Outline

### Slide 1 — Title & Promise
- **Name:** AttendSure v3 — *Pure-Software School Attendance, Campus Safety & SARDO Early-Warning*
- **Tagline:** Every Teacher On Duty. Every Student Accounted For. Zero Extra Devices Required.
- **Built & Working Today:** Full-stack Django 6 + React 19 + Expo React Native platform tailored for DepEd school operations.

### Slide 2 — The Real Everyday Problem in Schools
- **Paper Logbooks Hide Cutting Classes:** When attendance lives in separate paper notebooks, an adviser may not learn until days later that a student attended first period and skipped afternoon classes.
- **Late Support for At-Risk Students (SARDO):** Without live 30-day absence and cutting tracking, schools notice chronic absenteeism only when a learner is already close to dropping out.
- **Heavy Monthly Paperwork:** Teachers and advisers spend hours every month tallying DepEd **SF1**, **SF2**, **SF4**, and **CSC Form 48 (DTR)** sheets by hand.
- **Slow Emergency Headcounts:** During earthquakes, typhoons, or campus drills, searching through paper binders delays confirming who is safely accounted for.

### Slide 3 — The Pure-Software Solution
- **Built-In Camera Student QR Scanning:** Teachers scan cryptographically signed student QR ID cards using the built-in webcam on their laptop/PC (`jsqr`) or the back camera on their phone (`expo-camera`). Works offline with automatic local queue sync when Wi-Fi returns.
- **Phone Lock + Campus GPS Teacher Check-In:** Teachers clock in and out inside the AttendSure mobile app using their phone's built-in face unlock, fingerprint, or PIN lock — paired with 1-to-1 phone binding and campus GPS boundary checks. Zero raw face photos are ever stored on the server.
- **Automated Weekday-Aware Monitoring:** Flags students who miss a scheduled later class on that weekday without an active Exit Pass, and tracks outside-campus teacher movement unless covered by an approved Official Locator Slip.
- **Official DepEd Reports & Safety Tools:** Generates print-ready **SF1**, **SF2**, **SF4**, **CSC Form 48 (DTR)**, **30-Day SARDO Risk** lists, and **1-Click Emergency Roll-Call**.

### Slide 4 — Why Schools Can Adopt It Immediately
- **Zero Extra Equipment Budget:** No special devices to buy, install, wire, or repair — schools use the laptops, webcams, and smartphones staff already carry every day.
- **Built for Campus Wi-Fi Gaps:** Both the web webcam scanner and the mobile app store scans locally when offline and upload them cleanly once reconnected.
- **Clear Roles for Every Staff Member:** Supports all 5 school staff profiles — System Admin, School Principal, Department Head, Teaching Teacher / Adviser, and Non-Teaching Staff — with `EN` and `FIL` language support.

### Slide 5 — Built-In Anti-Fraud & Privacy Engineering
- **Signed Student QR IDs:** Every student QR code is signed with HMAC-SHA256 (`ATTENDSURE:...`), so photocopied or guessed LRN strings cannot forge attendance.
- **Anti-Proxy Teacher Verification:** 1-to-1 phone binding (`bound_device_id`), hardware-stored check-in key verification (`biometric_key_id`), mock-GPS rejection, weak-signal (> 250 m) rejection, and travel-speed checks stop buddy punching and fake GPS apps.
- **Privacy by Design (RA 10173):** Zero raw face photos or biometric templates ever leave the teacher's phone. Role scoping keeps teachers inside their own assigned sections, audit logs track every change and export, and Division Data Exports support optional personal ID masking.

### Slide 6 — Measurable School Impact
Every number shown on the AttendSure dashboard and safety panel comes live from the school database:
- **Faster Early Intervention (30-Day SARDO Risk):** Automatically highlights `CRITICAL_SARDO` and `EARLY_WARNING` learners so advisers and guidance staff can reach out early.
- **Hours Saved Every Month:** Eliminates manual end-of-month counting for DepEd **SF1**, **SF2**, **SF4**, and **CSC Form 48 (DTR)** submission and approval.
- **Live Campus Safety:** **1-Click Emergency Roll-Call** displays every student and teacher verified on campus today with live assembly-point safety checkboxes.
- **Cleaner Paperless Workflows:** Cuts repetitive printed daily sheets while keeping official print-ready DepEd forms one click away.

### Slide 7 — Clean, Maintainable Architecture
- **6 Focused Backend Apps (`accounts`, `school`, `students`, `attendance`, `campus`, `reports`):** Strict 3NF database design with zero duplicated columns, XOR database constraints on exit passes, and automated weekday schedule checks.
- **Consistent Web & Mobile Experience:** Synchronized 5-role permission checks across Django, React 19, and React Native, plus Light, Dark, and High-Contrast themes.
- **Zero-Downtime Updates:** Docker Blue-Green deployment (`web_blue` / `web_green` behind Nginx) updates the server without interrupting active classes.

### Slide 8 — Sustainable Deployment Model
| Plan | Designed For | What Is Included |
|---|---|---|
| **School Pilot** | Single public high school or pilot campus | Full built-in camera QR attendance, teacher phone check-in & GPS boundary, Exit Passes, SF1/SF2/SF4, CSC Form 48 (DTR), SARDO Risk, and Emergency Roll-Call. |
| **Division Rollout** | City or provincial school divisions | Multi-campus hosting, Division Data Export (`JSON` / `CSV` with optional ID masking), central onboarding, and zero-downtime server maintenance. |
| **Private K–12 Subscription** | Private schools & academies | Managed cloud hosting, automated backups, staff training, and priority technical support. |

- **Low Operating Cost:** Because AttendSure is pure software with zero extra hardware supply chain, school budgets go straight into reliable cloud or on-campus hosting and staff support.

### Slide 9 — Planned Next Steps (Roadmap)
- **Phase 1 (Current Release — Live Today):** Complete 5-role staff web portal & mobile app, signed camera QR scanning with offline sync, on-device phone lock & campus GPS teacher check-in, weekday-aware cutting detection, official DepEd SF1/SF2/SF4/DTR, 30-Day SARDO Risk, and 1-Click Emergency Roll-Call.
- **Phase 2 (Division Pilot & Scale):** Multi-school pilot across Region X public high schools, division analytics dashboards, and fine-tuned attendance trend reports.
- **Phase 3 (Planned Parent Mobile Alerts):** Optional **real-time mobile app push notifications** for parents/guardians when a student checks in for class or receives an approved campus Exit Pass — keeping communication instant and zero-cost.

### Slide 10 — Summary & Call to Action
- **Proven Codebase:** Verified by automated Django unit tests and an 8-gate repository audit covering migrations, API routes, 184 web/mobile permission checks, UI token consistency, vocabulary standards, and schedule conflict checks.
- **Ready for Campus Pilot:** Deployable on a school server or Docker cloud host in minutes using devices teachers already own.

## Timed 3-Minute Live Walkthrough Script

> **Before Starting:**  
> Run `python manage.py seed_competition_demo` inside `backend/`, start the Django server (`python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000`) and Web Portal (`npm run dev` inside `web/`), and open `http://localhost:5173`.

1. **[0:00 – 0:30] Landing Page & Language Switch**
   - Introduce AttendSure's core value: pure software running on existing teacher laptops, webcams, and phones — zero extra equipment to buy.
   - Toggle the header language switch (`EN` / `FIL`) and theme mode (`Light` / `Dark` / `High-Contrast`) to show everyday accessibility for Philippine school staff.
2. **[0:30 – 1:10] Live Dashboard, 30-Day SARDO Risk & 1-Click Emergency Roll-Call**
   - Sign in as `demo_admin` or `demo_principal` (password `AttendSure2026!`, or use the environment-gated preview button in local development).
   - Open **SARDO & Safety** to show students automatically grouped into `CRITICAL_SARDO` and `EARLY_WARNING` from real 30-day attendance patterns.
   - Click **Emergency Campus Roll-Call** to show the live headcount of every student and teacher verified on campus today, and mark students as **SAFE** at the assembly area in real time.
3. **[1:10 – 1:55] Classroom QR Scanner, Adviser Matrix & Weekday Schedule Filtering**
   - Open **QR Scanner** to show built-in laptop/PC webcam scanning (`jsqr`) with HMAC-signed student QR IDs and automatic offline local queue sync.
   - Open **Advisory** to show the daily subject monitoring matrix filtered to today's scheduled class periods (`ALL_WEEKDAYS`, `MWF`, `TTH`), spotting students present in Period 1 who missed a later scheduled period without an active Exit Pass.
4. **[1:55 – 2:30] Campus GPS Boundary, Teacher Check-In & Exit Passes**
   - Open **Geofence & Loafing** to show the campus GPS circle, live teacher check-in status, and outside-campus alerts (auto-resolved when teachers return or excused when an approved **Official Locator Slip** is active).
   - Emphasize privacy: teachers verify identity using their own phone's face/fingerprint/PIN lock with 1-to-1 phone binding and zero raw face photos sent to the server.
5. **[2:30 – 3:00] Official DepEd Forms & Division Export**
   - Open **DepEd Reports** to show print-ready **SF1**, **SF2**, **SF4**, and **DTR (CSC Form 48)** with teacher submission and Department Head approval.
   - Click **Division Export** with personal ID masking enabled to show privacy-safe reporting ready for school division offices.

## Common Reviewer Questions & Clear Answers

- **Q: What happens when campus internet goes down during morning attendance?**  
  *A:* Both the web webcam scanner (`localStorage`) and the mobile phone camera scanner (`AsyncStorage`) store signed QR scans in a local offline queue with unique scan IDs (`client_scan_uuid`). Once internet reconnects, they sync cleanly to `/api/v1/attendance/offline-sync/` without creating duplicates.
- **Q: Can someone copy a student's LRN or fake a teacher's location?**  
  *A:* Student QR cards are signed with HMAC-SHA256 (`common/qr_signer.py`), so plain LRNs or edited codes are rejected immediately. Teacher check-ins require their bound phone (`bound_device_id`), on-device face/fingerprint/PIN confirmation (`biometric_key_id`), real non-mocked GPS coordinates inside the campus boundary, and accurate GPS readings (≤ 250 m).
- **Q: Do you store teacher face photos or fingerprints on the server?**  
  *A:* Never. Face unlock, fingerprint, and PIN checks stay entirely inside the phone's operating system via `expo-local-authentication` and `expo-secure-store`. The server only stores a non-reversible SHA-256 key identifier (`biometric_key_id`) to confirm check-ins came from the teacher's bound phone.
- **Q: How does AttendSure handle non-teaching school staff?**  
  *A:* Non-teaching staff have `role="TEACHER"` with `can_handle_classes=False`. Both the web portal and mobile app hide classroom QR scanning, student class lists, and SF1/SF2 for them, showing only their personal dashboard, campus GPS check-in, official locator slips, and CSC Form 48 DTR.
- **Q: Are the preview login buttons safe for real production schools?**  
  *A:* Yes. `/api/v1/accounts/demo-login/` checks `DEBUG or ENABLE_JUDGE_DEMO` on the server and returns `HTTP 404` when disabled in production, verified by automated tests.

// AttendSure - Mobile API Client with Automated Failover
// File: mobile/src/api/client.ts

import axios, { AxiosError, InternalAxiosRequestConfig } from 'axios';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import type * as SecureStoreType from 'expo-secure-store';
import {
  getServerBaseUrl,
  resolveFastestServer,
  invalidateServerCache,
  markServerReachable,
  cleanUrl,
} from '../services/configService';

let cachedSecureStore: typeof SecureStoreType | null | undefined;
const getSecureStore = (): typeof SecureStoreType | null => {
  if (cachedSecureStore !== undefined) return cachedSecureStore;
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    cachedSecureStore = null;
    return null;
  }
  try {
    cachedSecureStore = require('expo-secure-store') as typeof SecureStoreType;
  } catch {
    cachedSecureStore = null;
  }
  return cachedSecureStore;
};

export const AUTH_TOKEN_KEY = 'attendsure_auth_token';
const LEGACY_TOKEN_KEYS = ['user_token', 'attendsure_token'];

type AuthExpiredListener = () => void;
const authExpiredListeners = new Set<AuthExpiredListener>();

export function onAuthExpired(listener: AuthExpiredListener): () => void {
  authExpiredListeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    authExpiredListeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

function notifyAuthExpired(): void {
  authExpiredListeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try {
      fn();
    } catch {}
  });
}

async function readStoredAuthToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  const store = getSecureStore();
  if (store) {
    try {
      const secureToken = await store.getItemAsync(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
      if (secureToken) return secureToken;
    } catch {}
  }

  let token = await AsyncStorage.getItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
  if (!token) {
    for (const legacyKey of LEGACY_TOKEN_KEYS) {
      const legacyToken = await AsyncStorage.getItem(legacyKey);
      if (legacyToken) {
        token = legacyToken;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  return token;
}

function isSameServerOrigin(requestUrl: string, baseUrl: string): boolean {
  if (!requestUrl.startsWith('http://') && !requestUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
    return true;
  }
  try {
    return new URL(requestUrl).origin === new URL(baseUrl).origin;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export const apiClient = axios.create({
  timeout: 8000,
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    Accept: 'application/json',
  },
});

apiClient.interceptors.request.use(
  async (config: InternalAxiosRequestConfig) => {
    // 1. Resolve and sanitize base URL (guarantees no trailing slashes or /api)
    const rawBaseUrl = await getServerBaseUrl();
    const resolvedBase = cleanUrl(rawBaseUrl);
    config.baseURL = resolvedBase;

    // 2. Prevent duplicate /api/ prefixes and path traversal
    const requestPath = config.url || '';
    const isAbsoluteUrl = requestPath.startsWith('http://') || requestPath.startsWith('https://');
    if (!isAbsoluteUrl) {
      const sanitized = requestPath
        .replace(/^\/+/, '')
        .replace(/\.\.\//g, '')
        .replace(/^(api\/)+/i, '');
      config.url = `/api/${sanitized}`;
    }

    // 3. Attach auth token ONLY to requests targeting our own AttendSure server
    if (isSameServerOrigin(requestPath, resolvedBase) && config.headers && !config.headers.Authorization) {
      const token = await readStoredAuthToken();
      if (token) {
        const sanitizedToken = token.trim().replace(/[\r\n]/g, '');
        const scheme = sanitizedToken.split('.').length === 3 ? 'Bearer' : 'Token';
        config.headers.Authorization = `${scheme} ${sanitizedToken}`;
      }
    }

    return config;
  },
  (error) => Promise.reject(error)
);

apiClient.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => {
    markServerReachable(response.config?.baseURL);
    return response;
  },
  async (error: AxiosError) => {
    // Never retry or invalidate server cache when a request was intentionally cancelled on unmount
    if (axios.isCancel(error) || error.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }

    const originalRequest = error.config as InternalAxiosRequestConfig & {
      _retryCount?: number;
    };

    // Clear stored credentials on 401 Unauthorized (except login endpoint itself)
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
      const reqUrl = String(originalRequest?.url || '');
      if (!reqUrl.includes('/login')) {
        await AsyncStorage.multiRemove([
          AUTH_TOKEN_KEY,
          'user_token',
          'attendsure_token',
          'attendsure_user_profile',
          'attendsure_user',
          'attendsure_role',
        ]);
        const store = getSecureStore();
        if (store) {
          try {
            await store.deleteItemAsync(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
          } catch {}
        }
        notifyAuthExpired();
      }
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }

    // Automated failover if network times out or drops
    const isNetworkError =
      !error.response ||
      error.code === 'ECONNABORTED' ||
      error.message?.includes('Network Error') ||
      error.message?.includes('timeout');

    if (isNetworkError && originalRequest) {
      originalRequest._retryCount = originalRequest._retryCount || 0;

      if (originalRequest._retryCount < 1) {
        originalRequest._retryCount += 1;
        invalidateServerCache();

        try {
          const newBaseUrl = await resolveFastestServer();
          originalRequest.baseURL = cleanUrl(newBaseUrl);
          return apiClient(originalRequest);
        } catch (discoveryError) {
          return Promise.reject(discoveryError);
        }
      }
    }

    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export default apiClient;

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Animated Brand Badge
 * File: mobile/src/branding/AttendSureBadge.tsx
 */

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { StyleSheet, Animated, type StyleProp, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { AttendSureLogo } from './BrandLogos';
import { useThemeMode } from '../context/ThemeContext';

export interface AttendSureBadgeProps {
  size?: number;
  animate?: boolean;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
}

export const AttendSureBadge: React.FC<AttendSureBadgeProps> = ({
  size = 96,
  animate = false,
  style,
}) => {
  const { palette } = useThemeMode();
  const scaleAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
  const iconSize = Math.round(size * 0.62);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!animate) {
      scaleAnim.setValue(1);
      return;
    }

    const breatheAnimation = Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.timing(scaleAnim, {
          toValue: 1.05,
          duration: 1200,
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
        Animated.timing(scaleAnim, {
          toValue: 1,
          duration: 1200,
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
      ])
    );

    breatheAnimation.start();
    return () => {
      breatheAnimation.stop();
    };
  }, [animate, scaleAnim]);

  return (
    <Animated.View
      style={[
        styles.badgeContainer,
        {
          width: size,
          height: size,
          borderRadius: size / 2,
          borderColor: palette.borderStrong,
          shadowColor: palette.primary,
          transform: [{ scale: scaleAnim }],
        },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <AttendSureLogo size={iconSize} style={{ borderWidth: 0 }} />
    </Animated.View>
  );
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  badgeContainer: {
    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    borderWidth: 2,
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.18,
    shadowRadius: 10,
    elevation: 6,
    overflow: 'hidden',
  },
});

export default AttendSureBadge;

import React from 'react';
import { Text, TouchableOpacity, ActivityIndicator, ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { useThemeMode } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

interface ButtonProps {
  title: string;
  onPress: () => void;
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'outline';
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  style?: ViewStyle;
}

export function Button({ title, onPress, variant = 'primary', loading = false, disabled = false, style }: ButtonProps) {
  const { palette, radius, spacing, fonts } = useThemeMode();

  const stylesMap = {
    primary: { bg: palette.buttonBg, text: palette.onPrimary, border: 'transparent' },
    danger: { bg: palette.dangerBg, text: palette.onPrimary, border: 'transparent' },
    secondary: { bg: palette.surfaceSubtle, text: palette.textPrimary, border: palette.border },
    outline: { bg: 'transparent', text: palette.textSecondary, border: palette.borderStrong },
  };
  const cfg = stylesMap[variant];

  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      style={[
        {
          height: 44,
          borderRadius: radius.md,
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          paddingHorizontal: spacing.md,
          backgroundColor: cfg.bg,
          borderColor: cfg.border,
          borderWidth: cfg.border !== 'transparent' ? 1 : 0,
          opacity: disabled ? 0.5 : 1,
        },
        style,
      ]}
      onPress={onPress}
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      activeOpacity={0.8}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <ActivityIndicator color={cfg.text} size="small" />
      ) : (
        <Text style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: cfg.text }}>{title}</Text>
      )}
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Reusable Horizontal / Wrapped Filter & Picker Chip Row
 * File: mobile/src/components/common/ChipRow.tsx
 */

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
  type StyleProp,
  type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { useThemeMode } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import type { ThemePalette } from '../../constants/theme';

export interface ChipOption<T extends string | number = string> {
  key: T;
  label: string;
}

export interface ChipRowProps<T extends string | number = string> {
  options: ReadonlyArray<ChipOption<T>>;
  selected: T;
  onSelect: (key: T) => void;
  wrap?: boolean;
  variant?: 'chip' | 'tab';
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  contentContainerStyle?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
}

export function ChipRow<T extends string | number = string>({
  options,
  selected,
  onSelect,
  wrap = false,
  variant = 'chip',
  style,
  contentContainerStyle,
}: ChipRowProps<T>) {
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);

  const items = options.map((opt) => {
    const active = selected === opt.key;
    return (
      <TouchableOpacity
        key={String(opt.key)}
        style={[
          variant === 'tab' ? styles.tabBtn : styles.chip,
          active && (variant === 'tab' ? styles.tabBtnActive : styles.chipActive),
        ]}
        onPress={() => onSelect(opt.key)}
        activeOpacity={0.8}
      >
        <Text
          style={[
            variant === 'tab' ? styles.tabText : styles.chipText,
            active && (variant === 'tab' ? styles.tabTextActive : styles.chipTextActive),
          ]}
        >
          {opt.label}
        </Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    );
  });

  if (wrap) {
    return <View style={[styles.wrapRow, style]}>{items}</View>;
  }

  return (
    <ScrollView
      horizontal
      showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
      style={[styles.scrollStrip, style]}
      contentContainerStyle={[styles.scrollContent, contentContainerStyle]}
    >
      {items}
    </ScrollView>
  );
}

const createStyles = (palette: ThemePalette, fonts: ReturnType<typeof useThemeMode>['fonts']) =>
  StyleSheet.create({
    scrollStrip: { flexGrow: 0 },
    scrollContent: { gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' },
    wrapRow: { flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6 },
    chip: {
      paddingVertical: 6,
      paddingHorizontal: 11,
      borderRadius: 8,
      backgroundColor: palette.surfaceSubtle,
      borderWidth: 1,
      borderColor: palette.border,
    },
    chipActive: {
      backgroundColor: palette.buttonBg,
      borderColor: palette.buttonBg,
    },
    chipText: {
      fontSize: fonts.xs,
      fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold,
      color: palette.textSecondary,
    },
    chipTextActive: {
      color: palette.onPrimary,
    },
    tabBtn: {
      paddingVertical: 8,
      paddingHorizontal: 12,
      borderRadius: 10,

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Cross-Platform Image & Transparent PNG Logo Uploader
 * File: mobile/src/components/common/ImageUploadField.tsx
 *
 * - On Web: native file chooser with transparent-PNG preservation & auto-trim for logos.
 * - On Android / iOS: built-in Camera Capture Modal powered by expo-camera (no extra native deps).
 */

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Modal,
  ActivityIndicator,
  Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { CameraView, useCameraPermissions } from 'expo-camera';
import { useThemeMode } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import {
  isSafeUrl,
  QR_COLORS,
  SCANNER_OVERLAY_COLORS,
  type ThemePalette,
} from '../../constants/theme';
import { getServerBaseUrl } from '../../services/configService';
import { resolveMediaUrl, showNotice } from '../../utils/helpers';

export interface ImageUploadFieldProps {
  label: string;
  helperText?: string;
  value: string | null | undefined;
  serverBase?: string;
  variant?: 'avatar' | 'logo' | 'proof';
  onChange: (dataUrl: string) => void;
  onRemove?: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Browser-side image preparation:
 * - For `logo`: preserves full alpha transparency, trims empty transparent padding, exports PNG.
 * - For `avatar`/`proof`: constrains max dimension to 800px cleanly.
 */
const processWebImageFile = (
  file: File,
  variant: 'avatar' | 'logo' | 'proof'
): Promise<string> =>
  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Could not read the selected image file.'));
    reader.onload = () => {
      const rawDataUrl = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      if (!rawDataUrl.startsWith('data:image/')) {
        reject(new Error('Please select a PNG, JPG, or WebP image.'));
        return;
      }
      if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof document === 'undefined') {
        resolve(rawDataUrl);
        return;
      }
      const img = new window.Image();
      img.onerror = () => resolve(rawDataUrl);
      img.onload = () => {
        try {
          const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width;
          const h = img.naturalHeight || img.height;
          if (!w || !h) {
            resolve(rawDataUrl);
            return;
          }

          if (variant === 'logo') {
            const srcCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            srcCanvas.width = w;
            srcCanvas.height = h;
            const srcCtx = srcCanvas.getContext('2d');
            if (!srcCtx) {
              resolve(rawDataUrl);
              return;
            }
            srcCtx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
            srcCtx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);

            // Auto-trim outer transparent margins while preserving every logo pixel
            const imgData = srcCtx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;
            let minX = w;
            let minY = h;
            let maxX = -1;
            let maxY = -1;
            for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
              for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
                const alpha = imgData[(y * w + x) * 4 + 3];
                if (alpha > 10) {
                  if (x < minX) minX = x;
                  if (y < minY) minY = y;
                  if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
                  if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
                }
              }
            }

            const cropX = maxX >= minX ? Math.max(0, minX - 2) : 0;
            const cropY = maxY >= minY ? Math.max(0, minY - 2) : 0;
            const cropW = maxX >= minX ? Math.min(w - cropX, maxX - cropX + 3) : w;
            const cropH = maxY >= minY ? Math.min(h - cropY, maxY - cropY + 3) : h;

            const maxDim = 640;
            const scale = Math.min(1, maxDim / Math.max(cropW, cropH));
            const outW = Math.max(1, Math.round(cropW * scale));
            const outH = Math.max(1, Math.round(cropH * scale));

            const outCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            outCanvas.width = outW;
            outCanvas.height = outH;
            const outCtx = outCanvas.getContext('2d');
            if (!outCtx) {
              resolve(rawDataUrl);
              return;
            }
            outCtx.clearRect(0, 0, outW, outH);
            outCtx.drawImage(srcCanvas, cropX, cropY, cropW, cropH, 0, 0, outW, outH);
            resolve(outCanvas.toDataURL('image/png'));
            return;
          }

          // Portrait / proof: scale down if oversized
          const maxDim = 768;
          const scale = Math.min(1, maxDim / Math.max(w, h));
          const outW = Math.max(1, Math.round(w * scale));
          const outH = Math.max(1, Math.round(h * scale));
          const outCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          outCanvas.width = outW;
          outCanvas.height = outH;
          const outCtx = outCanvas.getContext('2d');
          if (!outCtx) {
            resolve(rawDataUrl);
            return;
          }
          const isPng = file.type === 'image/png';
          if (!isPng) {
            outCtx.fillStyle = QR_COLORS.background;
            outCtx.fillRect(0, 0, outW, outH);
          }
          outCtx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, outW, outH);
          resolve(outCanvas.toDataURL(isPng ? 'image/png' : 'image/jpeg', 0.85));
        } catch {
          resolve(rawDataUrl);
        }
      };
      img.src = rawDataUrl;
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });

export const ImageUploadField: React.FC<ImageUploadFieldProps> = ({
  label,
  helperText,
  value,
  serverBase: propServerBase,
  variant = 'avatar',
  onChange,
  onRemove,
  disabled = false,
}) => {
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);

  const [internalBase, setInternalBase] = useState<string>(propServerBase || '');
  const [imgError, setImgError] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [cameraModalOpen, setCameraModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [facing, setFacing] = useState<'front' | 'back'>(variant === 'avatar' ? 'front' : 'back');
  const [capturing, setCapturing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [camPerm, requestCamPerm] = useCameraPermissions();

  const cameraRef = useRef<CameraView | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (propServerBase) {
      setInternalBase(propServerBase);
      return;
    }
    let mounted = true;
    void getServerBaseUrl().then((b) => {
      if (mounted && b) setInternalBase(b);
    });
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, [propServerBase]);

  const resolvedUri = useMemo(
    () => resolveMediaUrl(value, internalBase),
    [value, internalBase]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    setImgError(false);
  }, [resolvedUri]);

  const handleOpenPicker = async () => {
    if (disabled) return;

    if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const input = document.createElement('input');
      input.type = 'file';
      input.accept = 'image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp';
      input.onchange = async () => {
        const file = input.files?.[0];
        if (!file) return;
        if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
          showNotice('File Too Large', 'Please choose an image smaller than 2 MB.');
          return;
        }
        try {
          const dataUrl = await processWebImageFile(file, variant);
          if (isSafeUrl(dataUrl)) {
            onChange(dataUrl);
            setImgError(false);
          } else {
            showNotice('Unsupported File', 'Please select a valid PNG, JPG, or WebP image.');
          }
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showNotice(
            'Upload Error',
            err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not load the selected image.'
          );
        }
      };
      input.click();
      return;
    }

    // Native Android / iOS: request camera permission and open capture modal
    if (!camPerm?.granted) {
      const result = await requestCamPerm();
      if (!result.granted) {
        showNotice(
          'Camera Permission Needed',
          'Allow camera access in your phone settings to take a photo.'
        );
        return;
      }
    }
    setCameraModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleTakePhoto = async () => {
    if (!cameraRef.current || capturing) return;
    setCapturing(true);
    try {
      const photo = await cameraRef.current.takePictureAsync({
        base64: true,
        quality: 0.72,
      });
      if (photo?.base64) {
        const dataUrl = `data:image/jpeg;base64,${photo.base64}`;
        onChange(dataUrl);
        setImgError(false);
        setCameraModalOpen(false);
      } else {
        showNotice('Capture Failed', 'Could not read image from camera. Please try again.');
      }
    } catch {
      showNotice('Capture Failed', 'Unable to capture photo right now. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setCapturing(false);
    }
  };

  const isLogo = variant === 'logo';
  const isProof = variant === 'proof';

  return (
    <View style={styles.wrapper}>
      <Text style={styles.label}>{label}</Text>
      {helperText ? <Text style={styles.helper}>{helperText}</Text> : null}

      <View style={styles.row}>
        <View
          style={[
            isLogo
              ? styles.logoFrame
              : isProof
                ? styles.proofFrame
                : styles.avatarFrame,
          ]}
        >
          {resolvedUri && !imgError ? (
            <Image
              source={{ uri: resolvedUri }}
              style={isLogo ? styles.logoImg : styles.fullImg}
              contentFit={isLogo || isProof ? 'contain' : 'cover'}
              onError={() => setImgError(true)}
            />
          ) : (
            <Ionicons
              name={isLogo ? 'ribbon-outline' : isProof ? 'document-attach-outline' : 'person'}
              size={isLogo ? 28 : 26}
              color={palette.primary}
            />
          )}
        </View>

        <View style={styles.actionsCol}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.uploadBtn, disabled && { opacity: 0.55 }]}
            onPress={() => void handleOpenPicker()}
            disabled={disabled}
            activeOpacity={0.85}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name={Platform.OS === 'web' ? 'cloud-upload-outline' : 'camera-outline'}
              size={15}
              color={palette.primary}
            />
            <Text style={styles.uploadBtnText}>
              {Platform.OS === 'web'
                ? isLogo
                  ? 'Upload PNG / Logo'
                  : isProof
                    ? 'Upload Proof Image'
                    : 'Upload Photo'
                : isLogo
                  ? 'Capture Logo'
                  : isProof
                    ? 'Capture Proof'
                    : 'Take Photo'}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          {resolvedUri && onRemove && (
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.removeBtn, disabled && { opacity: 0.55 }]}
              onPress={onRemove}
              disabled={disabled}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
            >
              <Ionicons name="trash-outline" size={14} color={palette.danger} />
              <Text style={styles.removeBtnText}>Remove</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Native Camera Capture Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={cameraModalOpen}
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setCameraModalOpen(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.cameraShell}>
          <View style={styles.cameraTopBar}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.cameraIconBtn}
              onPress={() => setCameraModalOpen(false)}
              accessibilityLabel="Close camera"
            >
              <Ionicons name="close" size={22} color={SCANNER_OVERLAY_COLORS.hintText} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <Text style={styles.cameraTitle}>{label}</Text>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.cameraIconBtn}
              onPress={() => setFacing((prev) => (prev === 'front' ? 'back' : 'front'))}
              accessibilityLabel="Switch camera"
            >
              <Ionicons name="camera-reverse-outline" size={22} color={SCANNER_OVERLAY_COLORS.hintText} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.cameraPreviewWrap}>
            <CameraView ref={cameraRef} style={styles.cameraView} facing={facing} />
          </View>

          <View style={styles.cameraBottomBar}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.shutterBtn, capturing && { opacity: 0.6 }]}
              onPress={() => void handleTakePhoto()}
              disabled={capturing}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
            >
              {capturing ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.onPrimary} />
              ) : (
                <Ionicons name="camera" size={26} color={palette.onPrimary} />
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <Text style={styles.cameraHint}>Tap shutter to capture photo</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
};

const createStyles = (palette: ThemePalette, fonts: ReturnType<typeof useThemeMode>['fonts']) =>
  StyleSheet.create({

interface InputProps extends TextInputProps {

  error?: string;
}

export function Input({ label, error, style, ...rest }: InputProps) {
  const { palette, ui, fonts, spacing } = useThemeMode();

  return (
    <View style={{ marginBottom: spacing.md }}>
      <Text style={ui.label}>{label}</Text>
      <TextInput

          ui.input,
          error ? { borderColor: palette.danger, backgroundColor: palette.dangerLight } : null,
          style,

        placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
        {...rest}

export const ScheduleAlarmModal: React.FC<ScheduleAlarmModalProps> = ({
  alarm,

  onSnooze,

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useThemeMode } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import type { ThemePalette } from '../../constants/theme';
import { formatDistanceMeters } from '../../utils/helpers';

export interface CampusLocationCardProps {
  isInsideCampusPerimeter: boolean | null;
  liveDistanceMeters: number | null;
  radiusMeters: number | null;
  timestamp?: string | null;
  gpsError: string | null;
}

export const CampusLocationCard: React.FC<CampusLocationCardProps> = ({
  isInsideCampusPerimeter,
  liveDistanceMeters,
  radiusMeters,
  timestamp,
  gpsError,
}) => {
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);

  return (
    <View style={styles.campusLocationCard}>
      <View style={styles.campusCardHeader}>
        <View style={styles.campusHeaderLeft}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.pulseDot,
              {
                backgroundColor:
                  isInsideCampusPerimeter === true
                    ? palette.success
                    : isInsideCampusPerimeter === false
                      ? palette.warning
                      : palette.textMuted,
              },
            ]}
          />
          <Text style={styles.campusHeaderLabel}>SCHOOL CAMPUS LOCATION</Text>
        </View>

        {timestamp ? (
          <View style={styles.timestampBadge}>
            <Ionicons name="time-outline" size={11} color={palette.textMuted} />
            <Text style={styles.timestampBadgeText}>{timestamp}</Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.campusMainContent}>
        {liveDistanceMeters !== null ? (
          <>
            <View style={styles.distanceValueRow}>
              <Text style={styles.distanceMetricBig}>
                {formatDistanceMeters(liveDistanceMeters)}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.distanceMetricSub}>from school grounds</Text>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.perimeterBadgeRow}>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.perimeterBadge,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: isInsideCampusPerimeter
                      ? palette.successLight
                      : palette.warningLight,
                    borderColor: isInsideCampusPerimeter ? palette.success : palette.warning,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <Ionicons
                  name={isInsideCampusPerimeter ? 'checkmark-circle' : 'navigate-circle-outline'}
                  size={13}
                  color={isInsideCampusPerimeter ? palette.success : palette.warning}
                />
                <Text
                  style={[
                    styles.perimeterBadgeText,
                    { color: isInsideCampusPerimeter ? palette.success : palette.warning },
                  ]}
                >
                  {isInsideCampusPerimeter ? 'INSIDE SCHOOL GROUNDS' : 'OUTSIDE SCHOOL GROUNDS'}
                </Text>
              </View>

              <Text style={styles.perimeterRadiusMeta}>
                {radiusMeters !== null ? `Allowed area: ${radiusMeters}m` : 'Boundary not set'}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.acquiringFixBox}>
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
            <Text style={styles.acquiringFixText}>{gpsError || 'Finding GPS location...'}</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
};

export interface DtrDayRowSummary {

  pm_departure: string;
}

export interface DtrSummarySnapshot {
  month: string;
  year: number;
  days_present: number;
  total_undertime_hours: number;
  total_undertime_minutes: number;
  dtr_submitted: boolean;
  dept_head_approved: boolean;
}

export interface DashboardDtrAndKpiSectionProps {
  dtrData: DtrSummarySnapshot | null;
  todayDtrRow: DtrDayRowSummary | null;

  totalLate: number;
  totalAbsent: number;
  totalNeedsReview: number;
}

export const DashboardDtrAndKpiSection: React.FC<DashboardDtrAndKpiSectionProps> = ({
  dtrData,
  todayDtrRow,
  allowClassViews,
  lastSyncTime,

  totalLate,
  totalAbsent,
  totalNeedsReview,
}) => {

  return (
    <>
      {dtrData && (
        <>

            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderSub}>
              {dtrData.days_present} {dtrData.days_present === 1 ? 'Day' : 'Days'} Logged
            </Text>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.dtrSummaryCard}>
            <View style={styles.dtrGrid}>
              {[
                { label: 'AM IN', val: todayDtrRow?.am_arrival },
                { label: 'AM OUT', val: todayDtrRow?.am_departure },
                { label: 'PM IN', val: todayDtrRow?.pm_arrival },
                { label: 'PM OUT', val: todayDtrRow?.pm_departure },
              ].map((slot) => (
                <View key={slot.label} style={styles.dtrSlot}>
                  <Text style={styles.dtrSlotLabel}>{slot.label}</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.dtrSlotTime}>{slot.val || '--:--'}</Text>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>

            <View style={styles.dtrCardFooter}>
              <Text style={styles.dtrFooterMeta}>
                Undertime: {dtrData.total_undertime_hours}h {dtrData.total_undertime_minutes}m
              </Text>
              <Text
                style={[
                  styles.dtrApprovalBadge,
                  {
                    color: dtrData.dept_head_approved

                        ? palette.primary
                        : palette.textMuted,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {dtrData.dept_head_approved
                  ? 'APPROVED BY DEPT HEAD'
