/**
 * AttendSure - School Form 2 (SF2) Daily Attendance Report of Learners
 * File: mobile/src/components/reports/SF2ReportView.tsx
 */

import React, { useMemo, useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  ActivityIndicator,
} from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import axios from 'axios';
import { apiClient } from '../../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../../api/endpoints';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { useThemeMode } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { cleanText, getFriendlyErrorMessage } from '../../constants/theme';
import { DepEdReportHeader, DepEdReportFooter } from './DepEdReportHeaderFooter';

export interface SchoolDay {
  dateNumber: number;
  dayOfWeek: 'M' | 'T' | 'W' | 'TH' | 'F';
  fullDate?: string;
}

export interface SF2Learner {
  id: number;
  lrn: string;
  name: string;
  sex: 'M' | 'F';
  attendance: { [dayNumber: number]: string | number };
  total_absent: number;
  total_tardy: number;
  remarks?: string;
}

export interface SF2ReportViewProps {
  data: any;
  learners?: any[];
  sectionId?: number | string;
  month?: string;
  year?: number;
}

// Single source of truth for SF2 table widths (header & data rows align cleanly)
const SF2_COL_NUM = 26;
const SF2_COL_NAME = 175;
const SF2_DAY_COUNT = 25;
const SF2_DAY_CELL_WIDTH = 21;
const SF2_DAYS_TOTAL_WIDTH = SF2_DAY_COUNT * SF2_DAY_CELL_WIDTH; // 525
const SF2_COL_ABSENT = 35;
const SF2_COL_TARDY = 35;
const SF2_COL_MONTH_TOTAL = SF2_COL_ABSENT + SF2_COL_TARDY; // 70
const SF2_COL_REMARKS = 155;
const SF2_TALLY_LABEL_WIDTH = SF2_COL_NUM + SF2_COL_NAME; // 201
const SF2_TABLE_INNER_WIDTH =
  SF2_COL_NUM + SF2_COL_NAME + SF2_DAYS_TOTAL_WIDTH + SF2_COL_MONTH_TOTAL + SF2_COL_REMARKS; // 951
const SF2_TABLE_WIDTH = SF2_TABLE_INNER_WIDTH + 2; // 953 (includes 1px left/right border)
const SF2_CANVAS_WIDTH = SF2_TABLE_WIDTH + 12; // 965 (includes 6px horizontal padding)

export const SF2ReportView: React.FC<SF2ReportViewProps> = ({
  data,
  learners,
  sectionId,
  month,
  year,
}) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { palette } = useThemeMode();
  const [fetchedData, setFetchedData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loadingSelf, setLoadingSelf] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const isMountedRef = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  // Optional standalone fetch when rendered with sectionId without parent data
  useEffect(() => {
    if (data || !sectionId) return;

    abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortControllerRef.current = controller;

    setLoadingSelf(true);
    setLoadError(null);

    const encodedSection = encodeURIComponent(String(sectionId));
    apiClient
      .get(`${ENDPOINTS.REPORT_SF2}${encodedSection}/`, {
        params: {
          ...(month ? { month } : {}),
          ...(year ? { year } : {}),
        },
        signal: controller.signal,
      })
      .then((res) => {
        if (isMountedRef.current) {
          setFetchedData(res.data || null);
        }
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        if (axios.isCancel(err) || (err as { code?: string })?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (isMountedRef.current) {
          setLoadError(getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not load School Form 2 records.'));
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (isMountedRef.current) {
          setLoadingSelf(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [data, sectionId, month, year]);

  const activeData = data || fetchedData;

  // 1. Dynamic Teacher Signatory Resolution
  const activeUserFullName =
    user?.full_name ||
    `${user?.first_name || ''} ${user?.last_name || ''}`.trim() ||
    user?.teacher_name ||
    user?.username ||
    '';

  const userRole = String(user?.role || user?.system_role || 'TEACHER')
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase();

  const isTeacherRole = userRole === 'TEACHER';

  // 2. Safe Array Normalization (supports optional search-filtered learners prop)
  const schoolDays: SchoolDay[] = Array.isArray(activeData?.school_days)
    ? activeData.school_days
    : [];

  const { males, females } = useMemo(() => {
    const rawMales: SF2Learner[] = Array.isArray(activeData?.males) ? activeData.males : [];
    const rawFemales: SF2Learner[] = Array.isArray(activeData?.females) ? activeData.females : [];
    if (!Array.isArray(learners)) {
      return { males: rawMales, females: rawFemales };
    }
    const allowedKeys = new Set(
      learners.map((item: any) => String(item.id || item.lrn || item.name))
    );
    return {
      males: rawMales.filter((m) => allowedKeys.has(String(m.id || m.lrn || m.name))),
      females: rawFemales.filter((f) => allowedKeys.has(String(f.id || f.lrn || f.name))),
    };
  }, [activeData, learners]);

  const standardSchoolDays = useMemo(() => {
    const list: SchoolDay[] = [];
    const daysCycle: Array<'M' | 'T' | 'W' | 'TH' | 'F'> = ['M', 'T', 'W', 'TH', 'F'];

    for (let i = 0; i < SF2_DAY_COUNT; i++) {
      if (schoolDays[i]) {
        list.push(schoolDays[i]);
      } else {
        list.push({
          dateNumber: i + 1,
          dayOfWeek: daysCycle[i % 5],
        });
      }
    }
    return list;
  }, [schoolDays]);

  // 3. Totals Summary Cached with useMemo
  const totalsSummary = useMemo(() => {
    const maleAbsent = males.reduce((acc, cur) => acc + (Number(cur.total_absent) || 0), 0);
    const maleTardy = males.reduce((acc, cur) => acc + (Number(cur.total_tardy) || 0), 0);
    const femaleAbsent = females.reduce((acc, cur) => acc + (Number(cur.total_absent) || 0), 0);
    const femaleTardy = females.reduce((acc, cur) => acc + (Number(cur.total_tardy) || 0), 0);

    return {
      maleAbsent,
      maleTardy,
      femaleAbsent,
      femaleTardy,
      combinedAbsent: maleAbsent + femaleAbsent,
      combinedTardy: maleTardy + femaleTardy,
    };
  }, [males, females]);

  // 4. Daily Column Tallies
  const dailyAttendanceTotals = useMemo(() => {
    const malesCount: number[] = new Array(SF2_DAY_COUNT).fill(0);
    const femalesCount: number[] = new Array(SF2_DAY_COUNT).fill(0);
    const combinedCount: number[] = new Array(SF2_DAY_COUNT).fill(0);

    const isAttended = (value: unknown) => {
      const raw = String(value ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
      return (
        raw === 'present' ||
        raw === 'p' ||
        raw === 'tardy' ||
        raw === 'late' ||
        raw === 't' ||
        raw === 'cutting' ||
        raw === 'cc' ||
        raw === 'c' ||
        raw === '0' ||
        raw === '2' ||
        raw === '3'
      );
    };

    standardSchoolDays.forEach((day, idx) => {
      if (idx >= SF2_DAY_COUNT || idx >= schoolDays.length) return;
      let mPresent = 0;
      let fPresent = 0;

      males.forEach((m) => {
        if (isAttended(m.attendance?.[day.dateNumber])) {
          mPresent++;
        }
      });

      females.forEach((f) => {
        if (isAttended(f.attendance?.[day.dateNumber])) {
          fPresent++;
        }
      });

      malesCount[idx] = mPresent;
      femalesCount[idx] = fPresent;
      combinedCount[idx] = mPresent + fPresent;
    });

    return { males: malesCount, females: femalesCount, combined: combinedCount };
  }, [standardSchoolDays, schoolDays.length, males, females]);

  if (loadingSelf && !activeData) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.stateBox,
          { backgroundColor: palette.surface, borderColor: palette.border },
        ]}
      >
        <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
        <Text style={[styles.stateText, { color: palette.textSecondary }]}>
          Loading School Form 2...
        </Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (loadError && !activeData) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.stateBox,
          { backgroundColor: palette.surface, borderColor: palette.danger },
        ]}
      >
        <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={22} color={palette.danger} />
        <Text style={[styles.stateText, { color: palette.danger }]}>{loadError}</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!activeData) return null;

  const resolvedTeacherName =
    (isTeacherRole && activeUserFullName.length > 0 ? activeUserFullName : null) ||
    activeData.adviser_name ||
    activeUserFullName ||
    'Class Adviser';

  const resolvedSchoolHead = cleanText(activeData.school_head, 160) || 'School Head / Principal';

  // 5. Official DepEd Cell Notation Renderer
  const renderAttendanceCell = (status?: string | number | null) => {
    const s = String(status ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();

    if (s === 'absent' || s === 'x' || s === '1' || s === 'a') {
      return (
        <View style={styles.attCell}>
          <Text style={styles.textAbsent}>(x)</Text>
        </View>
      );
    }

    if (s === 'tardy' || s === 'late' || s === '2' || s === 't') {
      return (
        <View style={styles.attCell}>
          <View style={styles.triangleUpperShaded} />
        </View>
      );
    }

    if (s === 'cutting' || s === 'cc' || s === '3' || s === 'c') {
      return (
        <View style={styles.attCell}>
          <View style={styles.triangleLowerShaded} />
        </View>
      );
    }

    return <View style={styles.attCell} />;
  };

  const isListEmpty = males.length === 0 && females.length === 0;

  const metrics = activeData.metrics || {};
  const maleEnrolmentJune = metrics?.enrolment_june?.m ?? males.length;
  const femaleEnrolmentJune = metrics?.enrolment_june?.f ?? females.length;
  const totalEnrolmentJune = maleEnrolmentJune + femaleEnrolmentJune;

  const maleRegisteredEnd = males.length;
  const femaleRegisteredEnd = females.length;
  const totalRegisteredEnd = maleRegisteredEnd + femaleRegisteredEnd;

  const percentageEnrolment =
    totalEnrolmentJune > 0 ? ((totalRegisteredEnd / totalEnrolmentJune) * 100).toFixed(2) : '100.00';

  const adaM = Number(metrics?.average_daily_attendance?.m ?? 0).toFixed(1);
  const adaF = Number(metrics?.average_daily_attendance?.f ?? 0).toFixed(1);
  const adaTotal = Number(
    metrics?.average_daily_attendance?.total ?? Number(adaM) + Number(adaF)
  ).toFixed(1);

  const percAttM = Number(metrics?.percentage_attendance?.m ?? 0).toFixed(1);
  const percAttF = Number(metrics?.percentage_attendance?.f ?? 0).toFixed(1);
  const percAttTotal = Number(metrics?.percentage_attendance?.total ?? 0).toFixed(1);

  const leftLogoUrl = activeData.left_logo || null;
  const rightLogoUrl = activeData.right_logo || null;

  // Dynamic pagination footer (never hardcoded)
  const totalLearners = males.length + females.length;
  const totalPages =
    Number(activeData.total_pages) > 0
      ? Number(activeData.total_pages)
      : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalLearners / 40));
  const currentPage =
    Number(activeData.page_number) > 0
      ? Math.min(Number(activeData.page_number), totalPages)
      : 1;

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.sheetOuterWrapper,
        { backgroundColor: palette.surface, borderColor: palette.borderStrong },
      ]}
    >
      <View
        style={[
          styles.scrollHintBar,
          { backgroundColor: palette.surfaceSubtle, borderColor: palette.border },
        ]}
      >
        <Ionicons name="swap-horizontal-outline" size={14} color={palette.primary} />
        <Text style={[styles.scrollHintText, { color: palette.textSecondary }]}>
          Swipe sideways to inspect the full 25-day attendance table
        </Text>
      </View>

      <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator>
        <View style={styles.officialDocumentCanvas}>
          <DepEdReportHeader
            leftLogoUrl={leftLogoUrl}
            rightLogoUrl={rightLogoUrl}
            region={activeData.region}
            division={activeData.division}
            formTitle="School Form 2 (SF2) Daily Attendance Report of Learners"
            formSubtitle="(This replaced Form 1, Form 2 & STS Form 4 - Absenteeism and Dropout Profile)"
          />

          <View style={styles.metaTable}>
            <View style={styles.metaRow}>
              <View style={[styles.metaCol, { flex: 1.2 }]}>
                <Text style={styles.metaText}>
                  <Text style={styles.metaLabel}>School ID </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.metaValue}>{activeData.school_id || '—'}</Text>
                </Text>
              </View>
              <View style={[styles.metaCol, { flex: 1.2 }]}>
                <Text style={styles.metaText}>
                  <Text style={styles.metaLabel}>School Year </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.metaValue}>
                    {activeData.academic_year || activeData.school_year || '—'}
                  </Text>
                </Text>
              </View>
              <View style={[styles.metaCol, styles.lastCell, { flex: 1.6 }]}>
                <Text style={styles.metaText}>
                  <Text style={styles.metaLabel}>Report for the Month of </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.metaValue}>
                    {activeData.month || '—'} {activeData.year || ''}
                  </Text>
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <View style={[styles.metaRow, { borderTopWidth: 1, borderTopColor: '#000000' }]}>
              <View style={[styles.metaCol, { flex: 1.8 }]}>
                <Text style={styles.metaText}>
                  <Text style={styles.metaLabel}>Name of School </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.metaValue}>{activeData.school_name || '—'}</Text>
                </Text>
              </View>
              <View style={[styles.metaCol, { flex: 1 }]}>
                <Text style={styles.metaText}>
                  <Text style={styles.metaLabel}>Grade Level </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.metaValue}>{activeData.grade_level || '—'}</Text>
                </Text>
              </View>
              <View style={[styles.metaCol, styles.lastCell, { flex: 1.2 }]}>
                <Text style={styles.metaText}>
                  <Text style={styles.metaLabel}>Section </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.metaValue}>{activeData.section_name || '—'}</Text>
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.matrixTable}>
            <View style={styles.tableRowHeader}>
              <View style={[styles.thCell, { width: SF2_COL_NUM }]}>
                <Text style={styles.thText}>#</Text>
              </View>
              <View style={[styles.thCell, { width: SF2_COL_NAME, paddingHorizontal: 3 }]}>
                <Text style={styles.thText}>LEARNER&apos;S NAME</Text>
                <Text style={styles.thSubText}>(Last Name, First Name, Middle Name)</Text>
              </View>

              <View style={styles.daysContainer}>
                <View style={styles.daysTopBanner}>
                  <Text style={styles.daysBannerText}>
                    (1st row for date, 2nd row for Day: M,T,W,TH,F)
                  </Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.daysRowNumbers}>
                  {standardSchoolDays.map((sd, colIdx) => (
                    <View key={`dnum-col-${colIdx}`} style={styles.dayColCell}>
                      <Text style={styles.dayNumText}>{sd.dateNumber}</Text>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                </View>
                <View style={styles.daysRowLetters}>
                  {standardSchoolDays.map((sd, colIdx) => (
                    <View key={`dday-col-${colIdx}`} style={styles.dayColCell}>
                      <Text style={styles.dayLetterText}>{sd.dayOfWeek}</Text>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                </View>
              </View>

              <View style={[styles.thCell, { width: SF2_COL_MONTH_TOTAL }]}>
                <Text style={styles.thText}>Total for the{'\n'}Month</Text>
                <View style={styles.absTarSubRow}>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.absTarCell,
                      { width: SF2_COL_ABSENT, borderRightWidth: 1, borderColor: '#000000' },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text style={styles.thSmall}>ABSENT</Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={[styles.absTarCell, { width: SF2_COL_TARDY }]}>
                    <Text style={styles.thSmall}>TARDY</Text>
                  </View>
                </View>
              </View>

              <View
                style={[styles.thCell, styles.lastCell, { width: SF2_COL_REMARKS, paddingHorizontal: 4 }]}
              >
                <Text style={styles.thText}>
                  REMARK/S (If DROPPED OUT, state reason, please refer to legend number 2.{'\n'}
                  If TRANSFERRED IN/OUT, write the name of School.)
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            {isListEmpty ? (
              <View style={styles.emptyBox}>
                <Text style={styles.emptyText}>
                  {activeData.notice ||
                    `No student attendance records found for Section ${activeData.section_name || 'this class'}.`}
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : (
              <>
                {males.map((m, rowIdx) => (
                  <View key={`male-row-${rowIdx}-${m.id || rowIdx}`} style={styles.tableRowData}>
                    <View style={[styles.tdCell, { width: SF2_COL_NUM }]}>
                      <Text style={styles.tdText}>{rowIdx + 1}</Text>
                    </View>
                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.tdCell,
                        { width: SF2_COL_NAME, alignItems: 'flex-start', paddingLeft: 4 },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <Text style={styles.tdLearnerName} numberOfLines={1}>
                        {cleanText(m.name, 120)}
                      </Text>
                    </View>

                    {standardSchoolDays.map((sd, colIdx) => {
                      const status = m.attendance?.[sd.dateNumber];
                      return (
                        <View key={`m-${m.id || rowIdx}-col-${colIdx}`} style={styles.dayDataCell}>
                          {renderAttendanceCell(status)}
                        </View>
                      );
                    })}

                    <View style={[styles.tdCell, { width: SF2_COL_ABSENT }]}>
                      <Text style={styles.tdTotalAbsent}>{m.total_absent || ''}</Text>
                    </View>
                    <View style={[styles.tdCell, { width: SF2_COL_TARDY }]}>
                      <Text style={styles.tdTotalTardy}>{m.total_tardy || ''}</Text>
                    </View>
                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.tdCell,
                        styles.lastCell,
                        { width: SF2_COL_REMARKS, alignItems: 'flex-start', paddingLeft: 4 },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <Text style={styles.tdRemarks} numberOfLines={1}>
                        {cleanText(m.remarks, 120)}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                ))}

                <View style={styles.tallyRow}>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.tdCell,
                      { width: SF2_TALLY_LABEL_WIDTH, alignItems: 'flex-start', paddingLeft: 6 },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text style={styles.tallyLabel}>&larr; MALE | TOTAL Per Day &rarr;</Text>
                  </View>
                  {standardSchoolDays.map((_, colIdx) => (
                    <View key={`m-tot-col-${colIdx}`} style={styles.dayDataCell}>
                      <Text style={styles.tallyCountText}>
                        {dailyAttendanceTotals.males[colIdx] || ''}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                  <View style={[styles.tdCell, { width: SF2_COL_ABSENT }]}>
                    <Text style={styles.tallyCountText}>{totalsSummary.maleAbsent || ''}</Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={[styles.tdCell, { width: SF2_COL_TARDY }]}>
                    <Text style={styles.tallyCountText}>{totalsSummary.maleTardy || ''}</Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={[styles.tdCell, styles.lastCell, { width: SF2_COL_REMARKS }]} />
                </View>

                {females.map((f, rowIdx) => (
                  <View key={`female-row-${rowIdx}-${f.id || rowIdx}`} style={styles.tableRowData}>
                    <View style={[styles.tdCell, { width: SF2_COL_NUM }]}>
                      <Text style={styles.tdText}>{rowIdx + 1}</Text>
                    </View>
                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.tdCell,
                        { width: SF2_COL_NAME, alignItems: 'flex-start', paddingLeft: 4 },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <Text style={styles.tdLearnerName} numberOfLines={1}>
                        {cleanText(f.name, 120)}
                      </Text>
                    </View>

                    {standardSchoolDays.map((sd, colIdx) => {
                      const status = f.attendance?.[sd.dateNumber];
                      return (
                        <View key={`f-${f.id || rowIdx}-col-${colIdx}`} style={styles.dayDataCell}>
                          {renderAttendanceCell(status)}
                        </View>
                      );
                    })}

                    <View style={[styles.tdCell, { width: SF2_COL_ABSENT }]}>
                      <Text style={styles.tdTotalAbsent}>{f.total_absent || ''}</Text>
                    </View>
                    <View style={[styles.tdCell, { width: SF2_COL_TARDY }]}>
                      <Text style={styles.tdTotalTardy}>{f.total_tardy || ''}</Text>
                    </View>
                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.tdCell,
                        styles.lastCell,
                        { width: SF2_COL_REMARKS, alignItems: 'flex-start', paddingLeft: 4 },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <Text style={styles.tdRemarks} numberOfLines={1}>
                        {cleanText(f.remarks, 120)}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                ))}

                <View style={styles.tallyRow}>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.tdCell,
                      { width: SF2_TALLY_LABEL_WIDTH, alignItems: 'flex-start', paddingLeft: 6 },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text style={styles.tallyLabel}>&larr; FEMALE | TOTAL Per Day &rarr;</Text>
                  </View>
                  {standardSchoolDays.map((_, colIdx) => (
                    <View key={`f-tot-col-${colIdx}`} style={styles.dayDataCell}>
                      <Text style={styles.tallyCountText}>
                        {dailyAttendanceTotals.females[colIdx] || ''}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                  <View style={[styles.tdCell, { width: SF2_COL_ABSENT }]}>
                    <Text style={styles.tallyCountText}>{totalsSummary.femaleAbsent || ''}</Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={[styles.tdCell, { width: SF2_COL_TARDY }]}>
                    <Text style={styles.tallyCountText}>{totalsSummary.femaleTardy || ''}</Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={[styles.tdCell, styles.lastCell, { width: SF2_COL_REMARKS }]} />
                </View>

                <View style={[styles.tallyRow, { backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9', borderBottomWidth: 0 }]}>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.tdCell,
                      { width: SF2_TALLY_LABEL_WIDTH, alignItems: 'flex-start', paddingLeft: 6 },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text style={[styles.tallyLabel, { fontWeight: '900' }]}>
                      Combined TOTAL PER DAY
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                  {standardSchoolDays.map((_, colIdx) => (
                    <View key={`c-tot-col-${colIdx}`} style={styles.dayDataCell}>
                      <Text style={[styles.tallyCountText, { fontWeight: '900' }]}>
                        {dailyAttendanceTotals.combined[colIdx] || ''}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                  <View style={[styles.tdCell, { width: SF2_COL_ABSENT }]}>
                    <Text style={[styles.tallyCountText, { fontWeight: '900' }]}>
                      {totalsSummary.combinedAbsent || ''}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={[styles.tdCell, { width: SF2_COL_TARDY }]}>
                    <Text style={[styles.tallyCountText, { fontWeight: '900' }]}>
                      {totalsSummary.combinedTardy || ''}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={[styles.tdCell, styles.lastCell, { width: SF2_COL_REMARKS }]} />
                </View>
              </>
            )}
          </View>

          <View style={styles.bottomBlockContainer}>
            <View style={styles.guidelinesCol}>
              <Text style={styles.blockHeading}>GUIDELINES:</Text>
              <Text style={styles.guidelineP}>
                1. The attendance shall be accomplished daily. Refer to the codes for checking

                </View>

              </View>

              <View style={styles.formulaRow}>
                <Text style={styles.formulaLabel}>b. Average Daily Attendance =</Text>

              </View>

              <View style={styles.formulaRow}>
                <Text style={styles.formulaLabel}>
                  c. Percentage of Attendance for the month =
                </Text>
                <View style={styles.fractionWrap}>
                  <Text style={styles.fractionNumerator}>Average daily attendance</Text>
                  <View style={styles.fractionBar} />
                  <Text style={styles.fractionDenominator}>
                    Registered Learner as of End of the month
                  </Text>
                </View>
                <Text style={styles.multiplyText}>x 100</Text>
              </View>

              <Text style={styles.guidelineP}>
                4. Every End of the month, the class adviser will submit this form to the office
                of the principal for recording of summary table into the School Form 4. Once
                signed by the principal, this form should be returned to the adviser.
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.guidelineP}>
                5. The adviser will extend necessary intervention including but not limited to
                home visitation to learner/s that committed 5 consecutive days of absences or
                those with potentials of dropping out.
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.guidelineP}>

                138 every grading period.
              </Text>

                Beginning of School Year cut-off report is every 1st Friday of School Calendar Days
              </Text>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.codesAndReasonsCol}>
              <Text style={styles.blockHeading}>1. CODES FOR CHECKING ATTENDANCE</Text>
              <Text style={styles.codeText}>
                <Text style={{ fontWeight: '800' }}>blank </Text>- Present

              <View style={styles.signSection}>

                  <Text style={styles.signPositionLabel}>
                    (Signature of School Head over Printed Name)
                  </Text>
                </View>
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          <DepEdReportFooter
            schoolLogoUrl={activeData.school_logo || activeData.right_logo || null}
            address={activeData.school_address || activeData.address}
            contactNumber={activeData.school_contact || activeData.contact_number}
            email={activeData.school_email || activeData.email}
          />
          <View style={styles.pageMetaFooter}>
            <Text style={styles.pageMetaText}>
              School Form 2: Page {currentPage} of {totalPages}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  ActivityIndicator,
} from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import axios from 'axios';
import { apiClient } from '../../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../../api/endpoints';
import { useThemeMode } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { cleanText, getFriendlyErrorMessage } from '../../constants/theme';
import { DepEdReportHeader, DepEdReportFooter } from './DepEdReportHeaderFooter';

export interface MetricTriplet {
  m: number;
  f: number;
  total: number;
}

export interface SF4SectionRecord {
  section_id: number | string;
  section_name: string;
  grade_level: string;
  adviser_name: string;
  registered_end: MetricTriplet;
  daily_average: MetricTriplet;
  attendance_percentage: MetricTriplet;
  dropped_out_prev: MetricTriplet;
  dropped_out_month: MetricTriplet;
  dropped_out_cumulative: MetricTriplet;
  transferred_out_prev: MetricTriplet;
  transferred_out_month: MetricTriplet;
  transferred_out_cumulative: MetricTriplet;
  transferred_in_prev: MetricTriplet;
  transferred_in_month: MetricTriplet;
  transferred_in_cumulative: MetricTriplet;
}

export interface SF4GradeGroup {
  grade_level: string;
  sections: SF4SectionRecord[];
  subtotal: SF4SectionRecord;
}

export interface SF4ReportViewProps {
  data: any;
  gradeGroups?: SF4GradeGroup[];
  month?: string;
  year?: number;
}

// Single source of truth for SF4 header & data widths (guarantees exact alignment)
const COL_ADVISER = 100;
const COL_GRADE = 75;
const COL_SECTION = 70;
const COL_LEFT_SPAN = COL_ADVISER + COL_GRADE + COL_SECTION; // 245
const COL_MFT_GROUP = 78; // 26px per M / F / T column across 12 metric groups
const MFT_GROUP_COUNT = 12;
const SF4_TABLE_INNER_WIDTH = COL_LEFT_SPAN + COL_MFT_GROUP * MFT_GROUP_COUNT; // 1181
const SF4_TABLE_WIDTH = SF4_TABLE_INNER_WIDTH + 2; // 1183 (includes 1px left/right border)
const SF4_CANVAS_WIDTH = SF4_TABLE_WIDTH + 12; // 1195 (includes 6px horizontal padding)

const SF4_METRIC_HEADERS = [
  'REGISTERED\n(End of Month)',
  'ATTENDANCE\n(Daily Average)',
  'ATTENDANCE\n(Percentage)',
  'DROPPED OUT\n(Prev Month)',
  'DROPPED OUT\n(For Month)',
  'DROPPED OUT\n(Cumulative)',
  'TRANSFERRED OUT\n(Prev Month)',
  'TRANSFERRED OUT\n(For Month)',
  'TRANSFERRED OUT\n(Cumulative)',
  'TRANSFERRED IN\n(Prev Month)',
  'TRANSFERRED IN\n(For Month)',
  'TRANSFERRED IN\n(Cumulative)',
] as const;

const parseGradeLevelAndSection = (gradeLevelInput: string, existingSectionName?: string) => {
  const cleanGrade = cleanText(gradeLevelInput, 80);
  const cleanSection = cleanText(existingSectionName, 80);

  if (cleanSection) {
    return { grade: cleanGrade, section: cleanSection };
  }

  if (cleanGrade.includes(' - ')) {
    const parts = cleanGrade.split(' - ');
    return {
      grade: parts[0].trim(),
      section: parts.slice(1).join(' - ').trim(),
    };
  }

  if (cleanGrade.includes('-') && !cleanGrade.toLowerCase().startsWith('non-')) {
    const parts = cleanGrade.split('-');
    if (parts.length === 2 && parts[0].toLowerCase().includes('grade')) {
      return {
        grade: parts[0].trim(),
        section: parts[1].trim(),
      };
    }
  }

  return { grade: cleanGrade, section: '' };
};

export const SF4ReportView: React.FC<SF4ReportViewProps> = ({
  data,
  gradeGroups,
  month,
  year,
}) => {
  const { palette } = useThemeMode();
  const [fetchedData, setFetchedData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loadingSelf, setLoadingSelf] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const isMountedRef = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  // Optional standalone fetch when rendered without parent data
  useEffect(() => {
    if (data || (!month && !year)) return;

    abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortControllerRef.current = controller;

    setLoadingSelf(true);
    setLoadError(null);

    apiClient
      .get(ENDPOINTS.REPORT_SF4, {
        params: {
          ...(month ? { month } : {}),
          ...(year ? { year } : {}),
        },
        signal: controller.signal,
      })
      .then((res) => {
        if (isMountedRef.current) {
          setFetchedData(res.data || null);
        }
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        if (axios.isCancel(err) || (err as { code?: string })?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (isMountedRef.current) {
          setLoadError(getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not load School Form 4 records.'));
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (isMountedRef.current) {
          setLoadingSelf(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [data, month, year]);

  const activeData = data || fetchedData;

  if (loadingSelf && !activeData) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.stateBox,
          { backgroundColor: palette.surface, borderColor: palette.border },
        ]}
      >
        <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
        <Text style={[styles.stateText, { color: palette.textSecondary }]}>
          Loading School Form 4...
        </Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (loadError && !activeData) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.stateBox,
          { backgroundColor: palette.surface, borderColor: palette.danger },
        ]}
      >
        <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={22} color={palette.danger} />
        <Text style={[styles.stateText, { color: palette.danger }]}>{loadError}</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!activeData) return null;

  const leftLogoUrl = activeData.left_logo || null;
  const rightLogoUrl = activeData.right_logo || null;

  const safeGroups: SF4GradeGroup[] = Array.isArray(gradeGroups)
    ? gradeGroups
    : Array.isArray(activeData.grade_groups)
    ? activeData.grade_groups
    : [];

  const renderMetricGroup = (triplet?: MetricTriplet, isLastGroup = false) => (
    <View style={[styles.mftGroup, isLastGroup && styles.lastCell]}>
      <Text style={styles.tdCenter}>{triplet ? triplet.m : 0}</Text>
      <Text style={styles.tdCenter}>{triplet ? triplet.f : 0}</Text>
      <Text style={[styles.tdCenter, styles.lastCell, { fontWeight: '700' }]}>
        {triplet ? triplet.total : 0}
      </Text>
    </View>
  );

  const renderAllMetrics = (record?: Partial<SF4SectionRecord> | null) => (
    <>
      {renderMetricGroup(record?.registered_end)}
      {renderMetricGroup(record?.daily_average)}
      {renderMetricGroup(record?.attendance_percentage)}
      {renderMetricGroup(record?.dropped_out_prev)}
      {renderMetricGroup(record?.dropped_out_month)}
      {renderMetricGroup(record?.dropped_out_cumulative)}
      {renderMetricGroup(record?.transferred_out_prev)}
      {renderMetricGroup(record?.transferred_out_month)}
      {renderMetricGroup(record?.transferred_out_cumulative)}
      {renderMetricGroup(record?.transferred_in_prev)}
      {renderMetricGroup(record?.transferred_in_month)}
      {renderMetricGroup(record?.transferred_in_cumulative, true)}
    </>
  );

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.sheetContainer,
        { backgroundColor: palette.surface, borderColor: palette.borderStrong },
      ]}
    >
      <View
        style={[
          styles.scrollHintBar,
          { backgroundColor: palette.surfaceSubtle, borderColor: palette.border },
        ]}
      >
        <Ionicons name="swap-horizontal-outline" size={14} color={palette.primary} />
        <Text style={[styles.scrollHintText, { color: palette.textSecondary }]}>
          Swipe sideways to inspect all 39 consolidated columns
        </Text>
      </View>

      <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator>
        <View style={styles.officialDocumentCanvas}>
          {/* 1. Official DepEd DMOS Header */}
          <DepEdReportHeader
            leftLogoUrl={leftLogoUrl}
            rightLogoUrl={rightLogoUrl}
            region={activeData.region}
            division={activeData.division}
            formTitle="School Form 4 (SF 4) Monthly Learner's Movement and Attendance"
            formSubtitle="(Consolidated Learner Movement and Monthly Attendance Summary)"
          />

          {/* 2. Metadata Grid */}
          <View style={styles.metaGrid}>
            <View style={styles.metaRow}>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>School ID: </Text>
                {activeData.school_id || '—'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>Region: </Text>
                {activeData.region || '—'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>Division: </Text>
                {activeData.division || '—'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>District: </Text>
                {activeData.district || '—'}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.metaRow}>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>School Name: </Text>
                {activeData.school_name || '—'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>School Year: </Text>
                {activeData.school_year || activeData.academic_year || '—'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.metaCell}>
                <Text style={styles.metaKey}>Report Month: </Text>
                {activeData.month || '—'} {activeData.year || ''}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* 3. 39-Column SF4 Matrix Table (aligned widths) */}
          <View style={styles.table}>
            <View style={styles.thRow1}>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: COL_ADVISER }]}>NAME OF ADVISER</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: COL_GRADE }]}>GRADE LEVEL</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.th, { width: COL_SECTION }]}>SECTION</Text>
              {SF4_METRIC_HEADERS.map((label, idx) => (
                <Text
                  key={label}
                  style={[
                    styles.th,
                    { width: COL_MFT_GROUP },
                    idx === MFT_GROUP_COUNT - 1 && styles.lastCell,
                  ]}
                >
                  {label}
                </Text>
              ))}
            </View>

            <View style={styles.thRow2}>
              <View
                style={{
                  width: COL_LEFT_SPAN,
                  borderRightWidth: 1,
                  borderColor: '#0f172a',
                }}
              />
              {Array.from({ length: MFT_GROUP_COUNT }).map((_, i) => (
                <View
                  key={`mft-th-${i}`}
                  style={[styles.mftGroup, i === MFT_GROUP_COUNT - 1 && styles.lastCell]}
                >
                  <Text style={styles.mftTh}>M</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.mftTh}>F</Text>
                  <Text style={[styles.mftTh, styles.lastCell, { fontWeight: '800' }]}>T</Text>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>

            <View style={styles.rowCategory}>
              <Text style={styles.categoryText}>ELEMENTARY/SECONDARY:</Text>
            </View>

            {safeGroups.length === 0 ? (
              <View style={styles.emptyBox}>
                <Text style={styles.emptyText}>
                  No consolidated grade-level attendance summaries available for this month.
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : (
              safeGroups.map((group) => {
                const { grade: groupGrade, section: groupSection } = parseGradeLevelAndSection(
                  group.grade_level
                );
                return (
                  <React.Fragment key={`group-${group.grade_level}`}>
                    {group.sections && group.sections.length > 0 ? (
                      <>
                        {group.sections.map((sec) => {
                          const { grade: secGrade, section: secName } = parseGradeLevelAndSection(
                            sec.grade_level,
                            sec.section_name
                          );
                          return (
                            <View key={`sec-${sec.section_id}`} style={styles.tdRow}>
                              <Text
                                style={[
                                  styles.td,
                                  { width: COL_ADVISER, textAlign: 'left', paddingLeft: 4 },
                                ]}
                              >
                                {cleanText(sec.adviser_name, 100)}
                              </Text>
                              <Text style={[styles.td, { width: COL_GRADE, fontWeight: '700' }]}>
                                {secGrade}
                              </Text>
                              <Text style={[styles.td, { width: COL_SECTION }]}>{secName}</Text>
                              {renderAllMetrics(sec)}
                            </View>
                          );
                        })}
                        <View style={styles.subtotalRow}>
                          <Text
                            style={[
                              styles.td,
                              {
                                width: COL_LEFT_SPAN,
                                textAlign: 'left',
                                paddingLeft: 6,
                                fontWeight: '800',
                                borderRightColor: '#0f172a',
                              },
                            ]}
                          >
                            TOTAL FOR {groupGrade.toUpperCase()}
                          </Text>
                          {renderAllMetrics(group.subtotal)}
                        </View>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <View style={styles.tdRow}>
                        <Text style={[styles.td, { width: COL_ADVISER }]} />
                        <Text style={[styles.td, { width: COL_GRADE, fontWeight: '700' }]}>
                          {groupGrade}
                        </Text>
                        <Text style={[styles.td, { width: COL_SECTION }]}>{groupSection}</Text>
                        {renderAllMetrics(group.subtotal)}
                      </View>
                    )}
                  </React.Fragment>
                );
              })
            )}

            {activeData.non_graded_summary && (
              <View style={styles.subtotalRow}>
                <Text
                  style={[
                    styles.td,
                    {
                      width: COL_LEFT_SPAN,
                      textAlign: 'left',
                      paddingLeft: 6,
                      fontWeight: '800',
                      borderRightColor: '#0f172a',
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  TOTAL FOR NON-GRADED
                </Text>
                {renderAllMetrics(activeData.non_graded_summary)}
              </View>
            )}

            {activeData.total_summary && (
              <View style={[styles.subtotalRow, { backgroundColor: '#e2e8f0', borderBottomWidth: 0 }]}>
                <Text
                  style={[
                    styles.td,
                    {
                      width: COL_LEFT_SPAN,
                      textAlign: 'left',
                      paddingLeft: 6,
                      fontWeight: '900',
                      borderRightColor: '#0f172a',
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  TOTAL
                </Text>
                {renderAllMetrics(activeData.total_summary)}
              </View>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* 4. Guidelines & Signatures */}
          <View style={styles.summaryBox}>
            <View style={styles.summaryInfoCol}>
              <Text style={styles.summaryTitle}>GUIDELINES:</Text>
              <Text style={styles.summaryText}>
                1. This form shall be accomplished every end of the month.
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.summaryText}>
                2. Furnish copy to Division Office: a week after June 30, October 30 &amp; March 31.
              </Text>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.signCol}>
              <View style={styles.signBlock}>
                <Text style={styles.signName}>
                  {cleanText(activeData.school_head, 160) || 'School Head'}

          {/* 5. Official DepEd DMOS Footer */}
          <DepEdReportFooter
            schoolLogoUrl={activeData.school_logo || activeData.right_logo || null}

            email={activeData.school_email || activeData.email}
          />
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Academic Setup List Card Renderer
 * File: mobile/src/components/schedules/ScheduleListItemCard.tsx
 */

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { StyleSheet, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { useThemeMode } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import type { ThemePalette } from '../../constants/theme';
import { resolveMediaUrl } from '../../utils/helpers';
import type { ScheduleSubTab } from './types';

export interface ScheduleListItemCardProps {
  subTab: ScheduleSubTab;
  item: any;
  serverBase: string;
  allowCrud: boolean;
  onEdit: (item: any) => void;
  onDelete: (item: any) => void;
}

export const ScheduleListItemCard: React.FC<ScheduleListItemCardProps> = ({
  subTab,
  item,
  serverBase,
  allowCrud,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
}) => {
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);

  const avatarUri =
    subTab === 'PERIODS'
      ? resolveMediaUrl(item.teacher_photo_url, serverBase)
      : subTab === 'SECTIONS'
        ? resolveMediaUrl(item.adviser_photo_url, serverBase)
        : null;

  return (
    <View style={styles.card}>
      <View style={styles.cardRow}>
        {(subTab === 'PERIODS' || subTab === 'SECTIONS') && (
          <View style={styles.avatarBox}>
            {avatarUri ? (
              <Image source={{ uri: avatarUri }} style={styles.avatarImg} contentFit="cover" />
            ) : (
              <Ionicons name="person" size={18} color={palette.primary} />
            )}
          </View>
        )}

        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          {subTab === 'PERIODS' && (
            <>
              <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>
                {item.subject_code || item.subject_title || 'Subject'} &bull;{' '}
                {item.section_name || 'Section'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardSub}>
                {String(item.start_time || '').slice(0, 5)} –{' '}
                {String(item.end_time || '').slice(0, 5)} ({item.day_of_week || 'Mon–Fri'})
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardMeta}>
                Teacher: {item.teacher_name || 'Unassigned'} &bull; Room: {item.room_name || '—'}
              </Text>
            </>
          )}
          {subTab === 'SECTIONS' && (
            <>
              <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>
                {item.grade_level_name ? `${item.grade_level_name} - ` : ''}
                {item.name}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardSub}>Adviser: {item.adviser_name || 'No Adviser'}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardMeta}>
                Room: {item.room_name || '—'} &bull; Students: {item.student_count ?? 0}/
                {item.capacity ?? 45}
              </Text>
            </>
          )}
          {subTab === 'SUBJECTS' && (
            <>
              <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>{item.code}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardSub}>{item.title || item.name}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardMeta}>
                {item.subject_category || 'CORE'} &bull; {item.units ?? 1} unit(s)
              </Text>
            </>
          )}
          {subTab === 'ROOMS' && (
            <>
              <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>{item.name}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardSub}>
                {item.building || 'Main Building'} &bull; {item.room_type || 'CLASSROOM'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardMeta}>
                Capacity: {item.capacity ?? 45} &bull;{' '}
                {item.is_active !== false ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
              </Text>
            </>
          )}
          {subTab === 'GRADES' && (
            <>
              <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>{item.name}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardSub}>
                Code: {item.code || `G${item.level_number}`} &bull; Stage: {item.stage || 'JHS'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardMeta}>Order Level: {item.level_number}</Text>
            </>
          )}
          {subTab === 'YEARS' && (
            <>
              <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>
                S.Y. {item.name || item.code} {item.is_active ? '(ACTIVE)' : ''}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardSub}>
                {item.start_date || '—'} to {item.end_date || '—'}
              </Text>
            </>
          )}
          {subTab === 'DEPARTMENTS' && (
            <>
              <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>{item.name}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardSub}>Code: {item.code || '—'}</Text>
            </>
          )}
          {subTab === 'HOLIDAYS' && (
            <>
              <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>{item.title || item.reason}</Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardSub}>
                {item.date} &bull; {item.type || 'HOLIDAY'}
              </Text>
            </>
          )}
        </View>

        {allowCrud && (
          <View style={styles.actionsRow}>
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.iconBtn} onPress={() => onEdit(item)}>
              <Ionicons name="create-outline" size={16} color={palette.primary} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.iconBtn, { backgroundColor: palette.dangerLight }]}
              onPress={() => onDelete(item)}
            >
              <Ionicons name="trash-outline" size={16} color={palette.danger} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
};

  id: number;
  created_at?: string;
  timestamp?: string;
  time_only?: string;
  date_only?: string;
  user?: string;
  performed_by?: string;
  actor_username?: string;

const LOG_ACTION_OPTIONS: ReadonlyArray<{ key: string; label: string }> = [
  { key: 'ALL', label: 'All' },

const ACTION_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  LOGIN: 'Sign In',
  LOGOUT: 'Sign Out',
  LOGIN_FAIL: 'Failed Sign In',

const FAILED_ACTIONS = new Set(['LOCKOUT', 'LOCKED', 'LOGIN_FAIL', 'BIO_REJECT', 'DEV_REJECT']);
const ACCOUNT_ACTIONS = new Set(['LOGIN', 'LOGOUT', 'LOGIN_FAIL', 'LOCKOUT', 'LOCKED', 'PASSWORD', 'PROFILE', 'UNLOCK_ALL']);

function formatEntryTime(entry: AuditLogEntry): string {
  const rawIso = String(entry.created_at || '').trim();
  if (rawIso) {
    const parsed = new Date(rawIso);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
      const dateStr = parsed.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        year: 'numeric',
      });
      const timeStr = parsed.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
        hour: 'numeric',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: true,
      });
      return `${dateStr} • ${timeStr}`;
    }
  }
  if (entry.timestamp && String(entry.timestamp).trim()) {
    return String(entry.timestamp).trim();
  }
  return [entry.date_only, entry.time_only].filter(Boolean).join(' • ') || '—';
}

function getEntryActor(entry: AuditLogEntry): string {
  return (
    String(entry.actor_name || entry.user || entry.performed_by || entry.actor_username || '').trim() ||
    'System'
  );
}

function getEntryActionLabel(entry: AuditLogEntry): string {
  if (entry.action_label && String(entry.action_label).trim()) {
    return String(entry.action_label).trim();
  }
  const code = String(entry.action || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  return ACTION_LABELS[code] || (code ? code.replace(/_/g, ' ') : 'Activity');
}

function getEntryModuleLabel(entry: AuditLogEntry): string {
  if (entry.module && String(entry.module).trim()) {
    return String(entry.module).trim();
  }
  const rawModel = String(entry.target_model || entry.table_name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (rawModel && MODULE_LABELS[rawModel]) {
    return MODULE_LABELS[rawModel];
  }
  if (rawModel) {
    return rawModel.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
  }
  const code = String(entry.action || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  return ACCOUNT_ACTIONS.has(code) ? 'Account' : 'System';
}

function getEntryDetails(entry: AuditLogEntry): string {
  const direct = String(entry.details || '').trim();
  if (direct && direct !== '{}' && direct !== '[]') {
    return direct;
  }
  const targetId = entry.target_id ?? entry.record_id;
  return `${getEntryActionLabel(entry)} in ${getEntryModuleLabel(entry)}${targetId ? ` (#${targetId})` : ''}.`;
}

function getEntryStatus(entry: AuditLogEntry): { label: string; isFailure: boolean } {
  const code = String(entry.action || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const rawStatus = String(entry.status || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (code === 'LOCKOUT' || code === 'LOCKED') {
    return { label: 'Locked', isFailure: true };
  }
  if (rawStatus === 'FAILED' || FAILED_ACTIONS.has(code)) {
    return { label: 'Failed', isFailure: true };
  }
  return { label: 'Success', isFailure: false };
}

export const AuditLogsSection: React.FC<AuditLogsSectionProps> = ({
  logs,
  loading,
  search,
  onSearchChange,
  actionFilter,
  onActionFilterChange,
  onRefresh,
}) => {
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);

  return (
    <View style={styles.card}>
      <View style={styles.rowBetween}>
        <Text style={styles.cardTitle}>System Activity &amp; Audit Logs</Text>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.refreshMiniBtn} onPress={onRefresh} disabled={loading}>
          <Ionicons name="refresh-outline" size={15} color={palette.primary} />
          <Text style={styles.refreshMiniText}>Refresh</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.searchWrap}>
        <Ionicons name="search-outline" size={15} color={palette.textMuted} />
        <TextInput
          style={styles.searchInput}
          value={search}
          onChangeText={onSearchChange}
          placeholder="Search user, action, module, or IP..."
          placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
        />
      </View>

      <ChipRow
        options={LOG_ACTION_OPTIONS.map((opt) => ({ key: opt.key, label: opt.label }))}
        selected={actionFilter}
        onSelect={onActionFilterChange}
      />

      {loading ? (
        <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} style={{ marginVertical: 16 }} />
      ) : logs.length === 0 ? (
        <Text style={styles.cardSubtitle}>No audit entries match your filter.</Text>
      ) : (
        <View style={{ gap: 8, marginTop: 4 }}>
          {logs.map((entry) => {
            const statusInfo = getEntryStatus(entry);
            const actionLabel = getEntryActionLabel(entry);
            const moduleLabel = getEntryModuleLabel(entry);
            const actorName = getEntryActor(entry);
            const detailsText = getEntryDetails(entry);
            const ipAddr = String(entry.ip_address || entry.client_ip || '').trim();

            return (
              <View key={String(entry.id)} style={styles.logItem}>
                <View style={styles.rowBetween}>
                  <Text style={styles.logAction} numberOfLines={1}>
                    {actionLabel} &bull; {moduleLabel}
                  </Text>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.statusPill,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: statusInfo.isFailure
                          ? palette.dangerLight
                          : palette.successLight,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Text
                      style={[
                        styles.statusPillText,
                        { color: statusInfo.isFailure ? palette.danger : palette.success },
                      ]}
                    >
                      {statusInfo.label}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                </View>

                <Text style={styles.logDetails}>
                  <Text style={styles.logActor}>{actorName}: </Text>
                  {detailsText}
                </Text>

                <View style={styles.rowBetween}>
                  <Text style={styles.logTime}>{formatEntryTime(entry)}</Text>
                  {ipAddr ? <Text style={styles.logIp}>IP: {ipAddr}</Text> : null}
                </View>
              </View>
            );
          })}
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - School Server Connection Settings Modal
 * File: mobile/src/components/ServerConfigModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Modal,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ActivityIndicator,
} from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import {
  cleanUrl,
  getServerBaseUrl,
  isValidServerUrl,
  setServerBaseUrl,
  resetServerBaseUrl,
  testServerConnection,
} from '../services/configService';
import { Button } from './common/Button';
import { useThemeMode } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { cleanText, getFriendlyErrorMessage } from '../constants/theme';
import { showNotice } from '../utils/helpers';

export interface ServerConfigModalProps {
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function ServerConfigModal({ visible, onClose }: ServerConfigModalProps) {
  const { palette, spacing, radius, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const [url, setUrl] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const isMountedRef = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) return;
    let active = true;

    getServerBaseUrl()
      .then((resolved) => {
        if (active && isMountedRef.current) {
          setUrl(resolved || '');
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (active && isMountedRef.current) {
          setUrl('');
        }
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [visible]);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    const rawInput = cleanText(url, 300);
    if (!rawInput || !isValidServerUrl(rawInput)) {
      showNotice(
        'Invalid Address',
        'Enter a valid school server address (for example: http://192.168.100.9:8000).'
      );
      return;
    }

    const normalizedUrl = cleanUrl(rawInput);
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await setServerBaseUrl(normalizedUrl);
      const check = await testServerConnection(normalizedUrl);
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      setUrl(normalizedUrl);
      showNotice(
        check.ok ? 'Connected & Saved' : 'Address Saved',
        check.ok
          ? check.message
          : `${check.message} Make sure your phone and server are on the same network.`
      );
      onClose();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice(
        'Unable to Save',
        getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not save the school server address. Please try again.')
      );
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setBusy(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleReset = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await resetServerBaseUrl();
      const defaultUrl = await getServerBaseUrl();
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setUrl(defaultUrl);
      }
      showNotice('Reset Complete', 'Default school server address restored.');
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice(
        'Unable to Reset',
        getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not restore the default server address.')
      );
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setBusy(false);
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      visible={visible}
      transparent
      animationType="fade"
      onRequestClose={onClose}
    >
      <View style={[styles.overlay, { padding: spacing.lg }]}>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.modalBox,
            {
              backgroundColor: palette.surface,
              borderColor: palette.border,
              borderRadius: radius.lg,
              padding: spacing.lg,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.headerRow}>
            <View style={styles.titleGroup}>
              <View style={[styles.iconBadge, { backgroundColor: palette.primarySoft }]}>
                <Ionicons name="server-outline" size={18} color={palette.primary} />
              </View>
              <Text
                style={[
                  styles.modalTitle,
                  { color: palette.textPrimary, fontSize: fonts.size.lg },
                ]}
              >
                School Server Address
              </Text>
            </View>
            <TouchableOpacity
              onPress={onClose}
              accessibilityLabel="Close server settings"
              hitSlop={{ top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8, right: 8 }}
            >
              <Ionicons name="close" size={20} color={palette.textMuted} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          <Text
            style={[
              styles.modalDesc,
              {
                color: palette.textSecondary,
                marginVertical: spacing.xs,
                fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
              },
            ]}
          >
            Enter the Wi-Fi IP or web address of your AttendSure school server.
          </Text>

          <Text
            style={[
              styles.label,
              {
                color: palette.textPrimary,
                marginTop: spacing.sm,
                fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
              },
            ]}
          >
            Server Address
          </Text>
          <TextInput
            style={[
              styles.input,
              {
                borderColor: palette.borderStrong,
                borderRadius: radius.md,
                backgroundColor: palette.surfaceSubtle,
                color: palette.textPrimary,
                marginBottom: spacing.md,
                fontSize: fonts.size.base,
              },
            ]}
            value={url}
            onChangeText={setUrl}
            placeholder="http://192.168.100.9:8000"
            placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
            autoCapitalize="none"
            autoCorrect={false}
            keyboardType="url"
            editable={!busy}
            maxLength={300}
          />

          <View style={styles.buttonRow}>
            <Button
              title="Reset Default"
              variant="outline"
              onPress={() => void handleReset()}
              disabled={busy}
              style={styles.btnFlex}
            />
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[
                styles.saveBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: palette.buttonBg,
                  borderRadius: radius.md,
                  opacity: busy ? 0.6 : 1,
                },
              ]}
              onPress={() => void handleSave()}
              disabled={busy}
              activeOpacity={0.8}
            >
              {busy ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.onPrimary} />
              ) : (
                <Text
                  style={[
                    styles.saveBtnText,
                    { color: palette.onPrimary, fontSize: fonts.size.sm },
                  ]}
                >
                  Save &amp; Apply
                </Text>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>

          <Button
            title="Cancel"
            variant="secondary"
            onPress={onClose}
            disabled={busy}
            style={styles.cancelBtn}
          />
        </View>
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  overlay: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65)',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  modalBox: {
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  headerRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    marginBottom: 4,
  },
  titleGroup: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 8,
    flex: 1,
  },
  iconBadge: {
    width: 32,
    height: 32,
    borderRadius: 10,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  modalTitle: {
    fontWeight: '800',
  },
  modalDesc: {
    lineHeight: 18,
  },
  label: {
    fontWeight: '700',
    marginBottom: 4,
  },
  input: {
    borderWidth: 1,
    paddingHorizontal: 12,
    paddingVertical: 10,
    minHeight: 44,
  },
  buttonRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    gap: 8,
  },
  btnFlex: {
    flex: 1,
    height: 42,
  },
  saveBtn: {
    flex: 1,
    height: 42,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    paddingHorizontal: 12,
  },
  saveBtnText: {
    fontWeight: '800',
  },

    marginTop: 8,
    height: 40,
  },
});

export default ServerConfigModal;

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Seamless Branded Splash Screen
 * File: mobile/src/components/SplashScreen.tsx
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  Animated,
  Easing,
  Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { StatusBar } from 'expo-status-bar';
import * as ExpoSplashScreen from 'expo-splash-screen';
import { getServerBaseUrl } from '../services/configService';
import { AttendSureLogo } from '../branding/BrandLogos';
import { useThemeMode } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { QR_COLORS } from '../constants/theme';

export interface SplashScreenProps {
  loading?: boolean;
  minDurationMs?: number;
  maxDurationMs?: number;
  onFinish?: () => void;
}

interface SpiralDotSpec {
  index: number;
  angleDeg: string;
  inputRange: number[];
  outputScale: number[];
  outputOpacity: number[];
}

// Precomputed once at module load for smooth 60 FPS startup rendering
const SPIRAL_DOT_SPECS: readonly SpiralDotSpec[] = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => {
  const phase = i / 8;
  const sortedInputs = [0, phase, (phase + 0.5) % 1, 1].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const inputRange = Array.from(new Set(sortedInputs));
  const outputScale = inputRange.map((val) => {
    const dist = Math.abs(((val - phase + 1.5) % 1) - 0.5) * 2;
    return 1 - dist * 0.68;
  });
  const outputOpacity = inputRange.map((val) => {
    const dist = Math.abs(((val - phase + 1.5) % 1) - 0.5) * 2;
    return 1 - dist * 0.8;
  });
  return {
    index: i,
    angleDeg: `${i * 45}deg`,
    inputRange,
    outputScale,
    outputOpacity,
  };
});

export const SplashScreen: React.FC<SplashScreenProps> = ({
  loading = false,
  minDurationMs = 950,
  maxDurationMs = 3500,
  onFinish,
}) => {
  const { palette, isDark } = useThemeMode();
  const [canExit, setCanExit] = useState(false);
  const [forceExit, setForceExit] = useState(false);
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false);

  const isMountedRef = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const nativeSplashHiddenRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const exitStartedRef = useRef<boolean>(false);

  const opacityAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
  const radarWave1 = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const radarWave2 = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const radarSweep = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const spiralClock = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;

  const hideNativeSplashOnce = useCallback(() => {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web' || nativeSplashHiddenRef.current) return;
    nativeSplashHiddenRef.current = true;
    try {
      Promise.resolve(ExpoSplashScreen.hideAsync()).catch(() => {});
    } catch {
      // Safe no-op if native splash is already hidden
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    // Pre-warm fastest school server discovery in parallel during splash
    getServerBaseUrl().catch(() => {});

    // Fallback in case onLayout does not fire promptly
    const nativeFallback = setTimeout(hideNativeSplashOnce, 120);

    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      clearTimeout(nativeFallback);
    };
  }, [hideNativeSplashOnce]);

  // Start continuous radar & spiral animations
  useEffect(() => {
    const wave1Loop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.timing(radarWave1, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 2400,
        easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic),
        useNativeDriver: true,
      })
    );

    const wave2Loop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.sequence([
        Animated.delay(1200),
        Animated.timing(radarWave2, {
          toValue: 1,
          duration: 2400,
          easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic),
          useNativeDriver: true,
        }),
      ])
    );

    const sweepLoop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.timing(radarSweep, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 2200,
        easing: Easing.linear,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      })
    );

    const spiralLoop = Animated.loop(
      Animated.timing(spiralClock, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 1100,
        easing: Easing.linear,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      })
    );

    wave1Loop.start();
    wave2Loop.start();
    sweepLoop.start();
    spiralLoop.start();

    return () => {
      wave1Loop.stop();
      wave2Loop.stop();
      sweepLoop.stop();
      spiralLoop.stop();
    };
  }, [radarWave1, radarWave2, radarSweep, spiralClock]);

  // Min and max splash duration timers
  useEffect(() => {
    const minTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setCanExit(true);
      }
    }, minDurationMs);

    const maxTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setForceExit(true);
      }
    }, Math.max(minDurationMs, maxDurationMs));

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(minTimer);
      clearTimeout(maxTimer);
    };
  }, [minDurationMs, maxDurationMs]);

  // Smooth fade-out once minimum duration completes and session hydration settles
  useEffect(() => {
    if (exitStartedRef.current) return;
    if ((!loading && canExit) || forceExit) {
      exitStartedRef.current = true;
      const fadeAnim = Animated.timing(opacityAnim, {
        toValue: 0,
        duration: 260,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      });
      fadeAnim.start(({ finished }) => {
        if (finished && isMountedRef.current) {
          setHidden(true);
          onFinish?.();
        }
      });
      return () => {
        fadeAnim.stop();
      };
    }
    return undefined;
  }, [loading, canExit, forceExit, onFinish, opacityAnim]);

  if (hidden) return null;

  const wave1Scale = radarWave1.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0.95, 1.85] });
  const wave1Opacity = radarWave1.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0.75, 0] });

  const wave2Scale = radarWave2.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0.95, 1.85] });
  const wave2Opacity = radarWave2.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: [0.75, 0] });

  const sweepRotate = radarSweep.interpolate({ inputRange: [0, 1], outputRange: ['0deg', '360deg'] });

  return (
    <Animated.View
      onLayout={hideNativeSplashOnce}
      style={[
        styles.container,
        { backgroundColor: palette.background, opacity: opacityAnim },
      ]}
    >
      <SafeAreaView style={styles.safeContainer} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
        <StatusBar style={isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'} />

        <View style={styles.spacer} />

        {/* Center Circular Radar Logo + Spiral Loader */}
        <View style={styles.centerSection}>
          <View style={styles.radarContainer}>
            <Animated.View
              pointerEvents="none"
              style={[
                styles.radarRing,
                {
                  borderColor: palette.primary,
                  transform: [{ scale: wave1Scale }],
                  opacity: wave1Opacity,
                },
              ]}
            />

            <Animated.View
              pointerEvents="none"
              style={[
                styles.radarRing,
                {
                  borderColor: palette.secondary,
                  transform: [{ scale: wave2Scale }],
                  opacity: wave2Opacity,
                },
              ]}
            />

            <Animated.View
              pointerEvents="none"
              style={[
                styles.radarSweepRing,
                {
                  borderTopColor: palette.primary,
                  borderRightColor: `${palette.primary}55`,
                  transform: [{ rotate: sweepRotate }],
                },
              ]}
            />

            <View
              style={[
                styles.emblemCircle,
                {
                  backgroundColor: QR_COLORS.background,
                  borderColor: palette.primary,
                  shadowColor: palette.primary,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AttendSureLogo size={64} style={{ borderWidth: 0 }} />
            </View>
          </View>

          <Text style={[styles.brandTitle, { color: palette.textPrimary }]}>AttendSure</Text>
          <Text style={[styles.brandSubtitle, { color: palette.textSecondary }]}>
            School Attendance System
          </Text>

          {/* 8-Dot Spiral Loading Spinner */}
          <View style={styles.spiralContainer} accessibilityLabel="Loading">
            {SPIRAL_DOT_SPECS.map((spec) => {
              const dotScale = spiralClock.interpolate({
                inputRange: spec.inputRange,
                outputRange: spec.outputScale,
              });
              const dotOpacity = spiralClock.interpolate({
                inputRange: spec.inputRange,
                outputRange: spec.outputOpacity,
              });

              return (
                <View
                  key={spec.index}
                  style={[styles.spiralArm, { transform: [{ rotate: spec.angleDeg }] }]}
                >
                  <Animated.View
                    style={[
                      styles.spiralDot,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: palette.primary,
                        transform: [{ scale: dotScale }],
                        opacity: dotOpacity,
                      },
                    ]}
                  />
                </View>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.spacer} />
      </SafeAreaView>
    </Animated.View>
  );
};
