const SAFE_RASTER_DATA_URI = /^data:image\/(png|jpeg|jpg|webp|gif);base64,/i;

export const isSafeUrl = (url?: string | null): url is string => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  const clean = trimmed.toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || ['null', 'undefined', 'none'].includes(clean)) return false;
  if (
    clean.startsWith('javascript:') ||
    clean.startsWith('vbscript:') ||
    clean.startsWith('file:') ||
    clean.startsWith('data:image/svg')
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (clean.startsWith('data:')) {
    return SAFE_RASTER_DATA_URI.test(trimmed);
  }
  if (clean.startsWith('/')) {
    return !clean.startsWith('//');
  }
  return clean.startsWith('http://') || clean.startsWith('https://');
};

export const cleanText = (val?: string | null, maxLen = 200): string => {
  if (!val) return '';
  return String(val)
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLen);
};

export const getFriendlyErrorMessage = (
  err: unknown,
  fallback = 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'
): string => {
  const e = err as {
    response?: { status?: number; data?: unknown };
    code?: string;
    message?: string;
  };
  const status = e?.response?.status;
  const data = e?.response?.data;

  const isUnsafeRaw = (text: string): boolean => {
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    return (
      trimmed.startsWith('<!DOCTYPE') ||
      trimmed.startsWith('<html') ||
      trimmed.includes('Traceback (most recent call last)') ||
      trimmed.includes('File "/') ||
      trimmed.length > 280
    );
  };

  if (typeof data === 'string' && data.trim() && !isUnsafeRaw(data)) {
    return data.trim();
  }

  if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
    const record = data as Record<string, unknown>;
    const candidate = record.detail || record.error || record.message;
    if (typeof candidate === 'string' && candidate.trim() && !isUnsafeRaw(candidate)) {
      return candidate.trim();
    }
    const firstVal = Object.values(record)[0];
    if (Array.isArray(firstVal) && typeof firstVal[0] === 'string' && !isUnsafeRaw(firstVal[0])) {
      return firstVal[0];
    }
    if (typeof firstVal === 'string' && firstVal.trim() && !isUnsafeRaw(firstVal)) {
      return firstVal.trim();
    }
  }

  if (status === 401) return 'Your session expired. Please sign in again.';
  if (status === 403) return 'You do not have permission to perform this action.';
  if (status === 404) return 'The requested information could not be found.';
  if (status && status >= 500) return 'The server is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.';

  if (e?.code === 'ECONNABORTED' || e?.message?.toLowerCase().includes('timeout')) {
    return 'The request took too long. Please check your connection and try again.';
  }
  if (e?.message?.toLowerCase().includes('network error')) {
    return 'Cannot reach the school server. Check your Wi-Fi connection and try again.';
  }

  if (err instanceof Error && err.message && !isUnsafeRaw(err.message) && !err.message.includes('Request failed with status')) {
    return err.message;
  }

  return fallback;
};

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Authentication Context & Session Manager
 * File: mobile/src/context/AuthContext.tsx

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import type * as SecureStoreType from 'expo-secure-store';
import { apiClient, AUTH_TOKEN_KEY, onAuthExpired } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';
import { stopPassivePresenceTracking } from '../services/backgroundLocation';

let cachedSecureStore: typeof SecureStoreType | null | undefined;
const getSecureStore = (): typeof SecureStoreType | null => {
  if (cachedSecureStore !== undefined) return cachedSecureStore;
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    cachedSecureStore = null;
    return null;
  }
  try {
    // Lazy require avoids startup crashes if native SecureStore is missing in the runtime
    cachedSecureStore = require('expo-secure-store') as typeof SecureStoreType;
  } catch {
    cachedSecureStore = null;
  }
  return cachedSecureStore;
};

const USER_CACHE_KEY = 'attendsure_user_profile';
const REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY = 'attendsure_refresh_token';
const ALLOWED_ROLES = new Set(['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD', 'TEACHER']);

export interface AuthenticatedUser {
  id: number;
  username: string;
  first_name: string;
  last_name: string;
  middle_name?: string;
  suffix?: string;
  full_name: string;
  teacher_name?: string;
  teacher_id?: number | string | null;
  employee_id?: string;
  email: string;
  role: string;
  system_role?: string;
  position?: string;
  department?: string | null;
  division?: string | null;
  contact_number?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  school_name?: string;
  qr_token?: string | null;
  bound_device_id?: string | null;
  has_bound_device?: boolean;
  has_biometric_enrolled?: boolean;
  can_handle_classes: boolean;
  can_teach: boolean;
  is_superuser: boolean;
  is_staff: boolean;
}

interface AuthContextType {
  user: AuthenticatedUser | null;
  token: string | null;
  loading: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  login: (username: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshUser: () => Promise<void>;
  updateUser: (updatedFields: Partial<AuthenticatedUser>) => Promise<void>;
  updateSessionToken: (nextToken: string) => Promise<void>;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

const saveTokenSafely = async (token: string): Promise<void> => {
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY, token);
  const store = getSecureStore();
  if (store) {
    try {
      await store.setItemAsync(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY, token);
    } catch {}
  }
};

const readTokenSafely = async (): Promise<string | null> => {
  const store = getSecureStore();
  if (store) {
    try {
      const secureToken = await store.getItemAsync(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
      if (secureToken) return secureToken;
    } catch {}
  }
  return AsyncStorage.getItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
};

const clearTokenSafely = async (): Promise<void> => {
  await AsyncStorage.multiRemove([
    AUTH_TOKEN_KEY,
    REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY,
    USER_CACHE_KEY,
    'user_token',
    'attendsure_token',
    'attendsure_user',
    'attendsure_role',
    'attendsure_teacher_on_duty',
  ]);
  const store = getSecureStore();
  if (store) {
    try {
      await store.deleteItemAsync(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
    } catch {}
    try {
      await store.deleteItemAsync(REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY);
    } catch {}
  }
};

const normalizeUserPayload = (raw: Record<string, any>): AuthenticatedUser => {
  const rawRole = String(raw.role || raw.system_role || 'TEACHER').trim().toUpperCase();
  const role = ALLOWED_ROLES.has(rawRole) ? rawRole : 'TEACHER';
  const fullName =
    String(raw.full_name || raw.teacher_name || '').trim() ||
    `${raw.first_name || ''} ${raw.last_name || ''}`.trim() ||
    String(raw.username || '');

  const canHandle =
    raw.can_handle_classes !== undefined && raw.can_handle_classes !== null
      ? Boolean(raw.can_handle_classes)
      : raw.can_teach !== undefined && raw.can_teach !== null
        ? Boolean(raw.can_teach)
        : true;

  return {
    id: Number(raw.id ?? raw.user_id ?? 0),
    username: String(raw.username || ''),
    first_name: String(raw.first_name || ''),
    last_name: String(raw.last_name || ''),
    middle_name: raw.middle_name || '',
    suffix: raw.suffix || '',
    full_name: fullName,
    teacher_name: fullName,
    teacher_id: raw.teacher_id ?? null,
    employee_id: raw.employee_id || '',
    email: String(raw.email || ''),
    role,
    system_role: role,
    position: raw.position || '',
    department: raw.department ?? null,
    division: raw.division ?? null,
    contact_number: raw.contact_number || '',
    photo: raw.photo_url ?? raw.photo ?? null,
    photo_url: raw.photo_url ?? raw.photo ?? null,
    school_name: raw.school_name || '',
    qr_token: raw.qr_token ?? null,
    bound_device_id: raw.bound_device_id ?? null,
    has_bound_device: Boolean(raw.has_bound_device ?? raw.bound_device_id),
    has_biometric_enrolled: Boolean(raw.has_biometric_enrolled ?? raw.biometric_enrolled),
    can_handle_classes: canHandle,
    can_teach: canHandle,
    is_superuser: Boolean(raw.is_superuser),
    is_staff: Boolean(raw.is_staff),
  };
};

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<AuthenticatedUser | null>(null);
  const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const isRefreshingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const isMountedRef = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const refreshUser = useCallback(async () => {
    if (isRefreshingRef.current) return;
    isRefreshingRef.current = true;
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;

    try {
      const storedToken = await readTokenSafely();
      if (!storedToken) {
        if (isMountedRef.current) {
          setUser(null);
          setToken(null);
        }
        return;
      }

      const res = await apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.CURRENT_USER, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (isMountedRef.current && res.data && (res.data.id || res.data.username)) {
        const normalized = normalizeUserPayload(res.data);
        setUser(normalized);
        setToken(storedToken);
        await AsyncStorage.setItem(USER_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(normalized));
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { response?: { status?: number }; code?: string };
      if (anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') return;
      const status = anyErr?.response?.status;
      if (status === 401 || status === 403) {
        await clearTokenSafely();
        if (isMountedRef.current) {
          setUser(null);
          setToken(null);
        }
      }
    } finally {
      isRefreshingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const restoreSession = async () => {
      try {
        const storedToken = await readTokenSafely();
        const cachedUserStr = await AsyncStorage.getItem(USER_CACHE_KEY);

        if (isMountedRef.current && storedToken && cachedUserStr) {
          setToken(storedToken);
          setUser(normalizeUserPayload(JSON.parse(cachedUserStr)));
          setLoading(false);
          // Refresh profile silently in background so startup never blocks offline
          void refreshUser();
          return;
        }

        if (storedToken) {
          await refreshUser();
        }
      } catch {
        await clearTokenSafely();
        if (isMountedRef.current) {
          setUser(null);
          setToken(null);
        }
      } finally {
        if (isMountedRef.current) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    void restoreSession();

    const unsubscribeAuthExpired = onAuthExpired(() => {
      void stopPassivePresenceTracking();
      clearTokenSafely().finally(() => {
        if (isMountedRef.current) {
          setToken(null);
          setUser(null);
        }
      });
    });

    return () => {
      unsubscribeAuthExpired();
    };
  }, [refreshUser]);

  const login = async (username: string, password: string): Promise<void> => {
    const cleanUsername = username.replace(/[\r\n\t]/g, '').trim();
    const cleanPassword = password.replace(/[\r\n\t]/g, '').trim();

    if (!cleanUsername || !cleanPassword) {
      throw new Error('Please enter both username and password.');
    }

    const res = await apiClient.post(ENDPOINTS.LOGIN, {
      username: cleanUsername,
      password: cleanPassword,
    });

    const d = res.data || {};
    // Prefer durable DRF auth token (matches LogoutView & ChangePasswordView rotation); fall back to JWT access
    const receivedToken: string | undefined = d.token || d.access || d.key;
    const receivedRefresh: string | undefined = d.refresh;
    const rawUser: Record<string, any> | undefined = d.user || (d.id || d.user_id ? d : undefined);

    if (!receivedToken || !rawUser) {
      throw new Error('Invalid response received from authentication server.');
    }

    const roleCheck = String(rawUser.role || d.role || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (roleCheck && !ALLOWED_ROLES.has(roleCheck)) {
      throw new Error('Only teacher and school leader accounts are allowed in AttendSure.');
    }

    const normalizedUser = normalizeUserPayload({ ...d, ...rawUser });
    await saveTokenSafely(receivedToken);
    if (receivedRefresh) {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY, receivedRefresh).catch(() => {});
    }
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(USER_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(normalizedUser));

    setToken(receivedToken);
    setUser(normalizedUser);

    refreshUser().catch(() => {});
  };

  const logout = async (): Promise<void> => {
    await stopPassivePresenceTracking().catch(() => {});
    const refresh = await AsyncStorage.getItem(REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY).catch(() => null);
    await apiClient.post(ENDPOINTS.LOGOUT, refresh ? { refresh } : {}).catch(() => {});
    await clearTokenSafely();
    setToken(null);
    setUser(null);
  };

  const updateUser = async (updatedFields: Partial<AuthenticatedUser>): Promise<void> => {
    if (!user) return;
    const nextUser = { ...user, ...updatedFields };
    if ('photo_url' in updatedFields && !('photo' in updatedFields)) {
      nextUser.photo = updatedFields.photo_url ?? null;
    } else if ('photo' in updatedFields && !('photo_url' in updatedFields)) {
      nextUser.photo_url = updatedFields.photo ?? null;
    }
    setUser(nextUser);
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(USER_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextUser));
  };

  const updateSessionToken = async (nextToken: string): Promise<void> => {
    if (!nextToken) return;
    await saveTokenSafely(nextToken);
    setToken(nextToken);
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        user,
        token,
        loading,
        isLoading: loading,
        login,
        logout,
        refreshUser,
        updateUser,
        updateSessionToken,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = (): AuthContextType => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

export default AuthContext;

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Live Theme Context (Light, Dark & High-Contrast)
 * File: mobile/src/context/ThemeContext.tsx
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import {
  PALETTES,
  FONTS,
  SPACING,
  RADIUS,
  createMobileStyles,
  type ThemeMode,
  type ThemePalette,
} from '../constants/theme';

const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'attendsure_color_mode';

interface ThemeContextValue {
  mode: ThemeMode;
  isDark: boolean;
  palette: ThemePalette;
  fonts: typeof FONTS;
  spacing: typeof SPACING;
  radius: typeof RADIUS;
  ui: ReturnType<typeof createMobileStyles>;
  setThemeMode: (mode: ThemeMode) => void;
  toggleDarkMode: () => void;
  setDarkMode: (value: boolean) => void;
}

const defaultPalette = PALETTES.light;

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextValue>({
  mode: 'light',
  isDark: false,
  palette: defaultPalette,
  fonts: FONTS,
  spacing: SPACING,
  radius: RADIUS,
  ui: createMobileStyles(defaultPalette),
  setThemeMode: () => {},
  toggleDarkMode: () => {},
  setDarkMode: () => {},
});

export const ThemeProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ThemeMode>('light');

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    AsyncStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY)
      .then((saved) => {
        if (mounted && (saved === 'dark' || saved === 'light' || saved === 'high-contrast')) {
          setMode(saved);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const setThemeMode = (nextMode: ThemeMode) => {
    setMode(nextMode);
    AsyncStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, nextMode).catch(() => {});
  };

  const setDarkMode = (value: boolean) => setThemeMode(value ? 'dark' : 'light');

  // Cycles: Light -> Dark -> High-Contrast Daylight
  const toggleDarkMode = () => {
    const order: ThemeMode[] = ['light', 'dark', 'high-contrast'];
    const next = order[(order.indexOf(mode) + 1) % order.length];
    setThemeMode(next);
  };

  const palette = PALETTES[mode];
  const ui = useMemo(() => createMobileStyles(palette), [palette]);

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      mode,
      isDark: palette.isDark,
      palette,
      fonts: FONTS,
      spacing: SPACING,
      radius: RADIUS,
      ui,
      setThemeMode,
      toggleDarkMode,
      setDarkMode,
    }),
    [mode, palette, ui]
  );

  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>;
};

export const useThemeMode = () => useContext(ThemeContext);
export type { ThemePalette };

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Debounced & AbortController-Safe Live Field Availability Hook
 * File: mobile/src/hooks/useMobileFieldCheck.ts
 */

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';

export type MobileCheckFieldName =
  | 'username'
  | 'email'
  | 'employee_id'
  | 'contact_number'
  | 'lrn'
  | 'subject_code'
  | 'room_name';

export interface MobileFieldCheckOptions {
  enabled: boolean;
  field: MobileCheckFieldName;
  value: string;
  minLength?: number;
  minDigits?: number;
  formatError?: string;
  fallbackMessage?: string;
  excludeId?: number;
  excludeUserId?: number;
  excludeTeacherId?: number;
  debounceMs?: number;
}

export interface MobileFieldCheckResult {
  checking: boolean;
  warning: string;
  isTaken: boolean;
}

const IDLE_RESULT: MobileFieldCheckResult = {
  checking: false,
  warning: '',
  isTaken: false,
};

export function useMobileFieldCheck({
  enabled,
  field,
  value,
  minLength = 2,
  minDigits,
  formatError,
  fallbackMessage,
  excludeId,
  excludeUserId,
  excludeTeacherId,
  debounceMs = 320,
}: MobileFieldCheckOptions): MobileFieldCheckResult {
  const [state, setState] = useState<MobileFieldCheckResult>(IDLE_RESULT);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) {
      setState(IDLE_RESULT);
      return;
    }

    const trimmed = String(value || '').trim();
    if (formatError) {
      setState({ checking: false, warning: formatError, isTaken: false });
      return;
    }

    if (!trimmed || trimmed.length < minLength) {
      setState(IDLE_RESULT);
      return;
    }

    if (minDigits !== undefined && trimmed.replace(/\D/g, '').length < minDigits) {
      setState(IDLE_RESULT);
      return;
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, checking: true }));
      try {
        const params: Record<string, string | number> = {
          field,
          value: trimmed,
          nocache: 1,
        };
        if (excludeId) params.exclude_id = excludeId;
        if (excludeUserId) params.exclude_user_id = excludeUserId;
        if (excludeTeacherId) params.exclude_teacher_id = excludeTeacherId;

        const res = await apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.VALIDATE_FIELD, {
          params,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        const taken = Boolean(res.data?.is_taken || res.data?.available === false);
        setState({
          checking: false,
          warning: taken
            ? String(
                res.data?.message ||
                  fallbackMessage ||
                  `This ${field.replace('_', ' ')} is already in use.`
              )
            : '',
          isTaken: taken,
        });
      } catch {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setState(IDLE_RESULT);
        }
      }
    }, debounceMs);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [
    enabled,
    field,
    value,
    minLength,
    minDigits,
    formatError,
    fallbackMessage,
    excludeId,
    excludeUserId,
    excludeTeacherId,
    debounceMs,
  ]);

  return state;
}

      (payload?: { kind?: AlarmToneKind }) => {
        const kind: AlarmToneKind = payload?.kind || 'TIME_IN';
        triggerMobileAlarm(buildTestMobileAlarm(kind));
      }
    );

    return () => {
      toggleSub.remove();
      testSub.remove();
      stopScheduleAlarmLoop();
      if (alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current);
        alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [triggerMobileAlarm]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user || !alarmsEnabled) {
      stopScheduleAlarmLoop();
      return;
    }
    let active = true;
    const controller = new AbortController();

    const syncAlarmData = async () => {
      try {
        const [campusRes, classesRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
          apiClient.get<{
            duty_start_time?: string;
            duty_end_time?: string;
            teacher_list?: Array<{
              teacher_id?: number;
              user_id?: number;
              is_clocked_in?: boolean;
              time_in?: string | null;
              time_out?: string | null;
            }>;
          }>(ENDPOINTS.CAMPUS_OVERVIEW, { signal: controller.signal }),
          canScanStudentQr(user)
            ? apiClient.get<
                | Array<{
                    id: number;
                    subject_code?: string;
                    subject_title?: string;
                    subject_name?: string;
                    section_name?: string;
                    room_number?: string;
                    room?: string;
                    start_time?: string;
                    end_time?: string;
                    day_of_week?: string;
                  }>
                | { results?: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }
              >(ENDPOINTS.ATTENDANCE_CLASSES, {
                params: { summary: 1 },
                signal: controller.signal,
              })
            : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),
        ]);

        if (!active || controller.signal.aborted) return;

        let dutyStartTime = '';
        let dutyEndTime = '';
        let isTimedInToday = false;

        if (campusRes.status === 'fulfilled' && campusRes.value?.data) {
          const campus = campusRes.value.data;
          const ownTeacher = Array.isArray(campus.teacher_list)
            ? campus.teacher_list.find(
                (t) =>
                  (user.teacher_id && Number(t.teacher_id) === Number(user.teacher_id)) ||
                  (user.id && Number(t.user_id) === Number(user.id))
              )
            : undefined;

          if (ownTeacher || String(user.role || '').toUpperCase() === 'TEACHER') {
            dutyStartTime = String(campus.duty_start_time || '');
            dutyEndTime = String(campus.duty_end_time || '');
            isTimedInToday = Boolean(
              ownTeacher?.is_clocked_in || (ownTeacher?.time_in && !ownTeacher?.time_out)
            );
          }
        }

        let periods: MobileAlarmPeriod[] = [];
        if (classesRes.status === 'fulfilled' && classesRes.value?.data) {
          const rawData = classesRes.value.data;
          const rawList = Array.isArray(rawData)
            ? rawData
            : Array.isArray((rawData as { results?: unknown[] }).results)
              ? (rawData as { results: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }).results
              : [];
          periods = rawList
            .filter((item) => Boolean(item && item.start_time))
            .map((item) => ({
              id: Number(item.id || 0),
              subject_code: String(item.subject_code || ''),
              subject_name: String(item.subject_title || item.subject_name || item.subject_code || 'Class Period'),
              section_name: String(item.section_name || ''),
              room: String(item.room_number || item.room || ''),
              start_time: String(item.start_time || ''),
              end_time: String(item.end_time || ''),
              day_of_week: String(item.day_of_week || 'ALL_WEEKDAYS'),
            }));
        }

        alarmSnapshotRef.current = {
          dutyStartTime,
          dutyEndTime,
          isTimedInToday,
          periods,
        };
      } catch {
        // Ignore transient network errors while syncing alarm schedule
      }
    };

    const tickEvaluate = async () => {
      if (!active || activeAlarmRef.current || !alarmsEnabledRef.current) return;
      const due = await evaluateDueMobileAlarm(alarmSnapshotRef.current, new Date());
      if (due && active && !activeAlarmRef.current) {
        triggerMobileAlarm(due);
      }
    };

    void syncAlarmData().then(() => void tickEvaluate());
    const syncInterval = setInterval(() => void syncAlarmData(), 5 * 60 * 1000);
    const tickInterval = setInterval(() => void tickEvaluate(), 15 * 1000);
    const attUpdateSub = DeviceEventEmitter.addListener('attendsure:attendance-updated', () => {
      void syncAlarmData();
    });

    return () => {
      active = false;
      controller.abort();
      clearInterval(syncInterval);
      clearInterval(tickInterval);
      attUpdateSub.remove();
    };
  }, [user, alarmsEnabled, triggerMobileAlarm]);

  const fetchDTR = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      dtrAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      dtrAbortRef.current = controller;

      if (!silent && isMounted.current) setDtrLoading(true);
      const cacheKey = `attendsure_dtr_menu_${selectedDtrTeacherId || 'self'}_${dtrMonth}_${dtrYear}`;

      try {
        const cached = await AsyncStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
        if (cached && isMounted.current && !controller.signal.aborted) {
          setDtrData(JSON.parse(cached));
        }
      } catch {}

      try {
        const params: Record<string, number> = { month: dtrMonth, year: dtrYear };
        if (allowDtrSwitcher && selectedDtrTeacherId) {
          params.teacher_id = selectedDtrTeacherId;
        }
        const [res, teachersRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
          apiClient.get<DTRReportData>(ENDPOINTS.EMPLOYEE_DTR, {
            params,
            signal: controller.signal,
          }),
          allowDtrSwitcher && dtrTeachers.length === 0
            ? apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.TEACHERS_DROPDOWN, { signal: controller.signal })
            : Promise.resolve(null),
        ]);
        if (isMounted.current && !controller.signal.aborted) {
          if (teachersRes.status === 'fulfilled' && teachersRes.value?.data) {
            const rawT = teachersRes.value.data;
            setDtrTeachers(Array.isArray(rawT) ? rawT : Array.isArray(rawT?.results) ? rawT.results : []);
          }
          if (res.status === 'fulfilled' && res.value?.data) {
            const payload = res.value.data;
            setDtrData(payload);
            if (payload.regular_days_hours) setDtrRegularHours(payload.regular_days_hours);
            if (payload.saturdays_hours) setDtrSaturdayHours(payload.saturdays_hours);
            await AsyncStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(payload)).catch(() => {});
          }
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        if (isCanceledError(err)) return;
      } finally {
        if (isMounted.current && !silent) {
          setDtrLoading(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [dtrMonth, dtrYear, allowDtrSwitcher, selectedDtrTeacherId, dtrTeachers.length]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
      dtrAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab === 'dtr') {
      void fetchDTR(false);
    }
    return () => {
      dtrAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [activeTab, fetchDTR]);

  const handleSubmitDtr = async (action: 'SUBMIT_DTR' | 'APPROVE_DEPT_HEAD' = 'SUBMIT_DTR') => {
    if (!dtrData || dtrSubmitting) return;
    setDtrSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const encodedTeacherId = encodeURIComponent(String(dtrData.teacher_id));
      await apiClient.post(`${ENDPOINTS.EMPLOYEE_DTR}${encodedTeacherId}/`, {
        action,
        teacher_id: dtrData.teacher_id,
        month: dtrData.month_number,
        year: dtrData.year,
        regular_days_hours: dtrRegularHours.trim() || dtrData.regular_days_hours,
        saturdays_hours: dtrSaturdayHours.trim() || dtrData.saturdays_hours,
      });
      showNotice(
        action === 'APPROVE_DEPT_HEAD' ? 'Approved' : 'Submitted',
        action === 'APPROVE_DEPT_HEAD'
          ? 'Daily Time Record approved and verified.'
          : 'Your Daily Time Record has been sent to your Department Head.'
      );
      void fetchDTR(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showNotice(
        'Unable to Update DTR',
        getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not submit Daily Time Record right now.')
      );
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setDtrSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const renderSubHeader = (title: string, subtitle: string, backTarget: TabType = 'menu') => (
    <View style={[styles.subHeader, { paddingTop: Math.max(insets.top, 14) }]}>
      <View style={styles.subHeaderTop}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.backCircle}
          onPress={() => setActiveTab(backTarget)}
          activeOpacity={0.75}
          accessibilityLabel="Go back"
        >
          <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={20} color={palette.onPrimary} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <View style={styles.subHeaderTextWrap}>
          <Text style={styles.subHeaderEyebrow}>ACCOUNT &amp; TOOLS</Text>
          <Text style={styles.subHeaderTitle} numberOfLines={1}>
            {title}
          </Text>
          <Text style={styles.subHeaderSubtitle} numberOfLines={1}>
            {subtitle}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );

  const allowStudentQr = canScanStudentQr(user);

  // Strict 5-Tab Bottom Dock: Overview, Scanner/Time In/Out, Geofence, Passes, Account
  const navItems: Array<{
    key: TabType;
    label: string;
    icon: keyof typeof Ionicons.glyphMap;
    activeIcon: keyof typeof Ionicons.glyphMap;
  }> = useMemo(
    () => [
      { key: 'home', label: 'Overview', icon: 'home-outline', activeIcon: 'home' },
      {
        key: 'scanner',
        label: allowStudentQr ? 'Scanner' : 'Time In/Out',
        icon: allowStudentQr ? 'scan-outline' : 'finger-print-outline',
        activeIcon: allowStudentQr ? 'scan' : 'finger-print',
      },
      { key: 'geofence', label: 'Geofence', icon: 'navigate-outline', activeIcon: 'navigate' },
      { key: 'gate_pass', label: 'Passes', icon: 'clipboard-outline', activeIcon: 'clipboard' },
      { key: 'menu', label: 'Account', icon: 'person-outline', activeIcon: 'person' },
    ],
    [allowStudentQr]
  );

  const accountSubTabs: TabType[] = [
    'menu',
    'class_list',
    'students',
    'teachers',
    'schedules',
    'users',
    'settings',
    'sardo_safety',
    'calendar',
    'dtr',
    'reports',
  ];
  const resolvedNavKey: TabType = accountSubTabs.includes(activeTab) ? 'menu' : activeTab;

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <View style={styles.screenContainer}>
        {activeTab === 'home' && <DashboardScreen onNavigate={setActiveTab} />}
        {activeTab === 'scanner' && <ScannerScreen />}
        {activeTab === 'geofence' && <GeofenceStatusScreen onNavigate={setActiveTab} />}
        {activeTab === 'gate_pass' && <GatePassScreen />}
        {activeTab === 'menu' && <MenuScreen onSelectScreen={setActiveTab} />}

        {activeTab === 'class_list' && canViewTab(user, 'class_list') && (
          <View style={styles.subScreenFill}>
            {renderSubHeader('Class List & Matrix', 'Adviser & subject attendance tracking', 'menu')}
            <AdvisoryMatrixScreen />
          </View>
        )}
        {activeTab === 'students' && canViewTab(user, 'students') && (
          <View style={styles.subScreenFill}>
            {renderSubHeader('Students Directory', 'Add, edit, enroll and view QR ID passes', 'menu')}
            <StudentsScreen />
          </View>
        )}
        {activeTab === 'teachers' && canViewTab(user, 'teachers') && (
          <View style={styles.subScreenFill}>
            {renderSubHeader('Teachers', 'Manage teacher profiles and bound phones', 'menu')}
            <TeachersScreen />
          </View>
        )}
        {activeTab === 'schedules' && canViewTab(user, 'schedules') && (
          <View style={styles.subScreenFill}>
            {renderSubHeader('Academic Setup & Schedules', 'Sections, subjects and class periods', 'menu')}
            <SchedulesScreen />
          </View>
        )}
        {activeTab === 'users' && canViewTab(user, 'users') && (
          <View style={styles.subScreenFill}>
            {renderSubHeader('User Accounts & Roles', 'Create, update and manage login accounts', 'menu')}
            <UsersScreen />
          </View>
        )}
        {activeTab === 'reports' && canViewTab(user, 'reports') && (
          <View style={styles.subScreenFill}>
            {renderSubHeader('DepEd School Forms', 'SF1, SF2, SF4 and Form 48 records', 'menu')}
            <ReportsScreen embedded />
          </View>
        )}
        {activeTab === 'calendar' && (
          <View style={styles.subScreenFill}>
            {renderSubHeader('School Calendar', 'Suspensions, holidays and schedules', 'menu')}
            <CalendarScreen />
          </View>
        )}
        {activeTab === 'settings' && (
          <View style={styles.subScreenFill}>
            {renderSubHeader('Settings & School Setup', 'Profile, logos, alarms, maintenance & logs', 'menu')}
            <SettingsScreen />
          </View>
        )}
        {activeTab === 'sardo_safety' && canViewTab(user, 'sardo_safety') && (
          <View style={styles.subScreenFill}>
            {renderSubHeader('SARDO & Campus Safety', 'Early-warning, roll-call & division export', 'menu')}
            <SardoSafetyScreen />
          </View>
        )}
        {activeTab === 'dtr' && (
          <View style={styles.subScreenFill}>
            {renderSubHeader('Daily Time Record', 'Civil Service Form No. 48', 'menu')}
            <ScrollView
              contentContainerStyle={styles.subScreenScroll}
              showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
              refreshControl={
                <RefreshControl
                  refreshing={dtrLoading}
                  onRefresh={() => void fetchDTR(false)}
                  colors={[palette.primary]}
                  tintColor={palette.primary}
                />
              }
            >
              {/* Leader Teacher Switcher (Parity with Web DTRTab) */}
              {allowDtrSwitcher && dtrTeachers.length > 0 && (
                <View style={styles.dtrControlsCard}>
                  <Text style={styles.dtrControlsLabel}>INSPECT TEACHER DTR</Text>
                  <ScrollView
                    horizontal
                    showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
                    contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6, paddingVertical: 4 }}
                  >
                    <TouchableOpacity
                      style={[
                        styles.dtrChip,
                        selectedDtrTeacherId === null && styles.dtrChipActive,
                      ]}
                      onPress={() => setSelectedDtrTeacherId(null)}
                    >
                      <Text
                        style={[
                          styles.dtrChipText,
                          selectedDtrTeacherId === null && styles.dtrChipTextActive,
                        ]}
                      >
                        My DTR
                      </Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    {dtrTeachers.map((t) => {
                      const active = selectedDtrTeacherId === t.id;
                      return (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                          key={t.id}
                          style={[styles.dtrChip, active && styles.dtrChipActive]}
                          onPress={() => setSelectedDtrTeacherId(t.id)}
                        >
                          <Text style={[styles.dtrChipText, active && styles.dtrChipTextActive]}>
                            {t.full_name}
                          </Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                      );
                    })}
                  </ScrollView>
                </View>
              )}

              {/* Prescribed Working Hours Inputs (Parity with Web DTRTab) */}
              {dtrData && (
                <View style={styles.dtrControlsCard}>
                  <Text style={styles.dtrControlsLabel}>PRESCRIBED WORKING HOURS</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    style={styles.dtrHoursInput}
                    value={dtrRegularHours}
                    onChangeText={setDtrRegularHours}
                    placeholder="Regular Days (e.g. 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM / 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM)"
                    placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                  />
                  <TextInput
                    style={styles.dtrHoursInput}
                    value={dtrSaturdayHours}
                    onChangeText={setDtrSaturdayHours}
                    placeholder="Saturdays (e.g. As Required)"
                    placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                  />
                  {dtrData.can_approve_dept && !dtrData.dept_head_approved && (
                    <TouchableOpacity
                      style={[styles.dtrApproveBtn, dtrSubmitting && { opacity: 0.65 }]}
                      disabled={dtrSubmitting}
                      onPress={() => void handleSubmitDtr('APPROVE_DEPT_HEAD')}
                    >
                      <Ionicons name="shield-checkmark-outline" size={16} color={palette.onPrimary} />
                      <Text style={styles.dtrApproveBtnText}>Approve DTR (Dept Head / Principal)</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  )}
                </View>
              )}

              {dtrLoading && !dtrData ? (
                <View style={styles.loadingBox}>
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
                  <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Loading attendance records...</Text>
                </View>
              ) : (
                <DTRReportView
                  data={
                    dtrData
                      ? {
                          ...dtrData,
                          regular_days_hours: dtrRegularHours,
                          saturdays_hours: dtrSaturdayHours,
                        }
                      : null
                  }
                  selectedMonth={dtrMonth}
                  selectedYear={dtrYear}
                  onMonthChange={(m, y) => {
                    setDtrMonth(m);
                    setDtrYear(y);
                  }}
                  submitting={dtrSubmitting}
                  onSubmit={() => void handleSubmitDtr('SUBMIT_DTR')}
                  onRefreshNeeded={() => void fetchDTR(true)}
                />
              )}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Floating 5-Tab Bottom Navigation Dock */}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.floatingDockWrapper,
          { paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom, 10) },
        ]}
        pointerEvents="box-none"
      >
        <View style={styles.floatingDock} pointerEvents="auto">
          {navItems.map((item) => {
            const isFocused = resolvedNavKey === item.key;
            return (
              <TouchableOpacity
                key={item.key}
                onPress={() => setActiveTab(item.key)}
                activeOpacity={0.8}
                style={[styles.navPillBtn, isFocused && styles.navPillBtnActive]}
                accessibilityRole="tab"
                accessibilityState={{ selected: isFocused }}
                accessibilityLabel={item.label}
              >
                <Ionicons
                  name={isFocused ? item.activeIcon : item.icon}
                  size={20}
                  color={isFocused ? palette.primary : palette.textMuted}
                />
                {isFocused && (
                  <Text style={styles.navPillText} numberOfLines={1}>
                    {item.label}
                  </Text>
                )}
              </TouchableOpacity>
            );
          })}
        </View>
      </View>
      <ScheduleAlarmModal
        alarm={activeAlarm}
        onDismiss={handleDismissAlarm}
        onSnooze={handleSnoozeAlarm}
        onAction={(targetTab) => {
          handleDismissAlarm();
          setActiveTab(targetTab);
        }}
      />
    </View>
  );
};

  subject_code: string;

interface AdviseeRow {
  number: number;
  student_id: number;
  student_name: string;
  lrn: string;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  campus_status?: string;
  presence_state?: 'IN' | 'OUT' | 'NONE';
  attended_count: number;
  cutting_count: number;
  total_subjects: number;
  compliance_rate: number;
  subjects: SubjectStatus[];
}

interface CachedClassListPayload {
  has_advisory_class: boolean;
  section_name: string;
  grade_level: string;
  matrix: AdviseeRow[];
}

const triggerSafeWebPrint = (rawHtml: string): void => {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined' || typeof Blob === 'undefined' || typeof URL === 'undefined') {
    return;
  }
  const safeHtml = String(rawHtml || '')
    .replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '')
    .replace(/\son[a-z]+\s*=\s*("[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s>]+)/gi, '')
    .replace(/javascript:/gi, '');
  const blob = new Blob([safeHtml], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });
  const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
  iframe.setAttribute('sandbox', 'allow-modals allow-same-origin');
  iframe.style.position = 'fixed';
  iframe.style.top = '-10000px';
  iframe.style.left = '-10000px';
  iframe.style.width = '1200px';
  iframe.style.height = '900px';
  iframe.style.border = '0';
  iframe.onload = () => {
    try {
      iframe.contentWindow?.focus();
      iframe.contentWindow?.print();
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
        if (iframe.parentNode) iframe.parentNode.removeChild(iframe);
      }, 1500);
    }
  };
  iframe.src = blobUrl;
  document.body.appendChild(iframe);
};

export const AdvisoryMatrixScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const { palette, ui, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [filterMode, setFilterMode] = useState<'ALL' | 'CUTTING'>('ALL');
  const [hasAdvisoryClass, setHasAdvisoryClass] = useState(false);
  const [sectionName, setSectionName] = useState('');
  const [gradeLevel, setGradeLevel] = useState('');
  const [matrix, setMatrix] = useState<AdviseeRow[]>([]);
  const [serverBase, setServerBase] = useState('');
  const [selectedStudentIds, setSelectedStudentIds] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [exportingPack, setExportingPack] = useState<'CLASS_LIST' | 'CLASS_SCHEDULE' | null>(null);

  const isMountedRef = useRef(true);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const fetchClassListData = useCallback(async (fromCacheFirst = false) => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;

    if (fromCacheFirst) {
      try {
        const [cachedStr, base] = await Promise.all([
          AsyncStorage.getItem(CLASS_LIST_CACHE_KEY),
          getServerBaseUrl(),
        ]);
        if (isMountedRef.current && !controller.signal.aborted) {
          if (base) setServerBase(base);
          if (cachedStr) {
            const parsed: CachedClassListPayload = JSON.parse(cachedStr);
            setHasAdvisoryClass(Boolean(parsed.has_advisory_class));
            setSectionName(parsed.section_name || '');
            setGradeLevel(parsed.grade_level || '');
            setMatrix(Array.isArray(parsed.matrix) ? parsed.matrix : []);
          }
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get<CachedClassListPayload>(ENDPOINTS.ADVISER_MATRIX, {
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (!isMountedRef.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

      setErrorMsg(null);
      if (res.data?.has_advisory_class) {
        const payload: CachedClassListPayload = {
          has_advisory_class: true,
          section_name: res.data.section_name || '',
          grade_level: res.data.grade_level || '',
          matrix: Array.isArray(res.data.matrix) ? res.data.matrix : [],
        };
        setHasAdvisoryClass(true);
        setSectionName(payload.section_name);
        setGradeLevel(payload.grade_level);
        setMatrix(payload.matrix);
        AsyncStorage.setItem(CLASS_LIST_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(payload)).catch(() => {});
      } else {
        setHasAdvisoryClass(false);
        setMatrix([]);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current || isCanceledError(err)) return;
      setErrorMsg(getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not load your class list right now.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    void fetchClassListData(true);
    const sub = DeviceEventEmitter.addListener('attendsure:attendance-updated', () => {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        void fetchClassListData(false);
      }
    });
    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      sub.remove();
    };
  }, [fetchClassListData]);

  const cleanSearch = cleanText(search, 80).toLowerCase();

  const filteredMatrix = useMemo(() => {
    return matrix.filter((row) => {
      const matchSearch =
        !cleanSearch ||
        String(row.student_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) ||
        String(row.lrn || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch);
      if (!matchSearch) return false;
      return filterMode === 'CUTTING' ? row.cutting_count > 0 : true;
    });
  }, [matrix, cleanSearch, filterMode]);

  const cuttingTotal = useMemo(
    () => matrix.filter((m) => m.cutting_count > 0).length,
    [matrix]
  );

  const toggleStudentPick = (studentId: number) => {
    setSelectedStudentIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(studentId) ? prev.filter((id) => id !== studentId) : [...prev, studentId]
    );
  };

  const handleExportAdvisoryPack = async (packType: 'CLASS_LIST' | 'CLASS_SCHEDULE') => {
    setExportingPack(packType);
    try {
      const useSelected = packType === 'CLASS_LIST' && selectedStudentIds.length > 0;
      const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
        pack_type: packType,
        scope: useSelected ? 'SELECTED' : 'ALL',
        export_format: Platform.OS === 'web' ? 'html' : 'json',
        wrap_json: Platform.OS === 'web',
        action_mode: Platform.OS === 'web' ? 'PRINT' : 'EXPORT',
      };
      if (useSelected) {
        body.student_ids = selectedStudentIds;
      }

      const res = await apiClient.post(ENDPOINTS.REPORT_PRINT_PACK, body);
      if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
        const html = typeof res.data === 'string' ? res.data : res.data?.html || '';
        if (html) triggerSafeWebPrint(html);
      } else if (packType === 'CLASS_LIST') {
        const lists = Array.isArray(res.data?.class_lists) ? res.data.class_lists : [];
        const lines: string[] = [

        lists.forEach((cl: any) => {

          });

        await Share.share({

      } else {

                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  );
                })}
              </View>
            </View>
          );
        }}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

const CACHED_CALENDAR_KEY = 'attendsure_cached_calendar_data';

interface CalendarException {
  id: number;
  type: 'SUSPENSION' | 'HOLIDAY' | 'EVENT';
  date: string;
  reason: string;
  affects_all_grades?: boolean;
  created_at?: string;
}

const getLocalTodayDateString = (): string => {
  const now = new Date();
  const year = now.getFullYear();
  const month = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
};

const isValidIsoDate = (dateStr: string): boolean => {
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])$/.exec(dateStr);
  if (!match) return false;
  const year = Number(match[1]);
  const month = Number(match[2]);
  const day = Number(match[3]);
  const dt = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
  return dt.getFullYear() === year && dt.getMonth() === month - 1 && dt.getDate() === day;
};

export const CalendarScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);

  const isMounted = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const isAdmin = canManageSchoolSetup(user);

  const [exceptionDate, setExceptionDate] = useState<string>(getLocalTodayDateString);

  const [exceptions, setExceptions] = useState<CalendarException[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // 1. Cache-First Initialization
  const loadCachedCalendar = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const cached = await AsyncStorage.getItem(CACHED_CALENDAR_KEY);
      if (cached && isMounted.current) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (typeof parsed.weekend_rest_enabled === 'boolean') {
          weekendRestRef.current = parsed.weekend_rest_enabled;
          setWeekendRestEnabled(parsed.weekend_rest_enabled);
        }
        if (Array.isArray(parsed.exceptions)) {
          setExceptions(parsed.exceptions);
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Live network fetch will populate state
    }
  }, []);

  // 2. Stable Data Fetching Callback
  const fetchCalendarData = useCallback(async () => {
    abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortControllerRef.current = controller;

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.HOLIDAYS, {
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      const payload = res.data;

      if (!isMounted.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

      let nextWeekendRest = weekendRestRef.current;
      let nextExceptions: CalendarException[] = [];

      if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && !Array.isArray(payload)) {
        if (typeof payload.weekend_rest_enabled === 'boolean') {
          nextWeekendRest = payload.weekend_rest_enabled;
          weekendRestRef.current = payload.weekend_rest_enabled;
          setWeekendRestEnabled(payload.weekend_rest_enabled);
        }
        nextExceptions = Array.isArray(payload.results) ? payload.results : [];
      } else if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
        nextExceptions = payload;
      }

      setExceptions(nextExceptions);

      AsyncStorage.setItem(
        CACHED_CALENDAR_KEY,
        JSON.stringify({
          weekend_rest_enabled: nextWeekendRest,
          exceptions: nextExceptions,
        })
      ).catch(() => {});
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (isCanceledError(err)) return;
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    void loadCachedCalendar().then(() => {
      if (isMounted.current) {
        void fetchCalendarData();
      }
    });

    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
      abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [loadCachedCalendar, fetchCalendarData]);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    void fetchCalendarData();
  }, [fetchCalendarData]);

  // 3. Weekend Rest Toggle
  const handleToggleWeekendRest = async (value: boolean) => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    const previousValue = weekendRestEnabled;
    weekendRestRef.current = value;
    setWeekendRestEnabled(value);

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.patch(ENDPOINTS.HOLIDAYS, {
        weekend_rest_enabled: value,
      });
      if (isMounted.current && typeof res.data?.weekend_rest_enabled === 'boolean') {
        weekendRestRef.current = res.data.weekend_rest_enabled;
        setWeekendRestEnabled(res.data.weekend_rest_enabled);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      weekendRestRef.current = previousValue;
      if (isMounted.current) setWeekendRestEnabled(previousValue);
      showNotice(
        'Update Failed',
        getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not save weekend rest setting.')
      );
    }
  };

  // 4. Input Sanitization & Override Submission
  const handleAddException = async () => {
    if (!isAdmin) {
      showNotice('Permission Required', 'Only school administrators can add calendar overrides.');
      return;
    }

    const cleanedReason = cleanText(exceptionReason, 255);
    const cleanedDate = cleanText(exceptionDate, 10);

    if (!cleanedReason) {
      showNotice('Required', 'Please enter a reason or school notice.');
      return;
    }

    if (!isValidIsoDate(cleanedDate)) {
      showNotice('Invalid Date', 'Please enter a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        type: selectedType,
        date: cleanedDate,
        reason: cleanedReason,
        affects_all_grades: true,
      };

      if (editingExceptionId) {
        const res = await apiClient.patch<CalendarException>(
          `${ENDPOINTS.HOLIDAYS}${encodeURIComponent(String(editingExceptionId))}/`,
          payload
        );
        if (!isMounted.current) return;
        if (res.data && res.data.id) {
          setExceptions((prev) => prev.map((i) => (i.id === res.data.id ? res.data : i)));
        } else {
          await fetchCalendarData();
        }
        setEditingExceptionId(null);
        setExceptionReason('');
        showNotice('Updated', 'Calendar override updated.');
      } else {
        const res = await apiClient.post<CalendarException>(ENDPOINTS.HOLIDAYS, payload);
        if (!isMounted.current) return;

        if (res.data && res.data.id) {
          setExceptions((prev) => [res.data, ...prev.filter((i) => i.id !== res.data.id)]);
        } else {
          await fetchCalendarData();
        }

        setExceptionReason('');
        showNotice('Saved', 'Calendar override saved.');
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      showNotice(
        'Save Failed',
        getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not save calendar override right now.')
      );
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) {
        setSubmitting(false);
      }
    }
  };

  // 5. Deletion Handler with Numeric ID Validation
  const executeDeleteException = async (id: number) => {
    if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) return;

    try {
      await apiClient.delete(`${ENDPOINTS.HOLIDAYS}${encodeURIComponent(String(id))}/`);
      if (isMounted.current) {
        setExceptions((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showNotice('Error', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not remove this calendar override.'));
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteException = (id: number) => {
    if (!isAdmin) {
      showNotice('Permission Required', 'Only school administrators can remove overrides.');
      return;
    }

    confirmAction(
      'Confirm Delete',
      'Remove this calendar override?',
      'Delete',
      () => void executeDeleteException(id)
    );
  };

  const getBadgeColors = (type: CalendarException['type']) => {
    if (type === 'SUSPENSION') return { bg: palette.dangerLight, text: palette.danger };
    if (type === 'HOLIDAY') return { bg: palette.warningLight, text: palette.warning };
    return { bg: palette.infoLight, text: palette.info };
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            colors={[palette.primary]}
            tintColor={palette.primary}
          />
        }
      >
        {/* Weekend Rest Card */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.weekendCardRow}>
            <View style={styles.cardIconBox}>
              <Ionicons name="calendar" size={20} color={palette.primary} />
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginRight: 10 }}>
              <Text style={styles.cardHeading}>Weekend Rest</Text>
              <Text style={styles.cardDetailText}>
                Saturdays and Sundays are excluded from required attendance logging
              </Text>
            </View>
            {isAdmin ? (
              <Switch
                value={weekendRestEnabled}
                onValueChange={(val) => void handleToggleWeekendRest(val)}
                trackColor={{ false: palette.borderStrong, true: palette.primarySoft }}
                thumbColor={weekendRestEnabled ? palette.buttonBg : palette.surface}
              />
            ) : (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.readOnlyPill,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: weekendRestEnabled
                      ? palette.successLight
                      : palette.surfaceSubtle,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <Text
                  style={[
                    styles.readOnlyPillText,
                    { color: weekendRestEnabled ? palette.success : palette.textMuted },
                  ]}
                >
                  {weekendRestEnabled ? 'ACTIVE' : 'OFF'}
                </Text>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Admin Form: Add / Edit Override */}
        {isAdmin ? (
          <View style={styles.card}>
            <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderTitle}>
              {editingExceptionId ? 'EDIT SCHEDULE OVERRIDE' : 'ADD SCHEDULE OVERRIDE'}
            </Text>

            <View style={styles.fieldRow}>
              <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Effective Date (YYYY-MM-DD)</Text>
              <View style={styles.inputBox}>
                <Ionicons
                  name="calendar-outline"
                  size={16}
                  color={palette.textMuted}
                  style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
                />
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.inputText}
                  value={exceptionDate}
                  onChangeText={setExceptionDate}
                  placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD"
                  placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                  autoCapitalize="none"
                  maxLength={10}
                />
              </View>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.fieldRow}>
              <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Category</Text>
              <View style={styles.typeSelectorRow}>
                {(['SUSPENSION', 'HOLIDAY', 'EVENT'] as const).map((type) => {
                  const active = selectedType === type;
                  return (
                    <TouchableOpacity
                      key={type}
                      style={[styles.typePill, active && styles.typePillActive]}
                      onPress={() => setSelectedType(type)}
                      activeOpacity={0.8}
                    >
                      <Text style={[styles.typePillText, active && styles.typePillTextActive]}>
                        {type}
                      </Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  );
                })}
              </View>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.fieldRow}>
              <Text style={styles.fieldLabel}>Reason / School Notice</Text>
              <View style={[styles.inputBox, { height: 44 }]}>
                <Ionicons
                  name="document-text-outline"
                  size={16}
                  color={palette.textMuted}
                  style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
                />
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.inputText}
                  placeholder="Enter official reason or notice"
                  placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                  value={exceptionReason}
                  onChangeText={setExceptionReason}
                  maxLength={255}
                />
              </View>
            </View>

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.addOverrideBtn, submitting && styles.btnDisabled]}
              onPress={() => void handleAddException()}
              disabled={submitting}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
            >
              {submitting ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.onPrimary} />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Ionicons
                    name="add-circle-outline"
                    size={16}
                    color={palette.onPrimary}
                    style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
                  />
                  <Text style={styles.addOverrideBtnText}>
                    {editingExceptionId ? 'Save Changes' : 'Save Override'}
                  </Text>
                </>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
            {editingExceptionId ? (
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={{ marginTop: 8, alignItems: 'center', paddingVertical: 6 }}
                onPress={() => {
                  setEditingExceptionId(null);
                  setExceptionReason('');
                  setExceptionDate(getLocalTodayDateString());
                }}
              >
                <Text style={{ fontSize: fonts.xs, fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: palette.textSecondary }}>
                  Cancel Edit
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.infoBanner}>
            <Ionicons name="information-circle-outline" size={18} color={palette.primary} />
            <Text style={styles.infoBannerText}>
              Class suspensions, holidays, and schedule overrides are managed by the School Admin.
            </Text>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Active Overrides List */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <View style={styles.listHeaderRow}>
            <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderTitle}>
              ACTIVE OVERRIDES ({exceptions.length})
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.listSubText}>Overrides regular schedule</Text>
          </View>

          {loading && exceptions.length === 0 ? (
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} style={{ marginVertical: 14 }} />
          ) : exceptions.length === 0 ? (
            <Text style={styles.noExceptionsText}>No active date overrides set.</Text>
          ) : (
            exceptions.map((item) => {
              const badge = getBadgeColors(item.type);
              return (
                <View key={String(item.id)} style={styles.exceptionItemRow}>
                  <View style={[styles.typeBadge, { backgroundColor: badge.bg }]}>
                    <Text style={[styles.typeBadgeText, { color: badge.text }]}>{item.type}</Text>
                  </View>

                  <View style={{ flex: 1, marginHorizontal: 12 }}>
                    <Text style={styles.exceptionDateText}>{item.date}</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.exceptionReasonText}>{item.reason}</Text>
                  </View>

                  {isAdmin && (
                    <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 6 }}>
                      <TouchableOpacity
                        onPress={() => {
                          setEditingExceptionId(item.id);
                          setSelectedType(item.type || 'HOLIDAY');
                          setExceptionDate(item.date || getLocalTodayDateString());
                          setExceptionReason(item.reason || '');
                        }}
                        style={styles.deleteBtn}
                        activeOpacity={0.7}
                        accessibilityLabel="Edit override"
                      >
                        <Ionicons name="create-outline" size={16} color={palette.primary} />
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                      <TouchableOpacity
                        onPress={() => handleDeleteException(item.id)}
                        style={styles.deleteBtn}
                        activeOpacity={0.7}
                        accessibilityLabel="Delete override"
                      >
                        <Ionicons name="trash-outline" size={16} color={palette.danger} />
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                    </View>
                  )}
                </View>
              );
            })
          )}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
};

const getLocalTodayStr = (): string => {
  const now = new Date();
  const y = now.getFullYear();
  const m = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const d = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
};

const getGreeting = (): string => {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  if (hour < 12) return 'Good morning';
  if (hour < 17) return 'Good afternoon';
  return 'Good evening';
};
