  useEffect(() => {
    void setTeacherOnDutyFlag(isOfficiallyOnDuty);
  }, [isOfficiallyOnDuty]);

  const applyStationaryFilter = useCallback((raw: LiveGpsCoords): LiveGpsCoords => {
    const anchor = anchorCoordsRef.current;
    if (!anchor) {
      anchorCoordsRef.current = raw;
      return raw;
    }

    const displacement = calculateDistanceMeters(
      anchor.latitude,
      anchor.longitude,
      raw.latitude,
      raw.longitude
    );

    if (displacement < 6) {
      return {
        latitude: anchor.latitude,
        longitude: anchor.longitude,
        accuracy: raw.accuracy ?? anchor.accuracy,
        mocked: raw.mocked,
        timestamp: raw.timestamp,
      };
    }

    anchorCoordsRef.current = raw;
    return raw;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let watcherSubscription: Location.LocationSubscription | null = null;
    let heartbeatIntervalTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
    let isSubscribed = true;

    const transmitHeartbeat = async (coords: LiveGpsCoords, force = false) => {
      if (coords.mocked) {
        if (isSubscribed) {
          setGpsError(
            'A mock location setting appears to be turned on. Disable it in your phone settings to update your campus status.'
          );
        }
        return;
      }
      try {
        await sendLiveHeartbeat(coords, force);
        if (isSubscribed) {
          setIsOnline(true);
          setGpsError(null);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        if (!isSubscribed) return;
        const msg = getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not verify your campus location right now.');
        const lower = msg.toLowerCase();
        if (lower.includes('lock') || lower.includes('mismatch') || lower.includes('permission') || lower.includes('mock')) {
          setGpsError(msg);
          setIsOnline(false);
        }
      }
    };

    const startLiveGpsTracking = async () => {
      try {
        const { status } = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync();
        if (!isSubscribed) return;
        if (status !== 'granted') {
          setGpsError('Location access is needed for Teacher Time In / Time Out.');
          return;
        }

        const isGpsActive = await Location.hasServicesEnabledAsync();
        if (!isSubscribed) return;
        if (!isGpsActive) {
          setGpsError('Phone GPS is turned off.');
          return;
        }

        setGpsError(null);

        const initial = await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({
          accuracy: Location.Accuracy.High,
        });
        if (!isSubscribed) return;

        if (initial) {
          const rawCoords: LiveGpsCoords = {
            latitude: initial.coords.latitude,
            longitude: initial.coords.longitude,
            accuracy: initial.coords.accuracy,
            mocked: Boolean(initial.mocked),
            timestamp: format12HourTime(new Date()),
          };

          const stabilized = applyStationaryFilter(rawCoords);
          setLiveCoords(stabilized);

          lastHeartbeatSent.current = Date.now();
          void transmitHeartbeat(stabilized, true);
        }

        if (!isSubscribed) return;
        const sub = await Location.watchPositionAsync(
          {
            accuracy: Location.Accuracy.High,
            timeInterval: 5000,
            distanceInterval: 3,
          },
          (position) => {
            if (!isSubscribed) return;

            const rawCoords: LiveGpsCoords = {
              latitude: position.coords.latitude,
              longitude: position.coords.longitude,
              accuracy: position.coords.accuracy,
              mocked: Boolean(position.mocked),
              timestamp: format12HourTime(new Date()),
            };

            const stabilized = applyStationaryFilter(rawCoords);
            setLiveCoords(stabilized);
            setGpsError(null);

            const now = Date.now();
            if (now - lastHeartbeatSent.current >= ADAPTIVE_PING_INTERVAL_MS) {
              lastHeartbeatSent.current = now;
              void transmitHeartbeat(stabilized);
            }
          }
        );

        // Clean up immediately if unmounted while awaiting watchPositionAsync
        if (!isSubscribed) {
          sub.remove();
          return;
        }
        watcherSubscription = sub;

        heartbeatIntervalTimer = setInterval(async () => {
          if (!isSubscribed) return;
          const now = Date.now();
          if (now - lastHeartbeatSent.current < ADAPTIVE_PING_INTERVAL_MS) return;

          try {
            const freshLoc = await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({
              accuracy: Location.Accuracy.High,
            });
            if (!isSubscribed) return;
            const rawCoords: LiveGpsCoords = {
              latitude: freshLoc.coords.latitude,
              longitude: freshLoc.coords.longitude,
              accuracy: freshLoc.coords.accuracy,
              mocked: Boolean(freshLoc.mocked),
              timestamp: format12HourTime(new Date()),
            };
            const stabilized = applyStationaryFilter(rawCoords);
            setLiveCoords(stabilized);
            lastHeartbeatSent.current = now;
            void transmitHeartbeat(stabilized);
          } catch {
            if (!isSubscribed) return;
            if (anchorCoordsRef.current) {
              lastHeartbeatSent.current = now;
              const updated = {
                ...anchorCoordsRef.current,
                timestamp: format12HourTime(new Date()),
              };
              setLiveCoords(updated);
              void transmitHeartbeat(updated);
            }
          }
        }, ADAPTIVE_PING_INTERVAL_MS);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        if (isSubscribed) {
          setGpsError(getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Searching for GPS signal...'));
        }
      }
    };

    void startLiveGpsTracking();

    return () => {
      isSubscribed = false;
      if (watcherSubscription) {
        watcherSubscription.remove();
        watcherSubscription = null;
      }
      if (heartbeatIntervalTimer) {
        clearInterval(heartbeatIntervalTimer);
        heartbeatIntervalTimer = null;
      }
    };
  }, [currentUser?.username, currentUser?.id, applyStationaryFilter]);

  const campusCenter = useMemo(() => {
    const lat = geofenceConfig?.latitude ?? schoolProfile?.latitude ?? null;
    const lng = geofenceConfig?.longitude ?? schoolProfile?.longitude ?? null;
    const radius = geofenceConfig?.radius_meters ?? schoolProfile?.geofence_radius_meters ?? null;
    return { lat, lng, radius };
  }, [geofenceConfig, schoolProfile]);

  const liveDistanceMeters = useMemo(() => {
    if (!liveCoords || campusCenter.lat === null || campusCenter.lng === null) {
      return null;
    }
    return calculateDistanceMeters(
      liveCoords.latitude,
      liveCoords.longitude,
      campusCenter.lat,
      campusCenter.lng
    );
  }, [liveCoords, campusCenter]);

  const isInsideCampusPerimeter = useMemo(() => {
    if (liveDistanceMeters === null || campusCenter.radius === null) return null;
    return liveDistanceMeters <= campusCenter.radius;
  }, [liveDistanceMeters, campusCenter.radius]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isInsideCampusPerimeter === false && isOfficiallyOnDuty && campusCenter.radius !== null) {
      const accuracyMargin = liveCoords?.accuracy || 0;
      const excessDistance = (liveDistanceMeters || 0) - campusCenter.radius;

      if (excessDistance <= accuracyMargin) {
        return;
      }

      const now = Date.now();
      if (!campusAlertAcknowledged || now - lastCampusAlertTimestamp.current > 300000) {
        setShowCampusAlertModal(true);
        lastCampusAlertTimestamp.current = now;
        if (Platform.OS !== 'web') {
          Vibration.vibrate([0, 150, 100, 150]);
        }
      }
    } else if (isInsideCampusPerimeter === true) {
      setShowCampusAlertModal(false);
      setCampusAlertAcknowledged(false);
    }
  }, [
    isInsideCampusPerimeter,
    isOfficiallyOnDuty,
    liveDistanceMeters,
    liveCoords,
    campusCenter.radius,
    campusAlertAcknowledged,
  ]);

  const handleDismissCampusAlert = () => {
    setShowCampusAlertModal(false);
    setCampusAlertAcknowledged(true);
  };

  const loadCachedData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const results = await Promise.allSettled([
        AsyncStorage.getItem('attendsure_cached_school'),
        AsyncStorage.getItem('attendsure_cached_sections'),
        AsyncStorage.getItem('attendsure_cached_dtr'),
        AsyncStorage.getItem('attendsure_cached_geofence'),
        getServerBaseUrl(),
      ]);

      if (!isMounted.current) return;

      const [schoolRes, sectionsRes, dtrRes, geoRes, baseRes] = results;
      if (schoolRes.status === 'fulfilled' && schoolRes.value) {
        setSchoolProfile(JSON.parse(schoolRes.value));
      }
      if (sectionsRes.status === 'fulfilled' && sectionsRes.value) {
        setSections(JSON.parse(sectionsRes.value));
      }
      if (dtrRes.status === 'fulfilled' && dtrRes.value) {
        setDtrData(JSON.parse(dtrRes.value));
      }
      if (geoRes.status === 'fulfilled' && geoRes.value) {
        setGeofenceConfig(JSON.parse(geoRes.value));
      }
      if (baseRes.status === 'fulfilled' && baseRes.value) {
        setServerBase(baseRes.value);
      }
    } catch {}
  }, []);

  const normalizeClasses = (rawList: any[]): SectionItem[] =>
    rawList.map((item: any, idx: number) => ({
      schedule_id: item.schedule_id || item.id || idx + 1,
      section_id: item.section_id || item.section?.id || item.id || 0,
      section_name: item.section_name || item.section?.name || item.name || '',
      subject_name: item.subject_name || item.subject?.name || item.subject_title || '',
      subject_code: item.subject_code || item.subject?.code || '',
      room: item.room || item.room_number || item.room?.name || '',
      start_time: typeof item.start_time === 'string' ? item.start_time : '',
      end_time: typeof item.end_time === 'string' ? item.end_time : '',
      total_students: Array.isArray(item.students)
        ? item.students.length
        : Number(item.total_students) || 0,
      students: Array.isArray(item.students) ? item.students : [],
    }));

  const flushOfflineRecords = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      if (isMounted.current) setIsSyncingQueue(true);
      const res = await syncOfflineQueue();
      const updatedCount = await getUnsyncedCount();
      if (isMounted.current) {
        setOfflineCount(updatedCount);
        if (res.synced > 0) {
          setIsOnline(true);
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Keep unsynced count intact until next retry
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setIsSyncingQueue(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadAllDynamicData = useCallback(async () => {
    abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortControllerRef.current = controller;

    const todayDate = getLocalTodayStr();
    const now = new Date();

    const [classListRes, schoolRes, dtrRes, geofenceRes, calendarRes] =
      await Promise.allSettled([
        allowClassViews
          ? apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.ATTENDANCE_CLASSES, { signal: controller.signal, timeout: 5000 })
          : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),
        apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.SCHOOL_PROFILE, { signal: controller.signal, timeout: 5000 }),
        apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.EMPLOYEE_DTR, {
          params: { month: now.getMonth() + 1, year: now.getFullYear() },
          signal: controller.signal,
          timeout: 5000,
        }),
        apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.CAMPUS_OVERVIEW, { signal: controller.signal, timeout: 5000 }),
        apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.HOLIDAYS, { signal: controller.signal, timeout: 5000 }),
      ]);

    if (!isMounted.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

    let anySuccess = false;

    if (classListRes.status === 'fulfilled' && classListRes.value?.data) {
      anySuccess = true;
      const rawPayload = classListRes.value.data;
      const rawList = Array.isArray(rawPayload)
        ? rawPayload
        : Array.isArray(rawPayload?.results)
        ? rawPayload.results
        : [];
      const normalized = normalizeClasses(rawList);
      setSections(normalized);
      AsyncStorage.setItem('attendsure_cached_sections', JSON.stringify(normalized)).catch(
        () => {}
      );
    }

    if (schoolRes.status === 'fulfilled' && schoolRes.value?.data) {
      anySuccess = true;
      setSchoolProfile(schoolRes.value.data);
      AsyncStorage.setItem(
        'attendsure_cached_school',
        JSON.stringify(schoolRes.value.data)
      ).catch(() => {});
    }

    if (dtrRes.status === 'fulfilled' && dtrRes.value?.data) {
      anySuccess = true;
      setDtrData(dtrRes.value.data);
      AsyncStorage.setItem('attendsure_cached_dtr', JSON.stringify(dtrRes.value.data)).catch(
        () => {}
      );
    }

    if (geofenceRes.status === 'fulfilled' && geofenceRes.value?.data) {
      anySuccess = true;
      setGeofenceConfig(geofenceRes.value.data);
      AsyncStorage.setItem(
        'attendsure_cached_geofence',
        JSON.stringify(geofenceRes.value.data)
      ).catch(() => {});
    }

    if (calendarRes.status === 'fulfilled' && calendarRes.value?.data) {
      anySuccess = true;
      const calPayload = calendarRes.value.data;
      const list: CalendarOverrideItem[] = Array.isArray(calPayload)
        ? calPayload
        : Array.isArray(calPayload?.results)
        ? calPayload.results
        : [];
      if (typeof calPayload?.weekend_rest_enabled === 'boolean') {
        setWeekendRestEnabled(calPayload.weekend_rest_enabled);
      }
      const matched = list.find((item) => item.date === todayDate) || null;
      setTodayOverride(matched);
    }

    setIsOnline(anySuccess);

    const count = await getUnsyncedCount();
    if (!isMounted.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

    setOfflineCount(count);
    if (count > 0) {
      void flushOfflineRecords();
    }

    setLastSyncTime(format12HourTime(new Date()));
  }, [flushOfflineRecords, allowClassViews]);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    await Promise.allSettled([loadAllDynamicData(), flushOfflineRecords(), refreshUser()]);
    if (isMounted.current) setRefreshing(false);
  }, [loadAllDynamicData, flushOfflineRecords, refreshUser]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    void loadCachedData().then(() => {
      if (isMounted.current) {
        void loadAllDynamicData();
      }
    });
    void refreshUser();

    const sub = DeviceEventEmitter.addListener('attendsure:attendance-updated', () => {
      if (isMounted.current) void loadAllDynamicData();
    });
    const livePoll = setInterval(() => {
      if (isMounted.current) void loadAllDynamicData();
    }, 10000);

    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
      abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
      sub.remove();
      clearInterval(livePoll);
    };
  }, [loadCachedData, loadAllDynamicData, refreshUser]);

  const safeSections = Array.isArray(sections) ? sections : [];

  let totalStudentsEnrolled = 0;
  let totalPresent = 0;
  let totalLate = 0;
  let totalAbsent = 0;
  let totalNeedsReview = 0;

  // Deduplicate students across periods so daily totals are never double-counted
  const uniqueStudentsMap = new Map<string, StudentItem>();
  const statusPriority: Record<string, number> = {
    PRESENT: 5,
    LATE: 4,
    TARDY: 4,
    CUTTING: 3,
    UNVERIFIED: 2,
    ABSENT: 1,
    UNSCANNED: 0,
  };

  safeSections.forEach((sec) => {
    const students = Array.isArray(sec?.students) ? sec.students : [];
    students.forEach((st) => {
      const key = String(st?.id ?? st?.lrn ?? st?.full_name ?? '');
      if (!key) return;
      const existing = uniqueStudentsMap.get(key);
      if (!existing) {
        uniqueStudentsMap.set(key, st);
      } else {
        const prevScore =
          statusPriority[String(existing.attendance_status || 'UNSCANNED').toUpperCase()] ?? 0;
        const nextScore =
          statusPriority[String(st.attendance_status || 'UNSCANNED').toUpperCase()] ?? 0;
        if (nextScore > prevScore) {
          uniqueStudentsMap.set(key, st);
        }
      }
    });
  });

  const uniqueStudents = Array.from(uniqueStudentsMap.values());
  totalStudentsEnrolled = uniqueStudents.length;

  uniqueStudents.forEach((st) => {
    const status = String(st?.attendance_status || 'UNSCANNED').toUpperCase();
    if (status === 'PRESENT') {
      totalPresent += 1;
    } else if (status === 'LATE' || status === 'TARDY') {
      totalLate += 1;
    } else if (status === 'ABSENT') {
      totalAbsent += 1;
    } else if (status === 'CUTTING' || status === 'UNVERIFIED') {
      totalNeedsReview += 1;
    }
  });

  const totalAttended = totalPresent + totalLate;
  const overallRate =
    totalStudentsEnrolled > 0
      ? Math.round((totalAttended / totalStudentsEnrolled) * 100)
      : 0;

  const isWeekendToday = [0, 6].includes(new Date().getDay());

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safeContainer} edges={['top', 'left', 'right']}>
      <StatusBar style={isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'} />

      {/* Campus Boundary Notice Modal */}
      <CampusAlertModal
        visible={showCampusAlertModal}
        liveDistanceMeters={liveDistanceMeters}
        radiusMeters={campusCenter.radius}
        onDismiss={handleDismissCampusAlert}
      />

      {/* Top Header */}
      <View style={styles.topHeader}>
        <View style={styles.brandGroup}>
          {resolvedLogoUri && !logoFailed ? (
            <Image
              source={{ uri: resolvedLogoUri }}
              style={styles.schoolLogo}
              contentFit="contain"
              onError={() => setLogoFailed(true)}
            />
          ) : (
            <AttendSureLogo size={34} />
          )}
          <View style={styles.brandTextGroup}>
            <Text style={styles.schoolTitle} numberOfLines={1}>
              {schoolName}
            </Text>
            {schoolSubHeader ? (
              <View style={styles.subBrandRow}>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.activeDot,
                    { backgroundColor: isOnline ? palette.success : palette.textMuted },
                  ]}
                />
                <Text style={styles.schoolSubText} numberOfLines={1}>
                  {schoolSubHeader}
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.refreshButton}
          onPress={() => void onRefresh()}
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityLabel="Refresh records"
        >
          <Ionicons name="sync-outline" size={16} color={palette.primary} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        style={styles.scrollArea}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={() => void onRefresh()}
            colors={[palette.primary]}
            tintColor={palette.primary}
          />
        }
      >
        {/* Mock Location Notice */}
        {liveCoords?.mocked && (
          <View style={styles.locationNoticeCard}>
            <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={18} color={palette.danger} />
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.locationNoticeTitle}>Mock Location Setting Active</Text>
              <Text style={styles.locationNoticeBody}>
                A mock location option is turned on in your phone settings. Please disable it so
                your campus Time In / Out stays verified.
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* 1. Welcome Banner Card */}
        <View style={styles.welcomeCard}>
          <View style={styles.welcomeHeader}>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginRight: 10 }}>
              <Text style={styles.welcomeSub}>{greetingText},</Text>
              <Text style={styles.welcomeTitle} numberOfLines={1}>
                {displayName || 'Teacher'}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.avatarBox}>
              {resolvedUserPhoto && !avatarFailed ? (
                <Image
                  source={{ uri: resolvedUserPhoto }}
                  style={styles.avatarImg}
                  contentFit="cover"
                  onError={() => setAvatarFailed(true)}
                />
              ) : (
                <Ionicons name="person" size={22} color={palette.primary} />
              )}
            </View>
          </View>

          <View style={styles.progressContainer}>
            <View style={styles.progressTopRow}>
              <Text style={styles.progressBadgeText}>
                {employeeId ? `ID: ${employeeId}` : 'Teacher'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.progressPercent}>{overallRate}% Attendance Today</Text>
            </View>
            <View style={styles.progressBarTrack}>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.progressBarFill,
                  { width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(5, overallRate))}%` },
                ]}
              />
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* 1B. 3-Second Glanceable Duty, Location & Single Next-Step Hero */}
        <DutyRightNowCard
          offlineCount={offlineCount}
          isOnline={isOnline}
          isOfficiallyOnDuty={isOfficiallyOnDuty}
          hasCheckedInToday={hasCheckedInToday}
          hasCheckedOutToday={hasCheckedOutToday}
          arrivalTime={todayDtrRow?.am_arrival || todayDtrRow?.pm_arrival}
          isInsideCampusPerimeter={isInsideCampusPerimeter}
          liveDistanceMeters={liveDistanceMeters}
          allowClassViews={allowClassViews}
          onNavigate={onNavigate}
        />

        {/* 2. Primary Classroom Summary Card (Hidden for non-teaching staff) */}
        {allowClassViews && (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.primaryStatusCard}
            onPress={() => onNavigate?.('class_list')}
            activeOpacity={0.9}
          >
            <View style={styles.statusTopRow}>
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <Text style={styles.statusCardEyebrow}>TODAY&apos;S CLASS SUMMARY</Text>
                <Text style={styles.statusCardTitle}>
                  {totalPresent} of {totalStudentsEnrolled} Students Present
                </Text>
              </View>
              <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={18} color={palette.onPrimary} />
            </View>
            <View style={styles.statusFooterRow}>
              <View style={styles.statusPill}>
                <Text style={styles.statusPillText}>Needs Review: {totalNeedsReview}</Text>
              </View>
              <View style={[styles.statusPill, { backgroundColor: palette.headerSurface }]}>
                <Text style={styles.statusPillText}>
                  Campus GPS:{' '}
                  {isInsideCampusPerimeter === null
                    ? 'Locating...'
                    : isInsideCampusPerimeter
                    ? 'On Campus'
                    : `Outside (${liveDistanceMeters !== null ? formatDistanceMeters(liveDistanceMeters) : '—'})`}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}

        {/* 3. Quick Actions Grid & More Tools Card */}
        <DashboardQuickActions
          user={user}
          allowClassViews={allowClassViews}
          onNavigate={onNavigate}
        />

        {/* School Campus Location Card */}
        <CampusLocationCard
          isInsideCampusPerimeter={isInsideCampusPerimeter}
          liveDistanceMeters={liveDistanceMeters}
          radiusMeters={campusCenter.radius}
          timestamp={liveCoords?.timestamp}
          gpsError={gpsError}
        />

        {/* Offline Queue Banner */}
        {offlineCount > 0 && (
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.offlineBufferBanner}
            onPress={() => void flushOfflineRecords()}
            disabled={isSyncingQueue}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
          >
            <View style={styles.offlineBannerLeft}>
              <Ionicons
                name={isSyncingQueue ? 'sync-outline' : 'cloud-upload-outline'}
                size={18}
                color={palette.warning}
              />
              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <Text style={styles.offlineBufferTitle}>
                  {offlineCount} {offlineCount === 1 ? 'record' : 'records'} saved safely on phone
                </Text>
                <Text style={styles.offlineBufferSubtitle}>
                  {isSyncingQueue
                    ? 'Uploading to school server now...'
                    : isOnline
                    ? 'Will sync automatically — or tap to upload now'
                    : 'Saved on phone — will sync automatically when Wi-Fi returns'}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
            {isSyncingQueue ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.warning} />
            ) : (
              <View style={styles.syncNowBtn}>
                <Text style={styles.syncNowBtnText}>Upload Now</Text>
              </View>
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}

        {/* Calendar Holiday Banner */}
        {todayOverride ? (
          <View style={styles.calendarBanner}>
            <Ionicons name="calendar-outline" size={16} color={palette.primary} />
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.calendarBannerTitle}>
                {todayOverride.type}: {todayOverride.date}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.calendarBannerReason}>{todayOverride.reason}</Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        ) : isWeekendToday && weekendRestEnabled ? (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.calendarBanner,
              { backgroundColor: palette.successLight, borderColor: palette.success },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons name="partly-sunny-outline" size={16} color={palette.success} />
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={[styles.calendarBannerTitle, { color: palette.success }]}>
                Weekend Rest Day
              </Text>
              <Text style={[styles.calendarBannerReason, { color: palette.textPrimary }]}>
                Attendance logging is optional on scheduled rest days.
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* DTR Summary & Student Attendance KPI Tiles */}
        <DashboardDtrAndKpiSection
          dtrData={dtrData}
          todayDtrRow={todayDtrRow}
          allowClassViews={allowClassViews}

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Daily Time Record (Civil Service Form No. 48)
 * File: mobile/src/screens/DTRScreen.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  RefreshControl,
  ActivityIndicator,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Share,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useThemeMode } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import {
  getFriendlyErrorMessage,
  type ThemePalette,
} from '../constants/theme';
import { isCanceledError, showNotice } from '../utils/helpers';
import DTRReportView, { DTRReportData } from '../components/reports/DTRReportView';

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
];

interface DTRScreenProps {
  teacherId?: string;
}

export const DTRScreen: React.FC<DTRScreenProps> = ({ teacherId = '' }) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);

  const isMounted = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const currentUser = user as Record<string, any> | null;
  const userRole = String(currentUser?.role || currentUser?.system_role || 'TEACHER')
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase();
  const isTeacher = userRole === 'TEACHER';

  const now = new Date();
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<number>(now.getMonth() + 1);
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<number>(now.getFullYear());

  const [dtrData, setDtrData] = useState<DTRReportData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [submittingDtr, setSubmittingDtr] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportingDoc, setExportingDoc] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const fetchDTR = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortControllerRef.current = controller;

      const cleanTargetId = teacherId.trim();
      const endpoint =
        isTeacher && !cleanTargetId
          ? ENDPOINTS.EMPLOYEE_DTR
          : cleanTargetId
          ? `${ENDPOINTS.EMPLOYEE_DTR}${encodeURIComponent(cleanTargetId)}/`
          : ENDPOINTS.EMPLOYEE_DTR;

      const cacheKey = `attendsure_dtr_${cleanTargetId || 'self'}_${selectedMonth}_${selectedYear}`;

      if (!silent) {
        if (isMounted.current) setLoading(true);
        try {
          const cached = await AsyncStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
          if (cached && isMounted.current && !controller.signal.aborted) {
            setDtrData(JSON.parse(cached));
          }
        } catch {
          // Continue to live fetch
        }
      }

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<DTRReportData>(endpoint, {
          params: { month: selectedMonth, year: selectedYear },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        if (!isMounted.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

        setDtrData(res.data);
        AsyncStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(res.data)).catch(() => {});
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        if (isCanceledError(err)) return;
      } finally {
        if (isMounted.current) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [isTeacher, teacherId, selectedMonth, selectedYear]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    void fetchDTR(false);

    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
      abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    void fetchDTR(false);
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  const handleSubmitDtr = async () => {
    if (!dtrData || submittingDtr) return;

    setSubmittingDtr(true);
    try {
      const encodedId = encodeURIComponent(String(dtrData.teacher_id));
      await apiClient.post(`${ENDPOINTS.EMPLOYEE_DTR}${encodedId}/`, {
        action: 'SUBMIT_DTR',
        teacher_id: dtrData.teacher_id,
        month: dtrData.month_number,
        year: dtrData.year,
        regular_days_hours: dtrData.regular_days_hours,
        saturdays_hours: dtrData.saturdays_hours,
      });
      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      showNotice('Submitted', 'Your Daily Time Record has been sent to your Department Head.');
      void fetchDTR(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      showNotice(
        'Unable to Submit',
        getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not submit your Daily Time Record right now.')
      );
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setSubmittingDtr(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExport = async () => {
    if (!dtrData || exportingDoc) return;

    if (!dtrData.dept_head_approved) {
      showNotice('Approval Required', 'Department Head approval is needed before exporting.');
      return;
    }

    setExportingDoc(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.REPORT_EXPORT, {
        params: {
          report_type: 'DTR',
          teacher_id: dtrData.teacher_id,
          month: dtrData.month_number,
          year: dtrData.year,
        },
      });

      const title =
        res.data?.title ||
        `CSC_Form_48_${dtrData.teacher_name}_${dtrData.month}_${dtrData.year}`;
      await Share.share({
        title,
        message: `${title}\nCivil Service Form No. 48 verified in AttendSure.`,
      });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      showNotice('Notice', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not export your Daily Time Record.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setExportingDoc(false);
    }
  };

  const isApproved = Boolean(dtrData?.dept_head_approved);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safeContainer} edges={['top', 'left', 'right']}>
      {/* Top Header */}
      <View style={styles.topBar}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Text style={styles.screenTitle}>Daily Time Record</Text>
          <Text style={styles.screenSub}>Civil Service Form No. 48</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 6 }}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[
              styles.btnSec,
              (loading || exportingDoc || !isApproved) && { opacity: 0.6 },
            ]}
            onPress={() => void handleExport()}
            disabled={loading || exportingDoc || !isApproved}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name={isApproved ? 'share-outline' : 'lock-closed-outline'}
              size={15}
              color={isApproved ? palette.primary : palette.textMuted}
            />
            <Text style={[styles.btnSecText, !isApproved && { color: palette.textMuted }]}>
              Export
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={[styles.btnPri, loading && { opacity: 0.6 }]}
            onPress={() => void fetchDTR(false)}
            disabled={loading}
            accessibilityLabel="Refresh records"
          >
            {loading ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.onPrimary} />
            ) : (
              <Ionicons name="refresh" size={15} color={palette.onPrimary} />
            )}
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            colors={[palette.primary]}
            tintColor={palette.primary}
          />
        }
      >
        {/* Month Selector */}
        <View style={styles.monthPillRow}>
          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.navArrow}
            onPress={() => {
              if (selectedMonth === 1) {
                setSelectedMonth(12);
                setSelectedYear((y) => y - 1);
              } else {
                setSelectedMonth((m) => m - 1);
              }
            }}
            accessibilityLabel="Previous month"
          >
            <Ionicons name="chevron-back" size={18} color={palette.primary} />
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <Text style={styles.monthDisplay}>
            {MONTH_NAMES[selectedMonth - 1]} {selectedYear}
          </Text>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.navArrow}
            onPress={() => {
              if (selectedMonth === 12) {
                setSelectedMonth(1);
                setSelectedYear((y) => y + 1);
              } else {
                setSelectedMonth((m) => m + 1);
              }
            }}
            accessibilityLabel="Next month"
          >
            <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={18} color={palette.primary} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>

        {/* DTR Sheet Component */}
        {loading && !dtrData ? (
          <View style={styles.loadingBox}>
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
            <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Loading attendance records...</Text>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <DTRReportView
            data={dtrData}
            selectedMonth={selectedMonth}
            selectedYear={selectedYear}
            onMonthChange={(m, y) => {
              setSelectedMonth(m);
              setSelectedYear(y);
            }}
            submitting={submittingDtr}
            onSubmit={handleSubmitDtr}
            onRefreshNeeded={() => void fetchDTR(true)}
          />
        )}
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

const createStyles = (palette: ThemePalette, fonts: ReturnType<typeof useThemeMode>['fonts']) =>
  StyleSheet.create({

    abortRef.current = controller;

      try {
        const [cached, base] = await Promise.all([
          AsyncStorage.getItem(PASSES_CACHE_KEY),
          getServerBaseUrl(),
        ]);
        if (isMountedRef.current && !controller.signal.aborted) {
          if (base) setServerBase(base);
          if (cached) {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
            if (Array.isArray(parsed)) setPasses(parsed);
          }
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    try {
      const [passRes, stuRes, teaRes] = await Promise.allSettled([

        }),
        allowStudentPass
          ? apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.STUDENT_DROPDOWN, { signal: controller.signal })

      ]);

      if (!isMountedRef.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

      if (passRes.status === 'fulfilled' && passRes.value?.data) {
        const data = passRes.value.data;
        const list = Array.isArray(data)
          ? data
          : Array.isArray(data?.results)
            ? data.results
            : [];
        setPasses(list);
        AsyncStorage.setItem(PASSES_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)).catch(() => {});
      }

      if (stuRes.status === 'fulfilled' && stuRes.value?.data) {

      if (teaRes.status === 'fulfilled' && teaRes.value?.data) {
        const raw = teaRes.value.data;
        const list = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : Array.isArray(raw?.results) ? raw.results : [];
        setTeacherChoices(list);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current || isCanceledError(err)) return;
      if (!silent) {
        showNotice('Notice', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not load exit passes right now.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    }
  }, [allowStudentPass, isLeader]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    void fetchPasses(false);
    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchPasses]);

  const filteredPasses = useMemo(() => {
    const q = cleanText(searchQuery, 80).toLowerCase();
    return passes.filter((p) => {
      const matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'ALL' || p.pass_status === statusFilter;
      const hay = `${p.pass_number || ''} ${p.person_name || ''} ${p.pass_type || ''} ${p.destination || ''} ${p.reason || ''}`.toLowerCase();
      return matchesStatus && (!q || hay.includes(q));
    });
  }, [passes, statusFilter, searchQuery]);

  const filteredStudentChoices = useMemo(() => {
    const q = studentPickerSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return studentChoices.slice(0, 30);
    return studentChoices
      .filter((s) =>
        `${s.full_name} ${s.lrn} ${s.section_name || ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      )
      .slice(0, 30);
  }, [studentChoices, studentPickerSearch]);

  const openCreateModal = () => {
    const nextScope: 'STUDENT' | 'TEACHER' = allowStudentPass ? 'STUDENT' : 'TEACHER';
    setEditingPass(null);
    setPassScope(nextScope);
    setStudentPickerSearch('');
    setAttachmentBase64(null);
    setAttachmentPreview(null);
    setForm({
      student_id: '',
      teacher_id: user?.teacher_id ? String(user.teacher_id) : '',
      pass_type: nextScope === 'STUDENT' ? STUDENT_PASS_TYPES[0] : TEACHER_PASS_TYPES[0],
      destination: '',
      reason: '',
      duration_hours: '2',
    });
    setShowIssueModal(true);
  };

  const openEditModal = (pass: ExitPassItem) => {
    setEditingPass(pass);
    setPassScope(pass.pass_scope);
    setStudentPickerSearch('');
    setAttachmentBase64(null);
    setAttachmentPreview(pass.attachment_url || pass.attachment || null);
    setForm({
      student_id: pass.student ? String(pass.student) : '',
      teacher_id: pass.teacher ? String(pass.teacher) : '',
      pass_type:
        pass.pass_type ||
        (pass.pass_scope === 'STUDENT' ? STUDENT_PASS_TYPES[0] : TEACHER_PASS_TYPES[0]),
      destination: pass.destination || '',
      reason: pass.reason || '',
      duration_hours: '2',
    });
    setSelectedPass(null);
    setShowIssueModal(true);
  };

  const handleIssueSubmit = async () => {
    let parsedStudentId: number | null = null;
    if (!editingPass && passScope === 'STUDENT') {
      const cleanId = cleanText(form.student_id, 12);
      parsedStudentId = Number.parseInt(cleanId, 10);
      if (!cleanId || !Number.isFinite(parsedStudentId) || parsedStudentId <= 0) {
        showNotice('Required', 'Please select a student from the list.');
        return;
      }
    }

    const cleanedDest = cleanText(form.destination, 160);
    const cleanedReason = cleanText(form.reason, 300);
    if (!cleanedDest || !cleanedReason) {
      showNotice('Required', 'Please enter both destination and reason.');
      return;
    }

    const parsedHours = Number.parseInt(cleanText(form.duration_hours, 2), 10);
    const hours = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, Number.isFinite(parsedHours) ? parsedHours : 2));
    const expiry = new Date(Date.now() + hours * 3600000);

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, string | number | null> = {
        pass_scope: passScope,
        pass_type: cleanText(form.pass_type, 80),
        destination: cleanedDest,
        reason: cleanedReason,
      };
      if (!editingPass) {
        payload.valid_until = expiry.toISOString();
        if (passScope === 'STUDENT' && parsedStudentId !== null) {
          payload.student_id = parsedStudentId;
        } else if (form.teacher_id) {
          payload.teacher_id = Number(form.teacher_id);
        } else if (user?.teacher_id) {
          payload.teacher_id = Number(user.teacher_id);
        }
      }
      if (attachmentBase64) {
        payload.attachment = attachmentBase64;
      }

      if (editingPass) {
        await apiClient.patch(
          `${ENDPOINTS.EXIT_PASSES}${encodeURIComponent(String(editingPass.id))}/`,
          payload
        );
        showNotice('Updated', `Exit pass ${editingPass.pass_number} updated.`);
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(ENDPOINTS.EXIT_PASSES, payload);
        showNotice('Exit Pass Issued', 'The authorized exit pass is now active.');
      }

      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      setShowIssueModal(false);
      setEditingPass(null);
      void fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice('Could Not Save Pass', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Unable to save exit pass.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkReturned = async (pass: ExitPassItem) => {
    if (actionBusy) return;
    setActionBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(
        `${ENDPOINTS.EXIT_PASSES}${encodeURIComponent(String(pass.id))}/mark-returned/`
      );
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice('Returned', 'Return to campus has been recorded.');
      setSelectedPass(null);
      void fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        showNotice('Error', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not mark pass as returned.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setActionBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleApprovePass = async (pass: ExitPassItem) => {
    if (actionBusy || !isLeader) return;
    setActionBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(
        `${ENDPOINTS.EXIT_PASSES}${encodeURIComponent(String(pass.id))}/approve/`
      );
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice('Approved', `Official Locator Slip ${pass.pass_number} has been approved.`);
      setSelectedPass(null);
      void fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        showNotice('Error', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not approve this locator slip.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setActionBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancelPass = async (pass: ExitPassItem) => {
    if (actionBusy) return;
    setActionBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(
        `${ENDPOINTS.EXIT_PASSES}${encodeURIComponent(String(pass.id))}/cancel/`
      );
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      showNotice('Cancelled', `Pass ${pass.pass_number} has been cancelled.`);
      setSelectedPass(null);
      void fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        showNotice('Error', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not cancel this pass.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setActionBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeletePass = (pass: ExitPassItem) => {
    const run = async () => {
      setActionBusy(true);
      try {
        await apiClient.delete(`${ENDPOINTS.EXIT_PASSES}${encodeURIComponent(String(pass.id))}/`);
        if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
        showNotice('Deleted', `Exit pass ${pass.pass_number} removed.`);
        setSelectedPass(null);
        void fetchPasses(true);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        if (isMountedRef.current) {
          showNotice('Delete Failed', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not delete pass.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (isMountedRef.current) setActionBusy(false);
      }
    };
    confirmAction('Delete Pass', `Delete exit pass ${pass.pass_number}?`, 'Delete', () => void run());
  };

  const getStatusStyle = (st: ExitPassItem['pass_status']) => {
    if (st === 'ACTIVE') return { bg: palette.successLight, text: palette.success };
    if (st === 'OVERDUE') return { bg: palette.dangerLight, text: palette.danger };
    if (st === 'RETURNED') return { bg: palette.infoLight, text: palette.info };
    return { bg: palette.surfaceSubtle, text: palette.textMuted };
  };

  const passTypePresets = passScope === 'STUDENT' ? STUDENT_PASS_TYPES : TEACHER_PASS_TYPES;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container} edges={['top']}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <View style={styles.headerLeft}>
          {onBack && (
            <TouchableOpacity style={styles.backBtn} onPress={onBack} accessibilityLabel="Go back">
              <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={20} color={palette.primary} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}
          <View>
            <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>Authorized Exit Passes</Text>
            <Text style={styles.headerSubtitle}>Student &amp; Teacher Campus Permits</Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.newBtn} onPress={openCreateModal}>
          <Ionicons name="add" size={16} color={palette.onPrimary} />
          <Text style={styles.newBtnText}>{allowStudentPass ? 'New Pass' : 'Locator Slip'}</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.searchBox}>
        <Ionicons name="search" size={16} color={palette.textMuted} />
        <TextInput
          style={styles.searchInput}
          placeholder="Search pass number, name, destination..."
          placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
          value={searchQuery}
          onChangeText={setSearchQuery}
          maxLength={80}
        />
        {searchQuery.length > 0 && (
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setSearchQuery('')}>
            <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={16} color={palette.textMuted} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.filterRow}>
        <ChipRow
          options={['ACTIVE', 'OVERDUE', 'RETURNED', 'CANCELLED', 'ALL'].map((st) => ({
            key: st,
            label: st,
          }))}
          selected={statusFilter}
          onSelect={setStatusFilter}
        />
      </View>

      {loading && passes.length === 0 ? (
        <View style={styles.centerBox}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
          <Text style={styles.centerText}>Loading exit passes...</Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={filteredPasses}
          keyExtractor={(item) => String(item.id)}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
          refreshControl={
            <RefreshControl
              refreshing={refreshing}
              onRefresh={() => {
                setRefreshing(true);
                void fetchPasses(true);
              }}
              colors={[palette.primary]}
              tintColor={palette.primary}
            />
          }
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <View style={styles.emptyBox}>
              <Ionicons name="document-text-outline" size={38} color={palette.textMuted} />
              <Text style={styles.emptyTitle}>No exit passes here right now</Text>
              <Text style={styles.emptySub}>
                Tap &ldquo;{allowStudentPass ? 'New Pass' : 'Locator Slip'}&rdquo; at the top right to issue an approved campus exit or travel slip.
              </Text>
            </View>
          }
          renderItem={({ item }) => {
            const pillColors = getStatusStyle(item.pass_status);
            return (
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.card}
                activeOpacity={0.75}
                onPress={() => setSelectedPass(item)}
              >
                <View style={styles.cardTop}>
                  <View>
                    <Text style={styles.passCode}>{item.pass_number}</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.holderType}>
                      {item.pass_scope} EXIT PASS{item.pass_type ? ` • ${item.pass_type}` : ''}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={[styles.statusPill, { backgroundColor: pillColors.bg }]}>
                    <Text style={[styles.statusPillText, { color: pillColors.text }]}>
                      {item.pass_status}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                </View>

                <Text style={styles.holderName}>{item.person_name || 'Pass Holder'}</Text>
                <Text style={styles.reasonText} numberOfLines={2}>
                  {item.destination} — {item.reason}
                </Text>

                <View style={styles.cardBottom}>
                  <Text style={styles.dateText}>
                    Valid until:{' '}
                    {item.valid_until && !Number.isNaN(Date.parse(item.valid_until))
                      ? new Date(item.valid_until).toLocaleTimeString([], {
                          hour: '2-digit',
                          minute: '2-digit',
                        })
                      : '—'}
                  </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.cardAction}>
                    {item.attachment_url || item.attachment ? 'Proof • ' : ''}View Pass &gt;
                  </Text>
                </View>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            );
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Create / Edit Exit Pass Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={showIssueModal}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowIssueModal(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalBg}>
          <View style={styles.modalCard}>
            <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.modalHeading}>
                {editingPass ? `Edit Pass ${editingPass.pass_number}` : 'Issue Authorized Exit Pass'}
              </Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setShowIssueModal(false)}>
                <Ionicons name="close" size={22} color={palette.textPrimary} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
              {!editingPass && allowStudentPass && (
                <View style={styles.switchRow}>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    style={[styles.switchBtn, passScope === 'STUDENT' && styles.switchBtnActive]}
                    onPress={() => {
                      setPassScope('STUDENT');
                      setForm((p) => ({ ...p, pass_type: STUDENT_PASS_TYPES[0] }));
                    }}
                  >
                    <Text
                      style={[styles.switchText, passScope === 'STUDENT' && styles.switchTextActive]}
                    >
                      Student Pass
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    style={[styles.switchBtn, passScope === 'TEACHER' && styles.switchBtnActive]}
                    onPress={() => {
                      setPassScope('TEACHER');
                      setForm((p) => ({ ...p, pass_type: TEACHER_PASS_TYPES[0] }));
                    }}
                  >
                    <Text
                      style={[styles.switchText, passScope === 'TEACHER' && styles.switchTextActive]}
                    >
                      Official Locator Slip
                    </Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                </View>
              )}

              {/* Searchable Student Picker */}
              {!editingPass && allowStudentPass && passScope === 'STUDENT' && (
                <>
                  <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Select Student *</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    style={styles.inputField}
                    placeholder="Type student name or LRN to filter..."
                    placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                    value={studentPickerSearch}
                    onChangeText={setStudentPickerSearch}
                  />
                  <ChipRow
                    options={filteredStudentChoices.map((st) => ({
                      key: String(st.id),
                      label: `${st.full_name} (${st.section_name || st.lrn})`,
                    }))}
                    selected={form.student_id}
                    onSelect={(id) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, student_id: id }))}
                    contentContainerStyle={{ paddingVertical: 6 }}
                  />
                </>
              )}

              {/* Teacher Picker for School Leaders issuing Official Locator Slips */}
              {!editingPass && passScope === 'TEACHER' && isLeader && teacherChoices.length > 0 && (
                <>
                  <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Select Teacher *</Text>
                  <ChipRow
                    options={teacherChoices.map((t) => ({
                      key: String(t.id),
                      label: t.full_name,
                    }))}
                    selected={form.teacher_id}
                    onSelect={(id) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, teacher_id: id }))}
                    contentContainerStyle={{ paddingVertical: 6 }}
                  />
                </>
              )}

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Pass Type</Text>
              <ChipRow
                options={passTypePresets.map((pt) => ({ key: pt, label: pt }))}
                selected={form.pass_type}
                onSelect={(pt) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, pass_type: pt }))}
                contentContainerStyle={{ paddingVertical: 4 }}
              />

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Destination *</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.inputField}
                placeholder="e.g. School Clinic, Division Office"
                placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                maxLength={160}
                value={form.destination}
                onChangeText={(val) => setForm({ ...form, destination: val })}
              />

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Official Reason *</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={[styles.inputField, { height: 70, textAlignVertical: 'top', paddingTop: 8 }]}
                placeholder="Enter reason for leaving campus..."
                placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                multiline
                maxLength={300}
                value={form.reason}
                onChangeText={(val) => setForm({ ...form, reason: val })}
              />

              {!editingPass && (
                <>
                  <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Allowed Duration (Hours, 1 to 12)</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    style={styles.inputField}
                    placeholder="2"
                    placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                    keyboardType="numeric"
                    maxLength={2}
                    value={form.duration_hours}
                    onChangeText={(val) => setForm({ ...form, duration_hours: val })}
                  />
                </>
              )}

              <ImageUploadField
                label="Supporting Document / Proof Photo (Optional)"
                helperText="Attach travel order, clinic slip, or parent letter image."
                value={attachmentBase64 || attachmentPreview}
                serverBase={serverBase}
                variant="proof"
                onChange={(dataUrl) => {
                  setAttachmentBase64(dataUrl);
                  setAttachmentPreview(dataUrl);
                }}
                onRemove={() => {
                  setAttachmentBase64(null);
                  setAttachmentPreview(null);
                }}
              />

              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[styles.submitBtn, submitting && { opacity: 0.65 }]}
                onPress={() => void handleIssueSubmit()}
                disabled={submitting}
              >
                {submitting ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.onPrimary} />
                ) : (
                  <Text style={styles.submitBtnText}>
                    {editingPass ? 'Save Pass Changes' : 'Issue Exit Pass'}
                  </Text>
                )}
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Pass Slip Detail Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={Boolean(selectedPass)}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setSelectedPass(null)}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalBg}>
          <View style={styles.modalCard}>
            <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.modalHeading}>Exit Pass Details</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setSelectedPass(null)}>
                <Ionicons name="close" size={22} color={palette.textPrimary} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            {selectedPass && (
              <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
                <View style={styles.qrArea}>
                  <View style={styles.qrQuietZone}>
                    <QRCode
                      value={`ATTENDSURE-PASS:${cleanText(selectedPass.pass_number, 64)}`}
                      size={155}
                      color={QR_COLORS.foreground}
                      backgroundColor={QR_COLORS.background}
                    />
                  </View>
                  <Text style={styles.qrHint}>
                    {selectedPass.guardian_notice ||
                      'This official pass protects the holder from false alerts until the scheduled return time.'}
                  </Text>
                </View>

                <View style={styles.infoRow}>
                  <Text style={styles.infoLabel}>Pass Number:</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.infoVal}>{selectedPass.pass_number}</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.infoRow}>
                  <Text style={styles.infoLabel}>Holder:</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.infoVal}>{selectedPass.person_name}</Text>
                </View>
                {selectedPass.pass_type ? (
                  <View style={styles.infoRow}>
                    <Text style={styles.infoLabel}>Pass Type:</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.infoVal}>{selectedPass.pass_type}</Text>
                  </View>
                ) : null}
                <View style={styles.infoRow}>
                  <Text style={styles.infoLabel}>Destination:</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.infoVal}>{selectedPass.destination}</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.infoRow}>
                  <Text style={styles.infoLabel}>Reason:</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.infoVal}>{selectedPass.reason}</Text>
                </View>
                <View style={styles.infoRow}>
                  <Text style={styles.infoLabel}>Status:</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.infoVal}>{selectedPass.pass_status}</Text>
                </View>

                {resolveMediaUrl(selectedPass.attachment_url || selectedPass.attachment, serverBase) ? (
                  <View style={styles.proofBox}>
                    <Text style={styles.infoLabel}>Attached Proof Document:</Text>
                    <Image
                      source={{
                        uri: resolveMediaUrl(
                          selectedPass.attachment_url || selectedPass.attachment,
                          serverBase
                        )!,
                      }}
                      style={styles.proofImage}
                      contentFit="contain"
                    />
                  </View>
                ) : null}

                {(selectedPass.pass_status === 'ACTIVE' || selectedPass.pass_status === 'OVERDUE') && (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    style={[styles.confirmExitBtn, actionBusy && { opacity: 0.6 }]}
                    onPress={() => void handleMarkReturned(selectedPass)}
                    disabled={actionBusy}
                  >
                    <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={16} color={palette.onPrimary} />
                    <Text style={styles.confirmExitBtnText}>Mark Returned to Campus</Text>
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                )}

                {isLeader &&
                  selectedPass.pass_scope === 'TEACHER' &&
                  (selectedPass.pass_status === 'ACTIVE' || selectedPass.pass_status === 'OVERDUE') && (
                    <TouchableOpacity
                      style={[
                        styles.confirmExitBtn,
                        { backgroundColor: palette.success, marginTop: 8 },
                        actionBusy && { opacity: 0.6 },
                      ]}
                      onPress={() => void handleApprovePass(selectedPass)}
                      disabled={actionBusy}
                    >
                      <Ionicons name="shield-checkmark-outline" size={16} color={palette.onPrimary} />
                      <Text style={styles.confirmExitBtnText}>Approve Official Locator Slip</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  )}

                {isLeader && (
                  <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
                    <TouchableOpacity
                      style={[styles.confirmExitBtn, { flex: 1, marginTop: 0, backgroundColor: palette.primarySoft }]}
                      onPress={() => openEditModal(selectedPass)}
                      disabled={actionBusy}
                    >
                      <Ionicons name="create-outline" size={15} color={palette.primary} />
                      <Text style={[styles.confirmExitBtnText, { color: palette.primary }]}>Edit</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    {selectedPass.pass_status === 'ACTIVE' && (
                      <TouchableOpacity
                        style={[styles.confirmExitBtn, { flex: 1, marginTop: 0, backgroundColor: palette.warning }]}
                        onPress={() => void handleCancelPass(selectedPass)}
                        disabled={actionBusy}
                      >
                        <Text style={styles.confirmExitBtnText}>Cancel Pass</Text>
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                    )}
                    <TouchableOpacity
                      style={[styles.confirmExitBtn, { width: 46, marginTop: 0, backgroundColor: palette.danger }]}
                      onPress={() => handleDeletePass(selectedPass)}
                      disabled={actionBusy}
                      accessibilityLabel="Delete Exit Pass"
                    >
                      <Ionicons name="trash-outline" size={16} color={palette.onPrimary} />
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  </View>
                )}
              </ScrollView>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

const createStyles = (palette: ThemePalette, fonts: ReturnType<typeof useThemeMode>['fonts']) =>
  StyleSheet.create({
    container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: palette.background },
    header: {
      flexDirection: 'row',
      alignItems: 'center',
      justifyContent: 'space-between',
      paddingHorizontal: 14,
      paddingVertical: 10,
      backgroundColor: palette.surface,
      borderBottomWidth: 1,
      borderBottomColor: palette.border,
    },
    headerLeft: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flex: 1 },
    backBtn: {
      width: 34,
      height: 34,
      borderRadius: 17,
      backgroundColor: palette.surfaceSubtle,
      borderWidth: 1,
      borderColor: palette.border,
      alignItems: 'center',
      justifyContent: 'center',
    },
    headerTitle: { fontSize: fonts.lg, fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold, color: palette.textPrimary },
    headerSubtitle: { fontSize: fonts.xs, color: palette.textSecondary },
    newBtn: {
      flexDirection: 'row',
      alignItems: 'center',
      gap: 4,
      backgroundColor: palette.buttonBg,
