import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ActivityIndicator,
  RefreshControl,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useNavigation } from '@react-navigation/native';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import QRCode from 'react-native-qrcode-svg';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useThemeMode } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';
import { getServerBaseUrl } from '../services/configService';
import {
  cleanText,
  getFriendlyErrorMessage,
  QR_COLORS,
  type ThemePalette,
} from '../constants/theme';
import { confirmAction, isCanceledError, resolveMediaUrl } from '../utils/helpers';

const PROFILE_CACHE_KEY = 'attendsure_cached_teacher_profile';

interface LiveTeacherProfile {
  id: number;
  employee_id: string;
  first_name: string;
  last_name: string;
  full_name: string;
  position: string;
  department: string;
  contact_number?: string;
  email?: string;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  photo?: string | null;
  bound_device_id?: string | null;
  has_bound_device?: boolean;
  device_bound_at?: string | null;
}

interface ExtendedSessionUser {
  id?: number | string;
  username?: string;
  name?: string;
  full_name?: string;
  first_name?: string;
  last_name?: string;
  employee_id?: string;
  teacher_id?: string | number | null;
  role?: string;
  device_id?: string;
  bound_device_id?: string | null;
  has_bound_device?: boolean;
}

export const ProfileSettingsScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);

  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<LiveTeacherProfile | null>(null);
  const [serverBase, setServerBase] = useState<string>('');
  const [photoError, setPhotoError] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorBanner, setErrorBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [qrTimestamp, setQrTimestamp] = useState<number>(Date.now());

  const isMountedRef = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const fetchProfile = useCallback(async (fromCacheFirst = false) => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;

    if (fromCacheFirst) {
      try {
        const [cached, base] = await Promise.all([
          AsyncStorage.getItem(PROFILE_CACHE_KEY),
          getServerBaseUrl(),
        ]);
        if (isMountedRef.current && !controller.signal.aborted) {
          if (base) setServerBase(base);
          if (cached) setProfile(JSON.parse(cached));
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get<LiveTeacherProfile>(ENDPOINTS.CURRENT_USER, {
        timeout: 8000,
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (!isMountedRef.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;
      if (res.data) {
        setProfile(res.data);
        setErrorBanner(null);
        AsyncStorage.setItem(PROFILE_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(res.data)).catch(() => {});
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current || isCanceledError(err)) return;
      setErrorBanner(getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Showing saved profile details.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    void fetchProfile(true);
    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchProfile]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setQrTimestamp(Date.now());
      }
    }, 60000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    setQrTimestamp(Date.now());
    void fetchProfile(false);
  };

  const handleLogout = () => {
    confirmAction('Sign Out', 'Sign out of AttendSure on this device?', 'Sign Out', () => void logout());
  };

  const sessionUser = user as ExtendedSessionUser | null;
  const displayName = cleanText(
    profile?.full_name ||
      sessionUser?.full_name ||
      sessionUser?.name ||
      `${sessionUser?.first_name || ''} ${sessionUser?.last_name || ''}`.trim() ||
      sessionUser?.username ||
      'Teacher',
    120
  );
  const displayId = cleanText(
    profile?.employee_id ||
      sessionUser?.employee_id ||
      (sessionUser?.teacher_id ? String(sessionUser.teacher_id) : '') ||
      '—',
    40
  );
  const displayPosition = cleanText(profile?.position || sessionUser?.role || 'Teacher', 80);
  const displayDept = cleanText(profile?.department || '—', 80);
  const boundDeviceId =
    profile?.bound_device_id || sessionUser?.device_id || sessionUser?.bound_device_id || null;
  const isDeviceLinked = Boolean(
    profile?.has_bound_device || sessionUser?.has_bound_device || boundDeviceId
  );

  const safePhoto = resolveMediaUrl(
    user?.photo_url ?? user?.photo ?? profile?.photo_url ?? profile?.photo,
    serverBase
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    setPhotoError(false);
  }, [safePhoto]);

  const teacherPassPayload = JSON.stringify({
    app: 'ATTENDSURE_TEACHER_PASS',
    emp_id: displayId,
    name: displayName,
    ts: qrTimestamp,
    dev_id: boundDeviceId ? cleanText(boundDeviceId, 16).slice(0, 8) : 'UNLINKED',
  });

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container} edges={['top']}>
      <View style={styles.appBar}>
        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
          style={styles.backButton}
          accessibilityLabel="Go back"
        >
          <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={20} color={palette.textPrimary} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
        <Text style={styles.appBarTitle}>Teacher Profile &amp; Pass</Text>
        <View style={{ width: 36 }} />
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            colors={[palette.primary]}
            tintColor={palette.primary}
          />
        }
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        {errorBanner ? (
          <View style={styles.noticeBanner}>
            <Ionicons name="information-circle-outline" size={16} color={palette.warning} />
            <Text style={styles.noticeBannerText}>{errorBanner}</Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <View style={styles.profileCard}>
          <View style={styles.avatarContainer}>
            {safePhoto && !photoError ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: safePhoto }}
                style={styles.avatarImage}
                contentFit="cover"
                onError={() => setPhotoError(true)}
              />
            ) : (
              <Ionicons name="person" size={40} color={palette.primary} />
            )}
          </View>

          <Text style={styles.profileName}>{displayName}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.profileRole}>{displayPosition}</Text>
          {displayDept !== '—' ? <Text style={styles.profileDept}>{displayDept}</Text> : null}

          <View style={styles.badgeRow}>
            <View style={styles.idBadge}>
              <Ionicons name="card-outline" size={13} color={palette.primary} />
              <Text style={styles.idBadgeText}>ID: {displayId}</Text>
            </View>

            <View
              style={[
                styles.statusBadge,
                isDeviceLinked ? styles.statusActive : styles.statusPending,
              ]}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name={isDeviceLinked ? 'shield-checkmark' : 'shield-outline'}
                size={13}
                color={isDeviceLinked ? palette.success : palette.warning}
              />
              <Text
                style={[
                  styles.statusBadgeText,
                  { color: isDeviceLinked ? palette.success : palette.warning },
                ]}
              >
                {isDeviceLinked ? 'Device Linked' : 'Not Linked'}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.qrCard}>
          <View style={styles.qrHeader}>
            <Ionicons name="qr-code-outline" size={20} color={palette.primary} />
            <Text style={styles.qrCardTitle}>Digital Teacher ID Pass</Text>
          </View>
          <Text style={styles.qrSubtitle}>
            Verify daily teacher attendance using Phone Fingerprint / Biometric &amp; Campus GPS
            inside this app.
          </Text>

          <View style={styles.qrWrapper}>
            {loading && !profile ? (
              <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={palette.primary} />
            ) : (
              <QRCode
                value={teacherPassPayload}
                size={180}
                color={QR_COLORS.foreground}
                backgroundColor={QR_COLORS.background}
              />
            )}
          </View>

          <View style={styles.qrFooter}>
            <Ionicons name="sync-outline" size={13} color={palette.textMuted} />
            <Text style={styles.qrFooterText}>
              Refreshes every 60 seconds to prevent screenshot reuse
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <TouchableOpacity
          style={styles.logoutButton}
          onPress={handleLogout}
          activeOpacity={0.85}
        >
          <Ionicons name="log-out-outline" size={18} color={palette.onPrimary} />
          <Text style={styles.logoutText}>Sign Out of Device</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

type ReportType = 'SCHEDULE' | 'CLASS_LIST' | 'DTR' | 'SF1' | 'SF2' | 'SF4';

type MobilePaperKey = 'letter' | 'folio' | 'legal' | 'a4';
type MobileOrientation = 'portrait' | 'landscape';
type MobileMarginPreset = 'compact' | 'narrow' | 'normal';

interface MobilePageSetup {
  paperSize: MobilePaperKey;
  orientation: MobileOrientation;
  marginPreset: MobileMarginPreset;
}

const MOBILE_PAPER_DIMS: Record<MobilePaperKey, { label: string; width: number; height: number }> = {
  letter: { label: 'Letter (8.5×11 in)', width: 8.5, height: 11.0 },
  folio: { label: 'Folio (8.5×13 in)', width: 8.5, height: 13.0 },
  legal: { label: 'Legal (8.5×14 in)', width: 8.5, height: 14.0 },
  a4: { label: 'A4 (8.27×11.69 in)', width: 8.27, height: 11.69 },
};

const MOBILE_MARGIN_INCHES: Record<MobileMarginPreset, { label: string; inches: number }> = {
  compact: { label: 'Compact (0.25 in)', inches: 0.25 },
  narrow: { label: 'Narrow (0.50 in)', inches: 0.5 },
  normal: { label: 'Normal (1.00 in)', inches: 1.0 },
};

const applyMobilePageSetupToHtml = (rawHtml: string, setup: MobilePageSetup): string => {
  const paper = MOBILE_PAPER_DIMS[setup.paperSize] || MOBILE_PAPER_DIMS.legal;
  const wIn = setup.orientation === 'landscape' ? paper.height : paper.width;
  const hIn = setup.orientation === 'landscape' ? paper.width : paper.height;
  const mIn = (MOBILE_MARGIN_INCHES[setup.marginPreset] || MOBILE_MARGIN_INCHES.compact).inches;

  const pageCss = `<style>
    @page { size: ${wIn}in ${hIn}in; margin: ${mIn}in !important; }
    html, body { margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; page-break-inside: auto; }
    thead { display: table-header-group; }
    tr, .qr-card, .sig-grid { page-break-inside: avoid; break-inside: avoid; }
    section.sheet:not(:last-child) { page-break-after: always; break-after: page; }
    section.sheet:last-child, .page-break:last-child { page-break-after: avoid !important; break-after: avoid !important; }
  </style>`;

  if (/<\/head>/i.test(rawHtml)) {
    return rawHtml.replace(/<\/head>/i, `${pageCss}</head>`);
  }
  return `${pageCss}${rawHtml}`;
};

// Strips executable scripts and event handlers from HTML before printing or downloading
const sanitizeReportHtml = (rawHtml: string): string =>
  String(rawHtml || '')
    .replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<(iframe|object|embed|applet)\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<(iframe|object|embed|applet)\b[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/\son[a-z]+\s*=\s*("[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s>]+)/gi, '')
    .replace(/javascript:/gi, '');

// Safe sandboxed Blob URL printing without document.write
const triggerSafeBrowserPrint = (rawHtml: string): void => {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined' || typeof Blob === 'undefined' || typeof URL === 'undefined') {
    return;
  }

  const safeHtml = sanitizeReportHtml(rawHtml);
  const blob = new Blob([safeHtml], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });
  const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

  const frameId = 'attendsure-print-frame';
  const existing = document.getElementById(frameId);
  if (existing?.parentNode) existing.parentNode.removeChild(existing);

  const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
  iframe.id = frameId;
  // Scripts are strictly blocked because allow-scripts is omitted
  iframe.setAttribute('sandbox', 'allow-modals allow-same-origin');
  iframe.style.position = 'fixed';
  iframe.style.top = '-10000px';
  iframe.style.left = '-10000px';
  iframe.style.width = '1200px';
  iframe.style.height = '900px';
  iframe.style.border = '0';

  const cleanup = () => {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
    if (iframe.parentNode) iframe.parentNode.removeChild(iframe);
  };

  iframe.onload = () => {
    try {
      iframe.contentWindow?.focus();
      iframe.contentWindow?.print();
    } catch {
      // Browser blocked automatic print dialog
    } finally {
      setTimeout(cleanup, 1500);
    }
  };

  iframe.src = blobUrl;
  document.body.appendChild(iframe);
};

// Safe Blob file download on web without document.write
const triggerSafeBrowserDownload = (
  content: string,
  rawFilename: string,
  mimeType = 'text/html;charset=utf-8',
  extension = 'html'
): void => {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined' || typeof Blob === 'undefined' || typeof URL === 'undefined') {
    return;
  }

  const finalBody = extension === 'html' ? sanitizeReportHtml(content) : String(content || '');
  const safeName = cleanText(rawFilename, 80).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_') || 'AttendSure_Report';
  const blob = new Blob([finalBody], { type: mimeType });
  const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = blobUrl;
  link.download = `${safeName}.${extension}`;
  link.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl), 1000);
};

    });
    return lines.join('\n');
  };

  const handlePrint = async () => {
    if ((selectedTab === 'SF1' || selectedTab === 'SF2') && !selectedSectionId) {
      showNotice('Required', 'Please select a class section first.');
      return;
    }
    if (
      (selectedTab === 'SCHEDULE' || selectedTab === 'CLASS_LIST') &&
      packScope === 'SELECTED' &&
      pickedSectionIds.length === 0 &&
      (!isAdmin || pickedTeacherIds.length === 0)
    ) {
      showNotice('Selection Needed', 'Select at least one section or teacher, or switch to All.');
      return;
    }

    setPrintingDoc(true);
    try {
      if (selectedTab === 'SCHEDULE' || selectedTab === 'CLASS_LIST') {
        const res = await apiClient.post(
          ENDPOINTS.REPORT_PRINT_PACK,
          buildPrintPackBody(selectedTab, 'html', 'PRINT')
        );
        const html = typeof res.data === 'string' ? res.data : res.data?.html || '';
        const docTitle =
          (typeof res.data === 'object' && res.data?.title) || `AttendSure_${selectedTab}`;
        if (Platform.OS === 'web' && html) {
          triggerSafeBrowserPrint(applyMobilePageSetupToHtml(html, pageSetup));
        } else {
          await Share.share({
            title: docTitle,
            message: buildNativeShareSummary(selectedTab),
          });
        }
        return;
      }

      const data = await fetchReportExportPayload();
      const html = typeof data === 'string' ? data : data?.html || '';
      const monthName = FULL_MONTHS[selectedMonth - 1] || '';

      if (Platform.OS === 'web' && html) {
        triggerSafeBrowserPrint(applyMobilePageSetupToHtml(html, pageSetup));
      } else {
        await Share.share({
          title: `AttendSure_${selectedTab}_${monthName}_${selectedYear}`,
          message: `AttendSure ${selectedTab} Attendance Report (${monthName} ${selectedYear}). For printable PDF layout, open Reports on the AttendSure web portal.`,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      showNotice('Notice', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not prepare this document for printing.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setPrintingDoc(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExportReport = async () => {
    if ((selectedTab === 'SF1' || selectedTab === 'SF2') && !selectedSectionId) {
      showNotice('Required', 'Please select a class section first.');
      return;
    }
    if (
      (selectedTab === 'SCHEDULE' || selectedTab === 'CLASS_LIST') &&
      packScope === 'SELECTED' &&
      pickedSectionIds.length === 0 &&
      (!isAdmin || pickedTeacherIds.length === 0)
    ) {
      showNotice('Selection Needed', 'Select at least one section or teacher, or switch to All.');
      return;
    }

    setExportingDoc(true);
    try {
      if (selectedTab === 'SCHEDULE' || selectedTab === 'CLASS_LIST') {
        const docTitle = `AttendSure_${selectedTab.toLowerCase()}_${packScope.toLowerCase()}`;
        if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
          const res = await apiClient.post(
            ENDPOINTS.REPORT_PRINT_PACK,
            buildPrintPackBody(selectedTab, 'csv', 'EXPORT'),
            { responseType: 'text' }
          );
          const csvText = typeof res.data === 'string' ? res.data : String(res.data || '');
          triggerSafeBrowserDownload(csvText, docTitle, 'text/csv;charset=utf-8', 'csv');
        } else {
          await Share.share({
            title: docTitle,
            message: buildNativeShareSummary(selectedTab),
          });
        }
        return;
      }

      const data = await fetchReportExportPayload();
      const html = typeof data === 'string' ? data : data?.html || '';
      const monthName = FULL_MONTHS[selectedMonth - 1] || '';
      const title =
        (typeof data === 'object' && data?.title) ||
        `AttendSure_${selectedTab}_${monthName}_${selectedYear}`;

      if (Platform.OS === 'web' && html) {
        triggerSafeBrowserDownload(applyMobilePageSetupToHtml(html, pageSetup), title);
      } else {
        await Share.share({
          title,
          message: `${title}\n\nAttendSure Official Attendance Report (${monthName} ${selectedYear}).`,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      showNotice('Notice', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not export this report right now.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setExportingDoc(false);
    }
  };

  const cleanSearch = cleanText(searchQuery, 80).toLowerCase();

  const filteredSf1 = useMemo(() => {
    const raw = sf1Data?.learners || sf1Data?.students || [];
    if (!cleanSearch) return raw;
    return raw.filter(
      (st: any) =>
        String(st.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) ||
        String(st.lrn || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch)
    );
  }, [sf1Data, cleanSearch]);

  const filteredSf2 = useMemo(() => {
    if (!sf2Data) return [];
    const raw = [
      ...(Array.isArray(sf2Data.males) ? sf2Data.males : []),
      ...(Array.isArray(sf2Data.females) ? sf2Data.females : []),
      ...(Array.isArray(sf2Data.learners) ? sf2Data.learners : []),
    ];
    const seen = new Set();
    const unique = raw.filter((i) => {
      const k = i.id || i.lrn || i.name;
      if (seen.has(k)) return false;
      seen.add(k);
      return true;
    });
    if (!cleanSearch) return unique;
    return unique.filter(
      (st: any) =>
        String(st.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) ||
        String(st.lrn || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch)
    );
  }, [sf2Data, cleanSearch]);

  const filteredSf4 = useMemo(() => {
    const groups = sf4Data?.grade_groups || [];
    if (!cleanSearch) return groups;
    return groups.filter((g: any) =>
      String(g.grade_level || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch)
    );
  }, [sf4Data, cleanSearch]);

  const renderActionButtons = () => (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
      <TouchableOpacity
        style={styles.btnSec}
        onPress={() => setShowPageSetup(true)}
        activeOpacity={0.8}
      >
        <Ionicons name="options-outline" size={15} color={palette.primary} />
        <Text style={styles.btnSecText}>Page Setup</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>

      <TouchableOpacity
        style={[styles.btnSec, (loading || printingDoc) && { opacity: 0.6 }]}
        onPress={() => void handlePrint()}
        disabled={loading || printingDoc}
      >
        {printingDoc ? (
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
        ) : (
          <>
            <Ionicons name="print-outline" size={15} color={palette.primary} />
            <Text style={styles.btnSecText}>Print</Text>
          </>
        )}
      </TouchableOpacity>

      <TouchableOpacity
        style={[styles.btnPri, (loading || exportingDoc) && { opacity: 0.6 }]}
        onPress={() => void handleExportReport()}
        disabled={loading || exportingDoc}
      >
        {exportingDoc ? (
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.onPrimary} />
        ) : (
          <>
            <Ionicons name="download-outline" size={15} color={palette.onPrimary} />
            <Text style={styles.btnPriText}>Export</Text>
          </>
        )}
      </TouchableOpacity>

      <Modal
        visible={showPageSetup}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setShowPageSetup(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
          <View style={styles.modalCard}>
            <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Page Setup</Text>
            <Text style={styles.modalSub}>
              Choose paper size, orientation, and margins so every downloaded or printed sheet fits cleanly with no cut or blank pages.
            </Text>

            <Text style={styles.modalLabel}>Paper Size</Text>
            <ChipRow<MobilePaperKey>
              wrap
              options={(Object.keys(MOBILE_PAPER_DIMS) as MobilePaperKey[]).map((key) => ({
                key,
                label: MOBILE_PAPER_DIMS[key].label,
              }))}
              selected={pageSetup.paperSize}
              onSelect={(paperSize) => setPageSetup((p) => ({ ...p, paperSize }))}
            />

            <Text style={styles.modalLabel}>Orientation</Text>
            <ChipRow<MobileOrientation>
              wrap
              options={[
                { key: 'portrait', label: 'Portrait' },
                { key: 'landscape', label: 'Landscape' },
              ]}
              selected={pageSetup.orientation}
              onSelect={(orientation) => setPageSetup((p) => ({ ...p, orientation }))}
            />

            <Text style={styles.modalLabel}>Page Margins</Text>
            <ChipRow<MobileMarginPreset>
              wrap
              options={(Object.keys(MOBILE_MARGIN_INCHES) as MobileMarginPreset[]).map((mKey) => ({
                key: mKey,
                label: MOBILE_MARGIN_INCHES[mKey].label,
              }))}
              selected={pageSetup.marginPreset}
              onSelect={(marginPreset) => setPageSetup((p) => ({ ...p, marginPreset }))}
            />

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.btnPri, { width: '100%', paddingVertical: 11, marginTop: 12 }]}
              onPress={() => setShowPageSetup(false)}
            >
              <Text style={styles.btnPriText}>Apply Page Setup</Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );

  const content = (
    <>
      {/* Standalone Top Header (hidden when embedded inside MainTabNavigator) */}
      {!embedded ? (
        <View style={styles.topHeader}>
          <View style={styles.standaloneTitleRow}>
            {navigation.canGoBack() && (
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.backBtn}
                onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
                accessibilityLabel="Go back"
              >
                <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={19} color={palette.textPrimary} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text style={styles.screenTitle}>School Reports</Text>
              <Text style={styles.screenSub}>Print &amp; Export Records</Text>
            </View>
          </View>
          {renderActionButtons()}
        </View>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.embeddedActionBar}>
          <Text style={styles.embeddedHint}>Select a form to view, print, or share</Text>
          {renderActionButtons()}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Role-Filtered Tab Switcher */}
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        style={styles.tabScrollWrap}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.tabRow}
      >
        {availableTabs.map((tab) => {
          const active = selectedTab === tab.key;
          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={tab.key}
              style={[styles.tabBtn, active && styles.tabBtnActive]}
              onPress={() => {
                setSelectedTab(tab.key);
                setSearchQuery('');
              }}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name={tab.icon}
                size={13}
                color={active ? palette.onPrimary : palette.textSecondary}
              />
              <Text style={[styles.tabBtnText, active && styles.tabBtnTextActive]}>
                {tab.label}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>

      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            colors={[palette.primary]}
            tintColor={palette.primary}
          />
        }
      >
        {/* All vs Selected Only Controls for Schedules & Class Lists */}
        {(selectedTab === 'SCHEDULE' || selectedTab === 'CLASS_LIST') && (
          <View style={styles.card}>
            <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderTitle}>EXPORT &amp; PRINT SCOPE</Text>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, marginBottom: packScope === 'SELECTED' ? 10 : 0 }}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[styles.secPill, { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', marginRight: 0 }, packScope === 'ALL' && styles.secPillActive]}
                onPress={() => setPackScope('ALL')}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.secPillText, packScope === 'ALL' && styles.secPillTextActive]}>
                  {isAdmin ? 'All School Records' : 'All My Classes'}
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[styles.secPill, { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', marginRight: 0 }, packScope === 'SELECTED' && styles.secPillActive]}
                onPress={() => setPackScope('SELECTED')}
              >
                <Text style={[styles.secPillText, packScope === 'SELECTED' && styles.secPillTextActive]}>
                  Selected Only ({pickedSectionIds.length + (isAdmin ? pickedTeacherIds.length : 0)})
                </Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            {packScope === 'SELECTED' && (
              <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                {sections.length > 0 && (
                  <View>
                    <Text style={[styles.loadingText, { textAlign: 'left', marginBottom: 6 }]}>
                      Tap Class Sections to Include:
                    </Text>
                    <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}>
                      {sections.map((sec) => {
                        const checked = pickedSectionIds.includes(sec.section_id);
                        return (
                          <TouchableOpacity
                            key={`pick-sec-${sec.section_id}`}
                            style={[styles.secPill, checked && styles.secPillActive]}
                            onPress={() =>
                              setPickedSectionIds((prev) =>
                                prev.includes(sec.section_id)
                                  ? prev.filter((id) => id !== sec.section_id)
                                  : [...prev, sec.section_id]
                              )
                            }
                          >
                            <Ionicons
                              name={checked ? 'checkbox' : 'square-outline'}
                              size={13}
                              color={checked ? palette.onPrimary : palette.primary}
                            />
                            <Text style={[styles.secPillText, checked && styles.secPillTextActive]}>
                              {sec.section_name}
                            </Text>
                          </TouchableOpacity>
                        );
                      })}
                    </ScrollView>
                  </View>
                )}

                {isAdmin && teachersList.length > 0 && selectedTab === 'SCHEDULE' && (
                  <View>
                    <Text style={[styles.loadingText, { textAlign: 'left', marginBottom: 6 }]}>
                      Or Tap Teachers to Include:
                    </Text>
                    <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}>
                      {teachersList.map((t) => {
                        const checked = pickedTeacherIds.includes(t.id);
                        return (
                          <TouchableOpacity
                            key={`pick-t-${t.id}`}
                            style={[styles.secPill, checked && styles.secPillActive]}
                            onPress={() =>
                              setPickedTeacherIds((prev) =>
                                prev.includes(t.id)
                                  ? prev.filter((id) => id !== t.id)
                                  : [...prev, t.id]
                              )
                            }
                          >
                            <Ionicons
                              name={checked ? 'checkbox' : 'square-outline'}
                              size={13}
                              color={checked ? palette.onPrimary : palette.primary}
                            />
                            <Text style={[styles.secPillText, checked && styles.secPillTextActive]}>
                              {t.full_name}
                            </Text>
                          </TouchableOpacity>
                        );
                      })}
                    </ScrollView>
                  </View>
                )}
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Month Selector for DTR, SF2, SF4 */}
        {(selectedTab === 'DTR' || selectedTab === 'SF2' || selectedTab === 'SF4') && (
          <ScrollView
            ref={monthScrollRef}
            horizontal
            showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
            style={styles.monthStrip}
          >
            {SHORT_MONTHS.map((mName, idx) => {
              const mNum = idx + 1;
              const active = selectedMonth === mNum;
              return (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={mName}
                  style={[styles.monthChip, active && styles.monthChipActive]}
                  onPress={() => setSelectedMonth(mNum)}
                >
                  <Text style={[styles.monthChipText, active && styles.monthChipTextActive]}>
                    {mName} {selectedYear}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              );
            })}
          </ScrollView>
        )}

        {/* Section Selector for SF1 & SF2 */}
        {(selectedTab === 'SF1' || selectedTab === 'SF2') && (
          <View style={styles.card}>
            <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderTitle}>CLASS SECTION</Text>
            {sections.length === 0 ? (
              <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No assigned sections found.</Text>
            ) : (
              <ChipRow<number>
                options={sections.map((sec) => ({
                  key: sec.section_id,
                  label: sec.section_name,
                }))}
                selected={selectedSectionId ?? -1}
                onSelect={setSelectedSectionId}
              />
            )}
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Quick Search */}
        {selectedTab !== 'DTR' && (
          <View style={styles.searchBox}>
            <Ionicons name="search-outline" size={16} color={palette.textMuted} />
            <TextInput
              style={styles.searchInput}
              value={searchQuery}
              onChangeText={setSearchQuery}
              placeholder={
                selectedTab === 'SF4' ? 'Filter grade level...' : 'Search student name or LRN...'
              }
              placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
              maxLength={80}
            />
            {searchQuery.length > 0 && (
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setSearchQuery('')}>
                <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={16} color={palette.textMuted} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Dynamic Report Content */}
        {loading ? (
          <View style={styles.card}>
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} style={{ marginVertical: 24 }} />
            <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Loading {selectedTab.replace('_', ' ')} records...</Text>
          </View>
        ) : selectedTab === 'SCHEDULE' ? (
          <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
            {packScope === 'SELECTED' &&
            pickedSectionIds.length === 0 &&
            (!isAdmin || pickedTeacherIds.length === 0) ? (
              <View style={styles.card}>
                <Text style={styles.emptyText}>
                  Tap one or more class sections or teachers above, or switch to All.
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : !scheduleData || !(scheduleData.teacher_schedules || []).length ? (
              <View style={styles.card}>
                <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No class schedules found for the selected filter.</Text>
              </View>
            ) : (
              (scheduleData.teacher_schedules as any[])
                .filter(
                  (ts) =>
                    !cleanSearch ||
                    String(ts.teacher_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) ||
                    (ts.periods || []).some(
                      (p: any) =>
                        String(p.subject_title || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) ||
                        String(p.section_label || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch)
                    )
                )
                .map((ts: any) => (
                  <View key={`sched-t-${ts.teacher_id}`} style={styles.card}>
                    <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderTitle}>
                      {ts.teacher_name} ({ts.employee_id}) • {ts.total_weekly_hours} hrs/wk
                    </Text>
                    {Array.isArray(ts.advisory_sections) && ts.advisory_sections.length > 0 && (
                      <Text style={[styles.loadingText, { textAlign: 'left', marginBottom: 8 }]}>
                        Class Adviser: {ts.advisory_sections.join(', ')}
                      </Text>
                    )}
                    {(ts.periods || []).length === 0 ? (
                      <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No active subject periods assigned.</Text>
                    ) : (
                      (ts.periods || []).map((p: any) => (
                        <View
                          key={`per-${p.id}`}
                          style={{
                            paddingVertical: 8,
                            borderTopWidth: 1,
                            borderTopColor: palette.border,
                            gap: 2,
                          }}
                        >
                          <Text style={{ fontSize: fonts.sm, fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: palette.textPrimary }}>
                            {p.subject_code} — {p.subject_title}
                          </Text>
                          <Text style={{ fontSize: fonts.xs, color: palette.textSecondary }}>
                            {p.section_label} • {p.room_name}
                          </Text>
                          <Text style={{ fontSize: fonts.xs, color: palette.primary, fontWeight: fonts.weight.semibold }}>
                            {p.time_range} ({p.day_label})
                          </Text>
                        </View>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </View>
                ))
            )}
          </View>
        ) : selectedTab === 'CLASS_LIST' ? (
          <View style={{ gap: 10 }}>
            {packScope === 'SELECTED' && pickedSectionIds.length === 0 ? (
              <View style={styles.card}>
                <Text style={styles.emptyText}>
                  Tap one or more class sections above, or switch to All.
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : !classListData || !(classListData.class_lists || []).length ? (
              <View style={styles.card}>
                <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No class lists found for the selected filter.</Text>
              </View>
            ) : (
              (classListData.class_lists as any[]).map((cl: any) => {
                const matchingStudents = (cl.students || []).filter(
                  (st: any) =>
                    !cleanSearch ||
                    String(st.full_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) ||
                    String(st.lrn || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch)
                );
                return (
                  <View key={`cl-${cl.section_id}`} style={styles.card}>
                    <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderTitle}>
                      {cl.section_label} ({cl.total_count} Students)
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={[styles.loadingText, { textAlign: 'left', marginBottom: 8 }]}>
                      Adviser: {cl.adviser_name} • Room: {cl.room_name} • Male: {cl.male_count} / Female: {cl.female_count}
                    </Text>
                    {matchingStudents.length === 0 ? (
                      <Text style={styles.emptyText}>No students match your search.</Text>
                    ) : (
                      matchingStudents.map((st: any) => (
                        <View
                          key={`st-${cl.section_id}-${st.student_id}`}
                          style={{
                            flexDirection: 'row',
                            justifyContent: 'space-between',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            paddingVertical: 7,
                            borderTopWidth: 1,
                            borderTopColor: palette.border,
                            gap: 8,
                          }}
                        >
                          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                            <Text style={{ fontSize: fonts.sm, fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: palette.textPrimary }}>
                              {st.full_name}
                            </Text>
                            <Text style={{ fontSize: fonts.xs, color: palette.textSecondary }}>
                              LRN: {st.lrn} • {st.sex}
                            </Text>
                          </View>
                          <Text style={{ fontSize: fonts.xs, fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: palette.primary }}>
                            {st.today_status}
                          </Text>
                        </View>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </View>
                );
              })
            )}
          </View>
        ) : selectedTab === 'DTR' ? (
          <DTRReportView
            data={dtrData}
            selectedMonth={selectedMonth}
            selectedYear={selectedYear}
            onMonthChange={(m, y) => {
              setSelectedMonth(m);
              setSelectedYear(y);
            }}
            submitting={submittingDtr}
            onSubmit={handleSubmitDtr}
            onRefreshNeeded={() => void loadReportData()}
          />
        ) : selectedTab === 'SF1' ? (
          <SF1ReportView data={sf1Data} learners={filteredSf1} />
        ) : selectedTab === 'SF2' ? (
          <SF2ReportView data={sf2Data} learners={filteredSf2} />
        ) : selectedTab === 'SF4' ? (
          <SF4ReportView data={sf4Data} gradeGroups={filteredSf4} />
        ) : null}
      </ScrollView>
    </>
  );

  if (embedded) {
    return <View style={styles.container}>{content}</View>;
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.container} edges={['top', 'left', 'right']}>
      {content}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
};

const createStyles = (palette: ThemePalette, fonts: ReturnType<typeof useThemeMode>['fonts']) =>
  StyleSheet.create({
    container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: palette.background },
    topHeader: {
      flexDirection: 'row',
      alignItems: 'center',
      justifyContent: 'space-between',
      paddingHorizontal: 16,
      paddingVertical: 12,
      backgroundColor: palette.surface,
      borderBottomWidth: 1,
      borderBottomColor: palette.border,
      gap: 10,
    },
    standaloneTitleRow: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', flex: 1, gap: 10 },
    backBtn: {
      width: 34,
      height: 34,
      borderRadius: 10,
      backgroundColor: palette.surfaceSubtle,
      borderWidth: 1,
      borderColor: palette.border,
      alignItems: 'center',
      justifyContent: 'center',
    },
    embeddedActionBar: {
      flexDirection: 'row',
      alignItems: 'center',
      justifyContent: 'space-between',
      paddingHorizontal: 16,
      paddingVertical: 10,
      backgroundColor: palette.surface,
      borderBottomWidth: 1,
      borderBottomColor: palette.border,
      gap: 8,
    },
    embeddedHint: { flex: 1, fontSize: fonts.xs, color: palette.textSecondary, fontWeight: fonts.weight.semibold },
    screenTitle: { fontSize: fonts.lg, fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold, color: palette.textPrimary },
    screenSub: { fontSize: fonts.xs, color: palette.textSecondary, marginTop: 1 },
    btnPri: {
      flexDirection: 'row',
      alignItems: 'center',
      backgroundColor: palette.buttonBg,
      paddingVertical: 7,
      paddingHorizontal: 11,

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - DepEd Campus Safety, SARDO Early-Warning & Emergency Roll-Call
 * File: mobile/src/screens/SardoSafetyScreen.tsx
 *
 * 100% content parity with web EnterpriseSDGWidget:
 * - Emergency Evacuation Campus Roll-Call checklist (live headcount + safe check-off)
 * - DepEd Division Data Export (.JSON / .CSV) with Philippine Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) mask
 * - Live School Operations & Attendance Equity metrics
 * - 30-Day SARDO Dropout Early-Warning Class List with recommended interventions
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  ScrollView,
  TouchableOpacity,
  TextInput,
  Modal,
  Switch,
  RefreshControl,
  ActivityIndicator,
  Share,
  Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useThemeMode } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { getFriendlyErrorMessage, type ThemePalette } from '../constants/theme';
import { isSchoolLeader } from '../utils/permissions';
import { showNotice } from '../utils/helpers';

interface EmergencyStudent {
  student_id: number;
  lrn: string;
  full_name: string;
  section: string;
  guardian_contact?: string;
}

interface EmergencyRollCallData {
  timestamp: string;
  total_people_on_campus: number;
  students_count: number;
  teachers_count: number;
  students: EmergencyStudent[];
}

export const SardoSafetyScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);
  const leader = isSchoolLeader(user);

  const [impactData, setImpactData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [sardoData, setSardoData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const [rollCallOpen, setRollCallOpen] = useState(false);
  const [rollCallLoading, setRollCallLoading] = useState(false);
  const [rollCallData, setRollCallData] = useState<EmergencyRollCallData | null>(null);
  const [rollCallSearch, setRollCallSearch] = useState('');
  const [safeStudentIds, setSafeStudentIds] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});

  const [maskPersonalIds, setMaskPersonalIds] = useState(true);
  const [exportingFormat, setExportingFormat] = useState<'json' | 'csv' | null>(null);

  const isMounted = useRef(true);

  const loadData = useCallback(async (silent = false) => {
    if (!silent && isMounted.current) setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [impRes, sardoRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.REPORT_SDG_IMPACT),
        apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.REPORT_DROPOUT_RISK),
      ]);
      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      if (impRes.status === 'fulfilled' && impRes.value?.data) {
        setImpactData(impRes.value.data);
      }
      if (sardoRes.status === 'fulfilled' && sardoRes.value?.data) {
        setSardoData(sardoRes.value.data);
      }
    } catch {}
    finally {
      if (isMounted.current) {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    void loadData(false);
    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
    };
  }, [loadData]);

  const handleOpenRollCall = async () => {
    setRollCallOpen(true);
    setRollCallLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get<EmergencyRollCallData>(ENDPOINTS.CAMPUS_ROLL_CALL, {
        params: { nocache: 1 },
      });
      if (isMounted.current) {
        setRollCallData(res.data);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (isMounted.current) {
        showNotice('Roll-Call Error', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not load campus headcount.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setRollCallLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleStudentSafe = (studentId: number) => {
    setSafeStudentIds((prev) => ({ ...prev, [studentId]: !prev[studentId] }));
  };

  const handleDivisionExport = async (fmt: 'json' | 'csv') => {
    if (!leader || exportingFormat) return;
    setExportingFormat(fmt);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.REPORT_DIVISION_EXPORT, {
        params: {
          days: 30,
          anonymize: maskPersonalIds ? 1 : 0,
          export_format: fmt,
        },
        responseType: fmt === 'csv' ? 'text' : 'json',
      });
      const content =
        fmt === 'csv' ? String(res.data || '') : JSON.stringify(res.data, null, 2);
      const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const modeTag = maskPersonalIds ? 'privacy_masked' : 'official';
      const filename = `attendsure_deped_division_export_${modeTag}_${today}.${fmt}`;

      if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof document !== 'undefined') {
        const mime = fmt === 'csv' ? 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' : 'application/json';
        const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mime });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = filename;
        a.click();
        setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
        showNotice('Export Downloaded', `Saved ${filename}`);
      } else {
        await Share.share({
          title: filename,
          message: content.slice(0, 20000),
        });
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showNotice(
        'Export Failed',
        getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not export DepEd Division report right now.')
      );
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setExportingFormat(null);
    }
  };

  const filteredRollCallStudents = useMemo(() => {
    const list = rollCallData?.students || [];
    const q = rollCallSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return list;
    return list.filter(
      (s) =>
        s.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        s.lrn.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        s.section.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [rollCallData, rollCallSearch]);

  const safeCount = useMemo(() => {
    if (!rollCallData?.students) return 0;
    return rollCallData.students.filter((s) => Boolean(safeStudentIds[s.student_id])).length;
  }, [rollCallData, safeStudentIds]);

  const metricsRoot = impactData?.sdg_metrics || {};
  const eduMetrics = metricsRoot.sdg_4_quality_education || {};
  const inclusionMetrics = metricsRoot.sdg_5_and_10_equality_and_inclusion || {};
  const workloadMetrics = metricsRoot.sdg_8_decent_work || {};
  const paperlessMetrics = metricsRoot.sdg_12_and_13_climate_and_sustainability || {};
  const governanceMetrics = metricsRoot.sdg_16_accountable_institutions || {};
  const atRiskStudents: any[] = Array.isArray(sardoData?.at_risk_students)
    ? sardoData.at_risk_students
    : [];

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={() => {
              setRefreshing(true);
              void loadData(true);
            }}
            colors={[palette.primary]}
            tintColor={palette.primary}
          />
        }
      >
        {/* Top Action Banner */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.eyebrow}>DEPED CAMPUS SAFETY &amp; SARDO MONITORING</Text>
          <Text style={styles.title}>
            School Operations, SARDO Early-Warning &amp; Emergency Roll-Call
          </Text>
          <Text style={styles.subtext}>
            Live school metrics under DepEd PH &amp; Philippine Data Privacy Act (RA 10173).
          </Text>

          <TouchableOpacity
            style={styles.emergencyBtn}
            onPress={() => void handleOpenRollCall()}
            activeOpacity={0.85}
          >
            <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={18} color={palette.onPrimary} />
            <Text style={styles.emergencyBtnText}>Open Emergency Campus Roll-Call</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          {leader && (
            <View style={styles.exportBox}>
              <View style={styles.rowBetween}>
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.exportTitle}>DepEd Division Data Export (30 Days)</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.exportSub}>
                    Mask personal IDs under Data Privacy Act (RA 10173)
                  </Text>
                </View>
                <Switch
                  value={maskPersonalIds}
                  onValueChange={setMaskPersonalIds}
                  trackColor={{ false: palette.borderStrong, true: palette.success }}
                  thumbColor={palette.onPrimary}
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.exportBtnRow}>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  style={styles.exportBtn}
                  disabled={exportingFormat !== null}
                  onPress={() => void handleDivisionExport('json')}
                >
                  <Ionicons name="download-outline" size={15} color={palette.primary} />
                  <Text style={styles.exportBtnText}>
                    {exportingFormat === 'json' ? 'Exporting...' : 'Export .JSON'}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  style={[styles.exportBtn, { backgroundColor: palette.successLight, borderColor: palette.success }]}
                  disabled={exportingFormat !== null}
                  onPress={() => void handleDivisionExport('csv')}
                >
                  <Ionicons name="document-text-outline" size={15} color={palette.success} />
                  <Text style={[styles.exportBtnText, { color: palette.success }]}>
                    {exportingFormat === 'csv' ? 'Exporting...' : 'Export .CSV'}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Live KPI Cards Grid */}
        {loading ? (
          <View style={styles.centerBox}>
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
            <Text style={styles.subtext}>Loading live campus operations metrics...</Text>
          </View>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.kpiGrid}>
            <View style={styles.kpiCard}>
              <Text style={styles.kpiTag}>CLASSROOM ATTENDANCE &amp; SARDO</Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiBig}>
                {Number(eduMetrics.verified_classroom_qr_scans ?? 0).toLocaleString()}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiSub}>
                Signed QR Scans ({eduMetrics.attendance_rate_today ?? 0}% Present Today)
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiMeta}>
                Critical SARDO: {sardoData?.critical_sardo_count ?? 0} • Early-Warning:{' '}
                {sardoData?.early_warning_count ?? 0}
              </Text>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.kpiCard}>
              <Text style={styles.kpiTag}>LEARNER INCLUSION &amp; 4Ps TRACKING</Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiBig}>
                {inclusionMetrics.male_attendance_rate_today ?? 0}% M /{' '}
                {inclusionMetrics.female_attendance_rate_today ?? 0}% F
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiSub}>
                Gender Parity Index: {inclusionMetrics.gender_parity_index ?? '1.00'}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiMeta}>
                4Ps Beneficiaries Monitored: {inclusionMetrics.cct_4ps_beneficiaries_monitored ?? 0}
              </Text>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.kpiCard}>
              <Text style={styles.kpiTag}>TEACHER WORKLOAD &amp; SAVINGS</Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiBig}>
                {workloadMetrics.teacher_hours_saved_monthly ?? 0} hrs/mo
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiSub}>Clerical time saved on SF1 / SF2 / Form 48</Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiMeta}>
                Active Class Periods: {workloadMetrics.active_schedules ?? 0}
              </Text>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.kpiCard}>
              <Text style={styles.kpiTag}>PAPERLESS SCHOOL OPERATIONS</Text>
              <Text style={[styles.kpiBig, { color: palette.success }]}>
                {Number(paperlessMetrics.paper_sheets_saved ?? 0).toLocaleString()} Sheets
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiSub}>
                Paper Class Lists Saved ({paperlessMetrics.estimated_co2_reduced_kg ?? 0} kg CO2e)
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiMeta}>
                Est. Annual Savings: PHP{' '}
                {Number(paperlessMetrics.estimated_annual_savings_php ?? 0).toLocaleString()}
              </Text>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.kpiCard}>
              <Text style={styles.kpiTag}>CAMPUS GEOFENCE &amp; AUDIT TRAIL</Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiBig}>
                {governanceMetrics.teachers_face_gps_verified_today ?? 0} /{' '}
                {governanceMetrics.total_active_teachers ?? 0}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiSub}>Teachers Verified via Phone Biometric &amp; GPS Today</Text>
              <Text style={styles.kpiMeta}>
                Open Alerts: {governanceMetrics.open_loafing_incidents ?? 0} • Audit Logs (Month):{' '}
                {governanceMetrics.tamper_evident_audit_logs_this_month ?? 0}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* SARDO Dropout Early-Warning Class List */}
        <View style={styles.card}>
          <Text style={styles.title}>
            SARDO Dropout Early-Warning Class List ({atRiskStudents.length})
          </Text>
          {atRiskStudents.length === 0 ? (
            <View style={styles.healthyBox}>
              <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle-outline" size={20} color={palette.success} />
              <Text style={styles.healthyText}>
                Zero learners are flagged for SARDO dropout risk over the last 30 days.
              </Text>
            </View>
          ) : (
            atRiskStudents.map((st) => {
              const isCritical = st.risk_level === 'CRITICAL_SARDO';
              return (
                <View key={String(st.student_id)} style={styles.riskRow}>
                  <View style={styles.rowBetween}>
                    <Text style={styles.riskName}>{st.full_name}</Text>
                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.riskBadge,
                        { backgroundColor: isCritical ? palette.dangerLight : palette.warningLight },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <Text
                        style={[
                          styles.riskBadgeText,
                          { color: isCritical ? palette.danger : palette.warning },
                        ]}
                      >
                        {isCritical ? 'CRITICAL' : 'WATCH'} ({st.risk_score}%)
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                  <Text style={styles.riskMeta}>
                    LRN: {st.lrn} &bull; {st.section}
                    {st.is_4ps_beneficiary ? ' • 4Ps' : ''}
                  </Text>
                  <Text style={styles.riskStats}>
                    {st.absent_days_30d} Absent &bull; {st.cutting_days_30d} Cutting &bull;{' '}
                    {st.late_days_30d} Late
                  </Text>
                  {st.recommended_intervention ? (
                    <Text style={styles.riskAction}>Action: {st.recommended_intervention}</Text>
                  ) : null}
                </View>
              );
            })
          )}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Emergency Evacuation Campus Roll-Call Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={rollCallOpen}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setRollCallOpen(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.modalSheet}>
            <View style={styles.rowBetween}>
              <Text style={[styles.title, { color: palette.danger }]}>
                Emergency Campus Roll-Call
              </Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setRollCallOpen(false)}>
                <Ionicons name="close" size={22} color={palette.textMuted} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            {rollCallLoading ? (
              <View style={styles.centerBox}>
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.danger} />
                <Text style={styles.subtext}>Fetching live campus headcount...</Text>
              </View>
            ) : rollCallData ? (
              <>
                <Text style={styles.subtext}>
                  Snapshot: {rollCallData.timestamp} &bull; {rollCallData.total_people_on_campus}{' '}
                  people verified on campus
                </Text>

                <View style={styles.rollStatsRow}>
                  <View style={styles.rollStatBox}>
                    <Text style={styles.rollStatVal}>{rollCallData.students_count}</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.rollStatLbl}>Students</Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.rollStatBox}>
                    <Text style={[styles.rollStatVal, { color: palette.success }]}>{safeCount}</Text>
                    <Text style={styles.rollStatLbl}>Safe</Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.rollStatBox}>
                    <Text style={[styles.rollStatVal, { color: palette.danger }]}>
                      {Math.max(0, rollCallData.students_count - safeCount)}
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={styles.rollStatLbl}>Unaccounted</Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.rollStatBox}>
                    <Text style={[styles.rollStatVal, { color: palette.primary }]}>
                      {rollCallData.teachers_count ?? 0}
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={styles.rollStatLbl}>Teachers</Text>
                  </View>
                </View>

                <TextInput
                  style={styles.searchInput}
                  value={rollCallSearch}
                  onChangeText={setRollCallSearch}
                  placeholder="Filter learner by name, LRN, or section..."
                  placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                />

                <ScrollView style={{ maxHeight: 320 }} contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6 }}>
                  {filteredRollCallStudents.length === 0 ? (
                    <Text style={styles.subtext}>No learners currently checked in today.</Text>
                  ) : (
                    filteredRollCallStudents.map((st) => {
                      const isSafe = Boolean(safeStudentIds[st.student_id]);
                      return (
                        <TouchableOpacity
                          key={String(st.student_id)}
                          style={[
                            styles.rollRow,
                            isSafe && {
                              backgroundColor: palette.successLight,
                              borderColor: palette.success,
                            },
                          ]}
                          onPress={() => toggleStudentSafe(st.student_id)}
                        >
                          <Ionicons
                            name={isSafe ? 'checkbox' : 'square-outline'}
                            size={20}
                            color={isSafe ? palette.success : palette.textMuted}
                          />
                          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                            <Text style={styles.riskName}>{st.full_name}</Text>
                            <Text style={styles.riskMeta}>
                              LRN: {st.lrn} &bull; {st.section}
                            </Text>
                          </View>
                          <Text
                            style={[
                              styles.riskBadgeText,
                              { color: isSafe ? palette.success : palette.danger },
                            ]}
                          >
                            {isSafe ? 'SAFE' : 'UNACCOUNTED'}
                          </Text>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                      );
                    })
                  )}
                </ScrollView>
              </>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
};

const createStyles = (palette: ThemePalette, fonts: ReturnType<typeof useThemeMode>['fonts']) =>
  StyleSheet.create({
    container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: palette.background },
    scrollContent: { padding: 14, paddingBottom: 120, gap: 12 },
    card: {
      backgroundColor: palette.surface,
      borderRadius: 16,
      padding: 16,
      borderWidth: 1,
      borderColor: palette.border,
      gap: 10,
    },
    eyebrow: { fontSize: fonts.xxs, fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold, color: palette.primary },
    title: { fontSize: fonts.md, fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold, color: palette.textPrimary },
    subtext: { fontSize: fonts.xs, color: palette.textSecondary, lineHeight: 17 },
    emergencyBtn: {
      flexDirection: 'row',
      alignItems: 'center',
      justifyContent: 'center',
      gap: 8,
      height: 44,
      borderRadius: 12,
      backgroundColor: palette.dangerBg,
    },
    emergencyBtnText: {
      color: palette.onPrimary,
      fontSize: fonts.sm,
      fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold,
    },
    exportBox: {
      padding: 12,
      borderRadius: 12,
