/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Dual-Mode Attendance & Verification Screen
 * Mode 1: Continuous Automatic Student QR Scanner (Built-In Back Camera) + Student Photo & Timestamp
 * Mode 2: Built-In Phone Fingerprint / Passkey Sensor Verification + 1-to-1 Phone Binding + Anti-Fake Campus GPS
 * File: mobile/src/screens/ScannerScreen.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  TouchableOpacity,
  ActivityIndicator,
  AppState,
  ScrollView,
  DeviceEventEmitter,
} from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { CameraView, useCameraPermissions, type BarcodeScanningResult } from 'expo-camera';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import * as Location from 'expo-location';
import * as Crypto from 'expo-crypto';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useThemeMode } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import {
  getFriendlyErrorMessage,
  SCANNER_OVERLAY_COLORS,
  type ThemePalette,
} from '../constants/theme';
import { canScanStudentQr } from '../utils/permissions';
import { getInitials, isCanceledError, resolveMediaUrl, showNotice } from '../utils/helpers';
import { getServerBaseUrl } from '../services/configService';
import { getOrCreateDeviceUuid } from '../services/deviceService';
import {
  enqueueOfflineQrScan,
  getQueuedQrScans,
  syncOfflineQrScans,
} from '../services/offlineQueue';
import {
  playScanErrorSound,
  playScanSuccessSound,
  playScanWarningSound,
} from '../services/soundService';
import { format12HourTime, getRealDeviceModel } from '../services/telemetryService';
import { setTeacherOnDutyFlag } from '../services/backgroundLocation';
import {
  checkPhoneLockCapability,
  verifyTeacherBiometricProof,
  type PhoneLockCapability,
} from '../services/biometricService';

export const ATTENDANCE_UPDATED_EVENT = 'attendsure:attendance-updated';

export interface ScannerScreenProps {
  onBack?: () => void;
}

type ScannerMode = 'STUDENT_QR' | 'TEACHER_CHECKIN';
type CheckInAction = 'TIME_IN' | 'TIME_OUT';
type CheckInStep = 'IDLE' | 'BIOMETRIC' | 'GPS' | 'SAVING' | 'DONE';

interface ClassOption {
  schedule_id: number;
  section_name: string;
  subject_code: string;
  subject_title: string;
  time_display: string;
}

interface ScanCardResult {
  ok: boolean;
  isDuplicate?: boolean;
  studentName: string;
  statusLabel: string;
  timestamp: string;
  photoUrl: string | null;
  errorDetail?: string;
}

const makeUuid = (): string => {
  if (typeof Crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
    return Crypto.randomUUID();
  }
  return `scan-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
};

export const ScannerScreen: React.FC<ScannerScreenProps> = ({ onBack }) => {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const { user, refreshUser } = useAuth();
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);
  const [permission, requestPermission] = useCameraPermissions();

  const allowStudentQr = canScanStudentQr(user);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ScannerMode>(allowStudentQr ? 'STUDENT_QR' : 'TEACHER_CHECKIN');
  const [serverBase, setServerBase] = useState<string>('');
  const [scanPhotoFailed, setScanPhotoFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!allowStudentQr && mode === 'STUDENT_QR') {
      setMode('TEACHER_CHECKIN');
    }
  }, [allowStudentQr, mode]);

  // Mode 1: Continuous Student Camera QR state
  const [classes, setClasses] = useState<ClassOption[]>([]);
  const [selectedPeriodId, setSelectedPeriodId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [queuedQrCount, setQueuedQrCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [syncingQr, setSyncingQr] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [qrBusy, setQrBusy] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastScan, setLastScan] = useState<ScanCardResult | null>(null);

  // Mode 2: Phone Fingerprint / Screen Lock (PIN or Pattern) + Campus GPS state (NO front camera)
  const [checkInAction, setCheckInAction] = useState<CheckInAction>('TIME_IN');
  const [submittingCheckIn, setSubmittingCheckIn] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [checkInStep, setCheckInStep] = useState<CheckInStep>('IDLE');
  const [lockCapability, setLockCapability] = useState<PhoneLockCapability | null>(null);
  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState<string>(
    'Confirm with your phone lock inside the school boundary to record your Time In or Time Out. Zero face photos or fingerprint data are ever saved on the server.'
  );
  const [statusIsError, setStatusIsError] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastCheckInTime, setLastCheckInTime] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const isMountedRef = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const recentQrMapRef = useRef<Map<string, number>>(new Map());
  const inFlightQrSetRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const phoneModelLabel = useMemo(() => getRealDeviceModel() || 'This Phone', []);

  const loadAssignedClasses = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const [clsRes, queued, base] = await Promise.all([
        apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.ATTENDANCE_CLASSES, { params: { summary: '1' } }),
        getQueuedQrScans(),
        getServerBaseUrl(),
      ]);
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      if (base) setServerBase(base);
      const raw = Array.isArray(clsRes.data) ? clsRes.data : clsRes.data?.results || [];
      const list: ClassOption[] = raw
        .filter((item: any) => item.subject_code !== 'ADV')
        .map((item: any) => ({
          schedule_id: Number(item.schedule_id || item.id),
          section_name: String(item.section_name || item.name || 'Section'),
          subject_code: String(item.subject_code || 'CLASS'),
          subject_title: String(item.subject_title || item.subject_name || 'Class'),
          time_display: String(item.time_display || ''),
        }));
      setClasses(list);
      setSelectedPeriodId((prev) => prev ?? (list[0]?.schedule_id || null));
      setQueuedQrCount(queued.length);
    } catch {
      const queued = await getQueuedQrScans().catch(() => []);
      if (isMountedRef.current) setQueuedQrCount(queued.length);
    }
  }, []);

  const refreshPhoneLockCapability = useCallback(() => {
    checkPhoneLockCapability()
      .then((info) => {
        if (isMountedRef.current) setLockCapability(info);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    if (allowStudentQr) {
      void loadAssignedClasses();
    } else {
      getServerBaseUrl()
        .then((base) => {
          if (isMountedRef.current && base) setServerBase(base);
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }

    refreshPhoneLockCapability();

    // Re-check lock capability when returning from Android/iOS Settings -> Lock screen
    const appStateSub = AppState.addEventListener('change', (nextState) => {
      if (nextState === 'active') {
        refreshPhoneLockCapability();
      }
    });

    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
      appStateSub.remove();
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [loadAssignedClasses, allowStudentQr, refreshPhoneLockCapability]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode === 'TEACHER_CHECKIN') {
      refreshPhoneLockCapability();
    }
  }, [mode, refreshPhoneLockCapability]);

  // Only ask for camera permission when using Student QR mode
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode === 'STUDENT_QR' && permission && !permission.granted && permission.canAskAgain) {
      void requestPermission();
    }
  }, [mode, permission, requestPermission]);

  const handleSyncQueuedScans = async () => {
    if (syncingQr) return;
    setSyncingQr(true);
    try {
      const res = await syncOfflineQrScans();
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      setQueuedQrCount(res.remaining);
      if (res.synced > 0) {
        DeviceEventEmitter.emit(ATTENDANCE_UPDATED_EVENT, { syncedCount: res.synced });
      }
      showNotice(
        'Saved Scans Uploaded',
        res.synced > 0
          ? `Uploaded ${res.synced} saved student scan(s). Remaining on phone: ${res.remaining}.`
          : 'Your phone is still offline. Saved scans remain safe on your phone and will sync automatically.'
      );
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setSyncingQr(false);
    }
  };

  // Mode 1: Continuous automatic Student QR scanner (zero manual capture button)
  const handleStudentQrScanned = async (event: BarcodeScanningResult) => {
    if (mode !== 'STUDENT_QR') return;
    const rawQr = String(event.data || '').trim();
    if (!rawQr) return;

    const now = Date.now();
    recentQrMapRef.current.forEach((ts, key) => {
      if (now - ts > 10000) recentQrMapRef.current.delete(key);
    });

    // Per-QR 3-second duplicate cooldown so holding one card steady doesn't spam,
    // while the next student's QR card scans immediately with zero delay.
    const prevScanTs = recentQrMapRef.current.get(rawQr) || 0;
    if (now - prevScanTs < 3000 || inFlightQrSetRef.current.has(rawQr)) {
      return;
    }

    if (!selectedPeriodId) {
      recentQrMapRef.current.set(rawQr, now);
      setLastScan({
        ok: false,
        studentName: 'Select a Class Period First',
        statusLabel: '',
        timestamp: format12HourTime(new Date()),
        photoUrl: null,
        errorDetail: 'Tap your active class pill above before scanning.',
      });
      void playScanWarningSound();
      return;
    }

    recentQrMapRef.current.set(rawQr, now);
    inFlightQrSetRef.current.add(rawQr);
    setQrBusy(true);

    const scanUuid = makeUuid();
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(ENDPOINTS.ATTENDANCE_SCAN, {
        qr_text: rawQr,
        period_id: selectedPeriodId,
        client_scan_uuid: scanUuid,
      });
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;

      const d = res.data || {};
      const resolvedPhoto = resolveMediaUrl(d.photo_url, serverBase);
      const scanTimestamp = String(d.scanned_at || '').trim() || format12HourTime(new Date());
      const duplicate = Boolean(d.is_duplicate);

      setScanPhotoFailed(false);
      setLastScan({
        ok: true,
        isDuplicate: duplicate,
        studentName: String(d.student_name || 'Student'),
        statusLabel: String(d.status || 'PRESENT'),
        timestamp: scanTimestamp,
        photoUrl: resolvedPhoto,
      });

      if (duplicate) {
        void playScanWarningSound();
      } else {
        void playScanSuccessSound();
      }

      DeviceEventEmitter.emit(ATTENDANCE_UPDATED_EVENT, {
        studentId: d.student_id,
        periodId: d.period_id || selectedPeriodId,
        status: d.status || 'PRESENT',
        scannedAt: scanTimestamp,
      });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      const httpStatus = (err as { response?: { status?: number } })?.response?.status;
      const offlineTime = format12HourTime(new Date());

      if (!httpStatus) {
        const nextCount = await enqueueOfflineQrScan({
          client_scan_uuid: scanUuid,
          qr_token: rawQr,
          period_id: selectedPeriodId,
          scanned_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        });
        if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
        setQueuedQrCount(nextCount);
        setScanPhotoFailed(false);
        setLastScan({
          ok: true,
          isDuplicate: true,
          studentName: 'Saved on Phone',
          statusLabel: 'SAVED OFFLINE',
          timestamp: `${offlineTime} • Will sync automatically`,
          photoUrl: null,
        });
        void playScanWarningSound();
      } else {
        setLastScan({
          ok: false,
          studentName: 'Card Could Not Be Verified',
          statusLabel: '',
          timestamp: offlineTime,
          photoUrl: null,
          errorDetail: getFriendlyErrorMessage(
            err,
            'We could not verify this QR card. Please ask the student for their official AttendSure QR ID.'
          ),
        });
        void playScanErrorSound();
      }
    } finally {
      inFlightQrSetRef.current.delete(rawQr);
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setQrBusy(inFlightQrSetRef.current.size > 0);
      }
    }
  };

  // Mode 2: Phone Fingerprint / Passkey + 1-to-1 Phone Binding + Anti-Fake Campus GPS
  const handleTeacherBiometricCheckIn = async () => {
    if (submittingCheckIn) return;

    abortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;

    setSubmittingCheckIn(true);
    setStatusIsError(false);
    setCheckInStep('BIOMETRIC');
    setStatusMessage(
      lockCapability?.hasBiometric
        ? 'Step 1 of 3: Confirm your identity using your phone fingerprint or biometric lock...'
        : 'Step 1 of 3: Confirm your identity using your phone screen lock (PIN, Pattern, or Password)...'
    );

    try {
      const userId = user?.id ?? user?.username ?? 'teacher';
      const bioProof = await verifyTeacherBiometricProof(userId, checkInAction);
      if (!isMountedRef.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

      if (!bioProof.ok || !bioProof.keyId || !bioProof.proofHash) {
        const errMsg =
          bioProof.error ||
          'No screen lock is set on this phone. Please go to your phone Settings -> Lock screen and set a PIN, Pattern, or Fingerprint first.';
        setCheckInStep('IDLE');
        setStatusIsError(true);
        setStatusMessage(errMsg);
        void playScanErrorSound();
        showNotice('Phone Lock Verification Needed', errMsg);
        return;
      }

      setCheckInStep('GPS');
      setStatusMessage('Step 2 of 3: Checking live campus GPS signal...');

      const { status } = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync();
      if (!isMountedRef.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

      if (status !== 'granted') {
        const msg = 'Location permission is required to verify you are inside campus.';
        setCheckInStep('IDLE');
        setStatusIsError(true);
        setStatusMessage(msg);
        void playScanWarningSound();
        showNotice('Location Needed', 'Allow location access to verify school campus boundaries.');
        return;
      }

      const loc = await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({
        accuracy: Location.Accuracy.BestForNavigation,
      });
      if (!isMountedRef.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

      // Immediately block fake / mock GPS before calling the server API
      if (loc.mocked === true) {
        const msg =
          'A mock location setting is turned on. Please turn it off in phone Settings, then try again.';
        setCheckInStep('IDLE');
        setStatusIsError(true);
        setStatusMessage(msg);
        void playScanErrorSound();
        showNotice('Mock Location Active', msg);
        return;
      }

      const fixAgeSec = Math.abs(Date.now() - (loc.timestamp || Date.now())) / 1000;
      if (fixAgeSec > 90) {
        const msg =
          'Your GPS signal needs a quick refresh. Step near a window or outdoors and tap again.';
        setCheckInStep('IDLE');
        setStatusIsError(true);
        setStatusMessage(msg);
        void playScanWarningSound();
        showNotice('Refresh GPS Signal', msg);
        return;
      }

      if ((loc.coords.accuracy ?? 0) > 250) {
        const msg =
          'Your GPS signal is weak right now. Step near a window or outdoors and try again.';
        setCheckInStep('IDLE');
        setStatusIsError(true);
        setStatusMessage(msg);
        void playScanWarningSound();
        showNotice('Weak GPS Signal', msg);
        return;
      }

      setCheckInStep('SAVING');
      setStatusMessage('Step 3 of 3: Saving your verified attendance record...');

      const deviceId = await getOrCreateDeviceUuid();
      if (!isMountedRef.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;
      const deviceModel = getRealDeviceModel() || 'AttendSure Mobile';

      const res = await apiClient.post(
        ENDPOINTS.CAMPUS_CHECK_IN,
        {
          action: checkInAction,
          latitude: Number(loc.coords.latitude.toFixed(6)),
          longitude: Number(loc.coords.longitude.toFixed(6)),
          accuracy_meters: Number((loc.coords.accuracy ?? 15).toFixed(1)),
          speed_mps:
            loc.coords.speed !== null && loc.coords.speed !== undefined && loc.coords.speed >= 0
              ? Number(loc.coords.speed.toFixed(2))
              : null,
          gps_timestamp_ms: Math.round(loc.timestamp || Date.now()),
          device_id: deviceId,
          device_model: deviceModel,
          biometric_verified_on_device: true,
          biometric_key_id: bioProof.keyId,
          biometric_proof: bioProof.proofHash,
          biometric_method: bioProof.biometricMethod || 'BIOMETRIC',
          biometric_timestamp_ms: bioProof.timestampMs || Date.now(),
          is_mock_location: false,
        },
        { signal: controller.signal }
      );

      if (!isMountedRef.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;

      await setTeacherOnDutyFlag(checkInAction === 'TIME_IN');
      void playScanSuccessSound();
      void refreshUser();

      const recordedAt = String(res.data?.recorded_at || '').trim() || format12HourTime(new Date());
      setLastCheckInTime(recordedAt);
      setCheckInStep('DONE');
      setStatusIsError(false);

      DeviceEventEmitter.emit(ATTENDANCE_UPDATED_EVENT, {
        teacherCheckIn: checkInAction,
        recordedAt,
      });

      const replyMsg =
        typeof res.data?.message === 'string' && res.data.message.trim()
          ? res.data.message.trim()
          : checkInAction === 'TIME_IN'
          ? bioProof.biometricMethod === 'BIOMETRIC'
            ? 'Time In verified: Phone fingerprint & campus GPS confirmed.'
            : 'Time In verified: Phone screen lock & campus GPS confirmed.'
          : 'Time Out verified. Campus GPS tracking paused.';

      setStatusMessage(replyMsg);
      showNotice(checkInAction === 'TIME_IN' ? 'Timed In' : 'Timed Out', replyMsg);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!isMountedRef.current || isCanceledError(err)) return;
      void playScanErrorSound();
      const friendly = getFriendlyErrorMessage(
        err,
        'Move closer to a window or step inside the school boundary with your paired phone to complete Time In / Out.'
      );
      setCheckInStep('IDLE');
      setStatusIsError(true);
      setStatusMessage(friendly);
      showNotice('Could Not Complete Check-In', friendly);
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) {
        setSubmittingCheckIn(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const hasBiometricSensor = Boolean(lockCapability?.hasBiometric);
  const isPhoneLockReady = lockCapability ? lockCapability.ready : true;

  const stepActiveLabel =
    checkInStep === 'BIOMETRIC'
      ? hasBiometricSensor
        ? 'Confirming on Your Phone...'
        : 'Confirming Phone Screen Lock...'
      : checkInStep === 'GPS'
      ? 'Checking School Boundary...'
      : checkInStep === 'SAVING'
      ? 'Saving Your Attendance...'
      : checkInStep === 'DONE'
      ? `Saved at ${lastCheckInTime || format12HourTime(new Date())}`
      : lockCapability && !lockCapability.ready
      ? 'Screen Lock Not Set'
      : hasBiometricSensor
      ? 'Ready for Private Time In / Out'
      : lockCapability
      ? 'Ready — Screen Lock Active'
      : 'Checking Phone Security Lock...';

  const verifyButtonLabel = hasBiometricSensor
    ? checkInAction === 'TIME_IN'
      ? 'Verify Fingerprint & Time In'
      : 'Verify Fingerprint & Time Out'
    : checkInAction === 'TIME_IN'
    ? 'Verify Phone Lock & Time In'
    : 'Verify Phone Lock & Time Out';

  const isPhoneBound = Boolean(user?.has_bound_device || user?.bound_device_id);
  const isBiometricLocked = Boolean(user?.has_biometric_enrolled);

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      {/* Header + Dual-Tab Mode Switch */}
      <View style={[styles.header, { paddingTop: Math.max(insets.top, 12) }]}>
        <View style={styles.headerRow}>
          {onBack && (
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={styles.backCircle}
              onPress={onBack}
              activeOpacity={0.75}
              accessibilityLabel="Go back"
            >
              <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={20} color={palette.onPrimary} />
            </TouchableOpacity>
          )}
          <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: onBack ? 10 : 0 }}>
            <Text style={styles.headerEyebrow}>
              {mode === 'STUDENT_QR'
                ? 'AUTO QR SCANNER MODE'
                : hasBiometricSensor
                ? 'PHONE BIOMETRIC + CAMPUS GPS'
                : 'PHONE LOCK + CAMPUS GPS'}
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.headerTitle}>
              {mode === 'STUDENT_QR' ? 'Student Camera QR Scan' : 'Teacher Time In / Out'}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        {allowStudentQr && (
          <View style={styles.segmentWrap}>
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.segmentBtn, mode === 'STUDENT_QR' && styles.segmentBtnActive]}
              onPress={() => setMode('STUDENT_QR')}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name="qr-code-outline"
                size={15}
                color={mode === 'STUDENT_QR' ? palette.primary : palette.onPrimary}
              />
              <Text
                style={[styles.segmentText, mode === 'STUDENT_QR' && styles.segmentTextActive]}
              >
                Student QR
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>

            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.segmentBtn, mode === 'TEACHER_CHECKIN' && styles.segmentBtnActive]}
              onPress={() => setMode('TEACHER_CHECKIN')}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name="finger-print-outline"
                size={16}
                color={mode === 'TEACHER_CHECKIN' ? palette.primary : palette.onPrimary}
              />
              <Text
                style={[
                  styles.segmentText,
                  mode === 'TEACHER_CHECKIN' && styles.segmentTextActive,
                ]}
              >
                Teacher Time In / Out
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      {mode === 'STUDENT_QR' ? (
        <View style={[styles.body, { paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom, 12) + 92 }]}>
          {/* Mode 1: Class Period Pills + Offline Queue Sync */}
          <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6 }}
            >
              {classes.length === 0 ? (
                <View style={styles.periodPill}>
                  <Text style={styles.periodPillText}>
                    No class periods scheduled yet — check Academic Setup
                  </Text>
                </View>
              ) : (
                classes.map((cls) => {
                  const active = selectedPeriodId === cls.schedule_id;
                  return (
                    <TouchableOpacity
                      key={String(cls.schedule_id)}
                      style={[styles.periodPill, active && styles.periodPillActive]}
                      onPress={() => setSelectedPeriodId(cls.schedule_id)}
                    >
                      <Text style={[styles.periodPillText, active && styles.periodPillTextActive]}>
                        {cls.section_name} • {cls.subject_code}
                      </Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </ScrollView>

            {queuedQrCount > 0 && (
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.offlineQueueBar}
                onPress={() => void handleSyncQueuedScans()}
                disabled={syncingQr}
              >
                <Ionicons name="cloud-upload-outline" size={16} color={palette.warning} />
                <Text style={styles.offlineQueueText}>
                  {queuedQrCount} scan(s) saved safely on phone — tap to sync now
                </Text>
                {syncingQr && <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.warning} />}
              </TouchableOpacity>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* Mode 1: Continuous Automatic Back Camera QR Scanner */}
          <View style={styles.cameraCard}>
            {permission?.granted ? (
              <CameraView
                style={styles.cameraView}
                facing="back"
                autofocus="on"
                barcodeScannerSettings={{ barcodeTypes: ['qr'] }}
                onBarcodeScanned={(res) => void handleStudentQrScanned(res)}
              >
                <View style={styles.qrOverlay}>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.qrReticle,
                      qrBusy && { borderColor: SCANNER_OVERLAY_COLORS.activeRing },
                    ]}
                  />
                  <View style={styles.autoScanPill}>
                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.livePulseDot,
                        { backgroundColor: SCANNER_OVERLAY_COLORS.activeRing },
                      ]}
                    />
                    <Text style={styles.qrOverlayHint}>
                      {qrBusy
                        ? 'Scanning QR ID...'
                        : 'Auto-Scanner Active • Place QR ID in frame'}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                </View>
              </CameraView>
            ) : (
              <View style={styles.permissionFallback}>
                <Ionicons name="camera-outline" size={44} color={palette.onPrimary} />
                <Text style={styles.permissionText}>
                  Built-in camera access is required for automatic student QR attendance scanning.
                </Text>
                <TouchableOpacity
                  style={styles.grantBtn}
                  onPress={() => void requestPermission()}
                  activeOpacity={0.85}
                >
                  <Text style={styles.grantBtnText}>Allow Camera</Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* Mode 1 Result Card: Student Photo + Name (STATUS) + ONLY Timestamp below */}
          {lastScan ? (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.scanResultCard,
                {
                  backgroundColor: !lastScan.ok
                    ? palette.dangerLight
                    : lastScan.isDuplicate
                    ? palette.warningLight
                    : palette.successLight,
                  borderColor: !lastScan.ok
                    ? palette.danger
                    : lastScan.isDuplicate
                    ? palette.warning
                    : palette.success,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.studentPhotoCircle,
                  {
                    borderColor: !lastScan.ok
                      ? palette.danger
                      : lastScan.isDuplicate
                      ? palette.warning
                      : palette.success,
                    backgroundColor: palette.surface,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {lastScan.photoUrl && !scanPhotoFailed ? (
                  <Image
                    source={{ uri: lastScan.photoUrl }}
                    style={styles.studentPhotoImg}
                    contentFit="cover"
                    cachePolicy="memory-disk"
                    onError={() => setScanPhotoFailed(true)}
                  />
                ) : lastScan.ok ? (
                  <Text style={[styles.studentInitialsText, { color: palette.primary }]}>
                    {getInitials(lastScan.studentName)}
                  </Text>
                ) : (
                  <Ionicons name="alert-circle" size={24} color={palette.danger} />
                )}
              </View>

              <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                <Text
                  style={[
                    styles.instructionTitle,
                    {
                      color: !lastScan.ok
                        ? palette.danger
                        : lastScan.isDuplicate
                        ? palette.warning
                        : palette.success,
                    },
                  ]}
                  numberOfLines={1}
                >
                  {lastScan.statusLabel
                    ? `${lastScan.studentName} (${
                        lastScan.statusLabel === 'SAVED OFFLINE'
                          ? 'SAVED OFFLINE'
                          : lastScan.isDuplicate
                          ? `${lastScan.statusLabel} • ALREADY SCANNED`
                          : lastScan.statusLabel
                      })`
                    : lastScan.studentName}
                </Text>

                {/* Strictly ONLY the timestamp on valid scans */}
                <Text style={styles.timestampOnlyText} numberOfLines={2}>
                  {lastScan.ok ? lastScan.timestamp : lastScan.errorDetail || lastScan.timestamp}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.instructionBox}>
              <Text style={styles.instructionTitle}>Ready — Automatic QR Scanner Active</Text>
              <Text style={styles.instructionText}>
                Hold any student QR ID card in front of the camera for instant real-time attendance.
              </Text>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>
      ) : (
        /* Mode 2: Phone Fingerprint / Passkey + Campus GPS Check-In (NO Front Camera) */
        <ScrollView
          style={styles.biometricScroll}
          contentContainerStyle={[
            styles.biometricScrollContent,
            { paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom, 16) + 96 },
          ]}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        >
          {/* Time In / Time Out Toggle */}
          <View style={styles.actionRow}>
            {(['TIME_IN', 'TIME_OUT'] as const).map((act) => {
              const active = checkInAction === act;
              return (
                <TouchableOpacity
                  key={act}
                  style={[styles.actionChip, active && styles.actionChipActive]}
                  onPress={() => {
                    setCheckInAction(act);
                    if (checkInStep === 'DONE') setCheckInStep('IDLE');
                  }}
                  disabled={submittingCheckIn}
                >
                  <Ionicons
                    name={act === 'TIME_IN' ? 'log-in-outline' : 'log-out-outline'}
                    size={15}
                    color={active ? palette.onPrimary : palette.textSecondary}
                  />
                  <Text style={[styles.actionChipText, active && styles.actionChipTextActive]}>
                    {act === 'TIME_IN' ? 'Time In (Start Duty)' : 'Time Out (End Duty)'}
                  </Text>
                </TouchableOpacity>
              );
            })}
          </View>

          {/* Theme-Aware Phone Lock / Biometric Verification Card */}
          <View style={styles.biometricCard}>
            <View
              style={[
                styles.biometricIconRing,
                {
                  backgroundColor:
                    checkInStep === 'DONE'
                      ? palette.successLight
                      : statusIsError
                      ? palette.dangerLight
                      : !isPhoneLockReady
                      ? palette.warningLight
                      : hasBiometricSensor
                      ? palette.primarySoft
                      : palette.successLight,
                  borderColor:
                    checkInStep === 'DONE'
                      ? palette.success
                      : statusIsError
                      ? palette.danger
                      : !isPhoneLockReady
                      ? palette.warning
                      : hasBiometricSensor
                      ? palette.primary
                      : palette.success,
                },
              ]}
            >
              {submittingCheckIn ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={palette.primary} />
              ) : (
                <Ionicons
                  name={
                    checkInStep === 'DONE'
                      ? 'shield-checkmark'
                      : !isPhoneLockReady
                      ? 'lock-open-outline'
                      : hasBiometricSensor
                      ? 'finger-print-outline'
                      : 'shield-checkmark-outline'
                  }
                  size={44}
                  color={
                    checkInStep === 'DONE'
                      ? palette.success
                      : statusIsError
                      ? palette.danger
                      : !isPhoneLockReady
                      ? palette.warning
                      : hasBiometricSensor
                      ? palette.primary
                      : palette.success
                  }
                />
              )}
            </View>

            <Text style={styles.biometricTitle}>
              {hasBiometricSensor
                ? 'Private On-Phone Check & School Boundary'
                : 'Phone Screen Lock & School Boundary'}
            </Text>
            <Text style={styles.biometricSubtitle}>
              Your privacy is protected: identity check stays strictly on your phone for effortless
              proof of service. Zero raw face photos or fingerprint data are ever saved on the
              school server.
            </Text>

            {/* Bound Phone & Security Lock Status Badges */}
            <View style={styles.statusGrid}>
              <View style={styles.statusInfoRow}>
                <View style={styles.statusInfoLeft}>
                  <Ionicons name="phone-portrait-outline" size={16} color={palette.primary} />
                  <Text style={styles.statusInfoLabel}>Bound Phone</Text>
                </View>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.statusPill,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: isPhoneBound
                        ? palette.successLight
                        : palette.warningLight,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      styles.statusPillText,
                      { color: isPhoneBound ? palette.success : palette.warning },
                    ]}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {isPhoneBound ? `Linked • ${phoneModelLabel}` : 'Pairs on Time In'}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              </View>

              <View style={styles.statusInfoRow}>
                <View style={styles.statusInfoLeft}>
                  <Ionicons
                    name={hasBiometricSensor ? 'finger-print-outline' : 'lock-closed-outline'}
                    size={16}
                    color={palette.primary}
                  />
                  <Text style={styles.statusInfoLabel}>Phone Lock</Text>
                </View>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.statusPill,
                    {
                      backgroundColor:
                        lockCapability?.ready
                          ? palette.successLight
                          : lockCapability
                          ? palette.warningLight
                          : palette.surfaceSubtle,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      styles.statusPillText,
                      {
                        color: lockCapability?.ready
                          ? palette.success
                          : lockCapability
                          ? palette.warning
                          : palette.textSecondary,
                      },
                    ]}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {lockCapability ? lockCapability.modeLabel : 'Checking Lock...'}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              </View>

              <View style={[styles.statusInfoRow, { borderBottomWidth: 0, paddingBottom: 0 }]}>
                <View style={styles.statusInfoLeft}>
                  <Ionicons name="key-outline" size={16} color={palette.primary} />
                  <Text style={styles.statusInfoLabel}>1-to-1 Key Lock</Text>
                </View>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.statusPill,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: isBiometricLocked
                        ? palette.successLight
                        : palette.primarySoft,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      styles.statusPillText,
                      { color: isBiometricLocked ? palette.success : palette.primary },
                    ]}
                  >
                    {isBiometricLocked ? 'Active on Account' : 'Locks on First Time In'}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              </View>
            </View>

            {/* Live Step Status Banner */}
            <View
              style={[
                styles.liveStepBanner,
                {
                  backgroundColor: statusIsError
                    ? palette.dangerLight
                    : checkInStep === 'DONE' || (checkInStep === 'IDLE' && lockCapability?.ready)
                    ? palette.successLight
                    : !isPhoneLockReady
                    ? palette.warningLight
                    : palette.surfaceSubtle,
                  borderColor: statusIsError
                    ? palette.danger
                    : checkInStep === 'DONE' || (checkInStep === 'IDLE' && lockCapability?.ready)
                    ? palette.success
                    : !isPhoneLockReady
                    ? palette.warning
                    : palette.border,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <Text
                style={[
                  styles.liveStepTitle,
                  {
                    color: statusIsError
                      ? palette.danger
                      : checkInStep === 'DONE' || (checkInStep === 'IDLE' && lockCapability?.ready)
                      ? palette.success
                      : !isPhoneLockReady
                      ? palette.warning
                      : palette.primary,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {stepActiveLabel}
              </Text>
              <Text style={styles.instructionText}>{statusMessage}</Text>
            </View>

            {/* Setup Warning ONLY when phone has NO screen lock at all (SecurityLevel.NONE) */}
            {lockCapability && !lockCapability.ready && lockCapability.setupMessage ? (
              <View style={styles.setupWarningBox}>
                <Ionicons name="information-circle-outline" size={18} color={palette.warning} />
                <Text style={styles.setupWarningText}>{lockCapability.setupMessage}</Text>
              </View>
            ) : null}

            {/* Primary Phone Lock / Fingerprint Verification Button */}
            <TouchableOpacity
              style={[styles.captureBtn, submittingCheckIn && { opacity: 0.7 }]}
              onPress={() => void handleTeacherBiometricCheckIn()}
              disabled={submittingCheckIn}
              activeOpacity={0.85}
            >
              {submittingCheckIn ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.onPrimary} />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Ionicons
                    name={hasBiometricSensor ? 'finger-print-outline' : 'lock-closed-outline'}
                    size={20}
                    color={palette.onPrimary}
                  />
                  <Text style={styles.captureBtnText}>{verifyButtonLabel}</Text>
                </>
              )}
            </TouchableOpacity>
          </View>
        </ScrollView>
      )}
    </View>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Complete Academic Setup & Class Schedules CRUD (100% Web Parity)
 * File: mobile/src/screens/SchedulesScreen.tsx
 *
 * Covers all 8 Web Academic Setup tabs:
 * Periods, Sections, Subjects, Classrooms, Grade Levels, School Years, Departments, Holidays.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  FlatList,
  TouchableOpacity,
  TextInput,
  RefreshControl,
  ActivityIndicator,
} from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useThemeMode } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import {
  cleanText,
  getFriendlyErrorMessage,
  type ThemePalette,
} from '../constants/theme';
import { canManageSchoolSetup } from '../utils/permissions';
import { confirmAction, showNotice } from '../utils/helpers';
import { getServerBaseUrl } from '../services/configService';
import ChipRow from '../components/common/ChipRow';
import ScheduleListItemCard from '../components/schedules/ScheduleListItemCard';
import ScheduleFormModal from '../components/schedules/ScheduleFormModal';
import type {
  DeptFormState,
  GradeFormState,
  HolidayFormState,
  PeriodFormState,
  RoomFormState,
  ScheduleSubTab,
  SectionFormState,
  SubjectFormState,
  YearFormState,
} from '../components/schedules/types';

export const SchedulesScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);
  const allowCrud = canManageSchoolSetup(user);

  const [subTab, setSubTab] = useState<ScheduleSubTab>('PERIODS');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [serverBase, setServerBase] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const [periods, setPeriods] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [subjects, setSubjects] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [rooms, setRooms] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [grades, setGrades] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [schoolYears, setSchoolYears] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [holidays, setHolidays] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [teachers, setTeachers] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [conflictWarn, setConflictWarn] = useState<string>('');

  const [periodForm, setPeriodForm] = useState<PeriodFormState>({
    section: '',
    subject: '',
    teacher: '',
    day_of_week: 'ALL_WEEKDAYS',
    start_time: '08:00',
    end_time: '09:00',
  });

  const [sectionForm, setSectionForm] = useState<SectionFormState>({
    grade_level: '',
    name: '',
    room_name: '',
    capacity: '45',
    track_strand: '',
    adviser: '',
    allow_multiple_advisories: false,
  });

  const [subjectForm, setSubjectForm] = useState<SubjectFormState>({
    code: '',
    title: '',
    grade_level: '',
    subject_category: 'CORE',
    units: '1.0',
  });

  const [roomForm, setRoomForm] = useState<RoomFormState>({
    name: '',
    building: 'Main Building',
    capacity: '45',
    room_type: 'CLASSROOM',
    is_active: true,
  });

  const [gradeForm, setGradeForm] = useState<GradeFormState>({
    level_number: '7',
    code: 'G7',
    name: 'Grade 7',
    stage: 'JHS',
  });

  const [yearForm, setYearForm] = useState<YearFormState>({
    name: '',
    start_date: '',
    end_date: '',
    is_active: false,
  });

  const [deptForm, setDeptForm] = useState<DeptFormState>({
    code: '',
    name: '',
  });

  const [holidayForm, setHolidayForm] = useState<HolidayFormState>({
    date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    type: 'HOLIDAY',
    title: '',
  });

  const isMounted = useRef(true);

  const loadAll = useCallback(async (silent = false) => {
    if (!silent && isMounted.current) setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [pRes, secRes, subRes, rRes, gRes, syRes, dRes, hRes, tRes, base] =
        await Promise.allSettled([
          apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.PERIODS, { params: { page_size: 200 } }),
          apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.SECTIONS, { params: { page_size: 200 } }),
          apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.SUBJECTS, { params: { page_size: 200 } }),
          apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.ROOMS, { params: { page_size: 200 } }),
          apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.GRADE_LEVELS, { params: { page_size: 100 } }),
          apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.SCHOOL_YEARS, { params: { page_size: 100 } }),
          apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.DEPARTMENTS, { params: { page_size: 100 } }),
          apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.HOLIDAYS, { params: { page_size: 200 } }),
          apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.TEACHERS_DROPDOWN),
          getServerBaseUrl(),
        ]);

      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      if (base.status === 'fulfilled' && base.value) setServerBase(base.value);

      const extract = (r: PromiseSettledResult<any>) => {
        if (r.status !== 'fulfilled' || !r.value?.data) return [];
        const d = r.value.data;
        return Array.isArray(d) ? d : Array.isArray(d.results) ? d.results : [];
      };

      setPeriods(extract(pRes));
      setSections(extract(secRes));
      setSubjects(extract(subRes));
      setRooms(extract(rRes));
      setGrades(extract(gRes));
      setSchoolYears(extract(syRes));
      setDepartments(extract(dRes));
      setHolidays(extract(hRes));
      setTeachers(extract(tRes).filter((t: any) => t.can_handle_classes !== false));
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    void loadAll(false);
    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
    };
  }, [loadAll]);

  // Live conflict check for Class Period and Section Adviser
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!modalOpen) return;
    if (
      subTab === 'PERIODS' &&
      periodForm.section &&
      periodForm.teacher &&
      periodForm.start_time &&
      periodForm.end_time
    ) {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
        try {
          const res = await apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.CHECK_CONFLICT, {
            signal: controller.signal,
            params: {
              type: 'period',
              section_id: periodForm.section,
              teacher_id: periodForm.teacher,
              day_of_week: periodForm.day_of_week,
              start_time: periodForm.start_time,
              end_time: periodForm.end_time,
              ...(editingItem ? { exclude_id: editingItem.id } : {}),
            },
          });
          if (!isMounted.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;
          const d = res.data || {};
          const msgs = [d.time_error, d.section_conflict, d.teacher_conflict, d.room_conflict].filter(
            Boolean
          );
          setConflictWarn(msgs.join(' • '));
        } catch {}
      }, 300);
      return () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        controller.abort();
      };
    }

    if (subTab === 'SECTIONS' && (sectionForm.adviser || sectionForm.name.trim())) {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
        try {
          const res = await apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.CHECK_CONFLICT, {
            signal: controller.signal,
            params: {
              type: 'section',
              grade_level: sectionForm.grade_level || undefined,
              name: sectionForm.name || undefined,
              adviser_id: sectionForm.adviser || undefined,
              room_name: sectionForm.room_name || undefined,
              ...(editingItem ? { exclude_id: editingItem.id } : {}),
            },
          });
          if (!isMounted.current || controller.signal.aborted) return;
          const d = res.data || {};
          const msgs = [d.name_message, d.adviser_conflict?.message, d.room_message].filter(Boolean);
          setConflictWarn(msgs.join(' • '));
        } catch {}
      }, 300);
      return () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        controller.abort();
      };
    }
    setConflictWarn('');
  }, [modalOpen, subTab, periodForm, sectionForm, editingItem]);

  const openAdd = () => {
    setEditingItem(null);
    setConflictWarn('');
    const currentYr = new Date().getFullYear();

    if (subTab === 'PERIODS') {
      setPeriodForm({
        section: sections[0] ? String(sections[0].id) : '',
        subject: subjects[0] ? String(subjects[0].id) : '',
        teacher: teachers[0] ? String(teachers[0].id) : '',
        day_of_week: 'ALL_WEEKDAYS',
        start_time: '08:00',
        end_time: '09:00',
      });
    } else if (subTab === 'SECTIONS') {
      setSectionForm({
        grade_level: grades[0] ? String(grades[0].id) : '',
        name: '',
        room_name: rooms[0]?.name || '',
        capacity: '45',
        track_strand: '',
        adviser: '',
        allow_multiple_advisories: false,
      });
    } else if (subTab === 'SUBJECTS') {
      setSubjectForm({
        code: '',
        title: '',
        grade_level: grades[0] ? String(grades[0].id) : '',
        subject_category: 'CORE',
        units: '1.0',
      });
    } else if (subTab === 'ROOMS') {
      setRoomForm({
        name: '',
        building: 'Main Building',
        capacity: '45',
        room_type: 'CLASSROOM',
        is_active: true,
      });
    } else if (subTab === 'GRADES') {
      setGradeForm({ level_number: '7', code: 'G7', name: 'Grade 7', stage: 'JHS' });
    } else if (subTab === 'YEARS') {
      setYearForm({
        name: `${currentYr}-${currentYr + 1}`,
        start_date: `${currentYr}-06-15`,
        end_date: `${currentYr + 1}-03-31`,
        is_active: schoolYears.length === 0,
      });
    } else if (subTab === 'DEPARTMENTS') {
      setDeptForm({ code: '', name: '' });
    } else {
      setHolidayForm({
        date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        type: 'HOLIDAY',
        title: '',
      });
    }
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (item: any) => {
    setEditingItem(item);
    setConflictWarn('');
    if (subTab === 'PERIODS') {
      setPeriodForm({
        section: String(item.section || item.section_id || ''),
        subject: String(item.subject || item.subject_id || ''),
        teacher: String(item.teacher || item.teacher_id || ''),
        day_of_week: String(item.day_of_week || 'ALL_WEEKDAYS'),
        start_time: String(item.start_time || '08:00').slice(0, 5),
        end_time: String(item.end_time || '09:00').slice(0, 5),
      });
    } else if (subTab === 'SECTIONS') {
      setSectionForm({
        grade_level: String(item.grade_level || item.grade_level_id || ''),
        name: item.name || '',
        room_name: item.room_name || '',
        capacity: String(item.capacity ?? 45),
        track_strand: item.track_strand || '',
        adviser: item.adviser || item.adviser_id ? String(item.adviser || item.adviser_id) : '',
        allow_multiple_advisories: false,
      });
    } else if (subTab === 'SUBJECTS') {
      setSubjectForm({
        code: item.code || '',
        title: item.title || item.name || '',
        grade_level: item.grade_level ? String(item.grade_level) : '',
        subject_category: item.subject_category || 'CORE',
        units: String(item.units ?? '1.0'),
      });
    } else if (subTab === 'ROOMS') {
      setRoomForm({
        name: item.name || '',
        building: item.building || '',
        capacity: String(item.capacity ?? 45),
        room_type: item.room_type || 'CLASSROOM',
        is_active: item.is_active !== false,
      });
    } else if (subTab === 'GRADES') {
      setGradeForm({
        level_number: String(item.level_number ?? 7),
        code: item.code || '',
        name: item.name || '',
        stage: item.stage || 'JHS',
      });
    } else if (subTab === 'YEARS') {
      setYearForm({
        name: item.name || item.code || '',
        start_date: item.start_date || '',
        end_date: item.end_date || '',
        is_active: Boolean(item.is_active),
      });
    } else if (subTab === 'DEPARTMENTS') {
      setDeptForm({ code: item.code || '', name: item.name || '' });
    } else {
      setHolidayForm({
        date: item.date || '',
        type: item.type || 'HOLIDAY',
        title: item.title || item.reason || '',
      });
    }
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const getEndpointForTab = (t: ScheduleSubTab): string => {
    switch (t) {
      case 'PERIODS':
        return ENDPOINTS.PERIODS;
      case 'SECTIONS':
        return ENDPOINTS.SECTIONS;
      case 'SUBJECTS':
        return ENDPOINTS.SUBJECTS;
      case 'ROOMS':
        return ENDPOINTS.ROOMS;
      case 'GRADES':
        return ENDPOINTS.GRADE_LEVELS;
      case 'YEARS':
        return ENDPOINTS.SCHOOL_YEARS;
      case 'DEPARTMENTS':
        return ENDPOINTS.DEPARTMENTS;
      case 'HOLIDAYS':
        return ENDPOINTS.HOLIDAYS;
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const endpoint = getEndpointForTab(subTab);
      let payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};

      if (subTab === 'PERIODS') {
        payload = {
          section: Number(periodForm.section),
          subject: Number(periodForm.subject),
          teacher: Number(periodForm.teacher),
          day_of_week: periodForm.day_of_week,
          start_time: periodForm.start_time,
          end_time: periodForm.end_time,
        };
      } else if (subTab === 'SECTIONS') {
        payload = {
          grade_level: Number(sectionForm.grade_level),
          name: cleanText(sectionForm.name, 80),
          room_name: cleanText(sectionForm.room_name, 80),
          capacity: Math.max(5, Math.min(120, Number(sectionForm.capacity) || 45)),
          track_strand: cleanText(sectionForm.track_strand, 80),
          adviser: sectionForm.adviser ? Number(sectionForm.adviser) : null,
          allow_multiple_advisories: sectionForm.allow_multiple_advisories,
        };
      } else if (subTab === 'SUBJECTS') {
        payload = {
          code: cleanText(subjectForm.code, 30).toUpperCase(),
          title: cleanText(subjectForm.title, 150),
          grade_level: subjectForm.grade_level ? Number(subjectForm.grade_level) : null,
          subject_category: subjectForm.subject_category,
          units: Number(subjectForm.units) || 1.0,
        };
      } else if (subTab === 'ROOMS') {
        payload = {
          name: cleanText(roomForm.name, 100),
          building: cleanText(roomForm.building, 100),
          capacity: Math.max(5, Math.min(300, Number(roomForm.capacity) || 45)),
          room_type: roomForm.room_type,
          is_active: roomForm.is_active,
        };
      } else if (subTab === 'GRADES') {
        payload = {
          level_number: Number(gradeForm.level_number) || 7,
          code: cleanText(gradeForm.code, 20),
          name: cleanText(gradeForm.name, 80),
          stage: gradeForm.stage,
        };
      } else if (subTab === 'YEARS') {
        payload = {
          name: cleanText(yearForm.name, 20),
          start_date: yearForm.start_date.trim() || undefined,
          end_date: yearForm.end_date.trim() || undefined,
          is_active: yearForm.is_active,
        };
      } else if (subTab === 'DEPARTMENTS') {
        payload = {
          code: cleanText(deptForm.code, 20).toUpperCase(),
          name: cleanText(deptForm.name, 100),
        };
      } else {
        payload = {
          date: holidayForm.date.trim(),
          type: holidayForm.type,
          title: cleanText(holidayForm.title, 150),
        };
      }

      if (editingItem) {
        await apiClient.patch(`${endpoint}${editingItem.id}/`, payload);
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(endpoint, payload);
      }

      setModalOpen(false);
      showNotice('Saved', 'Academic record updated.');
      await loadAll(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showNotice('Save Blocked', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not save record.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = (item: any) => {
    const endpoint = getEndpointForTab(subTab);
    const label = item.title || item.name || item.subject_code || item.code || 'this record';
    const run = async () => {
      try {
        await apiClient.delete(`${endpoint}${item.id}/`);
        showNotice('Deleted', `Removed ${label}.`);
        await loadAll(true);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        showNotice('Delete Failed', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not delete item.'));
      }
    };
    confirmAction('Confirm Delete', `Delete ${label}?`, 'Delete', () => void run());
  };

  const rawActiveList = useMemo(() => {
    switch (subTab) {
      case 'PERIODS':
        return periods;
      case 'SECTIONS':
        return sections;
      case 'SUBJECTS':
        return subjects;
      case 'ROOMS':
        return rooms;
      case 'GRADES':
        return grades;
      case 'YEARS':
        return schoolYears;
      case 'DEPARTMENTS':
        return departments;
      case 'HOLIDAYS':
        return holidays;
    }
  }, [subTab, periods, sections, subjects, rooms, grades, schoolYears, departments, holidays]);

  const activeList = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return rawActiveList;
    return rawActiveList.filter((item) => JSON.stringify(item).toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [rawActiveList, searchQuery]);

  const tabMeta: Array<{ key: ScheduleSubTab; label: string; addLabel: string }> = [
    { key: 'PERIODS', label: `Periods (${periods.length})`, addLabel: 'Class Period' },
    { key: 'SECTIONS', label: `Sections (${sections.length})`, addLabel: 'Section' },
    { key: 'SUBJECTS', label: `Subjects (${subjects.length})`, addLabel: 'Subject' },
    { key: 'ROOMS', label: `Rooms (${rooms.length})`, addLabel: 'Classroom' },
    { key: 'GRADES', label: `Grades (${grades.length})`, addLabel: 'Grade Level' },
    { key: 'YEARS', label: `School Years (${schoolYears.length})`, addLabel: 'School Year' },
    { key: 'DEPARTMENTS', label: `Departments (${departments.length})`, addLabel: 'Department' },
    { key: 'HOLIDAYS', label: `Holidays (${holidays.length})`, addLabel: 'Holiday / Event' },
  ];

  const currentTabInfo = tabMeta.find((t) => t.key === subTab) || tabMeta[0];

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      {/* Horizontal 8-Tab Academic Setup Bar */}
      <ChipRow<ScheduleSubTab>
        variant="tab"
        options={tabMeta}
        selected={subTab}
        onSelect={(key) => {
          setSubTab(key);
          setSearchQuery('');
        }}
        style={styles.tabStrip}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.tabRow}
      />

      {/* Search + Add Bar */}
      <View style={styles.toolbar}>
        <View style={styles.searchWrap}>
          <Ionicons name="search-outline" size={16} color={palette.textMuted} />
          <TextInput
            style={styles.searchInput}
            placeholder={`Filter ${currentTabInfo.addLabel.toLowerCase()}s...`}
            placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
            value={searchQuery}
            onChangeText={setSearchQuery}
          />
        </View>
        {allowCrud && (
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.addBtn} onPress={openAdd} activeOpacity={0.85}>
            <Ionicons name="add-circle-outline" size={16} color={palette.onPrimary} />
            <Text style={styles.addBtnText}>Add</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
      </View>

      {loading ? (
        <View style={styles.centerBox}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
          <Text style={styles.mutedText}>Loading academic setup...</Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={activeList}
          keyExtractor={(item) => `${subTab}-${item.id}`}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
          refreshControl={
            <RefreshControl
              refreshing={refreshing}
              onRefresh={() => {
                setRefreshing(true);
                void loadAll(true);
              }}
              colors={[palette.primary]}
              tintColor={palette.primary}
            />
          }
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <View style={styles.centerBox}>
              <Text style={styles.mutedText}>No records found in {currentTabInfo.addLabel}s.</Text>
            </View>
          }
          renderItem={({ item }) => (
            <ScheduleListItemCard
              subTab={subTab}
              item={item}
              serverBase={serverBase}
              allowCrud={allowCrud}
              onEdit={openEdit}
              onDelete={handleDelete}
            />
          )}
        />
      )}

      {/* Universal Add / Edit Academic Setup Modal */}
      <ScheduleFormModal
        visible={modalOpen}
        subTab={subTab}
        addLabel={currentTabInfo.addLabel}
        isEditing={Boolean(editingItem)}
        saving={saving}
        conflictWarn={conflictWarn}
        sections={sections}
        subjects={subjects}
        teachers={teachers}
        grades={grades}
        rooms={rooms}
        periodForm={periodForm}
        setPeriodForm={setPeriodForm}
        sectionForm={sectionForm}
        setSectionForm={setSectionForm}
        subjectForm={subjectForm}
        setSubjectForm={setSubjectForm}
        roomForm={roomForm}
        setRoomForm={setRoomForm}
        gradeForm={gradeForm}
        setGradeForm={setGradeForm}
        yearForm={yearForm}
        setYearForm={setYearForm}
        deptForm={deptForm}
        setDeptForm={setDeptForm}
        holidayForm={holidayForm}
        setHolidayForm={setHolidayForm}
        onClose={() => setModalOpen(false)}
        onSave={() => void handleSave()}
      />
    </View>
  );
};

const createStyles = (palette: ThemePalette, fonts: ReturnType<typeof useThemeMode>['fonts']) =>
  StyleSheet.create({
    container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: palette.background },
    tabStrip: { flexGrow: 0, maxHeight: 50, marginTop: 10 },
    tabRow: { paddingHorizontal: 14, gap: 6, alignItems: 'center' },
    toolbar: { flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, paddingHorizontal: 14, paddingVertical: 8 },
    searchWrap: {
      flex: 1,
      flexDirection: 'row',
      alignItems: 'center',
      gap: 8,
      backgroundColor: palette.surface,
      borderRadius: 10,
      borderWidth: 1,
      borderColor: palette.borderStrong,
      paddingHorizontal: 10,
      height: 40,
    },
    searchInput: { flex: 1, fontSize: fonts.sm, color: palette.textPrimary },
    addBtn: {
      flexDirection: 'row',
      alignItems: 'center',
      justifyContent: 'center',
      gap: 5,
      backgroundColor: palette.buttonBg,
      borderRadius: 10,
      paddingHorizontal: 14,
      height: 40,
    },
    addBtnText: { color: palette.onPrimary, fontSize: fonts.xs, fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold },
    listContent: { padding: 14, paddingBottom: 120, gap: 10 },
    centerBox: { paddingVertical: 40, alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 },
    mutedText: { fontSize: fonts.sm, color: palette.textMuted },
  });

export default SchedulesScreen;
