/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Teachers & Staff Directory + Full CRUD (100% Web Parity)
 * File: mobile/src/screens/TeachersScreen.tsx
 *
 * Full parity with web TeachersTab: portrait photos, department & position chips,
 * suffix, active status switch, live duplicate field validation (employee_id,
 * email, contact_number), status/teaching/bound-phone filters, and inspection modal.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  FlatList,
  TouchableOpacity,
  TextInput,
  Modal,
  ScrollView,
  Switch,
  RefreshControl,
  ActivityIndicator,
} from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useThemeMode } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import {
  cleanText,
  getFriendlyErrorMessage,
  type ThemePalette,
} from '../constants/theme';
import { canManageTeachers, canResetBoundDevice } from '../utils/permissions';
import { confirmAction, resolveMediaUrl, showNotice } from '../utils/helpers';
import { useMobileFieldCheck } from '../hooks/useMobileFieldCheck';
import { getServerBaseUrl } from '../services/configService';
import ImageUploadField from '../components/common/ImageUploadField';
import ChipRow from '../components/common/ChipRow';

interface TeacherRow {
  id: number;
  username?: string;
  employee_id: string;
  first_name: string;
  middle_name?: string;
  last_name: string;
  suffix?: string;
  full_name?: string;
  email?: string;
  contact_number?: string;
  position?: string;
  department?: string;
  role?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  can_handle_classes?: boolean;
  is_active?: boolean;
  bound_device_id?: string | null;
  device_model?: string | null;
  device_bound_at?: string | null;
}

interface DepartmentOption {
  id: number;
  code: string;
  name: string;
}

const POSITION_PRESETS = [
  'Teacher I',
  'Teacher II',
  'Teacher III',
  'Master Teacher I',
  'Master Teacher II',
  'Head Teacher I',
  'School Principal',
  'Administrative Officer',
] as const;

type FilterType = 'ALL' | 'ACTIVE' | 'TEACHING' | 'NON_TEACHING' | 'BOUND_PHONE';

export const TeachersScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);

  const allowCrud = canManageTeachers(user);
  const allowResetPhone = canResetBoundDevice(user);

  const [teachers, setTeachers] = useState<TeacherRow[]>([]);
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState<DepartmentOption[]>([]);
  const [serverBase, setServerBase] = useState<string>('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [filterMode, setFilterMode] = useState<FilterType>('ALL');

  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<TeacherRow | null>(null);
  const [inspectTeacher, setInspectTeacher] = useState<TeacherRow | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [photoBase64, setPhotoBase64] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [photoRemoved, setPhotoRemoved] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    employee_id: '',
    first_name: '',
    middle_name: '',
    last_name: '',
    suffix: '',
    email: '',
    contact_number: '',
    position: 'Teacher I',
    department: 'General Education',
    can_handle_classes: true,
    is_active: true,
  });

  const isMounted = useRef(true);

  const loadTeachers = useCallback(async (silent = false) => {
    if (!silent && isMounted.current) setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [tRes, dRes, base] = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.TEACHERS, { params: { page_size: 200 } }),
        apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.DEPARTMENTS, { params: { page_size: 100 } }),
        getServerBaseUrl(),
      ]);
      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      if (base.status === 'fulfilled' && base.value) setServerBase(base.value);

      if (tRes.status === 'fulfilled' && tRes.value?.data) {
        const raw = tRes.value.data;
        setTeachers(Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : Array.isArray(raw?.results) ? raw.results : []);
      }
      if (dRes.status === 'fulfilled' && dRes.value?.data) {
        const raw = dRes.value.data;
        setDepartments(Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : Array.isArray(raw?.results) ? raw.results : []);
      }
    } catch {
      // Keep existing list offline
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    void loadTeachers(false);
    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
    };
  }, [loadTeachers]);

  // Live duplicate checks for Employee ID, Email, Contact Number
  const employeeIdCheck = useMobileFieldCheck({
    enabled: modalOpen,
    field: 'employee_id',
    value: form.employee_id,
    excludeId: editing?.id,
    excludeTeacherId: editing?.id,
  });
  const emailCheck = useMobileFieldCheck({
    enabled: modalOpen,
    field: 'email',
    value: form.email,
    excludeId: editing?.id,
    excludeTeacherId: editing?.id,
  });
  const contactCheck = useMobileFieldCheck({
    enabled: modalOpen,
    field: 'contact_number',
    value: form.contact_number,
    minDigits: 10,
    excludeId: editing?.id,
    excludeTeacherId: editing?.id,
  });

  const openAdd = () => {
    setEditing(null);
    setPhotoBase64(null);
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    setPhotoRemoved(false);
    setForm({
      employee_id: '',
      first_name: '',
      middle_name: '',
      last_name: '',
      suffix: '',
      email: '',
      contact_number: '',
      position: 'Teacher I',
      department: departments[0]?.name || 'General Education',
      can_handle_classes: true,
      is_active: true,
    });
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (t: TeacherRow) => {
    setEditing(t);
    setPhotoBase64(null);
    setPhotoPreview(t.photo_url || t.photo || null);
    setPhotoRemoved(false);
    setForm({
      employee_id: t.employee_id || '',
      first_name: t.first_name || '',
      middle_name: t.middle_name || '',
      last_name: t.last_name || '',
      suffix: t.suffix || '',
      email: t.email || '',
      contact_number: t.contact_number || '',
      position: t.position || 'Teacher I',
      department: t.department || '',
      can_handle_classes: t.can_handle_classes !== false,
      is_active: t.is_active !== false,
    });
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!form.employee_id.trim() || !form.first_name.trim() || !form.last_name.trim()) {
      showNotice('Missing Fields', 'Employee ID, first name, and last name are required.');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
        employee_id: cleanText(form.employee_id, 50),
        first_name: cleanText(form.first_name, 80),
        middle_name: cleanText(form.middle_name, 80),
        last_name: cleanText(form.last_name, 80),
        suffix: cleanText(form.suffix, 20),
        email: cleanText(form.email, 120),
        contact_number: cleanText(form.contact_number, 30),
        position: cleanText(form.position, 80),
        department: cleanText(form.department, 80),
        can_handle_classes: form.can_handle_classes,
        is_active: form.is_active,
      };
      if (photoRemoved) {
        payload.photo = null;
        payload.remove_photo = true;
      } else if (photoBase64) {
        payload.photo = photoBase64;
      }

      if (editing) {
        await apiClient.patch(`${ENDPOINTS.TEACHERS}${editing.id}/`, payload);
        showNotice('Updated', 'Teacher profile updated.');
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(ENDPOINTS.TEACHERS, payload);
        showNotice('Created', 'Teacher profile added.');
      }
      setModalOpen(false);
      await loadTeachers(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showNotice('Save Failed', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not save teacher profile.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetPhone = (t: TeacherRow) => {
    const name = t.full_name || `${t.first_name} ${t.last_name}`;
    const run = async () => {
      try {
        await apiClient.post(ENDPOINTS.RESET_DEVICE, { teacher_id: t.id });
        showNotice('Phone Reset', `${name} can now pair a new phone on their next Time In.`);
        setInspectTeacher(null);
        await loadTeachers(true);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        showNotice('Reset Failed', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not reset phone binding.'));
      }
    };
    confirmAction('Reset Bound Phone', `Unlink bound phone for ${name}?`, 'Unlink', () => void run());
  };

  const handleDelete = (t: TeacherRow) => {
    const name = t.full_name || `${t.first_name} ${t.last_name}`;
    const run = async () => {
      try {
        await apiClient.delete(`${ENDPOINTS.TEACHERS}${t.id}/`);
        showNotice('Deleted', `${name} was removed.`);
        setInspectTeacher(null);
        await loadTeachers(true);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        showNotice('Delete Failed', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not delete teacher.'));
      }
    };
    confirmAction('Delete Teacher', `Delete ${name}?`, 'Delete', () => void run());
  };

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    return teachers.filter((t) => {
      if (filterMode === 'ACTIVE' && t.is_active === false) return false;
      if (filterMode === 'TEACHING' && t.can_handle_classes === false) return false;
      if (filterMode === 'NON_TEACHING' && t.can_handle_classes !== false) return false;
      if (filterMode === 'BOUND_PHONE' && !t.bound_device_id) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      const text = `${t.full_name || ''} ${t.first_name} ${t.last_name} ${t.employee_id} ${t.department || ''} ${t.position || ''} ${t.email || ''}`.toLowerCase();
      return text.includes(q);
    });
  }, [teachers, searchQuery, filterMode]);

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <View style={styles.toolbar}>
        <View style={styles.searchWrap}>
          <Ionicons name="search-outline" size={16} color={palette.textMuted} />
          <TextInput
            style={styles.searchInput}
            placeholder="Search teacher name, ID, department..."
            placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
            value={searchQuery}
            onChangeText={setSearchQuery}
          />
        </View>
        {allowCrud && (
          <TouchableOpacity style={styles.addBtn} onPress={openAdd} activeOpacity={0.85}>
            <Ionicons name="add-circle-outline" size={16} color={palette.onPrimary} />
            <Text style={styles.addBtnText}>Add</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Filter Strip */}
      <ChipRow<FilterType>
        options={[
          { key: 'ALL', label: `All (${teachers.length})` },
          { key: 'ACTIVE', label: 'Active' },
          { key: 'TEACHING', label: 'Teaching' },
          { key: 'NON_TEACHING', label: 'Non-Teaching' },
          { key: 'BOUND_PHONE', label: 'Bound Phone' },
        ]}
        selected={filterMode}
        onSelect={setFilterMode}
        style={styles.filterStrip}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.filterRow}
      />

      {loading ? (
        <View style={styles.centerBox}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
          <Text style={styles.mutedText}>Loading teachers...</Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={filtered}
          keyExtractor={(item) => String(item.id)}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
          refreshControl={
            <RefreshControl
              refreshing={refreshing}
              onRefresh={() => {
                setRefreshing(true);
                void loadTeachers(true);
              }}
              colors={[palette.primary]}
              tintColor={palette.primary}
            />
          }
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <View style={styles.centerBox}>
              <Text style={styles.mutedText}>No teachers matched your filter.</Text>
            </View>
          }
          renderItem={({ item }) => {
            const name = item.full_name || `${item.first_name} ${item.last_name}`.trim();
            const avatarUri = resolveMediaUrl(item.photo_url || item.photo, serverBase);
            return (
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.card}
                activeOpacity={0.85}
                onPress={() => setInspectTeacher(item)}
              >
                <View style={styles.cardTop}>
                  <View style={styles.avatarBox}>
                    {avatarUri ? (
                      <Image source={{ uri: avatarUri }} style={styles.avatarImg} contentFit="cover" />
                    ) : (
                      <Ionicons name="person" size={20} color={palette.primary} />
                    )}
                  </View>
                  <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <Text style={styles.nameText} numberOfLines={1}>
                      {name}
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={styles.metaText}>
                      {item.employee_id} &bull; {item.position || 'Teacher'}
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={styles.subMeta}>
                      {item.department || 'No Department'} &bull;{' '}
                      {item.can_handle_classes !== false ? 'Teaching' : 'Non-Teaching'}
                      {item.is_active === false ? ' • Inactive' : ''}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.actionsRow}>
                    {allowResetPhone && item.bound_device_id ? (
                      <TouchableOpacity
                        style={[styles.iconBtn, { backgroundColor: palette.warningLight }]}
                        onPress={() => handleResetPhone(item)}
                        accessibilityLabel="Reset Bound Phone"
                      >
                        <Ionicons name="phone-portrait-outline" size={16} color={palette.warning} />
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                    ) : null}
                    {allowCrud && (
                      <>
                        <TouchableOpacity
                          style={styles.iconBtn}
                          onPress={() => openEdit(item)}
                          accessibilityLabel="Edit Teacher"
                        >
                          <Ionicons name="create-outline" size={16} color={palette.primary} />
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                        <TouchableOpacity
                          style={[styles.iconBtn, { backgroundColor: palette.dangerLight }]}
                          onPress={() => handleDelete(item)}
                          accessibilityLabel="Delete Teacher"
                        >
                          <Ionicons name="trash-outline" size={16} color={palette.danger} />
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </View>
                </View>

                <View style={styles.phoneRow}>
                  <Ionicons
                    name={item.bound_device_id ? 'shield-checkmark-outline' : 'phone-portrait-outline'}
                    size={13}
                    color={item.bound_device_id ? palette.success : palette.textMuted}
                  />
                  <Text
                    style={[
                      styles.phoneText,
                      { color: item.bound_device_id ? palette.success : palette.textMuted },
                    ]}
                  >
                    {item.bound_device_id
                      ? `Bound Phone: ${item.device_model || 'Linked'}`
                      : 'Pairs on first mobile Time In'}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            );
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Teacher Profile Inspection Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={Boolean(inspectTeacher)}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"
        onRequestClose={() => setInspectTeacher(null)}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.modalSheet}>
            <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>Teacher Profile Details</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setInspectTeacher(null)}>
                <Ionicons name="close" size={22} color={palette.textMuted} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
            {inspectTeacher && (
              <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} contentContainerStyle={{ alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                <View style={styles.detailAvatar}>
                  {resolveMediaUrl(inspectTeacher.photo_url || inspectTeacher.photo, serverBase) ? (
                    <Image
                      source={{
                        uri: resolveMediaUrl(inspectTeacher.photo_url || inspectTeacher.photo, serverBase)!,
                      }}
                      style={styles.avatarImg}
                      contentFit="cover"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <Ionicons name="person" size={34} color={palette.primary} />
                  )}
                </View>
                <Text style={[styles.nameText, { fontSize: fonts.lg, textAlign: 'center' }]}>
                  {inspectTeacher.full_name || `${inspectTeacher.first_name} ${inspectTeacher.last_name}`}
                </Text>
                <Text style={styles.metaText}>
                  {inspectTeacher.employee_id} &bull; {inspectTeacher.position || 'Teacher'}
                </Text>

                <View style={styles.detailBox}>
                  {[
                    ['Username', inspectTeacher.username ? `@${inspectTeacher.username}` : '—'],
                    ['Department', inspectTeacher.department || '—'],
                    ['System Role', inspectTeacher.role || 'TEACHER'],
                    ['Teaching Assignment', inspectTeacher.can_handle_classes !== false ? 'Classroom Teacher' : 'Non-Teaching'],
                    ['Account Status', inspectTeacher.is_active !== false ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'],
                    ['Email', inspectTeacher.email || '—'],
                    ['Contact Number', inspectTeacher.contact_number || '—'],
                    ['Bound Phone', inspectTeacher.bound_device_id ? inspectTeacher.device_model || 'Paired' : 'Not paired yet'],
                  ].map(([k, v]) => (
                    <View key={k} style={styles.detailRow}>
                      <Text style={styles.detailKey}>{k}</Text>
                      <Text style={styles.detailVal}>{v}</Text>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                </View>

                <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 8, width: '100%' }}>
                  {allowResetPhone && inspectTeacher.bound_device_id && (
                    <TouchableOpacity
                      style={[styles.saveBtn, { flex: 1, backgroundColor: palette.warning }]}
                      onPress={() => handleResetPhone(inspectTeacher)}
                    >
                      <Text style={styles.saveBtnText}>Unlink Phone</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  )}
                  {allowCrud && (
                    <TouchableOpacity
                      style={[styles.saveBtn, { flex: 1 }]}
                      onPress={() => {
                        const target = inspectTeacher;
                        setInspectTeacher(null);
                        openEdit(target);
                      }}
                    >
                      <Text style={styles.saveBtnText}>Edit Profile</Text>
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                  )}
                </View>
              </ScrollView>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Add / Edit Teacher Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={modalOpen}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setModalOpen(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.modalSheet}>
            <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>
                {editing ? 'Edit Teacher Profile' : 'Add Teacher'}
              </Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setModalOpen(false)}>
                <Ionicons name="close" size={22} color={palette.textMuted} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
            <ScrollView
              showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
              contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 10, paddingBottom: 16 }}
            >
              <ImageUploadField
                label="Teacher Portrait Photo"
                helperText="Displayed across directory, geofence monitor, and schedules."
                value={photoRemoved ? null : photoBase64 || photoPreview}
                serverBase={serverBase}
                variant="avatar"
                onChange={(dataUrl) => {
                  setPhotoBase64(dataUrl);
                  setPhotoPreview(dataUrl);
                  setPhotoRemoved(false);
                }}
                onRemove={() => {
                  setPhotoBase64(null);
                  setPhotoPreview(null);
                  setPhotoRemoved(true);
                }}
              />

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Employee ID *</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.input}
                value={form.employee_id}
                onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, employee_id: v }))}
                placeholder="e.g. EMP-2026-010"
                placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
              />
              {employeeIdCheck.warning ? (
                <Text style={styles.warnText}>{employeeIdCheck.warning}</Text>
              ) : null}

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>First Name *</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.input}
                value={form.first_name}
                onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, first_name: v }))}
                placeholder="First name"
                placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
              />

              <View style={styles.twoCol}>
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Middle Name</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    style={styles.input}
                    value={form.middle_name}
                    onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, middle_name: v }))}
                    placeholder="Optional"
                    placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                  />
                </View>
                <View style={{ width: 92 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Suffix</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    style={styles.input}
                    value={form.suffix}
                    onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, suffix: v }))}
                    placeholder="Jr. / PhD"
                    placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                  />
                </View>
              </View>

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Last Name *</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.input}
                value={form.last_name}
                onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, last_name: v }))}
                placeholder="Last name"
                placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
              />

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Position Title</Text>
              <ChipRow
                options={POSITION_PRESETS.map((pos) => ({ key: pos, label: pos }))}
                selected={form.position}
                onSelect={(pos) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, position: pos }))}
              />
              <TextInput
                style={styles.input}
                value={form.position}
                onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, position: v }))}
                placeholder="Or enter custom position"
                placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
              />

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Department</Text>
              {departments.length > 0 && (
                <ChipRow
                  options={departments.map((d) => ({ key: d.name, label: d.name }))}
                  selected={form.department}
                  onSelect={(dept) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, department: dept }))}
                />
              )}
              <TextInput
                style={styles.input}
                value={form.department}
                onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, department: v }))}
                placeholder="Mathematics / Science / Administration"
                placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
              />

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Email Address</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.input}
                keyboardType="email-address"
                autoCapitalize="none"
                value={form.email}
                onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, email: v }))}
                placeholder="teacher@school.edu.ph"
                placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
              />
              {emailCheck.warning ? (
                <Text style={styles.warnText}>{emailCheck.warning}</Text>
              ) : null}

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Mobile Contact</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.input}
                keyboardType="phone-pad"
                value={form.contact_number}
                onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, contact_number: v }))}
                placeholder="09XXXXXXXXX"
                placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
              />
              {contactCheck.warning ? (
                <Text style={styles.warnText}>{contactCheck.warning}</Text>
              ) : null}

              <View style={styles.switchRow}>
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.switchTitle}>Classroom Teacher (Can Handle Classes)</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.switchSub}>Turn off for non-teaching accounts</Text>
                </View>
                <Switch
                  value={form.can_handle_classes}
                  onValueChange={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, can_handle_classes: v }))}
                  trackColor={{ false: palette.borderStrong, true: palette.primary }}
                  thumbColor={palette.onPrimary}
                />
              </View>

              <View style={styles.switchRow}>
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.switchTitle}>Active Teacher Profile</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.switchSub}>Inactive accounts cannot sign in or Time In</Text>
                </View>
                <Switch
                  value={form.is_active}
                  onValueChange={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, is_active: v }))}
                  trackColor={{ false: palette.borderStrong, true: palette.success }}
                  thumbColor={palette.onPrimary}
                />
              </View>

              <TouchableOpacity
                style={[styles.saveBtn, saving && { opacity: 0.6 }]}
                onPress={() => void handleSave()}
                disabled={saving}
              >
                {saving ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.onPrimary} />
                ) : (
                  <Text style={styles.saveBtnText}>
                    {editing ? 'Save Changes' : 'Create Teacher'}
                  </Text>
                )}
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - User Accounts & Roles CRUD (Admin Only — 100% Web Parity)
 * File: mobile/src/screens/UsersScreen.tsx
 *
 * Full parity with web UsersTab: portrait photos, employee_id, middle_name, suffix,
 * contact_number, department, position, password visibility toggle, live field
 * uniqueness checks, role filters, and locked-account badges.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  FlatList,
  TouchableOpacity,
  TextInput,
  Modal,
  ScrollView,
  Switch,
  RefreshControl,
  ActivityIndicator,
} from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useThemeMode } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import {
  cleanText,
  getFriendlyErrorMessage,
  type ThemePalette,
} from '../constants/theme';
import { canManageUsers } from '../utils/permissions';
import { confirmAction, resolveMediaUrl, showNotice } from '../utils/helpers';
import { useMobileFieldCheck } from '../hooks/useMobileFieldCheck';
import { getServerBaseUrl } from '../services/configService';
import ImageUploadField from '../components/common/ImageUploadField';
import ChipRow from '../components/common/ChipRow';

interface UserAccountRow {
  id: number;
  username: string;
  first_name: string;
  middle_name?: string;
  last_name: string;
  suffix?: string;
  full_name?: string;
  email?: string;
  contact_number?: string;
  employee_id?: string;
  department?: string;
  position?: string;
  role: string;
  is_active: boolean;
  is_locked?: boolean;
  can_handle_classes?: boolean;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
}

interface DepartmentOption {
  id: number;
  name: string;
}

const ROLES = ['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD', 'TEACHER'] as const;
const POSITION_PRESETS = [
  'Teacher I',
  'Teacher II',
  'Teacher III',
  'Master Teacher I',
  'Head Teacher I',
  'School Principal',
  'System Administrator',
  'Administrative Officer',
] as const;

export const UsersScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { palette, fonts } = useThemeMode();
  const styles = useMemo(() => createStyles(palette, fonts), [palette, fonts]);
  const allowCrud = canManageUsers(user);

  const [users, setUsers] = useState<UserAccountRow[]>([]);
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState<DepartmentOption[]>([]);
  const [serverBase, setServerBase] = useState<string>('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<UserAccountRow | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

  const [photoBase64, setPhotoBase64] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [photoRemoved, setPhotoRemoved] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    username: '',
    password: '',
    employee_id: '',
    first_name: '',
    middle_name: '',
    last_name: '',
    suffix: '',
    email: '',
    contact_number: '',
    department: 'General Education',
    position: 'Teacher I',
    role: 'TEACHER',
    is_active: true,
    can_handle_classes: true,
  });

  const isMounted = useRef(true);

  const loadUsers = useCallback(async (silent = false) => {
    if (!silent && isMounted.current) setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [uRes, dRes, base] = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.USERS, { params: { page_size: 'ALL' } }),
        apiClient.get(ENDPOINTS.DEPARTMENTS, { params: { page_size: 100 } }),
        getServerBaseUrl(),
      ]);
      if (!isMounted.current) return;
      if (base.status === 'fulfilled' && base.value) setServerBase(base.value);

      if (uRes.status === 'fulfilled' && uRes.value?.data) {
        const raw = uRes.value.data;
        setUsers(Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : Array.isArray(raw?.results) ? raw.results : []);
      }
      if (dRes.status === 'fulfilled' && dRes.value?.data) {
        const raw = dRes.value.data;
        setDepartments(Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : Array.isArray(raw?.results) ? raw.results : []);
      }
    } catch {
      // Keep existing list
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    void loadUsers(false);
    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
    };
  }, [loadUsers]);

  // Live uniqueness checks for username, employee_id, email, contact_number
  const usernameCheck = useMobileFieldCheck({
    enabled: modalOpen,
    field: 'username',
    value: form.username,
    excludeId: editing?.id,
    excludeUserId: editing?.id,
  });
  const employeeIdCheck = useMobileFieldCheck({
    enabled: modalOpen,
    field: 'employee_id',
    value: form.employee_id,
    excludeId: editing?.id,
    excludeUserId: editing?.id,
  });
  const emailCheck = useMobileFieldCheck({
    enabled: modalOpen,
    field: 'email',
    value: form.email,
    excludeId: editing?.id,
    excludeUserId: editing?.id,
  });
  const contactCheck = useMobileFieldCheck({
    enabled: modalOpen,
    field: 'contact_number',
    value: form.contact_number,
    minDigits: 10,
    excludeId: editing?.id,
    excludeUserId: editing?.id,
  });

  const openAdd = () => {
    setEditing(null);
    setShowPassword(false);
    setPhotoBase64(null);
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    setPhotoRemoved(false);
    setForm({
      username: '',
      password: '',
      employee_id: '',
      first_name: '',
      middle_name: '',
      last_name: '',
      suffix: '',
      email: '',
      contact_number: '',
      department: departments[0]?.name || 'General Education',
      position: 'Teacher I',
      role: 'TEACHER',
      is_active: true,
      can_handle_classes: true,
    });
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (u: UserAccountRow) => {
    setEditing(u);
    setShowPassword(false);
    setPhotoBase64(null);
    setPhotoPreview(u.photo_url || u.photo || null);
    setPhotoRemoved(false);
    setForm({
      username: u.username || '',
      password: '',
      employee_id: u.employee_id || '',
      first_name: u.first_name || '',
      middle_name: u.middle_name || '',
      last_name: u.last_name || '',
      suffix: u.suffix || '',
      email: u.email || '',
      contact_number: u.contact_number || '',
      department: u.department || '',
      position: u.position || '',
      role: u.role || 'TEACHER',
      is_active: u.is_active !== false,
      can_handle_classes: u.can_handle_classes !== false,
    });
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!form.username.trim()) {
      showNotice('Username Required', 'Please enter a username.');
      return;
    }
    if (!editing && form.password.trim().length < 8) {
      showNotice('Password Required', 'New user passwords must be at least 8 characters.');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
        username: cleanText(form.username, 60),
        employee_id: cleanText(form.employee_id, 50),
        first_name: cleanText(form.first_name, 80),
        middle_name: cleanText(form.middle_name, 80),
        last_name: cleanText(form.last_name, 80),
        suffix: cleanText(form.suffix, 20),
        email: cleanText(form.email, 120),
        contact_number: cleanText(form.contact_number, 30),
        department: cleanText(form.department, 80),
        position: cleanText(form.position, 80),
        role: form.role,
        is_active: form.is_active,
        can_handle_classes: form.can_handle_classes,
      };
      if (form.password.trim()) {
        payload.password = form.password.trim();
      }
      if (photoRemoved) {
        payload.photo = null;
        payload.remove_photo = true;
      } else if (photoBase64) {
        payload.photo = photoBase64;
      }

      if (editing) {
        await apiClient.patch(`${ENDPOINTS.USERS}${editing.id}/`, payload);
        showNotice('Updated', 'User account updated.');
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(ENDPOINTS.USERS, payload);
        showNotice('Created', 'User account created.');
      }
      setModalOpen(false);
      await loadUsers(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showNotice('Save Failed', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not save user account.'));
    } finally {
      if (isMounted.current) setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = (u: UserAccountRow) => {
    if (Number(u.id) === Number(user?.id)) {
      showNotice('Blocked', 'You cannot delete your own active account.');
      return;
    }
    const run = async () => {
      try {
        await apiClient.delete(`${ENDPOINTS.USERS}${u.id}/`);
        showNotice('Deleted', `Removed account ${u.username}.`);
        await loadUsers(true);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        showNotice('Delete Failed', getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not delete user account.'));
      }
    };
    confirmAction('Delete Account', `Delete user account ${u.username}?`, 'Delete', () => void run());
  };

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    return users.filter((u) => {
      if (roleFilter !== 'ALL' && String(u.role).toUpperCase() !== roleFilter) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      return `${u.username} ${u.first_name} ${u.last_name} ${u.employee_id || ''} ${u.role} ${u.department || ''} ${u.email || ''}`
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(q);
    });
  }, [users, searchQuery, roleFilter]);

  if (!allowCrud) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.centerBox}>
        <Text style={styles.mutedText}>Administrator access is required to manage user accounts.</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <View style={styles.toolbar}>
        <View style={styles.searchWrap}>
          <Ionicons name="search-outline" size={16} color={palette.textMuted} />
          <TextInput
            style={styles.searchInput}
            placeholder="Search username, name, ID, role..."
            placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
            value={searchQuery}
            onChangeText={setSearchQuery}
          />
        </View>
        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.addBtn} onPress={openAdd} activeOpacity={0.85}>
          <Ionicons name="person-add-outline" size={16} color={palette.onPrimary} />
          <Text style={styles.addBtnText}>Add</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <ChipRow
        options={(['ALL', ...ROLES] as const).map((r) => ({
          key: r,
          label: r === 'ALL' ? `All (${users.length})` : r,
        }))}
        selected={roleFilter}
        onSelect={setRoleFilter}
        style={styles.filterStrip}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.filterRow}
      />

      {loading ? (
        <View style={styles.centerBox}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={palette.primary} />
          <Text style={styles.mutedText}>Loading user accounts...</Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          data={filtered}
          keyExtractor={(item) => String(item.id)}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
          refreshControl={
            <RefreshControl
              refreshing={refreshing}
              onRefresh={() => {
                setRefreshing(true);
                void loadUsers(true);
              }}
              colors={[palette.primary]}
              tintColor={palette.primary}
            />
          }
          renderItem={({ item }) => {
            const avatarUri = resolveMediaUrl(item.photo_url || item.photo, serverBase);
            return (
              <View style={styles.card}>
                <View style={styles.cardRow}>
                  <View style={styles.avatarBox}>
                    {avatarUri ? (
                      <Image source={{ uri: avatarUri }} style={styles.avatarImg} contentFit="cover" />
                    ) : (
                      <Ionicons name="person" size={20} color={palette.primary} />
                    )}
                  </View>
                  <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <Text style={styles.nameText} numberOfLines={1}>
                      {item.full_name || `${item.first_name} ${item.last_name}`.trim() || item.username}
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={styles.metaText}>
                      @{item.username} &bull; {item.role} &bull; {item.is_active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
                      {item.is_locked ? ' • LOCKED' : ''}
                    </Text>
                    <Text style={styles.subText} numberOfLines={1}>
                      {[item.employee_id, item.department, item.position].filter(Boolean).join(' • ') ||
                        item.email ||
                        'No details'}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.actionsRow}>
                    <TouchableOpacity style={styles.iconBtn} onPress={() => openEdit(item)}>
                      <Ionicons name="create-outline" size={16} color={palette.primary} />
                    </TouchableOpacity>
                    {Number(item.id) !== Number(user?.id) && (
                      <TouchableOpacity
                        style={[styles.iconBtn, { backgroundColor: palette.dangerLight }]}
                        onPress={() => handleDelete(item)}
                      >
                        <Ionicons name="trash-outline" size={16} color={palette.danger} />
                      </TouchableOpacity>
                    )}
                  </View>
                </View>
              </View>
            );
          }}
        />
      )}

      <Modal
        visible={modalOpen}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setModalOpen(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalOverlay}>
          <View style={styles.modalSheet}>
            <View style={styles.modalHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.modalTitle}>
                {editing ? 'Edit User Account' : 'Create User Account'}
              </Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setModalOpen(false)}>
                <Ionicons name="close" size={22} color={palette.textMuted} />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
            <ScrollView
              showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
              contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 10, paddingBottom: 16 }}
            >
              <ImageUploadField
                label="Account Portrait Photo"
                value={photoRemoved ? null : photoBase64 || photoPreview}
                serverBase={serverBase}
                variant="avatar"
                onChange={(dataUrl) => {
                  setPhotoBase64(dataUrl);
                  setPhotoPreview(dataUrl);
                  setPhotoRemoved(false);
                }}
                onRemove={() => {
                  setPhotoBase64(null);
                  setPhotoPreview(null);
                  setPhotoRemoved(true);
                }}
              />

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Username *</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.input}
                autoCapitalize="none"
                value={form.username}
                onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, username: v }))}
                placeholder="Username"
                placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
              />
              {usernameCheck.warning ? <Text style={styles.warnText}>{usernameCheck.warning}</Text> : null}

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>
                {editing ? 'New Password (leave blank to keep current)' : 'Password (min 8 characters) *'}
              </Text>
              <View style={styles.passwordWrap}>
                <TextInput
                  style={styles.passwordInput}
                  secureTextEntry={!showPassword}
                  value={form.password}
                  onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, password: v }))}
                  placeholder="Password"
                  placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                />
                <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setShowPassword((s) => !s)}>
                  <Ionicons
                    name={showPassword ? 'eye-off-outline' : 'eye-outline'}
                    size={18}
                    color={palette.textMuted}
                  />
                </TouchableOpacity>
              </View>

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Employee ID</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.input}
                value={form.employee_id}
                onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, employee_id: v }))}
                placeholder="e.g. EMP-2026-001 (auto-generated if blank)"
                placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
              />
              {employeeIdCheck.warning ? <Text style={styles.warnText}>{employeeIdCheck.warning}</Text> : null}

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>First Name *</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.input}
                value={form.first_name}
                onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, first_name: v }))}
                placeholder="First name"
                placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
              />

              <View style={styles.twoCol}>
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Middle Name</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    style={styles.input}
                    value={form.middle_name}
                    onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, middle_name: v }))}
                    placeholder="Optional"
                    placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                  />
                </View>
                <View style={{ width: 92 }}>
                  <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Suffix</Text>
                  <TextInput
                    style={styles.input}
                    value={form.suffix}
                    onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, suffix: v }))}
                    placeholder="Jr. / PhD"
                    placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
                  />
                </View>
              </View>

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Last Name *</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.input}
                value={form.last_name}
                onChangeText={(v) => setForm((p) => ({ ...p, last_name: v }))}
                placeholder="Last name"
                placeholderTextColor={palette.textMuted}
              />

              <Text style={styles.inputLabel}>Email Address</Text>
              <TextInput
                style={styles.input}
                keyboardType="email-address"
                autoCapitalize="none"

/**
 * AttendSure - Authentication Storage & Session API Service
 * File: mobile/src/services/authService.ts
 */

import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import type * as SecureStoreType from 'expo-secure-store';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';
import { cleanText, getFriendlyErrorMessage } from '../constants/theme';

let cachedSecureStore: typeof SecureStoreType | null | undefined;
const getSecureStore = (): typeof SecureStoreType | null => {
  if (cachedSecureStore !== undefined) return cachedSecureStore;
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    cachedSecureStore = null;
    return null;
  }
  try {
    cachedSecureStore = require('expo-secure-store') as typeof SecureStoreType;
  } catch {
    cachedSecureStore = null;
  }
  return cachedSecureStore;
};

export interface UserAccount {
  id: number;
  username: string;
  email: string;
  full_name: string;
  employee_id?: string;
  role: string;
}

export interface AuthResponse {
  token: string;
  user: UserAccount;
}

const TOKEN_KEY = 'attendsure_auth_token';
const USER_KEY = 'attendsure_user_data';

function stripControlChars(value: string): string {
  return String(value || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').trim();
}

const safeStorage = {
  async get(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      try {
        return typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(key) : null;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }
    const store = getSecureStore();
    if (store) {
      try {
        const val = await store.getItemAsync(key);
        if (val !== null) return val;
      } catch {}
    }
    try {
      return await AsyncStorage.getItem(key);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  },

  async set(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      try {
        if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
          localStorage.setItem(key, value);
        }
      } catch {}
      return;
    }
    const store = getSecureStore();
    if (store) {
      try {
        await store.setItemAsync(key, value);
      } catch {}
    }
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(key, value);
    } catch {}
  },

  async delete(key: string): Promise<void> {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      try {
        if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
          localStorage.removeItem(key);
        }
      } catch {}
      return;
    }
    const store = getSecureStore();
    if (store) {
      try {
        await store.deleteItemAsync(key);
      } catch {}
    }
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.removeItem(key);
    } catch {}
  },
};

export const getStoredToken = async (): Promise<string | null> => {
  const token = await safeStorage.get(TOKEN_KEY);
  return token ? stripControlChars(token) : null;
};

export const storeAuthSession = async (token: string, user: UserAccount): Promise<void> => {
  const safeToken = stripControlChars(token);
  if (!safeToken) return;
  await safeStorage.set(TOKEN_KEY, safeToken);
  await safeStorage.set(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
  apiClient.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Token ${safeToken}`;
};

export const getStoredUser = async (): Promise<UserAccount | null> => {
  const raw = await safeStorage.get(USER_KEY);
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw) as UserAccount;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const clearAuthSession = async (): Promise<void> => {
  await safeStorage.delete(TOKEN_KEY);
  await safeStorage.delete(USER_KEY);
  delete apiClient.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
};

export const loginApi = async (
  username: string,
  password: string,
  signal?: AbortSignal
): Promise<AuthResponse> => {
  const safeUsername = cleanText(username, 150);
  const safePassword = stripControlChars(password);

  if (!safeUsername || !safePassword) {
    throw new Error('Please enter both username and password.');
  }

  try {
    const response = await apiClient.post<AuthResponse>(
      ENDPOINTS.LOGIN,
      {
        username: safeUsername,
        password: safePassword,
      },
      { signal }
    );
    return response.data;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    throw new Error(
      getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Unable to sign in. Please check your username and password.')
    );
  }
};

export const fetchCurrentProfile = async (signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<UserAccount> => {
  try {
    const response = await apiClient.get<UserAccount>(ENDPOINTS.CURRENT_USER, { signal });
    return response.data;
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    throw new Error(
      getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Could not load your account profile right now.')
    );
  }
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Continuous Background & Sleep-Safe Campus GPS Heartbeat Service
 * File: mobile/src/services/backgroundLocation.ts
 *
 * Registered at top-level app entry (mobile/index.ts) so Android Foreground Service
 * and iOS Background Location continue checking GPS even when the phone is locked,
 * stationary, or sleeping. Backend duty-aware rules log continuous presence while
 * raising loafing alerts only during active duty hours without an exit pass.
 */

import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import * as TaskManager from 'expo-task-manager';
import * as Location from 'expo-location';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import defaultApiClient, { apiClient as namedClient, AUTH_TOKEN_KEY } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';
import { PALETTES } from '../constants/theme';
import { getHardwareDeviceUuid } from './deviceService';
import { getRealDeviceModel } from './telemetryService';
import {
  enqueueOfflineHeartbeat,
  syncOfflineQueue,
  QueuedCampusPingPayload,
} from './offlineQueue';

const client = defaultApiClient || namedClient;
export const BACKGROUND_TELEMETRY_TASK = 'ATTENDSURE_BACKGROUND_GEOFENCE';
export const TEACHER_ON_DUTY_KEY = 'attendsure_teacher_on_duty';
export const CONTINUOUS_GPS_ACTIVE_KEY = 'attendsure_continuous_gps_active';
export const LAST_HEARTBEAT_TS_KEY = 'attendsure_last_heartbeat_ts';

interface BackgroundLocationTaskData {
  locations?: Location.LocationObject[];
}

async function hasStoredAuthSession(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const [primary, access, legacy] = await Promise.all([
      AsyncStorage.getItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY),
      AsyncStorage.getItem('attendsure_access'),
      AsyncStorage.getItem('attendsure_token'),
    ]);
    return Boolean(
      (primary && primary.trim()) || (access && access.trim()) || (legacy && legacy.trim())
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function isTeacherOnDutyStored(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const flag = await AsyncStorage.getItem(TEACHER_ON_DUTY_KEY);
    return flag === 'true';
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function setTeacherOnDutyFlag(onDuty: boolean): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(TEACHER_ON_DUTY_KEY, onDuty ? 'true' : 'false');
    if (onDuty) {
      const signedIn = await hasStoredAuthSession();
      if (signedIn) {
        await startContinuousGpsHeartbeat();
      }
    } else {
      await stopContinuousGpsHeartbeat();
    }
  } catch {}
}

try {
  TaskManager.defineTask<BackgroundLocationTaskData>(
    BACKGROUND_TELEMETRY_TASK,
    async ({ data, error }) => {
      if (error || !data) return;

      // Transmit background GPS pings ONLY while the teacher is signed in and timed in on duty
      const [activeFlag, onDutyFlag, signedIn] = await Promise.all([
        AsyncStorage.getItem(CONTINUOUS_GPS_ACTIVE_KEY).catch(() => 'false'),
        AsyncStorage.getItem(TEACHER_ON_DUTY_KEY).catch(() => 'false'),
        hasStoredAuthSession(),
      ]);
      if (activeFlag === 'false' || onDutyFlag !== 'true' || !signedIn) {
        await stopContinuousGpsHeartbeat();
        return;
      }

      const locations = Array.isArray(data.locations) ? data.locations : [];
      const latest = locations.length > 0 ? locations[locations.length - 1] : null;
      if (!latest || !latest.coords) return;

      // Strictly block fake / mocked GPS before touching the API
      if (latest.mocked) return;

      const lat = latest.coords.latitude;
      const lng = latest.coords.longitude;
      const accuracy = latest.coords.accuracy ?? 15;

      if (
        !Number.isFinite(lat) ||
        !Number.isFinite(lng) ||
        lat < -90 ||
        lat > 90 ||
        lng < -180 ||
        lng > 180 ||
        accuracy > 250
      ) {
        return;
      }

      const deviceId = await getHardwareDeviceUuid().catch(() => '');
      const deviceModel = getRealDeviceModel();

      const payload = {
        latitude: Number(lat.toFixed(6)),
        longitude: Number(lng.toFixed(6)),
        accuracy_meters: Number(accuracy.toFixed(1)),
        device_id: deviceId,
        is_mock_location: false,
      };

      try {
        await client.post(ENDPOINTS.CAMPUS_PING, payload, { timeout: 10000 });
        await AsyncStorage.setItem(LAST_HEARTBEAT_TS_KEY, String(Date.now())).catch(() => {});
        // Opportunistically flush any pings queued while the phone had no signal
        await syncOfflineQueue().catch(() => {});
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const status = (err as { response?: { status?: number } })?.response?.status;
        if (status === 400 || status === 401 || status === 403) return;

        const offlinePayload: QueuedCampusPingPayload = {
          device_id: deviceId,
          latitude: payload.latitude,
          longitude: payload.longitude,
          accuracy_meters: payload.accuracy_meters,
          is_mock_location: false,
          device_model: deviceModel,
        };
        await enqueueOfflineHeartbeat(offlinePayload).catch(() => {});
      }
    }
  );
} catch {
  // Background task manager may not be available in web runtimes
}

/**
 * Starts continuous background GPS tracking with distanceInterval: 0 so stationary
 * teachers and sleeping phones continue transmitting uninterrupted campus heartbeats.
 */
export async function startContinuousGpsHeartbeat(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') return false;
  try {
    const [onDuty, signedIn] = await Promise.all([
      isTeacherOnDutyStored(),
      hasStoredAuthSession(),
    ]);
    if (!onDuty || !signedIn) {
      await stopContinuousGpsHeartbeat();
      return false;
    }

    await AsyncStorage.setItem(CONTINUOUS_GPS_ACTIVE_KEY, 'true');

    const { status: fgStatus } = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync();
    if (fgStatus !== 'granted') return false;

    const { status: bgStatus } = await Location.requestBackgroundPermissionsAsync().catch(() => ({
      status: 'denied',
    }));
    if (bgStatus !== 'granted') return false;

    const isRegistered = await TaskManager.isTaskRegisteredAsync(BACKGROUND_TELEMETRY_TASK);
    if (!isRegistered) {
      await Location.startLocationUpdatesAsync(BACKGROUND_TELEMETRY_TASK, {
        accuracy: Location.Accuracy.High,
        timeInterval: 45000,
        distanceInterval: 0,
        deferredUpdatesInterval: 45000,
        deferredUpdatesDistance: 0,
        pausesUpdatesAutomatically: false,
        showsBackgroundLocationIndicator: true,
        activityType: Location.ActivityType.Other,
        foregroundService: {
          notificationTitle: 'AttendSure Campus GPS Active',
          notificationBody: 'Checking campus GPS location while you are timed in on duty.',
          notificationColor: PALETTES.light.primary,
        },
      });
    }
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function stopContinuousGpsHeartbeat(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(CONTINUOUS_GPS_ACTIVE_KEY, 'false');
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') return;
    const isRegistered = await TaskManager.isTaskRegisteredAsync(BACKGROUND_TELEMETRY_TASK);
    if (isRegistered) {
      await Location.stopLocationUpdatesAsync(BACKGROUND_TELEMETRY_TASK);
    }
  } catch {}
}

// Backwards-compatible aliases
export const startPassivePresenceTracking = startContinuousGpsHeartbeat;
export const stopPassivePresenceTracking = stopContinuousGpsHeartbeat;

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Built-In Phone Lock / Biometric & Keystore Proof Service
 * Supports both hardware biometrics (Fingerprint / Face) and Android/iOS Screen Lock
 * (PIN, Pattern, or Password) via expo-local-authentication + expo-secure-store + expo-crypto.
 * Zero biometric or passcode data ever leaves the phone's hardware security storage.

import { Platform } from 'react-native';

import type * as SecureStoreType from 'expo-secure-store';

export interface PhoneLockCapability {

  hasBiometric: boolean;
  securityLevel: number;

const BIOMETRIC_SECRET_PREFIX = 'attendsure_biometric_secret_';
const NO_LOCK_SETUP_MESSAGE =
  'No screen lock is set on this phone. Please go to your phone Settings -> Lock screen and set a PIN, Pattern, or Fingerprint first.';

function sanitizeKeySegment(userId: string | number): string {
  const cleaned = String(userId ?? 'teacher')
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '_');
  return cleaned || 'teacher';
}

function bytesToHex(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  return Array.from(bytes)
    .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
    .join('');
}

/**
 * Checks the enrolled phone security level using getEnrolledLevelAsync() so phones
 * without a physical fingerprint sensor (PIN / Pattern / Password only) work seamlessly.
 */
export async function checkPhoneLockCapability(): Promise<PhoneLockCapability> {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    return {
      ready: false,
      hasBiometric: false,
      securityLevel: 0,
      modeLabel: 'Mobile Phone Required',
      methodCode: 'UNSUPPORTED',
      setupMessage:
        'Teacher Time In / Time Out requires the AttendSure mobile app on a phone with a Screen Lock (PIN, Pattern, or Fingerprint).',
    };
  }

  try {
    const LocalAuthentication = getLocalAuth();
    if (!LocalAuthentication || typeof LocalAuthentication.getEnrolledLevelAsync !== 'function') {
      return {
        ready: false,
        hasBiometric: false,
        securityLevel: 0,
        modeLabel: 'Screen Lock Unavailable',
        methodCode: 'NONE',
        setupMessage: NO_LOCK_SETUP_MESSAGE,
      };
    }

    const securityLevel = await LocalAuthentication.getEnrolledLevelAsync();

    if (securityLevel === LocalAuthentication.SecurityLevel.NONE) {
      return {
        ready: false,
        hasBiometric: false,
        securityLevel,
        modeLabel: 'Screen Lock Not Set',
        methodCode: 'NONE',
        setupMessage: NO_LOCK_SETUP_MESSAGE,
      };
    }

    if (securityLevel >= LocalAuthentication.SecurityLevel.BIOMETRIC_WEAK) {
      return {
        ready: true,
        hasBiometric: true,
        securityLevel,
        modeLabel: 'Fingerprint / Biometric Ready',
        methodCode: 'BIOMETRIC',
        setupMessage: null,
      };
    }

    return {
      ready: true,
      hasBiometric: false,
      securityLevel,
      modeLabel: 'Phone PIN / Pattern Lock Ready',
      methodCode: 'DEVICE_PIN_OR_PATTERN',
      setupMessage: null,
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      ready: false,
      hasBiometric: false,
      securityLevel: 0,
      modeLabel: 'Screen Lock Not Set',
      methodCode: 'NONE',
      setupMessage: NO_LOCK_SETUP_MESSAGE,
    };
  }
}

async function getOrCreateUserBiometricSecret(userId: string | number): Promise<string> {
  const storeKey = `${BIOMETRIC_SECRET_PREFIX}${sanitizeKeySegment(userId)}`;
  const SecureStore = getSecureStore();

  const existingSecure = SecureStore
    ? await SecureStore.getItemAsync(storeKey).catch(() => null)
    : null;
  if (existingSecure && existingSecure.trim().length >= 32) {
    return existingSecure.trim();
  }

  const existingFallback = await AsyncStorage.getItem(storeKey).catch(() => null);
  if (existingFallback && existingFallback.trim().length >= 32) {
    return existingFallback.trim();
  }

  const randomBytes = await Crypto.getRandomBytesAsync(32);
  const newSecret = bytesToHex(randomBytes);

  if (SecureStore) {
    await SecureStore.setItemAsync(storeKey, newSecret, {
      keychainAccessible: SecureStore.AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY,
    }).catch(() => {});
  } else {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(storeKey, newSecret).catch(() => {});
  }

  return newSecret;
}

function mapAuthErrorToPlainEnglish(errorCode?: string): string {
  switch (errorCode) {
    case 'user_cancel':
    case 'app_cancel':
    case 'system_cancel':
      return 'Verification was cancelled. Tap the button again when you are ready to verify.';
    case 'not_enrolled':
    case 'passcode_not_set':
      return NO_LOCK_SETUP_MESSAGE;
    case 'lockout':
      return 'Too many failed tries. Unlock your phone and try again.';
    case 'timeout':
      return 'Verification timed out. Tap the button and confirm your phone lock again.';
    default:
      return 'Identity verification did not succeed. Please confirm your phone fingerprint, PIN, or pattern and try again.';
  }
}

/**
 * Verifies the teacher using their phone's built-in Fingerprint/Biometric OR Screen Lock
 * (PIN / Pattern / Password), reads or creates the per-user SecureStore secret, and generates
 * a non-replayable SHA-256 check-in proof.
 */
export async function verifyTeacherBiometricProof(
  userId: string | number,
  action: CheckInProofAction
): Promise<BiometricProofResult> {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error:
        'Teacher Time In / Time Out requires the AttendSure mobile app on a phone with a Screen Lock (PIN, Pattern, or Fingerprint).',
    };
  }

  try {
    const LocalAuthentication = getLocalAuth();
    if (!LocalAuthentication || typeof LocalAuthentication.getEnrolledLevelAsync !== 'function') {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: NO_LOCK_SETUP_MESSAGE,
      };
    }

    const securityLevel = await LocalAuthentication.getEnrolledLevelAsync();

    if (securityLevel === LocalAuthentication.SecurityLevel.NONE) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: NO_LOCK_SETUP_MESSAGE,
      };
    }

    const biometricMethod: 'BIOMETRIC' | 'DEVICE_PIN_OR_PATTERN' =
      securityLevel >= LocalAuthentication.SecurityLevel.BIOMETRIC_WEAK
        ? 'BIOMETRIC'
        : 'DEVICE_PIN_OR_PATTERN';

    // Omit cancelLabel when disableDeviceFallback is false to stay compatible with Android DEVICE_CREDENTIAL (e.g. Samsung OneUI)
    const authResult = await LocalAuthentication.authenticateAsync({
      promptMessage:
        action === 'TIME_OUT'
          ? 'Verify your identity to Time Out'
          : 'Verify your identity to Time In',
      disableDeviceFallback: false,
    });

    if (!authResult.success) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: mapAuthErrorToPlainEnglish(authResult.error),
      };
    }

    const [secret, deviceUuid] = await Promise.all([
      getOrCreateUserBiometricSecret(userId),
      getOrCreateDeviceUuid(),
    ]);

    const timestampMs = Date.now();
    const cleanUserId = String(userId ?? '').trim();
    const keyId = await Crypto.digestStringAsync(
      Crypto.CryptoDigestAlgorithm.SHA256,
      secret
    );
    const proofPayload = `${secret}:${cleanUserId}:${deviceUuid}:${timestampMs}:${action}`;
    const proofHash = await Crypto.digestStringAsync(
      Crypto.CryptoDigestAlgorithm.SHA256,
      proofPayload
    );

    return {
      ok: true,
      biometricMethod,
      keyId,
      proofHash,
      timestampMs,
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: NO_LOCK_SETUP_MESSAGE,
    };
  }
}

const DANGEROUS_SCHEME_RE = /^(javascript|data|file|vbscript|blob|about):/i;
const ANY_SCHEME_RE = /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i;

function getLoopbackFallback(): string {
  return Platform.OS === 'android' ? 'http://10.0.2.2:8000' : 'http://127.0.0.1:8000';
}

function stripControlChars(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').trim();
}

function normalizeAccidentalExpoUrl(raw: string): string {
  let s = stripControlChars(raw);
  // Fix accidental "http://exp://192.168.x.x:8081:8000" or "exp://192.168.x.x:8081"
  s = s.replace(/^https?:\/\/exp:\/\//i, 'http://').replace(/^exp:\/\//i, 'http://');
  s = s.replace(/:8081:8000$/i, ':8000');
  return s;
}

export function isValidServerUrl(url?: string | null): boolean {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const trimmed = normalizeAccidentalExpoUrl(url);
  if (!trimmed) return false;

  if (DANGEROUS_SCHEME_RE.test(trimmed)) return false;
  if (ANY_SCHEME_RE.test(trimmed) && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const normalized = /^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed) ? trimmed : `http://${trimmed}`;
    const parsed = new URL(normalized);
    if (parsed.protocol !== 'http:' && parsed.protocol !== 'https:') return false;
    if (!parsed.hostname || parsed.hostname === 'exp') return false;
    if (parsed.port && (!/^\d+$/.test(parsed.port) || Number(parsed.port) > 65535)) return false;
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function cleanUrl(rawUrl?: string | null): string {
  const fallback = getLoopbackFallback();
  if (!rawUrl || typeof rawUrl !== 'string') {
    return fallback;
  }

  const sanitized = normalizeAccidentalExpoUrl(rawUrl);
  if (!sanitized || DANGEROUS_SCHEME_RE.test(sanitized)) {
    return fallback;
  }
  if (ANY_SCHEME_RE.test(sanitized) && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(sanitized)) {
    return fallback;
  }

  let trimmed = sanitized
    .replace(/\/+$/, '')
    .replace(/\/api(\/v1)?$/i, '')
    .replace(/\/+$/, '');

  if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) {
    trimmed = `http://${trimmed}`;
  }

  try {
    const parsed = new URL(trimmed);
    if (parsed.protocol !== 'http:' && parsed.protocol !== 'https:') {
      return fallback;
    }
    if (!parsed.hostname || parsed.hostname === 'exp') {
      return fallback;
    }
    return trimmed;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

export const sanitizeUrl = cleanUrl;

export function getMetroHostIp(): string | null {
  try {
    const Constants = require('expo-constants').default;
    const hostUri =
      Constants?.expoConfig?.hostUri ||
      Constants?.manifest2?.extra?.expoGo?.debuggerHost ||
      Constants?.manifest?.debuggerHost ||
      Constants?.linkingUri;

    if (hostUri && typeof hostUri === 'string') {
      const cleaned = hostUri.replace(/^[a-z]+:\/\//i, '');
      const ip = cleaned.split(':')[0].split('/')[0];
      if (
        ip &&
        ip !== 'localhost' &&
        ip !== '127.0.0.1' &&
        !ip.includes('expo.dev') &&
        !ip.includes('expo.app') &&
        !ip.includes('ngrok')
      ) {
        return ip;
      }
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;
}

export function getCandidateServers(): string[] {
  const candidates: string[] = [];
  const isNativeMobile = Platform.OS === 'android' || Platform.OS === 'ios';

  // 1. Live Expo Go Metro Bundler Host IP (always matches laptop's current Wi-Fi IP!)
  const metroIp = getMetroHostIp();
  if (metroIp && isValidServerUrl(`http://${metroIp}:8000`)) {
    candidates.push(cleanUrl(`http://${metroIp}:8000`));
  }

  // 2. Environment variable from mobile/.env
  const envUrl = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL;
  if (envUrl && isValidServerUrl(envUrl)) {
    const cleanedEnv = cleanUrl(envUrl);
    const isLoopback = cleanedEnv.includes('127.0.0.1') || cleanedEnv.includes('localhost');
    if (!isNativeMobile || !isLoopback) {
      candidates.push(cleanedEnv);
    }
  }

  // 3. Web / Android Emulator loopback fallback
  if (!isNativeMobile) {
    candidates.push('http://127.0.0.1:8000');
  } else if (Platform.OS === 'android') {
    candidates.push('http://10.0.2.2:8000');
  }

  return Array.from(new Set(candidates.filter((u) => Boolean(u && isValidServerUrl(u)))));
}

export function getDefaultBaseUrl(): string {
  return getCandidateServers()[0] || getLoopbackFallback();
}

export const DEFAULT_SERVER_URL = getDefaultBaseUrl();
