  cachedUrl = null;
  lastCacheTime = 0;
  inFlightDiscoveryPromise = null;
}

export function markServerReachable(url?: string | null): void {
  if (url && isValidServerUrl(url)) {
    cachedUrl = cleanUrl(url);
    lastCacheTime = Date.now();
  } else if (cachedUrl) {
    lastCacheTime = Date.now();
  }
}

const LEGACY_STORAGE_PURGE_KEY = 'attendsure_v3_purged_legacy_55555';

export async function purgeLegacySchoolCacheOnce(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const alreadyPurged = await AsyncStorage.getItem(LEGACY_STORAGE_PURGE_KEY);
    if (alreadyPurged === 'true') return;

    const cachedSchoolRaw = await AsyncStorage.getItem('attendsure_cached_school');
    const cachedProfileRaw = await AsyncStorage.getItem('attendsure_cached_school_profile');
    const combined = `${cachedSchoolRaw || ''} ${cachedProfileRaw || ''}`.toLowerCase();

    if (combined.includes('55555') || combined.includes('lapasan')) {
      await AsyncStorage.multiRemove([
        'attendsure_cached_school',
        'attendsure_cached_school_profile',
        'attendsure_cached_sections',
        'attendsure_cached_dtr',
        'attendsure_cached_geofence',
        'attendsure_offline_queue',
        'attendsure_offline_qr_scans',
        'attendsure_user_profile',
        'attendsure_user',
        'user_token',
        'attendsure_token',
        SERVER_URL_STORAGE_KEY,
        CUSTOM_SERVER_URL_KEY,
      ]);
    }

    // Also clear any broken exp:// URL saved previously in AsyncStorage
    const savedCustom = await AsyncStorage.getItem(CUSTOM_SERVER_URL_KEY);
    if (savedCustom && (savedCustom.includes('exp://') || savedCustom.includes(':8081'))) {
      await AsyncStorage.multiRemove([SERVER_URL_STORAGE_KEY, CUSTOM_SERVER_URL_KEY]);
    }

    await AsyncStorage.setItem(LEGACY_STORAGE_PURGE_KEY, 'true');
  } catch {}
}

async function runServerDiscovery(): Promise<string> {
  await purgeLegacySchoolCacheOnce();

  const customUrl = await AsyncStorage.getItem(CUSTOM_SERVER_URL_KEY).catch(() => null);
  const candidates = getCandidateServers();

  if (customUrl && isValidServerUrl(customUrl)) {
    const cleanedCustom = cleanUrl(customUrl);
    if (!candidates.includes(cleanedCustom)) {
      candidates.unshift(cleanedCustom);
    }
  }

  if (candidates.length === 0) {
    cachedUrl = getDefaultBaseUrl();
    lastCacheTime = Date.now();
    return cachedUrl;
  }

  const probeServer = async (
    targetUrl: string,
    externalController?: AbortController
  ): Promise<string> => {
    const controller = externalController || new AbortController();
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 2800);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${targetUrl}/api/v1/health/db/`, {
        method: 'GET',
        headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (res.status >= 200 && res.status < 400) return targetUrl;
      throw new Error(`Status ${res.status}`);
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    }
  };

  if (customUrl && isValidServerUrl(customUrl)) {
    const cleanedCustom = cleanUrl(customUrl);
    try {
      const okUrl = await probeServer(cleanedCustom);
      cachedUrl = okUrl;
      lastCacheTime = Date.now();
      return okUrl;
    } catch {
      // Fall through to auto-detected Metro LAN candidates if old custom IP changed
    }
  }

  const activeControllers: AbortController[] = [];
  const abortAllProbes = () => {
    activeControllers.forEach((ctrl) => {
      try {
        ctrl.abort();
      } catch {}
    });
  };

  try {
    const fastestUrl = await Promise.any(
      candidates.map((url) => {
        const ctrl = new AbortController();
        activeControllers.push(ctrl);
        return probeServer(url, ctrl);
      })
    );
    abortAllProbes();
    cachedUrl = fastestUrl;
    lastCacheTime = Date.now();
    AsyncStorage.setItem(SERVER_URL_STORAGE_KEY, fastestUrl).catch(() => {});
    return fastestUrl;
  } catch {
    abortAllProbes();
    const fallback = candidates[0];
    cachedUrl = fallback;
    lastCacheTime = Date.now();
    return fallback;
  }
}

export async function resolveFastestServer(): Promise<string> {
  if (inFlightDiscoveryPromise) {
    return inFlightDiscoveryPromise;
  }
  const discovery = runServerDiscovery().finally(() => {
    if (inFlightDiscoveryPromise === discovery) {
      inFlightDiscoveryPromise = null;
    }
  });
  inFlightDiscoveryPromise = discovery;
  return discovery;
}

export async function getServerBaseUrl(): Promise<string> {
  if (cachedUrl && Date.now() - lastCacheTime < CACHE_TTL_MS) {
    return cachedUrl;
  }
  return resolveFastestServer();
}

export async function setServerBaseUrl(newUrl: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!isValidServerUrl(newUrl)) {
    throw new Error('Please enter a valid web address starting with http:// or https://.');
  }
  const cleaned = cleanUrl(newUrl);
  try {
    await AsyncStorage.multiSet([
      [SERVER_URL_STORAGE_KEY, cleaned],
      [CUSTOM_SERVER_URL_KEY, cleaned],
    ]);
    cachedUrl = cleaned;
    lastCacheTime = Date.now();
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function resetServerBaseUrl(): Promise<void> {
  await AsyncStorage.multiRemove([SERVER_URL_STORAGE_KEY, CUSTOM_SERVER_URL_KEY]).catch(
    () => {}
  );
  invalidateServerCache();
}

export async function buildApiUrl(endpoint: string): Promise<string> {
  const base = await getServerBaseUrl();
  const safePath = stripControlChars(endpoint).replace(/\.\.\//g, '');
  const cleanEndpoint = safePath.startsWith('/') ? safePath : `/${safePath}`;
  return `${base}/api${cleanEndpoint}`;
}

export async function testServerConnection(
  testUrl?: string
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; message: string; pingMs: number }> {
  if (testUrl !== undefined && !isValidServerUrl(testUrl)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: 'Please enter a valid school server web address starting with http:// or https://.',
      pingMs: 0,
    };
  }

  const target = cleanUrl(testUrl || cachedUrl || getDefaultBaseUrl());
  const startTime = Date.now();
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 3000);

  try {
    const response = await fetch(`${target}/api/v1/health/db/`, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
      signal: controller.signal,
    });

    const pingMs = Date.now() - startTime;
    if (response.status >= 200 && response.status < 400) {
      return { ok: true, message: `Connected to school server (${pingMs}ms)`, pingMs };
    }
    return { ok: false, message: `Server replied with status ${response.status}`, pingMs };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const pingMs = Date.now() - startTime;
    const isAbort =
      err !== null &&
      typeof err === 'object' &&
      'name' in err &&
      (err as { name?: string }).name === 'AbortError';
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: isAbort
        ? 'Connection timed out. Check Windows Firewall on port 8000.'
        : 'Cannot reach school server. Verify phone & laptop are on the same Wi-Fi.',
      pingMs,
    };
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  }
}

/**
 * AttendSure - Hardware Device Identity Service
 * File: mobile/src/services/deviceService.ts
 *
 * Security & 1-to-1 Device Binding:
 * 1. Cryptographic Entropy: Generates unguessable device IDs using expo-crypto.
 * 2. Encrypted Storage: Persists IDs using hardware-backed SecureStore.
 * 3. In-Memory Caching: Speeds up repeated lookups without extra disk reads.
 * 4. Decoupled Service: Prevents circular dependencies across screens and background tasks.
 */

import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import type * as SecureStoreType from 'expo-secure-store';
import type * as ApplicationType from 'expo-application';
import * as Crypto from 'expo-crypto';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';

export const SECURE_DEVICE_UUID_KEY = 'attendsure_hardware_device_uuid';

function getSecureStore(): typeof SecureStoreType | null {
  try {
    return require('expo-secure-store') as typeof SecureStoreType;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function getApplicationModule(): typeof ApplicationType | null {
  try {
    return require('expo-application') as typeof ApplicationType;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// In-memory cache to prevent repeated storage disk reads
let cachedDeviceUuid: string | null = null;

function readWebStorageSafe(key: string): string | null {
  try {
    if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
      return localStorage.getItem(key);
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;
}

function writeWebStorageSafe(key: string, value: string): void {
  try {
    if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem(key, value);
    }
  } catch {}
}

/**
 * Generates or retrieves a single canonical, hardware-backed device UUID
 * shared across teacher phone biometric check-ins, foreground location verification,
 * and background campus presence updates.
 */
export const getOrCreateDeviceUuid = async (): Promise<string> => {
  if (cachedDeviceUuid) {
    return cachedDeviceUuid;
  }

  try {
    if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
      const stored = readWebStorageSafe(SECURE_DEVICE_UUID_KEY);
      if (stored && stored.trim().length > 0) {
        cachedDeviceUuid = stored.trim();
        return cachedDeviceUuid;
      }
      const randomPart =
        typeof Crypto.randomUUID === 'function'
          ? Crypto.randomUUID().substring(0, 13).toUpperCase()
          : Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10).toUpperCase();
      const webUuid = `DEV-WEB-${randomPart}`;
      writeWebStorageSafe(SECURE_DEVICE_UUID_KEY, webUuid);
      cachedDeviceUuid = webUuid;
      return webUuid;
    }

    const SecureStore = getSecureStore();
    const Application = getApplicationModule();

    // 1. Prefer hardware-encrypted SecureStore when available
    const secureExisting = SecureStore
      ? await SecureStore.getItemAsync(SECURE_DEVICE_UUID_KEY).catch(() => null)
      : null;
    if (secureExisting && secureExisting.trim().length > 0) {
      const clean = secureExisting.trim();
      cachedDeviceUuid = clean;
      AsyncStorage.setItem(SECURE_DEVICE_UUID_KEY, clean).catch(() => {});
      return clean;
    }

    // 2. Migrate any previously saved AsyncStorage hardware ID to keep 1-to-1 bindings intact
    const asyncExisting = await AsyncStorage.getItem(SECURE_DEVICE_UUID_KEY).catch(() => null);
    if (asyncExisting && asyncExisting.trim().length > 0) {
      const clean = asyncExisting.trim();
      cachedDeviceUuid = clean;
      if (SecureStore) {
        SecureStore.setItemAsync(SECURE_DEVICE_UUID_KEY, clean, {
          keychainAccessible: SecureStore.AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY,
        }).catch(() => {});
      }
      return clean;
    }

    // 3. Derive stable hardware ID when available, otherwise generate cryptographic entropy
    let hardwareSeed: string | null = null;
    try {
      if (Application && Platform.OS === 'android' && typeof Application.getAndroidId === 'function') {
        hardwareSeed = Application.getAndroidId();
      } else if (Application && Platform.OS === 'ios' && typeof Application.getIosIdForVendorAsync === 'function') {
        hardwareSeed = await Application.getIosIdForVendorAsync();
      }
    } catch {}

    let generated: string;
    if (hardwareSeed && hardwareSeed.trim().length > 0) {
      generated = `DEV-${Platform.OS.toUpperCase()}-${hardwareSeed.trim().toUpperCase()}`;
    } else {
      const randomBytes = await Crypto.getRandomBytesAsync(8);
      const hex = Array.from(randomBytes)
        .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
        .join('')
        .toUpperCase();
      generated = `DEV-${Platform.OS.toUpperCase()}-${hex.substring(0, 8)}-${hex.substring(8, 16)}`;
    }

    const writeOps: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [
      AsyncStorage.setItem(SECURE_DEVICE_UUID_KEY, generated),
    ];
    if (SecureStore) {
      writeOps.push(
        SecureStore.setItemAsync(SECURE_DEVICE_UUID_KEY, generated, {
          keychainAccessible: SecureStore.AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY,
        })
      );
    }
    await Promise.allSettled(writeOps);

    cachedDeviceUuid = generated;
    return generated;
  } catch {
    const fallback = `DEV-${Platform.OS.toUpperCase()}-TEMP-${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()}`;
    cachedDeviceUuid = fallback;
    return fallback;
  }
};

export const getHardwareDeviceUuid = getOrCreateDeviceUuid;

/**
 * AttendSure - Offline Storage & Sync Queue Engine (Student QR + Campus Pings)
 * File: mobile/src/services/offlineQueue.ts
 */

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { apiClient } from '../api/client';
import { ENDPOINTS } from '../api/endpoints';

const OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY = 'attendsure_offline_queue';
const OFFLINE_QR_SCANS_KEY = 'attendsure_offline_qr_scans';
const MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS = 8;
const MAX_QR_PERMANENT_RETRIES = 3;
const MAX_HEARTBEAT_AGE_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

let isSyncing = false;

export interface QueuedCampusPingPayload {
  device_id?: string | null;
  client_device_id?: string | null;
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  accuracy_meters?: number | null;
  accuracy?: number | null;
  is_mock_location?: boolean;
  device_model?: string | null;
}

export interface QueuedQrScan {
  client_scan_uuid: string;
  qr_token: string;
  period_id: number;
  scanned_at: string;
  retryCount?: number;
}

export interface OfflineQueueItem {
  id: string;
  endpoint: string;
  method: 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH';
  payload: unknown;
  timestamp: number;
  retryCount?: number;
}

function isAllowedRelativeEndpoint(endpoint?: string | null): endpoint is string {
  if (!endpoint || typeof endpoint !== 'string') return false;
  const trimmed = endpoint.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return false;
  if (
    /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i.test(trimmed) ||
    trimmed.startsWith('//') ||
    trimmed.includes('..') ||
    /[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/.test(trimmed)
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function isPingEndpoint(endpoint: string): boolean {
  const lower = endpoint.toLowerCase();
  return lower.includes('campus/ping') || lower.includes('campus/check-in');
}

async function readQueueSafe(): Promise<OfflineQueueItem[]> {
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? (parsed as OfflineQueueItem[]) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

async function readQrScansSafe(): Promise<QueuedQrScan[]> {
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(OFFLINE_QR_SCANS_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? (parsed as QueuedQrScan[]) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export async function getQueuedQrScans(): Promise<QueuedQrScan[]> {
  return readQrScansSafe();
}

export async function getUnsyncedCount(): Promise<number> {
  const [items, qrScans] = await Promise.all([readQueueSafe(), readQrScansSafe()]);
  return items.length + qrScans.length;
}

export async function enqueueOfflineQrScan(scan: QueuedQrScan): Promise<number> {
  try {
    const current = await readQrScansSafe();
    if (!current.some((s) => s.client_scan_uuid === scan.client_scan_uuid)) {
      current.push({ ...scan, retryCount: scan.retryCount ?? 0 });
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(OFFLINE_QR_SCANS_KEY, JSON.stringify(current));
    }
    return current.length;
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}

export async function syncOfflineQrScans(): Promise<{ synced: number; remaining: number }> {
  const scans = await readQrScansSafe();
  if (scans.length === 0) {
    return { synced: 0, remaining: 0 };
  }

  const apiScans = scans.map(({ client_scan_uuid, qr_token, period_id, scanned_at }) => ({
    client_scan_uuid,
    qr_token,
    period_id,
    scanned_at,
  }));

  try {
    await apiClient.post(
      ENDPOINTS.ATTENDANCE_OFFLINE_SYNC,
      { scans: apiScans },
      { timeout: 10000 }
    );
    const snapshotIds = new Set(scans.map((s) => s.client_scan_uuid));
    const latest = await readQrScansSafe();
    const stillPending = latest.filter((s) => !snapshotIds.has(s.client_scan_uuid));
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(OFFLINE_QR_SCANS_KEY, JSON.stringify(stillPending));
    return { synced: scans.length, remaining: stillPending.length };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const status = (err as { response?: { status?: number } })?.response?.status;

    // Leave 401 untouched so token refresh or sign-in can retry cleanly
    if (status === 401) {
      return { synced: 0, remaining: scans.length };
    }

    // Track retries on permanent 400/403 responses and drop unrecoverable items after max tries
    if (status === 400 || status === 403) {
      const snapshotIds = new Set(scans.map((s) => s.client_scan_uuid));
      const latest = await readQrScansSafe();
      const nextQueue: QueuedQrScan[] = [];
      let droppedCount = 0;

      for (const item of latest) {
        if (!snapshotIds.has(item.client_scan_uuid)) {
          nextQueue.push(item);
          continue;
        }
        const nextRetry = (item.retryCount || 0) + 1;
        if (nextRetry < MAX_QR_PERMANENT_RETRIES) {
          nextQueue.push({ ...item, retryCount: nextRetry });
        } else {
          droppedCount += 1;
        }
      }

      if (droppedCount > 0) {
        console.warn(
          `[AttendSure] Removed ${droppedCount} unrecoverable offline QR scan(s) after HTTP ${status} (${MAX_QR_PERMANENT_RETRIES} tries).`
        );
      }

      await AsyncStorage.setItem(OFFLINE_QR_SCANS_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextQueue));
      return { synced: 0, remaining: nextQueue.length };
    }

    // Keep transient network or 5xx errors queued for automatic retry
    return { synced: 0, remaining: scans.length };
  }
}

export async function enqueueOfflineHeartbeat(payload: QueuedCampusPingPayload): Promise<void> {
  if (payload.is_mock_location) return;
  try {
    const current = await readQueueSafe();
    const filtered = current.filter((item) => !isPingEndpoint(item.endpoint || ''));

    filtered.push({
      id: `ping_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`,
      endpoint: ENDPOINTS.CAMPUS_PING,
      method: 'POST',
      payload: {
        latitude: payload.latitude,
        longitude: payload.longitude,
        accuracy_meters: payload.accuracy_meters ?? payload.accuracy ?? 15,
        device_id: payload.device_id ?? payload.client_device_id ?? '',
        is_mock_location: false,
      },
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      retryCount: 0,
    });

    await AsyncStorage.setItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY, JSON.stringify(filtered));
  } catch {}
}

export async function queueOfflineAction(
  endpoint: string,
  payload: unknown,
  method: 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' = 'POST'
): Promise<void> {
  if (!isAllowedRelativeEndpoint(endpoint)) return;
  const safeEndpoint = endpoint.trim();

  try {
    let queue = await readQueueSafe();
    if (isPingEndpoint(safeEndpoint)) {
      queue = queue.filter((item) => !isPingEndpoint(item.endpoint || ''));
    }

    queue.push({
      id: `${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`,
      endpoint: safeEndpoint,
      method,
      payload,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      retryCount: 0,
    });

    await AsyncStorage.setItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY, JSON.stringify(queue));
  } catch {}
}

export async function syncOfflineQueue(): Promise<{ synced: number; remaining: number }> {
  if (isSyncing) {
    return { synced: 0, remaining: await getUnsyncedCount() };
  }

  isSyncing = true;
  let totalSynced = 0;

  try {
    // 1. Batch-sync any queued offline student QR scans
    const qrResult = await syncOfflineQrScans();
    totalSynced += qrResult.synced;

    // 2. Sync general queued actions / campus pings
    const queue = await readQueueSafe();
    if (queue.length === 0) {
      return { synced: totalSynced, remaining: qrResult.remaining };
    }

    const snapshotIds = new Set(queue.map((item) => item.id));
    const remaining: OfflineQueueItem[] = [];

    for (const item of queue) {
      if (!isAllowedRelativeEndpoint(item?.endpoint)) continue;
      if (isPingEndpoint(item.endpoint) && Date.now() - item.timestamp > MAX_HEARTBEAT_AGE_MS) {
        continue;
      }

      try {
        if (item.method === 'PUT') {
          await apiClient.put(item.endpoint, item.payload, { timeout: 7000 });
        } else if (item.method === 'PATCH') {
          await apiClient.patch(item.endpoint, item.payload, { timeout: 7000 });
        } else {
          await apiClient.post(item.endpoint, item.payload, { timeout: 7000 });
        }
        totalSynced += 1;
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const status = (err as { response?: { status?: number } })?.response?.status;
        if (status === 401) break;
        if (status === 400 || status === 403 || status === 404 || status === 409) continue;

        const nextRetry = (item.retryCount || 0) + 1;
        if (nextRetry < MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS) {
          remaining.push({ ...item, retryCount: nextRetry });
        }
      }
    }

    const latestQueue = await readQueueSafe();
    const newlyAdded = latestQueue.filter((item) => !snapshotIds.has(item.id));
    const nextQueue = [...remaining, ...newlyAdded];

    await AsyncStorage.setItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextQueue));
    return { synced: totalSynced, remaining: nextQueue.length + qrResult.remaining };
  } catch {
    return { synced: totalSynced, remaining: await getUnsyncedCount() };
  } finally {
    isSyncing = false;
  }
}

export async function clearOfflineQueue(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await AsyncStorage.multiRemove([OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY, OFFLINE_QR_SCANS_KEY]);
  } catch {}
}

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Teacher Time In/Out & Class Period Alarm Scheduler
 * File: mobile/src/services/scheduleAlarmService.ts
 *
 * Monitors school duty Time In / Time Out hours and today's assigned class periods,
 * triggering device alarm sound/vibration and an in-app popup modal with Snooze & Dismiss.

import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import type { AlarmToneKind } from './soundService';

export interface MobileAlarmEvent {
  id: string;
  kind: AlarmToneKind;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  timeLabel: string;
  detail: string;
  actionLabel: string;
  targetTab: 'scanner' | 'geofence' | 'dtr';
}

export interface MobileAlarmPeriod {
  id: number;
  subject_code: string;
  subject_name: string;
  section_name: string;
  room?: string;
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string;
  day_of_week?: string;
}

export interface MobileAlarmSnapshot {
  dutyStartTime: string;
  dutyEndTime: string;
  isTimedInToday: boolean;
  periods: MobileAlarmPeriod[];
}

const ENABLED_STORAGE_KEY = 'attendsure_mobile_alarms_enabled';
const DISMISSED_PREFIX = 'attendsure_mobile_dismissed_alarms_';

export function getLocalDateStamp(now: Date = new Date()): string {
  const y = now.getFullYear();
  const m = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const d = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}

export function parseTimeToMinutes(hhmm?: string): number | null {
  if (!hhmm) return null;
  const parts = String(hhmm).trim().split(':');
  if (parts.length < 2) return null;
  const h = Number(parts[0]);
  const m = Number(parts[1]);
  if (!Number.isFinite(h) || !Number.isFinite(m) || h < 0 || h > 23 || m < 0 || m > 59) {
    return null;
  }
  return h * 60 + m;
}

export function formatMinutes12h(totalMins: number): string {
  const h24 = Math.floor(totalMins / 60) % 24;
  const m = totalMins % 60;
  const ampm = h24 >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12 = h24 % 12 || 12;
  return `${h12}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')} ${ampm}`;
}

export function periodRunsOnJsDay(dayOfWeek: string | undefined, jsDay: number): boolean {
  const isoDay = jsDay === 0 ? 7 : jsDay;
  const clean = String(dayOfWeek || 'ALL_WEEKDAYS').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (clean === 'ALL_WEEKDAYS' || clean === 'ALL' || clean === 'MON-FRI' || clean === 'WEEKDAYS') {
    return isoDay >= 1 && isoDay <= 5;
  }
  if (clean === 'MWF') return isoDay === 1 || isoDay === 3 || isoDay === 5;
  if (clean === 'TTH') return isoDay === 2 || isoDay === 4;
  if (/^[1-7]$/.test(clean)) return Number(clean) === isoDay;
  return isoDay >= 1 && isoDay <= 5;
}

export async function getMobileAlarmsEnabled(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(ENABLED_STORAGE_KEY);
    return raw === null ? true : raw === 'true';
  } catch {
    return true;
  }
}

export async function setMobileAlarmsEnabled(enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(ENABLED_STORAGE_KEY, enabled ? 'true' : 'false');
  } catch {}
}

export async function getDismissedMobileAlarms(dateStamp: string): Promise<Set<string>> {
  try {
    const raw = await AsyncStorage.getItem(`${DISMISSED_PREFIX}${dateStamp}`);
    const list = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    return new Set(Array.isArray(list) ? list : []);
  } catch {
    return new Set();
  }
}

export async function markMobileAlarmDismissed(dateStamp: string, alarmId: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const current = await getDismissedMobileAlarms(dateStamp);
    current.add(alarmId);
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(`${DISMISSED_PREFIX}${dateStamp}`, JSON.stringify(Array.from(current)));
  } catch {}
}

export function fireOptionalLocalAlert(title: string, body: string): void {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'Notification' in window) {
    try {
      if (window.Notification.permission === 'granted') {
        new window.Notification(title, { body, silent: false });
      }
    } catch {}
  }
}

export async function evaluateDueMobileAlarm(
  snapshot: MobileAlarmSnapshot,
  now: Date = new Date()
): Promise<MobileAlarmEvent | null> {
  const dateStamp = getLocalDateStamp(now);
  const dismissed = await getDismissedMobileAlarms(dateStamp);
  const nowMins = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
  const jsDay = now.getDay();
  const isWeekday = jsDay >= 1 && jsDay <= 5;

  const startMins = parseTimeToMinutes(snapshot.dutyStartTime);
  if (isWeekday && startMins !== null && !snapshot.isTimedInToday) {
    const alarmId = `TIME_IN_${dateStamp}_${snapshot.dutyStartTime}`;
    if (!dismissed.has(alarmId) && nowMins >= startMins && nowMins <= startMins + 2) {
      return {
        id: alarmId,
        kind: 'TIME_IN',
        title: 'Time to TIME IN',
        subtitle: 'Teacher Duty Hours Starting',
        timeLabel: formatMinutes12h(startMins),
        detail: 'Your teacher duty starts now. Record your Teacher Time In inside the school campus circle.',
        actionLabel: 'Open Teacher Time In / Out',
        targetTab: 'scanner',
      };
    }
  }

  const endMins = parseTimeToMinutes(snapshot.dutyEndTime);
  if (isWeekday && endMins !== null && snapshot.isTimedInToday) {
    const alarmId = `TIME_OUT_${dateStamp}_${snapshot.dutyEndTime}`;
    if (!dismissed.has(alarmId) && nowMins >= endMins && nowMins <= endMins + 2) {
      return {
        id: alarmId,
        kind: 'TIME_OUT',
        title: 'Time to TIME OUT',
        subtitle: 'Teacher Duty Hours Ending',
        timeLabel: formatMinutes12h(endMins),
        detail: 'Your school duty ends now. Record your Teacher Time Out before leaving campus.',
        actionLabel: 'Open Teacher Time In / Out',
        targetTab: 'scanner',
      };
    }
  }

  for (const period of snapshot.periods) {
    if (!periodRunsOnJsDay(period.day_of_week, jsDay)) continue;
    const pStart = parseTimeToMinutes(period.start_time);
    if (pStart === null) continue;
    const alarmId = `PERIOD_${dateStamp}_${period.id}_${period.start_time}`;
    if (!dismissed.has(alarmId) && nowMins >= pStart && nowMins <= pStart + 2) {
      const pEnd = parseTimeToMinutes(period.end_time);
      const timeRange =
        pEnd !== null ? `${formatMinutes12h(pStart)} – ${formatMinutes12h(pEnd)}` : formatMinutes12h(pStart);
      return {
        id: alarmId,
        kind: 'CLASS_PERIOD',
        title: `Class Period Now: ${period.subject_name || period.subject_code}`,
        subtitle: period.section_name || 'Assigned Section',
        timeLabel: timeRange,
        detail: `Room: ${period.room || 'Assigned Room'} • Open Student QR Scanner to record student attendance.`,
        actionLabel: 'Open Student QR Scanner',
        targetTab: 'scanner',
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

export function buildTestMobileAlarm(kind: AlarmToneKind): MobileAlarmEvent {
  const now = new Date();
  const label = formatMinutes12h(now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes());
  if (kind === 'TIME_IN') {
    return {
      id: `TEST_TIME_IN_${Date.now()}`,
      kind: 'TIME_IN',
      title: 'Time to TIME IN',
      subtitle: 'Teacher Attendance Alarm',
      timeLabel: label,
      detail: 'School duty is starting. Record your Teacher Time In inside the school geofence circle.',
      actionLabel: 'Open Teacher Time In / Out',
      targetTab: 'scanner',
    };
  }
  if (kind === 'TIME_OUT') {
    return {
      id: `TEST_TIME_OUT_${Date.now()}`,
      kind: 'TIME_OUT',
      title: 'Time to TIME OUT',
      subtitle: 'Teacher Attendance Alarm',
      timeLabel: label,
      detail: 'School duty has ended. Record your Teacher Time Out before leaving the school boundary.',
      actionLabel: 'Open Teacher Time In / Out',
      targetTab: 'scanner',
    };
  }
  return {
    id: `TEST_PERIOD_${Date.now()}`,
    kind: 'CLASS_PERIOD',
    title: 'Class Period Starting Now',
    subtitle: 'Student Attendance Reminder',
    timeLabel: label,
    detail: 'Your scheduled class period is starting. Open the phone camera QR scanner for student attendance.',
    actionLabel: 'Open Student QR Scanner',
    targetTab: 'scanner',
  };
}

/**
 * AttendSure - Safe Tactile & Web Audio Feedback Service
 * File: mobile/src/services/soundService.ts
 *
 * Uses built-in React Native Vibration on native devices and pure Web Audio
 * tone synthesis on web with zero external CDN dependencies or missing packages.
 */

import { Vibration, Platform } from 'react-native';

type FeedbackType = 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

interface MinimalOscillator {
  type: string;
  frequency: {
    setValueAtTime: (frequency: number, startTime: number) => void;
  };
  connect: (destination: unknown) => void;
  start: (when?: number) => void;
  stop: (when?: number) => void;
}

interface MinimalGainNode {
  gain: {
    setValueAtTime: (value: number, startTime: number) => void;
    exponentialRampToValueAtTime: (value: number, endTime: number) => void;
  };
  connect: (destination: unknown) => void;
}

interface MinimalAudioContext {
  currentTime: number;
  destination: unknown;
  createOscillator: () => MinimalOscillator;
  createGain: () => MinimalGainNode;
  close?: () => Promise<void> | void;
}

type AudioContextCtor = new () => MinimalAudioContext;

const TONE_PROFILES: Record<
  FeedbackType,
  { notes: number[]; durationSec: number; wave: string }
> = {
  success: { notes: [880, 1175], durationSec: 0.09, wave: 'sine' },
  warning: { notes: [520, 440], durationSec: 0.14, wave: 'triangle' },
  error: { notes: [280, 210], durationSec: 0.16, wave: 'sawtooth' },
};

function playWebAudioTone(type: FeedbackType): void {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web') return;

  try {
    const scope = globalThis as unknown as {
      AudioContext?: AudioContextCtor;
      webkitAudioContext?: AudioContextCtor;
    };
    const Ctor = scope.AudioContext || scope.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!Ctor) return;

    const ctx = new Ctor();
    const profile = TONE_PROFILES[type];
    let offset = ctx.currentTime;

    for (const freq of profile.notes) {
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = profile.wave;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, offset);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, offset);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, offset + profile.durationSec);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);

      osc.start(offset);
      osc.stop(offset + profile.durationSec);
      offset += profile.durationSec + 0.03;
    }

    const totalMs = Math.ceil((profile.notes.length * (profile.durationSec + 0.03) + 0.1) * 1000);
    setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        ctx.close?.();
      } catch {}
    }, totalMs);
  } catch {
    // Web Audio may be blocked before user gesture; ignore safely
  }
}

function triggerFeedback(type: FeedbackType, vibratePattern: number | number[]): void {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    playWebAudioTone(type);
    return;
  }

  try {
    Vibration.vibrate(vibratePattern);
  } catch {
    // Ignore devices without vibration hardware or permission
  }
}

export const playScanSuccessSound = async (): Promise<void> => {
  triggerFeedback('success', 70);
};

export const playScanWarningSound = async (): Promise<void> => {
  triggerFeedback('warning', [0, 150, 80, 150]);
};

export const playScanErrorSound = async (): Promise<void> => {
  triggerFeedback('error', [0, 200, 100, 200]);
};

export type AlarmToneKind = 'TIME_IN' | 'TIME_OUT' | 'CLASS_PERIOD';

const ALARM_TONE_PROFILES: Record<
  AlarmToneKind,
  { notes: number[]; durationSec: number; wave: string; vibrate: number[] }
> = {
  TIME_IN: {
    notes: [587.33, 739.99, 880, 1174.66],
    durationSec: 0.16,
    wave: 'triangle',
    vibrate: [0, 450, 180, 450, 180, 650],
  },

    durationSec: 0.15,
    wave: 'triangle',
    vibrate: [0, 350, 150, 350, 150, 350, 150, 600],
  },
};

let activeAlarmTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

function playWebAlarmNotes(kind: AlarmToneKind): void {
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web') return;
  try {
    const scope = globalThis as unknown as {
      AudioContext?: AudioContextCtor;
      webkitAudioContext?: AudioContextCtor;
    };
    const Ctor = scope.AudioContext || scope.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!Ctor) return;

    const ctx = new Ctor();
    const profile = ALARM_TONE_PROFILES[kind] || ALARM_TONE_PROFILES.CLASS_PERIOD;
    let offset = ctx.currentTime + 0.02;

    for (const freq of profile.notes) {
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = profile.wave;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, offset);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.22, offset);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, offset + profile.durationSec);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);

      osc.start(offset);
      osc.stop(offset + profile.durationSec);
      offset += profile.durationSec + 0.05;
    }

    const totalMs = Math.ceil((profile.notes.length * (profile.durationSec + 0.05) + 0.15) * 1000);
    setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        ctx.close?.();
      } catch {}
    }, totalMs);
  } catch {}
}

export const playScheduleAlarmOnce = (kind: AlarmToneKind): void => {
  const profile = ALARM_TONE_PROFILES[kind] || ALARM_TONE_PROFILES.CLASS_PERIOD;
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    playWebAlarmNotes(kind);
    return;
  }
  try {
    Vibration.vibrate(profile.vibrate, false);
  } catch {}
};

export const startScheduleAlarmLoop = (kind: AlarmToneKind): void => {
  stopScheduleAlarmLoop();
  const profile = ALARM_TONE_PROFILES[kind] || ALARM_TONE_PROFILES.CLASS_PERIOD;
  if (Platform.OS === 'web') {
    playWebAlarmNotes(kind);
    activeAlarmTimer = setInterval(() => {
      playWebAlarmNotes(kind);
    }, 3400);
    return;
  }
  try {
    Vibration.vibrate(profile.vibrate, true);
  } catch {}
};

export const stopScheduleAlarmLoop = (): void => {
  if (activeAlarmTimer) {
    clearInterval(activeAlarmTimer);
    activeAlarmTimer = null;
  }
  if (Platform.OS !== 'web') {
    try {
      Vibration.cancel();
    } catch {}
  }
};

export const getRealDeviceModel = (): string | null => {

export const getRealBatteryPercentage = async (): Promise<number | null> => {

    if (!Battery || typeof Battery.getBatteryLevelAsync !== 'function') {
      return null;
    }
    const level = await Battery.getBatteryLevelAsync();
    if (typeof level === 'number' && level >= 0 && !Number.isNaN(level)) {
      return Math.round(level * 100);
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;

export const evaluateRealSignal = (
  accuracyMeters: number | null | undefined
): { label: string | null; percentage: number | null } => {
  if (
    accuracyMeters === null ||
    accuracyMeters === undefined ||
    accuracyMeters < 0 ||
    Number.isNaN(accuracyMeters)
  ) {
    return { label: null, percentage: null };
  }
  if (accuracyMeters <= 15) return { label: 'Strong', percentage: 95 };
  if (accuracyMeters <= 30) return { label: 'Good', percentage: 75 };
  if (accuracyMeters <= 60) return { label: 'Fair', percentage: 50 };
  return { label: 'Weak', percentage: 25 };
};

export const format12HourTime = (date: Date = new Date()): string => {
  let hours = date.getHours();
  const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  const seconds = String(date.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
  const ampm = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  hours = hours % 12 || 12;
  const strHours = String(hours).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${strHours}:${minutes}:${seconds} ${ampm}`;
};

export const sendLiveHeartbeat = async (
  coordsOrOptions?: CoordinatesPayload,
  force = false
): Promise<HeartbeatResponse> => {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (!force && now - lastSentTimestamp < ADAPTIVE_PING_INTERVAL_MS && lastSentTimestamp !== 0) {
    return { zone_status: 'THROTTLED' };
  }

  let lat: number | undefined;
  let lng: number | undefined;
  let acc: number | null = null;
  let isMock = false;

  if (coordsOrOptions && typeof coordsOrOptions === 'object') {
    lat = coordsOrOptions.latitude;
    lng = coordsOrOptions.longitude;
    acc = coordsOrOptions.accuracy ?? null;
    isMock = Boolean(coordsOrOptions.mocked);
  }

  if (lat === undefined || lng === undefined) {
    const { status } = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync();
    if (status !== 'granted') {
      throw new Error('Location permission is required to check campus boundaries.');
    }
    let loc: Location.LocationObject | null = null;
    try {
      loc = await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({ accuracy: Location.Accuracy.High });
    } catch {
      loc = await Location.getLastKnownPositionAsync({
        maxAge: 120000,
        requiredAccuracy: 250,
      }).catch(() => null);
    }
    if (!loc || !loc.coords) {
      throw new Error('Waiting for GPS satellite fix. Move near a window or open area.');
    }
    lat = loc.coords.latitude;
    lng = loc.coords.longitude;
    acc = loc.coords.accuracy ?? null;
    isMock = Boolean(loc.mocked);
  }

  // Strictly reject mocked / fake GPS locations before hitting the API
  if (isMock) {
    throw new Error(
      'Fake GPS or mock location detected. Turn off mock location apps before pinging campus.'
    );
  }

  if (
    !Number.isFinite(lat) ||
    !Number.isFinite(lng) ||
    lat < -90 ||
    lat > 90 ||
    lng < -180 ||
    lng > 180
  ) {
    throw new Error('Unable to read valid campus GPS coordinates.');
  }

  if (acc !== null && acc > 250) {
    throw new Error(
      `GPS signal is too weak (${Math.round(acc)}m accuracy). Move to an open area and try again.`
    );
  }

  const hardwareUuid = await getHardwareDeviceUuid();
  const deviceModel = getRealDeviceModel();

  const pingPayload = {
    latitude: Number(lat.toFixed(6)),
    longitude: Number(lng.toFixed(6)),
    accuracy_meters: acc !== null ? Number(acc.toFixed(1)) : 15,
    device_id: hardwareUuid,
    is_mock_location: false,
  };

  try {
    const res = await apiClient.post<CampusPingResponse>(ENDPOINTS.CAMPUS_PING, pingPayload, {
      timeout: 8000,
    });
    lastSentTimestamp = now;
    void syncOfflineQueue().catch(() => {});
    return {
      ...res.data,
      isQueuedOffline: false,
    };
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const httpStatus = (err as { response?: { status?: number } })?.response?.status;

    if (httpStatus === 401) {
      throw new Error(
        getFriendlyErrorMessage(err, 'Your session expired. Please sign in again.')
      );
    }

    if (httpStatus === 400 || httpStatus === 403) {
      throw new Error(
        getFriendlyErrorMessage(
          err,
          'Phone binding mismatch or GPS verification blocked by school server.'
        )
      );
    }

    const offlinePayload: QueuedCampusPingPayload = {
      device_id: hardwareUuid,
      latitude: pingPayload.latitude,
      longitude: pingPayload.longitude,
      accuracy_meters: pingPayload.accuracy_meters,
      is_mock_location: false,
      device_model: deviceModel,
    };
    await enqueueOfflineHeartbeat(offlinePayload);
    return { isQueuedOffline: true };
  }
};

function loadNativeExpoCrypto() {
  try {
    const core = require('expo-modules-core');
    if (core && typeof core.requireOptionalNativeModule === 'function') {
      return core.requireOptionalNativeModule('ExpoCrypto') || null;
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall back cleanly to pure-JS implementation
  }
  return null;
}

const BASE64_CHARS = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';

function utf8ToBytes(input) {
  const str = String(input ?? '');
  if (typeof TextEncoder !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      return new TextEncoder().encode(str);
    } catch {
      // Fall through to manual UTF-8 encoding
    }
  }
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i += 1) {
    let code = str.charCodeAt(i);
    if (code < 0x80) {
      out.push(code);
    } else if (code < 0x800) {
      out.push(0xc0 | (code >> 6), 0x80 | (code & 0x3f));
    } else if (code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdbff && i + 1 < str.length) {
      const next = str.charCodeAt(i + 1);
      if (next >= 0xdc00 && next <= 0xdfff) {
        const cp = ((code - 0xd800) << 10) + (next - 0xdc00) + 0x10000;
        out.push(
          0xf0 | (cp >> 18),
          0x80 | ((cp >> 12) & 0x3f),
          0x80 | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3f),
          0x80 | (cp & 0x3f)
        );
        i += 1;
        continue;
      }
      out.push(0xe0 | (code >> 12), 0x80 | ((code >> 6) & 0x3f), 0x80 | (code & 0x3f));
    } else {
      out.push(0xe0 | (code >> 12), 0x80 | ((code >> 6) & 0x3f), 0x80 | (code & 0x3f));
    }
  }
  return new Uint8Array(out);
}

function sha256Bytes(messageBytes) {
  const bytes = messageBytes instanceof Uint8Array ? messageBytes : new Uint8Array(messageBytes || []);
  const msgLen = bytes.length;
  const totalBlocks = Math.ceil((msgLen + 9) / 64);
  const padded = new Uint8Array(totalBlocks * 64);
  padded.set(bytes, 0);
  padded[msgLen] = 0x80;

  const bitLenHi = Math.floor(msgLen / 0x20000000);
  const bitLenLo = (msgLen << 3) >>> 0;
  const view = new DataView(padded.buffer);
  view.setUint32(padded.length - 8, bitLenHi, false);
  view.setUint32(padded.length - 4, bitLenLo, false);

  let h0 = 0x6a09e667;
  let h1 = 0xbb67ae85;
  let h2 = 0x3c6ef372;
  let h3 = 0xa54ff53a;
  let h4 = 0x510e527f;
  let h5 = 0x9b05688c;
  let h6 = 0x1f83d9ab;
  let h7 = 0x5be0cd19;

  const w = new Uint32Array(64);

  for (let offset = 0; offset < padded.length; offset += 64) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i += 1) {
      w[i] = view.getUint32(offset + i * 4, false);
    }
    for (let i = 16; i < 64; i += 1) {
      const w15 = w[i - 15];
      const w2 = w[i - 2];
      const s0 = ((w15 >>> 7) | (w15 << 25)) ^ ((w15 >>> 18) | (w15 << 14)) ^ (w15 >>> 3);
      const s1 = ((w2 >>> 17) | (w2 << 15)) ^ ((w2 >>> 19) | (w2 << 13)) ^ (w2 >>> 10);
      w[i] = (w[i - 16] + s0 + w[i - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
    }

    let a = h0;
    let b = h1;
    let c = h2;
    let d = h3;
    let e = h4;
    let f = h5;
    let g = h6;
    let h = h7;

    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i += 1) {
      const S1 = ((e >>> 6) | (e << 26)) ^ ((e >>> 11) | (e << 21)) ^ ((e >>> 25) | (e << 7));
      const ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
      const temp1 = (h + S1 + ch + SHA256_K[i] + w[i]) >>> 0;
      const S0 = ((a >>> 2) | (a << 30)) ^ ((a >>> 13) | (a << 19)) ^ ((a >>> 22) | (a << 10));
      const maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
      const temp2 = (S0 + maj) >>> 0;

      h = g;
      g = f;
      f = e;
      e = (d + temp1) >>> 0;
      d = c;
      c = b;
      b = a;
      a = (temp1 + temp2) >>> 0;
    }

    h0 = (h0 + a) >>> 0;
    h1 = (h1 + b) >>> 0;
    h2 = (h2 + c) >>> 0;
    h3 = (h3 + d) >>> 0;
    h4 = (h4 + e) >>> 0;
    h5 = (h5 + f) >>> 0;
    h6 = (h6 + g) >>> 0;
    h7 = (h7 + h) >>> 0;
  }

  const out = new Uint8Array(32);
  const outView = new DataView(out.buffer);
  outView.setUint32(0, h0, false);
  outView.setUint32(4, h1, false);
  outView.setUint32(8, h2, false);
  outView.setUint32(12, h3, false);
  outView.setUint32(16, h4, false);
  outView.setUint32(20, h5, false);
  outView.setUint32(24, h6, false);
  outView.setUint32(28, h7, false);
  return out;
}

function bytesToHex(bytes) {
  let hex = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 1) {
    hex += bytes[i].toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
  }
  return hex;
}

function bytesToBase64(bytes) {
  let result = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 3) {
    const b0 = bytes[i];
    const hasB1 = i + 1 < bytes.length;
    const hasB2 = i + 2 < bytes.length;
    const b1 = hasB1 ? bytes[i + 1] : 0;
    const b2 = hasB2 ? bytes[i + 2] : 0;

    const triplet = (b0 << 16) | (b1 << 8) | b2;
    result += BASE64_CHARS[(triplet >> 18) & 0x3f];
    result += BASE64_CHARS[(triplet >> 12) & 0x3f];
    result += hasB1 ? BASE64_CHARS[(triplet >> 6) & 0x3f] : '=';
    result += hasB2 ? BASE64_CHARS[triplet & 0x3f] : '=';
  }
  return result;
}

function decodeBase64ToBytes(b64) {
  const clean = String(b64 || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9+/=]/g, '');
  const bytes = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < clean.length; i += 4) {
    const c0 = BASE64_CHARS.indexOf(clean[i]);
    const c1 = BASE64_CHARS.indexOf(clean[i + 1]);
    const c2 = clean[i + 2] === '=' ? -1 : BASE64_CHARS.indexOf(clean[i + 2]);
    const c3 = clean[i + 3] === '=' ? -1 : BASE64_CHARS.indexOf(clean[i + 3]);
    if (c0 < 0 || c1 < 0) break;
    bytes.push((c0 << 2) | (c1 >> 4));
    if (c2 >= 0) bytes.push(((c1 & 0x0f) << 4) | (c2 >> 2));
    if (c3 >= 0) bytes.push(((c2 & 0x03) << 6) | c3);
  }
  return new Uint8Array(bytes);
}

let prngState = (Date.now() ^ Math.floor(Math.random() * 0xffffffff)) >>> 0;

function nextFallbackByte() {
  prngState = (prngState + 0x9e3779b9) >>> 0;
  let z = prngState ^ Math.floor(Math.random() * 0xffffffff);
  z = Math.imul(z ^ (z >>> 16), 0x85ebca6b) >>> 0;
  z = Math.imul(z ^ (z >>> 13), 0xc2b2ae35) >>> 0;
  return (z ^ (z >>> 16)) & 0xff;
}

export function getRandomValues(typedArray) {
  if (!typedArray || typeof typedArray.byteLength !== 'number') {
    throw new TypeError('Expected a TypedArray argument for getRandomValues.');
  }

  if (nativeExpoCrypto && typeof nativeExpoCrypto.getRandomValues === 'function') {
    try {
      nativeExpoCrypto.getRandomValues(typedArray);
      return typedArray;
    } catch {
      // Fall through to WebCrypto / JS fallback
    }
  }

  if (
    typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' &&
    globalThis.crypto &&
    typeof globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues === 'function'
  ) {
    try {
      return globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(typedArray);
    } catch {
      // Fall through to JS fallback
    }
  }

  const byteView = new Uint8Array(typedArray.buffer, typedArray.byteOffset, typedArray.byteLength);
  for (let i = 0; i < byteView.length; i += 1) {
    byteView[i] = nextFallbackByte();
  }
  return typedArray;
}

export function getRandomBytes(byteCount) {
  const size = Math.max(0, Math.min(65536, Math.floor(Number(byteCount) || 0)));
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
  if (size === 0) return bytes;
  return getRandomValues(bytes);
}

export async function getRandomBytesAsync(byteCount) {
  const size = Math.max(0, Math.min(65536, Math.floor(Number(byteCount) || 0)));
  if (size === 0) return new Uint8Array(0);

  if (nativeExpoCrypto && typeof nativeExpoCrypto.getRandomBytesAsync === 'function') {
    try {
      const nativeResult = await nativeExpoCrypto.getRandomBytesAsync(size);
      if (nativeResult instanceof Uint8Array) return nativeResult;
      if (Array.isArray(nativeResult)) return new Uint8Array(nativeResult);
      if (typeof nativeResult === 'string') return decodeBase64ToBytes(nativeResult).slice(0, size);
    } catch {
      // Fall back to getRandomBytes
    }
  }
  return getRandomBytes(size);
}

export function randomUUID() {
  if (nativeExpoCrypto && typeof nativeExpoCrypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
    try {
      const nativeUuid = nativeExpoCrypto.randomUUID();
      if (typeof nativeUuid === 'string' && nativeUuid.length >= 32) {
        return nativeUuid;
      }
    } catch {
      // Fall through
    }
  }

  if (
    typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' &&
    globalThis.crypto &&
    typeof globalThis.crypto.randomUUID === 'function'
  ) {
    try {
      return globalThis.crypto.randomUUID();
    } catch {
      // Fall through
    }
  }

  const bytes = getRandomBytes(16);
  bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40; // RFC 4122 version 4
  bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80; // RFC 4122 variant 10
  const hex = bytesToHex(bytes);
  return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20, 32)}`;
}

export async function digest(algorithm, data) {
  const inputBytes =
    data instanceof Uint8Array
      ? data
      : ArrayBuffer.isView(data)
        ? new Uint8Array(data.buffer, data.byteOffset, data.byteLength)
        : data instanceof ArrayBuffer
          ? new Uint8Array(data)
          : utf8ToBytes(data);

  if (nativeExpoCrypto && typeof nativeExpoCrypto.digest === 'function') {
    try {
      return await nativeExpoCrypto.digest(algorithm, inputBytes);
    } catch {
      // Fall back to pure-JS SHA-256
    }
  }
  return sha256Bytes(inputBytes).buffer;
}

export async function digestStringAsync(algorithm, data, options = {}) {
  const encoding = options?.encoding || CryptoEncoding.HEX;
  const text = String(data ?? '');

  if (nativeExpoCrypto && typeof nativeExpoCrypto.digestStringAsync === 'function') {
    try {
      return await nativeExpoCrypto.digestStringAsync(algorithm, text, { encoding });
    } catch {
      // Fall back to pure-JS SHA-256
    }
  }

  const digestBytes = sha256Bytes(utf8ToBytes(text));
  if (encoding === CryptoEncoding.BASE64) {
    return bytesToBase64(digestBytes);
  }
  return bytesToHex(digestBytes);
}

export default {
  CryptoDigestAlgorithm,
  CryptoEncoding,
  getRandomValues,
  getRandomBytes,
  getRandomBytesAsync,
  randomUUID,
  digest,
  digestStringAsync,
};

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Safe Native HMR Utils Shim for Expo Go / React Native 0.88
 * Prevents "Cannot read property 'hide' of undefined" when DevLoadingView is absent
 * from react-native/unstable-internals-do-not-use.
 * File: mobile/src/shims/hmrUtils.native.js
 */

import { DevSettings, LogBox, NativeModules } from 'react-native';

const ANSI_ESCAPE_REGEX = /\u001b\[[0-9;]*m/g;

function getUnstableInternals() {
  try {
    return require('react-native/unstable-internals-do-not-use') || {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

class HMRMetroBuildError extends Error {
  constructor(message = 'Unknown Metro Error', type, cause) {
    super(String(message || 'Unknown Metro Error').replace(ANSI_ESCAPE_REGEX, ''));
    this.name = type || 'BuildError';
    this.cause = cause;
    this.originalMessage = [type, message].filter(Boolean).join(': ');
    this.stack = '';
  }
}

export function showLoading(message, type) {
  try {
    const { DevLoadingView } = getUnstableInternals();
    if (DevLoadingView && typeof DevLoadingView.showMessage === 'function') {
      DevLoadingView.showMessage(message, type);
    }
  } catch {
    // Safely ignore when DevLoadingView is unavailable in Expo Go on RN 0.88
  }
}

export function hideLoading() {
  try {
    const { DevLoadingView } = getUnstableInternals();
    if (DevLoadingView && typeof DevLoadingView.hide === 'function') {
      DevLoadingView.hide();
    }
  } catch {
    // Safely ignore when DevLoadingView is unavailable in Expo Go on RN 0.88
  }
}

function dismissRedbox() {
  try {
    const { NativeRedBox, NativeExceptionsManager } = getUnstableInternals();
    if (process.env.EXPO_OS === 'ios' && NativeRedBox && typeof NativeRedBox.dismiss === 'function') {
      NativeRedBox.dismiss();
      return;
    }
    if (NativeExceptionsManager && typeof NativeExceptionsManager.dismissRedbox === 'function') {
      NativeExceptionsManager.dismissRedbox();
    }
  } catch {
    // Safely ignore if native redbox bridge is unavailable
  }
}

export function resetErrorOverlay() {
  dismissRedbox();
  try {
    if (LogBox && typeof LogBox.clearAllLogs === 'function') {
      LogBox.clearAllLogs();
    }
  } catch {
    // Safely ignore
  }
}

export function reload() {
  try {
    if (DevSettings && typeof DevSettings.reload === 'function') {
      DevSettings.reload('Bundle Splitting - Metro disconnected');
    }
  } catch {
    // Safely ignore
  }
}

export function getFullBundlerUrl({ serverScheme, serverHost, bundleEntry, platform }) {
  try {
    const scriptUrl = NativeModules?.SourceCode?.scriptURL;
    if (typeof scriptUrl === 'string' && scriptUrl.startsWith('http')) {
      return scriptUrl;
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall back to reconstructed bundler URL
  }
  return `${serverScheme}://${serverHost}/hot?bundleEntry=${bundleEntry}&platform=${platform}`;
}

export function getConnectionError(serverHost, e) {
  let error = `Cannot connect to Expo CLI.

Try the following to fix the issue:
- Ensure that Expo dev server is running and available on the same network`;
  if (process.env.EXPO_OS === 'android') {
    error += `
- Ensure that your device/emulator is connected to your machine and has USB debugging enabled - run 'adb devices' to see a list of connected devices
- If you're on a physical device connected to the same machine, run 'adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081' to forward requests from your device`;
  }
  error += `

URL: ${serverHost}

Error: ${e?.message || String(e || 'Connection failed')}`;
  return error;
}

export function handleCompileError(cause) {
  if (cause === null || cause === undefined) {
    return;
  }
  dismissRedbox();
  try {
    if (LogBox && typeof LogBox.addException === 'function') {
      LogBox.addException(new HMRMetroBuildError(cause.message, cause.type, cause.cause));
    }
  } catch {
    // Safely ignore
  }
}

/**
 * Safely parses Django ISO, UTC, or SQLite date strings into human-readable 12-hour time.
 */
export function formatScanTime(rawDate?: string | null): string {
  if (!rawDate) return '--:--';

  try {
    // Replace space with 'T' to standardize SQLite timestamps: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss' -> ISO
    const standardized = rawDate.includes('T') ? rawDate : rawDate.replace(' ', 'T');
    const parsed = new Date(standardized);

    if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
      return parsed.toLocaleTimeString([], {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: true,
      });
    }

    // Fallback regex if phone runtime timezone fails to parse
    const timeMatch = rawDate.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
    if (timeMatch) {
      const hours = parseInt(timeMatch[1], 10);
      const minutes = timeMatch[2];
      const ampm = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
      const formattedHours = hours % 12 || 12;
      return `${formattedHours}:${minutes} ${ampm}`;
    }
  } catch {
    // Return empty fallback instead of crash
  }

  return '--:--';
}

/**
 * Formats distance with appropriate units (meters vs kilometers).
 */
export function formatDistance(meters: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (meters === null || meters === undefined || isNaN(meters)) return 'Determining distance...';
  if (meters < 1000) {
    return `${Math.round(meters)} m`;
  }
  return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(2)} km`;
}

/**

import { Alert, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { isSafeUrl } from '../constants/theme';

export const isCanceledError = (err: unknown): boolean => {
  const e = err as { code?: string; name?: string };
  return e?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED' || e?.name === 'CanceledError' || e?.name === 'AbortError';
};

export const showNotice = (title: string, message: string): void => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.alert(`${title}: ${message}`);
  } else {
    Alert.alert(title, message);
  }
};

export const confirmAction = (
  title: string,
  message: string,
  confirmLabel: string,
  onConfirm: () => void,
  isDestructive = true
): void => {
  if (Platform.OS === 'web' && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    if (window.confirm(`${title}\n\n${message}`)) {
      onConfirm();
    }
    return;
  }
  Alert.alert(title, message, [
    { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
    {
      text: confirmLabel,
      style: isDestructive ? 'destructive' : 'default',
      onPress: onConfirm,
    },
  ]);
};

export const resolveMediaUrl = (
  raw: string | null | undefined,
  serverBase: string
): string | null => {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'string') return null;
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;
  const candidate =
    trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://') || trimmed.startsWith('data:')
      ? trimmed
      : serverBase
        ? `${serverBase.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/${trimmed.replace(/^\/+/, '')}`
        : '';
  return isSafeUrl(candidate) ? candidate : null;
};

export const calculateDistanceMeters = (
  lat1: number,
  lon1: number,
  lat2: number,
  lon2: number
): number => {
  const R = 6371000.0;
  const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180.0;
  const dLon = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180.0;
  const radLat1 = (lat1 * Math.PI) / 180.0;
  const radLat2 = (lat2 * Math.PI) / 180.0;
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
    Math.sin(dLon / 2) * Math.sin(dLon / 2) * Math.cos(radLat1) * Math.cos(radLat2);
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  return Math.round(R * c);
};

export const formatDistanceMeters = (meters: number): string => {
  if (meters >= 1000) {
    return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(2)} km`;
  }
  return `${Math.round(meters)} m`;
};

export const getInitials = (name: string | null | undefined, fallback = 'S'): string => {
  const clean = String(name || '')
    .replace(/,/g, ' ')
    .trim();
  if (!clean) return fallback;
  const parts = clean.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length >= 2) {
    return `${parts[0][0]}${parts[parts.length - 1][0]}`.toUpperCase();
  }
  return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
};

/**
 * AttendSure Mobile - Centralized Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Permission Matrix
 * File: mobile/src/utils/permissions.ts
 *
 * Mirrors web/src/utils/permissions.ts for the exact 5-profile visibility matrix:
 *  - ADMIN (System Administrator)
 *  - PRINCIPAL (School Principal)
 *  - DEPT_HEAD (Department Head)
 *  - TEACHER (can_handle_classes = true  / Teaching Staff & Homeroom Adviser)
 *  - TEACHER (can_handle_classes = false / Non-Teaching School Staff)
 */

export type StaffRole = 'ADMIN' | 'PRINCIPAL' | 'DEPT_HEAD' | 'TEACHER';

export type MobileTabId =
  | 'home'
  | 'scanner'
  | 'geofence'
  | 'gate_pass'
  | 'menu'
  | 'class_list'
  | 'students'
  | 'teachers'
  | 'schedules'
  | 'users'
  | 'reports'
  | 'calendar'
  | 'settings'
  | 'sardo_safety'
  | 'dtr';

export interface PermissionUser {
  role?: string | null;
  system_role?: string | null;
  can_handle_classes?: boolean | null;
  can_teach?: boolean | null;
  teacher_id?: number | string | null;
  is_superuser?: boolean | null;
}

const VALID_ROLES: ReadonlySet<StaffRole> = new Set([
  'ADMIN',
  'PRINCIPAL',
  'DEPT_HEAD',
  'TEACHER',
]);

export function normalizeRole(user?: PermissionUser | null): StaffRole {
  if (user?.is_superuser) return 'ADMIN';
  const raw = String(user?.role || user?.system_role || '')
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase() as StaffRole;
  return VALID_ROLES.has(raw) ? raw : 'TEACHER';
}

export function isTeachingStaff(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  const role = normalizeRole(user);
  if (role === 'ADMIN' || role === 'PRINCIPAL' || role === 'DEPT_HEAD') {
    return true;
  }
  if (user?.can_handle_classes !== undefined && user?.can_handle_classes !== null) {
    return Boolean(user.can_handle_classes);
  }
  if (user?.can_teach !== undefined && user?.can_teach !== null) {
    return Boolean(user.can_teach);
  }
  return true;
}

export function isSystemAdmin(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return normalizeRole(user) === 'ADMIN';
}

export function isAdminOrPrincipal(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  const role = normalizeRole(user);
  return role === 'ADMIN' || role === 'PRINCIPAL';
}

export function isSchoolLeader(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  const role = normalizeRole(user);
  return role === 'ADMIN' || role === 'PRINCIPAL' || role === 'DEPT_HEAD';
}

/** Student QR Camera Scan Mode: Leaders + Teaching Teachers (hidden for non-teaching staff) */
export function canScanStudentQr(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isSchoolLeader(user) || isTeachingStaff(user);
}

/** Student Exit Pass Issuance: Leaders + Teaching Teachers (hidden for non-teaching staff) */
export function canIssueStudentExitPass(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isSchoolLeader(user) || isTeachingStaff(user);
}

/** Approve / Cancel Teacher Official Locator Slips: ADMIN, PRINCIPAL, DEPT_HEAD */
export function canApproveOrCancelLocatorSlip(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isSchoolLeader(user);
}

/** View Students: Leaders + Teaching Teachers (hidden for non-teaching staff) */
export function canViewClassList(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isSchoolLeader(user) || isTeachingStaff(user);
}

/** View DepEd School Forms (SF1 / SF2): Leaders + Teaching Teachers (hidden for non-teaching staff) */
export function canViewReports(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isSchoolLeader(user) || isTeachingStaff(user);
}

/** View DepEd SF4 Monthly School Summary: ADMIN, PRINCIPAL, DEPT_HEAD */
export function canViewSf4(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isSchoolLeader(user);
}

/** Edit Campus Boundary / Radius Controls: ADMIN & PRINCIPAL */
export function canEditGeofence(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isAdminOrPrincipal(user);
}

/** Resolve / Confirm / Excuse Loafing Incidents: ADMIN, PRINCIPAL, DEPT_HEAD */
export function canResolveLoafing(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isSchoolLeader(user);
}

/** Academic Setup CRUD: ADMIN only */
export function canManageSchoolSetup(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isSystemAdmin(user);
}

/** Academic Setup View (ADMIN = CRUD, PRINCIPAL = view-only) */
export function canViewAcademicSetup(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isAdminOrPrincipal(user);
}

/** Reset 1-to-1 Bound Phone: ADMIN & PRINCIPAL */
export function canResetBoundDevice(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isAdminOrPrincipal(user);
}

/** Teachers Directory CRUD: ADMIN only */
export function canManageTeachers(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isSystemAdmin(user);
}

/** Staff User Accounts CRUD: ADMIN only */
export function canManageUsers(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isSystemAdmin(user);
}

/** View System Audit Logs: ADMIN & PRINCIPAL */
export function canViewAuditLogs(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isAdminOrPrincipal(user);
}

/** View school/department teacher directory & DTR switcher: ADMIN, PRINCIPAL, DEPT_HEAD */
export function canViewTeacherDirectory(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isSchoolLeader(user);
}

/** Add or Edit Student / Enrollment (ADMIN & PRINCIPAL = all sections; Homeroom Adviser = own sections) */
export function canManageStudents(
  user?: PermissionUser | null,
  advisedSectionIds?: ReadonlyArray<number> | null,
  targetSectionId?: number | null
): boolean {
  if (isAdminOrPrincipal(user)) return true;
  const role = normalizeRole(user);
  if (role !== 'TEACHER' || !isTeachingStaff(user)) return false;
  if (!advisedSectionIds || advisedSectionIds.length === 0) return false;
  if (targetSectionId !== undefined && targetSectionId !== null) {
    return advisedSectionIds.includes(Number(targetSectionId));
  }
  return true;
}

/** Delete Students: ADMIN & PRINCIPAL */
export function canDeleteStudents(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return isAdminOrPrincipal(user);
}

/** Mobile Tab Visibility Guard */
export function canViewTab(user: PermissionUser | null | undefined, tab: MobileTabId): boolean {
  if (tab === 'class_list' || tab === 'students' || tab === 'sardo_safety') return canViewClassList(user);
  if (tab === 'teachers') return canViewTeacherDirectory(user);
  if (tab === 'schedules') return canViewAcademicSetup(user);
  if (tab === 'users') return canManageUsers(user);
  if (tab === 'reports') return canViewReports(user);
  return true;
}

# AttendSure Mobile — Developer & Architecture Guide

This folder contains the **AttendSure Mobile** companion app for school staff (System Admin, School Principal, Department Head, Teaching Teachers / Advisers, and Non-Teaching School Staff).

It is built with **Expo SDK 58**, **React Native 0.88**, **React 19.3**, **TypeScript**, and **React Navigation (`@react-navigation/native` + `@react-navigation/native-stack`)**.

> **Important:** This app does **not** use Expo Router (`src/app/`). All navigation lives in `App.tsx`, `src/navigation/AppNavigator.tsx`, and `src/navigation/MainTabNavigator.tsx`.

---

## 1. Commands

Run commands inside `mobile/`:

```bash
npm install                   # Install dependencies
npx expo install <package>    # Add or update Expo-compatible native packages
npx expo start                # Start Expo dev server
npx expo start --android      # Launch on Android device / emulator
npx expo start --ios          # Launch on iOS simulator
npx tsc --noEmit              # Run TypeScript type checks
```

Always check `package.json` for exact package versions before adding or updating native modules, and run `npx tsc --noEmit` plus `python ../scripts/audit_codebase.py` before finishing changes.

---

## 2. Navigation Architecture

### Root Stack (`App.tsx` -> `src/navigation/AppNavigator.tsx`)
- `App.tsx` wraps the app in `SafeAreaProvider` -> `ThemeProvider` -> `AuthProvider` -> `NavigationContainer` with a branded `SplashScreen` overlay.
- `AppNavigator.tsx` uses `createNativeStackNavigator<RootStackParamList>()`:
  - Signed out: `Login` (`LoginScreen`)
  - Signed in:
    - `Main` (`MainTabNavigator`)
    - `ProfileSettings` (`ProfileSettingsScreen`)
    - `Reports` (`ReportsScreen`)

### 5-Tab Bottom Navigation Dock (`src/navigation/MainTabNavigator.tsx`)
`MainTabNavigator.tsx` renders a floating 5-tab dock adapted to the signed-in staff member's permissions (`canScanStudentQr(user)` and `canViewTab(user, tab)`):

1. **`Overview`** (`home` -> `DashboardScreen`): Daily attendance summary, quick shortcuts, and live status.
2. **`Scanner`** / **`Check-In`** (`scanner` -> `ScannerScreen`):
   - Label shows **`Scanner`** for school leaders and teaching teachers (`can_handle_classes=True`), offering dual-mode Student QR back-camera scanning (`expo-camera`) and Teacher Phone Lock + Campus GPS Check-In.
   - Label shows **`Check-In`** for non-teaching staff (`can_handle_classes=False`), showing Teacher Phone Lock + Campus GPS Check-In only (student QR mode is hidden).
3. **`Geofence`** (`geofence` -> `GeofenceStatusScreen`): Live campus GPS boundary distance, signal strength, duty pings, and outside-campus alert status.
4. **`Passes`** (`gate_pass` -> `GatePassScreen`): Student Exit Passes (hidden for non-teaching staff) and Teacher Official Locator Slips.
5. **`Account`** (`menu` -> `MenuScreen`): Account menu and sub-views rendered inside `MainTabNavigator`:
   - `class_list` -> `AdvisoryMatrixScreen` (hidden for non-teaching staff)
   - `reports` -> `ReportsScreen` (DepEd SF1, SF2, SF4; SF4 restricted to school leaders, hidden for non-teaching staff)
   - `calendar` -> `CalendarScreen` (school holidays, suspensions, and schedules)
   - `dtr` -> `DTRReportView` (CSC Form 48 Daily Time Record with monthly submission)
   - `settings` -> `SettingsScreen` (profile, password, server URL, and theme mode)

---

## 3. Role-Based Access Control (`src/utils/permissions.ts`)

`mobile/src/utils/permissions.ts` mirrors `web/src/utils/permissions.ts` and `backend/common/permissions.py` across all **5 staff profiles**:
- `ADMIN`
- `PRINCIPAL`
- `DEPT_HEAD`
- `TEACHER` with `can_handle_classes=true` (teaching teacher / homeroom adviser)
- `TEACHER` with `can_handle_classes=false` (non-teaching school staff)

Never hardcode inline role string checks inside screens; always call the exported helpers (`canScanStudentQr`, `canIssueStudentExitPass`, `canApproveOrCancelLocatorSlip`, `canViewClassList`, `canViewReports`, `canViewSf4`, `canEditGeofence`, `canResolveLoafing`, `canResetBoundDevice`, `canViewTab`). Gate 3 of `scripts/audit_codebase.py` validates this file automatically.

---

## 4. Centralized Theme Tokens & UI Rules

- **Single Source of Truth:** `mobile/src/theme/tokens.ts` defines `PALETTES` (`light`, `dark`, `high-contrast`), `FONTS`, `SPACING`, `RADIUS`, `QR_COLORS`, and `SCANNER_OVERLAY_COLORS`.
- **Re-Export & Shared Styles:** `mobile/src/constants/theme.ts` re-exports all tokens from `../theme/tokens` and provides `createUiStyles(palette)`, `isSafeUrl()`, `cleanText()`, and `getFriendlyErrorMessage()`.
- **Strict Audit Gate 5 Rule:** **Never write hardcoded hex colors (`#xxxxxx`) inside `mobile/src/screens/*.tsx`.** Always read colors from `useThemeMode().palette` or exported tokens from `../constants/theme`.
- **Plain-English Vocabulary Rule:** Always use **teacher** (or **adviser**) and **class list** in UI copy, comments, and identifiers. Never introduce banned vocabulary or foreign acronyms.

---

## 5. Built-In Camera, On-Device Verification & Campus GPS Services

| Service File | What It Does |
|---|---|
| `src/services/biometricService.ts` | Uses `expo-local-authentication` (`getEnrolledLevelAsync`, `authenticateAsync` with `disableDeviceFallback: false`) so teachers verify identity via phone **Face Unlock, Fingerprint, or PIN/Pattern**. Generates a per-user secret inside `expo-secure-store` and computes a SHA-256 `keyId` and non-replayable `proofHash` via `expo-crypto`. Zero raw face photos or biometric data ever leave the phone. |
| `src/services/deviceService.ts` | Creates and caches a 1-to-1 hardware-backed phone UUID (`attendsure_hardware_device_uuid`) in `expo-secure-store` (with Android ID / iOS Vendor ID or random cryptographic fallback) sent on teacher check-ins and GPS pings to prevent proxy clock-ins. |
| `src/services/telemetryService.ts` | Sends live campus GPS pings (`POST v1/campus/ping/`) throttled to `ADAPTIVE_PING_INTERVAL_MS = 45000` (45 seconds). Rejects mocked GPS (`loc.mocked`), invalid coordinates, and weak GPS accuracy (> 250 m) before calling the API. Queues pings offline on transient network failure. |
| `src/services/backgroundLocation.ts` | Registers `ATTENDSURE_BACKGROUND_GEOFENCE` via `expo-task-manager` and `expo-location` (`timeInterval: 45000`, `distanceInterval: 10`) with an Android foreground notification. Only transmits while `attendsure_teacher_on_duty === 'true'` (automatically stops on clock-out). |
| `src/services/offlineQueue.ts` | Persists offline student QR scans (`attendsure_offline_qr_scans`, synced in batches via `POST v1/attendance/offline-sync/` using unique `client_scan_uuid`) and offline campus pings/actions (`attendsure_offline_queue`) in `AsyncStorage`. Drops pings older than 24 hours, drops permanent 4xx errors (`400`, `403`, `404`, `409`), pauses on `401`, and retries transient network failures up to 8 times. |
| `src/services/authService.ts` & `src/api/client.ts` | Manages JWT / DRF token storage, dynamic school server URL (`configService.ts`), request timeouts, and automatic token refresh. |
| `src/services/soundService.ts` | Plays clear audio feedback cues on successful, duplicate, or invalid student QR camera scans. |

---

## 6. Key Project Structure

```text
mobile/
├── App.tsx                          # Providers + NavigationContainer + SplashScreen
├── app.json                         # Expo SDK 58 config, camera/location/biometric permissions & plugins
├── package.json                     # Dependencies and npm scripts
└── src/
    ├── api/                         # client.ts, endpoints.ts
    ├── branding/                    # AttendSureLogo, AttendSureBadge, BrandLogos
    ├── components/                  # ScreenWrapper, ServerConfigModal, SplashScreen, common/*, reports/*
    ├── constants/theme.ts           # Re-exports theme/tokens.ts + shared UI styles & error formatters
    ├── context/                     # AuthContext, ThemeContext
    ├── navigation/                  # AppNavigator (native-stack), MainTabNavigator (5-tab dock)
    ├── screens/                     # Dashboard, Scanner, GeofenceStatus, GatePass, Menu, AdvisoryMatrix, Calendar, Reports, DTR, Settings, ProfileSettings, Login
    ├── services/                    # biometricService, deviceService, telemetryService, backgroundLocation, offlineQueue, authService, configService, soundService, teacherService
    ├── theme/tokens.ts              # Centralized color palettes (light, dark, high-contrast) & typography
    ├── types/                       # TypeScript interfaces
    └── utils/                       # permissions.ts, formatters.ts
```

---

## 7. Security & Native Build Rules

- Configure permissions and native plugins (`expo-local-authentication`, `expo-location`, `expo-splash-screen`) in `app.json`; do not hand-edit generated `ios/` or `android/` folders if Continuous Native Generation is used.
- Keep `isSafeUrl()` checks on all remote media URLs (`photo_url`, school logos) before rendering images.
- Never log auth tokens, `expo-secure-store` biometric secrets, or raw student personal details to console output.
- Always enforce offline queue endpoint validation (`isAllowedRelativeEndpoint`) and discard mocked GPS coordinates locally before queuing or transmitting.

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  NavigationContainer,
  DefaultTheme,
  DarkTheme,
  type Theme as NavigationTheme,
} from '@react-navigation/native';
import { SafeAreaProvider } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from './src/context/AuthContext';
import { ThemeProvider, useThemeMode } from './src/context/ThemeContext';
import AppNavigator from './src/navigation/AppNavigator';
import SplashScreen from './src/components/SplashScreen';

function AppShell() {
  const [splashDone, setSplashDone] = useState(false);
  const { loading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const { palette, isDark } = useThemeMode();

  const navigationTheme = useMemo<NavigationTheme>(() => {
    const base = isDark ? DarkTheme : DefaultTheme;
    return {
      ...base,
      colors: {
        ...base.colors,
        primary: palette.primary,
        background: palette.background,
        card: palette.surface,
        text: palette.textPrimary,
        border: palette.border,
        notification: palette.danger,
      },
    };
  }, [isDark, palette]);

  return (
    <NavigationContainer theme={navigationTheme}>
      <AppNavigator hideLoadingSpinner={!splashDone} />
      {!splashDone && (
        <SplashScreen
          loading={authLoading}
          minDurationMs={950}
          maxDurationMs={3500}
          onFinish={() => setSplashDone(true)}
        />
      )}
    </NavigationContainer>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <SafeAreaProvider>
      <ThemeProvider>
        <AuthProvider>
          <AppShell />
        </AuthProvider>
      </ThemeProvider>
    </SafeAreaProvider>
  );
}
