                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.62rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, fontWeight: 500 }}>
                    {sched.teacher_name}
                  </div>
                </th>
              ))}
              <th style={{ ...ui.th, width: 115, textAlign: 'center' }}>Periods</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {filteredMatrix.length > 0 ? (
              filteredMatrix.map((row) => (
                <tr
                  key={row.student_id}
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: row.cutting_count > 0 ? tokens.dangerLight : 'transparent',
                  }}
                >
                  <td
                    style={{
                      ...ui.td,
                      textAlign: 'center',
                      fontWeight: 800,
                      color: tokens.textMuted,
                      fontFamily: fonts.mono,
                    }}
                  >
                    {row.number}
                  </td>

                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                      <ProfileAvatar
                        photoUrl={row.photo_url}
                        name={row.student_name}
                        size={32}
                        iconSize={15}
                      />
                      <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <strong style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, color: tokens.textPrimary, display: 'block' }}>
                          {row.student_name}
                        </strong>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>
                          LRN: {row.lrn}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      }}
                    >
                      {row.campus_status}
                    </span>
                  </td>

                  {row.subjects.map((sub) => (
                    <td key={sub.schedule_id} style={{ ...ui.td, textAlign: 'center' }}>
                      {renderStatusPill(sub.status, sub.time)}
                    </td>
                  ))}

                  <td style={{ ...ui.td, textAlign: 'center' }}>
                    <div
                      style={{
                        fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
                        fontWeight: 800,
                        color:
                          row.total_subjects === 0
                            ? tokens.textMuted
                            : row.compliance_rate >= 80
                            ? brand.success
                            : brand.danger,
                      }}
                    >
                      {row.attended_count} / {row.total_subjects}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.64rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                      {row.compliance_rate}% Attended
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))
            ) : (
              <tr>
                <td
                  colSpan={4 + schedules.length}
                  style={{
                    padding: 36,
                    textAlign: 'center',
                    color: tokens.textMuted,
                    fontSize: fonts.size.base,
                  }}
                >
                  No students match the selected filter.
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const pillStyle = (bg: string, color: string): React.CSSProperties => ({

const ALLOWED_WEB_ROLES = new Set(['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD', 'TEACHER']);

const clearPreviousSessionStorage = (): void => {
  const keys = [
    'attendsure_access',
    'attendsure_refresh',
    'attendsure_token',
    'auth_token',
    'token',
    'attendsure_username',
    'attendsure_teacher_name',
    'attendsure_role',
    'attendsure_user_id',
    'attendsure_teacher_id',
    'attendsure_is_superuser',
    'attendsure_user_photo',
    'attendsure_can_teach',
  ];
  keys.forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k));
};

export const AuthPage: React.FC<AuthPageProps> = ({ onAuthSuccess, onLoginSuccess, onBackToShowcase }) => {
  const { school, updateSchoolInstantly, refreshSchool } = useSchool();
  const { mode, setThemeMode, tokens, brand, fonts } = useTheme();

  const [capsLockOn, setCapsLockOn] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [focusedField, setFocusedField] = useState<'username' | 'password' | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [cooldownSeconds, setCooldownSeconds] = useState<number>(0);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loginForm, setLoginForm] = useState<LoginPayload>({ username: '', password: '' });

  const usernameInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const loginAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    usernameInputRef.current?.focus();
    return () => {
      loginAbortRef.current?.abort();
      setLoginForm({ username: '', password: '' });
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (cooldownSeconds <= 0) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setCooldownSeconds((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1)), 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [cooldownSeconds]);

  const handleKeyEvent = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (typeof e.getModifierState === 'function') {
      setCapsLockOn(e.getModifierState('CapsLock'));
    }
  };

  const handleLoginSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (loading || cooldownSeconds > 0) return;

    const cleanUsername = loginForm.username.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '').trim().slice(0, 100);
    const rawPassword = loginForm.password.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').slice(0, 128);

    if (!cleanUsername || !rawPassword) {
      setErrorMsg('Please enter both your username and password.');
      return;
    }

    loginAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    loginAbortRef.current = controller;

    setErrorMsg(null);
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(
        API_ROUTES.accounts.login,
        {
          username: cleanUsername,
          password: rawPassword,
        },
        { signal: controller.signal }
      );
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      const data = res.data || {};
      const userObj = data.user || data;
      const role = String(userObj.role || userObj.system_role || 'TEACHER').toUpperCase();

      if (!ALLOWED_WEB_ROLES.has(role)) {
        clearPreviousSessionStorage();
        clearApiClientCache();
        setLoginForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, password: '' }));
        setErrorMsg(
          'Access is restricted to authorized teachers and school administrators.'
        );
        return;
      }

      const token = String(data.token || data.access || '').trim();
      const access = String(data.access || '').trim();
      const refresh = String(data.refresh || '').trim();
      const username = String(userObj.username || cleanUsername).trim();
      const teacherName = String(userObj.teacher_name || userObj.full_name || username).trim();
      const userId = Number(userObj.id || userObj.user_id || 0);
      const teacherId = userObj.teacher_id ? Number(userObj.teacher_id) : null;
      const isSuperuser = Boolean(userObj.is_superuser);
      const canTeach =
        userObj.can_handle_classes !== undefined && userObj.can_handle_classes !== null

          : userObj.can_teach !== undefined && userObj.can_teach !== null

      const rawPhoto = (userObj.photo_url || userObj.photo) as string | null | undefined;

      if (access) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_access', access);

      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_username', username);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_teacher_name', teacherName);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_role', role);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_can_teach', String(canTeach));
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_is_superuser', String(isSuperuser));
      if (userId) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_id', String(userId));

/**
 * AttendSure - Theme-Adaptive Brand Emblem Badge
 * File: web/src/components/branding/AttendSureBadge.tsx
 */

import React, { memo, useState } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { sanitizeText, SEAL_COLORS, type ThemeMode } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { BRAND_ASSETS } from './BrandAssets';

export interface AttendSureBadgeProps {
  size?: number;
  animate?: boolean;
  shape?: 'circle' | 'squircle';
  mode?: ThemeMode;
  alt?: string;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const MIN_BADGE_PX = 16;
const MAX_BADGE_PX = 320;

const clampBadgeSize = (rawSize?: number): number => {
  const parsed = Number(rawSize);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return 96;
  return Math.min(MAX_BADGE_PX, Math.max(MIN_BADGE_PX, Math.round(parsed)));
};

export const AttendSureBadge: React.FC<AttendSureBadgeProps> = memo(
  ({
    size = 96,
    animate = false,
    shape = 'circle',
    mode: overrideMode,
    alt = 'AttendSure',
    className,
    style,
  }) => {
    const { mode: contextMode } = useTheme();
    const [imageFailed, setImageFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);

    const activeMode = overrideMode || contextMode;
    const safeSize = clampBadgeSize(size);
    const iconSize = Math.round(safeSize * 0.62);
    const safeAlt = sanitizeText(alt, 60) || 'AttendSure';
    const radiusValue = shape === 'circle' ? '50%' : `${Math.max(8, Math.round(safeSize * 0.26))}px`;

    const borderColor =
      activeMode === 'dark'
        ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.55)'
        : activeMode === 'high-contrast'
        ? SEAL_COLORS.navyDeep
        : SEAL_COLORS.border;

    const badgeShadow =
      activeMode === 'dark'
        ? `0 8px 24px -4px rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.35), inset 0 1px 0 ${SEAL_COLORS.white}`
        : activeMode === 'high-contrast'
        ? `0 0 0 1.5px ${SEAL_COLORS.navyDeep}`
        : `0 8px 22px -4px rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.16), inset 0 1px 0 ${SEAL_COLORS.white}`;

    return (
      <div
        className={className}
        role="img"
        aria-label={safeAlt}
        style={{
          width: `${safeSize}px`,
          height: `${safeSize}px`,
          borderRadius: radiusValue,
          background: `linear-gradient(180deg, ${SEAL_COLORS.white} 0%, ${SEAL_COLORS.surface} 100%)`,
          borderWidth: activeMode === 'high-contrast' ? 2 : 1.5,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor,
          boxShadow: badgeShadow,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          animation: animate ? 'attendsure-badge-pulse 2.6s ease-in-out infinite' : 'none',
          flexShrink: 0,
          userSelect: 'none',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
          ...style,
        }}
      >
        {!imageFailed ? (
          <img
            src={BRAND_ASSETS.attendsureLogo}
            alt={safeAlt}
            width={iconSize}
            height={iconSize}
            decoding="async"
            draggable={false}
            onError={() => setImageFailed(true)}
            style={{
              width: `${iconSize}px`,
              height: `${iconSize}px`,
              objectFit: 'contain',
              display: 'block',
            }}
          />
        ) : (
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 64 64"
            width={iconSize}
            height={iconSize}
            fill="none"
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <path d="M32 8L12 52H22.5L32 30.5L41.5 52H52L32 8Z" fill={SEAL_COLORS.navy} />
            <rect x="14" y="42" width="36" height="10" rx="3" fill={SEAL_COLORS.sky} />
          </svg>
        )}

        {animate && (
          <style>{`
            @keyframes attendsure-badge-pulse {
              0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
              50% { transform: scale(1.035); }
            }
            @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
              div[role="img"] { animation: none !important; }
            }
          `}</style>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }
);

AttendSureBadge.displayName = 'AttendSureBadge';

export default AttendSureBadge;

/**
 * AttendSure - Dynamic School Identity Badge (Theme-Adaptive & Zero Mock Data)
 * File: web/src/components/branding/SchoolTenantBadge.tsx
 */

import React, { memo, useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { School } from 'lucide-react';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl, sanitizeText, SEAL_COLORS } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { BRAND_ASSETS } from './BrandAssets';

export interface SchoolTenantBadgeProps {
  showDivision?: boolean;
  showSchoolId?: boolean;
  compact?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const formatDivisionText = (division?: string, region?: string): string => {
  const cleanDivision = sanitizeText(division || '', 80);
  if (cleanDivision) {
    return /division/i.test(cleanDivision) ? cleanDivision : `Division of ${cleanDivision}`;
  }
  return sanitizeText(region || '', 60);
};

export const SchoolTenantBadge: React.FC<SchoolTenantBadgeProps> = memo(
  ({
    showDivision = true,
    showSchoolId = false,
    compact = false,
    className,
    style,
  }) => {
    const { school, loading } = useSchool();
    const { mode, tokens, brand, fonts } = useTheme();

    const [sealFailed, setSealFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);
    const [fallbackFailed, setFallbackFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);

    const safeSchoolLogo = useMemo(
      () => (isSafeImageUrl(school.school_logo) ? school.school_logo : null),
      [school.school_logo]
    );

    useEffect(() => {
      setSealFailed(false);
    }, [safeSchoolLogo]);

    const schoolName = useMemo(() => {
      const cleaned = sanitizeText(school.school_name || '', 120);
      if (cleaned) return cleaned;
      return loading ? 'Loading school...' : 'School Not Configured';
    }, [school.school_name, loading]);

    const divisionLabel = useMemo(
      () => (showDivision ? formatDivisionText(school.division, school.region) : ''),
      [showDivision, school.division, school.region]
    );

    const validSchoolId = useMemo(() => {
      if (!showSchoolId) return '';
      const rawId = sanitizeText(school.school_id || '', 20);
      return rawId && rawId !== '55555' && rawId !== '000000' ? rawId : '';
    }, [showSchoolId, school.school_id]);

    const activeImageSrc =
      safeSchoolLogo && !sealFailed
        ? safeSchoolLogo
        : !fallbackFailed
        ? BRAND_ASSETS.attendsureLogo
        : null;

    const sealBoxSize = compact ? 22 : 26;
    const sealImgSize = compact ? 16 : 20;

    return (
      <div
        className={className}
        title={
          divisionLabel
            ? `${schoolName} • ${divisionLabel}`
            : schoolName
        }
        style={{
          display: 'inline-flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: compact ? 8 : 10,
          padding: compact ? '4px 11px 4px 6px' : '5px 14px 5px 7px',
          maxWidth: '100%',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderWidth: mode === 'high-contrast' ? 1.5 : 1,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
          borderRadius: 9999,
          boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
          fontFamily: fonts.sans,
          userSelect: 'none',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
          transition: 'background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease',
          ...style,
        }}
      >
        {/* Porcelain Seal Medallion keeps dark-ink logos crisp in Dark Mode */}
        <div
          style={{
            width: sealBoxSize,
            height: sealBoxSize,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            backgroundColor: SEAL_COLORS.white,
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderStyle: 'solid',
            borderColor: mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)' : SEAL_COLORS.subtleBorder,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          {activeImageSrc ? (
            <img
              src={activeImageSrc}
              alt={`${schoolName} Seal`}
              width={sealImgSize}
              height={sealImgSize}
              decoding="async"
              referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
              draggable={false}
              onError={() => {
                if (safeSchoolLogo && !sealFailed) {
                  setSealFailed(true);
                } else {
                  setFallbackFailed(true);
                }
              }}
              style={{
                width: sealImgSize,
                height: sealImgSize,
                objectFit: 'contain',
                display: 'block',
              }}
            />
          ) : (
            <School size={compact ? 13 : 15} color={SEAL_COLORS.navy} aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
        </div>

        <span
          style={{
            fontSize: compact ? fonts.size.sm : fonts.size.base,
            fontWeight: 800,
            color: tokens.textPrimary,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            minWidth: 0,
          }}
        >
          {schoolName}
        </span>

        {validSchoolId && (
          <span
            style={{
              fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
              fontWeight: 700,
              fontFamily: fonts.mono,
              color: brand.primary,
              backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
              padding: '1px 7px',
              borderRadius: 9999,
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            ID: {validSchoolId}
          </span>
        )}

        {divisionLabel && (
          <span
            style={{
              fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
              fontWeight: 500,
              color: tokens.textSecondary,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              flexShrink: 1,
            }}
          >
            &bull; {divisionLabel}
          </span>
        )}

    );
  }

/**
 * AttendSure - Pure-Vector Theme-Adaptive Developer Signature Badge
 * File: web/src/components/branding/TechBlazerSignature.tsx
 */

import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { sanitizeText, SEAL_COLORS } from '../../theme/tokens';

export interface TechBlazerSignatureProps {
  size?: number;
  textColor?: string;
  label?: string;
  layout?: 'stacked' | 'inline';
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const MIN_ICON_PX = 14;
const MAX_ICON_PX = 96;

const clampIconSize = (rawSize?: number): number => {
  const parsed = Number(rawSize);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return 20;
  return Math.min(MAX_ICON_PX, Math.max(MIN_ICON_PX, Math.round(parsed)));
};

const isSafeCssColor = (value?: string): boolean => {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = value.trim();
  return (
    /^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$/.test(clean) ||
    /^(rgb|rgba|hsl|hsla)\([0-9.,%\s/]+\)$/.test(clean) ||
    /^var\(--[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+(?:\s*,\s*#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8})?\)$/.test(clean)
  );
};

export const TechBlazerSignature: React.FC<TechBlazerSignatureProps> = memo(
  ({
    size = 20,
    textColor,
    label = 'from',
    layout = 'stacked',
    className = '',
    style,
  }) => {
    const { mode, tokens, fonts } = useTheme();

    const safeSize = clampIconSize(size);
    const tileSize = Math.round(safeSize * 1.35);
    const wordmarkFontPx = Math.max(11, Math.round(safeSize * 0.88));
    const safeLabel = sanitizeText(label, 24);
    const resolvedTextColor = isSafeCssColor(textColor) ? textColor!.trim() : tokens.textPrimary;

    const tileBorderColor =
      mode === 'dark'
        ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)'
        : mode === 'high-contrast'
        ? SEAL_COLORS.navyDeep
        : SEAL_COLORS.subtleBorder;

    return (
      <div
        className={className}
        aria-label={`${safeLabel ? `${safeLabel} ` : ''}TECHBLAZER`}
        style={{

/**
 * AttendSure - Shared Profile Photo / Avatar Upload Field
 * File: web/src/components/common/AvatarUploadField.tsx
 *
 * Used across User Accounts, My Profile, Complete Profile, Teachers, and Students modals.
 * Enforces MIME type (JPEG/PNG/WEBP), <= 2 MB file size, safe isSafeImageUrl preview,
 * fallback initials, instant preview, replace, and remove actions.
 */

import React, { useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Camera, Trash2, Upload, User } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';

const ALLOWED_IMAGE_MIMES = new Set(['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp']);
const MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

export interface AvatarUploadFieldProps {
  previewUrl?: string | null;
  displayName?: string;
  label?: string;
  helpText?: string;
  size?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onSelectPhoto: (file: File, dataUri: string) => void;
  onRemovePhoto: () => void;
  onValidationError?: (message: string) => void;
}

const getInitials = (name?: string): string => {
  const parts = String(name || '')
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 0) return '';
  if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  return `${parts[0][0]}${parts[parts.length - 1][0]}`.toUpperCase();
};

export const AvatarUploadField: React.FC<AvatarUploadFieldProps> = ({
  previewUrl,
  displayName = '',
  label = 'Profile Photo',
  helpText = 'JPEG, PNG, or WEBP up to 2 MB (auto-resized to 600x600)',
  size = 68,
  disabled = false,
  onSelectPhoto,
  onRemovePhoto,
  onValidationError,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui, fonts } = useTheme();
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [imgFailed, setImgFailed] = useState(false);
  const [localError, setLocalError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    setImgFailed(false);
  }, [previewUrl]);

  const safeUrl = isSafeImageUrl(previewUrl) && !imgFailed ? previewUrl! : null;
  const initials = getInitials(displayName);

  const handleFilePick = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    e.target.value = '';
    if (!file) return;

    if (!ALLOWED_IMAGE_MIMES.has(file.type)) {
      const msg = 'Please select a valid JPEG, PNG, or WEBP image.';
      setLocalError(msg);
      onValidationError?.(msg);
      return;
    }
    if (file.size > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) {
      const msg = 'Profile photo must be 2 MB or smaller.';
      setLocalError(msg);
      onValidationError?.(msg);
      return;
    }

    setLocalError('');
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      const result = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      if (!isSafeImageUrl(result)) {
        const msg = 'Could not preview selected image file.';
        setLocalError(msg);
        onValidationError?.(msg);
        return;
      }
      onSelectPhoto(file, result);
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 14,
        padding: '12px 14px',
        borderRadius: 10,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderStyle: 'solid',
        borderColor: localError ? brand.danger : tokens.borderSubtle,
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          position: 'relative',
          width: size,
          height: size,
          borderRadius: '50%',
          backgroundColor: brand.primarySoft,
          borderWidth: 2,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: safeUrl ? brand.primary : tokens.borderStrong,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          flexShrink: 0,
        }}
      >
        {safeUrl ? (
          <img
            src={safeUrl}
            alt={displayName || label}
            onError={() => setImgFailed(true)}
            style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover', display: 'block' }}
          />
        ) : initials ? (
          <span
            style={{
              fontFamily: fonts.display,
              fontSize: Math.round(size * 0.34),
              fontWeight: 800,
              color: brand.primary,
            }}
          >
            {initials}
          </span>
        ) : (
          <User size={Math.round(size * 0.44)} color={brand.primary} />
        )}
      </div>

      <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
          {label}
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>
          {helpText}
        </div>

        {localError && (
          <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, fontWeight: 700, color: brand.danger, marginTop: 4 }}>
            {localError}
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginTop: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            type="file"
            accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
            onChange={handleFilePick}
            disabled={disabled}
            style={{ display: 'none' }}
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={disabled}
            onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}
            style={{
              ...ui.btnSecondary,
              padding: '5px 10px',
              fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
              opacity: disabled ? 0.6 : 1,
            }}
          >
            {safeUrl ? <Camera size={13} /> : <Upload size={13} />}
            <span>{safeUrl ? 'Replace Photo' : 'Upload Photo'}</span>
          </button>

          {safeUrl && !disabled && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setLocalError('');
                onRemovePhoto();
              }}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 5,
                padding: '5px 10px',
                borderRadius: 8,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderStyle: 'solid',
                borderColor: brand.danger,
                backgroundColor: tokens.dangerBg,
                color: brand.danger,
                fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                fontWeight: 700,
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              <Trash2 size={13} />
              <span>Remove Photo</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AvatarUploadField;

/**
 * AttendSure - Fault Isolation Error Boundary
 * File: web/src/components/common/ErrorBoundary.tsx
 *
 * Prevents isolated page issues from crashing the entire web portal.
 */

import React, { Component } from 'react';
import type { ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, RefreshCw, Copy, Check, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { copyTextToClipboard } from '../../utils/clipboard';

export interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  featureName?: string;
  fallback?: ReactNode | ((props: { error: Error; resetError: () => void }) => ReactNode);
  onReset?: () => void;
  onError?: (error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) => void;
  resetKeys?: unknown[];
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  errorInfo: ErrorInfo | null;
  copied: boolean;
  showDetails: boolean;
}

const IS_DEV = Boolean(import.meta.env.DEV);

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<ErrorBoundaryProps, State> {
  private copyTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  public state: State = {
    hasError: false,
    error: null,
    errorInfo: null,
    copied: false,
    showDetails: false,
  };

  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): Partial<State> {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    this.setState({ errorInfo });
    this.props.onError?.(error, errorInfo);
  }

  public componentDidUpdate(prevProps: ErrorBoundaryProps) {
    if (!this.state.hasError) return;

    if (this.props.resetKeys && prevProps.resetKeys) {
      const hasChanged = this.props.resetKeys.some(
        (key, index) => key !== prevProps.resetKeys?.[index]
      );
      if (hasChanged) {
        this.handleReset();
      }
    }
  }

  public componentWillUnmount() {
    if (this.copyTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.copyTimer);
      this.copyTimer = null;
    }
  }

  private handleReset = () => {
    this.props.onReset?.();
    this.setState({
      hasError: false,
      error: null,
      errorInfo: null,
      copied: false,
      showDetails: false,
    });
  };

  private handleCopyDiagnostic = async () => {
    const lines = [
      `Feature: ${this.props.featureName || 'Application Section'}`,
      `Time: ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
      `Error: ${this.state.error?.name || 'Error'}`,
    ];
    if (IS_DEV) {
      lines.push(`Message: ${this.state.error?.message || ''}`);
      lines.push(`Stack: ${this.state.error?.stack || 'None'}`);
    }
    const errorText = lines.join('\n');
    const success = await copyTextToClipboard(errorText);

    if (success) {
      this.setState({ copied: true });
      if (this.copyTimer) clearTimeout(this.copyTimer);
      this.copyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.setState({ copied: false });
        this.copyTimer = null;
      }, 2500);
    }
  };

  public render() {
    if (this.state.hasError && this.state.error) {
      if (typeof this.props.fallback === 'function') {
        return this.props.fallback({
          error: this.state.error,
          resetError: this.handleReset,
        });
      }

      if (this.props.fallback) {
        return this.props.fallback;
      }

      const featureTitle = this.props.featureName || 'Section';

      return (
        <div style={errorContainerStyle}>
          <div style={errorCardStyle}>
            <div style={iconBadgeStyle}>
              <AlertTriangle size={24} color="var(--danger)" />
            </div>

            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', width: '100%' }}>
              <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 6px 0', fontSize: '1.05rem', fontWeight: 800, color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                {featureTitle} Temporarily Unavailable
              </h3>
              <p style={{ margin: '0 0 14px 0', fontSize: '0.82rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
                A temporary problem occurred while displaying this section. Other AttendSure tabs, classroom QR scanning, and background tasks are still running normally.
              </p>

              {IS_DEV && (
                <div style={debugCodeStyle}>
                  {this.state.error.message || 'Unexpected rendering error.'}
                </div>
              )}

              {IS_DEV && this.state.showDetails && (
                <div style={stackTraceContainerStyle}>
                  <pre style={stackTracePreStyle}>
                    {this.state.error.stack || 'No extended details available.'}
                    {this.state.errorInfo?.componentStack || ''}
                  </pre>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div style={actionsRowStyle}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={this.handleReset}
                style={primaryBtnStyle}
              >
                <RefreshCw size={14} />
                <span>Try Again</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={this.handleCopyDiagnostic}
                style={secondaryBtnStyle}
                title="Copy report reference"
              >
                {this.state.copied ? <Check size={14} color="var(--success)" /> : <Copy size={14} />}
                <span>{this.state.copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy Details'}</span>
              </button>

              {IS_DEV && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => this.setState((prev) => ({ showDetails: !prev.showDetails }))}
                  style={secondaryBtnStyle}
                >
                  <span>{this.state.showDetails ? 'Hide Details' : 'Details'}</span>
                </button>
              )}

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
                style={secondaryBtnStyle}
                title="Reload the page"
              >
                <RotateCcw size={14} />
                <span>Reload</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

export default ErrorBoundary;

const errorContainerStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'center',
  width: '100%',

  padding: '24px 16px',
  boxSizing: 'border-box',
  backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-app)',
};

    </div>
  );
};

import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { PAPER_PRESET_COLORS, SEAL_COLORS } from '../../theme/tokens';

interface PageSetupModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  currentConfig: PageSetupConfig;
  onLiveChange?: (config: PageSetupConfig) => void;
  onApply: (config: PageSetupConfig, setAsDefault: boolean) => void;
  reportTitle?: string;
}

const PRESET_COLORS = PAPER_PRESET_COLORS;

export const PageSetupModal: React.FC<PageSetupModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  currentConfig,
  onLiveChange,
  onApply,
  reportTitle = 'Report',
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<PageSetupConfig>({
    ...currentConfig,
    headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
  });
  const [setAsDefault, setSetAsDefault] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const initialConfigRef = useRef<PageSetupConfig>(currentConfig);
  const wasOpenRef = useRef<boolean>(false);

  // Only snapshot initialConfigRef and reset checkbox when modal opens (not on every live edit)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && !wasOpenRef.current) {
      const snapshot: PageSetupConfig = {
        ...currentConfig,
        margins: { ...currentConfig.margins },
        headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
      };
      initialConfigRef.current = snapshot;
      setDraft(snapshot);
      setSetAsDefault(false);
    }
    wasOpenRef.current = isOpen;
  }, [isOpen, currentConfig]);

  const updateDraft = useCallback(
    (newDraft: PageSetupConfig) => {
      const standardizedDraft: PageSetupConfig = {
        ...newDraft,
        headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
      };
      setDraft(standardizedDraft);
      onLiveChange?.(standardizedDraft);
    },
    [onLiveChange]
  );

  const handleCancel = useCallback(() => {
    onLiveChange?.(initialConfigRef.current);
    onClose();
  }, [onLiveChange, onClose]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleCancel();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, handleCancel]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleOrientationChange = (orientation: PageOrientation) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, orientation });
  };

  const handleLayoutModeChange = (layoutMode: LayoutMode) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, layoutMode });
  };

  const handlePaperSizeChange = (paperSize: PaperSizeKey) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, paperSize });
  };

  const handlePageColorChange = (pageColor: string) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, pageColor });
  };

  const handleMarginPresetChange = (preset: MarginPresetKey) => {
    updateDraft({
      ...draft,
      marginPreset: preset,
      margins: { ...MARGIN_PRESETS[preset].margins },
    });
  };

    updateDraft({
      ...draft,
      marginPreset: 'custom',
      margins: {
        ...draft.margins,
        [side]: Math.max(0, Number(val) || 0),
      },
    });
  };

  const handleResetToInitial = () => {
    updateDraft({
      ...initialConfigRef.current,
      margins: { ...initialConfigRef.current.margins },

    setSetAsDefault(false);
  };

    onClose();
  };

  const selectedPaper = PAPER_SIZES[draft.paperSize] || PAPER_SIZES.folio;
  const isLandscape = draft.orientation === 'landscape';
  const liveWidth = isLandscape ? selectedPaper.height : selectedPaper.width;
  const liveHeight = isLandscape ? selectedPaper.width : selectedPaper.height;

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable Server Pagination Bar & Safe CSV Exporter
 * File: web/src/components/common/Pagination.tsx
 *
 * Cybersecurity & Stability Hardening:
 * 1. OWASP CSV Formula Injection Defense: Neutralizes cells starting with =, +, -, @, |, \t, \r.
 * 2. Asynchronous Memory Cleanup: Delays URL.revokeObjectURL by 1s to prevent premature download aborts.
 * 3. Strict Numeric Math: shields against NaN / divide-by-zero during rapid page size switching.
 * 4. WCAG Accessible Controls: Adds aria-label descriptors to all buttons and select inputs.
 */

import React, { useId } from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, ChevronsLeft, ChevronsRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

/** Safe upper ceiling representing "All" records without exhausting server RAM */
export const ALL_ROWS_SIZE = 10000;

export const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS: number[] = [
  25,
  50,
  100,
  250,
  500,
  1000,
  ALL_ROWS_SIZE,
];

/**
 * Cybersecurity Helper: Sanitizes cell values to prevent CSV Formula / DDE Injection
 * in Microsoft Excel, LibreOffice, and Google Sheets.
 * Blocks: =, +, -, @, |, \t, \r
 */
export const sanitizeCsvCell = (val: string | number | boolean | undefined | null): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '""';
  
  // Escape internal double quotes by doubling them per RFC 4180
  const clean = String(val).replace(/"/g, '""').trim();
  
  // Neutralize formula trigger characters with a leading single quote
  if (/^[=+\-@\t\r|]/.test(clean)) {
    return `"'${clean}"`;
  }
  
  return `"${clean}"`;
};

/**
 * Reusable CSV Downloader for any table module.
 * Embeds UTF-8 BOM (\uFEFF) for proper display of special characters in Excel.
 */
export const exportToCsv = (
  filename: string,
  headers: string[],
  rows: (string | number | boolean | undefined | null)[][]
): boolean => {
  if (!rows || rows.length === 0) return false;

  const csvLines = [
    headers.map((h) => sanitizeCsvCell(h)).join(','),
    ...rows.map((row) => row.map((cell) => sanitizeCsvCell(cell)).join(',')),
  ];

  // UTF-8 BOM prefix ensures correct rendering in Excel
  const csvContent = '\uFEFF' + csvLines.join('\r\n');
  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv') ? filename : `${filename}.csv`;
  link.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);

  // Defer revocation by 1 second to ensure browser has completed file stream
  setTimeout(() => {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 1000);

  return true;
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable User & Teacher Avatar
 * Replaces duplicate implementations across TeachersTab, DTRTab, and MyAssignedClassesTab.
 * File: web/src/components/common/ProfileAvatar.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { User } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';

interface ProfileAvatarProps {
  photoUrl?: string | null;
  name?: string;
  size?: number;
  iconSize?: number;
}

export const ProfileAvatar: React.FC<ProfileAvatarProps> = ({
  photoUrl,
  name = 'Member',
  size = 38,
  iconSize = 19,
}) => {
  const { tokens } = useTheme();
  const [imageFailed, setImageFailed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setImageFailed(false);
  }, [photoUrl]);

  const hasPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(photoUrl);

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: '50%',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
      title={name}
    >
      {hasPhoto && !imageFailed ? (
        <img
          src={photoUrl!}
          alt={name}
          style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
          onError={() => setImageFailed(true)}
        />
      ) : (
        <User size={iconSize} color={tokens.textMuted} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Zero-Dependency Local QR Code SVG Generator (ISO/IEC 18004)
 * File: web/src/components/common/QrCodeSvg.tsx
 *
 * Generates standard Byte-mode QR codes (Versions 1-10, Error Correction Level L)
 * completely inside the browser so signed student and teacher QR codes work
 * offline and never transmit sensitive tokens to external third-party servers.
 */

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { QR_COLORS } from '../../theme/tokens';

type BlockGroup = readonly [blocks: number, dataCodewords: number, ecCodewords: number];

interface VersionSpec {
  version: number;
  maxBytes: number;
  totalData: number;
  groups: readonly BlockGroup[];
  alignment: readonly number[];
}

const VERSION_SPECS: readonly VersionSpec[] = [
  { version: 1, maxBytes: 17, totalData: 19, groups: [[1, 19, 7]], alignment: [] },
  { version: 2, maxBytes: 32, totalData: 34, groups: [[1, 34, 10]], alignment: [6, 18] },
  { version: 3, maxBytes: 53, totalData: 55, groups: [[1, 55, 15]], alignment: [6, 22] },
  { version: 4, maxBytes: 78, totalData: 80, groups: [[1, 80, 20]], alignment: [6, 26] },
  { version: 5, maxBytes: 106, totalData: 108, groups: [[1, 108, 26]], alignment: [6, 30] },
  { version: 6, maxBytes: 134, totalData: 136, groups: [[2, 68, 18]], alignment: [6, 34] },
  { version: 7, maxBytes: 154, totalData: 156, groups: [[2, 78, 20]], alignment: [6, 22, 38] },
  { version: 8, maxBytes: 192, totalData: 194, groups: [[2, 97, 24]], alignment: [6, 24, 42] },
  { version: 9, maxBytes: 230, totalData: 232, groups: [[2, 116, 30]], alignment: [6, 26, 46] },
  { version: 10, maxBytes: 271, totalData: 274, groups: [[2, 68, 18], [2, 69, 18]], alignment: [6, 28, 50] },
];

const GF_EXP = new Uint8Array(512);
const GF_LOG = new Uint8Array(256);

(() => {
  let x = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 255; i++) {
    GF_EXP[i] = x;
    GF_LOG[x] = i;
    x <<= 1;
    if (x & 0x100) x ^= 0x11d;
  }
  for (let i = 255; i < 512; i++) {
    GF_EXP[i] = GF_EXP[i - 255];
  }
})();

const gfMul = (a: number, b: number): number => {
  if (a === 0 || b === 0) return 0;
  return GF_EXP[GF_LOG[a] + GF_LOG[b]];
};

const rsGeneratorPoly = (degree: number): Uint8Array => {
  let poly = new Uint8Array([1]);
  for (let i = 0; i < degree; i++) {
    const next = new Uint8Array(poly.length + 1);
    const factor = GF_EXP[i];
    for (let j = 0; j < poly.length; j++) {
      next[j] ^= poly[j];
      next[j + 1] ^= gfMul(poly[j], factor);
    }
    poly = next;
  }
  return poly;
};

const rsComputeEc = (data: Uint8Array, ecCount: number): Uint8Array => {
  const gen = rsGeneratorPoly(ecCount);
  const rem = new Uint8Array(ecCount);
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
    const factor = data[i] ^ rem[0];
    rem.copyWithin(0, 1);
    rem[ecCount - 1] = 0;
    if (factor !== 0) {
      for (let j = 0; j < ecCount; j++) {
        rem[j] ^= gfMul(gen[j + 1], factor);
      }
    }
  }
  return rem;
};

const computeFormatBits = (mask: number): number => {
  const data = (0b01 << 3) | (mask & 0b111); // ECC Level L = 01
  let rem = data << 10;
  for (let i = 14; i >= 10; i--) {
    if ((rem >> i) & 1) rem ^= 0x537 << (i - 10);
  }
  return ((data << 10) | rem) ^ 0x5412;
};

const computeVersionBits = (version: number): number => {
  let rem = version << 12;
  for (let i = 17; i >= 12; i--) {
    if ((rem >> i) & 1) rem ^= 0x1f25 << (i - 12);
  }
  return (version << 12) | rem;
};

const applyMaskCheck = (mask: number, r: number, c: number): boolean => {
  switch (mask) {
    case 0: return (r + c) % 2 === 0;
    case 1: return r % 2 === 0;
    case 2: return c % 3 === 0;
    case 3: return (r + c) % 3 === 0;
    case 4: return (Math.floor(r / 2) + Math.floor(c / 3)) % 2 === 0;
    case 5: return ((r * c) % 2) + ((r * c) % 3) === 0;
    case 6: return (((r * c) % 2) + ((r * c) % 3)) % 2 === 0;
    default: return (((r + c) % 2) + ((r * c) % 3)) % 2 === 0;
  }
};

const writeFormatBits = (grid: boolean[][], size: number, mask: number) => {
  const bits = computeFormatBits(mask);
  const topLeftCoords: Array<[number, number]> = [
    [8, 0], [8, 1], [8, 2], [8, 3], [8, 4], [8, 5], [8, 7], [8, 8],
    [7, 8], [5, 8], [4, 8], [3, 8], [2, 8], [1, 8], [0, 8],
  ];
  const splitCoords: Array<[number, number]> = [
    [size - 1, 8], [size - 2, 8], [size - 3, 8], [size - 4, 8],
    [size - 5, 8], [size - 6, 8], [size - 7, 8],
    [8, size - 8], [8, size - 7], [8, size - 6], [8, size - 5],
    [8, size - 4], [8, size - 3], [8, size - 2], [8, size - 1],
  ];
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    const dark = Boolean((bits >> (14 - i)) & 1);
    const [r1, c1] = topLeftCoords[i];
    const [r2, c2] = splitCoords[i];
    grid[r1][c1] = dark;
    grid[r2][c2] = dark;
  }
};

const scoreGrid = (grid: boolean[][], size: number): number => {
  let penalty = 0;
  let darkCount = 0;

  for (let r = 0; r < size; r++) {
    let rowRun = 1;
    let colRun = 1;
    for (let c = 0; c < size; c++) {
      if (grid[r][c]) darkCount++;
      if (c > 0) {
        if (grid[r][c] === grid[r][c - 1]) rowRun++;
        else {
          if (rowRun >= 5) penalty += 3 + (rowRun - 5);
          rowRun = 1;
        }
        if (grid[c][r] === grid[c - 1][r]) colRun++;
        else {
          if (colRun >= 5) penalty += 3 + (colRun - 5);
          colRun = 1;
        }
      }
      if (r < size - 1 && c < size - 1) {
        const v = grid[r][c];
        if (v === grid[r][c + 1] && v === grid[r + 1][c] && v === grid[r + 1][c + 1]) {
          penalty += 3;
        }
      }
    }
    if (rowRun >= 5) penalty += 3 + (rowRun - 5);
    if (colRun >= 5) penalty += 3 + (colRun - 5);
  }

  const ratio = (darkCount * 100) / (size * size);
  penalty += Math.floor(Math.abs(ratio - 50) / 5) * 10;
  return penalty;
};

export function generateQrMatrix(rawValue: string): boolean[][] {
  const input = (rawValue || '').trim() || 'ATTENDSURE';
  const encoded = new TextEncoder().encode(input);
  const payloadBytes = encoded.length > 271 ? encoded.slice(0, 271) : encoded;

  const spec =
    VERSION_SPECS.find((s) => payloadBytes.length <= s.maxBytes) ||
    VERSION_SPECS[VERSION_SPECS.length - 1];

  // Build data codeword bit stream (Byte mode 0100)
  const bits: number[] = [];
  const pushBits = (val: number, len: number) => {
    for (let i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) bits.push((val >> i) & 1);
  };

  pushBits(0b0100, 4);
  pushBits(payloadBytes.length, spec.version >= 10 ? 16 : 8);
  for (let i = 0; i < payloadBytes.length; i++) pushBits(payloadBytes[i], 8);

  const totalDataBits = spec.totalData * 8;
  const termBits = Math.min(4, totalDataBits - bits.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < termBits; i++) bits.push(0);
  while (bits.length % 8 !== 0) bits.push(0);

  const dataBytes = new Uint8Array(spec.totalData);
  let byteIdx = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < bits.length; i += 8) {
    let b = 0;
    for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) b = (b << 1) | bits[i + j];
    dataBytes[byteIdx++] = b;
  }
  let padToggle = 0;
  while (byteIdx < spec.totalData) {
    dataBytes[byteIdx++] = padToggle === 0 ? 0xec : 0x11;
    padToggle ^= 1;
  }

  // Split blocks & compute Reed-Solomon error correction
  const dataBlocks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  const ecBlocks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let offset = 0;
  for (const [blockCount, dataLen, ecLen] of spec.groups) {
    for (let b = 0; b < blockCount; b++) {
      const slice = dataBytes.slice(offset, offset + dataLen);
      offset += dataLen;
      dataBlocks.push(slice);
      ecBlocks.push(rsComputeEc(slice, ecLen));
    }
  }

  const maxDataLen = Math.max(...dataBlocks.map((b) => b.length));
  const ecLen = ecBlocks[0].length;
  const finalBytes: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < maxDataLen; i++) {
    for (const blk of dataBlocks) {
      if (i < blk.length) finalBytes.push(blk[i]);
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < ecLen; i++) {
    for (const ec of ecBlocks) finalBytes.push(ec[i]);
  }

  const finalBits: boolean[] = [];
  for (const byteVal of finalBytes) {
    for (let i = 7; i >= 0; i--) finalBits.push(Boolean((byteVal >> i) & 1));
  }

  const size = spec.version * 4 + 17;
  const baseGrid: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: size }, () => Array<boolean>(size).fill(false));
  const isFunc: boolean[][] = Array.from({ length: size }, () => Array<boolean>(size).fill(false));

  const setFunc = (r: number, c: number, dark: boolean) => {
    if (r < 0 || c < 0 || r >= size || c >= size) return;
    baseGrid[r][c] = dark;
    isFunc[r][c] = true;
  };

  // 1. Finder patterns + white separators
  const placeFinder = (top: number, left: number) => {
    for (let dr = -1; dr <= 7; dr++) {
      for (let dc = -1; dc <= 7; dc++) {
        const r = top + dr;
        const c = left + dc;
        if (r < 0 || c < 0 || r >= size || c >= size) continue;
        const inOuter = dr >= 0 && dr <= 6 && dc >= 0 && dc <= 6;
        const onOuterBorder = dr === 0 || dr === 6 || dc === 0 || dc === 6;
        const inCore = dr >= 2 && dr <= 4 && dc >= 2 && dc <= 4;
        setFunc(r, c, inOuter && (onOuterBorder || inCore));
      }
    }
  };
  placeFinder(0, 0);
  placeFinder(0, size - 7);
  placeFinder(size - 7, 0);

  // 2. Alignment patterns
  for (const rCenter of spec.alignment) {
    for (const cCenter of spec.alignment) {
      if (isFunc[rCenter][cCenter]) continue;
      for (let dr = -2; dr <= 2; dr++) {
        for (let dc = -2; dc <= 2; dc++) {
          const dist = Math.max(Math.abs(dr), Math.abs(dc));
          setFunc(rCenter + dr, cCenter + dc, dist === 0 || dist === 2);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 3. Timing patterns
  for (let i = 8; i < size - 8; i++) {
    const dark = i % 2 === 0;
    if (!isFunc[6][i]) setFunc(6, i, dark);
    if (!isFunc[i][6]) setFunc(i, 6, dark);
  }

  // 4. Always-dark module + format info reservation
  setFunc(4 * spec.version + 9, 8, true);
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    if (!isFunc[8][i]) setFunc(8, i, false);
    if (!isFunc[i][8]) setFunc(i, 8, false);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    setFunc(8, size - 1 - i, false);
    if (i < 7) setFunc(size - 1 - i, 8, false);
  }

  // 5. Version info blocks (v7+)
  if (spec.version >= 7) {
    const vBits = computeVersionBits(spec.version);
    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
      const dark = Boolean((vBits >> i) & 1);
      const a = Math.floor(i / 3);
      const b = i % 3;
      setFunc(a, size - 11 + b, dark);
      setFunc(size - 11 + b, a, dark);
    }
  }

  // 6. Zig-zag data bit placement
  let bitIdx = 0;
  let upward = true;
  for (let col = size - 1; col >= 1; col -= 2) {
    if (col === 6) col = 5;
    for (let step = 0; step < size; step++) {
      const row = upward ? size - 1 - step : step;
      for (let dc = 0; dc < 2; dc++) {
        const c = col - dc;
        if (!isFunc[row][c]) {
          baseGrid[row][c] = bitIdx < finalBits.length ? finalBits[bitIdx] : false;
          bitIdx++;
        }
      }
    }
    upward = !upward;
  }

  // 7. Pick optimal mask (0..7)
  let bestGrid = baseGrid;
  let bestPenalty = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  for (let mask = 0; mask < 8; mask++) {
    const candidate = baseGrid.map((row, r) =>
      row.map((val, c) => (isFunc[r][c] ? val : applyMaskCheck(mask, r, c) ? !val : val))
    );
    writeFormatBits(candidate, size, mask);
    const penalty = scoreGrid(candidate, size);
    if (penalty < bestPenalty) {
      bestPenalty = penalty;
      bestGrid = candidate;
    }
  }

  return bestGrid;
}

export function buildQrSvgPath(matrix: boolean[][], quietZone = 4): { viewBoxSize: number; path: string } {
  const size = matrix.length;
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < size; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < size; c++) {
      if (matrix[r][c]) {
        parts.push(`M${c + quietZone},${r + quietZone}h1v1h-1z`);
      }
    }
  }
  return { viewBoxSize: size + quietZone * 2, path: parts.join('') };
}

export function buildQrSvgDataUri(value: string, size = 180): string {
  const matrix = generateQrMatrix(value);
  const { viewBoxSize, path } = buildQrSvgPath(matrix, 4);
  const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 ${viewBoxSize} ${viewBoxSize}" shape-rendering="crispEdges"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="${QR_COLORS.background}"/><path d="${path}" fill="${QR_COLORS.foreground}"/></svg>`;
  return `data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`;
}

export interface QrCodeSvgProps {
  value: string;
  size?: number;
  label?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

export const QrCodeSvg: React.FC<QrCodeSvgProps> = ({
  value,
  size = 180,
  label = 'AttendSure QR code',
  style,
}) => {
  const { viewBoxSize, path } = useMemo(() => {
    const matrix = generateQrMatrix(value);
    return buildQrSvgPath(matrix, 4);
  }, [value]);

  return (
    <svg
      width={size}
      height={size}
      viewBox={`0 0 ${viewBoxSize} ${viewBoxSize}`}
      shapeRendering="crispEdges"
      role="img"
      aria-label={label}
      style={{
        display: 'block',
        backgroundColor: QR_COLORS.background,
        borderRadius: 6,
        ...style,
      }}
    >
      <rect width={viewBoxSize} height={viewBoxSize} fill={QR_COLORS.background} />
      <path d={path} fill={QR_COLORS.foreground} />
    </svg>
  );
};

export default QrCodeSvg;

/**
 * AttendSure - Unified Semantic Status Badge
 * File: web/src/components/common/StatusBadge.tsx
 *
 * Uses centralized ThemeContext tokens for consistent Light, Dark, and High-Contrast rendering:
 *  - Green (Success): PRESENT, ON TIME, INSIDE, ACTIVE, ENROLLED, RETURNED, EXCUSED, IN
 *  - Amber (Warning): LATE, TARDY, AUTHORIZED OUTSIDE, ACTIVE PASS, TRANSFERRED OUT
 *  - Red   (Danger):  ABSENT, LOAFING ALERT, CONFIRMED LOAFING, OPEN, OVERDUE, CUTTING CLASS, DROPPED, LOCKED, OUT
 *  - Neutral:         OFF DUTY, OFFLINE, CANCELLED, INACTIVE, UNASSIGNED
 */

import React from 'react';
import { LogIn, LogOut, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle, Clock, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

interface StatusBadgeProps {
  status: string;
  type?: 'DIRECTION' | 'ATTENDANCE' | 'ACTIVE' | 'GENERIC';
  label?: string;
}

const GREEN_STATUSES = new Set([
  'IN',
  'PRESENT',
  'ON_TIME',
  'ON TIME',
  'INSIDE',
  'INSIDE_CAMPUS',
  'ACTIVE',
  'ENROLLED',
  'TRANSFERRED_IN',
  'RETURNED',
  'EXCUSED',
  'APPROVED',
  'BOUND',
]);

const AMBER_STATUSES = new Set([
  'LATE',
  'TARDY',
  'AUTHORIZED_OUTSIDE',
  'AUTHORIZED OUTSIDE',
  'ON_OFFICIAL_PASS',
  'ACTIVE_PASS',
  'ACTIVE PASS',
  'TRANSFERRED_OUT',
  'TRANSFERRED OUT',
  'PENDING',
  'WARNING',
]);

const RED_STATUSES = new Set([
  'OUT',
  'ABSENT',
  'LOAFING_ALERT',
  'LOAFING ALERT',
  'CONFIRMED_LOAFING',
  'CONFIRMED LOAFING',
  'OPEN',
  'OVERDUE',
  'CUTTING',
  'CUTTING_CLASS',
  'CUTTING CLASS',
  'DROPPED',
  'LOCKED',
  'OUTSIDE',
]);

const NEUTRAL_STATUSES = new Set([
  'OFF_DUTY',
  'OFF DUTY',
  'OFFLINE',
  'CANCELLED',
  'INACTIVE',
  'UNASSIGNED',
  'UNBOUND',
]);

export const StatusBadge: React.FC<StatusBadgeProps> = ({ status, type = 'GENERIC', label }) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const normalized = String(status || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const display = label || normalized.replace(/_/g, ' ');

  let bg = tokens.neutralBg;
  let text = tokens.textSecondary;
  let border = tokens.neutralBorder;
  let icon: React.ReactNode = null;

  if (type === 'DIRECTION' && (normalized === 'IN' || normalized === 'OUT')) {
    if (normalized === 'IN') {
      bg = tokens.successLight;
      text = brand.success;
      border = brand.success;
      icon = <LogIn size={11} />;
    } else {
      bg = tokens.dangerLight;
      text = brand.danger;
      border = brand.danger;
      icon = <LogOut size={11} />;
    }
  } else if (GREEN_STATUSES.has(normalized)) {
    bg = tokens.successLight;
    text = brand.success;
    border = brand.success;
    icon = normalized === 'IN' ? <LogIn size={11} /> : normalized === 'EXCUSED' ? <ShieldCheck size={11} /> : <CheckCircle2 size={11} />;
  } else if (AMBER_STATUSES.has(normalized)) {
    bg = tokens.warningLight;
    text = brand.warning;
    border = brand.warning;
    icon = <Clock size={11} />;
  } else if (RED_STATUSES.has(normalized)) {
    bg = tokens.dangerLight;
    text = brand.danger;
    border = brand.danger;
    icon = normalized === 'OUT' ? <LogOut size={11} /> : <AlertTriangle size={11} />;
  } else if (NEUTRAL_STATUSES.has(normalized) || (type === 'ACTIVE' && normalized !== 'ACTIVE')) {
    bg = tokens.neutralBg;
    text = tokens.textSecondary;
    border = tokens.neutralBorder;
    icon = normalized === 'INACTIVE' || normalized === 'CANCELLED' ? <XCircle size={11} /> : null;
  }

  return (
    <span
      style={{
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 4,
        padding: '3px 8px',
        borderRadius: 6,
        fontSize: '0.68rem',
        fontWeight: 800,
        backgroundColor: bg,
        color: text,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderStyle: 'solid',
        borderColor: border,
        letterSpacing: '0.2px',
        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
      }}
    >
      {icon}
      <span>{display}</span>
    </span>
  );
};

export default StatusBadge;

/**
 * AttendSure - Instant-Hydrating School Dashboard
 * File: web/src/components/dashboard/DashboardView.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache, subscribeApiCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { canViewTab, getCurrentUserFromStorage } from '../../utils/permissions';
import { StatsCard } from '../common/StatsCard';
import {
  UserCheck,
  UserX,
  Clock,
  Globe,
  RefreshCw,
  Scan,
  TrendingUp,
  Inbox,
  Database,
  Ticket,
  CalendarCheck,

  ChevronRight,
  Sparkles,
  QrCode,
  BookOpen,
  MapPin,
  ShieldAlert,

interface DashboardViewProps {
  isServerOnline?: boolean;
  userRole?: string;
  onStatusChange?: (online: boolean) => void;
  onManualRefresh?: () => void;
  onNavigateTab?: (tab: string, report?: string) => void;
}

interface HourlyBar {
  hour: string;
  count: number;
  height: number;
  is_peak: boolean;
}

interface RecentScanItem {
  person_name: string;
  grade_section: string;
  scan_time: string;
}

interface DashboardState {
  total_students: number;
  students_present: number;
  students_absent: number;
  students_cutting: number;
  attendance_rate: number;
  teachers_on_duty: number;
  total_teachers: number;
  classroom_scans_today: number;
  active_exit_passes: number;
  open_loafing_incidents: number;
  hourly_scans: HourlyBar[];
  recent_scans: RecentScanItem[];
}

const EMPTY_DASHBOARD: DashboardState = {
  total_students: 0,
  students_present: 0,
  students_absent: 0,
  students_cutting: 0,
  attendance_rate: 0,
  teachers_on_duty: 0,
  total_teachers: 0,
  classroom_scans_today: 0,
  active_exit_passes: 0,
  open_loafing_incidents: 0,
  hourly_scans: [],
  recent_scans: [],
};

const normalizeDashboardPayload = (d: Record<string, any> | undefined): DashboardState => {
  if (!d) return EMPTY_DASHBOARD;
  const total = Number(d.total_students) || 0;
  const present = Number(d.students_present) || 0;
  const rawHourly = Array.isArray(d.hourly_scans) ? d.hourly_scans : [];
  const maxCount = Math.max(...rawHourly.map((h: any) => Number(h.count) || 0), 1);

  return {
    total_students: total,
    students_present: present,
    students_absent: Number(d.students_absent) || Math.max(0, total - present),
    students_cutting: Number(d.students_cutting) || 0,
    attendance_rate: total > 0 ? Math.round((present / total) * 100) : Number(d.attendance_rate) || 0,
    teachers_on_duty: Number(d.teachers_on_duty) || 0,
    total_teachers: Number(d.total_teachers) || 0,
    classroom_scans_today: Number(d.classroom_scans_today) || 0,
    active_exit_passes: Number(d.active_exit_passes) || 0,
    open_loafing_incidents: Number(d.open_loafing_incidents) || 0,
    hourly_scans: rawHourly.map((h: any) => {
      const c = Number(h.count) || 0;
      return {
        hour: String(h.hour || ''),
        count: c,
        height: c > 0 ? Math.round((c / maxCount) * 100) : 0,
        is_peak: Boolean(h.is_peak),
      };
    }),
    recent_scans: Array.isArray(d.recent_scans) ? d.recent_scans : [],
  };
};

export const DashboardView: React.FC<DashboardViewProps> = ({
  isServerOnline = true,
  userRole,
  onStatusChange,
  onManualRefresh,
  onNavigateTab,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();

  const warmPayload = useMemo(
    () => peekApiCache<Record<string, any>>(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard),
    []
  );

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => warmPayload === undefined);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastSyncTime, setLastSyncTime] = useState<string>(() =>
    warmPayload ? new Date().toLocaleTimeString() : ''
  );
  const [fetchFailed, setFetchFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [calendarDate, setCalendarDate] = useState<Date>(() => new Date());
  const [data, setData] = useState<DashboardState>(() => normalizeDashboardPayload(warmPayload));

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const currentUser = { ...getCurrentUserFromStorage(), ...(userRole ? { role: userRole } : {}) };
  const role = (currentUser.role || 'TEACHER').toUpperCase();
  const isTeacher = role === 'TEACHER';
  const isOnline = isServerOnline && !fetchFailed;

  useEffect(() => {
    return subscribeApiCache(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard, undefined, (freshRaw) => {
      setData(normalizeDashboardPayload(freshRaw as Record<string, any>));
      setLastSyncTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, []);

  const navigateTo = (tab: string, report?: string) => {
    if (onNavigateTab) {
      onNavigateTab(tab, report);
      return;
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendsure:navigate', { detail: report ? { tab, report } : tab }));
  };

  const fetchDashboardData = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      try {
        if (!silent) setRefreshing(true);
        const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard, {
          params: {
            silent: silent ? '1' : undefined,
            ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        if (res.data) {
          setFetchFailed(false);
          setData(normalizeDashboardPayload(res.data));
          setLastSyncTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
          onStatusChange?.(true);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (
          controller.signal.aborted ||
          anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
          anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
          anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
        ) {

        }
        setFetchFailed(true);
        onStatusChange?.(false);
      } finally {

          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [onStatusChange]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchDashboardData(warmPayload !== undefined, false);
    const handleAttendanceUpdated = () => {
      void fetchDashboardData(true, true);
    };
    window.addEventListener('attendsure:attendance-updated', handleAttendanceUpdated);
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {

      }

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('attendsure:attendance-updated', handleAttendanceUpdated);
      clearInterval(timer);
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchDashboardData, warmPayload]);

  const calendarDays = useMemo(() => {
    const y = calendarDate.getFullYear();
    const m = calendarDate.getMonth();
    const firstDay = new Date(y, m, 1).getDay();
    const totalDays = new Date(y, m + 1, 0).getDate();
    const now = new Date();
    return [
      ...Array.from({ length: firstDay }, () => ({ day: null as number | null, isToday: false })),
      ...Array.from({ length: totalDays }, (_, i) => ({
        day: i + 1,
        isToday: now.getFullYear() === y && now.getMonth() === m && now.getDate() === i + 1,
      })),

  }, [calendarDate]);

  const quickActions = [
    {

    },
    {

    {

  if (loading) {

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useApiResource } from '../../hooks/useApiResource';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { getCurrentUserFromStorage, isSchoolLeader } from '../../utils/permissions';

interface EmergencyStudent {
  student_id: number;
  lrn: string;
  full_name: string;
  section: string;
  guardian_contact?: string;
}

interface EmergencyTeacher {
  teacher_id: number;
  employee_id: string;
  full_name: string;
  department: string;
}

interface EmergencyRollCallData {
  timestamp: string;
  total_people_on_campus: number;
  students_count: number;
  teachers_count: number;
  students: EmergencyStudent[];
  teachers: EmergencyTeacher[];
}

export const EnterpriseSDGWidget: React.FC = () => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const isLeader = isSchoolLeader(getCurrentUserFromStorage());

  const { data: impactData, loading: loadingImpact, reload: reloadImpact } = useApiResource<any>(
    API_ROUTES.reports.sdgImpact,
    null
  );
  const { data: sardoData, loading: loadingSardo, reload: reloadSardo } = useApiResource<any>(
    API_ROUTES.reports.dropoutRisk,
    null
  );

  const [showAtRiskList, setShowAtRiskList] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [rollCallOpen, setRollCallOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [rollCallLoading, setRollCallLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [rollCallData, setRollCallData] = useState<EmergencyRollCallData | null>(null);
  const [rollCallSearch, setRollCallSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [safeStudentIds, setSafeStudentIds] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});
  const [exportingFormat, setExportingFormat] = useState<'json' | 'csv' | null>(null);
  const [maskPersonalIds, setMaskPersonalIds] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [exportStatus, setExportStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const rollCallAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const exportAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const revokeTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      rollCallAbortRef.current?.abort();
      exportAbortRef.current?.abort();
      if (revokeTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(revokeTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const loading = loadingImpact || loadingSardo;

  const handleRefresh = () => {
    void reloadImpact(false, true);
    void reloadSardo(false, true);
  };

  const handleOpenEmergencyRollCall = async () => {
    rollCallAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    rollCallAbortRef.current = controller;

    setRollCallOpen(true);
    setRollCallLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.campus.rollCall, {
        params: { nocache: 1 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      setRollCallData(res.data);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      setRollCallData(null);
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setRollCallLoading(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleCloseEmergencyRollCall = () => {
    rollCallAbortRef.current?.abort();
    setRollCallOpen(false);
  };

  const toggleStudentSafe = (studentId: number) => {
    setSafeStudentIds((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [studentId]: !prev[studentId],
    }));
  };

  const handleDivisionExport = async (exportFmt: 'json' | 'csv') => {
    exportAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    exportAbortRef.current = controller;

    setExportingFormat(exportFmt);
    setExportStatus(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.reports.divisionExport, {
        params: {
          days: 30,
          anonymize: maskPersonalIds ? 1 : 0,
          export_format: exportFmt,
        },
        responseType: exportFmt === 'csv' ? 'text' : 'json',
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const modeTag = maskPersonalIds ? 'privacy_masked' : 'official';
      const content =
        exportFmt === 'csv'
          ? String(res.data || '')
          : JSON.stringify(res.data, null, 2);
      const mime = exportFmt === 'csv' ? 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' : 'application/json';
      const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mime });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `attendsure_deped_division_export_${modeTag}_${today}.${exportFmt}`;
      a.click();
      if (revokeTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(revokeTimerRef.current);
      revokeTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      }, 1000);

      const eventCount =
        exportFmt === 'json' ? res.data?.recordCounts?.studentSchoolAttendanceEvents ?? 0 : null;
      setExportStatus(
        exportFmt === 'csv'
          ? `Downloaded DepEd Division Data Export (.CSV • ${
              maskPersonalIds ? 'Privacy-Masked' : 'Full Official'
            }).`
          : `Downloaded DepEd Division Data Export (.JSON • ${eventCount} attendance events • ${
              maskPersonalIds ? 'Privacy-Masked' : 'Full Official'
            }).`
      );
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      setExportStatus(
        extractApiError(
          err,
          'DepEd Division Data Export requires School Leadership permissions (Admin / Principal / Department Head).'
        )
      );
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setExportingFormat(null);
      }
    }
  };

  const filteredRollCallStudents = useMemo(() => {
    const list = rollCallData?.students || [];
    const q = rollCallSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return list;
    return list.filter(
      (s) =>
        s.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        s.lrn.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        s.section.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [rollCallData, rollCallSearch]);

  const safeCount = useMemo(() => {
    if (!rollCallData?.students) return 0;
    return rollCallData.students.filter((s) => Boolean(safeStudentIds[s.student_id])).length;
  }, [rollCallData, safeStudentIds]);

  const eduMetrics = impactData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_4_quality_education;
  const inclusionMetrics = impactData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_5_and_10_equality_and_inclusion;
  const workloadMetrics = impactData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_8_decent_work;
  const paperlessMetrics = impactData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_12_and_13_climate_and_sustainability;
  const governanceMetrics = impactData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_16_accountable_institutions;
  const atRiskStudents = Array.isArray(sardoData?.at_risk_students) ? sardoData.at_risk_students : [];

  return (
    <div style={{ ...containerStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle }}>
      <div style={headerBarStyle}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <span style={{ ...badgePillStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight, color: brand.primary }}>
              <ShieldAlert size={13} /> DEPED CAMPUS SAFETY &amp; SARDO MONITORING
            </span>
            <span style={{ ...privacyPillStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.successLight, color: brand.success }}>

          {isLeader && (

import React from 'react';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { Building2 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface FooterProps {
  schoolName?: string;
  schoolId?: string;
  divisionOrCity?: string;
  isDatabaseConnected?: boolean;
  isGateSystemOnline?: boolean;
}

export const Footer: React.FC<FooterProps> = ({
  schoolName,
  schoolId,
  divisionOrCity,
}) => {
  const { school } = useSchool();
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const activeSchoolName = schoolName?.trim() || school.school_name?.trim() || 'AttendSure School Portal';
  const activeSchoolId = schoolId?.trim() || school.school_id?.trim() || '—';
  const activeDivision = divisionOrCity?.trim() || school.division?.trim() || '';

  return (
    <footer
      style={{
        width: '100%',
        minHeight: 42,
        flexShrink: 0,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        padding: '8px clamp(12px, 2vw, 22px)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        flexWrap: 'wrap',
        gap: '8px 18px',
        fontSize: '0.73rem',
        color: tokens.textSecondary,
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
      }}
    >
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8 }}>
        <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
          <Building2 size={14} color={brand.primary} />
          <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{activeSchoolName}</strong>
        </span>
        <span style={{ color: tokens.borderStrong }}>|</span>
        <span style={{ color: tokens.textMuted }}>School ID: {activeSchoolId}</span>
        {activeDivision && (
          <>
            <span style={{ color: tokens.borderStrong }}>|</span>
            <span style={{ color: tokens.textMuted }}>{activeDivision}</span>
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 16 }}>
        <span style={{ color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: '0.68rem' }}>&copy; 2026 AttendSure &bull; TechBlazer</span>
      </div>
    </footer>
  );
};

export default Footer;
