export type TabBadgeCounts = Partial<Record<NavItemKey, number>>;

export interface HeaderProps {
  title: string;
  isSystemOnline: boolean;
  session: UserSession | null;
  userPhoto?: string | null;
  schoolName?: string;
  schoolId?: string;
  schoolLogo?: string | null;
  badgeCounts?: TabBadgeCounts;
  alarmsEnabled?: boolean;
  onToggleAlarms?: (next: boolean) => void;
  onTestAlarm?: (kind: AlarmKind) => void;
  onLogout: () => void;
  onNavigateTab: (tab: NavItemKey) => void;
  onOpenProfile: () => void;
}

interface CurrentUserAccountData {
  id?: number;
  username?: string;
  employee_id?: string | null;
  position?: string | null;
  department?: string | null;
  qr_payload?: string | null;
}

const sanitizePlainText = (raw: unknown, maxLen = 100): string =>
  String(raw ?? '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLen);

export const Header: React.FC<HeaderProps> = ({
  title,
  isSystemOnline,
  session,
  userPhoto,
  schoolName,
  schoolId,
  alarmsEnabled = true,
  onToggleAlarms,
  onTestAlarm,
  onLogout,
  onNavigateTab,
  onOpenProfile,
}) => {
  const themeCtx = useTheme();
  const { mode, tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = themeCtx;

  const handleToggleTheme = useCallback(() => {
    const rawTheme = themeCtx as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof rawTheme.toggleTheme === 'function') {
      (rawTheme.toggleTheme as () => void)();
    } else if (typeof rawTheme.toggleMode === 'function') {
      (rawTheme.toggleMode as () => void)();
    } else if (typeof rawTheme.setMode === 'function') {
      (rawTheme.setMode as (next: 'light' | 'dark') => void)(mode === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark');
    }
  }, [themeCtx, mode]);

  const [isPassModalOpen, setIsPassModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPassPageSetupOpen, setIsPassPageSetupOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [savingPassPdf, setSavingPassPdf] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [passPageConfig, setPassPageConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>({
    ...DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP,
    layoutMode: 'pages',
    orientation: 'portrait',
    paperSize: 'letter',
    pageColor: QR_COLORS.background,
    marginPreset: 'narrow',
    margins: { top: 0.5, right: 0.5, bottom: 0.5, left: 0.5 },
    headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
  });
  const passCardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isUserMenuOpen, setIsUserMenuOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isAlarmMenuOpen, setIsAlarmMenuOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [alertPermState, setAlertPermState] = useState<string>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('Notification' in window)) return 'unsupported';
    return window.Notification.permission;
  });
  const { copied: copiedId, copy } = useCopyFeedback();

  const cachedMe = peekApiCache<CurrentUserAccountData>(API_ROUTES.accounts.me);
  const [accountMeta, setAccountMeta] = useState<CurrentUserAccountData | null>(cachedMe || null);

  const userMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const alarmMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const roleUpper = useMemo(
    () =>
      sanitizePlainText(session?.role || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'TEACHER', 30).toUpperCase(),
    [session?.role]
  );

  const canOpenSettings = canViewTab(
    { ...getCurrentUserFromStorage(), role: roleUpper },
    'settings'
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session?.token) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get<CurrentUserAccountData>(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, { signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted && res.data) {
          setAccountMeta(res.data);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [session?.token]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isUserMenuOpen && !isAlarmMenuOpen) return;

    const handleOutsideClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (userMenuRef.current && !userMenuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsUserMenuOpen(false);
      }
      if (alarmMenuRef.current && !alarmMenuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsAlarmMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };
    const handleEsc = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsUserMenuOpen(false);
        setIsAlarmMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleOutsideClick);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleOutsideClick);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
    };
  }, [isUserMenuOpen, isAlarmMenuOpen]);

  const displaySchoolName = sanitizePlainText(schoolName, 140) || 'AttendSure Campus';
  const displaySchoolId = sanitizePlainText(schoolId, 30);
  const displayUserName =
    sanitizePlainText(session?.teacher_name || session?.username, 100) || 'Teacher';

  const badgeIdValue = useMemo(() => {
    const empId = sanitizePlainText(accountMeta?.employee_id, 40);
    if (empId) return empId;
    const uname = sanitizePlainText(accountMeta?.username || session?.username, 40);
    return uname || `STAFF-${session?.user_id || 1}`;
  }, [accountMeta, session?.username, session?.user_id]);

  const qrBadgeValue = useMemo(() => {
    const signed = sanitizePlainText(accountMeta?.qr_payload, 240);
    if (signed) return signed;
    return `ATTENDSURE:TEACHER:${badgeIdValue}`;
  }, [accountMeta?.qr_payload, badgeIdValue]);

  const handleCopyIdentifier = async () => {
    if (!badgeIdValue) return;
    await copy(badgeIdValue, 'id');
  };

  const cleanHeaderTitle = useMemo(() => {
    const prefix = displaySchoolName ? `${displaySchoolName} • ` : '';
    return title.startsWith(prefix) ? title.slice(prefix.length) : title;
  }, [title, displaySchoolName]);

  return (
    <>
      <header
        className="no-print"
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '10px 20px',

        }}
      >

              fontSize: '1.05rem',
              fontWeight: 800,
              color: tokens.textPrimary,
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
            }}
          >
            {cleanHeaderTitle}
          </h1>
          <div
            style={{
              fontSize: '0.72rem',
              color: tokens.textSecondary,
              marginTop: 2,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 6,
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
            }}
          >
            <span>{displaySchoolName}</span>

            <span>School ID: {displaySchoolId || '—'}</span>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <div

          <div

          <div ref={alarmMenuRef} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>

const getSchoolAbbreviation = (name?: string): string => {
  if (!name || !name.trim()) return 'AS';
  const ignore = new Set(['of', 'the', 'and', 'in', 'at', 'for', 'to', 'ng', 'sa']);
  const words = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter((w) => !ignore.has(w.toLowerCase()));
  return words.length === 1
    ? words[0].slice(0, 4).toUpperCase()
    : words
        .map((w) => w[0])
        .join('')
        .toUpperCase()
        .slice(0, 6);
};

const formatBadge = (count?: number): string => {
  if (!count || count <= 0) return '';
  return count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
};

export const sanitizeAcademicField = (raw: string, maxLength = 100): string =>
  Array.from(String(raw || ''))
    .filter((ch) => {
      const code = ch.charCodeAt(0);
      return code >= 32 && code !== 127 && ch !== '<' && ch !== '>';
    })
    .join('')
    .slice(0, maxLength);

export const extractTeacherId = (item: AcademicScheduleItem | null | undefined): string => {
  if (!item) return '';
  const candidate =
    item.teacher_id ??
    (typeof item.teacher === 'object' && item.teacher ? item.teacher.id : item.teacher) ??
    '';
  return candidate !== null && candidate !== undefined ? String(candidate) : '';
};

export const extractTeacherName = (
  item: AcademicScheduleItem | null | undefined,
  teacherList: AcademicTeacherOption[]
): string => {
  if (!item) return 'Unassigned';
  const directName =
    item.teacher_name ||
    (typeof item.teacher === 'object' && item.teacher
      ? item.teacher.full_name || item.teacher.name
      : null);
  if (directName && String(directName).trim()) return String(directName).trim();

  const tid = extractTeacherId(item);
  if (tid) {
    const match = teacherList.find((t) => String(t.id) === tid);
    if (match) return match.full_name || match.name || 'Unassigned';
  }
  return 'Unassigned';
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Class Period & Subject Teacher Schedule CRUD Sub-Form
 * File: web/src/components/modals/academic/SchedulePeriodForm.tsx

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../../context/ThemeContext';
import { Button } from '../../ui/Button';
import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Edit2, Loader2, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  DAY_SCHEDULE_OPTIONS,
  extractTeacherId,
  extractTeacherName,
  formCardStyle,
  inputStyle,
  labelStyle,
  sanitizeAcademicField,
  tableContainerStyle,
  type AcademicScheduleItem,
  type AcademicSectionItem,
  type AcademicSubjectItem,
  type AcademicTeacherOption,
} from './academicShared';

export interface ScheduleFormState {
  id: number | null;
  section_id: string;
  subject_id: string;
  teacher_id: string;
  room_id: string;
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string;
  days_of_week: string;
}

const EMPTY_SCHEDULE_FORM: ScheduleFormState = {
  id: null,
  section_id: '',
  subject_id: '',
  teacher_id: '',
  room_id: '',
  start_time: '07:30',
  end_time: '08:30',
  days_of_week: 'ALL_WEEKDAYS',
};

const EMPTY_PERIOD_CONFLICT = {
  checking: false,
  has_conflict: false,
  time_error: null as string | null,
  section_conflict: null as string | null,
  teacher_conflict: null as string | null,
  room_conflict: null as string | null,
};

interface SchedulePeriodFormProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  initialEditItem?: AcademicScheduleItem | null;
  sections: AcademicSectionItem[];
  subjects: AcademicSubjectItem[];
  schedules: AcademicScheduleItem[];
  teacherList: AcademicTeacherOption[];
  teachingTeachers: AcademicTeacherOption[];
  onReload: () => Promise<void>;
  onDelete: (route: string, id: number, label: string) => void;
  onStatus: (error: string | null, success: string | null) => void;
}

const mapPeriodToForm = (item: AcademicScheduleItem): ScheduleFormState => {
  const secId =
    item.section_id ?? (typeof item.section === 'object' && item.section ? item.section.id : item.section) ?? '';
  const subId =
    item.subject_id ?? (typeof item.subject === 'object' && item.subject ? item.subject.id : item.subject) ?? '';
  const roomId = item.room_id ?? (typeof item.room === 'object' && item.room ? item.room.id : item.room) ?? '';

  return {
    id: item.id || null,
    section_id: String(secId || ''),
    subject_id: String(subId || ''),
    teacher_id: extractTeacherId(item),
    room_id: typeof roomId === 'number' || /^\d+$/.test(String(roomId)) ? String(roomId) : '',
    start_time: item.start_time ? String(item.start_time).slice(0, 5) : '07:30',
    end_time: item.end_time ? String(item.end_time).slice(0, 5) : '08:30',
    days_of_week: item.day_of_week || item.days_of_week || 'ALL_WEEKDAYS',
  };
};

export const SchedulePeriodForm: React.FC<SchedulePeriodFormProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  initialEditItem,
  sections,
  subjects,
  schedules,
  teacherList,
  teachingTeachers,
  onReload,
  onDelete,
  onStatus,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [scheduleForm, setScheduleForm] = useState<ScheduleFormState>(() =>
    initialEditItem ? mapPeriodToForm(initialEditItem) : EMPTY_SCHEDULE_FORM
  );
  const [asyncConflict, setAsyncConflict] = useState<{
    key: string;
    state: typeof EMPTY_PERIOD_CONFLICT;
  }>({ key: '', state: EMPTY_PERIOD_CONFLICT });
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const checkAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const hasValidRange = Boolean(
    isOpen &&
      scheduleForm.start_time &&
      scheduleForm.end_time &&
      scheduleForm.start_time < scheduleForm.end_time &&
      (scheduleForm.section_id || scheduleForm.teacher_id)
  );
  const conflictKey = hasValidRange
    ? JSON.stringify([
        scheduleForm.id,
        scheduleForm.section_id,
        scheduleForm.subject_id,
        scheduleForm.teacher_id,
        scheduleForm.days_of_week,
        scheduleForm.start_time,
        scheduleForm.end_time,
      ])
    : '';

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!conflictKey) {
      checkAbortRef.current?.abort();
      return;
    }

    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      checkAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      checkAbortRef.current = controller;
      setAsyncConflict((prev) => ({
        key: conflictKey,
        state: {
          ...(prev.key === conflictKey ? prev.state : EMPTY_PERIOD_CONFLICT),
          checking: true,
          time_error: null,
        },
      }));
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.checkConflict, {
          params: {
            type: 'period',
            section_id: scheduleForm.section_id || undefined,
            subject_id: scheduleForm.subject_id || undefined,
            teacher_id: scheduleForm.teacher_id || undefined,
            day_of_week: scheduleForm.days_of_week || 'ALL_WEEKDAYS',
            start_time: scheduleForm.start_time,
            end_time: scheduleForm.end_time,
            exclude_id: scheduleForm.id || undefined,
            nocache: 1,
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted || !res.data) return;
        setAsyncConflict({
          key: conflictKey,
          state: {
            checking: false,
            has_conflict: Boolean(res.data.has_conflict),
            time_error: res.data.time_error || null,
            section_conflict: res.data.section_conflict || null,
            teacher_conflict: res.data.teacher_conflict || null,
            room_conflict: res.data.room_conflict || null,
          },
        });
      } catch {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setAsyncConflict((prev) => ({
            key: conflictKey,
            state: {
              ...(prev.key === conflictKey ? prev.state : EMPTY_PERIOD_CONFLICT),
              checking: false,
            },
          }));
        }
      }
    }, 300);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      checkAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [
    conflictKey,
    scheduleForm.id,
    scheduleForm.section_id,
    scheduleForm.subject_id,
    scheduleForm.teacher_id,
    scheduleForm.days_of_week,
    scheduleForm.start_time,
    scheduleForm.end_time,
  ]);

  const periodConflict =
    isOpen &&
    scheduleForm.start_time &&
    scheduleForm.end_time &&
    scheduleForm.start_time >= scheduleForm.end_time
      ? {
          ...EMPTY_PERIOD_CONFLICT,
          has_conflict: true,
          time_error: 'End time must be later than start time.',
        }
      : conflictKey && asyncConflict.key === conflictKey
        ? asyncConflict.state
        : EMPTY_PERIOD_CONFLICT;

  const scheduleBlocked = periodConflict.checking || periodConflict.has_conflict;

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!scheduleForm.section_id) {
      onStatus('Please select a class section.', null);
      return;
    }
    if (!scheduleForm.subject_id) {
      onStatus('Please select a subject.', null);
      return;
    }
    if (scheduleForm.start_time >= scheduleForm.end_time) {
      onStatus('End time must be later than start time.', null);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    onStatus(null, null);

    const teacherPk = scheduleForm.teacher_id ? Number(scheduleForm.teacher_id) : null;
    const payload = {
      section: Number(scheduleForm.section_id),
      section_id: Number(scheduleForm.section_id),
      subject: Number(scheduleForm.subject_id),
      subject_id: Number(scheduleForm.subject_id),
      teacher: teacherPk,
      teacher_id: teacherPk,
      start_time: scheduleForm.start_time,
      end_time: scheduleForm.end_time,
      day_of_week: sanitizeAcademicField(scheduleForm.days_of_week || 'ALL_WEEKDAYS', 30).trim() || 'ALL_WEEKDAYS',
    };

    try {
      if (scheduleForm.id) {
        await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.periods}${scheduleForm.id}/`, payload);
        onStatus(null, 'Class schedule and Subject Teacher updated.');
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.periods, payload);
        onStatus(null, 'New class period and Subject Teacher saved.');
      }
      setScheduleForm(EMPTY_SCHEDULE_FORM);
      await onReload();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      onStatus(extractApiError(err, 'Failed to save class schedule.'), null);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const hasTimeError = Boolean(
    periodConflict.time_error || periodConflict.section_conflict || periodConflict.room_conflict
  );

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
      <form onSubmit={handleSave} style={formCardStyle(tokens)}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, marginBottom: 8 }}>
          {scheduleForm.id ? 'Edit Class Schedule & Teacher' : 'Add Subject Period & Assign Teacher'}
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Class Section *</label>
            <select
              required
              value={scheduleForm.section_id}
              onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, section_id: e.target.value })}
              style={inputStyle(tokens)}
            >
              <option value="">Select Section</option>
              {sections.map((s) => (
                <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                  {s.name} ({s.grade_level_name || (typeof s.grade_level === 'object' ? s.grade_level?.name : '') || 'Section'})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject *</label>
            <select
              required
              value={scheduleForm.subject_id}
              onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, subject_id: e.target.value })}
              style={inputStyle(tokens)}
            >
              <option value="">Select Subject</option>
              {subjects.map((sub) => (
                <option key={sub.id} value={sub.id}>
                  {sub.code} - {sub.title}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Teacher</label>
            <select
              value={scheduleForm.teacher_id}
              onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, teacher_id: e.target.value })}
              style={{
                ...inputStyle(tokens),
                borderColor: periodConflict.teacher_conflict ? brand.danger : tokens.borderStrong,
              }}
            >
              <option value="">(None / Unassigned)</option>
              {teachingTeachers.map((t) => (
                <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                  {t.full_name || t.name} {t.employee_id ? `(${t.employee_id})` : ''}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Class Days *</label>
            <select
              value={scheduleForm.days_of_week}
              onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, days_of_week: e.target.value })}
              style={inputStyle(tokens)}
            >
              {DAY_SCHEDULE_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>
                  {opt.label}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Start Time</label>
            <input
              type="time"
              required
              value={scheduleForm.start_time}
              onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, start_time: e.target.value })}
              style={{ ...inputStyle(tokens), borderColor: hasTimeError ? brand.danger : tokens.borderStrong }}
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>End Time</label>
            <input
              type="time"
              required
              value={scheduleForm.end_time}
              onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, end_time: e.target.value })}
              style={{ ...inputStyle(tokens), borderColor: hasTimeError ? brand.danger : tokens.borderStrong }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {periodConflict.has_conflict && (
          <div
            style={{
              marginTop: 10,
              padding: '9px 12px',
              borderRadius: 8,
              backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
              border: `1px solid ${brand.danger}`,
              color: brand.danger,
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              gap: 5,
              fontSize: '0.75rem',
              fontWeight: 700,
            }}
          >
            {[
              periodConflict.time_error,
              periodConflict.section_conflict,
              periodConflict.teacher_conflict,
              periodConflict.room_conflict,
            ]
              .filter(Boolean)
              .map((msg) => (
                <div key={msg} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                  <AlertCircle size={14} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
                  <span>{msg}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {!periodConflict.checking && !periodConflict.has_conflict && scheduleForm.section_id && (
          <div
            style={{
              marginTop: 8,
              fontSize: '0.72rem',
              color: brand.success,
              fontWeight: 700,
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 5,
            }}
          >
            <CheckCircle2 size={13} />
            <span>No section, teacher, or classroom schedule conflicts found.</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 12 }}>
          {scheduleForm.id && (
            <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" type="button" onClick={() => setScheduleForm(EMPTY_SCHEDULE_FORM)}>
              Cancel Edit
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="submit" disabled={submitting || scheduleBlocked}>
            {submitting || periodConflict.checking ? (
              <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} />
            ) : scheduleForm.id ? (
              'Save Changes'
            ) : (
              'Create Class Period'
            )}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>

      <div style={tableContainerStyle(tokens)}>
        <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
          <thead>
            <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Section</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Subject</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Subject Teacher</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Time</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Actions</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {schedules.map((sc) => {
              const secName =
                sc.section_name || (typeof sc.section === 'object' ? sc.section?.name : '') || 'Section';
              const subCode =
                sc.subject_code || (typeof sc.subject === 'object' ? sc.subject?.code : '') || 'SUB';
              const teacherName = extractTeacherName(sc, teacherList);

              return (
                <tr key={sc.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                  <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{secName}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700 }}>{subCode}</td>
                  <td
                    style={{
                      padding: '8px 10px',

                      fontWeight: 600,
                    }}
                  >
                    {teacherName}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                    {String(sc.start_time).slice(0, 5)} - {String(sc.end_time).slice(0, 5)}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setScheduleForm(mapPeriodToForm(sc))}
                      style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, cursor: 'pointer', marginRight: 8 }}
                      title="Edit Schedule & Teacher"
                      aria-label={`Edit schedule ${subCode}`}
                    >
                      <Edit2 size={13} />

                      onClick={() => onDelete(API_ROUTES.school.periods, sc.id, 'Class Schedule')}

  name: '',
  grade_level: '',
  adviser_id: '',
  room_number: '',
  capacity: 45,

};

const mapSectionToForm = (item?: AcademicSectionItem | null): SectionFormState => {
  if (!item) return EMPTY_SECTION_FORM;
  const advId =
    item.adviser_id ??
    (typeof item.adviser === 'object' && item.adviser ? item.adviser.id : item.adviser) ??
    '';
  const gradeId =
    item.grade_level_id ??
    (typeof item.grade_level === 'object' && item.grade_level
      ? item.grade_level.id
      : item.grade_level) ??
    '';

  return {
    id: item.id || null,
    name: item.name || item.section_name || '',
    grade_level: String(gradeId || ''),
    adviser_id: String(advId || ''),
    room_number: item.room_number || item.room_name || '',
    capacity: item.capacity || 45,
    allow_multiple_advisories: false,
  };
};

const EMPTY_CONFLICT = {
  checking: false,
  name_taken: false,
  name_message: '',
  adviser_conflict: {
    has_existing_advisory: false,
    existing_sections: [] as string[],
    can_handle_classes: true,
    message: '',
  },
  room_in_use_by_sections: [] as string[],
  room_message: '',
};

interface SectionAdviserFormProps {

export const SectionAdviserForm: React.FC<SectionAdviserFormProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  initialEditItem,
  grades,
  sections,
  teacherList,
  teachingTeachers,
  onReload,
  onDelete,
  onStatus,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [sectionForm, setSectionForm] = useState<SectionFormState>(() =>
    mapSectionToForm(initialEditItem)
  );
  const [asyncConflict, setAsyncConflict] = useState<{
    key: string;
    state: typeof EMPTY_CONFLICT;
  }>({ key: '', state: EMPTY_CONFLICT });
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const checkAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const cleanName = sanitizeAcademicField(sectionForm.name, 80).trim();
  const cleanRoom = sanitizeAcademicField(sectionForm.room_number, 50).trim();
  const shouldCheck = Boolean(isOpen && (cleanName || sectionForm.adviser_id || cleanRoom));
  const conflictKey = shouldCheck
    ? JSON.stringify([
        sectionForm.id,
        cleanName,
        sectionForm.grade_level,
        sectionForm.adviser_id,
        cleanRoom,
      ])
    : '';

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!conflictKey) {
      checkAbortRef.current?.abort();
      return;
    }

    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      checkAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      checkAbortRef.current = controller;
      setAsyncConflict((prev) => ({
        key: conflictKey,
        state: {
          ...(prev.key === conflictKey ? prev.state : EMPTY_CONFLICT),
          checking: true,
        },
      }));
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.checkConflict, {
          params: {
            type: 'section',
            name: cleanName || undefined,
            grade_level: sectionForm.grade_level || undefined,
            adviser_id: sectionForm.adviser_id || undefined,
            room_name: cleanRoom || undefined,
            exclude_id: sectionForm.id || undefined,
            nocache: 1,
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted || !res.data) return;
        setAsyncConflict({
          key: conflictKey,
          state: {
            checking: false,
            name_taken: Boolean(res.data.name_taken),
            name_message: String(res.data.name_message || ''),
            adviser_conflict: {
              has_existing_advisory: Boolean(res.data.adviser_conflict?.has_existing_advisory),
              existing_sections: Array.isArray(res.data.adviser_conflict?.existing_sections)
                ? res.data.adviser_conflict.existing_sections
                : [],
              can_handle_classes: res.data.adviser_conflict?.can_handle_classes !== false,
              message: String(res.data.adviser_conflict?.message || ''),
            },
            room_in_use_by_sections: Array.isArray(res.data.room_in_use_by_sections)
              ? res.data.room_in_use_by_sections
              : [],
            room_message: String(res.data.room_message || ''),
          },
        });
      } catch {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setAsyncConflict((prev) => ({
            key: conflictKey,
            state: {
              ...(prev.key === conflictKey ? prev.state : EMPTY_CONFLICT),
              checking: false,
            },
          }));
        }
      }
    }, 300);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      checkAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [conflictKey, cleanName, cleanRoom, sectionForm.id, sectionForm.grade_level, sectionForm.adviser_id]);

  const sectionConflict =
    conflictKey && asyncConflict.key === conflictKey ? asyncConflict.state : EMPTY_CONFLICT;

  const sectionBlocked =
    sectionConflict.checking ||
    sectionConflict.name_taken ||
    !sectionConflict.adviser_conflict.can_handle_classes ||
    (sectionConflict.adviser_conflict.has_existing_advisory && !sectionForm.allow_multiple_advisories);

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cleanName = sanitizeAcademicField(sectionForm.name, 80).trim();
    const cleanRoomNumber = sanitizeAcademicField(sectionForm.room_number, 50).trim();
    if (!cleanName) {
      onStatus('Section name is required.', null);
      return;
    }
    if (!sectionForm.grade_level) {
      onStatus('Please select a grade level.', null);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    onStatus(null, null);

    const adviserPk = sectionForm.adviser_id ? Number(sectionForm.adviser_id) : null;
    const payload = {
      name: cleanName,
      grade_level: Number(sectionForm.grade_level),
      adviser: adviserPk,
      adviser_id: adviserPk,
      room_number: cleanRoomNumber,
      capacity: Number(sectionForm.capacity) || 45,
      allow_multiple_advisories: Boolean(sectionForm.allow_multiple_advisories),
    };

    try {
      if (sectionForm.id) {
        await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.sections}${sectionForm.id}/`, payload);
        onStatus(null, 'Section and Class Adviser updated.');
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.sections, payload);
        onStatus(null, 'New section and Class Adviser saved.');
      }
      setSectionForm(EMPTY_SECTION_FORM);
      await onReload();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      onStatus(extractApiError(err, 'Failed to save section.'), null);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
      <form onSubmit={handleSave} style={formCardStyle(tokens)}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, marginBottom: 8 }}>
          {sectionForm.id ? 'Edit Section & Adviser' : 'Add Section & Assign Class Adviser'}
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Section Name *</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              required
              maxLength={80}
              placeholder="e.g. Diamond"
              value={sectionForm.name}
              onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, name: sanitizeAcademicField(e.target.value, 80) })}
              style={{
                ...inputStyle(tokens),
                borderColor: sectionConflict.name_taken ? brand.danger : tokens.borderStrong,
              }}
            />
            {sectionConflict.name_taken && (
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: brand.danger, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 4 }}>
                {sectionConflict.name_message || 'A section with this name already exists for this grade level.'}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Level *</label>
            <select
              required
              value={sectionForm.grade_level}
              onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, grade_level: e.target.value })}
              style={inputStyle(tokens)}
            >
              <option value="">Select Grade Level</option>
              {grades.map((g) => (
                <option key={g.id} value={g.id}>
                  {g.name || g.code}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Class Adviser</label>
            <select
              value={sectionForm.adviser_id}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setSectionForm({
                  ...sectionForm,
                  adviser_id: e.target.value,
                  allow_multiple_advisories: false,
                })
              }
              style={{
                ...inputStyle(tokens),
                borderColor: !sectionConflict.adviser_conflict.can_handle_classes
                  ? brand.danger
                  : sectionConflict.adviser_conflict.has_existing_advisory
                    ? brand.warning
                    : tokens.borderStrong,
              }}
            >
              <option value="">(None / Unassigned)</option>
              {teachingTeachers.map((t) => {
                const advisedList: string[] = Array.isArray(t.advised_sections) ? t.advised_sections : [];
                const advisedBadge =
                  advisedList.length > 0 ? ` (Already Adviser: ${advisedList.join(', ')})` : '';
                return (
                  <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                    {t.full_name || t.name}
                    {t.employee_id ? ` [${t.employee_id}]` : ''}
                    {advisedBadge}
                  </option>
                );
              })}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Default Room Number</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              maxLength={50}
              placeholder="e.g. Room 204"
              value={sectionForm.room_number}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, room_number: sanitizeAcademicField(e.target.value, 50) })
              }
              style={inputStyle(tokens)}
            />
            {sectionConflict.room_in_use_by_sections.length > 0 && (
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'flex-start',
                  gap: 5,
                  fontSize: '0.70rem',
                  color: brand.primary,
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  marginTop: 4,
                }}
              >
                <Info size={12} style={{ flexShrink: 0, marginTop: 1 }} />
                <span>{sectionConflict.room_message}</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {!sectionConflict.adviser_conflict.can_handle_classes && (
          <div style={{ ...alertBoxStyle(tokens.dangerLight, brand.danger), marginTop: 10 }}>
            <AlertCircle size={15} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
            <span>{sectionConflict.adviser_conflict.message}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {sectionConflict.adviser_conflict.has_existing_advisory && (
          <div
            style={{
              marginTop: 10,
              padding: '10px 12px',
              borderRadius: 8,
              backgroundColor: tokens.warningLight,
              border: `1px solid ${brand.warning}`,
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              gap: 8,
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 8, color: brand.warning, fontSize: '0.76rem', fontWeight: 700 }}>
              <AlertTriangle size={16} style={{ flexShrink: 0, marginTop: 1 }} />
              <span>
                DepEd Adviser Workload Notice: This teacher is already the adviser of{' '}
                {sectionConflict.adviser_conflict.existing_sections.join(', ')}. Under DepEd guidelines, teachers normally hold one homeroom advisory class.
              </span>
            </div>
            <label
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 8,
                fontSize: '0.75rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={sectionForm.allow_multiple_advisories}
                onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, allow_multiple_advisories: e.target.checked })}
                style={{ accentColor: brand.warning }}
              />
              <span>Allow second advisory class (approved double-shift, multigrade, or substitute load)</span>
            </label>
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 12 }}>
          {sectionForm.id && (
            <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" type="button" onClick={() => setSectionForm(EMPTY_SECTION_FORM)}>
              Cancel Edit
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="submit" disabled={submitting || sectionBlocked}>
            {submitting || sectionConflict.checking ? (
              <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} />
            ) : sectionForm.id ? (
              'Save Changes'
            ) : (
              'Create Section'
            )}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>

      <div style={tableContainerStyle(tokens)}>
        <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
          <thead>
            <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Section</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Grade</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Class Adviser</th>
              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Actions</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {sections.map((sec) => {
              const adviserName =
                sec.adviser_name ||
                sec.adviser_full_name ||
                (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser ? sec.adviser.full_name || sec.adviser.name : null) ||
                teacherList.find((t) => t.id === sec.adviser_id || t.id === sec.adviser)?.full_name ||
                'Unassigned';

              return (
                <tr key={sec.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                  <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{sec.name}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                    {sec.grade_level_name || (typeof sec.grade_level === 'object' ? sec.grade_level?.name : '') || '—'}
                  </td>
                  <td
                    style={{
                      padding: '8px 10px',
                      color: adviserName === 'Unassigned' ? brand.warning : brand.primary,
                      fontWeight: 600,
                    }}
                  >
                    {adviserName}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setSectionForm(mapSectionToForm(sec))}
                      style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, cursor: 'pointer', marginRight: 8 }}
                      title="Edit Section & Adviser"
                      aria-label={`Edit section ${sec.name}`}
                    >
                      <Edit2 size={13} />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onDelete(API_ROUTES.school.sections, sec.id, 'Section')}
                      style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                      title="Delete Section"
                      aria-label={`Delete section ${sec.name}`}
                    >
                      <Trash2 size={13} />
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable Lookup CRUD Sub-Form (Rooms, Subjects, Grades, School Years, Holidays)
 * File: web/src/components/modals/academic/SimpleLookupCrudForm.tsx
 */

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useFieldAvailability } from '../../../hooks/useFieldAvailability';
import { Button } from '../../ui/Button';
import { Edit2, Loader2, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  formCardStyle,
  inputStyle,
  labelStyle,
  sanitizeAcademicField,
  tableContainerStyle,
  type AcademicGradeItem,
  type AcademicHolidayItem,
  type AcademicRoomItem,
  type AcademicSubjectItem,
  type AcademicYearItem,
} from './academicShared';

export type SimpleLookupTab = 'ROOMS' | 'SUBJECTS' | 'GRADES' | 'YEARS' | 'HOLIDAYS';

const EMPTY_SIMPLE_FORM = {
  id: null as number | null,
  code: '',
  name: '',
  building: '',
  capacity: 45,
  title: '',
  units: 1,
  stage: 'JHS',
  level_order: 1,
  start_date: '',
  baseline_cutoff_date: '',
  end_date: '',
  is_active: true,
  holiday_date: '',
  holiday_type: 'HOLIDAY',
  holiday_reason: '',
};

interface SimpleLookupCrudFormProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  activeSubTab: SimpleLookupTab;
  rooms: AcademicRoomItem[];
  subjects: AcademicSubjectItem[];
  grades: AcademicGradeItem[];
  years: AcademicYearItem[];
  holidays: AcademicHolidayItem[];
  onReload: () => Promise<void>;
  onDelete: (route: string, id: number, label: string) => void;
  onStatus: (error: string | null, success: string | null) => void;
}

export const SimpleLookupCrudForm: React.FC<SimpleLookupCrudFormProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  activeSubTab,
  rooms,
  subjects,
  grades,
  years,
  holidays,
  onReload,
  onDelete,
  onStatus,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [simpleForm, setSimpleForm] = useState(EMPTY_SIMPLE_FORM);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const checkFieldType = activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS' ? 'subject_code' : 'room_name';
  const checkValue =
    activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS'
      ? sanitizeAcademicField(simpleForm.code, 30).trim()
      : sanitizeAcademicField(simpleForm.name, 60).trim();

  const fieldAvail = useFieldAvailability({
    enabled: isOpen && (activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS' || activeSubTab === 'ROOMS'),
    field: checkFieldType,
    value: checkValue,
    minLength: 2,
    fallbackMessage:
      activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS'
        ? 'A subject with this code already exists.'
        : 'A classroom with this name already exists.',
    excludeId: simpleForm.id ?? undefined,
  });

  const simpleBlocked =
    (activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS' || activeSubTab === 'ROOMS') && (fieldAvail.checking || fieldAvail.isTaken);

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    onStatus(null, null);

    try {
      const isEdit = Boolean(simpleForm.id);
      if (activeSubTab === 'ROOMS') {
        const cleanRoomName = sanitizeAcademicField(simpleForm.name, 60).trim();
        const cleanBuilding = sanitizeAcademicField(simpleForm.building, 80).trim();
        if (!cleanRoomName) {
          onStatus('Room name is required.', null);
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        const payload = {
          name: cleanRoomName,
          building: cleanBuilding,
          capacity: Math.max(1, Number(simpleForm.capacity) || 45),
        };
        if (isEdit) await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.rooms}${simpleForm.id}/`, payload);
        else await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.rooms, payload);
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS') {
        const cleanCode = sanitizeAcademicField(simpleForm.code, 30).trim().toUpperCase();
        const cleanTitle = sanitizeAcademicField(simpleForm.title, 100).trim();
        if (!cleanCode || !cleanTitle) {
          onStatus('Subject code and title are required.', null);
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        const payload = {
          code: cleanCode,
          title: cleanTitle,
          units: Math.max(1, Number(simpleForm.units) || 1),
        };
        if (isEdit) await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.subjects}${simpleForm.id}/`, payload);
        else await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.subjects, payload);
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'GRADES') {
        const cleanCode = sanitizeAcademicField(simpleForm.code, 20).trim().toUpperCase();
        const cleanName = sanitizeAcademicField(simpleForm.name, 60).trim();
        if (!cleanCode || !cleanName) {
          onStatus('Grade code and name are required.', null);
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        const payload = {
          code: cleanCode,
          name: cleanName,
          stage: sanitizeAcademicField(simpleForm.stage || 'JHS', 20).trim() || 'JHS',
          level_order: Number(simpleForm.level_order) || 1,
        };
        if (isEdit) await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.gradeLevels}${simpleForm.id}/`, payload);
        else await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.gradeLevels, payload);
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'YEARS') {
        const cleanCode = sanitizeAcademicField(simpleForm.code, 20).trim();
        if (!cleanCode || !simpleForm.start_date || !simpleForm.end_date) {
          onStatus('School year code, start date, and end date are required.', null);
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        const payload = {
          code: cleanCode,
          start_date: simpleForm.start_date,
          baseline_cutoff_date: simpleForm.baseline_cutoff_date || simpleForm.start_date,
          end_date: simpleForm.end_date,
          is_active: Boolean(simpleForm.is_active),
        };
        if (isEdit) await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.schoolYears}${simpleForm.id}/`, payload);
        else await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.schoolYears, payload);
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'HOLIDAYS') {
        const cleanReason = sanitizeAcademicField(simpleForm.holiday_reason, 140).trim();
        if (!simpleForm.holiday_date || !cleanReason) {
          onStatus('Holiday date and title/reason are required.', null);
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        const payload = {
          date: simpleForm.holiday_date,
          type: simpleForm.holiday_type || 'HOLIDAY',
          reason: cleanReason,
        };
        if (isEdit) await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.holidays}${simpleForm.id}/`, payload);
        else await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.holidays, payload);
      }

      setSimpleForm(EMPTY_SIMPLE_FORM);
      onStatus(null, isEdit ? 'Record updated.' : 'Record added.');
      await onReload();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      onStatus(extractApiError(err, 'Failed to save record.'), null);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const renderRowActions = (
    label: string,
    itemLabel: string,
    route: string,
    id: number,
    onEdit: () => void
  ) => (
    <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onEdit}
        aria-label={`Edit ${label}`}
        title={`Edit ${itemLabel}`}
        style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, cursor: 'pointer', marginRight: 8 }}
      >
        <Edit2 size={13} />
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onDelete(route, id, itemLabel)}
        aria-label={`Delete ${label}`}
        title={`Delete ${itemLabel}`}
        style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}
      >
        <Trash2 size={13} />
      </button>
    </td>
  );

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
      <form
        onSubmit={handleSave}
        style={{ ...formCardStyle(tokens), display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'flex-end', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {activeSubTab === 'ROOMS' && (
            <>
              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Room Name *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  maxLength={60}
                  placeholder="e.g. Room 101"
                  value={simpleForm.name}
                  onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, name: sanitizeAcademicField(e.target.value, 60) })}
                  style={{
                    ...inputStyle(tokens),
                    borderColor: fieldAvail.isTaken
                      ? brand.danger
                      : fieldAvail.verified
                        ? brand.success
                        : tokens.borderStrong,
                  }}
                />
                {fieldAvail.isTaken && (
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: brand.danger, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 3 }}>
                    {fieldAvail.error}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Building</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  maxLength={80}
                  placeholder="e.g. Science Wing"
                  value={simpleForm.building}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, building: sanitizeAcademicField(e.target.value, 80) })
                  }
                  style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                />
              </div>
              <div style={{ width: 90 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Capacity</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={500}
                  value={simpleForm.capacity}
                  onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, capacity: Number(e.target.value) || 45 })}
                  style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                />
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {activeSubTab === 'GRADES' && (
            <>
              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 90 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Code *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  maxLength={20}
                  placeholder="e.g. G7"
                  value={simpleForm.code}
                  onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, code: sanitizeAcademicField(e.target.value, 20) })}
                  style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                />
              </div>
              <div style={{ flex: 2, minWidth: 140 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Name *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  maxLength={60}
                  placeholder="e.g. Grade 7"
                  value={simpleForm.name}
                  onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, name: sanitizeAcademicField(e.target.value, 60) })}
                  style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                />
              </div>
              <div style={{ width: 95 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Stage</label>
                <select
                  value={simpleForm.stage}
                  onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, stage: e.target.value })}
                  style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                >
                  <option value="ELEM">ELEM</option>
                  <option value="JHS">JHS</option>
                  <option value="SHS">SHS</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div style={{ width: 76 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Order</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={20}
                  value={simpleForm.level_order}
                  onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, level_order: Number(e.target.value) || 1 })}
                  style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                />
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS' && (
            <>
              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Code *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  maxLength={30}
                  placeholder="e.g. MATH7"
                  value={simpleForm.code}
                  onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, code: sanitizeAcademicField(e.target.value, 30) })}
                  style={{
                    ...inputStyle(tokens),
                    borderColor: fieldAvail.isTaken
                      ? brand.danger
                      : fieldAvail.verified
                        ? brand.success
                        : tokens.borderStrong,
                  }}
                />
                {fieldAvail.isTaken && (
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: brand.danger, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 3 }}>
                    {fieldAvail.error}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              <div style={{ flex: 2, minWidth: 140 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Title *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  maxLength={100}
                  placeholder="e.g. Mathematics 7"
                  value={simpleForm.title}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, title: sanitizeAcademicField(e.target.value, 100) })
                  }
                  style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                />
              </div>
              <div style={{ width: 76 }}>
                <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Units</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={10}
                  value={simpleForm.units}

              <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Details</th>

                    {y.start_date && y.end_date ? ` • ${y.start_date} to ${y.end_date}` : ''}
                  </td>
                  {renderRowActions(`school year ${y.code}`, 'School Year', API_ROUTES.school.schoolYears, y.id, () =>

                      code: y.code || '',
                      start_date: y.start_date || '',
                      baseline_cutoff_date: y.baseline_cutoff_date || y.start_date || '',
                      end_date: y.end_date || '',

                      code: g.code || '',

/**
 * AttendSure - Academic Structure Setup Modal (Themed)
 * File: web/src/components/modals/AcademicSetupModal.tsx
 * Manages Sections, Advisers, Schedules, Subject Teachers, Rooms, Subjects, and Grade Levels.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import {
  AlertCircle,
  BookOpen,
  Calendar,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  DoorOpen,
  Layers,
  Loader2,
  Users,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { alertBoxStyle, type AcademicSubTab } from './academic/academicShared';
import { SectionAdviserForm } from './academic/SectionAdviserForm';
import { SchedulePeriodForm } from './academic/SchedulePeriodForm';
import { SimpleLookupCrudForm, type SimpleLookupTab } from './academic/SimpleLookupCrudForm';

export type TabType =
  | 'SECTIONS'
  | 'SCHEDULE'
  | 'SECTION'
  | 'ROOM'
  | 'ROOMS'
  | 'SUBJECT'
  | 'SUBJECTS'
  | 'GRADES'
  | 'YEARS'
  | 'HOLIDAYS';

export interface AcademicSetupModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdated?: () => void;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
  initialTab?: TabType;
  editItem?: any;
}

const normalizeTab = (tab: TabType): AcademicSubTab => {
  if (tab === 'SECTION' || tab === 'SECTIONS') return 'SECTIONS';
  if (tab === 'SCHEDULE') return 'SCHEDULE';
  if (tab === 'ROOM' || tab === 'ROOMS') return 'ROOMS';
  if (tab === 'SUBJECT' || tab === 'SUBJECTS') return 'SUBJECTS';
  if (tab === 'GRADES') return 'GRADES';
  if (tab === 'HOLIDAYS') return 'HOLIDAYS';
  return 'YEARS';
};

export const AcademicSetupModal: React.FC<AcademicSetupModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onUpdated,
  onSuccess,
  initialTab = 'SECTIONS',
  editItem = null,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { showConfirm } = useAlert();

  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<AcademicSubTab>(normalizeTab(initialTab));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const [years, setYears] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [grades, setGrades] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [rooms, setRooms] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [subjects, setSubjects] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [teacherList, setTeacherList] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [schedules, setSchedules] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [holidays, setHolidays] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const teachingTeachers = useMemo(
    () => teacherList.filter((t) => t.can_handle_classes !== false && t.can_teach !== false),
    [teacherList]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialTab) return;
    setActiveSubTab(normalizeTab(initialTab));
    setError(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
  }, [initialTab, editItem]);

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const results = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.schoolYears, { signal: controller.signal }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.gradeLevels, { signal: controller.signal }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.rooms, { signal: controller.signal }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.subjects, { signal: controller.signal }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.sections, { params: { page_size: 300 }, signal: controller.signal }),
        apiClient
          .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.teachersDropdown, { signal: controller.signal })
          .catch(() =>
            apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.teachers, { params: { page_size: 300 }, signal: controller.signal })
          ),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.periods, { params: { page_size: 300 }, signal: controller.signal }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.holidays, { params: { page_size: 200 }, signal: controller.signal }),
      ]);

      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      const getData = (res: PromiseSettledResult<any>) =>
        res.status === 'fulfilled' && res.value?.data
          ? Array.isArray(res.value.data)
            ? res.value.data
            : res.value.data.results || []
          : [];

      setYears(getData(results[0]));
      setGrades(getData(results[1]));
      setRooms(getData(results[2]));
      setSubjects(getData(results[3]));
      setSections(getData(results[4]));
      setTeacherList(getData(results[5]));
      setSchedules(getData(results[6]));
      setHolidays(getData(results[7]));
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load academic records.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      void loadData();
    }
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [isOpen, loadData]);

  const handleReloadAndNotify = useCallback(async () => {
    await loadData();
    onUpdated?.();
    onSuccess?.();
  }, [loadData, onUpdated, onSuccess]);

  const handleStatus = useCallback((err: string | null, success: string | null) => {
    setError(err);
    setSuccessMessage(success);
  }, []);

  const handleDeleteItem = useCallback(
    (baseRoute: string, id: number, label = 'Record') => {
      showConfirm({
        title: `Delete ${label}`,
        message: `Are you sure you want to permanently delete this ${label.toLowerCase()}?`,
        confirmLabel: 'Delete',
        isDestructive: true,
        onConfirm: async () => {
          setError(null);
          setSuccessMessage(null);
          try {
            await apiClient.delete(`${baseRoute}${id}/`);
            setSuccessMessage(`${label} deleted.`);
            await handleReloadAndNotify();
          } catch (err: unknown) {
            setError(extractApiError(err, `Could not delete ${label.toLowerCase()}.`));
          }
        },
      });
    },
    [showConfirm, handleReloadAndNotify]
  );

  const navTabs: Array<{ key: AcademicSubTab; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode }> = [
    { key: 'SECTIONS', label: 'Sections & Advisers', icon: <Users size={14} /> },
    { key: 'SCHEDULE', label: 'Schedules & Subject Teachers', icon: <Clock size={14} /> },
    { key: 'SUBJECTS', label: 'Subjects', icon: <BookOpen size={14} /> },
    { key: 'ROOMS', label: 'Classrooms', icon: <DoorOpen size={14} /> },
    { key: 'GRADES', label: 'Grade Levels', icon: <Layers size={14} /> },
    { key: 'YEARS', label: 'School Years', icon: <Calendar size={14} /> },
    { key: 'HOLIDAYS', label: 'Holidays', icon: <Calendar size={14} /> },
  ];

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title="Academic Structure & Teacher Assignments">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 8,
            borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            paddingBottom: 8,
            overflowX: 'auto',
          }}
        >
          {navTabs.map((tab) => (
            <button
              key={tab.key}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setActiveSubTab(tab.key);
                setError(null);
                setSuccessMessage(null);
              }}
              style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === tab.key, brand.primary, tokens)}
            >
              {tab.icon} {tab.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {loading && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" color={brand.primary} />
            <span>Loading academic records...</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {error && (
          <div style={alertBoxStyle(tokens.dangerLight, brand.danger)}>
            <AlertCircle size={15} />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {successMessage && (
          <div style={alertBoxStyle(tokens.successLight, brand.success)}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={15} />
            <span>{successMessage}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {activeSubTab === 'SECTIONS' && (
          <SectionAdviserForm
            key={`sections-${isOpen ? editItem?.id ?? 'new' : 'closed'}`}
            isOpen={isOpen}
            initialEditItem={normalizeTab(initialTab) === 'SECTIONS' ? editItem : null}
            grades={grades}
            sections={sections}
            teacherList={teacherList}
            teachingTeachers={teachingTeachers}
            onReload={handleReloadAndNotify}
            onDelete={handleDeleteItem}
            onStatus={handleStatus}
          />
        )}

        {activeSubTab === 'SCHEDULE' && (
          <SchedulePeriodForm
            key={`schedule-${isOpen ? editItem?.id ?? 'new' : 'closed'}`}
            isOpen={isOpen}
            initialEditItem={normalizeTab(initialTab) === 'SCHEDULE' ? editItem : null}
            sections={sections}
            subjects={subjects}
            schedules={schedules}
            teacherList={teacherList}
            teachingTeachers={teachingTeachers}
            onReload={handleReloadAndNotify}
            onDelete={handleDeleteItem}
            onStatus={handleStatus}
          />
        )}

        {activeSubTab !== 'SECTIONS' && activeSubTab !== 'SCHEDULE' && (
          <SimpleLookupCrudForm
            key={activeSubTab}
            isOpen={isOpen}
            activeSubTab={activeSubTab as SimpleLookupTab}
            rooms={rooms}
            subjects={subjects}
            grades={grades}
            years={years}
            holidays={holidays}
            onReload={handleReloadAndNotify}
            onDelete={handleDeleteItem}
            onStatus={handleStatus}
          />
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: 8 }}>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={onClose}>
            Close
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
};

const tabBtnStyle = (active: boolean, brandColor: string, tokens: any): React.CSSProperties => ({
  padding: '6px 12px',
  borderRadius: 6,
  border: active ? `1px solid ${brandColor}` : '1px solid transparent',
  backgroundColor: active ? tokens.primaryLight : 'transparent',
  color: active ? brandColor : tokens.textSecondary,
  fontWeight: 700,
  fontSize: '0.78rem',
  cursor: 'pointer',
  display: 'flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  gap: 6,
  whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
});

export default AcademicSetupModal;
