/**
 * AttendSure - First-Time Profile Completion Modal
 * File: web/src/components/modals/CompleteProfileModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { AvatarUploadField } from '../common/AvatarUploadField';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { UserCheck, ShieldCheck, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface CompletedProfileUser {
  full_name?: string;
  username?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface CompleteProfileModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onCompleted: (updatedUser: CompletedProfileUser) => void;
}

const sanitizeField = (raw: string, maxLen = 100): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '').slice(0, maxLen);

const sanitizePassword = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').slice(0, 128);

export const CompleteProfileModal: React.FC<CompleteProfileModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onCompleted }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    first_name: '',
    middle_name: '',
    last_name: '',
    suffix: '',
    contact_number: '',
    department: 'Junior High School',
    current_password: '',
    password: '',
    photo: null as string | null,
  });

  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const submitAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      submitAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    setLoading(true);
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current || !res.data) return;
        const u = res.data;
        const pic = u.photo_url || u.photo || null;
        setFormData((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          first_name: sanitizeField(u.first_name || '', 100),
          middle_name: sanitizeField(u.middle_name || '', 100),
          last_name: sanitizeField(u.last_name || '', 100),
          suffix: sanitizeField(u.suffix || '', 12),
          contact_number: sanitizeField(u.contact_number || '', 13),
          department: sanitizeField(u.department || 'Junior High School', 100) || 'Junior High School',
          current_password: '',
          password: '',
          photo: null,
        }));
        setPhotoPreview(isSafeImageUrl(pic) ? pic : null);
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (
          controller.signal.aborted ||
          !mountedRef.current ||
          anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
          anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
          anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
        ) {
          return;
        }
        showAlert({ title: 'Notice', message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not pre-load profile details.'), type: 'warning' });
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted && mountedRef.current) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [isOpen, showAlert]);

  const cleanPhone = formData.contact_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
  const isPhoneValid = /^(09|\+639)\d{9}$/.test(cleanPhone);
  const isPasswordValid =
    !formData.password ||
    (formData.password.length >= 8 && /[A-Za-z]/.test(formData.password) && /[0-9]/.test(formData.password));
  const isFormValid =
    formData.first_name.trim().length >= 2 &&
    formData.last_name.trim().length >= 2 &&
    isPhoneValid &&
    isPasswordValid;

  const setField = (key: Exclude<keyof typeof formData, 'photo'>, val: string) => {
    const clean =
      key === 'password' || key === 'current_password'
        ? sanitizePassword(val)
        : sanitizeField(val, key === 'contact_number' ? 13 : 100);
    setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, [key]: clean }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isFormValid || saving) return;

    const cleanPw = sanitizePassword(formData.password).trim();
    const cleanCurrentPw = sanitizePassword(formData.current_password).trim();
    if (cleanPw && !cleanCurrentPw) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Current Password Required',
        message: 'Enter your current password to update your password.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    submitAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    submitAbortRef.current = controller;

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      if (cleanPw && cleanCurrentPw) {
        const pwRes = await apiClient.post(
          API_ROUTES.accounts.changePassword,
          { current_password: cleanCurrentPw, new_password: cleanPw },
          { signal: controller.signal }
        );
        if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;
        if (pwRes.data?.token) {
          localStorage.setItem('attendsure_token', pwRes.data.token);
        }
      }

      const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
        first_name: sanitizeField(formData.first_name, 100).trim(),
        middle_name: sanitizeField(formData.middle_name, 100).trim(),
        last_name: sanitizeField(formData.last_name, 100).trim(),
        suffix: sanitizeField(formData.suffix, 12).trim(),
        contact_number: cleanPhone,
        department: sanitizeField(formData.department, 100).trim(),
      };
      if (formData.photo !== null) {
        if (formData.photo === '') {
          payload.photo = null;
          payload.remove_photo = true;
        } else if (isSafeImageUrl(formData.photo)) {
          payload.photo = formData.photo;
        }
      }

      const res = await apiClient.put(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, payload, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;
      showAlert({ title: 'Profile Completed', message: 'Your teacher profile is now active.', type: 'success' });
      onCompleted(res.data);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        !mountedRef.current ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to update profile.'), type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted && mountedRef.current) {
        setSaving(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const responsiveGrid: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: 'grid',
    gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 190px), 1fr))',
    gap: 10,
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={() => {}} title="Complete Your Profile Information">
      {loading ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
          <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" style={{ margin: '0 auto 6px', display: 'block', color: brand.primary }} />
          Loading profile...
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              ...ui.subtleBox,
              backgroundColor: tokens.infoLight,
              borderColor: brand.secondary,
              display: 'flex',
              gap: 10,
              alignItems: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <ShieldCheck size={20} color={brand.secondary} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
              Please complete your personal details to activate your DTR and class list access.
            </span>
          </div>

          <AvatarUploadField
            previewUrl={photoPreview}
            displayName={`${formData.first_name} ${formData.last_name}`.trim() || 'Teacher'}
            label="Profile Photo (Optional)"
            size={54}
            disabled={saving}
            onSelectPhoto={(_file, dataUri) => {
              setPhotoPreview(dataUri);
              setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: dataUri }));
            }}
            onRemovePhoto={() => {
              setPhotoPreview(null);
              setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: '' }));
            }}
            onValidationError={(msg) => showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Image', message: msg, type: 'error' })}
          />

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>First Name *</label>
              <input
                required
                maxLength={100}
                style={ui.input}
                value={formData.first_name}
                onChange={(e) => setField('first_name', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Last Name *</label>
              <input
                required
                maxLength={100}
                style={ui.input}
                value={formData.last_name}
                onChange={(e) => setField('last_name', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Middle Name</label>
              <input
                maxLength={100}
                style={ui.input}
                value={formData.middle_name}
                onChange={(e) => setField('middle_name', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Suffix</label>
              <select style={ui.input} value={formData.suffix} onChange={(e) => setField('suffix', e.target.value)}>
                <option value="">None</option>
                <option value="Jr.">Jr.</option>
                <option value="Sr.">Sr.</option>
                <option value="II">II</option>
                <option value="III">III</option>
                <option value="IV">IV</option>
                <option value="V">V</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Contact Number (11 Digits) *</label>
              <input
                required
                maxLength={13}
                placeholder="09171234567"
                style={ui.input}
                value={formData.contact_number}
                onChange={(e) => setField('contact_number', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Department *</label>
              <select required style={ui.input} value={formData.department} onChange={(e) => setField('department', e.target.value)}>
                <option value="Junior High School">Junior High School</option>
                <option value="Senior High School">Senior High School</option>
                <option value="Office of the Principal / Administration">Administration</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Current Password (If changing)</label>
              <input
                type="password"
                maxLength={128}
                autoComplete="current-password"
                placeholder="Current password"
                style={ui.input}
                value={formData.current_password}
                onChange={(e) => setField('current_password', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>New Password (Optional)</label>
              <input
                type="password"
                maxLength={128}
                autoComplete="new-password"
                placeholder="Min 8 chars, letters & numbers"
                style={ui.input}
                value={formData.password}
                onChange={(e) => setField('password', e.target.value)}
              />
              {!isPasswordValid && (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: brand.danger, marginTop: 4, display: 'block' }}>
                  Password must be at least 8 characters and contain both letters and numbers.
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: 8 }}>
            <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="submit" disabled={saving || !isFormValid}>
              {saving ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <UserCheck size={16} />}
              <span>{saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Complete & Activate Profile'}</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
};

export default CompleteProfileModal;

const PACK_LABELS: Record<PrintPackType, string> = {
  CLASS_SCHEDULE: 'Class Schedule',

  QR_ID_CARDS: 'Student QR ID Cards',
  TEACHER_DIRECTORY: 'Teacher Directory',
  COMPLETE_TEACHER_PACKET: 'Complete Teaching Packet',

const EMPTY_IDS: number[] = [];
const EMPTY_OPTIONS: SelectableOption[] = [];

export const PrintableExportModal: React.FC<PrintableExportModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  title = 'Download & Print Official Sheets',
  defaultPackType,
  allowedPackTypes,
  initialScope = 'ALL',
  preselectedSectionIds = EMPTY_IDS,
  preselectedPeriodIds = EMPTY_IDS,
  preselectedTeacherIds = EMPTY_IDS,
  preselectedStudentIds = EMPTY_IDS,
  sectionOptions = EMPTY_OPTIONS,
  teacherOptions = EMPTY_OPTIONS,
  isSchoolLeader = false,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, radius, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const [packType, setPackType] = useState<PrintPackType>(defaultPackType);
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<PrintPackScope>(initialScope);
  const [pickedSectionIds, setPickedSectionIds] = useState<number[]>(() => [...preselectedSectionIds]);
  const [pickedTeacherIds, setPickedTeacherIds] = useState<number[]>(() => [...preselectedTeacherIds]);
  const [pickedPeriodIds, setPickedPeriodIds] = useState<number[]>(() => [...preselectedPeriodIds]);
  const [pickedStudentIds, setPickedStudentIds] = useState<number[]>(() => [...preselectedStudentIds]);
  const [syncedOpen, setSyncedOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [refreshTick, setRefreshTick] = useState<number>(0);

  const [payload, setPayload] = useState<PrintPackPayload | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pageConfig, setPageConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(DEFAULT_PRINT_PACK_PAGE_SETUP);
  const [isPageSetupOpen, setIsPageSetupOpen] = useState(false);

  const paperDims = useMemo(() => {
    const p = PAPER_SIZES[pageConfig.paperSize] || PAPER_SIZES.a4;
    return pageConfig.orientation === 'landscape'
      ? { widthIn: p.height, heightIn: p.width }
      : { widthIn: p.width, heightIn: p.height };
  }, [pageConfig.paperSize, pageConfig.orientation]);

  const sheetPageStyle = useMemo<React.CSSProperties>(
    () => ({
      width: '100%',
      maxWidth: `${paperDims.widthIn}in`,
      margin: '0 auto 18px',
      paddingTop: `${pageConfig.margins.top}in`,
      paddingRight: `${pageConfig.margins.right}in`,
      paddingBottom: `${pageConfig.margins.bottom}in`,
      paddingLeft: `${pageConfig.margins.left}in`,
      backgroundColor: pageConfig.pageColor || QR_COLORS.background,
      color: QR_COLORS.foreground,
      boxSizing: 'border-box',
      borderWidth: 1,
      borderStyle: 'solid',
      borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
      borderRadius: 6,
    }),
    [paperDims.widthIn, pageConfig.margins, pageConfig.pageColor, tokens.borderSubtle]
  );

  const sheetRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const wasOpenRef = useRef<boolean>(false);

  // Sync incoming selection props ONLY when transitioning from closed -> open
  // (Prevents infinite re-fetch loops and avoids firing a stale preview request before props sync)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && !wasOpenRef.current) {
      setPackType(defaultPackType);
      setScope(initialScope);
      setPickedSectionIds([...preselectedSectionIds]);
      setPickedTeacherIds([...preselectedTeacherIds]);
      setPickedPeriodIds([...preselectedPeriodIds]);
      setPickedStudentIds([...preselectedStudentIds]);
      setError(null);
      setSyncedOpen(true);
    } else if (!isOpen && wasOpenRef.current) {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      setSyncedOpen(false);
    }
    wasOpenRef.current = isOpen;
  }, [
    isOpen,
    defaultPackType,
    initialScope,
    preselectedSectionIds,
    preselectedTeacherIds,
    preselectedPeriodIds,
    preselectedStudentIds,
  ]);

  const hasAnySelection = useMemo(() => {
    if (packType === 'TEACHER_DIRECTORY') {
      return pickedTeacherIds.length > 0;
    }
    return (
      pickedSectionIds.length > 0 ||
      pickedTeacherIds.length > 0 ||
      pickedPeriodIds.length > 0 ||
      pickedStudentIds.length > 0
    );
  }, [packType, pickedSectionIds, pickedTeacherIds, pickedPeriodIds, pickedStudentIds]);

  const buildRequestBody = useCallback(
    (exportFormat: 'json' | 'html' | 'csv', actionMode: 'PRINT' | 'EXPORT' = 'EXPORT') => {
      const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
        pack_type: packType,
        scope,
        export_format: exportFormat,
        action_mode: actionMode,
      };
      if (scope === 'SELECTED') {
        if (pickedSectionIds.length > 0 && packType !== 'TEACHER_DIRECTORY') {
          body.section_ids = pickedSectionIds;
        }
        if (pickedTeacherIds.length > 0 && isSchoolLeader) {
          body.teacher_ids = pickedTeacherIds;
        }
        if (
          pickedPeriodIds.length > 0 &&
          (packType === 'CLASS_SCHEDULE' || packType === 'COMPLETE_TEACHER_PACKET')
        ) {
          body.period_ids = pickedPeriodIds;
        }
        if (
          pickedStudentIds.length > 0 &&
          (packType === 'CLASS_LIST' ||
            packType === 'QR_ID_CARDS' ||
            packType === 'COMPLETE_TEACHER_PACKET')
        ) {
          body.student_ids = pickedStudentIds;
        }
      }
      return body;
    },
    [
      packType,
      scope,
      pickedSectionIds,
      pickedTeacherIds,
      pickedPeriodIds,
      pickedStudentIds,
      isSchoolLeader,
    ]
  );

  // Primitive serialized key guarantees preview fetches ONLY when query parameters genuinely change
  const previewRequestKey = useMemo(
    () => JSON.stringify(buildRequestBody('json', 'EXPORT')),
    [buildRequestBody]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || !syncedOpen) return;
    if (scope === 'SELECTED' && !hasAnySelection) {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      setPayload(null);
      setError(null);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    abortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;

    let cancelled = false;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    const requestBody = JSON.parse(previewRequestKey) as Record<string, unknown>;
    apiClient
      .post<PrintPackPayload>(API_ROUTES.reports.printPack, requestBody, {
        signal: controller.signal,
      })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setPayload(res.data);
        }
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const maybeCancel = err as { code?: string; name?: string };
        if (
          cancelled ||
          maybeCancel?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED' ||
          maybeCancel?.name === 'CanceledError'
        ) {
          return;
        }
        setPayload(null);
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load the printable sheet right now.'));
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled && abortRef.current === controller) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [isOpen, syncedOpen, scope, hasAnySelection, previewRequestKey, refreshTick]);

  const handleRefreshPreview = () => {
    setRefreshTick((prev) => prev + 1);
  };

  const toggleId = (list: number[], id: number, setter: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<number[]>>) => {
    setter(list.includes(id) ? list.filter((item) => item !== id) : [...list, id]);
  };

  const baseFilename = useMemo(() => {
    const stamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    return `AttendSure_${packType.toLowerCase()}_${scope.toLowerCase()}_${stamp}`;
  }, [packType, scope]);

  const handlePrint = async () => {
    if (!sheetRef.current || !payload) return;
    setExporting('PRINT');
    try {
      const audit = buildAuditStamp(packType, payload.school?.school_id);
      printHtmlWithPageSetup({
        title: PACK_LABELS[packType],
        bodyHtml: sheetRef.current.innerHTML,
        pageConfig,
        auditFooter: audit,
        extraCss: `
          body { font-size: 11px; }
          th, td { border: 1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}; padding: 5px 6px; text-align: left; }
        `,
      });

      void logOfficialReportAudit({
        reportName: PACK_LABELS[packType],
        trackingId: audit.trackingId,
        printedAt: audit.printedAt,
        action: 'PRINT',
      });
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Print Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not open the print dialog.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setExporting(null);
    }
  };

  const handleExportPdf = async () => {
    if (!sheetRef.current || !payload) return;
    setExporting('PDF');
    try {
      const audit = buildAuditStamp(packType, payload.school?.school_id);
      await exportElementToLocalPdf({
        element: sheetRef.current,
        filename: baseFilename,
        pageWidthInches: paperDims.widthIn,
        pageHeightInches: paperDims.heightIn,
        orientation: pageConfig.orientation,
        pageColor: pageConfig.pageColor || QR_COLORS.background,
        pageless: pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless',
        marginsInches: [0, 0, 0, 0],
      });
      void logOfficialReportAudit({
        reportName: PACK_LABELS[packType],
        trackingId: audit.trackingId,
        printedAt: audit.printedAt,
        action: 'PDF',
      });
      showAlert({
        title: 'PDF Saved',
        message: `${PACK_LABELS[packType]} was saved as a PDF file.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'PDF Export Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not generate the PDF file.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setExporting(null);
    }
  };

  const handleExportOffice = async (kind: 'EXCEL' | 'WORD') => {
    if (!sheetRef.current || !payload) return;
    setExporting(kind);
    try {
      const audit = buildAuditStamp(packType, payload.school?.school_id);
      if (kind === 'EXCEL') {
        await exportElementToExcel(sheetRef.current, baseFilename, audit);
      } else {
        await exportElementToWord(sheetRef.current, baseFilename, audit);
      }
      void logOfficialReportAudit({
        reportName: PACK_LABELS[packType],
        trackingId: audit.trackingId,
        printedAt: audit.printedAt,
        action: kind,
      });
      showAlert({
        title: kind === 'EXCEL' ? 'Excel File Downloaded' : 'Word Document Downloaded',
        message: `${PACK_LABELS[packType]} is ready in your downloads folder.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Download Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not create the download file.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setExporting(null);
    }
  };

  const handleExportCsv = async () => {
    if (!payload) return;
    setExporting('CSV');
    try {
      const audit = buildAuditStamp(packType, payload.school?.school_id);
      const res = await apiClient.post(
        API_ROUTES.reports.printPack,
        buildRequestBody('csv', 'EXPORT'),
        { responseType: 'blob' }
      );
      const blob = new Blob([res.data], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      triggerBlobDownload(blob, `${baseFilename}.csv`);
      void logOfficialReportAudit({
        reportName: PACK_LABELS[packType],
        trackingId: audit.trackingId,
        printedAt: audit.printedAt,
        action: 'CSV',
      });
      showAlert({
        title: 'CSV Downloaded',
        message: `${PACK_LABELS[packType]} CSV was saved safely.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'CSV Export Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not download the CSV file.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setExporting(null);
    }
  };

      )}
      <div
        style={{

        }}
      >
        <span>
          <strong>Advisory Class:</strong>{' '}
          {ts.advisory_sections.length > 0 ? ts.advisory_sections.join(', ') : 'None'}
        </span>

          <strong>Weekly Teaching Hours:</strong> {ts.total_weekly_hours.toFixed(2)} hrs
        </span>

      </div>
      <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse' }}>

              </tr>
            ))
          )}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      {renderSignatures('Prepared By:', ts.teacher_name)}
    </div>

        </span>
        <span>
          <strong>Female:</strong> {cl.female_count}
        </span>

          <strong>Combined Total:</strong> {cl.total_count}
        </span>
        <span>
          <strong>School Year:</strong> {cl.school_year || payload?.school?.school_year || '—'}
        </span>

              <td style={{ ...paperCellStyle, textAlign: 'right' }}>{st.row_number}</td>

              <td style={{ ...paperCellStyle, fontWeight: 700 }}>{st.full_name}</td>
              <td style={paperCellStyle}>{st.sex}</td>
              <td style={paperCellStyle}>{st.birth_date || '—'}</td>
              <td style={paperCellStyle}>
                {[st.guardian_name, st.guardian_contact].filter(Boolean).join(' / ') || '—'}
              </td>
              <td style={paperCellStyle}>{st.qr_status}</td>
              <td style={paperCellStyle}>{st.today_status}</td>

  const renderPreviewBody = () => {
    if (!payload) return null;

    if (payload.pack_type === 'CLASS_SCHEDULE') {
      const blocks = payload.teacher_schedules || [];
      if (blocks.length === 0) {
        return <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 28 }}>No active class schedules matched your filter.</div>;
      }
      return blocks.map((ts, idx) => renderScheduleBlock(ts, `ts-${ts.teacher_id}`, idx > 0));
    }

    if (payload.pack_type === 'CLASS_LIST') {
      const lists = payload.class_lists || [];
      if (lists.length === 0) {
        return <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 28 }}>No enrolled students matched your filter.</div>;
      }
      return lists.map((cl, idx) => renderClassListBlock(cl, `cl-${cl.section_id}`, idx > 0));
    }

    if (payload.pack_type === 'QR_ID_CARDS') {
      const cards = payload.cards || [];
      if (cards.length === 0) {
        return (
          <div className="print-pack-page" data-print-page="true" style={sheetPageStyle}>
            {renderDepEdHeader(
              'Printable Student QR ID Cards',
              'Total Cards: 0 • Cut along dashed lines • Signed classroom camera QR codes'
            )}
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 28 }}>No students matched your filter for QR ID cards.</div>
          </div>
        );
      }
      const perPage = pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? cards.length : pageConfig.orientation === 'landscape' ? 8 : 6;
      const chunks: QrCardItem[][] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < cards.length; i += perPage) {
        chunks.push(cards.slice(i, i + perPage));
      }
      return (
        <>
          {chunks.map((chunk, chunkIdx) => (
            <div key={`qr-page-${chunkIdx}`} className="print-pack-page" data-print-page="true" style={sheetPageStyle}>
              {renderDepEdHeader(
                'Printable Student QR ID Cards',
                `Total Cards: ${cards.length} • Page ${chunkIdx + 1} of ${chunks.length} • Cut along dashed lines`
              )}
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
                {chunk.map((card) => (
                  <div
                    key={card.student_id}
                    className="qr-card-item"
                    style={{
                      borderWidth: 1.5,
                      borderStyle: 'dashed',
                      borderColor: tokens.borderStrong,
                      borderRadius: 10,
                      overflow: 'hidden',
                      backgroundColor: QR_COLORS.background,
                    }}
                  >
                    <div
                      style={{
                        backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg,
                        color: tokens.onPrimary,
                        padding: '8px 10px',
                        textAlign: 'center',
                      }}
                    >
                      <div
                        style={{
                          display: 'inline-flex',
                          alignItems: 'center',
                          gap: 4,
                          fontSize: '0.68rem',
                          fontWeight: 800,
                        }}
                      >
                        <ShieldCheck size={12} />
                        <span>OFFICIAL STUDENT QR ID</span>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.64rem', opacity: 0.92, marginTop: 1 }}>{card.school_name}</div>
                    </div>

                    <div
                      style={{
                        padding: '10px 12px',
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        gap: 10,
                      }}
                    >
                      <div style={{ textAlign: 'left', flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: '0.84rem', color: QR_COLORS.foreground }}>
                          {card.full_name}
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: QR_COLORS.foreground, marginTop: 2 }}>
                          {card.grade_section}
                        </div>
                        <div
                          style={{
                            fontFamily: fonts.mono,
                            fontSize: '0.74rem',
                            fontWeight: 800,
                            color: brand.primary,
                            marginTop: 5,
                          }}
                        >
                          LRN: {card.lrn}
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.66rem', color: QR_COLORS.foreground, marginTop: 4 }}>
                          Adviser: {card.adviser_name}
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.64rem', color: QR_COLORS.foreground, marginTop: 1 }}>
                          SY {card.school_year || payload.school?.school_year || '—'}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div
                        style={{
                          padding: 4,
                          borderWidth: 1,
                          borderStyle: 'solid',
                          borderColor: tokens.borderStrong,
                          borderRadius: 6,
                          backgroundColor: QR_COLORS.background,
                          flexShrink: 0,
                        }}
                      >
                        <QrCodeSvg value={card.qr_payload} size={92} label={`QR code for ${card.full_name}`} />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </>
      );
    }

    if (payload.pack_type === 'TEACHER_DIRECTORY') {
      const teachers = payload.teachers || [];
      return (
        <div className="print-pack-page" data-print-page="true" style={sheetPageStyle}>
          {renderDepEdHeader(
            'School Teachers Directory',
            `Total Teachers: ${teachers.length} • Generated: ${payload.generated_at}`
          )}
          <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse' }}>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style={paperThStyle}>Employee ID</th>
                <th style={paperThStyle}>Full Name</th>
                <th style={paperThStyle}>Position</th>
                <th style={paperThStyle}>Department</th>
                <th style={paperThStyle}>Status</th>
                <th style={paperThStyle}>Advisory Class</th>
                <th style={{ ...paperThStyle, textAlign: 'right' }}>Classes</th>
                <th style={paperThStyle}>Contact</th>
                <th style={paperThStyle}>Phone Binding</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {teachers.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={9} style={{ ...paperCellStyle, textAlign: 'center', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
                    No teachers matched your filter.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                teachers.map((t) => (
                  <tr key={t.teacher_id}>
                    <td style={{ ...paperCellStyle, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>{t.employee_id}</td>
                    <td style={{ ...paperCellStyle, fontWeight: 700 }}>{t.full_name}</td>
                    <td style={paperCellStyle}>{t.position}</td>
                    <td style={paperCellStyle}>{t.department}</td>
                    <td style={paperCellStyle}>{t.teaching_status}</td>
                    <td style={paperCellStyle}>{t.advisory_label}</td>
                    <td style={{ ...paperCellStyle, textAlign: 'right' }}>
                      {t.scheduled_periods_count} ({t.weekly_hours.toFixed(1)}h)
                    </td>
                    <td style={paperCellStyle}>{t.contact_number || t.email || '—'}</td>
                    <td style={paperCellStyle}>{t.phone_status}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
          {renderSignatures('Prepared By:', payload.generated_by)}
        </div>
      );
    }

    // COMPLETE_TEACHER_PACKET
    const packets = payload.packets || [];
    if (packets.length === 0) {
      return <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 28 }}>No schedules or class lists matched your filter.</div>;
    }

    const elements: React.ReactNode[] = [];
    packets.forEach((pkt, pktIdx) => {
      elements.push(renderScheduleBlock(pkt, `pkt-sched-${pkt.teacher_id}`, pktIdx > 0));
      pkt.class_lists.forEach((cl) => {
        elements.push(renderClassListBlock(cl, `pkt-${pkt.teacher_id}-cl-${cl.section_id}`, true));
      });
    });
    return <>{elements}</>;
  };

  const showSectionPicker =
    scope === 'SELECTED' && sectionOptions.length > 0 && packType !== 'TEACHER_DIRECTORY';
  const showTeacherPicker =
    scope === 'SELECTED' &&
    isSchoolLeader &&
    teacherOptions.length > 0 &&
    (packType === 'TEACHER_DIRECTORY' ||
      packType === 'CLASS_SCHEDULE' ||
      packType === 'COMPLETE_TEACHER_PACKET');

  const selectedSummaryText = useMemo(() => {
    const parts: string[] = [];
    if (pickedStudentIds.length > 0) parts.push(`${pickedStudentIds.length} students`);
    if (pickedPeriodIds.length > 0) parts.push(`${pickedPeriodIds.length} periods`);
    if (pickedSectionIds.length > 0) parts.push(`${pickedSectionIds.length} sections`);
    if (pickedTeacherIds.length > 0) parts.push(`${pickedTeacherIds.length} teachers`);
    return parts.join(', ');
  }, [pickedStudentIds, pickedPeriodIds, pickedSectionIds, pickedTeacherIds]);

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title={title} maxWidth="1060px">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
        {/* 1. Document Type & Scope Controls */}
        <div
          style={{
            ...ui.subtleBox,
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: 10,
            padding: '12px 14px',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {allowedPackTypes.map((type) => {
                const active = packType === type;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={type}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setPackType(type)}
                    style={{
                      padding: '6px 12px',
                      borderRadius: radius.pill,
                      borderWidth: 1,
                      borderStyle: 'solid',
                      borderColor: active ? brand.primary : tokens.borderStrong,
                      backgroundColor: active ? brand.buttonBg : tokens.bgSurface,
                      color: active ? tokens.onPrimary : tokens.textPrimary,
                      fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                      fontWeight: 800,
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                    }}
                  >
                    {PACK_LABELS[type]}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setScope('ALL')}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 12px',
                  borderRadius: radius.sm,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderStyle: 'solid',
                  borderColor: scope === 'ALL' ? brand.primary : tokens.borderStrong,
                  backgroundColor: scope === 'ALL' ? tokens.primaryLight : tokens.bgSurface,
                  color: scope === 'ALL' ? brand.primary : tokens.textSecondary,
                  fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                }}
              >
                All Accessible
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setScope('SELECTED')}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 12px',
                  borderRadius: radius.sm,
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  borderStyle: 'solid',
                  borderColor: scope === 'SELECTED' ? brand.primary : tokens.borderStrong,
                  backgroundColor: scope === 'SELECTED' ? tokens.primaryLight : tokens.bgSurface,
                  color: scope === 'SELECTED' ? brand.primary : tokens.textSecondary,
                  fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                }}
              >
                Selected Only{selectedSummaryText ? ` (${selectedSummaryText})` : ''}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {showSectionPicker && (
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textSecondary, marginBottom: 6 }}>
                Select Class Sections ({pickedSectionIds.length} selected):
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6, maxHeight: 100, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
                {sectionOptions.map((sec) => {
                  const checked = pickedSectionIds.includes(sec.id);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={sec.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => toggleId(pickedSectionIds, sec.id, setPickedSectionIds)}
                      style={{
                        display: 'inline-flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        gap: 5,
                        padding: '4px 9px',
                        borderRadius: radius.sm,
                        borderWidth: 1,
                        borderStyle: 'solid',
                        borderColor: checked ? brand.primary : tokens.borderSubtle,
                        backgroundColor: checked ? tokens.primaryLight : tokens.bgSurface,
                        color: checked ? brand.primary : tokens.textSecondary,
                        fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        cursor: 'pointer',
                      }}
                    >
                      {checked ? <CheckSquare size={12} /> : <Square size={12} />}
                      <span>{sec.label}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {showTeacherPicker && (
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textSecondary, marginBottom: 6 }}>
                Select Teachers ({pickedTeacherIds.length} selected):
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6, maxHeight: 100, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
                {teacherOptions.map((t) => {
                  const checked = pickedTeacherIds.includes(t.id);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={t.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => toggleId(pickedTeacherIds, t.id, setPickedTeacherIds)}
                      style={{
                        display: 'inline-flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        gap: 5,
                        padding: '4px 9px',
                        borderRadius: radius.sm,
                        borderWidth: 1,
                        borderStyle: 'solid',
                        borderColor: checked ? brand.primary : tokens.borderSubtle,
                        backgroundColor: checked ? tokens.primaryLight : tokens.bgSurface,
                        color: checked ? brand.primary : tokens.textSecondary,
                        fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        cursor: 'pointer',
                      }}
                    >
                      {checked ? <CheckSquare size={12} /> : <Square size={12} />}
                      <span>{t.label}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* 2. Export & Print Action Toolbar */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsPageSetupOpen(true)}
              icon={<SlidersHorizontal size={14} />}
            >
              Page Setup ({(PAPER_SIZES[pageConfig.paperSize]?.name || 'A4').split(' ')[0]} &bull;{' '}
              {pageConfig.orientation === 'landscape' ? 'Landscape' : 'Portrait'})
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              type="button"
              disabled={!payload || loading || exporting !== null}
              loading={exporting === 'PRINT'}
              onClick={() => void handlePrint()}
              icon={<Printer size={14} />}
            >
              Print
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              type="button"
              disabled={!payload || loading || exporting !== null}
              loading={exporting === 'PDF'}
              onClick={() => void handleExportPdf()}
              icon={<FileText size={14} />}
            >
              Save PDF
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              type="button"
              disabled={!payload || loading || exporting !== null}
              loading={exporting === 'EXCEL'}
              onClick={() => void handleExportOffice('EXCEL')}
              icon={<FileSpreadsheet size={14} />}
            >
              Excel (.xls)
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              type="button"
              disabled={!payload || loading || exporting !== null}
              loading={exporting === 'WORD'}
              onClick={() => void handleExportOffice('WORD')}
              icon={<FileText size={14} />}
            >
              Word (.doc)
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              type="button"
              disabled={!payload || loading || exporting !== null}
              loading={exporting === 'CSV'}
              onClick={() => void handleExportCsv()}
              icon={<Download size={14} />}
            >
              CSV (.csv)
            </Button>
          </div>

          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            type="button"
            disabled={loading}
            onClick={handleRefreshPreview}
            icon={<RefreshCw size={13} />}
          >
            Refresh Preview
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* 3. Live Paper Preview */}
        {error && (
          <div
            style={{
              ...ui.subtleBox,
              backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
              borderColor: brand.danger,
              color: brand.danger,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 8,
              fontWeight: 700,
              fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
            }}
          >
            <AlertCircle size={16} />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {scope === 'SELECTED' && !hasAnySelection ? (
          <div
            style={{
              ...ui.subtleBox,
              padding: 28,
              textAlign: 'center',
              color: tokens.textSecondary,
              fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
            }}
          >
            Check at least one item in the table or pick sections/teachers above to preview{' '}
            <strong>Selected Only</strong>, or switch to <strong>All Accessible</strong>.
          </div>
        ) : loading ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            <Loader2
              size={26}
              className="animate-spin"
              color={brand.primary}
              style={{ margin: '0 auto 8px', display: 'block' }}
            />
            <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 700 }}>
              Preparing printable {PACK_LABELS[packType].toLowerCase()}...
            </span>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div
            style={{
              maxHeight: '52vh',
              overflowY: 'auto',
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderStyle: 'solid',
              borderColor: tokens.borderStrong,
              borderRadius: radius.md,
              backgroundColor: QR_COLORS.background,
              color: QR_COLORS.foreground,
              padding: 18,
            }}
          >
            <div ref={sheetRef}>{renderPreviewBody()}</div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <PageSetupModal
        isOpen={isPageSetupOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsPageSetupOpen(false)}
        currentConfig={pageConfig}
        onLiveChange={setPageConfig}
        onApply={(cfg) => setPageConfig(cfg)}
        reportTitle={PACK_LABELS[packType]}
      />
    </Modal>
  );
};

export default PrintableExportModal;

/**
 * AttendSure - User Profile View & Edit Modal
 * File: web/src/components/modals/ProfileModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { AvatarUploadField } from '../common/AvatarUploadField';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { useFieldAvailability } from '../../hooks/useFieldAvailability';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface ProfileUpdatePayload {
  full_name?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  token?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface ProfileModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onProfileUpdated?: (updated: ProfileUpdatePayload) => void;
}

const SUFFIX_OPTIONS = ['', 'Jr.', 'Sr.', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V'];

const sanitizeField = (raw: string, maxLen = 100): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '').slice(0, maxLen);

const sanitizePassword = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').slice(0, 128);

export const ProfileModal: React.FC<ProfileModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onProfileUpdated }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [profileIds, setProfileIds] = useState<{ userId?: number; teacherId?: number }>({});
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    first_name: '',
    middle_name: '',
    last_name: '',
    suffix: '',
    email: '',
    contact_number: '',
    position: '',
    department: '',
    current_password: '',
    password: '',
    photo: null as string | null,
  });

  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const submitAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      submitAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    setLoading(true);
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current || !res.data) return;
        const u = res.data;
        const pic = u.photo_url || u.photo || null;
        setProfileIds({
          userId: u.id ? Number(u.id) : undefined,
          teacherId: u.teacher_id ? Number(u.teacher_id) : undefined,
        });
        setFormData({
          first_name: sanitizeField(u.first_name || '', 100),
          middle_name: sanitizeField(u.middle_name || '', 100),
          last_name: sanitizeField(u.last_name || '', 100),
          suffix: sanitizeField(u.suffix || '', 12),
          email: sanitizeField(u.email || '', 150),
          contact_number: sanitizeField(u.contact_number || '', 30),
          position: sanitizeField(u.position || '', 100),
          department: sanitizeField(u.department || '', 100),
          current_password: '',
          password: '',
          photo: null,
        });
        setPhotoPreview(isSafeImageUrl(pic) ? pic : null);
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (
          controller.signal.aborted ||
          !mountedRef.current ||
          anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
          anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
          anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
        ) {
          return;
        }
        showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not load profile details.'), type: 'error' });
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted && mountedRef.current) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [isOpen, showAlert]);

  const cleanEmailCheck = sanitizeField(formData.email, 150).trim().toLowerCase();
  const emailFormatErr =
    cleanEmailCheck && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(cleanEmailCheck)
      ? 'Please enter a valid email address.'
      : '';
  const emailAvail = useFieldAvailability({
    enabled: isOpen && !loading && Boolean(cleanEmailCheck),
    field: 'email',
    value: cleanEmailCheck,
    formatError: emailFormatErr,
    fallbackMessage: 'This email address is already in use.',
    excludeId: profileIds.userId,
    excludeUserId: profileIds.userId,
  });

  const cleanPhoneCheck = sanitizeField(formData.contact_number, 30).trim();
  const phoneAvail = useFieldAvailability({
    enabled: isOpen && !loading && cleanPhoneCheck.replace(/\D/g, '').length >= 10,
    field: 'contact_number',
    value: cleanPhoneCheck,
    minLength: 10,
    fallbackMessage: 'This mobile number is already assigned to another staff account.',
    excludeTeacherId: profileIds.teacherId,
    excludeUserId: profileIds.userId,
  });

  const liveErrors = {
    email: emailAvail.error || undefined,
    contact_number: phoneAvail.error || undefined,
  };
  const fieldVerified = {
    email: emailAvail.verified,
    contact_number: phoneAvail.verified,
  };
  const checkingCount = (emailAvail.checking ? 1 : 0) + (phoneAvail.checking ? 1 : 0);
  const hasLiveErrors = Boolean(liveErrors.email || liveErrors.contact_number);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;
    if (hasLiveErrors) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Duplicate Information',
        message: liveErrors.email || liveErrors.contact_number || 'Please fix the highlighted errors first.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    const cleanFirst = sanitizeField(formData.first_name, 100).trim();
    const cleanLast = sanitizeField(formData.last_name, 100).trim();
    const cleanEmail = sanitizeField(formData.email, 150).trim().toLowerCase();
    const cleanPw = sanitizePassword(formData.password).trim();
    const cleanCurrentPw = sanitizePassword(formData.current_password).trim();

    if (!cleanFirst || !cleanLast) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Missing Information', message: 'First name and last name are required.', type: 'warning' });
      return;
    }
    if (cleanEmail && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(cleanEmail)) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Email', message: 'Please enter a valid email address.', type: 'warning' });
      return;
    }
    if (cleanPw && cleanPw.length < 8) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Weak Password',
        message: 'New password must be at least 8 characters long.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }
    if (cleanPw && !cleanCurrentPw) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Current Password Required',
        message: 'Please enter your current password to set a new password.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    submitAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    submitAbortRef.current = controller;

    setSaving(true);
    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      first_name: cleanFirst,
      middle_name: sanitizeField(formData.middle_name, 100).trim(),
      last_name: cleanLast,
      suffix: SUFFIX_OPTIONS.includes(formData.suffix) ? formData.suffix : '',
      email: cleanEmail,
      contact_number: sanitizeField(formData.contact_number, 30).trim(),
    };
    if (formData.photo !== null) {
      if (formData.photo === '') {
        payload.photo = null;
        payload.remove_photo = true;
      } else if (isSafeImageUrl(formData.photo)) {
        payload.photo = formData.photo;
      }
    }

    try {
      let rotatedToken: string | undefined;
      if (cleanPw) {
        const pwRes = await apiClient.post(
          API_ROUTES.accounts.changePassword,
          { current_password: cleanCurrentPw, new_password: cleanPw },
          { signal: controller.signal }
        );
        if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;
        if (pwRes.data?.token) {
          rotatedToken = pwRes.data.token;
          localStorage.setItem('attendsure_token', pwRes.data.token);
        }
      }

      const res = await apiClient.put(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, payload, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;
      if (res.data?.token) {
        localStorage.setItem('attendsure_token', res.data.token);
      }
      const mergedData = rotatedToken && !res.data?.token ? { ...res.data, token: rotatedToken } : res.data;
      showAlert({
        title: 'Saved',
        message: cleanPw ? 'Profile and password updated.' : 'Profile updated.',
        type: 'success',
      });
      onProfileUpdated?.(mergedData);
      onClose();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        !mountedRef.current ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Update failed.'), type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted && mountedRef.current) {
        setSaving(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const setField = (k: Exclude<keyof typeof formData, 'photo'>, v: string) => {
    let clean = v;
    if (k === 'password' || k === 'current_password') {
      clean = sanitizePassword(v);
    } else if (k === 'email') {
      clean = sanitizeField(v, 150);
    } else if (k === 'contact_number') {
      clean = sanitizeField(v, 30);
    } else {
      clean = sanitizeField(v, 100);
    }
    setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: clean }));
  };

  const responsiveGrid: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: 'grid',
    gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 190px), 1fr))',
    gap: 10,
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title="My User Profile">
      {loading ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
          <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" style={{ margin: '0 auto 6px', display: 'block', color: brand.primary }} />
          Loading profile...
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          <AvatarUploadField
            previewUrl={photoPreview}
            displayName={`${formData.first_name} ${formData.last_name}`.trim() || 'My Profile'}
            label="Profile Photo"
            size={56}
            disabled={saving}
            onSelectPhoto={(_file, dataUri) => {
              setPhotoPreview(dataUri);
              setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: dataUri }));
            }}
            onRemovePhoto={() => {
              setPhotoPreview(null);
              setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: '' }));
            }}
            onValidationError={(msg) => showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Image', message: msg, type: 'error' })}
          />

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>First Name</label>
              <input required maxLength={100} style={ui.input} value={formData.first_name} onChange={(e) => setField('first_name', e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Last Name</label>
              <input required maxLength={100} style={ui.input} value={formData.last_name} onChange={(e) => setField('last_name', e.target.value)} />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Middle Name</label>
              <input maxLength={100} style={ui.input} value={formData.middle_name} onChange={(e) => setField('middle_name', e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Suffix</label>
              <select style={ui.input} value={formData.suffix} onChange={(e) => setField('suffix', e.target.value)}>
                {SUFFIX_OPTIONS.map((s) => (
                  <option key={s} value={s}>
                    {s || 'None'}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Email</label>
              <input
                type="email"
                maxLength={150}
                style={{
                  ...ui.input,
                  borderColor: liveErrors.email
                    ? brand.danger
                    : fieldVerified.email
                      ? brand.success
                      : tokens.borderStrong,
                }}
                value={formData.email}
                onChange={(e) => setField('email', e.target.value)}
              />
              {liveErrors.email && (
                <span style={{ display: 'block', marginTop: 3, fontSize: '0.70rem', fontWeight: 700, color: brand.danger }}>
                  {liveErrors.email}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Contact Number</label>
              <input
                maxLength={30}
                style={{
                  ...ui.input,
                  borderColor: liveErrors.contact_number
                    ? brand.danger
                    : fieldVerified.contact_number
                      ? brand.success
                      : tokens.borderStrong,
                }}
                value={formData.contact_number}
                onChange={(e) => setField('contact_number', e.target.value)}
              />
              {liveErrors.contact_number && (
                <span style={{ display: 'block', marginTop: 3, fontSize: '0.70rem', fontWeight: 700, color: brand.danger }}>
                  {liveErrors.contact_number}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Current Password (If changing)</label>
              <input
                type="password"
                maxLength={128}
                autoComplete="current-password"
                placeholder="Current password"
                style={ui.input}
                value={formData.current_password}
                onChange={(e) => setField('current_password', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>New Password (Optional)</label>
              <input
                type="password"
                maxLength={128}
                autoComplete="new-password"
                placeholder="Min 8 characters"
                style={ui.input}
                value={formData.password}
                onChange={(e) => setField('password', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={onClose}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="submit" disabled={saving || hasLiveErrors || checkingCount > 0}>
              {saving ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : 'Save Changes'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
};

export default ProfileModal;

/**

 * File: web/src/components/modals/ScheduleAlarmModal.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { BellRing, Clock, Volume2, ArrowRight, AlarmClockOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import type { ActiveAlarmEvent } from '../../utils/scheduleAlarms';
import type { NavItemKey } from '../layout/Sidebar';

interface ScheduleAlarmModalProps {
  alarm: ActiveAlarmEvent | null;
  onDismiss: () => void;
  onSnooze: () => void;
  onNavigateTab: (tab: NavItemKey) => void;
}

export const ScheduleAlarmModal: React.FC<ScheduleAlarmModalProps> = ({
  alarm,
  onDismiss,
  onSnooze,
  onNavigateTab,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, radius, ui } = useTheme();

  if (!alarm) return null;

  const accentColor =
    alarm.kind === 'TIME_IN'
      ? brand.success
      : alarm.kind === 'TIME_OUT'
        ? brand.warning
        : brand.primary;

  const accentSoft =
    alarm.kind === 'TIME_IN'
      ? tokens.successLight
      : alarm.kind === 'TIME_OUT'
        ? tokens.warningLight
        : tokens.primaryLight;

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={Boolean(alarm)} onClose={onDismiss} title="Schedule & Time In / Out Alarm" maxWidth="460px">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center', gap: 14 }}>
        <div
          style={{
            width: 68,
            height: 68,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            backgroundColor: accentSoft,
            borderWidth: 2,
            borderStyle: 'solid',
            borderColor: accentColor,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
          }}
        >
          <BellRing size={32} color={accentColor} />
        </div>

        <div>
          <span style={ui.badge(accentSoft, accentColor)}>
            <Volume2 size={11} /> ALARM RINGING
          </span>
          <h3
            style={{
              margin: '8px 0 4px',
              fontSize: fonts.size.lg,
              fontWeight: 900,
              color: tokens.textPrimary,
            }}
          >
            {alarm.title}
          </h3>
          <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            {alarm.subtitle}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div
          style={{
            ...ui.subtleBox,
            width: '100%',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            gap: 8,
            padding: '10px 14px',
            borderRadius: radius.md,
          }}
        >
          <Clock size={16} color={accentColor} />
          <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: 900, color: tokens.textPrimary, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>
            {alarm.timeLabel}
          </span>
        </div>

        <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: fonts.size.sm, color: tokens.textSecondary, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
          {alarm.detail}
        </p>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, width: '100%', marginTop: 4 }}>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            size="md"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              onDismiss();
              onNavigateTab(alarm.targetTab);
            }}
            icon={<ArrowRight size={15} />}
          >
            {alarm.actionLabel}
          </Button>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={onSnooze} style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              Snooze 5 min
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="md"
              type="button"
              onClick={onDismiss}
              icon={<AlarmClockOff size={14} />}
              style={{ flex: 1 }}
            >
              Stop Alarm
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
};

export default ScheduleAlarmModal;
