/**
 * AttendSure - Digital ID & Signed QR Pass Modal
 * File: web/src/components/modals/StudentIdPassModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { escapeHtml } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { useCopyFeedback } from '../../utils/clipboard';
import { QrCodeSvg, buildQrSvgDataUri } from '../common/QrCodeSvg';
import { PageSetupModal } from '../common/PageSetupModal';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import {
  exportElementToLocalPdf,
  printHtmlWithPageSetup,
} from '../../utils/reportExporters';
import {
  DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP,
  PAPER_SIZES,
  type PageSetupConfig,
} from '../../types/pageSetup';
import { ShieldCheck, Copy, Check, Printer, Download, SlidersHorizontal, User as UserIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import type { StudentItem, AssignedClass } from '../tabs/MyAssignedClassesTab';

const DEFAULT_ID_PASS_PAGE_SETUP: PageSetupConfig = {
  ...DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP,
  layoutMode: 'pages',
  orientation: 'portrait',
  paperSize: 'letter',
  pageColor: '#ffffff',
  marginPreset: 'narrow',
  margins: { top: 0.5, right: 0.5, bottom: 0.5, left: 0.5 },
  headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
};

interface StudentIdPassModalProps {
  student:
    | (Partial<StudentItem> & {
        name: string;
        lrn: string;
        qr_token?: string;
        qr_payload?: string;
        photo_url?: string | null;
      })
    | null;
  selectedClass?: AssignedClass | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onCopyLrn: (lrn: string) => void;
}

export const StudentIdPassModal: React.FC<StudentIdPassModalProps> = ({
  student,
  selectedClass,
  onClose,
  onCopyLrn,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();
  const { school } = useSchool();
  const { copied, copy } = useCopyFeedback();
  const [pageConfig, setPageConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(DEFAULT_ID_PASS_PAGE_SETUP);
  const [isPageSetupOpen, setIsPageSetupOpen] = useState(false);
  const [savingPdf, setSavingPdf] = useState(false);
  const passCardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  if (!student) return null;
  const safePhoto = isSafeImageUrl(student.photo_url) ? student.photo_url : null;
  const identifier = student.lrn || 'ID-00000';
  // Prefer digitally signed qr_payload so passes verify cleanly on built-in QR Scanners
  const qrData = student.qr_payload || identifier;
  const schoolName = school.school_name || 'Authorized School Campus';
  const subtitle = selectedClass?.section_name || 'Authorized Student';
  const signatureLabel = student.qr_payload ? 'Digitally Verified' : 'Active';

  const handleCopyIdentifier = () => {
    void copy(identifier, 'lrn');
    onCopyLrn(identifier);
  };

  const handlePrintPass = () => {
    const qrDataUri = buildQrSvgDataUri(qrData, 180);
    const photoMarkup =
      safePhoto && isSafeImageUrl(safePhoto)
        ? `<img src="${escapeHtml(safePhoto)}" alt="${escapeHtml(student.name)}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;" />`
        : `<span style="font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:#004b87;">${escapeHtml(student.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'S')}</span>`;

    const cardMarkup = `
      <div class="print-pack-page" data-print-page="true" style="display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;padding-top:12px;">
        <div class="id-pass-card">
          <div class="head">
            <div class="head-title">ATTENDSURE OFFICIAL PASS</div>
            <div class="head-school">${escapeHtml(schoolName)}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="body">
            <div class="avatar">${photoMarkup}</div>
            <div class="name">${escapeHtml(student.name)}</div>
            <div class="sub">${escapeHtml(subtitle)}</div>
            <div class="lrn">LRN: ${escapeHtml(identifier)}</div>
            <div class="qr-box">
              <img src="${qrDataUri}" alt="AttendSure QR Code" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="foot">
            Verification Signature: <strong>${escapeHtml(signatureLabel)}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;

    printHtmlWithPageSetup({
      title: `AttendSure ID Pass - ${student.name}`,
      bodyHtml: cardMarkup,
      pageConfig,
      extraCss: `
        .id-pass-card { width: 300px; border: 2px solid #004b87; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; text-align: center; background: #ffffff; }
        .head { background: #004b87; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px; }
        .head-title { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
        .head-school { font-size: 10px; opacity: 0.92; margin-top: 3px; }
        .body { padding: 16px; }
        .avatar { width: 58px; height: 58px; border-radius: 50%; margin: 0 auto 10px; border: 2px solid #cbd5e1; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #f8fafc; }
        .name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; }
        .sub { font-size: 12px; color: #475569; margin-top: 3px; }
        .lrn { display: inline-block; margin: 10px auto; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #f8fafc; font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
        .qr-box { width: 148px; height: 148px; margin: 8px auto 0; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; }
        .qr-box img { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
        .foot { background: #f8fafc; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 9px; font-size: 11px; color: #475569; }
      `,
    });
  };

  const handleSavePdf = async () => {
    if (!passCardRef.current) return;
    setSavingPdf(true);
    try {
      const paper = PAPER_SIZES[pageConfig.paperSize] || PAPER_SIZES.letter;
      const isLandscape = pageConfig.orientation === 'landscape';
      const safeName = student.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_') || 'Student';
      await exportElementToLocalPdf({
        element: passCardRef.current,
        filename: `AttendSure_ID_Pass_${safeName}.pdf`,
        pageWidthInches: isLandscape ? paper.height : paper.width,
        pageHeightInches: isLandscape ? paper.width : paper.height,
        orientation: pageConfig.orientation,
        pageColor: pageConfig.pageColor,
        pageless: pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless',
        marginsInches: [
          pageConfig.margins.top,
          pageConfig.margins.right,
          pageConfig.margins.bottom,
          pageConfig.margins.left,
        ],
      });
    } finally {
      setSavingPdf(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={Boolean(student)} onClose={onClose} title="Digital QR ID Pass">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center' }}>
        <div
          ref={passCardRef}
          data-print-page="true"
          style={{
            width: 290,
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
            border: `2px solid ${brand.primary}`,
            borderRadius: 14,
            overflow: 'hidden',
            boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg, color: '#ffffff', padding: 12 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: fonts.size.xs, fontWeight: 800 }}>
              <ShieldCheck size={14} /> ATTENDSURE OFFICIAL PASS
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.62rem', opacity: 0.92, marginTop: 2 }}>
              {schoolName}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ padding: 16 }}>
            <div
              style={{
                width: 54,
                height: 54,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                margin: '0 auto 10px',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `2px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                overflow: 'hidden',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
              }}
            >
              {safePhoto ? (
                <img src={safePhoto} alt={student.name} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
              ) : (
                <UserIcon size={26} color={tokens.textMuted} />
              )}
            </div>

            <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{student.name}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, color: tokens.textSecondary, marginTop: 2 }}>
              {subtitle}
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleCopyIdentifier}
              style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, margin: '10px auto', fontFamily: fonts.mono }}
            >
              <span>LRN: {identifier}</span>
              {copied ? <Check size={12} color={brand.success} /> : <Copy size={12} />}
            </button>

            <div
              style={{
                margin: '6px auto',
                padding: 6,
                backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                borderRadius: 10,
                width: 124,
                height: 124,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
              }}
            >
              <QrCodeSvg
                value={qrData}
                size={112}
                label={`AttendSure QR code for ${student.name}`}
                style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div
            style={{
              backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
              borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
              padding: 8,
              fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
              color: tokens.textSecondary,
            }}
          >
            Verification Signature:{' '}
            <strong style={{ color: student.qr_payload ? brand.success : brand.warning }}>
              {signatureLabel}
            </strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 14, flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" type="button" onClick={() => setIsPageSetupOpen(true)}>
            <SlidersHorizontal size={13} style={{ marginRight: 5 }} /> Page Setup
          </Button>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" type="button" disabled={savingPdf} onClick={() => void handleSavePdf()}>
            <Download size={13} style={{ marginRight: 5 }} /> {savingPdf ? 'Saving...' : 'Save PDF'}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="button" onClick={handlePrintPass}>
            <Printer size={13} style={{ marginRight: 5 }} /> Print Pass
          </Button>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" type="button" onClick={onClose}>
            Close
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <PageSetupModal
        isOpen={isPageSetupOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsPageSetupOpen(false)}
        currentConfig={pageConfig}
        onLiveChange={setPageConfig}
        onApply={(cfg) => setPageConfig(cfg)}
        reportTitle="Student QR ID Pass"
      />
    </Modal>
  );
};

export default StudentIdPassModal;

const DEFAULT_REPORTS: ReportTabItem[] = [
  { id: 'sf1', label: 'Form 1 (School Register)', icon: FileText },
  { id: 'sf2', label: 'Form 2 (Daily Attendance)', icon: CalendarCheck },
  { id: 'sf4', label: 'Form 4 (Monthly Movement)', icon: FileSpreadsheet },

const DEFAULT_MONTHS = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
];

const getCurrentMonthName = (): string => {
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { month: 'long' }).format(new Date());
  } catch {
    return 'January';
  }
};

const extractSectionGradeName = (sec?: SectionOption | null): string => {
  if (!sec) return '';
  if (sec.grade_level_name && String(sec.grade_level_name).trim()) {
    return String(sec.grade_level_name).trim();
  }
  const val = sec.grade_level;
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof val === 'string') return /^\d+$/.test(val.trim()) ? '' : val.trim();
  if (typeof val === 'object') {
    const name = val.name || val.grade_name || val.level || val.code;
    return name ? String(name).trim() : '';
  }
  return '';
};

export const ReportNavBar: React.FC<ReportNavBarProps> = ({
  reports = DEFAULT_REPORTS,
  activeReportId,
  onSelectReport,
  academicYears = [],
  selectedAcademicYear = '',
  onAcademicYearChange,
  showAcademicYearFilter = false,
  gradeLevels = [],
  selectedGradeLevel = 'ALL',
  onGradeLevelChange,
  showGradeLevelFilter = true,
  sections = [],
  selectedSectionId,
  onSectionChange,
  showSectionFilter = true,
  showDateFilter = false,
  selectedDate = '',
  onDateChange,
  showMonthFilter = false,
  selectedMonth = getCurrentMonthName(),
  onMonthChange,
  monthsList = DEFAULT_MONTHS,
  showCalendarYearFilter = false,
  selectedCalendarYear = new Date().getFullYear(),
  onCalendarYearChange,
  searchQuery = '',
  onSearchChange,
  showSearch = true,
  layoutMode = 'pages',
  onToggleLayoutMode,
  showLayoutModeToggle = true,
  onRefresh,
  isRefreshing = false,
  onOpenPageSetup,
  exportHandlers,
  onPrint,
  isExporting = false,
  exportingText = 'Exporting...',
  disableActions = false,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [isExportDropdownOpen, setIsExportDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const currentUser = getCurrentUserFromStorage();
  const allowSf4 = canViewSf4(currentUser);

  const filteredReports = useMemo(() => {
    return reports.filter((rep) => {
      if (rep.id === 'sf4' && !allowSf4) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }, [reports, allowSf4]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isExportDropdownOpen) return;

    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isExportDropdownOpen]);

  const filteredSections = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedGradeLevel || selectedGradeLevel === 'ALL') {
      return sections;
    }
    const target = selectedGradeLevel.toLowerCase().trim();
    return sections.filter((sec) => {
      const g = extractSectionGradeName(sec).toLowerCase();
      return g === target || g.includes(target);
    });
  }, [sections, selectedGradeLevel]);

  const availableGradeLevels = useMemo(() => {
    if (gradeLevels && gradeLevels.length > 0) {
      return gradeLevels
        .map((g) => String(g || '').trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));
    }
    const extracted = Array.from(new Set(sections.map(extractSectionGradeName).filter(Boolean)));
    return extracted.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));
  }, [gradeLevels, sections]);

  const handleExportAction = (action?: () => void | Promise<void>) => {
    setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
    if (action) void action();
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="no-print"
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        width: '100%',
        flexShrink: 0,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '10px 24px',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        }}
      >
        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted, letterSpacing: '0.4px', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
          REPORT FORM:
        </span>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, padding: '4px', borderRadius: 10, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
          {filteredReports.map((rep) => {
            const Icon = rep.icon;
            const isActive = rep.id === activeReportId;
            return (
              <button
                key={rep.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onSelectReport(rep.id)}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 14px',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  border: 'none',
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,
                  backgroundColor: isActive ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent',
                  color: isActive ? tokens.onPrimary : tokens.textSecondary,
                  boxShadow: isActive ? tokens.cardShadow : 'none',
                  transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                }}
              >
                {Icon && <Icon size={15} />}
                <span>{rep.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          padding: '10px 24px',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 12,
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {showAcademicYearFilter && onAcademicYearChange && academicYears.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>School Year:</span>
              <select
                value={selectedAcademicYear}
                onChange={(e) => onAcademicYearChange(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,

                }}

          )}

          {showGradeLevelFilter && onGradeLevelChange && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>

          {showSectionFilter && (

export const DEFAULT_DEPED_LANDSCAPE_SETUP: PageSetupConfig = {
  ...DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP,
  layoutMode: 'pages',
  orientation: 'landscape',
  paperSize: 'legal',
  pageColor: SEAL_COLORS.white,

export const resolvePaperDimensionsInches = (
  config: PageSetupConfig
): { widthIn: number; heightIn: number } => {
  const paper = PAPER_SIZES[config.paperSize] || PAPER_SIZES.legal;
  const isLandscape = config.orientation === 'landscape';
  return isLandscape
    ? { widthIn: paper.height, heightIn: paper.width }
    : { widthIn: paper.width, heightIn: paper.height };
};

export interface ReportHeaderBarProps {
  activeReportId?: string;
  onSelectReport?: (reportId: string) => void;
  documentTitle: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  isSavingPdf?: boolean;
  onOpenPageSetup: () => void;
  onPrint: () => void;
  onSavePdf: () => void;
  onSavePdfAs?: () => void;
  onDownloadExcel: () => void;
  onSaveExcelAs?: () => void;
  onDownloadCsv: () => void;
  onSaveCsvAs?: () => void;
  onDownloadWord: () => void;
  onSaveWordAs?: () => void;
  onDownloadJson: () => void;
  onSaveJsonAs?: () => void;
}

export const ReportHeaderBar: React.FC<ReportHeaderBarProps> = ({
  activeReportId = 'sf1',
  onSelectReport,
  documentTitle,
  subtitle,
  isSavingPdf = false,
  onOpenPageSetup,
  onPrint,
  onSavePdf,
  onSavePdfAs,
  onDownloadExcel,
  onSaveExcelAs,
  onDownloadCsv,
  onSaveCsvAs,
  onDownloadWord,
  onSaveWordAs,
  onDownloadJson,
  onSaveJsonAs,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const isLeader = canViewSf4(getCurrentUserFromStorage());

  const reportTabs = [
    { id: 'sf1', label: 'Form 1 (School Register)' },
    { id: 'sf2', label: 'Form 2 (Daily Attendance)' },
    ...(isLeader ? [{ id: 'sf4', label: 'Form 4 (Monthly Movement)' }] : []),
  ];

  const handleSwitchReport = (reportId: string) => {
    if (onSelectReport) {
      onSelectReport(reportId);
    } else {
      window.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent('attendsure:navigate', { detail: { tab: 'reports', report: reportId } })
      );
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!menuOpen) return;

    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [menuOpen]);

  const menuActions: Array<{ label: string; fn: () => void }> = [
    { label: 'Download PDF (.pdf)', fn: onSavePdf },
    ...(onSavePdfAs ? [{ label: 'Save PDF As...', fn: onSavePdfAs }] : []),
    { label: 'Download Excel (.xls)', fn: onDownloadExcel },
    ...(onSaveExcelAs ? [{ label: 'Save Excel As...', fn: onSaveExcelAs }] : []),
    { label: 'Download CSV (.csv)', fn: onDownloadCsv },
    ...(onSaveCsvAs ? [{ label: 'Save CSV As...', fn: onSaveCsvAs }] : []),
    { label: 'Download Word (.doc)', fn: onDownloadWord },
    ...(onSaveWordAs ? [{ label: 'Save Word As...', fn: onSaveWordAs }] : []),
    { label: 'Download JSON (.json)', fn: onDownloadJson },
    ...(onSaveJsonAs ? [{ label: 'Save JSON As...', fn: onSaveJsonAs }] : []),
  ];

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', width: '100%' }}>
      {/* Report Form Switcher Bar (Form 1 / Form 2 / Form 4) */}
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '8px 24px',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
        }}
      >
        <span
          style={{
            fontSize: '0.72rem',
            fontWeight: 800,
            color: tokens.textMuted,
            letterSpacing: '0.4px',
            textTransform: 'uppercase',
          }}
        >
          REPORT FORM:
        </span>
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 6,
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
            padding: 4,
            borderRadius: 10,
            border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
          }}
        >
          {reportTabs.map((tab) => {
            const isActive = activeReportId === tab.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleSwitchReport(tab.id)}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 14px',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  border: 'none',
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  backgroundColor: isActive ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent',
                  color: isActive ? tokens.onPrimary : tokens.textSecondary,
                  boxShadow: isActive ? tokens.cardShadow : 'none',
                  transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                }}
              >
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Document Title & Export Actions Row */}
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '10px 24px',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        }}
      >
        <div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.92rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
            {documentTitle}
          </div>
          {subtitle && (
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{subtitle}</div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 8,
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            position: 'relative',
          }}
        >
          <button type="button" onClick={onOpenPageSetup} style={ui.btnSecondary}>
            <Settings size={14} />
            <span>Page Setup</span>
          </button>

          <div ref={dropdownRef} style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-haspopup="true"
              aria-expanded={menuOpen}
              onClick={() => setMenuOpen((prev) => !prev)}
              style={ui.btnSecondary}
            >
              <FileSpreadsheet size={14} />
              <span>Export Formats</span>
            </button>

            {menuOpen && (
              <div
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  right: 0,
                  top: 'calc(100% + 6px)',
                  zIndex: 50,
                  minWidth: 210,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
                  padding: 6,
                  display: 'flex',
                  flexDirection: 'column',
                  gap: 2,
                }}
              >
                {menuActions.map((item) => (
                  <button
                    key={item.label}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setMenuOpen(false);
                      item.fn();
                    }}
                    style={{
                      textAlign: 'left',
                      padding: '7px 10px',
                      borderRadius: 6,
                      border: 'none',
                      background: 'transparent',
                      color: tokens.textPrimary,
                      fontSize: '0.76rem',
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                    }}
                  >
                    {item.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onSavePdf}
            disabled={isSavingPdf}
            style={ui.btnSecondary}
          >
            {isSavingPdf ? (
              <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <Download size={14} color={brand.primary} />
            )}
            <span>{isSavingPdf ? 'Saving PDF...' : 'Export PDF'}</span>
          </button>

          <button type="button" onClick={onPrint} style={ui.btnPrimary}>
            <Printer size={14} />
            <span>Print</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const sanitizeCssToken = (raw: string, fallback: string): string => {
  const cleaned = String(raw || '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '');
  return cleaned || fallback;
};

const sanitizePageColor = (raw?: string): string => {
  if (raw && /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(raw.trim())) {
    return raw.trim();
  }
  return SEAL_COLORS.white;
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import type { AxiosResponse } from 'axios';
import jsQR from 'jsqr';
import apiClient, { invalidateApiCache, peekApiCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';

  Camera,

export interface ScannedStudent {
  student_id: number;
  student_name: string;
  lrn: string;
  section: string;
  status: string;
  scanned_at: string;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  is_duplicate?: boolean;
}

interface ClassPeriodOption {
  id: number;
  schedule_id?: number | null;
  name: string;
  grade_level: string;
  subject_code: string;
  subject_title: string;
  time_display: string;
}

interface OfflineScanEntry {
  qr_token: string;
  period_id: number | null;
  scanned_at: string;
  client_scan_uuid: string;
}

export interface ClassroomScannerProps {
  onClose?: () => void;
  isModal?: boolean;
}

const OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY = 'attendsure_offline_qr_queue';
const SCAN_CANVAS_WIDTH = 400;
const SCAN_CANVAS_HEIGHT = 300;
const SCAN_INTERVAL_MS = 66; // ~15 FPS continuous auto-scanner

const generateScanUuid = (): string => {
  if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }
  return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, (c) => {
    const r = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
    const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3) | 0x8;
    return v.toString(16);
  });
};

const loadOfflineQueue = (): OfflineScanEntry[] => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as OfflineScanEntry[]) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
};

const playFeedbackChime = (type: 'SUCCESS' | 'WARNING' | 'ERROR') => {
  try {
    const AudioCtx =
      window.AudioContext ||
      (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtx) return;
    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = type === 'SUCCESS' ? 'sine' : 'triangle';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(type === 'SUCCESS' ? 1046 : 250, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.22);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.onended = () => {
      void ctx.close().catch(() => {});
    };
    osc.start();
    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.22);
  } catch {
    // Browser autoplay policy blocked audio
  }
};

const MAX_QR_INPUT_LENGTH = 256;
const sanitizeQrInput = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .slice(0, MAX_QR_INPUT_LENGTH);

export const ClassroomScanner: React.FC<ClassroomScannerProps> = ({ onClose, isModal = false }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const warmPeriods = useMemo(() => {
    const cached = peekApiCache<ClassPeriodOption[]>(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, { summary: 1 });
    return Array.isArray(cached) ? cached.filter((p) => p.id > 0) : [];
  }, []);

  const [soundEnabled, setSoundEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [syncingOffline, setSyncingOffline] = useState(false);
  const [manualQrInput, setManualQrInput] = useState('');
  const [cameraRestartKey, setCameraRestartKey] = useState(0);

  const [periods, setPeriods] = useState<ClassPeriodOption[]>(() => warmPeriods);
  const [selectedPeriodId, setSelectedPeriodId] = useState<number | null>(() =>
    warmPeriods.length > 0 ? warmPeriods[0].id : null
  );
  const [activeStudent, setActiveStudent] = useState<ScannedStudent | null>(null);
  const [sessionList, setSessionList] = useState<ScannedStudent[]>([]);
  const [offlineQueue, setOfflineQueue] = useState<OfflineScanEntry[]>(loadOfflineQueue);
  const [cameraMessage, setCameraMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const lastFrameDecodeTsRef = useRef(0);
  const recentScansMapRef = useRef<Map<string, number>>(new Map());
  const inFlightSetRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const processScanRef = useRef<(rawCode: string) => Promise<void>>(async () => {});
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const frameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get<ClassPeriodOption[]>(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, {
        params: { summary: 1 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      })
      .then((res: AxiosResponse<ClassPeriodOption[]>) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const rawList: ClassPeriodOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : [];
        const validList = rawList.filter((p) => p.id > 0);
        setPeriods(validList);
        if (validList.length > 0) setSelectedPeriodId((prev) => prev ?? validList[0].id);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  const syncOfflineScans = useCallback(async () => {
    const queued = loadOfflineQueue();
    if (queued.length === 0) return;
    setSyncingOffline(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.attendance.offlineSync, { scans: queued });
      if (!mountedRef.current) return;
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY);
      } catch {}
      setOfflineQueue([]);
      invalidateApiCache();
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendsure:attendance-updated'));
      showAlert({
        title: 'Offline Scans Synced',
        message: `Synced ${res.data?.synced_count ?? 0} scan(s) (${res.data?.duplicate_count ?? 0} duplicate).`,
        type: 'success',
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (!mountedRef.current) return;
      showAlert({ title: 'Sync Notice', message: extractApiError(err, 'Still offline.'), type: 'warning' });
    } finally {
      if (mountedRef.current) setSyncingOffline(false);
    }
  }, [showAlert]);

  const handleProcessScan = useCallback(
    async (rawCode: string) => {
      const clean = sanitizeQrInput(rawCode).trim();
      if (!clean) return;

      const now = Date.now();
      recentScansMapRef.current.forEach((ts, k) => {
        if (now - ts > 10000) recentScansMapRef.current.delete(k);
      });
      if (
        now - (recentScansMapRef.current.get(clean) || 0) < 3000 ||
        inFlightSetRef.current.has(clean)
      ) {
        return;
      }

      recentScansMapRef.current.set(clean, now);
      inFlightSetRef.current.add(clean);
      setLoading(true);

      const scanUuid = generateScanUuid();
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.attendance.scan, {
          qr_text: clean,
          period_id: selectedPeriodId && selectedPeriodId > 0 ? selectedPeriodId : undefined,
          client_scan_uuid: scanUuid,
        });
        if (!mountedRef.current) return;

        const d = res.data || {};
        const item: ScannedStudent = {
          student_id: d.student_id,
          student_name: d.student_name,
          lrn: d.lrn,
          section: d.section,
          status: d.status || 'PRESENT',
          scanned_at: d.scanned_at,
          photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(d.photo_url) ? d.photo_url : null,
          is_duplicate: Boolean(d.is_duplicate),
        };

        setActiveStudent(item);
        invalidateApiCache();
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendsure:attendance-updated', { detail: item }));

        if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime(item.is_duplicate ? 'WARNING' : 'SUCCESS');
        if (!item.is_duplicate) {
          setSessionList((prev) => [item, ...prev.filter((p) => p.lrn !== item.lrn)]);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const netErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string; response?: unknown };
        if (
          !mountedRef.current ||
          netErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
          netErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
          netErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
        ) {
          return;
        }
        if (!netErr?.response) {
          const nextQueue: OfflineScanEntry[] = [
            ...loadOfflineQueue(),
            {
              qr_token: clean,
              period_id: selectedPeriodId && selectedPeriodId > 0 ? selectedPeriodId : null,
              scanned_at: new Date().toISOString(),
              client_scan_uuid: scanUuid,
            },
          ];
          try {
            localStorage.setItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextQueue));
          } catch {}
          setOfflineQueue(nextQueue);
          if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime('WARNING');
          showAlert({
            title: 'Saved on Device',
            message: 'School Wi-Fi is unreachable right now. This scan is safely saved on your device and will upload automatically once connected.',
            type: 'info',
          });
        } else {
          if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime('ERROR');
          showAlert({ title: 'Could Not Verify QR Card', message: extractApiError(err), type: 'warning' });
        }
      } finally {
        inFlightSetRef.current.delete(clean);
        if (mountedRef.current) {
          setLoading(inFlightSetRef.current.size > 0);
          setManualQrInput('');
        }
      }
    },
    [selectedPeriodId, soundEnabled, showAlert]
  );

  processScanRef.current = handleProcessScan;

  useEffect(() => {
    setCameraMessage(null);

    if (!window.isSecureContext || !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      const portSuffix = window.location.port ? `:${window.location.port}` : '';
      setCameraMessage(
        `Browser camera access requires HTTPS or localhost (${window.location.origin}). Open http://localhost${portSuffix} to enable your built-in camera, or verify a signed QR string below.`
      );
      return;
    }

    let active = true;
    const startCameraStream = async () => {
      let stream: MediaStream;
      try {
        stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          video: { facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' }, width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } },
          audio: false,
        });
      } catch {
        stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true, audio: false });
      }

      if (!active) {
        stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
        return;
      }

      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        await videoRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
      }

      if (!canvasRef.current) {
        canvasRef.current = document.createElement('canvas');
      }
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      canvas.width = SCAN_CANVAS_WIDTH;
      canvas.height = SCAN_CANVAS_HEIGHT;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });

      const scanFrame = (timestamp: number) => {
        if (!active) return;
        const video = videoRef.current;
        if (
          timestamp - lastFrameDecodeTsRef.current >= SCAN_INTERVAL_MS &&
          video &&
          ctx &&
          video.readyState >= video.HAVE_ENOUGH_DATA &&
          video.videoWidth > 0 &&
          video.videoHeight > 0
        ) {
          lastFrameDecodeTsRef.current = timestamp;
          ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, SCAN_CANVAS_WIDTH, SCAN_CANVAS_HEIGHT);
          const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, SCAN_CANVAS_WIDTH, SCAN_CANVAS_HEIGHT);
          const decoded = jsQR(imageData.data, SCAN_CANVAS_WIDTH, SCAN_CANVAS_HEIGHT, {
            inversionAttempts: 'dontInvert',
          });

          if (decoded?.data) {
            void processScanRef.current(decoded.data);
          }
        }
        if (active) {
          frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(scanFrame);
        }
      };

      frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(scanFrame);
    };

    startCameraStream().catch((err: unknown) => {
      if (!active) return;
      const errName = (err as { name?: string })?.name || '';
      if (errName === 'NotFoundError' || errName === 'DevicesNotFoundError') {
        setCameraMessage('No built-in camera was detected on this device.');
      } else if (errName === 'NotReadableError' || errName === 'TrackStartError') {
        setCameraMessage(
          'Your camera is currently in use by another app. Close the other app and click Retry Camera.'
        );
      } else {
        setCameraMessage(
          'Camera permission was blocked. Allow camera access in your browser address bar, then click Retry Camera.'
        );
      }
    });

    return () => {
      active = false;
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
      if (frameRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
    };
  }, [cameraRestartKey]);

  return (
    <div
      style={
        isModal
          ? {
              position: 'fixed',
              inset: 0,
              zIndex: 9999,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(15,23,42,0.65)',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: 16,
            }
          : { width: '100%' }
      }
    >
      <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden', width: '100%', maxWidth: isModal ? 900 : '100%' }}>
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            gap: 12,
            padding: '12px 18px',
            borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <div
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 7,
                padding: '6px 12px',
                borderRadius: 8,
                backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                color: brand.primary,
                fontSize: '0.78rem',
                fontWeight: 800,
              }}
            >
              <Camera size={15} />
              <span>Auto QR Scanner</span>
            </div>

            {periods.length > 0 && (
              <select
                aria-label="Select class period"
                value={selectedPeriodId || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedPeriodId(e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : null)}
                style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', minWidth: 220, padding: '6px 10px' }}
              >
                {periods.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                    {p.grade_level} - {p.name} • {p.subject_code || p.subject_title} ({p.time_display || 'Active'})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            {offlineQueue.length > 0 && (
              <button type="button" onClick={syncOfflineScans} disabled={syncingOffline} style={ui.btnPrimary}>
                <CloudUpload size={14} /> Sync Offline ({offlineQueue.length})
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setCameraRestartKey((k) => k + 1)}
              style={ui.btnSecondary}
              title="Restart built-in camera"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={14} /> Retry Camera
            </button>

            <button type="button" onClick={() => setSoundEnabled(!soundEnabled)} style={ui.btnSecondary}>
              {soundEnabled ? <Volume2 size={14} color={brand.primary} /> : <VolumeX size={14} />}
              {soundEnabled ? 'Sound On' : 'Muted'}
            </button>

            {onClose && (
              <button
                type="button"

                onClick={onClose}

                <div style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, color: brand.warning, lineHeight: 1.5, fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                  {cameraMessage}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div
                  style={{

                    backgroundColor: tokens.darkSurface,
                    borderRadius: 10,
                    overflow: 'hidden',
                    display: 'flex',

                  }}
                >
                  <video ref={videoRef} muted playsInline style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
                  <div
                    style={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      width: 185,

                      border: `3px solid ${loading ? brand.success : brand.primary}`,

                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

  onDemoLoginSuccess: (session: UserSession, targetTab?: NavItemKey) => void;

const clearPreviousSessionStorage = (): void => {
  [
    'attendsure_access',
    'attendsure_refresh',
    'attendsure_token',
    'auth_token',
    'token',
    'attendsure_username',
    'attendsure_teacher_name',
    'attendsure_role',
    'attendsure_user_id',
    'attendsure_teacher_id',
    'attendsure_is_superuser',
    'attendsure_user_photo',
    'attendsure_can_teach',
  ].forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k));
};

export const StartupShowcasePage: React.FC<StartupShowcasePageProps> = ({
  onOpenSignIn,
  onDemoLoginSuccess,
}) => {
  const { mode, setThemeMode, tokens, brand, fonts } = useTheme();
  const { school, updateSchoolInstantly, refreshSchool } = useSchool();
  const { locale, setLocale, t } = useCompliance();

  const [demoEnabled, setDemoEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [demoRoles, setDemoRoles] = useState<DemoRoleOption[]>([]);
  const [launchingRole, setLaunchingRole] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [demoError, setDemoError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const loginAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.demoStatus, { timeout: 4000, signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!active || controller.signal.aborted || !res.data) return;
        setDemoEnabled(Boolean(res.data.enabled));
        const roles: DemoRoleOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data.roles) ? res.data.roles : [];
        setDemoRoles(roles);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (active && !controller.signal.aborted) setDemoEnabled(false);
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
      controller.abort();
      loginAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const handleLaunchDemo = async (role: string, targetTab: NavItemKey = 'dashboard') => {
    if (launchingRole) return;
    loginAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    loginAbortRef.current = controller;

    setDemoError(null);
    setLaunchingRole(`${role}:${targetTab}`);

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(
        API_ROUTES.accounts.demoLogin,
        { role },
        { signal: controller.signal }
      );
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      const data = res.data || {};
      const userObj = data.user || data;
      const resolvedRole = String(userObj.role || userObj.system_role || 'ADMIN').toUpperCase();
      const token = String(data.token || data.access || '').trim();
      const access = String(data.access || '').trim();
      const refresh = String(data.refresh || '').trim();
      const username = String(userObj.username || `demo_${role}`).trim();
      const teacherName = String(userObj.teacher_name || userObj.full_name || username).trim();
      const userId = Number(userObj.id || userObj.user_id || 0);
      const teacherId = userObj.teacher_id ? Number(userObj.teacher_id) : null;
      const isSuperuser = Boolean(userObj.is_superuser);
      const canTeach =
        userObj.can_handle_classes !== undefined && userObj.can_handle_classes !== null
          ? Boolean(userObj.can_handle_classes)
          : userObj.can_teach !== undefined && userObj.can_teach !== null
            ? Boolean(userObj.can_teach)
            : resolvedRole === 'TEACHER';
      const rawPhoto = (userObj.photo_url || userObj.photo) as string | null | undefined;
      const safeUserPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(rawPhoto) ? rawPhoto! : null;

      clearPreviousSessionStorage();
      clearApiClientCache();

      if (token) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_token', token);
      if (access) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_access', access);
      if (refresh) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_refresh', refresh);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_username', username);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_teacher_name', teacherName);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_role', resolvedRole);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_can_teach', String(canTeach));
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_is_superuser', String(isSuperuser));
      if (userId) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_id', String(userId));
      if (teacherId) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_teacher_id', String(teacherId));
      if (safeUserPhoto) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', safeUserPhoto);

      if (userObj.school_name || userObj.school_id) {
        updateSchoolInstantly({
          school_name: String(userObj.school_name || ''),
          school_id: String(userObj.school_id || ''),
          school_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.school_logo) ? userObj.school_logo : school.school_logo,
          left_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.left_logo) ? userObj.left_logo : school.left_logo,
          right_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.right_logo) ? userObj.right_logo : school.right_logo,
        });

/**
 * AttendSure - Circular Radar & Spiral Loader Splash Screen
 * File: web/src/components/splash/SplashScreen.tsx
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { AttendSureBrandBadge } from '../branding/BrandAssets';

interface SplashScreenProps {
  loading: boolean;
  minDurationMs?: number;
  onFinish?: () => void;
}

const SPIRAL_DOTS = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, index) => index);

export const SplashScreen: React.FC<SplashScreenProps> = ({
  loading,
  minDurationMs = 7000,
  onFinish,
}) => {
  const { mode, tokens, brand, fonts } = useTheme();
  const [canExit, setCanExit] = useState(false);
  const [fading, setFading] = useState(false);
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setCanExit(true);
    }, minDurationMs);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [minDurationMs]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading && canExit) {
      setFading(true);
      const exitTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        setHidden(true);
        if (onFinish) onFinish();
      }, 350);
      return () => clearTimeout(exitTimer);
    }
  }, [loading, canExit, onFinish]);

  if (hidden) return null;

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        zIndex: 99999,
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgCanvas,
        opacity: fading ? 0 : 1,
        transform: fading ? 'scale(1.02)' : 'scale(1)',
        transition: 'opacity 0.35s ease, transform 0.35s ease',
        pointerEvents: fading ? 'none' : 'auto',
        fontFamily: fonts.display,
        padding: '32px 24px 24px',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
      }}
    >
      <style>{`
        @keyframes radarPing {
          0% {
            transform: scale(0.95);
            opacity: 0.75;
          }
          100% {
            transform: scale(1.85);
            opacity: 0;
          }
        }
        @keyframes radarSweep {
          0% {
            transform: rotate(0deg);
          }
          100% {
            transform: rotate(360deg);
          }
        }
        @keyframes spiralDotPulse {
          0%, 100% {
            transform: scale(0.32);
            opacity: 0.2;
          }
          50% {
            transform: scale(1);
            opacity: 1;
          }
        }
      `}</style>

      {/* Top Spacer */}
      <div style={{ height: 20 }} />

      {/* Center Circular Radar Logo + Spiral Loader */}
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          alignItems: 'center',
          textAlign: 'center',
          width: '100%',
          maxWidth: 340,
        }}
      >
        {/* Circular Radar Emblem Container */}
        <div
          style={{
            position: 'relative',
            width: 112,
            height: 112,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            marginBottom: 22,
          }}
        >
          {/* Expanding Radar Wave 1 */}
          <span
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              inset: 6,
              borderRadius: '50%',
              border: `2px solid ${brand.primary}`,
              animation: 'radarPing 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) infinite',
              pointerEvents: 'none',
            }}
          />

          {/* Expanding Radar Wave 2 (Staggered) */}
          <span
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              inset: 6,
              borderRadius: '50%',
              border: `2px solid ${brand.secondary}`,
              animation: 'radarPing 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 1.2s infinite',
              pointerEvents: 'none',
            }}
          />

          {/* Rotating Radar Conic Sweep Ring */}
          <span
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              inset: 2,
              borderRadius: '50%',
              background: `conic-gradient(from 0deg, ${brand.primary}55 0deg, transparent 110deg, transparent 360deg)`,
              animation: 'radarSweep 2.2s linear infinite',
              pointerEvents: 'none',
            }}
          />

          {/* Solid Circular Logo Badge */}
          <AttendSureBrandBadge
            size={92}
            shape="circle"
            mode={mode}
            style={{
              position: 'relative',
              zIndex: 2,
              borderWidth: 2,
              borderColor: brand.primary,
              boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
            }}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Direct, Simple English Title */}
        <h1
          style={{
            margin: 0,
            fontSize: '2rem',

              >

                    height: 8,
                    margin: '0 auto',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: tokens.textPrimary,
                    animation: `spiralDotPulse 1.1s ease-in-out ${delaySec}s infinite`,
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <span
          style={{
            fontSize: '0.78rem',
            fontWeight: 600,
            color: tokens.textMuted,
            marginTop: 10,
          }}
        >
          Please wait...

      </div>

      {/* Bottom Footer */}
      <div
        style={{

const FAILED_ACTIONS = new Set(['LOCKOUT', 'LOCKED', 'LOGIN_FAIL', 'BIO_REJECT', 'DEV_REJECT']);
const ACCOUNT_ACTIONS = new Set(['LOGIN', 'LOGOUT', 'LOGIN_FAIL', 'LOCKOUT', 'LOCKED', 'PASSWORD', 'PROFILE', 'UNLOCK_ALL']);

export function formatAuditTimestamp(log: ActivityRecord): {
  dateText: string;
  timeText: string;
  fullText: string;
} {
  const rawIso = String(log.created_at || '').trim();
  if (rawIso) {
    const parsed = new Date(rawIso);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
      const dateText = parsed.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
        timeZone: 'Asia/Manila',
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        year: 'numeric',
      });
      const timeText = parsed.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
        timeZone: 'Asia/Manila',
        hour: 'numeric',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: true,
      });
      return { dateText, timeText, fullText: `${dateText} • ${timeText}` };
    }
  }

  const fallbackDate = String(log.date_only || '').trim();
  const fallbackTime = String(log.time_only || '').trim();
  if (fallbackDate || fallbackTime) {
    const fullText = [fallbackDate, fallbackTime].filter(Boolean).join(' • ');
    return { dateText: fallbackDate, timeText: fallbackTime, fullText };
  }

  const fallbackTs = String(log.timestamp || '').trim();
  return {
    dateText: fallbackTs || '—',
    timeText: '',
    fullText: fallbackTs || '—',
  };
}

export function getAuditActorName(log: ActivityRecord): string {
  const name = String(
    log.actor_name || log.user || log.performed_by || log.actor_username || ''
  ).trim();
  return name || 'System';
}

export function getAuditActionLabel(log: ActivityRecord): string {
  if (log.action_label && String(log.action_label).trim()) {
    return String(log.action_label).trim();
  }
  const code = String(log.action || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  return ACTION_LABEL_MAP[code] || (code ? code.replace(/_/g, ' ') : 'Activity');
}

export function getAuditModuleLabel(log: ActivityRecord): string {
  if (log.module && String(log.module).trim()) {
    return String(log.module).trim();
  }
  const rawModel = String(log.target_model || log.table_name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (rawModel && MODULE_LABEL_MAP[rawModel]) {
    return MODULE_LABEL_MAP[rawModel];
  }
  if (rawModel) {
    return rawModel
      .replace(/_/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\b\w/g, (ch) => ch.toUpperCase());
  }
  const code = String(log.action || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  return ACCOUNT_ACTIONS.has(code) ? 'Account' : 'System';
}

export function getAuditDetailsText(log: ActivityRecord): string {
  const direct = String(log.details || '').trim();
  if (direct && direct !== '{}' && direct !== '[]') {
    return direct;
  }
  const actionLabel = getAuditActionLabel(log);
  const moduleLabel = getAuditModuleLabel(log);
  const targetId = log.target_id ?? log.record_id;
  const suffix = targetId ? ` (#${targetId})` : '';
  return `${actionLabel} in ${moduleLabel}${suffix}.`;
}

export function getAuditIpAddress(log: ActivityRecord): string {
  const ip = String(log.ip_address || log.client_ip || '').trim();
  return ip || '—';
}

export function getAuditStatusDisplay(log: ActivityRecord): {
  label: string;
  isFailure: boolean;
} {
  const code = String(log.action || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const rawStatus = String(log.status || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (code === 'LOCKOUT' || code === 'LOCKED') {
    return { label: 'Locked', isFailure: true };
  }
  if (rawStatus === 'FAILED' || FAILED_ACTIONS.has(code)) {
    return { label: 'Failed', isFailure: true };
  }
  return { label: 'Success', isFailure: false };
}

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                <div
                  style={{
                    width: 38,
                    height: 38,
                    borderRadius: 10,
                    backgroundColor: item.iconBg,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                  }}
                >
                  <HeaderIcon size={18} color={item.iconColor} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.88rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                    {item.title}
                  </h3>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>{item.subtitle}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p style={{ margin: '8px 0 14px 0', fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, lineHeight: 1.4 }}>
                {item.description}
              </p>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={actionLoading !== null}
                onClick={() => onRunAction(item.key, item.title, item.confirmDesc, item.call)}
                style={actionBtnStyle(item.btnColor)}
              >
                {isBusy ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : <ActionIcon size={14} />}
                <span>{isBusy ? item.busyLabel : item.btnLabel}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

const prepareLogoDataUrl = (file: File, maxDim = 640): Promise<string> => {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
        resolve('');
        return;
      }
      const rawDataUrl = typeof e.target?.result === 'string' ? e.target.result : '';
      if (!isSafeImageUrl(rawDataUrl)) {
        resolve('');
        return;
      }
      const img = new window.Image();
      img.src = rawDataUrl;
      img.onload = () => {
        const srcW = img.naturalWidth || img.width;
        const srcH = img.naturalHeight || img.height;
        if (!srcW || !srcH) {
          resolve(rawDataUrl);
          return;
        }

        const workScale = Math.min(1, maxDim / Math.max(srcW, srcH));
        const workW = Math.max(1, Math.round(srcW * workScale));
        const workH = Math.max(1, Math.round(srcH * workScale));

        const workCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        workCanvas.width = workW;
        workCanvas.height = workH;
        const workCtx = workCanvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
        if (!workCtx) {
          resolve(rawDataUrl);
          return;
        }
        workCtx.clearRect(0, 0, workW, workH);
        workCtx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
        workCtx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
        workCtx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, workW, workH);

        let hasTransparency = file.type === 'image/png' || file.type === 'image/webp';
        let cropX = 0;
        let cropY = 0;
        let cropW = workW;
        let cropH = workH;

        try {
          const pixels = workCtx.getImageData(0, 0, workW, workH).data;
          let minX = workW;
          let minY = workH;
          let maxX = -1;
          let maxY = -1;
          let foundTransparent = false;

          for (let y = 0; y < workH; y += 1) {
            for (let x = 0; x < workW; x += 1) {
              const alpha = pixels[(y * workW + x) * 4 + 3];
              if (alpha < 250) foundTransparent = true;
              if (alpha > 8) {
                if (x < minX) minX = x;
                if (y < minY) minY = y;
                if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
                if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
              }
            }
          }

          if (foundTransparent) hasTransparency = true;
          if (foundTransparent && maxX >= minX && maxY >= minY) {
            cropX = minX;
            cropY = minY;
            cropW = maxX - minX + 1;
            cropH = maxY - minY + 1;
          }
        } catch {
          // Proceed without pixel trimming if canvas readback is restricted
        }

        const pad = hasTransparency ? Math.max(2, Math.round(Math.max(cropW, cropH) * 0.03)) : 0;
        const outW = cropW + pad * 2;
        const outH = cropH + pad * 2;

        const outCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        outCanvas.width = outW;
        outCanvas.height = outH;
        const outCtx = outCanvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!outCtx) {
          resolve(rawDataUrl);
          return;
        }
        outCtx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
        outCtx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';

        if (hasTransparency) {
          outCtx.clearRect(0, 0, outW, outH);
          outCtx.drawImage(workCanvas, cropX, cropY, cropW, cropH, pad, pad, cropW, cropH);
          const pngUrl = outCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
          resolve(isSafeImageUrl(pngUrl) ? pngUrl : rawDataUrl);
        } else {
          outCtx.fillStyle = SEAL_COLORS.white;
          outCtx.fillRect(0, 0, outW, outH);
          outCtx.drawImage(workCanvas, 0, 0, workW, workH, 0, 0, outW, outH);
          const jpgUrl = outCanvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.9);
          resolve(isSafeImageUrl(jpgUrl) ? jpgUrl : rawDataUrl);
        }
      };
      img.onerror = () => resolve('');
    };
    reader.onerror = () => resolve('');
  });
};

  onSubmit: (e: React.FormEvent) => void;
}

        ...prev,

      return;

    const tid = Number(teacherIdStr);
    const chosen = teacherList.find((t) => t.id === tid);
    if (chosen) {
      onChangeFormData((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        principal_teacher: tid,
        principal_name: chosen.full_name || `${chosen.first_name} ${chosen.last_name}`.trim(),
        principal_title: chosen.position || 'School Principal',
        principal_photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(chosen.photo_url) ? chosen.photo_url ?? null : null,
        principal_employee_id: chosen.employee_id || '',

    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>

    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (!['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Invalid Image Format',
        message: 'Only PNG, JPG, and WebP images are allowed.',

      });
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_BYTES) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Image File Too Large',
        message: 'Please choose an image under 2 MB.',

      return;
    }

    const prepared = await prepareLogoDataUrl(file, 640);
    e.target.value = '';
    if (prepared && isSafeImageUrl(prepared)) {

  const cardTitleStyle: React.CSSProperties = {

  const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {

  const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {

  return (

      >

        <div style={cardStyle}>
          <div style={cardHeaderStyle}>

              style={{
                fontSize: '0.66rem',

                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 5,
                          }}
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={12} /> Remove
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </fieldset>

      {canEditSettings && (
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'flex-end',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 12,
            marginTop: 6,
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
          }}
        >
          {saveSuccess && (
            <span
              style={{
                color: brand.success,
                fontSize: '0.80rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 4,
              }}
            >
              <CheckCircle2 size={15} /> Configuration saved successfully.
            </span>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            size="md"
            type="submit"
            disabled={saving}
            icon={saving ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={15} /> : <Save size={15} />}
          >
            Save School Configuration
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  );
};

export const sanitizeSettingsInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 200): string =>
  Array.from(String(raw || ''))
    .filter((ch) => {
      const code = ch.charCodeAt(0);
      return code >= 32 && code !== 127 && ch !== '<' && ch !== '>';
    })
    .join('')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);
