export const DTRTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { mode, tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { school } = useSchool();
  const successBtnBg = mode === 'dark' ? '#059669' : brand.success;

  const currentUser = useMemo(() => getCurrentUserFromStorage(), []);
  const isTeacher = !canViewTeacherDirectory(currentUser);

  const nowDate = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);
  const yearOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const cur = nowDate.getFullYear();
    return [cur - 1, cur, cur + 1];
  }, [nowDate]);

  const [teacherList, setTeacherList] = useState<TeacherDropdownItem[]>(() => {
    if (isTeacher) return [];
    const cached = peekApiCache<TeacherDropdownItem[]>(API_ROUTES.accounts.teachersDropdown);
    return Array.isArray(cached) ? cached : [];
  });
  const [selectedTeacherId, setSelectedTeacherId] = useState<string>(() => {
    if (isTeacher) return '';
    const cached = peekApiCache<TeacherDropdownItem[]>(API_ROUTES.accounts.teachersDropdown);
    return Array.isArray(cached) && cached.length > 0 ? String(cached[0].id) : '';
  });
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<number>(nowDate.getMonth() + 1);
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<number>(nowDate.getFullYear());

  const [regularHours, setRegularHours] = useState<string>('');
  const [saturdayHours, setSaturdayHours] = useState<string>('');
  const [hoursDirty, setHoursDirty] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [viewSide, setViewSide] = useState<FormSide>('BOTH');

  const [dtrData, setDtrData] = useState<DTRReportData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [actionProcessing, setActionProcessing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [exportingPdf, setExportingPdf] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [pageConfig, setPageConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(DEFAULT_DTR_PAGE_SETUP);
  const [isPageSetupOpen, setIsPageSetupOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const dtrPaperDims = useMemo(() => {
    const p = PAPER_SIZES[pageConfig.paperSize] || PAPER_SIZES.folio;
    return pageConfig.orientation === 'landscape'
      ? { widthIn: p.height, heightIn: p.width }
      : { widthIn: p.width, heightIn: p.height };
  }, [pageConfig.paperSize, pageConfig.orientation]);

  const [selectedAlertRow, setSelectedAlertRow] = useState<DailyDTRRow | null>(null);
  const [excuseRemarks, setExcuseRemarks] = useState<string>('');

  const printAreaRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const isInteracting = useRef<boolean>(false);
  isInteracting.current = Boolean(selectedAlertRow) || actionProcessing || hoursDirty;

  const activeTeacher = useMemo(
    () => teacherList.find((t) => String(t.id) === selectedTeacherId),
    [teacherList, selectedTeacherId]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isTeacher) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();

    apiClient
      .get<TeacherDropdownItem[]>(API_ROUTES.accounts.teachersDropdown, {
        signal: controller.signal,
      })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const list = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : [];
        setTeacherList(list);
        if (list.length > 0) {
          setSelectedTeacherId((prev) => prev || String(list[0].id));
        }
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load teacher list.'));
      });

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [isTeacher]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setHoursDirty(false);
  }, [selectedTeacherId, selectedMonth, selectedYear]);

  const normalizeDtrPayload = useCallback(
    (raw: any): DTRReportData => {
      const rawRows: any[] = Array.isArray(raw.rows)
        ? raw.rows
        : Array.isArray(raw.daily_logs)
          ? raw.daily_logs
          : [];

      const rowsByDay = new Map<number, any>();
      rawRows.forEach((r) => {
        if (r && typeof r.day === 'number') rowsByDay.set(r.day, r);
      });

      const rows31: DailyDTRRow[] = [];
      for (let dayNum = 1; dayNum <= 31; dayNum++) {
        const found = rowsByDay.get(dayNum);
        if (found) {
          rows31.push({
            day: dayNum,
            date_str: String(found.date_str || found.date || ''),
            day_of_week: String(found.day_of_week || found.weekday || ''),
            is_weekend: Boolean(found.is_weekend || found.status === 'WEEKEND'),
            am_arrival: String(found.am_arrival || ''),
            am_departure: String(found.am_departure || ''),
            pm_arrival: String(found.pm_arrival || ''),
            pm_departure: String(found.pm_departure || ''),
            undertime_hours: found.undertime_hours ?? '',
            undertime_minutes: found.undertime_minutes ?? '',
            is_loafing: Boolean(found.is_loafing),
            loafing_excused: Boolean(found.loafing_excused),
            loafing_remarks: String(found.loafing_remarks || ''),
          });
        } else {
          rows31.push({
            day: dayNum,
            date_str: '',
            day_of_week: '',
            is_weekend: false,
            am_arrival: '',
            am_departure: '',
            pm_arrival: '',
            pm_departure: '',
            undertime_hours: '',
            undertime_minutes: '',
            is_loafing: false,
            loafing_excused: false,
            loafing_remarks: '',
          });
        }
      }

      const resolvedMonthNum = Number(raw.month_number || selectedMonth);
      const resolvedMonthName =
        typeof raw.month === 'string' && isNaN(Number(raw.month))
          ? raw.month
          : MONTH_NAMES[resolvedMonthNum - 1] || 'Month';

      const regHrs = String(raw.regular_days_hours ?? raw.regular_hours ?? '');
      const satHrs = String(raw.saturdays_hours ?? raw.saturday_hours ?? '');

      if (!isInteracting.current) {
        setRegularHours(regHrs);
        setSaturdayHours(satHrs);
      }

      if (!isTeacher && raw.teacher_id && !selectedTeacherId) {
        setSelectedTeacherId(String(raw.teacher_id));
      }

      return {
        teacher_id: Number(raw.teacher_id || 0),
        teacher_name: String(raw.teacher_name || ''),
        employee_id: String(raw.employee_id || ''),
        department: String(raw.department || ''),
        month: resolvedMonthName,
        month_number: resolvedMonthNum,
        year: Number(raw.year || selectedYear),
        regular_days_hours: regHrs,
        saturdays_hours: satHrs,
        school_head: String(raw.school_head || raw.school?.school_head || ''),
        school_head_title: String(raw.school_head_title || raw.school?.principal_title || ''),
        dtr_submitted: Boolean(raw.dtr_submitted ?? raw.is_submitted),
        dept_head_approved: Boolean(raw.dept_head_approved ?? raw.is_dept_head_approved),
        can_approve_dept: Boolean(
          raw.can_approve_dept ?? canResolveLoafing(currentUser)
        ),
        can_clear_loafing: Boolean(
          raw.can_clear_loafing ?? isAdminOrPrincipal(currentUser)
        ),
        rows: rows31,
        total_undertime_hours: Number(raw.total_undertime_hours || 0),
        total_undertime_minutes: Number(raw.total_undertime_minutes || 0),
        days_present: Number(raw.days_present || 0),
      };
    },
    [selectedTeacherId, selectedMonth, selectedYear, currentUser, isTeacher]
  );

  const fetchDTR = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      if (!isTeacher && !selectedTeacherId && teacherList.length > 0) return;

      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const endpoint =
        !isTeacher && selectedTeacherId
          ? `${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${selectedTeacherId}/`
          : API_ROUTES.reports.dtr;

      const baseParams = { month: selectedMonth, year: selectedYear };
      const cached = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<any>(endpoint, baseParams) : undefined;
      if (cached) {
        setDtrData(normalizeDtrPayload(cached));
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<any>(endpoint, {
          params: {
            ...baseParams,
            ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setDtrData(normalizeDtrPayload(res.data || {}));
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load Daily Time Record.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [isTeacher, selectedTeacherId, selectedMonth, selectedYear, teacherList.length, normalizeDtrPayload]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchDTR(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void fetchDTR(true, true);
      }
    }, 20000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  const handleSubmitDTR = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Certify & Submit DTR',
      message: `Certify and submit your Daily Time Record for ${dtrData.month} ${dtrData.year} to your Department Head for review?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Certify & Submit',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionProcessing(true);
        try {
          await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${dtrData.teacher_id}/`, {
            action: 'SUBMIT_DTR',
            teacher_id: dtrData.teacher_id,
            month: dtrData.month_number,
            year: dtrData.year,
            regular_days_hours: sanitizeInput(regularHours, 100),
            saturdays_hours: sanitizeInput(saturdayHours, 100),
          });
          setHoursDirty(false);
          showAlert({
            title: 'DTR Submitted',
            message: 'Your Daily Time Record was submitted for Department Head approval.',
            type: 'success',
          });
          void fetchDTR(true, true);
        } catch (err) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Submission Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not submit DTR.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionProcessing(false);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleApproveByDeptHead = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Approve Official DTR',
      message: `Approve the Daily Time Record for ${dtrData.teacher_name} (${dtrData.month} ${dtrData.year})? This removes the DRAFT watermark and unlocks printing.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Approve DTR',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionProcessing(true);
        try {
          await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${dtrData.teacher_id}/`, {
            action: 'APPROVE_DEPT_HEAD',
            teacher_id: dtrData.teacher_id,
            month: dtrData.month_number,
            year: dtrData.year,
            regular_days_hours: sanitizeInput(regularHours, 100),
            saturdays_hours: sanitizeInput(saturdayHours, 100),
          });
          setHoursDirty(false);
          showAlert({
            title: 'DTR Approved',
            message: `Official DTR for ${dtrData.teacher_name} is now unlocked for printing.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
          void fetchDTR(true, true);
        } catch (err) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Approval Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not approve DTR.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionProcessing(false);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleExcuseAlertByPrincipal = async () => {
    if (!dtrData || !selectedAlertRow) return;
    const cleanReason = sanitizeInput(excuseRemarks, 240);
    if (!cleanReason) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Reason Required',
        message: 'Please enter official remarks explaining why this teacher loafing alert is excused.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setActionProcessing(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${dtrData.teacher_id}/`, {
        action: 'EXCUSE_LOAFING',
        teacher_id: dtrData.teacher_id,
        date_str: selectedAlertRow.date_str,
        month: dtrData.month_number,
        year: dtrData.year,
        remarks: cleanReason,
      });
      showAlert({
        title: 'Alert Excused',
        message: `Teacher loafing alert on ${selectedAlertRow.date_str} has been marked as excused.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
      setSelectedAlertRow(null);
      setExcuseRemarks('');
      void fetchDTR(true, true);
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Action Denied',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Only authorized leadership can excuse campus alerts.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setActionProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadPdf = async () => {
    if (!printAreaRef.current || !dtrData) return;
    if (!dtrData.dept_head_approved) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Approval Required',
        message: 'Department Head approval is required before exporting official PDF copies.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setExportingPdf(true);
    try {
      const safeName = (dtrData.teacher_name || 'Teacher').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_');
      await exportElementToLocalPdf({
        element: printAreaRef.current,
        filename: `CSC_Form_48_${safeName}_${dtrData.month}_${dtrData.year}.pdf`,
        pageWidthInches: dtrPaperDims.widthIn,
        pageHeightInches: dtrPaperDims.heightIn,
        orientation: pageConfig.orientation,
        pageColor: pageConfig.pageColor,
        pageless: pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless',
        marginsInches: [0, 0, 0, 0],
      });
    } catch {
      window.print();
    } finally {
      setExportingPdf(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {

      showAlert({
        title: 'Printing Locked',
        message: 'Printing is locked until the Department Head approves this record.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }
    window.print();
  };

  const resolvedSchoolHead = (dtrData?.school_head || school.principal_name || '').trim();
  const resolvedSchoolHeadTitle = (dtrData?.school_head_title || school.principal_title || '').trim();

  const renderDTRCopy = () => {

        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 2 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '7.5pt', fontStyle: 'italic', fontFamily: "'Times New Roman', Times, serif" }}>
            Civil Service Form No. 48
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '11.5pt', fontWeight: 900, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.6px', marginTop: 1 }}>
            DAILY TIME RECORD
          </div>

          <div style={{ marginTop: 8, borderBottom: '1.2px solid #000', paddingBottom: 1, minHeight: 18 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '9.2pt', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
              {dtrData.teacher_name}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '6.5pt', fontStyle: 'italic', marginTop: 1 }}>(Name)</div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ fontSize: '6.8pt', marginBottom: 4, lineHeight: 1.25 }}>
          <div style={{ borderBottom: '0.8px solid #000', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
            <span>
              For the month of <u>&nbsp;<strong>{dtrData.month}</strong>&nbsp;</u>, {dtrData.year}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginTop: 3 }}>

            <div style={{ width: '54%', fontSize: '6.2pt', lineHeight: 1.15 }}>

              <div style={{ marginTop: 1 }}>Saturdays: <u>{saturdayHours || '\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0'}</u></div>

          <tbody>
            {dtrData.rows.map((row) => {

                      >

                      </span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.am_arrival}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.am_departure}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>

                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>

                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 800 : 400 }}>
                    {row.undertime_hours}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 800 : 400 }}>
                    {row.undertime_minutes}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}

            <tr style={{ height: 16, borderTop: '1.2px solid #000', fontWeight: 800 }}>
              <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, fontWeight: 900 }}>TOTAL</td>
              <td colSpan={4} style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, fontSize: '5.6pt' }}>

          <div style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #000', width: '82%', margin: '0 auto', minHeight: 14 }}>

  const renderInstructionsCopy = () => (
    <div style={formCardContainer}>
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 8, borderBottom: '1px solid #000', paddingBottom: 4 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: '11pt', fontWeight: 900, letterSpacing: '0.8px' }}>INSTRUCTIONS</div>

      <div style={{ fontSize: '6.0pt', textAlign: 'justify', lineHeight: 1.35, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
        <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>
          Civil Service Form No. 48, after completion, should be filed in the records of the Bureau or Office which submits the monthly report on Civil Service Form No. 3 to the Bureau of Civil Service.
        </p>
        <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>
          In the space provided for the purpose on the other side will be indicated the office hours the employee is required to observe, as for example, &ldquo;Regular days, 8:00 to 12:00 and 1:00 to 4:00; Saturdays, 8:00 to 1:00.&rdquo;
        </p>
        <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>
          Attention is invited to paragraph 3, Civil Service Rule XV, Executive Order No. 5, series of 1909, which reads as follows:
        </p>
        <blockquote style={{ margin: '0 0 0 8px', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #000', paddingLeft: 6, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
          &ldquo;Each chief of a Bureau or Office shall require a daily record of attendance of all the officers and employees under him entitled to leave of absence or vacation (including teachers) to be kept on the proper form and also a systematic office record showing for each day all absences from duty from any cause whatever. At the beginning of each month he shall report to the Commissioner on the proper form of all absences from any cause whatever, including the exact amount of undertime of each person for each day. Falsification of time records will render the offending officer or employee liable to summary removal from the service and criminal prosecution.&rdquo;
        </blockquote>
        <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '5.7pt' }}>
          <strong>(NOTE:</strong> A record made from memory at sometime subsequent to the occurrence of an event is not reliable. Non-observance of office hours deprives the employee of leave privileges although he may have rendered overtime service. Where service is rendered outside of the Office for the whole morning or afternoon, notation to that effect should be made clearly.)
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          ...ui.card,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '12px 16px',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <ProfileAvatar
              photoUrl={activeTeacher?.photo_url}
              name={activeTeacher?.full_name || dtrData?.teacher_name || 'Teacher'}
              size={36}
              iconSize={18}
            />

            {isTeacher ? (
              <div
                style={{
                  ...ui.subtleBox,

                </span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <select

              >
                {teacherList.map((t) => (
                  <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                    {t.full_name} ({t.employee_id})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
            <Calendar size={15} color={brand.primary} />
            <select

          >
            {!dtrData?.dept_head_approved ? <Lock size={14} /> : <Printer size={14} />}

              : dtrData.dtr_submitted
              ? brand.secondary
              : brand.warning,
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            {dtrData.dept_head_approved ? (

              <ShieldAlert size={20} color={dtrData.dtr_submitted ? brand.secondary : brand.warning} />

            <div>

      <div

            <span style={{ color: tokens.textSecondary, fontWeight: 600 }}>Regular Days:</span>
            <input
              type="text"
              maxLength={100}

                setHoursDirty(true);
                setRegularHours(e.target.value);
              }}
              style={{ ...ui.input, width: 250, padding: '5px 10px', fontSize: '0.76rem' }}
            />

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: '0.76rem' }}>
            <span style={{ color: tokens.textSecondary, fontWeight: 600 }}>Saturdays:</span>

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { SEAL_COLORS } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { ModuleTableLayout } from './ModuleTableLayout';
import { QrCodeSvg } from '../common/QrCodeSvg';
import { StatusBadge } from '../common/StatusBadge';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import {
  canApproveOrCancelLocatorSlip,
  canIssueStudentExitPass,
  getCurrentUserFromStorage,
} from '../../utils/permissions';
import { CheckCircle2, ShieldCheck, Printer, QrCode, FileText, Plus, ExternalLink, Edit2, Trash2, XCircle } from 'lucide-react';

interface ExitPassItem {
  id: number;
  pass_number: string;
  pass_scope: 'STUDENT' | 'TEACHER';
  enrollment?: number | null;
  student_id?: number | null;
  student_name?: string;
  student_lrn?: string;
  teacher?: number | null;
  teacher_name?: string;
  teacher_employee_id?: string;
  pass_type: string;
  reason: string;
  destination?: string;
  issued_at: string;
  valid_until: string;
  returned_at?: string | null;
  is_cancelled?: boolean;
  pass_status: 'ACTIVE' | 'RETURNED' | 'OVERDUE' | 'CANCELLED';
  status?: 'ACTIVE' | 'RETURNED' | 'OVERDUE' | 'CANCELLED';
  attachment_url?: string | null;
  issued_by_name?: string;
  guardian_notice?: string;
}

interface StudentOption {
  id: number;
  lrn: string;
  full_name: string;
}

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 250): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const isSafeProofUrl = (url?: string | null): boolean => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const trimmed = url.trim().toLowerCase();
  return trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://') || trimmed.startsWith('/media/');
};

export const GatePassesTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { school } = useSchool();
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();

  const currentUser = getCurrentUserFromStorage();
  const isLeader = canApproveOrCancelLocatorSlip(currentUser);
  const canIssueStudentPass = canIssueStudentExitPass(currentUser);

  const [passes, setPasses] = useState<ExitPassItem[]>(() => {
    const cached = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses);
    return cached?.results ?? (Array.isArray(cached) ? cached : []);
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses));
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [debouncedSearch, setDebouncedSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  const [selectedPass, setSelectedPass] = useState<ExitPassItem | null>(null);
  const [editingPass, setEditingPass] = useState<ExitPassItem | null>(null);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const [students, setStudents] = useState<StudentOption[]>([]);
  const [loadingStudents, setLoadingStudents] = useState(false);
  const [passScope, setPassScope] = useState<'STUDENT' | 'TEACHER'>('STUDENT');

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    student_id: '',
    pass_type: 'Clinic / Medical Clearance',
    destination: '',
    reason: '',
    valid_until: '',
  });
  const [attachedFile, setAttachedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);

  const passesAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const studentsAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedSearch(sanitizeInput(search, 80));
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [search]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      passesAbortRef.current?.abort();
      studentsAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const fetchPasses = useCallback(
    async (bypassCache = false) => {
      passesAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      passesAbortRef.current = controller;

      const baseParams = {
        search: debouncedSearch || undefined,
        status: statusFilter !== 'ALL' ? statusFilter : undefined,
      };
      const cached = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses, baseParams) : undefined;
      if (cached) {
        setPasses(cached?.results ?? (Array.isArray(cached) ? cached : []));
        setLoading(false);
      } else {
        setLoading(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<any>(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses, {
          params: {
            ...baseParams,
            ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const list = res.data?.results ?? (Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : []);
        setPasses(list);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Failed to fetch exit passes.'));
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [debouncedSearch, statusFilter]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchPasses(false);
  }, [fetchPasses]);

  const fetchStudents = async () => {
    studentsAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    studentsAbortRef.current = controller;

    const cached = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.students.dropdown);
    if (cached) {
      setStudents(cached?.results ?? (Array.isArray(cached) ? cached : []));
      setLoadingStudents(false);
    } else {
      setLoadingStudents(true);
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get<any>(API_ROUTES.students.dropdown, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      setStudents(res.data?.results ?? (Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : []));
    } catch {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) setStudents([]);
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoadingStudents(false);
    }
  };

  const toInputDate = (d: Date) => {
    const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
  };

  const handleOpenCreateModal = (scope: 'STUDENT' | 'TEACHER') => {
    setEditingPass(null);
    setPassScope(scope);
    const now = new Date();
    setFormData({
      student_id: '',
      pass_type: scope === 'STUDENT' ? 'Clinic / Medical Clearance' : 'Official Travel Order',
      destination: '',
      reason: '',
      valid_until: toInputDate(new Date(now.getTime() + 4 * 3600000)),
    });
    setAttachedFile(null);
    if (scope === 'STUDENT') void fetchStudents();
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEditModal = (pass: ExitPassItem) => {
    setEditingPass(pass);
    setPassScope(pass.pass_scope || (pass.student_id ? 'STUDENT' : 'TEACHER'));
    const toDt = pass.valid_until ? new Date(pass.valid_until) : new Date(Date.now() + 4 * 3600000);
    setFormData({
      student_id: pass.student_id ? String(pass.student_id) : '',
      pass_type: pass.pass_type || '',
      destination: pass.destination || '',
      reason: pass.reason || '',
      valid_until: isNaN(toDt.getTime()) ? toInputDate(new Date(Date.now() + 4 * 3600000)) : toInputDate(toDt),
    });
    setAttachedFile(null);
    if (pass.pass_scope === 'STUDENT') void fetchStudents();
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmitPass = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (attachedFile && attachedFile.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({ title: 'File Too Large', message: 'Attachment must be 5 MB or smaller.', type: 'warning' });
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const cleanPassType = sanitizeInput(formData.pass_type, 60);
      const cleanReason = sanitizeInput(formData.reason, 500);
      const cleanDest = sanitizeInput(formData.destination, 200);
      if (!cleanPassType || !cleanReason) {
        showAlert({ title: 'Details Required', message: 'Please enter a valid pass type and reason.', type: 'warning' });
        setSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      const payload = new FormData();
      payload.append('pass_scope', passScope);
      payload.append('pass_type', cleanPassType);
      payload.append('destination', cleanDest);
      payload.append('reason', cleanReason);
      payload.append('valid_until', new Date(formData.valid_until).toISOString());
      if (attachedFile) payload.append('attachment', attachedFile);

      if (passScope === 'STUDENT') {
        if (!formData.student_id) {
          showAlert({ title: 'Student Required', message: 'Please select a student.', type: 'warning' });
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        payload.append('student_id', formData.student_id);
      }

      if (editingPass) {
        await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${editingPass.id}/`, payload, {
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
        });
        showAlert({ title: 'Pass Updated', message: `Exit pass #${editingPass.pass_number} updated.`, type: 'success' });
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses, payload, {
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
        });
        showAlert({
          title: passScope === 'TEACHER' ? 'Teacher Travel Pass Issued' : 'Student Exit Pass Issued',
          message: 'Pass saved and active. Campus boundary checks will automatically recognize this approved departure until the scheduled return time.',
          type: 'success',
        });
      }

      setIsModalOpen(false);
      setEditingPass(null);
      await fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Submission Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Unable to save exit pass.'), type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkReturned = async (passId: number) => {
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${passId}/mark-returned/`);
      showAlert({ title: 'Return Recorded', message: 'Welcome back — return to campus has been recorded.', type: 'success' });
      await fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Notice', message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to mark pass as returned.'), type: 'warning' });
    }
  };

  const handleApprovePass = async (pass: ExitPassItem) => {
    if (!isLeader) return;
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${pass.id}/approve/`);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Locator Slip Approved',
        message: `Official Locator Slip #${pass.pass_number} approved.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
      await fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Approval Failed', message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to approve locator slip.'), type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleCancelPass = (pass: ExitPassItem) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Cancel Exit Pass',
      message: `Cancel pass #${pass.pass_number}?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Cancel Pass',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${pass.id}/cancel/`);
          showAlert({ title: 'Pass Cancelled', message: `Pass #${pass.pass_number} cancelled.`, type: 'info' });
          await fetchPasses(true);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to cancel pass.'), type: 'error' });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleDeletePass = (pass: ExitPassItem) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Exit Pass',
      message: `Permanently delete pass #${pass.pass_number}?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${pass.id}/`);
          setPasses((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== pass.id));
          showAlert({ title: 'Pass Deleted', message: `Pass #${pass.pass_number} removed.`, type: 'success' });
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({ title: 'Delete Failed', message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not delete pass.'), type: 'error' });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const resolveStatus = (p: ExitPassItem) => p.pass_status || p.status || 'ACTIVE';

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16, padding: 'clamp(14px, 2.5vw, 24px)', boxSizing: 'border-box', width: '100%' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, padding: 14, borderRadius: 12, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {['ALL', 'ACTIVE', 'RETURNED', 'OVERDUE', 'CANCELLED'].map((st) => (
            <button
              key={st}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter(st)}
              style={{
                padding: '6px 14px',
                borderRadius: 20,
                fontSize: '0.74rem',
                fontWeight: 700,

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 80): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const formatMeters = (val: unknown): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined || val === '') return '—';
  const rawStr = typeof val === 'string' ? val.trim() : '';
  if (typeof val === 'string' && (!rawStr || rawStr === 'null' || rawStr === 'undefined')) {
    return '—';
  }
  const numeric =
    typeof val === 'number'
      ? val
      : Number(rawStr.replace(/\s*m$/i, ''));
  if (Number.isFinite(numeric)) {
    if (numeric >= 1000) {
      return `${(numeric / 1000).toFixed(2)} km`;
    }
    return `${Math.round(numeric)}m`;
  }
  return rawStr || '—';
};

          setLoading(false);
        }

        }
        if (auditVerdictFilter !== 'ALL') {
          params.status = auditVerdictFilter;
        }

        const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.campus.audit, {
          params,
          timeout: 8000,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const rawRecords: AuditRecord[] = Array.isArray(res.data?.records) ? res.data.records : [];
        const cleanQuery = sanitizeInput(auditSearchQuery, 80).toLowerCase();
        const filtered = cleanQuery
          ? rawRecords.filter(
              (r) =>
                (r.teacher_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanQuery) ||
                (r.employee_id || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanQuery) ||
                (r.device_id || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanQuery)
            )
          : rawRecords;
        setAuditRecords(filtered);
        setTotalDatabaseRecords(res.data?.count ?? filtered.length);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Audit Log Error',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not load campus location logs from the server.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted && !silent) {
          setAuditLoading(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [dateFilterMode, auditDate, auditTeacherFilter, auditVerdictFilter, auditSearchQuery, showAlert]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchGeofenceData(false, false);
  }, [fetchGeofenceData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const liveInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current && !isDirtyRef.current && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        if (activeScreen === 'LIVE_MAP') {
          void fetchGeofenceData(true, true);
        } else if (activeScreen === 'AUDIT_SCREEN') {
          void fetchAuditHistory(true);
        }
      }
    }, 10000);
    return () => clearInterval(liveInterval);
  }, [fetchGeofenceData, fetchAuditHistory, activeScreen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeScreen === 'AUDIT_SCREEN') {
      void fetchAuditHistory(false);
    }
  }, [activeScreen, fetchAuditHistory]);

  // Local Bundled Leaflet Initialization
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeScreen !== 'LIVE_MAP' || !mapContainerRef.current) return;
    if (lat === null || lng === null) return;

    const getTileUrl = (layer: 'streets' | 'satellite') => {
      if (layer === 'satellite') {
        return 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}';
      }
      return 'https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png';
    };

    if (mapInstanceRef.current && mapInstanceRef.current.getContainer() !== mapContainerRef.current) {
      try {
        mapInstanceRef.current.remove();
      } catch {
        // Ignore stale container cleanup
      }
      mapInstanceRef.current = null;
      markerInstanceRef.current = null;
      circleInstanceRef.current = null;
      innerCircleInstanceRef.current = null;
      hasFittedCircleRef.current = false;
      userMarkersLayerRef.current = null;
      tileLayerRef.current = null;
    }

    if (resizeTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimerRef.current);
      resizeTimerRef.current = null;
    }

    if (!mapInstanceRef.current) {
      const map = L.map(mapContainerRef.current, {
        center: [lat, lng],
        zoom: 17,
        zoomControl: true,
      });

      const tileLayer = L.tileLayer(getTileUrl(mapLayer), {
        maxZoom: 19,
        attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors',
      }).addTo(map) as L.TileLayer & { _layerType?: string };
      tileLayer._layerType = mapLayer;
      tileLayerRef.current = tileLayer;

      userMarkersLayerRef.current = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
      mapInstanceRef.current = map;

      resizeTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        map.invalidateSize();
      }, 250);

      map.on('click', (e: L.LeafletMouseEvent) => {
        if (!isAdmin) return;
        isDirtyRef.current = true;
        setLat(parseFloat(e.latlng.lat.toFixed(6)));
        setLng(parseFloat(e.latlng.lng.toFixed(6)));
      });
    } else {
      resizeTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        mapInstanceRef.current?.invalidateSize();
      }, 150);
    }

    const currentMap = mapInstanceRef.current;

    if (tileLayerRef.current && tileLayerRef.current._layerType !== mapLayer) {
      currentMap.removeLayer(tileLayerRef.current);
      const nextTile = L.tileLayer(getTileUrl(mapLayer), { maxZoom: 19 }).addTo(currentMap) as L.TileLayer & {
        _layerType?: string;
      };
      nextTile._layerType = mapLayer;
      tileLayerRef.current = nextTile;
    }

    const safeCampusTitle = escapeHtml(
      geoData?.campus_name || geoData?.name || school?.school_name || 'School Campus'
    );
    const radiusDisplay = radius !== null ? formatMeters(radius) : '—';

    const campusCenterIcon = L.divIcon({
      className: 'campus-center-beacon',
      html: `
        <div style="position: relative; width: 48px; height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;">
          <div style="position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; background-color: ${MAP_STATUS_COLORS.authorizedOutside}; opacity: 0.25;"></div>
          <div style="width: 34px; height: 34px; background-color: ${MAP_STATUS_COLORS.perimeterStroke}; border: 3px solid ${MAP_STATUS_COLORS.pinRing}; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,75,135,0.55); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: ${MAP_STATUS_COLORS.pinRing}; position: relative; z-index: 2;">
            <svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/>
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" fill="currentColor"/>
              <line x1="12" y1="2" x2="12" y2="5"/>
              <line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="22"/>
              <line x1="2" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12"/>
              <line x1="19" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div style="position: absolute; top: 50px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.94); color: ${MAP_STATUS_COLORS.pinRing}; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.32); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); pointer-events: none; z-index: 4;">
            SCHOOL CENTER &bull; ${safeCampusTitle} (${escapeHtml(radiusDisplay)})
          </div>
        </div>
      `,
      iconSize: [48, 48],
      iconAnchor: [24, 24],
    });

    if (markerInstanceRef.current) {
      markerInstanceRef.current.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
      markerInstanceRef.current.setIcon(campusCenterIcon);
    } else {
      markerInstanceRef.current = L.marker([lat, lng], {
        icon: campusCenterIcon,
        draggable: isAdmin,
        zIndexOffset: 500,
      }).addTo(currentMap);

      markerInstanceRef.current.on('dragend', (e: L.DragEndEvent) => {
        isDirtyRef.current = true;
        const pos = (e.target as L.Marker).getLatLng();
        setLat(parseFloat(pos.lat.toFixed(6)));
        setLng(parseFloat(pos.lng.toFixed(6)));
      });
    }

    if (radius !== null) {
      if (circleInstanceRef.current) {
        circleInstanceRef.current.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
        circleInstanceRef.current.setRadius(radius);
      } else {
        circleInstanceRef.current = L.circle([lat, lng], {
          radius,
          color: MAP_STATUS_COLORS.perimeterStroke,
          weight: 4,
          fillColor: MAP_STATUS_COLORS.authorizedOutside,
          fillOpacity: 0.22,
        }).addTo(currentMap);
      }

      const halfRadius = Math.max(10, Math.round(radius * 0.5));
      if (innerCircleInstanceRef.current) {
        innerCircleInstanceRef.current.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
        innerCircleInstanceRef.current.setRadius(halfRadius);
      } else {
        innerCircleInstanceRef.current = L.circle([lat, lng], {
          radius: halfRadius,
          color: MAP_STATUS_COLORS.perimeterStroke,
          weight: 1.5,
          opacity: 0.45,
          fillOpacity: 0,
          dashArray: '6, 8',
          interactive: false,
        }).addTo(currentMap);
      }

      if (!hasFittedCircleRef.current && circleInstanceRef.current) {
        hasFittedCircleRef.current = true;
        try {
          currentMap.fitBounds(circleInstanceRef.current.getBounds(), {
            padding: [48, 48],
            maxZoom: 18,
          });
        } catch {
          currentMap.setView([lat, lng], 17);
        }
      }
    }
  }, [activeScreen, lat, lng, radius, mapLayer, isAdmin, geoData?.campus_name, geoData?.name, school?.school_name]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeScreen !== 'LIVE_MAP' || !mapInstanceRef.current || !userMarkersLayerRef.current) return;
    const layer = userMarkersLayerRef.current;
    layer.clearLayers();

    const teachers = geoData?.teacher_list || [];

    teachers.forEach((teacher: TeacherBoundaryStatus) => {
      const userLat = parseFloat(String(teacher.latitude));
      const userLng = parseFloat(String(teacher.longitude));

      if (isNaN(userLat) || isNaN(userLng) || userLat === 0 || userLng === 0) return;

      const isOnline = Boolean(teacher.is_online);
      const insideFlag = teacher.is_inside ?? teacher.is_inside_geofence ?? teacher.zone_status === 'INSIDE';
      const isLoafing = teacher.zone_status === 'LOAFING_ALERT' || teacher.status === 'PERIMETER_BREACH';
      const isAuthorizedPass =
        teacher.zone_status === 'AUTHORIZED_OUTSIDE' || teacher.status === 'AUTHORIZED_LEAVE';
      const isOutsideOffDuty = !isLoafing && !isAuthorizedPass && insideFlag === false;
      const isOutside = isLoafing || isOutsideOffDuty;

      const safeName = escapeHtml(teacher.teacher_name || teacher.full_name || 'Teacher');
      const safeEmpId = escapeHtml(teacher.employee_id);
      const safePos = escapeHtml(teacher.position || '—');
      const safeDist = escapeHtml(formatMeters(teacher.distance ?? teacher.distance_meters));
      const safeDev = escapeHtml(teacher.device_model || teacher.bound_device_id || 'Unbound');

      const rawAvatar = teacher.photo_url || teacher.photo;
      const safeAvatar = isSafeImageUrl(rawAvatar) ? escapeHtml(rawAvatar!.trim()) : '';
      const safeInitials = escapeHtml(
        (teacher.teacher_name || 'T')
          .split(' ')
          .map((n) => n[0] || '')
          .slice(0, 2)
          .join('')
          .toUpperCase()
      );

      if (isOutside && lat !== null && lng !== null) {
        const lineColor = isLoafing
          ? MAP_STATUS_COLORS.loafingAlert
          : isOnline
            ? brand.warning
            : SEAL_COLORS.mutedBorder;
        const connectingLine = L.polyline(
          [
            [lat, lng],
            [userLat, userLng],
          ],
          {
            color: lineColor,
            weight: 2.5,
            opacity: isOnline ? 0.85 : 0.45,
            dashArray: '6, 8',
            lineCap: 'round',
          }
        ).addTo(layer);

        connectingLine.bindTooltip(
          `
            <div style="font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; padding: 2px;">
              <strong style="color: ${lineColor};">${safeName}</strong><br/>
              <span>Distance to Campus: <strong>${safeDist}</strong></span>
            </div>
          `,
          { sticky: true, opacity: 0.95 }
        );
      }

      const pinColor = isAuthorizedPass
        ? MAP_STATUS_COLORS.authorizedOutside
        : isOnline
          ? isLoafing
            ? MAP_STATUS_COLORS.loafingAlert
            : isOutsideOffDuty
              ? brand.warning
              : MAP_STATUS_COLORS.inside
          : MAP_STATUS_COLORS.offDuty;
      const ringBg = isOnline ? 'rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.35)' : 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.15)';
      const statusLabel = isAuthorizedPass
        ? 'Official Exit Pass'
        : isLoafing
          ? 'Teacher Loafing Alert'
          : isOutsideOffDuty
            ? 'Outside Campus (Off Duty)'
            : 'On Campus';
      const statusColor = isAuthorizedPass
        ? MAP_STATUS_COLORS.authorizedOutside
        : isLoafing
          ? MAP_STATUS_COLORS.loafingAlert
          : isOutsideOffDuty
            ? brand.warning
            : MAP_STATUS_COLORS.inside;
      const onlineTag = isOnline ? '● Online' : '○ Offline';

      const avatarInnerHtml = safeAvatar
        ? `<img src="${safeAvatar}" alt="${safeName}" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';" /><div style="display: none; width: 100%; height: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: ${SEAL_COLORS.surface}; color: ${pinColor}; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px;">${safeInitials}</div>`
        : `<div style="display: flex; width: 100%; height: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: ${SEAL_COLORS.surface}; color: ${pinColor}; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px;">${safeInitials}</div>`;

      const userLocationPinIcon = L.divIcon({
        className: 'user-location-pin-marker',
        html: `
          <div style="position: relative; width: 50px; height: 60px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.30));">
            ${
              isOnline
                ? `<div style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 1px; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: ${ringBg}; z-index: 0;"></div>`
                : ''
            }
            <svg width="50" height="60" viewBox="0 0 50 60" fill="none" style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; z-index: 1;">
              <path d="M25 0C11.193 0 0 11.193 0 25C0 41.5 25 60 25 60C25 60 50 41.5 50 25C50 11.193 38.807 0 25 0Z" fill="${pinColor}"/>
              <circle cx="25" cy="25" r="21" fill="${MAP_STATUS_COLORS.pinRing}"/>
            </svg>
            <div style="position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; background-color: ${MAP_STATUS_COLORS.pinRing}; z-index: 2;">
              ${avatarInnerHtml}
            </div>
            <div style="position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 4px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: ${pinColor}; border: 2px solid ${MAP_STATUS_COLORS.pinRing}; z-index: 4;"></div>
            <div style="position: absolute; top: 64px; z-index: 3; background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.94); color: ${MAP_STATUS_COLORS.pinRing}; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.30); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); pointer-events: none;">
              ${safeName} &bull; <span style="color: ${isOnline ? MAP_STATUS_COLORS.inside : SEAL_COLORS.border}; font-weight: 800;">${onlineTag}</span> (${safeDist})
            </div>
          </div>
        `,
        iconSize: [50, 60],
        iconAnchor: [25, 60],
      });

      const marker = L.marker([userLat, userLng], { icon: userLocationPinIcon }).addTo(layer);

      const tooltipContent = `
        <div style="font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; min-width: 210px; padding: 4px;">
          <div style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; color: ${SEAL_COLORS.ink}; margin-bottom: 2px;">${safeName}</div>
          <div style="color: ${MAP_STATUS_COLORS.offDuty}; font-size: 10px; margin-bottom: 6px;">ID: ${safeEmpId} &bull; ${safePos}</div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 3px;">
            <span>Campus Boundary:</span>
            <strong style="color: ${statusColor};">${escapeHtml(statusLabel)}</strong>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 3px;">
            <span>Distance from Campus:</span>
            <strong>${safeDist}</strong>
          </div>
          <div style="color: ${SEAL_COLORS.navy}; font-size: 9px; font-family: monospace; margin-top: 4px; border-top: 1px solid ${SEAL_COLORS.subtleBorder}; padding-top: 3px;">
            Device: ${safeDev}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      marker.bindTooltip(tooltipContent, {
        direction: 'top',
        offset: [0, -60],
        opacity: 0.98,
      });
    });
  }, [activeScreen, geoData, lat, lng, radius, brand.warning]);

  const handleFitAllOnMap = () => {
    if (!mapInstanceRef.current || lat === null || lng === null) return;
    const bounds = L.latLngBounds([[lat, lng]]);

    (geoData?.teacher_list || []).forEach((u) => {
      const uLat = parseFloat(String(u.latitude));
      const uLng = parseFloat(String(u.longitude));
      if (!isNaN(uLat) && !isNaN(uLng) && uLat !== 0) {
        bounds.extend([uLat, uLng]);
      }
    });

    mapInstanceRef.current.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [70, 70], maxZoom: 17 });
  };

  const handleDetectGPS = () => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Location Unavailable', message: 'GPS location is not supported by this browser.', type: 'error' });
      return;
    }

    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        isDirtyRef.current = true;
        const detectedLat = parseFloat(pos.coords.latitude.toFixed(6));
        const detectedLng = parseFloat(pos.coords.longitude.toFixed(6));
        setLat(detectedLat);
        setLng(detectedLng);
        if (mapInstanceRef.current) {
          mapInstanceRef.current.flyTo([detectedLat, detectedLng], 17);
        }
        showAlert({
          title: 'Location Centered',
          message: `Coordinates centered: ${detectedLat}°N, ${detectedLng}°E.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      },
      (err) => {
        showAlert({ title: 'Location Error', message: err.message, type: 'warning' });
      },
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000 }
    );
  };

  const handleSavePerimeter = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isAdmin || lat === null || lng === null || radius === null) return;

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put(
        API_ROUTES.campus.boundary,
        {
          center_latitude: lat,
          center_longitude: lng,
          latitude: lat,
          longitude: lng,
          radius_meters: radius,
        },
        { timeout: 8000 }
      );

      isDirtyRef.current = false;
      showAlert({
        title: 'Boundary Saved',
        message: res.data?.message || 'Campus boundary updated successfully.',
        type: 'success',
      });
      await refreshSchool();
      await fetchGeofenceData(true, true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Save Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not update campus boundary settings.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetDevice = (teacherId: number, teacherName: string) => {
    if (!canResetPhone) return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Reset Phone Device Lock',
      message: `Unbind the registered phone for ${teacherName}? This clears their 1-to-1 phone lock so they can pair a replacement phone on their next Time In.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Reset Device Lock',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setResettingId(teacherId);
        try {
          const res = await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.accounts.teachers}${teacherId}/reset-device/`);
          showAlert({
            title: 'Device Lock Cleared',
            message: res.data?.message || `Phone binding for ${teacherName} has been cleared.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
          await fetchGeofenceData(true, true);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Reset Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not clear device binding.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setResettingId(null);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const exportAuditCSV = () => {
    if (auditRecords.length === 0) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Empty Export', message: 'No location records available to export.', type: 'warning' });
      return;
    }

    const headers = [
      'Timestamp',
      'Teacher',
      'Employee ID',
      'Zone Status',
      'Distance from Campus',
      'Accuracy (m)',
      'Device ID',
    ];
    const rows = auditRecords.map((r) => [
      r.timestamp,
      r.teacher_name,
      r.employee_id || '—',
      r.status || (r.is_inside ? 'INSIDE' : 'OUTSIDE'),
      formatMeters(r.distance ?? r.distance_meters),
      r.accuracy_meters !== null && r.accuracy_meters !== undefined ? `${Math.round(r.accuracy_meters)}m` : '—',
      r.device_id || '—',
    ]);

    exportToCsv(
      `AttendSure_Campus_GPS_Logs_${dateFilterMode === 'ALL_LOGS' ? 'All_Logs' : auditDate}.csv`,
      headers,
      rows
    );
  };

  const badgePill = (bg: string, color: string, border: string): React.CSSProperties => ({
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    padding: '2px 8px',
    borderRadius: 4,
    backgroundColor: bg,
    color,
    border: `1px solid ${border}`,
    fontSize: '0.64rem',
    fontWeight: 800,
    letterSpacing: '0.3px',
  });

  const getStatusBadge = (s: TeacherBoundaryStatus) => {
    if (s.zone_status === 'AUTHORIZED_OUTSIDE' || s.status === 'AUTHORIZED_LEAVE') {
      return <span style={badgePill(tokens.primaryLight, brand.primary, brand.primary)}>Official Exit Pass</span>;
    }
    const inside = s.is_inside ?? s.is_inside_geofence;
    const hasCoordsToday = s.latitude !== null && s.latitude !== undefined;

    if (s.zone_status === 'INSIDE' || s.status === 'VERIFIED_INSIDE' || (hasCoordsToday && inside === true)) {
      return (
        <span style={badgePill(tokens.successLight, brand.success, brand.success)}>
          <Check size={11} style={{ marginRight: 3 }} /> On Campus
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (s.zone_status === 'LOAFING_ALERT' || s.status === 'PERIMETER_BREACH') {
      return <span style={badgePill(tokens.dangerLight, brand.danger, brand.danger)}>Teacher Loafing</span>;
    }
    if (hasCoordsToday && inside === false) {
      return (
        <span style={badgePill(tokens.warningLight, brand.warning, brand.warning)}>
          Outside Campus (Off Duty)
        </span>
      );
    }
    return <span style={badgePill(tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, tokens.textMuted, tokens.borderSubtle)}>Off Duty</span>;
  };

  const screenSwitchBtn = (active: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 5,
    padding: '5px 10px',
    borderRadius: 5,
    border: 'none',
    backgroundColor: active ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent',
    color: active ? tokens.onPrimary : tokens.textSecondary,
    fontWeight: active ? 800 : 600,
    fontSize: '0.72rem',
    cursor: 'pointer',
  });

  const layerToggleBtn = (active: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 4,
    padding: '3px 8px',
    borderRadius: 4,
    border: 'none',
    backgroundColor: active ? tokens.bgSurface : 'transparent',
    color: active ? brand.primary : tokens.textSecondary,
    fontWeight: active ? 800 : 600,
    fontSize: '0.66rem',
    cursor: 'pointer',
  });

  const panelCard: React.CSSProperties = {
    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
    borderRadius: 12,
    border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
    boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
    overflow: 'hidden',
  };

  const teacherList = geoData?.teacher_list || [];
  const openIncidentsCount = geoData?.open_incidents_count ?? 0;

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: 'clamp(12px, 2.5vw, 20px)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10 }}>
        <div>
          <h2
            style={{
              fontSize: '1.20rem',
              fontWeight: 800,
              color: tokens.textPrimary,
              margin: 0,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 8,
            }}
          >
            <Building2 size={20} color={brand.primary} />
            <span>Geofence &amp; Loafing Monitor</span>

            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 200px), 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
          <StatsCard
            label="LOCATION CHECKS"
            value={totalDatabaseRecords}
            helpText={dateFilterMode === 'ALL_LOGS' ? 'Recent campus location checks' : `Records on ${auditDate}`}
          />
          <StatsCard
            label="INSIDE CAMPUS"
            value={auditRecords.filter((r) => Boolean(r.is_inside ?? r.is_inside_geofence)).length}
            valueColor={brand.success}
            helpText={radius !== null ? `Within ${radius}m boundary` : 'Boundary not set'}
          />
          <StatsCard
            label="OUTSIDE CAMPUS"
            value={auditRecords.filter((r) => !Boolean(r.is_inside ?? r.is_inside_geofence)).length}
            valueColor={brand.danger}
            helpText="Beyond campus boundary"
          />
        </div>

        <div style={panelCard}>
          <div style={{ padding: '12px 16px', borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8 }}>
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                Campus GPS Location Logs
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, marginTop: 2 }}>
                Timestamped teacher GPS pings with dynamically computed distance from campus center.
              </div>
            </div>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
              Showing <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{auditRecords.length}</strong> record(s)
            </span>
          </div>

          <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
            <table style={{ width: '100%', minWidth: 780, borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.76rem' }}>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Timestamp</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Teacher</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Zone Status</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Distance from Campus</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>GPS Accuracy</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Device ID</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {auditRecords.length > 0 ? (
                  auditRecords.map((r) => {
                    const inside = Boolean(r.is_inside ?? r.is_inside_geofence);
                    return (
                      <tr key={r.id}>
                        <td style={{ ...ui.td, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                          <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{r.time_only || r.timestamp}</div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.64rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>{r.date_only || ''}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td style={ui.td}>
                          <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{r.teacher_name}</strong>
                          {r.employee_id && (
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.64rem', color: tokens.textMuted, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                              ID: {r.employee_id}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td style={ui.td}>
                          {inside ? (
                            <span style={badgePill(tokens.successLight, brand.success, brand.success)}>
                              <Check size={10} style={{ marginRight: 3 }} /> {r.status || 'INSIDE'}
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span style={badgePill(tokens.dangerLight, brand.danger, brand.danger)}>
                              <AlertTriangle size={10} style={{ marginRight: 3 }} /> {r.status || 'OUTSIDE'}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ ...ui.td, fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700, color: inside ? brand.success : brand.danger }}>
                          {formatMeters(r.distance ?? r.distance_meters)}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ ...ui.td, fontFamily: 'monospace', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                          {r.accuracy_meters !== null && r.accuracy_meters !== undefined ? `±${Math.round(r.accuracy_meters)}m` : '—'}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ ...ui.td, fontFamily: 'monospace', color: tokens.textSecondary, fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>
                          {r.device_id || '—'}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })
                ) : (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={6} style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '30px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                      {auditLoading ? 'Loading location logs...' : 'No location logs found matching your filters.'}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GeofenceTab;
