/**
 * AttendSure - Live Loafing & Class-Cutting Incident Monitor
 * File: web/src/components/tabs/LoafingMonitorPanel.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { sanitizeText } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { StatusBadge } from '../common/StatusBadge';
import { canResolveLoafing, getCurrentUserFromStorage } from '../../utils/permissions';
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  ShieldAlert,
  RefreshCw,
  PlayCircle,
  Clock,
  Check,
  XCircle,
  FileCheck,
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface LoafingIncidentItem {
  id: number;
  incident_type: 'TEACHER_OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE' | 'STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS' | 'EXPIRED_EXIT_PASS';
  status: 'OPEN' | 'RETURNED' | 'EXCUSED' | 'CONFIRMED_LOAFING';
  person_name: string;
  person_code: string;
  person_role: string;
  section_name?: string;
  class_period_label?: string;
  pass_number?: string;
  distance_meters?: number | null;
  detected_at: string;
  resolved_at?: string | null;
  remarks: string;
  reviewed_by_name?: string;
}

interface LoafingMonitorPanelProps {
  onIncidentUpdated?: () => void;
}

const INCIDENT_TYPE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  TEACHER_OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE: 'Teacher Loafing',
  STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS: 'Student Cutting Class',
  EXPIRED_EXIT_PASS: 'Expired Exit Pass',
};

const getStatusLabel = (status: string, incidentType?: string): string => {
  if (status === 'CONFIRMED_LOAFING') {
    return incidentType === 'STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS' ? 'Confirmed Cutting' : 'Confirmed Loafing';
  }
  if (status === 'OPEN') return 'Open Alert';
  if (status === 'RETURNED') return 'Returned';
  if (status === 'EXCUSED') return 'Excused';
  return status;
};

export const LoafingMonitorPanel: React.FC<LoafingMonitorPanelProps> = ({ onIncidentUpdated }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const isLeader = canResolveLoafing(getCurrentUserFromStorage());

  const [incidents, setIncidents] = useState<LoafingIncidentItem[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [auditing, setAuditing] = useState(false);
  const [resolvingId, setResolvingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [remarksById, setRemarksById] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const fetchIncidents = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      if (!silent) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const params: Record<string, string> = { nocache: '1' };
        if (typeFilter !== 'ALL') params.incident_type = typeFilter;
        if (statusFilter !== 'ALL') params.status = statusFilter;

        const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.campus.loafing, {
          params,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const rows = Array.isArray(res.data)
          ? res.data
          : Array.isArray(res.data?.results)
            ? res.data.results
            : Array.isArray(res.data?.records)
              ? res.data.records
              : [];
        setIncidents(rows as LoafingIncidentItem[]);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Load Notice',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not load teacher loafing and student cutting alerts from the server.'),
            type: 'warning',
          });
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted && !silent) setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [typeFilter, statusFilter, showAlert]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchIncidents(false);
    return () => abortRef.current?.abort();
  }, [fetchIncidents]);

  const handleRunClassAudit = async () => {
    setAuditing(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.campus.loafingAudit, {});
      const data = res.data || {};
      const cutting = Number(data.created_cutting_incidents ?? 0);
      const expired = Number(data.created_expired_pass_incidents ?? 0);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Student Cutting Audit Complete',
        message: `Detected ${cutting} new student cutting alert(s) and ${expired} expired exit pass alert(s).`,
        type: cutting + expired > 0 ? 'warning' : 'success',
      });
      await fetchIncidents(false);
      onIncidentUpdated?.();
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Audit Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Unable to run the student cutting audit right now.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setAuditing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResolve = async (
    incident: LoafingIncidentItem,
    nextStatus: 'CONFIRMED_LOAFING' | 'RETURNED' | 'EXCUSED'
  ) => {
    if (!isLeader) return;
    const incidentId = incident.id;
    setResolvingId(incidentId);
    try {
      const cleanRemarks = sanitizeText(remarksById[incidentId] || '', 240);
      await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.campus.loafingIncidents}${incidentId}/`, {
        status: nextStatus,
        remarks: cleanRemarks,
      });
      showAlert({
        title: 'Incident Updated',
        message: `Alert #${incidentId} marked as ${getStatusLabel(nextStatus, incident.incident_type)}.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
      setRemarksById((prev) => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        delete next[incidentId];
        return next;
      });
      await fetchIncidents(false);
      onIncidentUpdated?.();
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Update Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not update alert status.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setResolvingId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          padding: '12px 16px',
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 10,
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        }}
      >
        <div>
          <div
            style={{
              fontSize: '0.90rem',
              fontWeight: 800,
              color: tokens.textPrimary,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 7,
            }}
          >
            <ShieldAlert size={16} color={brand.danger} />
            <span>Teacher Loafing &amp; Student Cutting Alerts</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, marginTop: 2 }}>
            Helps school leaders review off-campus duty alerts, missed class periods, and overdue exit passes with fair context.
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <select
            aria-label="Filter incident type"
            value={typeFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setTypeFilter(e.target.value)}
            style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', padding: '5px 9px', fontSize: '0.74rem' }}
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Alert Types</option>
            <option value="TEACHER_OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE">Teacher Loafing</option>
            <option value="STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS">Student Cutting Class</option>
            <option value="EXPIRED_EXIT_PASS">Expired Exit Pass</option>
          </select>

          <select
            aria-label="Filter incident status"
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
            style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', padding: '5px 9px', fontSize: '0.74rem' }}
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Statuses</option>
            <option value="OPEN">Open Alerts</option>
            <option value="RETURNED">Returned</option>
            <option value="EXCUSED">Excused</option>
            <option value="CONFIRMED_LOAFING">Confirmed Loafing / Cutting</option>
          </select>

          {isLeader && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void handleRunClassAudit()}
              disabled={auditing}
              style={ui.btnPrimary}
            >
              <PlayCircle size={14} />
              <span>{auditing ? 'Auditing...' : 'Run Student Cutting Audit'}</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void fetchIncidents(false)}
            disabled={loading}
            style={ui.btnSecondary}
          >
            <RefreshCw size={13} className={loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
            <span>Refresh</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
        <table style={{ width: '100%', minWidth: 860, borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.76rem' }}>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th style={ui.th}>Person</th>
              <th style={ui.th}>Alert Type</th>
              <th style={ui.th}>Context / Distance</th>
              <th style={ui.th}>Detected</th>
              <th style={ui.th}>Status</th>
              <th style={ui.th}>Remarks / Review</th>
              {isLeader && <th style={{ ...ui.th, textAlign: 'right' }}>Action</th>}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {loading && incidents.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={isLeader ? 7 : 6} style={{ padding: 28, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                  Loading alerts...
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : incidents.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={isLeader ? 7 : 6} style={{ padding: 28, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                  <CheckCircle2 size={20} color={brand.success} style={{ margin: '0 auto 6px', display: 'block' }} />
                  All clear — no open teacher loafing or student cutting alerts match these filters.
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              incidents.map((inc) => (
                <tr key={inc.id}>
                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{inc.person_name || 'Unknown'}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.66rem', color: tokens.textMuted, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                      {inc.person_role} &bull; {inc.person_code || `#${inc.id}`}
                    </div>
                  </td>

                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                      <AlertTriangle
                        size={13}
                        color={inc.status === 'OPEN' ? brand.danger : brand.warning}
                      />
                      {INCIDENT_TYPE_LABELS[inc.incident_type] || inc.incident_type}
                    </span>
                  </td>

                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    {inc.class_period_label && (
                      <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{inc.class_period_label}</div>
                    )}
                    {inc.section_name && (
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{inc.section_name}</div>
                    )}
                    {inc.pass_number && (
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: brand.primary, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                        Pass #{inc.pass_number}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {inc.distance_meters !== null && inc.distance_meters !== undefined && (
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: brand.danger, fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                        {Math.round(inc.distance_meters)}m from campus
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </td>

                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                      <Clock size={12} />
                      {inc.detected_at ? new Date(inc.detected_at).toLocaleString() : '—'}
                    </span>
                  </td>

                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <StatusBadge
                      status={inc.status}
                      label={getStatusLabel(inc.status, inc.incident_type)}
                    />
                  </td>

                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textPrimary, maxWidth: 260 }}>
                      {inc.remarks || '—'}
                    </div>
                    {inc.reviewed_by_name && (
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.64rem', color: tokens.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>
                        Reviewed by {inc.reviewed_by_name}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {isLeader && inc.status === 'OPEN' && (
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        maxLength={240}
                        placeholder="Add official reason, locator slip #, or review note..."
                        value={remarksById[inc.id] || ''}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setRemarksById((prev) => ({ ...prev, [inc.id]: e.target.value }))
                        }
                        style={{ ...ui.input, marginTop: 6, padding: '4px 8px', fontSize: '0.70rem' }}
                      />
                    )}
                  </td>

                  {isLeader && (
                    <td style={{ ...ui.td, textAlign: 'right' }}>
                      {inc.status === 'OPEN' ? (
                        <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: 4, flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={resolvingId === inc.id}
                            onClick={() => void handleResolve(inc, 'CONFIRMED_LOAFING')}
                            style={{
                              ...ui.btnSecondary,
                              padding: '4px 7px',
                              fontSize: '0.66rem',
                              color: brand.danger,
                              borderColor: brand.danger,
                              backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
                            }}
                            title={
                              inc.incident_type === 'STUDENT_CUTTING_CLASS'
                                ? 'Confirm student cutting class'
                                : 'Confirm teacher loafing'
                            }
                          >
                            <XCircle size={11} /> Confirm
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={resolvingId === inc.id}
                            onClick={() => void handleResolve(inc, 'RETURNED')}
                            style={{
                              ...ui.btnSecondary,
                              padding: '4px 7px',
                              fontSize: '0.66rem',
                              color: brand.success,
                              borderColor: brand.success,
                              backgroundColor: tokens.successLight,
                            }}
                            title="Mark person as returned"
                          >
                            <Check size={11} /> Returned
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            disabled={resolvingId === inc.id}
                            onClick={() => void handleResolve(inc, 'EXCUSED')}
                            style={{
                              ...ui.btnSecondary,
                              padding: '4px 7px',
                              fontSize: '0.66rem',
                              color: brand.primary,
                              borderColor: brand.primary,
                              backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                            }}
                            title="Excuse with official reason"
                          >
                            <FileCheck size={11} /> Excuse
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Resolved</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  )}
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default LoafingMonitorPanel;

/**
 * AttendSure - Standard Module Table Layout
 * File: web/src/components/tabs/ModuleTableLayout.tsx
 */

import { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Search, Plus, Loader2, AlertCircle, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

export interface Column<T> {
  header: string;
  render: (item: T, index?: number) => ReactNode;
  align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right';
  width?: string | number;
}

export interface ModuleTableLayoutProps<T> {
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  searchValue: string;
  onSearchChange: (value: string) => void;
  addButtonLabel?: string;
  onAdd?: () => void;
  extraActions?: ReactNode;
  pagination?: ReactNode;
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  columns: Column<T>[];
  data: T[];
  keyExtractor: (item: T) => string | number;
}

export function ModuleTableLayout<T>({
  title,
  subtitle,
  searchPlaceholder = 'Search records...',
  searchValue,
  onSearchChange,
  addButtonLabel,
  onAdd,
  extraActions,
  pagination,
  loading,
  error,
  columns,
  data,
  keyExtractor,
}: ModuleTableLayoutProps<T>) {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();

  const tableItems: T[] = Array.isArray(data)
    ? data
    : (data as { results?: T[] })?.results && Array.isArray((data as { results?: T[] }).results)
    ? ((data as { results?: T[] }).results as T[])
    : (data as { data?: T[] })?.data && Array.isArray((data as { data?: T[] }).data)
    ? ((data as { data?: T[] }).data as T[])
    : [];

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', width: '100%' }}>
      {/* Header Toolbar */}
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          padding: '16px 20px',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 12,
        }}
      >
        <div>
          <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '1.15rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, letterSpacing: '-0.3px' }}>
            {title}
          </h3>
          <p style={{ margin: '3px 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.80rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            {subtitle}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <div style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <Search
              size={15}
              color={tokens.textMuted}
              style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 10, pointerEvents: 'none' }}
            />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
              value={searchValue}
              onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value)}
              style={{
                padding: '8px 30px 8px 32px',
                borderRadius: 6,

            fontSize: '0.84rem',

          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          overflow: 'hidden',
          minHeight: '220px',

        }}

          <div
            style={{
              textAlign: 'center',
              padding: '60px 20px',
              color: tokens.textMuted,
              fontSize: '0.86rem',

                <tr
                  style={{

                    borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                    color: tokens.textSecondary,
                    fontWeight: 700,
                  }}
                >
                  {columns.map((col, idx) => (
                    <th
                      key={idx}
                      style={{
                        padding: '12px 16px',
                        textAlign: col.align || 'left',
                        width: col.width || undefined,
                        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                      }}
                    >
                      {col.header}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {tableItems.map((item, index) => {
                  const itemKey = keyExtractor(item) ?? index;
                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={itemKey}
                      style={{
                        borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                        color: tokens.textPrimary,
                        transition: 'background-color 0.15s ease',
                      }}
                    >
                      {columns.map((col, cIdx) => (
                        <td
                          key={cIdx}
                          style={{
                            padding: '12px 16px',
                            textAlign: col.align || 'left',
                            verticalAlign: 'middle',
                          }}
                        >
                          {col.render(item, index)}
                        </td>
                      ))}
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {pagination && (
          <div style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface }}>
            {pagination}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ModuleTableLayout;

export interface StudentItem {
  id: number;
  lrn: string;
  name: string;
  gender: string;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  attendance_status: string;
  attendance_record_id?: number | null;
  guardian_contact?: string;
  qr_token?: string;
  qr_payload?: string;
}

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 60): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

export interface AssignedClass {
  schedule_id: number;
  section_id: number;
  section_name: string;
  grade_level?: string;
  display_name: string;
  subject_code: string;
  subject_title: string;
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string;
  time_display?: string;
  room_number?: string;
  total_students: number;
  students: StudentItem[];
  is_adviser?: boolean;
}

type ViewScope = 'MY_CLASSES' | 'ALL_CLASSES';
type StatusFilter = 'ALL' | 'PRESENT' | 'LATE' | 'CUTTING' | 'UNSCANNED';

const extractGradeLevelText = (val: unknown): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof val === 'string') return val.trim();
  if (typeof val === 'number') return `Grade ${val}`;
  if (typeof val === 'object') {
    const obj = val as Record<string, unknown>;
    const label = obj.name ?? obj.level ?? obj.grade_name ?? obj.grade;
    return label ? String(label).trim() : '';
  }
  return String(val).trim();
};

const maskQrToken = (token?: string): string => {
  const clean = String(token || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return '';
  return clean.length <= 4 ? 'Linked' : `••••${clean.slice(-4)}`;
};

const formatStatusLabel = (status: string): string => {
  const code = status.toUpperCase();
  if (code === 'UNSCANNED') return 'NOT SCANNED';
  return code;
};

export const MyAssignedClassesTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();
  const { school } = useSchool();
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedClass, setSelectedClass] = useState<AssignedClass | null>(null);

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');

  const [viewScope, setViewScope] = useState<ViewScope>('MY_CLASSES');

  const [badgeStudent, setBadgeStudent] = useState<StudentItem | null>(null);
  const [savingStudentId, setSavingStudentId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [selectedStudentIds, setSelectedStudentIds] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [isPrintModalOpen, setIsPrintModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const userRole = useMemo(
    () => String(localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'TEACHER').toUpperCase(),
    []

  const isAdmin = ['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(userRole);
  const canEditAttendance = ['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD', 'TEACHER'].includes(userRole);

  const uniqueSectionOptions = useMemo<SelectableOption[]>(() => {

    classes.forEach((c) => {
      if (c.section_id && !map.has(c.section_id)) {
        map.set(c.section_id, {
          id: c.section_id,
          label: `${c.grade_level ? `${c.grade_level} - ` : ''}${c.section_name}`,
        });
      }
    });
    return Array.from(map.values());
  }, [classes]);

  const toggleStudentSelection = (studentId: number) => {

      prev.includes(studentId) ? prev.filter((id) => id !== studentId) : [...prev, studentId]
    );
  };

  const normalizeClassList = useCallback((rawPayload: unknown): AssignedClass[] => {
    const rawData: Record<string, unknown>[] = Array.isArray(rawPayload)
      ? rawPayload
      : Array.isArray((rawPayload as { results?: Record<string, unknown>[] })?.results)
        ? ((rawPayload as { results: Record<string, unknown>[] }).results)
        : [];

    return rawData.map((item, idx) => {
      const rawStudents = Array.isArray(item.students) ? item.students : [];
      const students: StudentItem[] = rawStudents.map((st: Record<string, unknown>) => {
        const rawPhoto = (st.photo_url || st.photo) as string | null | undefined;
        const fullName =
          String(st.name || st.full_name || '').trim() ||
          `${String(st.first_name || '')} ${String(st.last_name || '')}`.trim() ||
          'Student';

        return {
          id: Number(st.id) || 0,
          lrn: String(st.lrn || '—').trim(),
          name: fullName,
          gender: String(st.sex || st.gender || '—').trim(),
          photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(rawPhoto) ? rawPhoto : null,
          attendance_status: String(st.attendance_status || 'UNSCANNED').toUpperCase(),
          attendance_record_id: st.attendance_record_id ? Number(st.attendance_record_id) : null,
          guardian_contact: String(st.guardian_contact || '').trim(),
          qr_token: String(st.qr_token || '').trim(),
          qr_payload: String(st.qr_payload || '').trim() || undefined,
        };
      });

      const sectionName = String(item.section_name || item.name || 'Section').trim();
      const subjectTitle = String(item.subject_title || item.subject_name || 'Homeroom').trim();
      const startTime = item.start_time ? String(item.start_time).slice(0, 5) : '';
      const endTime = item.end_time ? String(item.end_time).slice(0, 5) : '';
      const timeDisplay =
        String(item.time_display || '').trim() ||
        (startTime && endTime ? `${startTime} - ${endTime}` : 'Homeroom');
      const roomVal = String(item.room_number || item.room || '').trim();

      return {
        schedule_id: Number(item.schedule_id || item.id || idx + 1),
        section_id: Number(item.section_id || idx + 1),
        section_name: sectionName,
        grade_level: extractGradeLevelText(item.grade_level),
        display_name: String(item.display_name || `${sectionName} • ${subjectTitle}`),
        subject_code: String(item.subject_code || 'CLASS'),
        subject_title: subjectTitle,
        start_time: startTime,
        end_time: endTime,
        time_display: timeDisplay,
        room_number: roomVal || '—',
        total_students: students.length || Number(item.total_students) || 0,
        students,
        is_adviser: Boolean(item.is_adviser),
      };
    });
  }, []);

  const applyNormalizedClasses = useCallback((normalized: AssignedClass[]) => {

        normalized.find((c) => c.section_id === prev.section_id) ||
        normalized[0]
      );
    });
  }, []);

  const fetchClasses = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const baseParams: Record<string, string | number> = {};
      if (viewScope === 'ALL_CLASSES') baseParams.mode = 'all';

      const cached = !bypassCache
        ? peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, Object.keys(baseParams).length ? baseParams : undefined)
        : undefined;
      if (cached !== undefined) {
        applyNormalizedClasses(normalizeClassList(cached));
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const params: Record<string, string | number> = { ...baseParams };
        if (bypassCache) params.nocache = 1;

        const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, {
          params,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        applyNormalizedClasses(normalizeClassList(res.data));
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load your assigned classes.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {

          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [viewScope, normalizeClassList, applyNormalizedClasses]

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchClasses(false, false);

      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchClasses]);

    window.addEventListener('attendsure:attendance-updated', handleAttendanceUpdated);

      if (!isInteracting.current && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void fetchClasses(true, true);
      }
    }, 15000);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('attendsure:attendance-updated', handleAttendanceUpdated);
      clearInterval(liveInterval);
    };
  }, [fetchClasses]);

  const handleCopy = async (val: string) => {
    if (!val || val === '—') return;

  };

  const cleanSearch = useMemo(() => sanitizeInput(searchQuery, 60).toLowerCase(), [searchQuery]);

  const filteredStudents = useMemo(() => {

  return (

        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <select
            aria-label="Select assigned class"
            value={selectedClass ? `${selectedClass.schedule_id}:${selectedClass.section_id}` : ''}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const found = classes.find(

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 60): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const getSectionDisplayName = (sec: SectionOption): string => {
  return sec.name || sec.section_name || `Section #${sec.id}`;
};

const extractList = <T,>(payload: unknown): T[] => {
  if (Array.isArray(payload)) return payload as T[];
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && Array.isArray((payload as { results?: T[] }).results)) {
    return (payload as { results: T[] }).results;
  }
  return [];
};

  const cachedSections = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.school.sections, { page_size: 500 });
  const cachedTeachers = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.accounts.teachersDropdown);

  const [schedules, setSchedules] = useState<ScheduleItem[]>(() => extractList<ScheduleItem>(cachedPeriods));
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<SectionOption[]>(() => extractList<SectionOption>(cachedSections));
  const [teacherList, setTeacherList] = useState<TeacherOption[]>(() => extractList<TeacherOption>(cachedTeachers));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !cachedPeriods);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>('');

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedSectionFilter, setSelectedSectionFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [modalTab, setModalTab] = useState<AcademicTabType>('SCHEDULE');
  const [editItem, setEditItem] = useState<any>(null);
  const [selectedPeriodIds, setSelectedPeriodIds] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [isPrintModalOpen, setIsPrintModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const isInteracting = useRef(false);
  isInteracting.current = isModalOpen || isPrintModalOpen;

  const currentUser = useMemo(() => getCurrentUserFromStorage(), []);
  const userRole = normalizeRole(currentUser);
  const isLeaderRole = ['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(userRole);
  // Strict RBAC check: ADMIN gets full CRUD; PRINCIPAL gets View-Only (all Create/Edit/Delete hidden)
  const canManageSchedule = canManageSchoolSetup(currentUser);

  const sectionOptions = useMemo<SelectableOption[]>(
    () =>
      sections.map((sec) => ({
        id: sec.id,
        label: `${sec.grade_level_name ? `${sec.grade_level_name} - ` : ''}${getSectionDisplayName(sec)}`,
      })),
    [sections]
  );

  const teacherOptions = useMemo<SelectableOption[]>(
    () =>
      teacherList.map((t) => ({
        id: t.id,
        label: `${t.full_name || t.name || `Teacher #${t.id}`}${t.employee_id ? ` (${t.employee_id})` : ''}`,
      })),
    [teacherList]
  );

  const togglePeriodSelection = (periodId: number) => {
    setSelectedPeriodIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(periodId) ? prev.filter((id) => id !== periodId) : [...prev, periodId]
    );
  };

  const loggedInTeacherName = useMemo(() => {
    return (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_teacher_name') || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_full_name') || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();
  }, []);

  const loggedInUsername = useMemo(() => {
    return (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') || localStorage.getItem('username') || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();
  }, []);

  const isSectionAdvisoryForUser = useCallback(
    (sec: SectionOption): boolean => {
      if (sec.is_adviser) return true;

      if (loggedInUsername && sec.adviser_employee_id && sec.adviser_employee_id.toLowerCase() === loggedInUsername) {
        return true;
      }

      if (loggedInTeacherName) {
        if (sec.adviser_name && sec.adviser_name.toLowerCase().includes(loggedInTeacherName)) return true;
        if (sec.adviser_full_name && sec.adviser_full_name.toLowerCase().includes(loggedInTeacherName)) return true;
        if (typeof sec.adviser === 'string' && sec.adviser.toLowerCase().includes(loggedInTeacherName)) return true;
        if (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser) {
          const advName = (sec.adviser.full_name || sec.adviser.name || '').toLowerCase();
          if (advName && (advName.includes(loggedInTeacherName) || loggedInTeacherName.includes(advName))) {
            return true;
          }
        }
      }

      return false;
    },
    [loggedInTeacherName, loggedInUsername]
  );

  const myAdvisorySection = useMemo(() => {
    return sections.find((sec) => isSectionAdvisoryForUser(sec)) || null;
  }, [sections, isSectionAdvisoryForUser]);

  const loadData = useCallback(async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;

    if (!bypassCache && !silent) {
      const warmPeriods = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.school.periods, { page_size: 500 });
      if (warmPeriods) {
        setSchedules(extractList<ScheduleItem>(warmPeriods));
        setLoading(false);
      } else {
        setLoading(true);
      }
    } else if (!silent) {
      setLoading(true);
    }
    setError('');

    try {
      const cacheParam = bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {};
      const results = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.periods, {
          params: { page_size: 500, ...cacheParam },
          signal: controller.signal,
        }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.sections, {
          params: { page_size: 500, ...cacheParam },
          signal: controller.signal,
        }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.teachersDropdown, {
          params: cacheParam,
          signal: controller.signal,
        }),
      ]);

      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      const schedRes = results[0].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[0].value : null;
      const secRes = results[1].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[1].value : null;
      const teacherRes = results[2].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[2].value : null;

      if (schedRes?.data) setSchedules(extractList<ScheduleItem>(schedRes.data));
      if (secRes?.data) setSections(extractList<SectionOption>(secRes.data));
      if (teacherRes?.data) setTeacherList(extractList<TeacherOption>(teacherRes.data));

      if (results[0].status === 'rejected' && results[1].status === 'rejected') {
        const reason = results[0].reason as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (reason?.name !== 'CanceledError' && reason?.code !== 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          setError(extractApiError(results[0].reason, 'Could not load class schedule records.'));
        }
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
        return;
      }
      if (!silent) {
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load class schedule records. Please check server connection.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted && !silent) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadData(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [loadData]);

  const hasAutoSelectedRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasAutoSelectedRef.current && myAdvisorySection && userRole === 'TEACHER') {
      setSelectedSectionFilter(String(myAdvisorySection.id));
      hasAutoSelectedRef.current = true;
    }
  }, [myAdvisorySection, userRole]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const liveInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void loadData(true, true);
      }
    }, 12000);
    return () => clearInterval(liveInterval);
  }, [loadData]);

  const handleDelete = (id: number, code: string) => {
    if (!canManageSchedule) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Access Denied',
        message: 'Only school administrators can delete class schedules.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Class Schedule',
      message: `Are you sure you want to delete class period "${code}"? The assigned subject teacher will be unassigned.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete Schedule',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${API_ROUTES.school.periods}${id}/`);
          setSchedules((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
          showAlert({
            title: 'Schedule Removed',
            message: `Schedule ${code} was deleted successfully.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
          void loadData(true, true);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Delete Error',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to delete schedule period.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleOpenModal = (tab: AcademicTabType, item: any = null) => {
    setModalTab(tab);
    setEditItem(item);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCloseModal = () => {
    setIsModalOpen(false);
    setEditItem(null);
  };

  const formatTime = (timeStr?: string) => {
    if (!timeStr) return '--:--';
    const parts = timeStr.split(':');
    if (parts.length < 2) return timeStr;
    let hours = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
    const minutes = parts[1];
    const ampm = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
    hours = hours % 12 || 12;
    const strHours = hours < 10 ? `0${hours}` : `${hours}`;
    return `${strHours}:${minutes} ${ampm}`;
  };

  const getScheduleCode = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    return item.schedule_code || item.code || `SCH-${String(item.id).padStart(4, '0')}`;
  };

  const getTeacherInfo = useCallback(
    (item: ScheduleItem) => {
      let name = 'Unassigned';
      let photo: string | null = item.teacher_photo_url || null;
      let employeeId = item.teacher_employee_id || '';

      if (item.teacher_name && item.teacher_name.trim() !== '' && item.teacher_name.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'unassigned') {
        name = item.teacher_name.trim();
      } else if (typeof item.teacher === 'object' && item.teacher) {
        name = item.teacher.full_name || item.teacher.name || name;
        photo = item.teacher.photo_url || item.teacher.photo || photo;
        employeeId = item.teacher.employee_id || employeeId;
      }

      let targetTeacherId: number | undefined;
      if (typeof item.teacher_id === 'number') {
        targetTeacherId = item.teacher_id;
      } else if (typeof item.teacher === 'number') {
        targetTeacherId = item.teacher;
      } else if (typeof item.teacher === 'string' && !isNaN(Number(item.teacher))) {
        targetTeacherId = Number(item.teacher);
      } else if (typeof item.teacher === 'object' && item.teacher && typeof item.teacher.id === 'number') {
        targetTeacherId = item.teacher.id;
      }

      if (targetTeacherId !== undefined) {
        const matched = teacherList.find((t) => t.id === targetTeacherId);
        if (matched) {
          name = matched.full_name || matched.name || name;
          photo = matched.photo_url || matched.photo || photo;
          employeeId = matched.employee_id || employeeId;
        }
      }

      return { name, photo: isSafeImageUrl(photo) ? photo : null, employeeId };
    },
    [teacherList]
  );

  const getSubjectCode = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.subject_code) return item.subject_code;
    if (typeof item.subject === 'object' && item.subject) {
      return item.subject.code || item.subject.title || item.subject.name || '—';
    }
    if (typeof item.subject === 'string') return item.subject;
    return item.subject ? `SUB-${item.subject}` : '—';
  };

  const getSubjectName = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.subject_title) return item.subject_title;
    if (item.subject_name) return item.subject_name;
    if (typeof item.subject === 'object' && item.subject) {
      return item.subject.title || item.subject.name || '';
    }
    return '';
  };

  const getSectionName = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.section_name) return item.section_name;
    if (typeof item.section === 'object' && item.section) {
      return item.section.name || item.section.section_name || `Section #${item.section.id}`;
    }
    return item.section ? `Section #${item.section}` : 'Unassigned';
  };

  const getRoomDisplay = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.room_number) return item.room_number;
    if (item.room_name) return item.room_name;
    if (typeof item.room === 'object' && item.room) {
      return item.room.room_number || item.room.name || '—';
    }
    if (typeof item.room === 'string') return item.room;
    if (item.room) return `Rm ${item.room}`;
    return '—';
  };

  const cleanSearchQuery = useMemo(() => sanitizeInput(searchQuery, 60).toLowerCase(), [searchQuery]);

  const filteredSchedules = useMemo(() => {
    return schedules.filter((s) => {
      if (selectedSectionFilter !== 'ALL') {
        const secId = typeof s.section === 'object' && s.section ? s.section.id : s.section;
        const matchesId = String(secId) === selectedSectionFilter;
        const matchesName = String(s.section_name) === selectedSectionFilter;
        if (!matchesId && !matchesName) return false;
      }

      if (cleanSearchQuery !== '') {
        const code = getScheduleCode(s).toLowerCase();
        const sec = getSectionName(s).toLowerCase();
        const sub = `${getSubjectCode(s)} ${getSubjectName(s)}`.toLowerCase();
        const teacherName = getTeacherInfo(s).name.toLowerCase();
        const rm = getRoomDisplay(s).toLowerCase();

        return (
          code.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          sec.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          sub.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          teacherName.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          rm.includes(cleanSearchQuery)
        );
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [schedules, selectedSectionFilter, cleanSearchQuery, getTeacherInfo]);

  const currentSelectedSectionObj = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedSectionFilter === 'ALL') return null;
    return sections.find((sec) => String(sec.id) === selectedSectionFilter) || null;
  }, [selectedSectionFilter, sections]);

  const getAdviserDetails = useCallback(
    (sec: SectionOption | null) => {
      if (!sec) return null;

      let name = '';
      let photo: string | null = null;
      let employeeId = '';

      if (sec.adviser_name) name = sec.adviser_name;
      if (sec.adviser_full_name) name = sec.adviser_full_name;
      if (sec.adviser_photo_url) photo = sec.adviser_photo_url;
      if (sec.adviser_employee_id) employeeId = sec.adviser_employee_id;

      if (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser) {
        if (!name) name = sec.adviser.full_name || sec.adviser.name || '';
        if (!photo) photo = sec.adviser.photo_url || sec.adviser.photo || null;
        if (!employeeId) employeeId = sec.adviser.employee_id || '';
      } else if (typeof sec.adviser === 'string' && !name) {
        name = sec.adviser;
      }

      let adviserId: number | undefined;
      if (typeof sec.adviser_id === 'number') {
        adviserId = sec.adviser_id;
      } else if (typeof sec.adviser === 'number') {
        adviserId = sec.adviser;
      } else if (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser && typeof sec.adviser.id === 'number') {
        adviserId = sec.adviser.id;
      }

      if (adviserId !== undefined) {
        const match = teacherList.find((t) => t.id === adviserId);
        if (match) {
          if (!name) name = match.full_name || match.name || '';
          if (!photo) photo = match.photo_url || match.photo || null;
          if (!employeeId) employeeId = match.employee_id || '';
        }
      }

      return {
        name: name || null,
        photo: isSafeImageUrl(photo) ? photo : null,
        employeeId: employeeId || '',
      };
    },
    [teacherList]
  );

  const resolvedAdviser = useMemo(() => getAdviserDetails(currentSelectedSectionObj), [currentSelectedSectionObj, getAdviserDetails]);
  const resolvedMyAdviser = useMemo(() => getAdviserDetails(myAdvisorySection), [myAdvisorySection, getAdviserDetails]);

  const uniqueSectionsCount = useMemo(
    () => new Set(schedules.map((s) => getSectionName(s)).filter((n) => n !== 'Unassigned')).size,
    [schedules]
  );

  const uniqueTeacherCount = useMemo(
    () => new Set(schedules.map((s) => getTeacherInfo(s).name).filter((n) => n !== 'Unassigned')).size,
    [schedules, getTeacherInfo]
  );

  const uniqueRoomsCount = useMemo(
    () => new Set(schedules.map((s) => getRoomDisplay(s)).filter((r) => r !== '—')).size,
    [schedules]
  );

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2.5vw, 20px)' }}>
      {/* 1. Summary Cards */}
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 210px), 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
        <StatsCard
          label="SCHEDULE PERIODS"
          value={schedules.length}
          helpText="Active timetable slots"
          badge={<Calendar size={18} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="SCHEDULED SECTIONS"
          value={uniqueSectionsCount}
          valueColor={brand.success}
          helpText="Sections with class schedules"
          badge={<Users size={18} color={brand.success} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="SUBJECT TEACHERS"
          value={uniqueTeacherCount}
          valueColor={brand.primary}
          helpText="Teachers with class loads"
          badge={<GraduationCap size={18} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="OCCUPIED ROOMS"
          value={uniqueRoomsCount}
          valueColor={brand.warning}
          helpText="Rooms currently scheduled"
          badge={<DoorOpen size={18} color={brand.warning} />}
        />
      </div>

      {/* 2. Top Filter and Setup Navigation Bar */}
      <div
        style={{
          ...ui.card,
          padding: '10px 14px',
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 10,
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: '0.80rem' }}>
            <Filter size={15} /> Class Section:
          </div>
          <select
            aria-label="Filter by class section"
            value={selectedSectionFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedSectionFilter(e.target.value)}
            style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', minWidth: 210, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer' }}
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Sections ({schedules.length} periods)</option>
            {sections.map((sec) => {
              const displayName = getSectionDisplayName(sec);
              const isMine = isSectionAdvisoryForUser(sec);
              return (
                <option key={sec.id} value={sec.id}>
                  {displayName} {isMine ? '★ (Your Advisory Class)' : sec.code ? `(${sec.code})` : ''}
                </option>
              );
            })}
          </select>

          {myAdvisorySection && selectedSectionFilter !== String(myAdvisorySection.id) && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSelectedSectionFilter(String(myAdvisorySection.id))}
              style={{
                ...ui.btnSecondary,
                backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                borderColor: brand.primary,
                color: brand.primary,
              }}
              title="Jump directly to your advisory class section"
            >
              <Sparkles size={13} color={brand.primary} />
              <span>View My Advisory Class</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {selectedPeriodIds.length > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSelectedPeriodIds([])}
              style={{
                ...ui.btnSecondary,
                backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                borderColor: brand.primary,
                color: brand.primary,
              }}
            >
              <span>{selectedPeriodIds.length} Selected &times; Clear</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsPrintModalOpen(true)}
            style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, borderColor: brand.primary, color: brand.primary }}
            title="Download or Print Class Schedules (All or Selected)"
          >
            <Printer size={13} color={brand.primary} />
            <span>
              {selectedPeriodIds.length > 0
                ? `Print / Export (${selectedPeriodIds.length})`
                : 'Print / Export Schedules'}
            </span>
          </button>

          {canManageSchedule && (
            <>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleOpenModal('SECTION')}
                style={ui.btnSecondary}
                title="Add a Section and Assign an Adviser"
              >
                <Users size={13} color={brand.primary} /> + Section &amp; Adviser
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleOpenModal('ROOM')}
                style={ui.btnSecondary}
                title="Add a Classroom or Laboratory"
              >
                <DoorOpen size={13} color={brand.primary} /> + Room
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleOpenModal('SUBJECT')}
                style={ui.btnSecondary}
                title="Add an Academic Subject"
              >
                <BookOpen size={13} color={brand.primary} /> + Subject
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleOpenModal('SCHEDULE')}
                style={ui.btnPrimary}
                title="Assign a Subject Teacher to this Section"
              >
                <Plus size={15} /> Add Subject Teacher Slot
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3A. Dedicated Advisory Class Banner */}
      {selectedSectionFilter === 'ALL' && myAdvisorySection && (
        <div
          style={{
            ...ui.subtleBox,
            backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
            borderColor: brand.primary,
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            gap: 12,
            padding: '12px 18px',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {resolvedMyAdviser?.photo && isSafeImageUrl(resolvedMyAdviser.photo) ? (
              <ProfileAvatar
                photoUrl={resolvedMyAdviser.photo}
                name={resolvedMyAdviser.name || 'Adviser'}
                size={44}
                iconSize={20}
              />
            ) : (
              <div
                style={{
                  width: 44,
                  height: 44,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                  border: `1.5px solid ${brand.primary}`,
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              >
                <UserCheck size={20} color={brand.primary} />
              </div>
            )}

            <div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.96rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  Your Advisory Class: {getSectionDisplayName(myAdvisorySection)}
                </span>
                <span style={ui.badge(tokens.successLight, brand.success)}>Official Class Adviser</span>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginTop: 3, fontSize: '0.76rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <span style={{ color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700 }}>Assigned Adviser:</span>
                <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {resolvedMyAdviser?.name || 'You are designated Class Adviser'}
                </strong>
                {resolvedMyAdviser?.employeeId && (
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                    ({resolvedMyAdviser.employeeId})
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSelectedSectionFilter(String(myAdvisorySection.id))}
            style={ui.btnPrimary}
          >
            <span>Filter to My Advisory Class</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 3B. Section Overview Banner */}
      {currentSelectedSectionObj && (
        <div
          style={{
            ...ui.subtleBox,
            backgroundColor: tokens.infoLight,
            borderColor: brand.secondary,
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            gap: 12,
            padding: '12px 18px',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {resolvedAdviser?.photo && isSafeImageUrl(resolvedAdviser.photo) ? (
              <ProfileAvatar
                photoUrl={resolvedAdviser.photo}
                name={resolvedAdviser.name || 'Adviser'}
                size={44}
                iconSize={20}
              />
            ) : (
              <div
                style={{
                  width: 44,
                  height: 44,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                  border: `1.5px solid ${brand.primary}`,
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              >
                <UserCheck size={20} color={brand.primary} />
              </div>
            )}

            <div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.96rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {getSectionDisplayName(currentSelectedSectionObj)}
                </span>
                <span style={{ ...ui.badge(tokens.primaryLight, brand.primary), fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                  {currentSelectedSectionObj.code || 'SEC'}
                </span>
                {currentSelectedSectionObj.grade_level_name && (
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                    &bull; {currentSelectedSectionObj.grade_level_name}
                  </span>
                )}
                {isSectionAdvisoryForUser(currentSelectedSectionObj) && (

              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginTop: 3, fontSize: '0.76rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <span style={{ color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700 }}>Class Adviser:</span>
                <strong style={{ color: resolvedAdviser?.name ? tokens.textPrimary : brand.warning }}>
                  {resolvedAdviser?.name || 'No Homeroom Adviser Assigned'}
                </strong>
                {resolvedAdviser?.employeeId && (
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                    ({resolvedAdviser.employeeId})
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <div style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted, display: 'block' }}>
                SUBJECT TEACHERS
              </span>
              <strong style={{ fontSize: '1.05rem', color: brand.primary }}>
                {filteredSchedules.length} classes scheduled
              </strong>
            </div>

            {canManageSchedule && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleOpenModal('SECTION', currentSelectedSectionObj)}
                style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, borderColor: brand.primary, color: brand.primary }}
              >
                <Edit2 size={12} />
                <span>Change Adviser</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4. Main Timetable List */}
      <div style={ui.card}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 16, flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10 }}>
          <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', maxWidth: 320 }}>
            <Search
              size={15}
              color={tokens.textMuted}
              style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 10, top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)', pointerEvents: 'none' }}
            />
            <input
              type="text"
              maxLength={60}
              placeholder="Search by section, subject, teacher, room..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              style={{ ...ui.input, paddingLeft: 32 }}
            />
          </div>

          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            Showing <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{filteredSchedules.length}</strong> of{' '}
            <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{schedules.length}</strong> timetable slots
          </div>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div
            style={{
              ...ui.subtleBox,
              backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
              borderColor: brand.danger,
              color: brand.danger,
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              alignItems: 'center',
              marginBottom: 16,
              gap: 10,
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
              <AlertCircle size={18} color={brand.danger} />
              <span>{error}</span>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void loadData(false, true)}
              style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, borderColor: brand.danger, color: brand.danger }}
            >
              <RefreshCw size={13} /> Retry
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {loading ? (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 10, padding: '50px 0' }}>
            <Loader2 size={26} className="animate-spin" color={brand.primary} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Loading schedules from database...</span>
          </div>
        ) : filteredSchedules.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '40px 0' }}>
            <Calendar size={38} color={tokens.textMuted} />
            <p style={{ margin: '8px 0 2px 0', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary, fontSize: '0.88rem' }}>
              No timetable records found
            </p>
            <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
              {canManageSchedule
                ? 'Click "+ Add Subject Teacher Slot" above to schedule a class for this section.'
                : 'No class schedules match your current filter.'}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
            <table style={{ width: '100%', minWidth: 640, borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left' }}>
              <thead>
                <tr>

                      onChange={(e) => {
                        if (e.target.checked) {

                          style={{

                          {displayCode}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, fontSize: '0.84rem' }}>
                          {getSectionName(row)}
                        </div>
                        {row.grade_level_name && (
                          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, marginTop: 1 }}>
                            {row.grade_level_name}

                            photoUrl={teacherInfo.photo}
                            name={teacherInfo.name}
                            size={30}
                            iconSize={15}
                          />

                              {teacherInfo.name}
                            </span>

                              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', fontFamily: 'monospace', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                                {teacherInfo.employeeId}
                              </span>
                            )}

                        <div
                          style={{
                            display: 'inline-flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 5,
                            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                            border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                            padding: '3px 8px',
                            borderRadius: 6,
                            fontSize: '0.74rem',
                            color: tokens.textPrimary,
                            fontWeight: 600,
                          }}
                        >
                          <Clock size={12} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                          <span>
                            {formatTime(row.start_time)} - {formatTime(row.end_time)}
                          </span>
                          <span style={{ color: tokens.textMuted }}>&bull; {row.days_of_week || 'MON-FRI'}</span>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, fontSize: '0.80rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>

                              aria-label={`Edit schedule ${displayCode}`}

                              <Edit2 size={13} color={brand.primary} />
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleDelete(row.id, displayCode)}
                              style={{
                                ...ui.btnSecondary,
                                padding: '5px 7px',
                                backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
                                borderColor: brand.danger,
                                color: brand.danger,
                              }}
                              title="Delete Class Schedule"
                              aria-label={`Delete schedule ${displayCode}`}
                            >
                              <Trash2 size={13} color={brand.danger} />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      )}
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <AcademicSetupModal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        initialTab={modalTab}
        editItem={editItem}
        onClose={handleCloseModal}
        onSuccess={() => {
          void loadData(true, true);
          handleCloseModal();
        }}
      />

      <PrintableExportModal
        isOpen={isPrintModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsPrintModalOpen(false)}
        title="Print & Download School Class Schedules"
        defaultPackType="CLASS_SCHEDULE"
        allowedPackTypes={['CLASS_SCHEDULE', 'COMPLETE_TEACHER_PACKET']}
        initialScope={
          selectedPeriodIds.length > 0 || selectedSectionFilter !== 'ALL' ? 'SELECTED' : 'ALL'
        }
        preselectedPeriodIds={selectedPeriodIds}
        preselectedSectionIds={
          selectedPeriodIds.length === 0 && selectedSectionFilter !== 'ALL'
            ? [Number(selectedSectionFilter)]
            : []
        }
        sectionOptions={sectionOptions}
        teacherOptions={teacherOptions}
        isSchoolLeader={isLeaderRole}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default SchedulesTab;

/**
