import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { exportToCsv } from '../common/Pagination';
import { canManageSchoolSetup, canViewAuditLogs, getCurrentUserFromStorage } from '../../utils/permissions';
import { Building2, History, Layers, Loader2, Wrench } from 'lucide-react';
import { MaintenancePanel } from './settings/MaintenancePanel';
import {
  AuditLogsPanel,
  formatAuditTimestamp,
  getAuditActionLabel,
  getAuditActorName,
  getAuditDetailsText,
  getAuditIpAddress,
  getAuditModuleLabel,
  getAuditStatusDisplay,
} from './settings/AuditLogsPanel';
import { SchoolProfileForm } from './settings/SchoolProfileForm';
import {
  sanitizeSettingsInput,
  type ActivityRecord,
  type FreshLogosState,
  type MaintenanceHealthStatus,
  type SchoolSettingsFormData,
  type TeacherOption,
} from './settings/types';

const INITIAL_FORM_DATA: SchoolSettingsFormData = {
  school_id: '',
  school_name: '',
  region: '',
  division: '',
  district: '',
  academic_year: '',
  address: '',
  contact_number: '',
  email: '',
  website: '',
  principal_teacher: '',
  principal_name: '',
  principal_title: '',
  principal_photo_url: null,
  principal_employee_id: '',
  principal_department: '',
  principal_contact_number: '',
  principal_email: '',
  superintendent_name: '',
  school_logo: null,
  left_logo: null,
  right_logo: null,
  latitude: '',
  longitude: '',
  geofence_radius_meters: 150,
};

export const SettingsTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { updateSchoolInstantly, refreshSchool } = useSchool();
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const currentUser = getCurrentUserFromStorage();
  const canEditSettings = canManageSchoolSetup(currentUser);
  const canViewLogs = canViewAuditLogs(currentUser);

  const initAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const diagAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const logsAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const saveSuccessTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<'MAINTENANCE' | 'SETTINGS' | 'LOGS' | 'ALL'>(
    canEditSettings ? 'MAINTENANCE' : 'LOGS'
  );

  const cachedSchool = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.school.settings);
  const [teacherList, setTeacherList] = useState<TeacherOption[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!cachedSchool);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveSuccess, setSaveSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [activityLogs, setActivityLogs] = useState<ActivityRecord[]>([]);
  const [logsLoading, setLogsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [logSearch, setLogSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [logActionFilter, setLogActionFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [logDateFilter, setLogDateFilter] = useState<string>('');
  const [isAdminUser, setIsAdminUser] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [health, setHealth] = useState<MaintenanceHealthStatus>({
    database: 'ONLINE',
    dbLatencyMs: 0,
    teachersOnline: 0,
    teachersTotal: 0,
    openLoafingIncidents: 0,
    activeExitPasses: 0,
    lastChecked: '',
  });

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<SchoolSettingsFormData>(INITIAL_FORM_DATA);
  const [freshLogos, setFreshLogos] = useState<FreshLogosState>({
    school_logo: false,
    left_logo: false,
    right_logo: false,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      initAbortRef.current?.abort();
      diagAbortRef.current?.abort();
      logsAbortRef.current?.abort();
      if (saveSuccessTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(saveSuccessTimerRef.current);
        saveSuccessTimerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const applySchoolPayload = useCallback((s: any) => {
    if (!s || typeof s !== 'object') return;
    setFormData({
      school_id: s.school_id || '',
      school_name: s.school_name || '',
      region: s.region || '',
      division: s.division || '',
      district: s.district || '',
      academic_year: s.academic_year || s.school_year || '',
      address: s.address || s.street_address || '',
      contact_number: s.contact_number || s.telephone || '',
      email: s.email || '',
      website: s.website || '',
      principal_teacher: s.principal_teacher ?? '',
      principal_name: s.principal_name || '',
      principal_title: s.principal_title || '',
      principal_photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(s.principal_photo_url) ? s.principal_photo_url : null,
      principal_employee_id: s.principal_employee_id || '',
      principal_department: s.principal_department || '',
      principal_contact_number: s.principal_contact_number || '',
      principal_email: s.principal_email || '',
      superintendent_name: s.superintendent_name || '',
      school_logo: isSafeImageUrl(s.school_logo) ? s.school_logo : null,
      left_logo: isSafeImageUrl(s.left_logo) ? s.left_logo : null,
      right_logo: isSafeImageUrl(s.right_logo) ? s.right_logo : null,
      latitude: s.latitude !== undefined && s.latitude !== null && s.latitude !== '' ? String(s.latitude) : '',
      longitude: s.longitude !== undefined && s.longitude !== null && s.longitude !== '' ? String(s.longitude) : '',
      geofence_radius_meters: s.geofence_radius_meters ? Number(s.geofence_radius_meters) : 150,
    });
  }, []);

  const fetchDiagnostics = useCallback(async () => {
    diagAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    diagAbortRef.current = controller;

    const [dbRes, sysRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
      apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.health.db, { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal }),
      apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.reports.systemStatus, { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal }),
    ]);

    if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

    const dbData = dbRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? dbRes.value.data : null;
    const sysData = sysRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? sysRes.value.data : null;

    setHealth({
      database: dbData?.database === 'CONNECTED' || dbData?.status === 'CONNECTED' ? 'ONLINE' : 'OFFLINE',
      dbLatencyMs: Number(dbData?.latency_ms) || 0,
      teachersOnline: Number(sysData?.online_teachers ?? sysData?.online_count ?? sysData?.teachers_on_duty) || 0,
      teachersTotal: Number(sysData?.total_teachers ?? sysData?.total_scanners) || 0,
      openLoafingIncidents: Number(sysData?.open_loafing_incidents) || 0,
      activeExitPasses: Number(sysData?.active_exit_passes) || 0,
      lastChecked: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }),
    });
  }, []);

  const fetchUserActivities = useCallback(async () => {
    logsAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    logsAbortRef.current = controller;

    setLogsLoading(true);
    try {
      const params: Record<string, string | number> = { nocache: 1 };
      const cleanSearch = sanitizeSettingsInput(logSearch, 80);
      if (cleanSearch) params.search = cleanSearch;
      if (logActionFilter !== 'ALL') params.action = logActionFilter;
      if (logDateFilter) params.date = logDateFilter;

      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.auditLogs, {
        params,
        timeout: 8000,
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      if (res.data) {
        const rawList = res.data.records || res.data.results || (Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : []);
        setActivityLogs(rawList);
        setIsAdminUser(Boolean(res.data.is_admin));
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
        return;
      }
      setActivityLogs([]);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Activity Log Notice',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not load activity logs.'),
        type: 'warning',
      });
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setLogsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [logSearch, logActionFilter, logDateFilter, showAlert]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    initAbortRef.current = controller;

    const warmSchool = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.school.settings);
    if (warmSchool) {
      applySchoolPayload(warmSchool);
      setLoading(false);
    }

    const loadInitialData = async () => {
      if (!warmSchool) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const [schoolRes, teacherRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
          apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.settings, { timeout: 6000, signal: controller.signal }),
          apiClient
            .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.teachersDropdown, {
              params: { include_all: 'true' },
              timeout: 6000,
              signal: controller.signal,
            })
            .catch(() => apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.teachers, { timeout: 6000, signal: controller.signal })),
        ]);

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        if (schoolRes.status === 'fulfilled' && schoolRes.value.data) {
          applySchoolPayload(schoolRes.value.data);
        }

        if (teacherRes.status === 'fulfilled' && teacherRes.value.data) {
          const tList = Array.isArray(teacherRes.value.data)
            ? teacherRes.value.data
            : teacherRes.value.data?.results || [];
          setTeacherList(tList);
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    void loadInitialData();
    void fetchDiagnostics();

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [applySchoolPayload, fetchDiagnostics]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeSubTab === 'LOGS' || activeSubTab === 'ALL') {
      void fetchUserActivities();
    }
  }, [activeSubTab, fetchUserActivities]);

  const runMaintenanceAction = (
    actionKey: string,
    title: string,
    description: string,
    apiCall: () => Promise<any>
  ) => {
    showConfirm({
      title,
      message: `${description} Do you want to proceed?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Run Fix Now',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionLoading(actionKey);
        try {
          const res = await apiCall();
          showAlert({
            title: 'Task Finished Successfully',
            message: res?.data?.message || `${title} completed with zero errors.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
          void fetchDiagnostics();
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Action Notice',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Action could not be completed. Please try again.'),
            type: 'warning',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionLoading(null);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const exportActivityCSV = () => {
    if (activityLogs.length === 0) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Empty Export', message: 'No activity logs available to export.', type: 'warning' });
      return;
    }

    exportToCsv(
      `AttendSure_User_Activities_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`,
      ['Timestamp', 'User Account', 'Action', 'Module', 'Event Details', 'Client IP', 'Status'],
      activityLogs.map((r) => [
        formatAuditTimestamp(r).fullText,
        getAuditActorName(r),
        getAuditActionLabel(r),
        getAuditModuleLabel(r),
        getAuditDetailsText(r),
        getAuditIpAddress(r),
        getAuditStatusDisplay(r).label,
      ])
    );
  };

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveSuccess(false);

    const hasLat = String(formData.latitude).trim() !== '';
    const hasLng = String(formData.longitude).trim() !== '';
    const lat = hasLat ? Number(formData.latitude) : null;
    const lng = hasLng ? Number(formData.longitude) : null;
    const radius = Number(formData.geofence_radius_meters);

    if (lat !== null && (isNaN(lat) || lat < -90 || lat > 90)) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Latitude', message: 'Latitude must be between -90 and 90 degrees.', type: 'error' });
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }
    if (lng !== null && (isNaN(lng) || lng < -180 || lng > 180)) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Longitude', message: 'Longitude must be between -180 and 180 degrees.', type: 'error' });
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }
    if (isNaN(radius) || radius < 20 || radius > 5000) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Boundary Radius', message: 'Radius must be between 20 and 5000 meters.', type: 'error' });
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    const validTeacherId =
      formData.principal_teacher && !isNaN(Number(formData.principal_teacher))
        ? Number(formData.principal_teacher)
        : null;

    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      school_id: sanitizeSettingsInput(formData.school_id, 40),
      school_name: sanitizeSettingsInput(formData.school_name, 160),
      region: sanitizeSettingsInput(formData.region, 80),
      division: sanitizeSettingsInput(formData.division, 120),
      district: sanitizeSettingsInput(formData.district, 120),
      academic_year: sanitizeSettingsInput(formData.academic_year, 20),
      address: sanitizeSettingsInput(formData.address, 250),
      contact_number: sanitizeSettingsInput(formData.contact_number, 40),
      email: sanitizeSettingsInput(formData.email, 150),
      website: sanitizeSettingsInput(formData.website, 200),
      principal_teacher: validTeacherId,
      principal_name: sanitizeSettingsInput(formData.principal_name, 150),
      principal_title: sanitizeSettingsInput(formData.principal_title, 120),
      superintendent_name: sanitizeSettingsInput(formData.superintendent_name, 150),
      latitude: lat,
      longitude: lng,
      geofence_radius_meters: radius,
    };

    if (freshLogos.school_logo) payload.school_logo = formData.school_logo;
    if (freshLogos.left_logo) payload.left_logo = formData.left_logo;
    if (freshLogos.right_logo) payload.right_logo = formData.right_logo;

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put(API_ROUTES.school.settings, payload, { timeout: 15000 });
      updateSchoolInstantly(res.data || payload);
      if (isSafeImageUrl(res.data?.principal_photo_url)) {
        setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, principal_photo_url: res.data.principal_photo_url }));
      }
      setFreshLogos({ school_logo: false, left_logo: false, right_logo: false });
      setSaveSuccess(true);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Settings Saved',
        message: 'School profile and campus boundary saved to the database.',
        type: 'success',
        autoCloseDuration: 2500,
      });
      if (saveSuccessTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(saveSuccessTimerRef.current);
      saveSuccessTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setSaveSuccess(false);
        saveSuccessTimerRef.current = null;
      }, 3000);
      await refreshSchool();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Save Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not save school settings. Please check your permissions and inputs.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', height: '60vh' }}>
        <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={30} color={brand.primary} />
      </div>

        height: '100%',
        overflowY: 'auto',
        overflowX: 'hidden',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',

        padding: 'clamp(14px, 2.5vw, 24px)',
      }}

            <h1 style={{ fontSize: '1.25rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, margin: 0 }}>
              School Settings &amp; Maintenance Center
            </h1>
            <p style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, marginTop: 4 }}>
              Manage school profiles, official report seals, self-service maintenance diagnostics, and activity logs.
            </p>

              gap: 4,
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
            }}
          >
            {(
              [
                ...(canEditSettings
                  ? ([{ key: 'MAINTENANCE', label: 'One-Click System Fixes', icon: <Wrench size={14} /> }] as const)
                  : []),
                {
                  key: 'SETTINGS',
                  label: canEditSettings ? 'School Profile & Settings' : 'School Profile (View)',
                  icon: <Building2 size={14} />,
                },
                ...(canViewLogs
                  ? ([{ key: 'LOGS', label: 'System Audit Logs', icon: <History size={14} /> }] as const)
                  : []),
                ...(canEditSettings
                  ? ([{ key: 'ALL', label: 'Show All', icon: <Layers size={14} /> }] as const)
                  : []),
              ] as const
            ).map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab.key}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveSubTab(tab.key)}
                style={{
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,

                  fontWeight: 700,
                  fontSize: '0.78rem',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  boxShadow: activeSubTab === tab.key ? tokens.cardShadow : 'none',
                }}
              >
                {tab.icon}
                <span>{tab.label}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {canEditSettings && (activeSubTab === 'MAINTENANCE' || activeSubTab === 'ALL') && (
          <MaintenancePanel
            health={health}
            actionLoading={actionLoading}
            onRefreshDiagnostics={() => void fetchDiagnostics()}
            onRunAction={runMaintenanceAction}
          />
        )}

        {(activeSubTab === 'LOGS' || activeSubTab === 'ALL') && (
          <AuditLogsPanel
            activityLogs={activityLogs}
            logsLoading={logsLoading}
            isAdminUser={isAdminUser}
            logSearch={logSearch}
            logActionFilter={logActionFilter}
            logDateFilter={logDateFilter}
            onLogSearchChange={setLogSearch}
            onLogActionFilterChange={setLogActionFilter}
            onLogDateFilterChange={setLogDateFilter}
            onRefresh={() => void fetchUserActivities()}
            onExportCsv={exportActivityCSV}
          />
        )}

        {(activeSubTab === 'SETTINGS' || activeSubTab === 'ALL') && (
          <SchoolProfileForm
            formData={formData}
            teacherList={teacherList}
            canEditSettings={canEditSettings}
            saving={saving}
            saveSuccess={saveSuccess}
            onChangeFormData={setFormData}
            onMarkLogoDirty={(field) => setFreshLogos((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: true }))}
            onSubmit={handleSave}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SettingsTab;

const sanitizeSearchText = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);

const parseGuardianFields = (name?: string, rel?: string) => {
  const roles = ['MOTHER', 'FATHER', 'AUNT', 'UNCLE', 'GRANDMOTHER', 'GRANDFATHER', 'GUARDIAN'];
  const cleanName = String(name || '').trim();
  const cleanRel = String(rel || '').trim();

  if (roles.includes(cleanName.toUpperCase()) && !roles.includes(cleanRel.toUpperCase())) {
    return { gName: cleanRel, gRel: cleanName };
  }
  return {
    gName: cleanName,
    gRel: cleanRel.toLowerCase() === 'mather' ? 'Mother' : cleanRel,
  };
};

const splitAddressParts = (st: SF1LearnerRow) => {
  const street = st.house_street_sitio || st.house_street || '';
  const brgy = st.barangay || '';
  const city = st.municipality_city || '';
  const prov = st.province || '';

  if (street || brgy || city || prov) {
    return { street, brgy, city, prov };
  }

  const parts = String(st.address || '')
    .split(',')
    .map((p) => p.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

  return {
    street: parts[0] || '',
    brgy: parts[1] || '',
    city: parts[2] || '',
    prov: parts[3] || '',
  };
};

  region?: string;
  division: string;
  district: string;
  academic_year: string;
  grade_level: string;
  section_name: string;
  month: string;
  year: number;
  adviser_name: string;
  school_head: string;
  school_address?: string;
  school_contact?: string;
  school_email?: string;
  left_logo?: string | null;
  right_logo?: string | null;
  school_logo?: string | null;
  school_days: SchoolDay[];
  has_enrolled_students?: boolean;
  males: SF2Learner[];
  females: SF2Learner[];
  metrics: SF2Metrics;
}

export interface SF2ReportTabProps {
  sectionId?: number | string;
  activeReportId?: string;
  onSelectReport?: (reportId: string) => void;
}

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'January',
  'February',
  'March',
  'April',
  'May',
  'June',
  'July',
  'August',
  'September',
  'October',
  'November',
  'December',
];

const PRESENT_STATUSES = new Set(['present', 'late', 'tardy', 'cutting', 'excused']);

const SVG_DIAGONAL_ONLY =
  'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="0" y1="16" x2="24" y2="0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.6"/></svg>'
  );

const SVG_ABSENT =
  'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="0" y1="16" x2="24" y2="0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.6"/><line x1="4" y1="2" x2="20" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="20" y1="2" x2="4" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>'
  );

const SVG_TARDY =
  'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" preserveAspectRatio="none"><polygon points="0,0 24,0 0,16" fill="#000000"/><line x1="0" y1="16" x2="24" y2="0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.75"/></svg>'
  );

const SVG_CUTTING =
  'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" preserveAspectRatio="none"><polygon points="24,0 24,16 0,16" fill="#000000"/><line x1="0" y1="16" x2="24" y2="0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.75"/></svg>'
  );

const AttendanceCell: React.FC<{ status?: string | number | null; isSchoolDay?: boolean }> = ({
  status,
  isSchoolDay = true,
}) => {
  if (!isSchoolDay) {
    return <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '16px', backgroundColor: '#ffffff' }} />;
  }

  const s = String(status ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
  let src = SVG_DIAGONAL_ONLY;
  let alt = 'Present';

  if (s === 'absent' || s === 'x' || s === '1' || s === 'a') {
    src = SVG_ABSENT;
    alt = 'Absent (X)';
  } else if (s === 'tardy' || s === 'late' || s === '2' || s === 't') {
    src = SVG_TARDY;
    alt = 'Late';
  } else if (s === 'cutting' || s === 'cc' || s === '3' || s === 'c') {
    src = SVG_CUTTING;
    alt = 'Cutting Classes';
  }

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: '100%',
        height: '16px',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
      }}
    >
      <img
        src={src}
        alt={alt}
        style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'block', objectFit: 'fill' }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

const sanitizeSearchText = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);

export const SF2ReportTab: React.FC<SF2ReportTabProps> = ({
  sectionId,
  activeReportId = 'sf2',
  onSelectReport,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { school: globalSchool } = useSchool();

  const now = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);
  const yearOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const y = now.getFullYear();
    return [y - 1, y, y + 1];
  }, [now]);

  const cachedSectionsPayload = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.school.sections, { page_size: 250 });
  const initialSections: SectionOption[] = Array.isArray(cachedSectionsPayload)
    ? cachedSectionsPayload
    : cachedSectionsPayload?.results || [];

  const [sections, setSections] = useState<SectionOption[]>(initialSections);
  const [selectedSectionId, setSelectedSectionId] = useState<string>(
    sectionId ? String(sectionId) : initialSections[0] ? String(initialSections[0].id) : ''
  );
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<string>(
    () => MONTH_NAMES[now.getMonth()] || 'October'
  );
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<number>(now.getFullYear());
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');

  const [reportData, setReportData] = useState<SF2ReportData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const reportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const cleanSearch = useMemo(() => sanitizeSearchText(searchQuery).toLowerCase(), [searchQuery]);

  const males = useMemo(() => {
    const list = Array.isArray(reportData?.males) ? reportData!.males : [];
    if (!cleanSearch) return list;
    return list.filter(
      (m) => m.name.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) || m.lrn.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch)
    );
  }, [reportData, cleanSearch]);

  const females = useMemo(() => {
    const list = Array.isArray(reportData?.females) ? reportData!.females : [];
    if (!cleanSearch) return list;
    return list.filter(
      (f) => f.name.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) || f.lrn.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch)
    );
  }, [reportData, cleanSearch]);

  const getBaseFilename = useCallback(() => {
    const secClean = (reportData?.section_name || 'Section').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
    return `DepEd_SF2_${secClean}_${reportData?.month || selectedMonth}_${selectedYear}`;
  }, [reportData?.section_name, reportData?.month, selectedMonth, selectedYear]);

  const buildCsvData = useCallback(() => {
    if (!reportData) return { headers: [] as string[], rows: [] as Array<Array<string | number>> };
    const schoolDaysList = Array.isArray(reportData.school_days) ? reportData.school_days : [];
    const dayHeaders = schoolDaysList.map((d) => `${d.dateNumber} (${d.dayOfWeek})`);
    const headers = ['LRN', 'Learner Name', 'Sex', ...dayHeaders, 'Total Absent', 'Total Tardy', 'Remarks'];

    const rows = [...males, ...females].map((st) => [
      st.lrn,
      st.name,
      st.sex,
      ...schoolDaysList.map((d) => st.attendance?.[d.dateNumber] || ''),
      st.total_absent || 0,
      st.total_tardy || 0,
      st.remarks || '',
    ]);
    return { headers, rows };
  }, [reportData, males, females]);

  const {
    auditMeta,
    isExportingPdf,
    isPrinting,
    pageConfig,
    setPageConfig,
    isPageSetupOpen,
    setIsPageSetupOpen,
    pageWidthInches,
    pageHeightInches,
    stampView,
    handleDirectPrint,
    handleExportPdf,
    handleExportCsv,
    handleExportExcel,
    handleExportWord,
    handleExportJson,
  } = useOfficialReportExport({
    formCode: 'SF2',
    reportData,
    reportRef,
    schoolId: reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id,
    sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    getBaseFilename,
    buildCsvData,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sectionId) {
      setSelectedSectionId(String(sectionId));
    }
  }, [sectionId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.school.sections, {
        params: { page_size: 250 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const list: SectionOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.results || [];
        setSections(list);
        if (list.length > 0) {
          setSelectedSectionId((prev) => prev || String(list[0].id));
        } else {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load class sections.'));
        setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const fetchSF2 = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      if (!selectedSectionId) return;

      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const endpoint = `${API_ROUTES.reports.sf2}${encodeURIComponent(selectedSectionId)}/`;
      const baseParams = { month: selectedMonth, year: selectedYear };
      const warmHit = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<SF2ReportData>(endpoint, baseParams) : undefined;

      if (warmHit) {
        setReportData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<SF2ReportData>(endpoint, {
          params: bypassCache ? { ...baseParams, nocache: 1 } : baseParams,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setReportData(res.data);
        stampView(res.data?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not generate DepEd SF2 Daily Attendance Report.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [selectedSectionId, selectedMonth, selectedYear, globalSchool.school_id, stampView]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchSF2(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchSF2]);

  const dailyAttendanceTotals = useMemo(() => {
    const maxCols = 25;
    const malesCount: number[] = new Array(maxCols).fill(0);
    const femalesCount: number[] = new Array(maxCols).fill(0);
    const combinedCount: number[] = new Array(maxCols).fill(0);

    if (!reportData?.school_days) {
      return { males: malesCount, females: femalesCount, combined: combinedCount };
    }

    reportData.school_days.forEach((day, idx) => {
      if (idx >= maxCols) return;
      let mPresent = 0;
      let fPresent = 0;

      males.forEach((m) => {
        const st = String(m.attendance?.[day.dateNumber] ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (PRESENT_STATUSES.has(st)) mPresent++;
      });

      females.forEach((f) => {
        const st = String(f.attendance?.[day.dateNumber] ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (PRESENT_STATUSES.has(st)) fPresent++;
      });

      malesCount[idx] = mPresent;
      femalesCount[idx] = fPresent;
      combinedCount[idx] = mPresent + fPresent;
    });

    return { males: malesCount, females: femalesCount, combined: combinedCount };
  }, [reportData, males, females]);

  const fitsOnSinglePage = useMemo(() => {
    if (pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless') return true;
    const printableHeight =
      pageHeightInches - (pageConfig.margins.top || 0.25) - (pageConfig.margins.bottom || 0.25);
    const totalRows = males.length + females.length;
    return 5.4 + totalRows * 0.17 <= printableHeight;
  }, [pageConfig, males.length, females.length, pageHeightInches]);

  const schoolDays = Array.isArray(reportData?.school_days) ? reportData!.school_days : [];
  const isListEmpty = males.length === 0 && females.length === 0;
  const schoolHead = reportData?.school_head || globalSchool.principal_name || '';

  const renderTableHeader = () => (
    <thead>

          REMARK/S (If DROPPED OUT, state reason; if TRANSFERRED IN/OUT, write name of School)

      <tr>
        {Array.from({ length: 25 }).map((_, i) => {

          );

        <th style={{ width: '2.75%', ...thCell, fontSize: '4.5pt' }}>ABSENT</th>
        <th style={{ width: '2.75%', ...thCell, fontSize: '4.5pt' }}>TARDY</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
  );

  const renderSummaryFooter = () => {
    const m = reportData?.metrics;
    return (
      <div style={{ marginTop: 8, width: '100%' }}>
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'grid',
            gridTemplateColumns: '38% 34% 26%',

            alignItems: 'start',
            fontSize: '5.5pt',
            lineHeight: 1.18,

          <div style={{ border: '1px solid #000', padding: '4px 6px' }}>

              <strong>b. Average Daily Attendance = </strong> Total Daily Attendance / Number of School Days in month
            </div>
            <div style={{ paddingLeft: 6 }}>
              <strong>c. % of Attendance = </strong> (Average daily attendance / Registered Learners end of month) x 100
            </div>
            <div style={{ marginTop: 3 }}>
              <strong>CODES FOR CHECKING ATTENDANCE:</strong><br />
              <strong>blank</strong> - Present; <strong>(X)</strong> - Absent; <strong>Tardy</strong> (Upper shaded = Late Comer, Lower shaded = Cutting Classes)

          <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', border: '1px solid #000', fontSize: '5.4pt' }}>

  };

  const sheetBaseStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    backgroundColor: pageConfig.pageColor || '#ffffff',
    color: '#000000',
    width: isPrinting ? '100%' : `${pageWidthInches}in`,

  district: string;
  school_year: string;
  month: string;
  year: number;
  school_head: string;
  school_address?: string;
  school_contact?: string;
  school_email?: string;
  left_logo?: string | null;
  right_logo?: string | null;
  school_logo?: string | null;
  grade_groups: SF4GradeGroup[];
  non_graded_summary: SF4SectionRecord | null;
  total_summary: SF4SectionRecord;
}

interface SF4PageChunk {
  pageNumber: number;
  totalPages: number;
  groups: SF4GradeGroup[];
  isFinalPage: boolean;
}

export interface SF4ReportTabProps {
  activeReportId?: string;
  onSelectReport?: (reportId: string) => void;
}

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'January',
  'February',
  'March',
  'April',
  'May',
  'June',
  'July',
  'August',
  'September',
  'October',
  'November',
  'December',
];

const getDynamicSchoolYear = (): string => {
  const now = new Date();
  const y = now.getFullYear();
  return now.getMonth() >= 5 ? `${y}-${y + 1}` : `${y - 1}-${y}`;
};

const sanitizeSearchText = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);

export const SF4ReportTab: React.FC<SF4ReportTabProps> = ({
  activeReportId = 'sf4',
  onSelectReport,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { school: globalSchool } = useSchool();

  const now = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);
  const yearOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const cur = now.getFullYear();
    return [cur - 1, cur, cur + 1];
  }, [now]);

  const [schoolYearOptions, setSchoolYearOptions] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedAcademicYear, setSelectedAcademicYear] = useState<string>(
    () => globalSchool.academic_year || getDynamicSchoolYear()
  );
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<string>(
    () => MONTH_NAMES[now.getMonth()] || 'October'
  );
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<number>(now.getFullYear());
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');

  const [reportData, setReportData] = useState<SF4ReportData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const reportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const filteredGradeGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const groups = Array.isArray(reportData?.grade_groups) ? reportData!.grade_groups : [];
    const q = sanitizeSearchText(searchQuery).toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return groups;

    return groups
      .map((g) => ({
        ...g,
        sections: (g.sections || []).filter(
          (s) =>
            s.section_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            s.adviser_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            s.grade_level.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        ),
      }))
      .filter((g) => g.sections.length > 0 || g.grade_level.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [reportData, searchQuery]);

  const getBaseFilename = useCallback(
    () => `DepEd_SF4_${reportData?.month || selectedMonth}_${selectedYear}`,
    [reportData?.month, selectedMonth, selectedYear]
  );

  const buildCsvData = useCallback(() => {
    if (!reportData) return { headers: [] as string[], rows: [] as Array<Array<string | number>> };
    const headers = [
      'Name of Adviser',
      'Grade Level',
      'Section',
      'Registered End M',
      'Registered End F',
      'Registered End T',
      'Daily Avg M',
      'Daily Avg F',
      'Daily Avg T',
      'Attendance % M',
      'Attendance % F',
      'Attendance % T',
      'Dropped Out Cum T',
      'Transferred Out Cum T',
      'Transferred In Cum T',
    ];
    const rows: Array<Array<string | number>> = [];
    filteredGradeGroups.forEach((grp) => {
      grp.sections.forEach((s) => {
        rows.push([
          s.adviser_name,
          s.grade_level,
          s.section_name,
          s.registered_end.m,
          s.registered_end.f,
          s.registered_end.total,
          s.daily_average.m,
          s.daily_average.f,
          s.daily_average.total,
          s.attendance_percentage.m,
          s.attendance_percentage.f,
          s.attendance_percentage.total,
          s.dropped_out_cumulative.total,
          s.transferred_out_cumulative.total,
          s.transferred_in_cumulative.total,
        ]);
      });
    });
    return { headers, rows };
  }, [reportData, filteredGradeGroups]);

  const {
    auditMeta,
    isExportingPdf,
    isPrinting,
    pageConfig,
    setPageConfig,
    isPageSetupOpen,
    setIsPageSetupOpen,
    pageWidthInches,
    pageHeightInches,
    stampView,
    handleDirectPrint,
    handleExportPdf,
    handleExportCsv,
    handleExportExcel,
    handleExportWord,
    handleExportJson,
  } = useOfficialReportExport({
    formCode: 'SF4',
    reportData,
    reportRef,
    schoolId: reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id,
    getBaseFilename,
    buildCsvData,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.school.schoolYears, { signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const list = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.results || [];
        const codes = list
          .map((item: any) => (typeof item === 'string' ? item : item?.code || item?.name || ''))
          .filter(Boolean);
        setSchoolYearOptions(codes);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  const availableSchoolYears = useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.from(
        new Set(
          [
            ...schoolYearOptions,
            reportData?.school_year,
            globalSchool.academic_year,
            selectedAcademicYear,
            getDynamicSchoolYear(),
          ].filter(Boolean)
        )
      ) as string[],
    [schoolYearOptions, reportData?.school_year, globalSchool.academic_year, selectedAcademicYear]
  );

  const fetchSF4 = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const baseParams = {
        month: selectedMonth,
        year: selectedYear,
        school_year: selectedAcademicYear,
      };
      const warmHit = !bypassCache
        ? peekApiCache<SF4ReportData>(API_ROUTES.reports.sf4, baseParams)
        : undefined;

      if (warmHit) {
        setReportData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<SF4ReportData>(API_ROUTES.reports.sf4, {
          params: bypassCache ? { ...baseParams, nocache: 1 } : baseParams,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setReportData(res.data);
        stampView(res.data?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load DepEd SF4 School Summary Report.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [selectedMonth, selectedYear, selectedAcademicYear, globalSchool.school_id, stampView]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchSF4(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchSF4]);

  const paginatedPages = useMemo<SF4PageChunk[]>(() => {
    if (pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless' || filteredGradeGroups.length === 0) {
      return [{ pageNumber: 1, totalPages: 1, groups: filteredGradeGroups, isFinalPage: true }];
    }

    const printableHeight = Math.max(
      3.5,
      pageHeightInches - (pageConfig.margins.top || 0.25) - (pageConfig.margins.bottom || 0.25)
    );
    const rowH = 0.22;
    const totalRows = filteredGradeGroups.reduce(
      (acc, g) => acc + (g.sections.length > 0 ? g.sections.length + 1 : 1),
      3
    );

    if (totalRows * rowH + 3.6 <= printableHeight) {
      return [{ pageNumber: 1, totalPages: 1, groups: filteredGradeGroups, isFinalPage: true }];
    }

    const rawPages: Array<{ groups: SF4GradeGroup[] }> = [];
    let currentGroups: SF4GradeGroup[] = [];
    let currentRows = 0;

    filteredGradeGroups.forEach((grp) => {
      const grpRows = grp.sections.length > 0 ? grp.sections.length + 1 : 1;
      const cap = rawPages.length === 0 ? 18 : 26;
      if (currentRows + grpRows <= cap || currentGroups.length === 0) {
        currentGroups.push(grp);
        currentRows += grpRows;
      } else {
        rawPages.push({ groups: currentGroups });
        currentGroups = [grp];
        currentRows = grpRows;
      }
    });

    if (currentGroups.length > 0) {
      rawPages.push({ groups: currentGroups });
    }

    const total = rawPages.length;
    return rawPages.map((p, idx) => ({
      pageNumber: idx + 1,
      totalPages: total,
      groups: p.groups,
      isFinalPage: idx === total - 1,
    }));
  }, [filteredGradeGroups, pageConfig, pageHeightInches]);

  const renderTripletCells = (triplet?: MetricTriplet) => (
    <>
      <td style={tdNum}>{triplet ? triplet.m : 0}</td>
      <td style={tdNum}>{triplet ? triplet.f : 0}</td>
      <td style={tdNumBold}>{triplet ? triplet.total : 0}</td>
    </>
  );

  const renderSectionMetricCols = (rec?: SF4SectionRecord | null) => (
    <>
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.registered_end)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.daily_average)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.attendance_percentage)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.dropped_out_prev)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.dropped_out_month)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.dropped_out_cumulative)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.transferred_out_prev)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.transferred_out_month)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.transferred_out_cumulative)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.transferred_in_prev)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.transferred_in_month)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.transferred_in_cumulative)}
    </>
  );

  const schoolName = reportData?.school_name || globalSchool.school_name || '';
  const schoolId = reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id || '';
  const schoolHead = reportData?.school_head || globalSchool.principal_name || '';

  return (
    <div
      className="report-tab-root"
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        width: '100%',
        height: '100%',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgApp,
      }}
    >
      <div className="no-print">
        <ReportHeaderBar
          activeReportId={activeReportId}
          onSelectReport={onSelectReport}
          documentTitle={
            reportData
              ? `SF4_Movement_Attendance_${reportData.month}_${reportData.year}`
              : 'DepEd_SF4_Monthly_Movement'
          }
          subtitle="Official DepEd School Form 4 (SF4) Monthly Learner's Movement and Attendance"
          isSavingPdf={isExportingPdf}
          onOpenPageSetup={() => setIsPageSetupOpen(true)}
          onPrint={handleDirectPrint}
          onSavePdf={() => void handleExportPdf(false)}
          onSavePdfAs={() => void handleExportPdf(true)}
          onDownloadExcel={() => void handleExportExcel(false)}
          onSaveExcelAs={() => void handleExportExcel(true)}
          onDownloadCsv={() => void handleExportCsv(false)}
          onSaveCsvAs={() => void handleExportCsv(true)}
          onDownloadWord={() => void handleExportWord(false)}
          onSaveWordAs={() => void handleExportWord(true)}
          onDownloadJson={() => void handleExportJson(false)}
          onSaveJsonAs={() => void handleExportJson(true)}
        />
      </div>

      <ReportViewerShell
        loading={loading}
        loadingMessage="Consolidating Official DepEd SF4 Summary..."
        error={error}
        hasData={Boolean(reportData)}
        isPrinting={isPrinting}
        isExportingPdf={isExportingPdf}
        pageWidthInches={pageWidthInches}
        pageHeightInches={pageHeightInches}
        pageConfig={pageConfig}
        sheetClassName="sf4-sheet-page"
        documentId="sf4-official-document"
        reportRef={reportRef}
        leftToolbarContent={
          <>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>SY:</span>
              <select
                aria-label="Select School Year"
                value={selectedAcademicYear}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedAcademicYear(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  padding: '5px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                }}
              >
                {availableSchoolYears.map((sy) => (
                  <option key={sy} value={sy}>
                    {sy}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <Calendar size={15} color={brand.primary} />
              <select
                aria-label="Select Month"
                value={selectedMonth}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedMonth(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  padding: '5px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                }}
              >
                {MONTH_NAMES.map((m) => (
                  <option key={m} value={m}>
                    {m}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>

              <select
                aria-label="Select Year"
                value={selectedYear}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedYear(Number(e.target.value))}
                style={{
                  padding: '5px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                }}
              >
                {yearOptions.map((y) => (
                  <option key={y} value={y}>
                    {y}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '4px 10px',
                borderRadius: 6,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput,
              }}
            >
              <Search size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} />
              <input
                type="text"
                maxLength={80}
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search section or adviser..."
                style={{
                  border: 'none',
                  outline: 'none',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  fontSize: '0.78rem',
                  width: 155,
                }}
              />
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void fetchSF4(true, true)}
              disabled={loading || refreshing}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '5px 10px',
                borderRadius: 6,
                fontSize: '0.76rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
              }}
            >
              <RefreshCw size={13} className={refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
              <span>Refresh</span>
            </button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {reportData &&
          paginatedPages.map((page) => (
            <div
              key={`sf4-page-${page.pageNumber}`}
              className="sf4-sheet-page"
              data-print-page="true"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: pageConfig.pageColor || '#ffffff',
                color: '#000000',
                width: isPrinting ? '100%' : `${pageWidthInches}in`,
                minHeight:
                  pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless'
                    ? 'auto'
                    : isExportingPdf
                      ? `${Math.max(1, pageHeightInches - 0.08)}in`
                      : `${pageHeightInches}in`,
                paddingTop: `${pageConfig.margins.top}in`,
                paddingRight: `${pageConfig.margins.right}in`,
                paddingBottom: `${pageConfig.margins.bottom}in`,
                paddingLeft: `${pageConfig.margins.left}in`,
                marginBottom: isPrinting || page.isFinalPage ? 0 : '20px',
                boxShadow: isPrinting ? 'none' : '0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22)',
                border: isPrinting ? 'none' : '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                boxSizing: 'border-box',
                fontFamily: 'Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
              }}
            >
              <div>
                {page.pageNumber === 1 ? (
                  <DepEdReportHeader
                    formTitle="School Form 4 (SF 4) Monthly Learner's Movement and Attendance"
                    formSubtitle="(Consolidated Learner Movement and Monthly Attendance Summary)"
                    formType="SF4"
                    reportData={reportData}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <div
                    style={{
                      display: 'flex',
                      justifyContent: 'space-between',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      borderBottom: '1.5px solid #000',
                      paddingBottom: 4,
                      marginBottom: 6,
                      fontSize: '7.5pt',
                      fontWeight: 700,
                    }}
                  >
                    <span>
                      School Form 4 (SF4) — {schoolName} ({schoolId})
                    </span>
                    <span>
                      {reportData.month} {reportData.year} | SY {reportData.school_year} (Page {page.pageNumber} of {page.totalPages})
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}

                <table style={sf4Table}>
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th rowSpan={3} style={{ ...thCell, width: '9.0%' }}>NAME OF ADVISER</th>
                      <th rowSpan={3} style={{ ...thCell, width: '6.8%' }}>GRADE/<br />YEAR<br />LEVEL</th>
                      <th rowSpan={3} style={{ ...thCell, width: '6.6%' }}>SECTION</th>
                      <th colSpan={3} rowSpan={2} style={thCell}>
                        REGISTERED LEARNER<br />
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '4.6pt', fontWeight: 400 }}>(As of End of Month)</span>
                      </th>
                      <th colSpan={6} style={thCell}>ATTENDANCE</th>
                      <th colSpan={9} style={thCell}>DROPPED OUT</th>
                      <th colSpan={9} style={thCell}>TRANSFERRED OUT</th>
                      <th colSpan={9} style={thCell}>TRANSFERRED IN</th>
                    </tr>
                    <tr>
                      <th colSpan={3} style={thSubGroup}>Daily Average</th>
                      <th colSpan={3} style={thSubGroup}>Percentage for Month</th>
                      <th colSpan={3} style={thSubGroup}>(A) Prev Month</th>
                      <th colSpan={3} style={thSubGroup}>(B) For Month</th>
                      <th colSpan={3} style={thSubGroup}>(A+B) Cumulative</th>
                      <th colSpan={3} style={thSubGroup}>(A) Prev Month</th>
                      <th colSpan={3} style={thSubGroup}>(B) For Month</th>
                      <th colSpan={3} style={thSubGroup}>(A+B) Cumulative</th>
                      <th colSpan={3} style={thSubGroup}>(A) Prev Month</th>
                      <th colSpan={3} style={thSubGroup}>(B) For Month</th>
                      <th colSpan={3} style={thSubGroup}>(A+B) Cumulative</th>
                    </tr>
                    <tr>
                      {Array.from({ length: 12 }).map((_, idx) => (
                        <React.Fragment key={`mft-${idx}`}>
                          <th style={thMFT}>M</th>
                          <th style={thMFT}>F</th>
                          <th style={thMFT}>T</th>
                        </React.Fragment>
                      ))}
                    </tr>
                  </thead>

                  <tbody>
                    <tr style={{ backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', fontWeight: 800 }}>
                      <td colSpan={39} style={{ ...tdText, paddingLeft: 6 }}>
                        ELEMENTARY / SECONDARY:
                      </td>
                    </tr>

                    {page.groups.map((grp) => (
                      <React.Fragment key={`grp-${grp.grade_level}`}>
                        {grp.sections && grp.sections.length > 0 ? (
                          <>
                            {grp.sections.map((sec) => (
                              <tr key={`sec-${sec.section_id}`}>
                                <td style={tdText}>{sec.adviser_name}</td>
                                <td style={{ ...tdText, fontWeight: 700 }}>{sec.grade_level}</td>
                                <td style={tdText}>{sec.section_name}</td>
                                {renderSectionMetricCols(sec)}
                              </tr>
                            ))}
                            <tr style={{ backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', fontWeight: 800 }}>
                              <td colSpan={3} style={{ ...tdText, fontWeight: 800 }}>
                                TOTAL FOR {grp.grade_level.toUpperCase()}
                              </td>
                              {renderSectionMetricCols(grp.subtotal)}
                            </tr>
                          </>
                        ) : (
                          <tr>
                            <td style={tdText}></td>
                            <td style={{ ...tdText, fontWeight: 700 }}>{grp.grade_level}</td>
                            <td style={tdText}></td>
                            {renderSectionMetricCols(grp.subtotal)}
                          </tr>
                        )}
                      </React.Fragment>
                    ))}

                    {page.isFinalPage && reportData.non_graded_summary && (
                      <tr style={{ backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', fontWeight: 800 }}>
                        <td colSpan={3} style={{ ...tdText, fontWeight: 800 }}>TOTAL FOR NON-GRADED</td>
                        {renderSectionMetricCols(reportData.non_graded_summary)}
                      </tr>
                    )}

                    {page.isFinalPage && reportData.total_summary && (
                      <tr style={{ backgroundColor: '#e2e8f0', fontWeight: 900 }}>
                        <td colSpan={3} style={{ ...tdText, fontWeight: 900 }}>TOTAL</td>
                        {renderSectionMetricCols(reportData.total_summary)}
                      </tr>
                    )}
                  </tbody>

type ModalFormTab = 'BASIC' | 'ADDRESS' | 'GUARDIAN' | 'DEPED';

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 150): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const maskQrToken = (token?: string): string => {
  const clean = String(token || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return '';
  return clean.length <= 4 ? 'Linked' : `••••${clean.slice(-4)}`;
};
