      setCurrentPage(1);
    } catch (err) {
      setImportError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not import CSV class list.'));
    } finally {
      setImportingCsv(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExportCsv = async () => {
    setIsExporting(true);
    try {
      const params: Record<string, string | number> = { page_size: 'ALL' };
      if (debouncedSearch) params.search = debouncedSearch;
      if (selectedSectionFilter !== 'ALL') params.section_id = selectedSectionFilter;

      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.students.list, { params });
      const list: Student[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.results || [];

      exportToCsv(
        `AttendSure_Students_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`,
        [
          'LRN',
          'Full Name',
          'Sex',
          'Birthdate',
          'Class Section',
          'QR Card Status',
          'Guardian Contact',
          'Father Name',
          'Mother Maiden Name',
          'Barangay',
          'Municipality / City',
          'Status',
        ],
        list.map((s) => [
          s.lrn,
          s.full_name || `${s.last_name}, ${s.first_name}`,
          s.sex || '',
          s.birthdate || '',
          s.current_section || 'Unassigned',
          s.qr_token ? 'Linked' : 'Not Linked',
          s.guardian_contact || '',
          s.father_name || '',
          s.mother_maiden_name || '',
          s.barangay || '',
          s.municipality_city || '',
          s.is_active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE',
        ])
      );
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Export Failed', message: extractApiError(err), type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingStudent(null);
    setFormError(null);
    setPhotoRemoved(false);
    setFormTab('BASIC');
    const defaultAdvisedSec =
      !isExecutive && advisedSectionIds.length > 0
        ? sections.find((s) => advisedSectionIds.includes(s.id))
        : undefined;
    const defaultGl =
      defaultAdvisedSec && typeof defaultAdvisedSec.grade_level === 'object' && defaultAdvisedSec.grade_level !== null
        ? defaultAdvisedSec.grade_level.id
        : defaultAdvisedSec?.grade_level;
    setFormData({
      lrn: '',
      first_name: '',
      middle_name: '',
      last_name: '',
      suffix: '',
      sex: 'Male',
      birthdate: '2012-01-01',
      grade_level_id: defaultGl ? String(defaultGl) : gradeLevels[0] ? String(gradeLevels[0].id) : '',
      section_id: defaultAdvisedSec ? String(defaultAdvisedSec.id) : '',
      enrollment_status: 'ENROLLED',
      qr_token: '',
      photo: null,
      house_street_sitio: '',
      barangay: '',
      municipality_city: '',
      province: '',
      father_name: '',
      mother_maiden_name: '',
      guardian_name: '',
      guardian_relationship: 'Mother',
      guardian_contact: '',
      mother_tongue: '',
      ethnic_group: '',
      religion: '',
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (st: Student) => {
    setEditingStudent(st);
    setFormError(null);
    setPhotoRemoved(false);
    setFormTab('BASIC');

    const exactSecId = st.current_section_id ?? st.section_id;
    const matchedSec =
      (exactSecId ? sections.find((s) => s.id === exactSecId) : undefined) ||
      sections.find((s) => s.name === st.current_section);
    const glVal =
      matchedSec && typeof matchedSec.grade_level === 'object' && matchedSec.grade_level !== null
        ? matchedSec.grade_level.id
        : matchedSec?.grade_level;

    setFormData({
      lrn: st.lrn || '',
      first_name: st.first_name || '',
      middle_name: st.middle_name || '',
      last_name: st.last_name || '',
      suffix: st.suffix || '',
      sex: st.sex === 'Female' || st.sex === 'F' ? 'Female' : 'Male',
      birthdate: st.birthdate || '2012-01-01',
      grade_level_id: glVal ? String(glVal) : gradeLevels[0] ? String(gradeLevels[0].id) : '',
      section_id: exactSecId ? String(exactSecId) : matchedSec ? String(matchedSec.id) : '',
      enrollment_status: st.enrollment_status || 'ENROLLED',
      qr_token: '',
      photo: isSafeImageUrl(st.photo_url || st.photo) ? st.photo_url || st.photo || null : null,
      house_street_sitio: st.house_street_sitio || '',
      barangay: st.barangay || '',
      municipality_city: st.municipality_city || '',
      province: st.province || '',
      father_name: st.father_name || '',
      mother_maiden_name: st.mother_maiden_name || '',
      guardian_name: st.guardian_name || '',
      guardian_relationship: st.guardian_relationship || 'Mother',
      guardian_contact: st.guardian_contact || '',
      mother_tongue: st.mother_tongue || '',
      ethnic_group: st.ethnic_group || '',
      religion: st.religion || '',
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFormError(null);

    if (formData.lrn.trim().length !== 12) {
      setFormError('LRN must be 12 digits.');
      setFormTab('BASIC');
      return;
    }
    if (lrnCheck.is_taken) {
      setFormError(lrnCheck.message || 'This 12-digit LRN is already registered to another student.');
      setFormTab('BASIC');
      return;
    }
    if (!formData.first_name.trim() || !formData.last_name.trim()) {
      setFormError('First name and last name are required.');
      setFormTab('BASIC');
      return;
    }
    if (!formData.section_id) {
      setFormError('Please select a class section.');
      setFormTab('BASIC');
      return;
    }

    const cleanGuardianPhone = formData.guardian_contact.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
    if (!cleanGuardianPhone) {
      setFormError('Guardian contact number is required in the "3. Guardian" tab.');
      setFormTab('GUARDIAN');
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
        lrn: formData.lrn.trim(),
        first_name: sanitizeInput(formData.first_name, 100),
        middle_name: sanitizeInput(formData.middle_name, 100),
        last_name: sanitizeInput(formData.last_name, 100),
        suffix: sanitizeInput(formData.suffix, 20),
        gender: formData.sex,
        birth_date: formData.birthdate,
        mother_tongue: sanitizeInput(formData.mother_tongue, 80),
        ethnic_group: sanitizeInput(formData.ethnic_group, 80),
        religion: sanitizeInput(formData.religion, 80),
        house_street_sitio: sanitizeInput(formData.house_street_sitio, 150),
        barangay: sanitizeInput(formData.barangay, 100),
        municipality_city: sanitizeInput(formData.municipality_city, 100),
        province: sanitizeInput(formData.province, 100),
        father_name: sanitizeInput(formData.father_name, 150),
        mother_maiden_name: sanitizeInput(formData.mother_maiden_name, 150),
        guardian_name: sanitizeInput(formData.guardian_name, 150),
        guardian_relationship: sanitizeInput(formData.guardian_relationship, 60),
        guardian_contact: sanitizeInput(cleanGuardianPhone, 20),
        section_id: Number(formData.section_id),
        enrollment_status: formData.enrollment_status,
      };

      if (formData.photo && formData.photo.startsWith('data:image/') && isSafeImageUrl(formData.photo)) {
        payload.photo = formData.photo;
      } else if (photoRemoved && editingStudent) {
        payload.photo = null;
        payload.remove_photo = true;
      }

      if (editingStudent) {
        await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.students.list}${editingStudent.id}/`, payload);
        showAlert({ title: 'Student Updated', message: 'Student profile saved.', type: 'success' });
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.students.list, payload);
        showAlert({ title: 'Student Enrolled', message: 'New student enrolled successfully.', type: 'success' });
      }

      setIsModalOpen(false);
      await loadMetrics(true);
      await loadStudents(currentPage, pageSize, false, true);
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(extractApiError(err, 'Failed to save student record.'));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = (st: Student) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Student Record',
      message: `Permanently delete ${st.full_name} (LRN: ${st.lrn})?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete Student',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${API_ROUTES.students.list}${st.id}/`);
          showAlert({ title: 'Student Removed', message: `${st.full_name} was removed from the class list.`, type: 'info' });
          await loadMetrics(true);
          await loadStudents(currentPage, pageSize, true, true);
        } catch (err) {
          showAlert({ title: 'Delete Failed', message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not delete student record.'), type: 'error' });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const totalPages = pageSize >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE ? 1 : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalCount / pageSize));
  const activeSchoolName = school.school_name || 'Official Student Pass';

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 210px), 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
        <StatsCard
          label="REGISTERED STUDENTS"
          value={metrics.total.toLocaleString()}
          helpText="Students in your accessible scope"
          badge={<GraduationCap size={18} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="ACTIVE CLASS LIST"
          value={metrics.active.toLocaleString()}
          valueColor={brand.success}
          helpText="Cleared for classroom QR scanning"
          badge={<User size={18} color={brand.success} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="QR CARDS LINKED"
          value={`${metrics.paired.toLocaleString()} / ${metrics.active.toLocaleString()}`}
          valueColor={brand.primary}
          helpText="Active signed QR tokens"
          badge={<CreditCard size={18} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="CLASS SECTIONS"
          value={metrics.total_sections.toLocaleString()}
          valueColor={brand.secondary}
          helpText="Assigned active sections"
          badge={<BookOpen size={18} color={brand.secondary} />}
        />
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          ...ui.card,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '12px 16px',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <select
            aria-label="Filter by class section"
            value={selectedSectionFilter}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setSelectedSectionFilter(e.target.value);
              setCurrentPage(1);
            }}
            style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', minWidth: 220, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer' }}
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Class Sections</option>
            {sections.map((sec) => (
              <option key={sec.id} value={sec.id}>
                {sec.grade_level_name ? `${sec.grade_level_name} - ` : ''}
                {sec.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: 250 }}>
            <Search
              size={14}
              color={tokens.textMuted}
              style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 10, top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)' }}
            />
            <input
              type="text"
              maxLength={60}
              placeholder="Search student name or LRN..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              style={{ ...ui.input, paddingLeft: 32 }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {selectedStudentIds.length > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSelectedStudentIds([])}
              style={{
                ...ui.btnSecondary,
                backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                borderColor: brand.primary,
                color: brand.primary,
              }}
            >
              <span>{selectedStudentIds.length} Selected &times; Clear</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsPrintModalOpen(true)}
            disabled={totalCount === 0}
            style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, borderColor: brand.primary, color: brand.primary }}
          >
            <Printer size={14} color={brand.primary} />
            <span>
              {selectedStudentIds.length > 0
                ? `Print Class List & QR (${selectedStudentIds.length})`
                : 'Print / Export Class List & QR'}
            </span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleExportCsv}
            disabled={isExporting || totalCount === 0}
            style={ui.btnSecondary}
          >
            {isExporting ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Download size={14} />}
            <span>Export CSV ({totalCount.toLocaleString()})</span>
          </button>

          {canBulkImport && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleOpenCsvImport}
              style={ui.btnSecondary}
            >
              <Upload size={14} color={brand.primary} />
              <span>Import CSV Class List</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {canAddStudent && (
            <button type="button" onClick={handleOpenCreate} style={ui.btnPrimary}>
              <Plus size={15} />
              <span>Add Student</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        {error && (
          <div
            style={{
              ...ui.subtleBox,
              margin: 14,
              backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
              borderColor: brand.danger,
              color: brand.danger,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 8,
              fontWeight: 600,
            }}
          >
            <AlertCircle size={16} />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {loading ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            <Loader2 size={26} className="animate-spin" color={brand.primary} style={{ margin: '0 auto 8px', display: 'block' }} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, fontWeight: 600 }}>Loading student records...</span>
          </div>
        ) : students.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            <User size={36} style={{ margin: '0 auto 8px', display: 'block' }} />
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>No Students Found</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, marginTop: 2 }}>No student records match your current filter.</div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
            <table style={{ width: '100%', minWidth: 740, borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left' }}>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th style={{ ...ui.th, width: 38, textAlign: 'center' }}>
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      aria-label="Select all students on this page"
                      checked={
                        students.length > 0 &&
                        students.every((row) => selectedStudentIds.includes(row.id))
                      }
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const pageIds = students.map((row) => row.id);
                        if (e.target.checked) {
                          setSelectedStudentIds((prev) => Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...pageIds])));
                        } else {
                          setSelectedStudentIds((prev) => prev.filter((id) => !pageIds.includes(id)));
                        }
                      }}
                      style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
                    />
                  </th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Student</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>LRN</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Class Section</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>QR ID Card</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Guardian Contact</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Status</th>
                  <th style={{ ...ui.th, textAlign: 'right' }}>Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {students.map((row) => {
                  const fullName = row.full_name || `${row.first_name} ${row.last_name}`;
                  return (
                    <tr key={row.id}>
                      <td style={{ ...ui.td, textAlign: 'center' }}>
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          aria-label={`Select ${fullName}`}
                          checked={selectedStudentIds.includes(row.id)}
                          onChange={() => toggleStudentSelection(row.id)}
                          style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
                        />
                      </td>
                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                          <ProfileAvatar photoUrl={row.photo_url || row.photo} name={fullName} size={36} iconSize={17} />
                          <div>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{fullName}</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                              {row.sex}
                              {row.grade_level_name ? ` • ${row.grade_level_name}` : ''}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div
                          style={{
                            display: 'inline-flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 6,
                            padding: '3px 8px',
                            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            borderStyle: 'solid',
                            borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
                            borderRadius: 6,
                            fontFamily: fonts.mono,
                            fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
                            fontWeight: 700,
                          }}
                        >
                          <span>{row.lrn}</span>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleCopy(row.lrn)}
                            title="Copy LRN"
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0, display: 'flex' }}
                          >
                            {copiedValue === row.lrn ? (
                              <Check size={12} color={brand.success} />
                            ) : (
                              <Copy size={12} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                            )}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                          <BookOpen size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                          <span>{row.current_section || 'Unassigned'}</span>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        {row.qr_token ? (
                          <span
                            style={{
                              display: 'inline-flex',
                              alignItems: 'center',
                              gap: 5,
                              fontWeight: 700,
                              color: brand.success,
                              fontFamily: fonts.mono,
                              fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
                            }}
                          >
                            <CreditCard size={13} /> {maskQrToken(row.qr_token)}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: fonts.size.sm }}>
                            <CreditCard size={13} /> Not Linked
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, fontSize: fonts.size.sm, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                          <Phone size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} /> {row.guardian_contact || '—'}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <StatusBadge
                          status={row.enrollment_status || (row.is_active ? 'ENROLLED' : 'INACTIVE')}
                        />
                      </td>

                      <td style={{ ...ui.td, textAlign: 'right' }}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: 6 }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setBadgeStudent(row)}
                            title="View / Print Student QR ID"
                            style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, padding: '6px 8px' }}
                          >
                            <QrCode size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                          </button>

                          {canEditStudentRow(row) && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(row)}
                              title="Edit Student"
                              style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, padding: '6px 8px' }}
                            >
                              <Pencil size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                            </button>
                          )}

                          {canDeleteStudent && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleDelete(row)}
                              title="Delete Student"
                              style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, padding: '6px 8px', color: brand.danger }}
                            >
                              <Trash2 size={14} />
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        <Pagination
          currentPage={currentPage}
          totalPages={totalPages}
          totalCount={totalCount}
          pageSize={pageSize}
          onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
          onPageSizeChange={(nextSize) => {
            setPageSize(nextSize);
            setCurrentPage(1);
          }}
          itemLabel="students"
          style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Bulk CSV Class List Import Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isImportModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsImportModalOpen(false)}
        title="Bulk Import CSV Class List"
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleRunCsvImport} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              ...ui.subtleBox,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
              gap: 10,
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
              <FileSpreadsheet size={20} color={brand.primary} />
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  2-Minute School Onboarding
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                  Upload up to 2,000 students at once (.csv, max 5 MB). Signed QR IDs generate automatically.
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleDownloadCsvTemplate}
              style={ui.btnSecondary}
            >
              <Download size={13} />
              <span>Download Sample CSV Template</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {importError && (
            <div
              style={{
                ...ui.subtleBox,
                backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
                borderColor: brand.danger,

    ],
  },
  {

];

const DEFAULT_DEPARTMENTS = STAFF_DEPARTMENTS_LIST;

const INITIAL_FORM_DATA: TeacherFormState = {
  employee_id: '',
  first_name: '',
  middle_name: '',
  last_name: '',
  suffix: '',
  position: 'Teacher I',
  department: 'Junior High School',
  contact_number: '',
  email: '',
  can_handle_classes: true,
  is_active: true,
  photo: null,
};

const cleanInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 120): string => {
  const stripped = String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '')
    .replace(/[<>]/g, '');
  return sanitizeText(stripped, maxLength);
};

const getSafeAvatarUrl = (teacher: Pick<Teacher, 'photo_url' | 'photo'>): string | null => {
  const candidate = teacher.photo_url || teacher.photo || null;
  return isSafeImageUrl(candidate) ? candidate : null;
};

const getInitials = (name: string): string => {
  const words = cleanInput(name, 80)
    .replace(/,/g, ' ')
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length >= 2) return `${words[0][0]}${words[1][0]}`.toUpperCase();
  return (words[0] || 'T').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
};

const getUserScopedCacheKey = (): string => {
  const scope = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user_id') || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') || 'default';
  return `${CACHE_STORAGE_KEY}_${scope}`;
};

const readCachedTeacherList = (): { items: Teacher[]; count: number } | null => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(getUserScopedCacheKey());
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { items?: Teacher[]; count?: number };
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed.items)) return null;
    return {
      items: parsed.items,
      count: typeof parsed.count === 'number' ? parsed.count : parsed.items.length,
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

const writeCachedTeacherList = (items: Teacher[], count: number): void => {
  try {
    const compact = items.slice(0, 100).map((item) => ({
      ...item,
      photo: item.photo && item.photo.length > 500 ? null : item.photo,
    }));
    localStorage.setItem(
      getUserScopedCacheKey(),
      JSON.stringify({ items: compact, count, savedAt: Date.now() })
    );
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage quota restrictions
  }
};

export const TeachersTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { mode, tokens, brand, fonts, radius, ui } = useTheme();
  const { school, refreshSchool } = useSchool();

  const currentUser = useMemo(() => getCurrentUserFromStorage(), []);
  const canManageTeachers = canManageTeachersPerm(currentUser);
  const canResetPhoneLock = canResetBoundDevice(currentUser);

  const initialCache = useMemo(() => {
    const apiHit = peekApiCache<PaginatedResponse<Teacher> | Teacher[]>(TEACHERS_ENDPOINT, {
      page: 1,
      page_size: 25,
    });
    if (apiHit) {
      if ('results' in apiHit && Array.isArray(apiHit.results)) {
        return { items: apiHit.results, count: apiHit.count };
      }
      if (Array.isArray(apiHit)) {
        return { items: apiHit, count: apiHit.length };
      }
    }
    return readCachedTeacherList();
  }, []);

  const [teacherList, setTeacherList] = useState<Teacher[]>(() => initialCache?.items || []);
  const [directoryDepartments, setDirectoryDepartments] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !initialCache);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState<string>('');

  const [search, setSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [departmentFilter, setDepartmentFilter] = useState<string>('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<StatusFilter>('ALL');

  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<number>(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState<number>(25);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState<number>(1);
  const [totalCount, setTotalCount] = useState<number>(() => initialCache?.count || 0);

  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [editingTeacher, setEditingTeacher] = useState<Teacher | null>(null);
  const [inspectingTeacher, setInspectingTeacher] = useState<Teacher | null>(null);
  const [selectedTeacherIds, setSelectedTeacherIds] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [isPrintModalOpen, setIsPrintModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const teacherOptions = useMemo<SelectableOption[]>(
    () =>
      teacherList.map((t) => ({
        id: t.id,
        label: `${t.full_name || `${t.first_name} ${t.last_name}`} (${t.employee_id})`,
      })),
    [teacherList]
  );

  const toggleTeacherSelection = (teacherId: number) => {
    setSelectedTeacherIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(teacherId) ? prev.filter((id) => id !== teacherId) : [...prev, teacherId]
    );
  };
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [resettingDeviceId, setResettingDeviceId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<TeacherFormState>(INITIAL_FORM_DATA);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { copiedKey, copy } = useCopyFeedback();

  const mountedRef = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const activeAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const prevSearchRef = useRef<string>(search);
  const hasLoadedItemsRef = useRef<boolean>((initialCache?.items.length || 0) > 0);
  const isInteractingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  isInteractingRef.current = isModalOpen || Boolean(inspectingTeacher) || isPrintModalOpen;

  const handleCopy = useCallback(
    async (text: string, key: string) => {
      const cleanValue = cleanInput(text, 120);
      if (!cleanValue) return;
      await copy(cleanValue, key);
    },
    [copy]
  );

  const loadTeacherList = useCallback(
    async (
      page = 1,
      size = 25,
      query = '',
      deptVal = '',
      silent = false,
      bypassCache = false
    ) => {
      activeAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      activeAbortRef.current = controller;

      const cleanQuery = cleanInput(query, 80);
      const cleanDept = cleanInput(deptVal, 100);
      const isAll = size >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE;

      try {
        if (!silent) {
          if (!hasLoadedItemsRef.current) setLoading(true);
          setRefreshing(true);
        }
        setErrorMessage(null);

        const [listOutcome, dropdownOutcome] = await Promise.allSettled([
          apiClient.get<PaginatedResponse<Teacher> | Teacher[]>(TEACHERS_ENDPOINT, {
            params: {
              page: isAll ? 1 : page,
              page_size: isAll ? 'ALL' : size,
              search: cleanQuery || undefined,
              department: cleanDept || undefined,
              ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
            },
            signal: controller.signal,
          }),
          apiClient.get<Teacher[]>(TEACHERS_DROPDOWN_ENDPOINT, {
            params: { include_all: 1 },
            signal: controller.signal,
          }),
        ]);

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        if (listOutcome.status === 'fulfilled') {
          const payload = listOutcome.value.data;
          if (payload && !Array.isArray(payload) && Array.isArray(payload.results)) {
            setTeacherList(payload.results);
            hasLoadedItemsRef.current = payload.results.length > 0;
            setTotalCount(payload.count);
            setTotalPages(isAll ? 1 : payload.total_pages || Math.ceil(payload.count / size) || 1);
            setCurrentPage(isAll ? 1 : payload.current_page || page);
            if (!cleanQuery && !cleanDept && page === 1) {
              writeCachedTeacherList(payload.results, payload.count);
            }
          } else if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
            setTeacherList(payload);
            hasLoadedItemsRef.current = payload.length > 0;
            setTotalCount(payload.length);
            setTotalPages(1);
            setCurrentPage(1);
            if (!cleanQuery && !cleanDept) {
              writeCachedTeacherList(payload, payload.length);
            }
          }
          setLastUpdated(new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }));
        } else {
          const reason = listOutcome.reason as { name?: string; code?: string };
          if (reason?.name === 'CanceledError' || reason?.name === 'AbortError' || reason?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
            return;
          }
          if (!silent) {
            setErrorMessage(
              extractApiError(
                listOutcome.reason,
                'Could not load the teacher directory right now. Please check your connection and try again.'
              )
            );
          }
        }

        if (dropdownOutcome.status === 'fulfilled' && Array.isArray(dropdownOutcome.value.data)) {
          const foundDepts = Array.from(
            new Set(
              dropdownOutcome.value.data
                .map((item) => cleanInput(item.department || '', 100))
                .filter(Boolean)
            )
          ).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
          setDirectoryDepartments(foundDepts);
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    []
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      activeAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const cleanEmpCheck = cleanInput(formData.employee_id, 50);
  const empAvail = useFieldAvailability({
    enabled: isModalOpen,
    field: 'employee_id',
    value: cleanEmpCheck,
    minLength: 2,
    fallbackMessage: 'This Employee ID is already assigned.',
    excludeId: editingTeacher?.id,
    excludeTeacherId: editingTeacher?.id,
  });

  const cleanEmailCheck = cleanInput(formData.email, 150).toLowerCase();
  const emailFormatErr =
    cleanEmailCheck && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(cleanEmailCheck)
      ? 'Please enter a valid email address.'
      : '';
  const emailAvail = useFieldAvailability({
    enabled: isModalOpen && Boolean(cleanEmailCheck),
    field: 'email',
    value: cleanEmailCheck,
    formatError: emailFormatErr,
    fallbackMessage: 'This email address is already in use.',
    excludeTeacherId: editingTeacher?.id,
    excludeUserId: editingTeacher?.user,
  });

  const cleanPhoneCheck = cleanInput(formData.contact_number, 30);
  const phoneAvail = useFieldAvailability({
    enabled: isModalOpen && cleanPhoneCheck.replace(/\D/g, '').length >= 10,
    field: 'contact_number',
    value: cleanPhoneCheck,
    minLength: 10,
    fallbackMessage: 'This mobile number is already assigned to another staff account.',
    excludeId: editingTeacher?.id,
    excludeTeacherId: editingTeacher?.id,
  });

  const liveErrors = {
    employee_id: empAvail.error || undefined,
    email: emailAvail.error || undefined,
    contact_number: phoneAvail.error || undefined,
  };
  const fieldVerified = {
    employee_id: empAvail.verified,
    email: emailAvail.verified,
    contact_number: phoneAvail.verified,
  };
  const checkingCount =
    (empAvail.checking ? 1 : 0) + (emailAvail.checking ? 1 : 0) + (phoneAvail.checking ? 1 : 0);
  const hasLiveErrors = Boolean(liveErrors.employee_id || liveErrors.email || liveErrors.contact_number);

  useEffect(() => {
    const searchChanged = prevSearchRef.current !== search;
    prevSearchRef.current = search;
    const delay = searchChanged ? 280 : 0;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setCurrentPage(1);
      void loadTeacherList(1, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, false, false);
    }, delay);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [search, departmentFilter, pageSize, loadTeacherList]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && !isInteractingRef.current) {
        void loadTeacherList(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true, true);
      }
    }, 15000);
    return () => clearInterval(intervalId);
  }, [currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, loadTeacherList]);

  const departmentOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const combined = new Set<string>(DEFAULT_DEPARTMENTS);
    directoryDepartments.forEach((d) => combined.add(d));
    teacherList.forEach((t) => {
      if (t.department?.trim()) combined.add(t.department.trim());
    });
    if (formData.department.trim()) combined.add(formData.department.trim());
    return Array.from(combined).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  }, [directoryDepartments, teacherList, formData.department]);

  const positionGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const knownRanks = new Set(DEFAULT_POSITION_GROUPS.flatMap((g) => g.ranks));
    const currentPos = formData.position.trim();
    if (!currentPos || knownRanks.has(currentPos)) {
      return DEFAULT_POSITION_GROUPS;
    }
    return [{ category: 'Current Assignment', ranks: [currentPos] }, ...DEFAULT_POSITION_GROUPS];
  }, [formData.position]);

  const displayedTeachers = useMemo(() => {
    return teacherList.filter((item) => {
      if (statusFilter === 'ACTIVE') return item.is_active;
      if (statusFilter === 'INACTIVE') return !item.is_active;
      if (statusFilter === 'BOUND') return Boolean(item.bound_device_id);
      if (statusFilter === 'UNBOUND') return !item.bound_device_id;
      return true;
    });
  }, [teacherList, statusFilter]);

  const activeTeachersCount = useMemo(
    () => teacherList.filter((t) => t.is_active).length,
    [teacherList]
  );

  const boundPhonesCount = useMemo(
    () => teacherList.filter((t) => Boolean(t.bound_device_id && t.bound_device_id.trim())).length,
    [teacherList]
  );

  const uniqueDepartmentCount = useMemo(() => {
    const source = directoryDepartments.length > 0 ? directoryDepartments : teacherList.map((t) => t.department);
    return new Set(source.filter(Boolean)).size;
  }, [directoryDepartments, teacherList]);

  const handlePageChange = (nextPage: number) => {
    if (nextPage < 1 || nextPage > totalPages) return;
    setCurrentPage(nextPage);
    void loadTeacherList(nextPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, false, false);
  };

  const handlePageSizeChange = (nextSize: number) => {
    if (nextSize === pageSize) return;
    setPageSize(nextSize);
    setCurrentPage(1);
  };

  const handleManualRefresh = () => {
    void refreshSchool();
    void loadTeacherList(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, false, true);
  };

  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const suffix = pageSize >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE ? 'All' : `Page${currentPage}_${pageSize}rows`;
    const exported = exportToCsv(
      `AttendSure_Teachers_${suffix}.csv`,
      [
        'Employee ID',
        'Full Name',
        'Position',
        'Department',
        'Handles Classes',
        'Email',
        'Phone Number',
        'Linked Mobile Device',
        'Status',
      ],
      displayedTeachers.map((t) => [
        t.employee_id,
        t.full_name,
        t.position,
        t.department,
        t.can_handle_classes ?? t.can_teach ? 'YES' : 'NO',
        t.email || '',
        t.contact_number || '',
        t.bound_device_id ? t.device_model || 'Linked Phone' : 'Not Linked',
        t.is_active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE',
      ])
    );

    if (exported) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'CSV Downloaded',
        message: `Saved ${displayedTeachers.length} teacher records to a CSV file.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
    } else {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Nothing to Export',
        message: 'There are no teacher records matching your current filters.',
        type: 'info',
      });
    }
  };

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingTeacher(null);
    setFormData(INITIAL_FORM_DATA);
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (teacher: Teacher) => {
    setEditingTeacher(teacher);
    setFormData({
      employee_id: teacher.employee_id || '',
      first_name: teacher.first_name || '',
      middle_name: teacher.middle_name || '',
      last_name: teacher.last_name || '',
      suffix: teacher.suffix || '',
      position: teacher.position || 'Teacher I',
      department: teacher.department || 'Junior High School',
      contact_number: teacher.contact_number || '',
      email: teacher.email || '',
      can_handle_classes: teacher.can_handle_classes ?? teacher.can_teach ?? true,
      is_active: teacher.is_active ?? true,
      photo: null,
    });
    setPhotoPreview(getSafeAvatarUrl(teacher));
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;

    if (hasLiveErrors) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Duplicate Information Found',
        message:
          liveErrors.employee_id ||
          liveErrors.email ||
          liveErrors.contact_number ||
          'Please fix the highlighted fields before saving.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    const cleanEmployeeId = cleanInput(formData.employee_id, 50).toUpperCase();
    const cleanFirstName = cleanInput(formData.first_name, 100);
    const cleanMiddleName = cleanInput(formData.middle_name, 100);
    const cleanLastName = cleanInput(formData.last_name, 100);
    const cleanSuffix = (STAFF_SUFFIX_OPTIONS as readonly string[]).includes(formData.suffix)
      ? formData.suffix
      : '';
    const cleanEmail = cleanInput(formData.email, 150).toLowerCase();
    const cleanPhone = cleanInput(formData.contact_number, 30)
      .replace(/[^\d+\-()\s]/g, '')
      .replace(/[\s()-]/g, '');

    if (!cleanEmployeeId || !cleanFirstName || !cleanLastName) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Missing Information',
        message: 'Please enter the Employee ID, First Name, and Last Name.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (cleanEmail && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(cleanEmail)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Invalid Email Address',
        message: 'Please enter a valid email address or leave the email box blank.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      employee_id: cleanEmployeeId,
      first_name: cleanFirstName,
      middle_name: cleanMiddleName,
      last_name: cleanLastName,
      suffix: cleanSuffix,
      position: cleanInput(formData.position, 100),
      department: cleanInput(formData.department, 100),
      email: cleanEmail,
      contact_number: cleanPhone,
      can_handle_classes: Boolean(formData.can_handle_classes),
      is_active: Boolean(formData.is_active),
    };

    if (formData.photo !== null) {
      if (formData.photo === '') {
        payload.photo = null;
        payload.remove_photo = true;
      } else {
        payload.photo = formData.photo;
      }
    }

    try {
      if (editingTeacher) {
        const res = await apiClient.put<Teacher>(`${TEACHERS_ENDPOINT}${editingTeacher.id}/`, payload);
        setTeacherList((prev) => prev.map((t) => (t.id === editingTeacher.id ? res.data : t)));
        showAlert({
          title: 'Profile Saved',
          message: `Updated details for ${cleanFirstName} ${cleanLastName}.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      } else {
        const res = await apiClient.post<Teacher>(TEACHERS_ENDPOINT, payload);
        setTeacherList((prev) => [res.data, ...prev]);
        showAlert({
          title: 'Teacher Added',
          message: `${cleanFirstName} ${cleanLastName} has been added to the directory.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      }
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      void loadTeacherList(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true, true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Could Not Save',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Unable to save this teacher record. Please check the details and try again.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetDeviceBinding = (teacher: Teacher) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Reset Phone Lock',
      message: `Unlink the current mobile phone and biometric key lock for ${teacher.full_name}? Their next Phone Fingerprint / Biometric & Campus GPS Time In will automatically pair their new phone.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Reset Phone Lock',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setResettingDeviceId(teacher.id);
        try {
          const res = await apiClient.post<{ message?: string }>(
            `${TEACHERS_ENDPOINT}${teacher.id}/reset-device/`,
            { teacher_id: teacher.id }
          );
          setTeacherList((prev) =>
            prev.map((item) =>
              item.id === teacher.id
                ? { ...item, bound_device_id: null, device_model: null, device_bound_at: null }
                : item
            )
          );
          if (inspectingTeacher?.id === teacher.id) {
            setInspectingTeacher((prev) =>
              prev ? { ...prev, bound_device_id: null, device_model: null, device_bound_at: null } : null
            );
          }
          showAlert({
            title: 'Phone Lock Cleared',
            message: res.data?.message || `Cleared the bound phone for ${teacher.full_name}.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Reset Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not reset the phone lock for this teacher.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setResettingDeviceId(null);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const promptDelete = (teacher: Teacher) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Remove Teacher',
      message: `Permanently remove ${teacher.full_name || teacher.first_name} (${teacher.employee_id}) from the AttendSure teacher directory?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Remove Teacher',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${TEACHERS_ENDPOINT}${teacher.id}/`);
          setTeacherList((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== teacher.id));
          if (inspectingTeacher?.id === teacher.id) setInspectingTeacher(null);
          showAlert({
            title: 'Teacher Removed',
            message: `Removed ${teacher.full_name || teacher.first_name} from the directory.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
          void loadTeacherList(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true, true);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Could Not Remove',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Unable to remove this teacher record right now.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const styles = useMemo(
    () => ({
      page: {
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column' as const,
        gap: 16,
        padding: 'clamp(12px, 2.2vw, 20px)',
        maxWidth: 1400,
        margin: '0 auto',
        fontFamily: fonts.sans,
      },
      headerCard: {
        ...ui.card,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        flexWrap: 'wrap' as const,
        gap: 12,
      },
      statsGrid: {
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 205px), 1fr))',
        gap: 12,
      },
      controlsBar: {
        ...ui.card,
        padding: '12px 16px',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column' as const,
        gap: 10,
      },
      controlsTopRow: {
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        alignItems: 'center',
        flexWrap: 'wrap' as const,
        gap: 10,
      },
      searchWrap: {
        position: 'relative' as const,
        flex: '1 1 220px',
        maxWidth: 320,
      },
      searchInput: {
        ...ui.input,
        paddingLeft: 34,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
      },
      deptSelect: {
        ...ui.input,
        width: 'auto',
        minWidth: 210,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        cursor: 'pointer',
      },
      filterPillsRow: {
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',

                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontFamily: fonts.mono, fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                    ID: {inspectingTeacher.employee_id}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, padding: '10px 12px', borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textSecondary, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                    Mobile Time In / Out: {inspectingTeacher.bound_device_id ? inspectingTeacher.device_model || 'Linked Phone Active' : 'Pairs on first mobile Time In'}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                    Phone Fingerprint / Biometric &amp; Campus GPS only. Zero biometric data ever leaves the teacher&apos;s phone.
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 16 }}>
                {canResetPhoneLock && inspectingTeacher.bound_device_id && (
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="md"
                    onClick={() => handleResetDeviceBinding(inspectingTeacher)}
                    loading={resettingDeviceId === inspectingTeacher.id}
                    icon={<RotateCcw size={14} />}
                  >
                    Reset Phone Lock
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button variant="primary" size="md" onClick={() => setInspectingTeacher(null)}>
                  Close
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      <PrintableExportModal
        isOpen={isPrintModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsPrintModalOpen(false)}
        title="Print & Download Teacher Directory, Schedules & Packets"
        defaultPackType="TEACHER_DIRECTORY"
        allowedPackTypes={['TEACHER_DIRECTORY', 'CLASS_SCHEDULE', 'COMPLETE_TEACHER_PACKET']}
        initialScope={selectedTeacherIds.length > 0 ? 'SELECTED' : 'ALL'}
        preselectedTeacherIds={selectedTeacherIds}
        teacherOptions={teacherOptions}
        isSchoolLeader={true}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default TeachersTab;

export interface SystemUser {
  id: number;
  username: string;
  employee_id?: string;
  first_name?: string;
  middle_name?: string;
  last_name?: string;
  suffix?: string;
  full_name?: string;
  email?: string;
  contact_number?: string;
  phone_number?: string;
  department?: string;
  position?: string;

  can_handle_classes?: boolean;
  can_teach?: boolean;
  is_profile_completed?: boolean;
  teacher_id?: number | null;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
}

const RBAC_ROLES = [
  { value: 'TEACHER', label: 'Teacher / Class Adviser' },
  { value: 'DEPT_HEAD', label: 'Department Head' },
  { value: 'PRINCIPAL', label: 'School Principal' },
  { value: 'ADMIN', label: 'System Administrator' },
];

const DEPARTMENTS_LIST = STAFF_DEPARTMENTS_LIST;
const POSITIONS_LIST = STAFF_POSITIONS_LIST;

const INITIAL_FORM = {
  username: '',
  employee_id: '',
  first_name: '',
  middle_name: '',
  last_name: '',
  suffix: '',
  email: '',
  contact_number: '',
  department: 'Junior High School',
  position: 'Teacher I',
  role: 'TEACHER',
  is_teaching: true,
  is_active: true,
  password: '',
  photo: null as string | null,
};

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 150): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const extractUsers = (raw: unknown): SystemUser[] => {
  if (Array.isArray(raw)) return raw as SystemUser[];
  if (raw && typeof raw === 'object' && Array.isArray((raw as { results?: SystemUser[] }).results)) {
    return (raw as { results: SystemUser[] }).results;
  }
  return [];
};

export const UsersTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const currentLoggedUsername = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const canEditUsers = useMemo(() => canManageUsers(getCurrentUserFromStorage()), []);

  const cachedUsers = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.accounts.users, { page_size: 'ALL' });

  const [users, setUsers] = useState<SystemUser[]>(() => extractUsers(cachedUsers));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !cachedUsers);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState<string>('');
  const [teachingFilter, setTeachingFilter] = useState<string>('');

  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [editingUser, setEditingUser] = useState<SystemUser | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState(INITIAL_FORM);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const { copiedKey, copy } = useCopyFeedback();

  const activeAbortController = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      activeAbortController.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const usernameFmtErr = useMemo(() => {
    if (!formData.username) return '';
    if (/\s/.test(formData.username)) return 'Username cannot contain spaces.';
    if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$/.test(formData.username)) {
      return 'Use only letters, numbers, dots, dashes, or underscores.';
    }
    if (formData.username.length < 3) return 'Username must be at least 3 characters.';
    return '';
  }, [formData.username]);

  const emailFmtErr = useMemo(() => {
    const trimmed = formData.email.trim();
    if (trimmed && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(trimmed)) {
      return 'Please enter a valid email address.';
    }
    return '';
  }, [formData.email]);

  const passwordFmtErr = useMemo(() => {
    if (!formData.password) return '';
    if (formData.password.length < 8) return 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.';
    if (!/[A-Za-z]/.test(formData.password) || !/[0-9]/.test(formData.password)) {
      return 'Password must include both letters and numbers.';
    }
    return '';
  }, [formData.password]);

  const usernameAvail = useFieldAvailability({
    enabled: isModalOpen && Boolean(formData.username),
    field: 'username',
    value: sanitizeInput(formData.username, 64),
    minLength: 3,
    formatError: usernameFmtErr,
    fallbackMessage: 'This username is already taken.',
    excludeId: editingUser?.id,
    excludeUserId: editingUser?.id,
  });

  const empAvail = useFieldAvailability({
    enabled: isModalOpen,
    field: 'employee_id',
    value: sanitizeInput(formData.employee_id, 40),
    minLength: 2,
    fallbackMessage: 'This Employee ID is already assigned.',
    excludeTeacherId: editingUser?.teacher_id ?? undefined,
    excludeUserId: editingUser?.id,
  });

  const cleanEmailCheck = sanitizeInput(formData.email, 150).toLowerCase();
  const emailAvail = useFieldAvailability({
    enabled: isModalOpen && Boolean(cleanEmailCheck),
    field: 'email',
    value: cleanEmailCheck,
    formatError: emailFmtErr,
    fallbackMessage: 'This email address is already in use.',
    excludeId: editingUser?.id,
    excludeUserId: editingUser?.id,
  });

  const cleanPhoneCheck = sanitizeInput(formData.contact_number, 20);
  const phoneAvail = useFieldAvailability({
    enabled: isModalOpen && cleanPhoneCheck.replace(/\D/g, '').length >= 10,
    field: 'contact_number',
    value: cleanPhoneCheck,
    minLength: 10,
    fallbackMessage: 'This mobile number is already assigned to another staff account.',
    excludeTeacherId: editingUser?.teacher_id ?? undefined,
    excludeUserId: editingUser?.id,
  });

  const liveErrors = {
    username: usernameAvail.error || undefined,
    employee_id: empAvail.error || undefined,
    email: emailAvail.error || undefined,
    contact_number: phoneAvail.error || undefined,
    password: passwordFmtErr || undefined,
  };
  const fieldVerified = {
    username: usernameAvail.verified,
    employee_id: empAvail.verified,
    email: emailAvail.verified,
    contact_number: phoneAvail.verified,
  };
  const hasLiveErrors = Boolean(
    liveErrors.username ||
      liveErrors.employee_id ||
      liveErrors.email ||
      liveErrors.contact_number ||
      liveErrors.password
  );
  const isCheckingFields =
    usernameAvail.checking || empAvail.checking || emailAvail.checking || phoneAvail.checking;

  const handleCopy = async (text: string, id: string) => {
    if (!text) return;
    await copy(text, id);
  };

  const fetchUsers = useCallback(async (query = '', silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
    activeAbortController.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    activeAbortController.current = controller;

    const cleanQuery = sanitizeInput(query, 80);
    const baseParams: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = {
      search: cleanQuery || undefined,
      page_size: 'ALL',
    };

    if (!bypassCache) {
      const warm = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.accounts.users, baseParams);
      if (warm !== undefined) {
        setUsers(extractUsers(warm));
        setLoading(false);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      }
    } else if (!silent) {
      setLoading(true);
    }
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.users, {
        params: {
          ...baseParams,
          ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
        },
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      setUsers(extractUsers(res.data));
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
        return;
      }
      if (!silent) {
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Unable to load user accounts. Administrator permissions required.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted && !silent) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      void fetchUsers(search, false, false);
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [search, fetchUsers]);

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingUser(null);
    setFormData(INITIAL_FORM);
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    setShowPassword(false);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (user: SystemUser) => {
    const rawRole = (user.current_role || user.role || 'TEACHER').toUpperCase();
    const isTeach =
      user.can_handle_classes !== undefined
        ? Boolean(user.can_handle_classes)
        : user.is_teaching !== undefined
          ? Boolean(user.is_teaching)
          : user.can_teach !== undefined
            ? Boolean(user.can_teach)
            : true;

    const safeRole = RBAC_ROLES.some((r) => r.value === rawRole) ? rawRole : 'TEACHER';
    const phoneVal = user.phone_number || user.contact_number || '';
    const existingPic = user.photo_url || user.photo || null;

    setEditingUser(user);
    setFormData({
      username: user.username || '',
      employee_id: user.employee_id || user.username || '',
      first_name: user.first_name || '',
      middle_name: user.middle_name || '',
      last_name: user.last_name || '',
      suffix: user.suffix || '',
      email: user.email || '',
      contact_number: phoneVal,
      department: user.department || 'Junior High School',
      position: user.position || 'Teacher I',
      role: safeRole,
      is_teaching: isTeach,
      is_active: user.is_active ?? true,
      password: '',
      photo: null,
    });
    setPhotoPreview(isSafeImageUrl(existingPic) ? existingPic : null);
    setShowPassword(false);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (hasLiveErrors) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Form Notice',
        message:
          liveErrors.username ||
          liveErrors.employee_id ||
          liveErrors.email ||
          liveErrors.contact_number ||
          liveErrors.password ||
          'Please fix the highlighted errors.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    const cleanUsername = sanitizeInput(formData.username, 64).replace(/\s+/g, '');
    if (!cleanUsername) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Username Required',
        message: 'Username cannot be blank or contain spaces.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!editingUser && formData.password.trim().length < 8) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Password Required',
        message: 'Initial password must be at least 8 characters long.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    const cleanPhone = sanitizeInput(formData.contact_number, 20);

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
        username: cleanUsername,
        employee_id: (sanitizeInput(formData.employee_id, 40) || cleanUsername).toUpperCase(),
        first_name: sanitizeInput(formData.first_name, 100),
        middle_name: sanitizeInput(formData.middle_name, 100),
        last_name: sanitizeInput(formData.last_name, 100),
        suffix: sanitizeInput(formData.suffix, 20),
        email: sanitizeInput(formData.email, 150).toLowerCase(),
        contact_number: cleanPhone,
        department: sanitizeInput(formData.department, 100),
        position: sanitizeInput(formData.position, 100),
        role: formData.role,
        can_handle_classes: formData.is_teaching,
        is_teaching: formData.is_teaching,
        is_active: formData.is_active,
      };

      if (formData.password.trim()) {
        payload.password = formData.password.trim().slice(0, 128);
      }

      if (formData.photo !== null) {
        if (formData.photo === '') {
          payload.photo = null;
          payload.remove_photo = true;
        } else if (isSafeImageUrl(formData.photo)) {
          payload.photo = formData.photo;
        }
      }

      if (editingUser) {
        await apiClient.put(`${API_ROUTES.accounts.users}${editingUser.id}/`, payload);
        showAlert({
          title: 'Account Saved',
          message: `Saved updates for @${cleanUsername}. Role and permissions are now synced.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.accounts.users, payload);
        showAlert({
          title: 'Account Registered',
          message: `@${cleanUsername} is registered. ${
            payload.is_teaching
              ? 'This teacher now appears in the Teachers tab.'
              : 'Account is active for web and mobile login.'
          }`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      }

      setIsModalOpen(false);
      await fetchUsers(search, true, true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Save Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to save user account.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const promptDelete = (user: SystemUser) => {
    if (user.username.trim().toLowerCase() === currentLoggedUsername) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Action Denied',
        message: 'You cannot delete your own active administrator account.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete User Account',

            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const filteredUsers = useMemo(() => {
    const q = sanitizeInput(search, 80).toLowerCase();
    return users.filter((u) => {

      const phone = (u.phone_number || u.contact_number || '').toLowerCase();

      const matchesRole = !roleFilter || (u.current_role || u.role || '').toUpperCase() === roleFilter;

      if (teachingFilter === 'CAN_TEACH') {

      } else if (teachingFilter === 'CANT_TEACH') {
        matchesTeaching = !Boolean(u.can_handle_classes ?? u.is_teaching ?? u.can_teach);
      }

      return matchesSearch && matchesRole && matchesTeaching;
    });
  }, [users, search, roleFilter, teachingFilter]);

  const { activeCount, canTeachCount, cantTeachCount } = useMemo(() => {
    let active = 0;
    let teach = 0;
    for (const u of users) {

    }
    return {
      activeCount: active,
      canTeachCount: teach,
      cantTeachCount: users.length - teach,
    };
  }, [users]);

  const errorTextStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    fontSize: '0.70rem',
    color: brand.danger,
    fontWeight: 600,
    marginTop: 3,
    display: 'block',
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2.5vw, 20px)' }}>
      {/* 1. System Account Summary */}
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 210px), 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
        <StatsCard
          label="TOTAL REGISTERED ACCOUNTS"
          value={users.length}
          helpText="Teachers & school leadership accounts"
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="CLASSROOM TEACHERS"
          value={canTeachCount}
          valueColor={brand.primary}
          helpText="Visible in Teachers tab & class schedules"
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="NON-TEACHING ACCOUNTS"
          value={cantTeachCount}
          valueColor={tokens.textSecondary}
          helpText="Principals & administrative accounts"
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="ACTIVE ACCOUNTS"
          value={activeCount}
          valueColor={brand.success}
          helpText="Authorized for mobile & web login"
        />
      </div>

      {/* 2. Control Bar with Filters & Add Button */}
      <div
        style={{
          ...ui.card,
          padding: '10px 14px',
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 10,
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <select
            aria-label="Filter by role"
            value={roleFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setRoleFilter(e.target.value)}
            style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', minWidth: 170 }}
          >
            <option value="">All Roles</option>

            ))}

          columns={[

                        >
                          {copiedKey === `user-${u.id}` ? (

            {
              header: 'Role & Teaching Access',
              render: (u) => {

                return (
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
                    <span style={{ ...ui.badge(tokens.primaryLight, brand.primary), width: 'fit-content' }}>
                      <Shield size={11} /> {u.current_role || u.role || 'TEACHER'}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      style={{

/**
 * AttendSure - Resilient Modal Dialog
 * File: web/src/components/ui/AlertDialog.tsx
 *
 * Cybersecurity & Stability Hardening:
 * 1. Safe Child Parsing: Safely converts objects, errors, and arrays to text to prevent React rendering crashes.
 * 2. Focus & Escape Handling: Automatically focuses primary action and supports Escape dismissal.
 * 3. Quick Workflow (Auto-Close): Automatically dismisses non-critical success alerts after 3.5 seconds.
 * 4. Overflow Protection: Adds scroll constraints so long error messages never clip action buttons.
 */

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Info,
  XCircle,
  X,
  ArrowRight,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

export type AlertType = 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

export interface AlertDialogProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  title?: string;
  message: string | unknown;
  type?: AlertType;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  autoClose?: boolean; // Defaults to true for success, false for error/warning
  autoCloseDuration?: number; // Milliseconds (default: 3500ms)
  onAction?: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

/**
 * Defensive Sanitizer: Ensures message is always rendered as a safe, readable string.
 */
const sanitizeMessage = (msg: unknown): string => {
  if (msg === null || msg === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof msg === 'string') {
    const trimmed = msg.trim();
    if (trimmed.startsWith('<!DOCTYPE') || trimmed.startsWith('<html') || trimmed.includes('Traceback (most recent call last)')) {
      return 'Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.';
    }
    return trimmed;
  }
  if (typeof msg === 'number' || typeof msg === 'boolean') return String(msg);
  return extractApiError(msg, 'An unexpected notice was received. Please try again.');
};

export const AlertDialog: React.FC<AlertDialogProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  title,
  message,
  type = 'info',
  confirmLabel = 'Understood',
  actionLabel,
  autoClose,
  autoCloseDuration = 3500,
  onAction,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const confirmBtnRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const autoCloseTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
    if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
      autoCloseTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    onClose();
  }, [onClose]);

  // Handle Escape key and auto-focus for accessibility
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    const focusTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      confirmBtnRef.current?.focus();
    }, 50);

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleClose();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);

    const shouldAutoClose = autoClose ?? (type === 'success' && !actionLabel);
    if (shouldAutoClose) {
      autoCloseTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        handleClose();
      }, autoCloseDuration);
    }

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(focusTimeout);
      if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
      }
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen, type, actionLabel, autoClose, autoCloseDuration, handleClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const config = {
    info: {
      icon: Info,
      color: brand.primary,
      buttonBg: brand.buttonBg,
      bgColor: brand.primarySoft,
      borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
      defaultTitle: 'Notice',
    },
    success: {
      icon: CheckCircle2,
      color: tokens.success,
      buttonBg: brand.success,
      bgColor: tokens.successBg,
      borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
      defaultTitle: 'Saved Successfully',
    },
    warning: {
      icon: AlertTriangle,
      color: tokens.warning,
      buttonBg: brand.warning,
      bgColor: tokens.warningBg,
      borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
      defaultTitle: 'Action Needed',
    },
    error: {
      icon: XCircle,
      color: tokens.danger,
      buttonBg: brand.danger,
      bgColor: tokens.dangerBg,
      borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
      defaultTitle: 'Notice',
    },
  }[type];

  const IconComponent = config.icon;
  const safeMessage = sanitizeMessage(message);

  return (
    <div
      style={overlayStyle}
      onClick={handleClose}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="alert-dialog-title"
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          maxWidth: 420,
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderRadius: 12,
          boxShadow: '0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14)',
          border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Top Accent Color Line */}
        <div style={{ height: 4, backgroundColor: config.color, width: '100%' }} />

        <div style={{ padding: '20px 22px 18px 22px' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 14 }}>
            {/* Status Icon */}
            <div
              style={{
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                backgroundColor: config.bgColor,
                border: `1px solid ${config.borderColor}`,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                flexShrink: 0,
              }}
            >
              <IconComponent size={22} color={config.color} />
            </div>

            {/* Content Text */}
            <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, paddingTop: 1 }}>
              <div
                id="alert-dialog-title"
                style={{
                  fontSize: '0.96rem',
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  marginBottom: 6,
                }}
              >
                {title || config.defaultTitle}
              </div>
              <div
                style={{
                  fontSize: '0.82rem',
                  color: tokens.textSecondary,
                  lineHeight: 1.5,
                  maxHeight: '40vh',
                  overflowY: 'auto',
                  wordBreak: 'break-word',
                  paddingRight: 4,
                }}
              >
                {safeMessage}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Top Close Button */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClose}
              style={{ ...closeBtnStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}
              title="Close"
              aria-label="Close dialog"
            >
              <X size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Action Button Row */}
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'flex-end',
              gap: 8,
              marginTop: 18,
              paddingTop: 12,
              borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            }}
          >
            {actionLabel && onAction && (
              <button

                  onAction();
