                <span>{actionLabel}</span>
                <ArrowRight size={13} />
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              ref={confirmBtnRef}
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClose}
              style={{
                padding: '7px 16px',
                backgroundColor: actionLabel ? tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle : config.buttonBg,
                color: actionLabel ? tokens.textPrimary : tokens.onPrimary,
                borderRadius: 6,

import React from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'dark' | 'ghost';
  size?: 'sm' | 'md';
  loading?: boolean;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}

export const Button: React.FC<ButtonProps> = ({
  children,
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  loading = false,
  icon,
  disabled,
  style,
  ...props
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand, radius } = useTheme();

  const getVariantStyles = (): React.CSSProperties => {
    switch (variant) {
      case 'primary':
        return {
          backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg,
          color: tokens.onPrimary,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: brand.buttonBg,
          boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.22)',
        };
      case 'secondary':
        return {
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
          color: tokens.textPrimary,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: tokens.borderStrong,
        };
      case 'danger':
        return {
          backgroundColor: brand.danger,
          color: tokens.onPrimary,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: brand.danger,
        };
      case 'dark':
        return {
          backgroundColor: tokens.darkSurfaceElevated,
          color: tokens.darkText,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: tokens.darkBorder,
        };
      case 'ghost':
        return {
          backgroundColor: 'transparent',
          color: tokens.textPrimary,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: 'transparent',
        };
    }
  };

  const sizeStyles: React.CSSProperties =
    size === 'sm'
      ? { padding: '5px 10px', fontSize: '0.78rem' }
      : { padding: '8px 14px', fontSize: '0.86rem' };

  return (
    <button
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      style={{
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        gap: 7,
        fontWeight: 700,
        borderRadius: radius.md,
        cursor: disabled || loading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
        opacity: disabled ? 0.6 : 1,
        transition: 'background-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease',
        ...sizeStyles,
        ...getVariantStyles(),
        ...style,
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      {loading ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={16} /> : icon}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Precision Segmented Control Switch & Toggle Switch
 * File: web/src/components/ui/ControlSwitch.tsx
 */

import React from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

export interface SwitchOption<T extends string> {
  value: T;
  label?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  badge?: number | string;
  title?: string;
}

interface ControlSwitchProps<T extends string> {
  options: ReadonlyArray<SwitchOption<T>>;
  value: T;
  onChange: (next: T) => void;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md';
  compactIconsOnly?: boolean;
  ariaLabel?: string;
}

export function ControlSwitch<T extends string>({
  options,
  value,
  onChange,
  size = 'md',
  compactIconsOnly = false,
  ariaLabel = 'View Switcher',
}: ControlSwitchProps<T>) {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts } = useTheme();

  return (
    <div
      role="tablist"
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      style={{
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 2,
        padding: 3,
        borderRadius: compactIconsOnly ? 9999 : 10,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderStyle: 'solid',
        borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
    >
      {options.map((opt) => {
        const active = opt.value === value;
        return (
          <button
            key={opt.value}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={active}
            title={opt.title || opt.label || opt.value}
            onClick={() => onChange(opt.value)}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              gap: 5,
              padding: compactIconsOnly ? 0 : size === 'sm' ? '4px 10px' : '6px 12px',
              width: compactIconsOnly ? 28 : undefined,
              height: compactIconsOnly ? 28 : undefined,
              borderRadius: compactIconsOnly ? '50%' : 7,
              borderWidth: 0,
              borderStyle: 'none',
              backgroundColor: active ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent',
              color: active ? tokens.onPrimary : tokens.textSecondary,
              boxShadow: active ? '0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)' : 'none',
              fontFamily: fonts.sans,
              fontSize: size === 'sm' ? fonts.size.xs : fonts.size.sm,
              fontWeight: active ? 800 : 600,
              cursor: 'pointer',
              transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            }}
          >
            {opt.icon}
            {!compactIconsOnly && opt.label && <span>{opt.label}</span>}
            {opt.badge !== undefined && opt.badge !== '' && Number(opt.badge) > 0 && (
              <span
                style={{
                  padding: '1px 6px',
                  borderRadius: 9999,
                  fontSize: '0.62rem',
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  backgroundColor: active ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)' : tokens.primaryLight,
                  color: active ? tokens.onPrimary : brand.primary,
                }}
              >
                {opt.badge}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

          width: 42,

          borderRadius: 9999,

          }}
        />

/**
 * AttendSure - Accessible Theme-Adaptive Dialog Modal
 * File: web/src/components/ui/Modal.tsx
 */

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

interface ModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  maxWidth?: string;
}

export const Modal: React.FC<ModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  title,
  children,
  maxWidth = '540px',
}) => {
  const { tokens, fonts, radius } = useTheme();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label={title}
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.58)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(3px)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        zIndex: 9999,
        padding: 16,
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
      }}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          maxWidth,
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          color: tokens.textPrimary,
          borderRadius: radius.lg,
          border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
          overflow: 'hidden',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          maxHeight: '90vh',
          fontFamily: fonts.sans,
        }}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div
          style={{
            padding: '14px 20px',
            borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
            gap: 12,
          }}
        >
          <h3
            style={{
              margin: 0,
              fontSize: fonts.size.md,
              fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold,
              color: tokens.textPrimary,
            }}
          >
            {title}
          </h3>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close dialog"
            style={{
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              color: tokens.textMuted,
              padding: 4,
              borderRadius: radius.sm,
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div style={{ padding: 20, overflowY: 'auto', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Modal;

/**
 * AttendSure - Global Alert & Confirmation System (Referentially Stable)
 * File: web/src/context/AlertContext.tsx
 */

import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  useCallback,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle, Info, X, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { extractApiError } from '../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from './ThemeContext';

export type AlertType = 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';

export interface AlertOptions {
  title: string;
  message: string | unknown;
  type?: AlertType;
  actionLabel?: string;
  autoCloseDuration?: number;
  onAction?: () => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
}

export interface ConfirmOptions {
  title: string;
  message: string | unknown;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  isDestructive?: boolean;
  onConfirm: () => Promise<void> | void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
}

interface AlertContextType {
  showAlert: (options: AlertOptions) => void;
  showConfirm: (options: ConfirmOptions) => void;
  closeAlert: () => void;
  closeConfirm: () => void;
}

const AlertContext = createContext<AlertContextType | undefined>(undefined);

const toSafeString = (val: unknown): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof val === 'string') {
    const trimmed = val.trim();
    if (trimmed.startsWith('<!DOCTYPE') || trimmed.startsWith('<html') || trimmed.includes('Traceback (most recent call last)')) {
      return 'Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.';
    }
    return trimmed;
  }
  if (typeof val === 'number' || typeof val === 'boolean') return String(val);
  return extractApiError(val, 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.');
};

export const AlertProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [alertData, setAlertData] = useState<AlertOptions | null>(null);
  const [confirmData, setConfirmData] = useState<ConfirmOptions | null>(null);
  const [isConfirmLoading, setIsConfirmLoading] = useState(false);

  const alertDataRef = useRef<AlertOptions | null>(null);
  const confirmDataRef = useRef<ConfirmOptions | null>(null);
  const confirmLoadingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const autoCloseTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  alertDataRef.current = alertData;
  confirmDataRef.current = confirmData;
  confirmLoadingRef.current = isConfirmLoading;

  const closeAlert = useCallback(() => {
    if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
      autoCloseTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    const current = alertDataRef.current;
    alertDataRef.current = null;
    setAlertData(null);
    current?.onClose?.();
  }, []);

  const closeConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    if (confirmLoadingRef.current) return;
    const current = confirmDataRef.current;
    confirmDataRef.current = null;
    setConfirmData(null);
    current?.onCancel?.();
  }, []);

  const showAlert = useCallback(
    (options: AlertOptions) => {
      if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
        autoCloseTimerRef.current = null;
      }

      const normalized: AlertOptions = {
        ...options,
        title: toSafeString(options.title) || 'Notice',
        message: toSafeString(options.message),
      };
      alertDataRef.current = normalized;
      setAlertData(normalized);

      if (options.type === 'success' && !options.actionLabel) {
        const duration = options.autoCloseDuration ?? 3500;
        autoCloseTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          closeAlert();
        }, duration);
      }
    },
    [closeAlert]
  );

  const showConfirm = useCallback((options: ConfirmOptions) => {
    const normalized: ConfirmOptions = {
      ...options,
      title: toSafeString(options.title) || 'Confirm Action',
      message: toSafeString(options.message),
    };
    confirmDataRef.current = normalized;
    setConfirmData(normalized);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (confirmDataRef.current && !confirmLoadingRef.current) {
          closeConfirm();
        } else if (alertDataRef.current) {
          closeAlert();
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [closeAlert, closeConfirm]);

  const handleConfirmAction = async () => {
    const activeConfirm = confirmDataRef.current;
    if (!activeConfirm || confirmLoadingRef.current) return;
    try {
      setIsConfirmLoading(true);
      confirmLoadingRef.current = true;
      await activeConfirm.onConfirm();
      confirmDataRef.current = null;
      setConfirmData(null);
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Action Error',
        message: err,
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      confirmLoadingRef.current = false;
      setIsConfirmLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAlertAction = () => {
    alertDataRef.current?.onAction?.();
    closeAlert();
  };

  const getAlertIcon = (type: AlertType) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'success':
        return <CheckCircle2 size={24} color={tokens.success} />;
      case 'error':
        return <XCircle size={24} color={tokens.danger} />;
      case 'warning':
        return <AlertTriangle size={24} color={tokens.warning} />;
      case 'info':
      default:
        return <Info size={24} color={brand.primary} />;
    }
  };

  const getAlertColorTheme = (type: AlertType) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'success':
        return { bg: tokens.successBg, border: tokens.borderSubtle };
      case 'error':
        return { bg: tokens.dangerBg, border: tokens.borderSubtle };
      case 'warning':
        return { bg: tokens.warningBg, border: tokens.borderSubtle };
      case 'info':
      default:
        return { bg: brand.primarySoft, border: tokens.borderSubtle };
    }
  };

  const modalBoxStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    width: '100%',
    maxWidth: 420,
    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
    borderRadius: 12,
    padding: 18,
    boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)',
    border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
  };

  const primaryBtnStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg,
    color: '#ffffff',
    border: 'none',
    borderRadius: 6,
    padding: '7px 16px',
    fontSize: '0.80rem',
    fontWeight: 700,
    cursor: 'pointer',
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  };

  const secondaryBtnStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
    color: tokens.textPrimary,
    border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderInput}`,
    borderRadius: 6,
    padding: '7px 14px',
    fontSize: '0.80rem',
    fontWeight: 600,
    cursor: 'pointer',
  };

  const contextValue = useMemo(
    () => ({ showAlert, showConfirm, closeAlert, closeConfirm }),
    [showAlert, showConfirm, closeAlert, closeConfirm]
  );

  return (
    <AlertContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      {children}

      {alertData && (
        <div style={overlayStyle} role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
          <div style={modalBoxStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  ...iconContainerStyle,
                  backgroundColor: getAlertColorTheme(alertData.type || 'info').bg,
                  border: `1px solid ${getAlertColorTheme(alertData.type || 'info').border}`,
                }}
              >
                {getAlertIcon(alertData.type || 'info')}
              </div>

              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.96rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {alertData.title}
                </h3>
                <p
                  style={{
                    margin: '6px 0 0 0',
                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                    color: tokens.textSecondary,
                    lineHeight: 1.45,
                    wordBreak: 'break-word',
                  }}
                >
                  {String(alertData.message)}
                </p>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={closeAlert}
                style={closeBtnStyle}
                title="Close"
                aria-label="Close alert"
              >
                <X size={16} color={tokens.textMuted} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 16 }}>
              {alertData.actionLabel ? (
                <>
                  <button type="button" onClick={closeAlert} style={secondaryBtnStyle}>
                    Dismiss
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={handleAlertAction} style={primaryBtnStyle}>
                    {alertData.actionLabel}
                  </button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <button type="button" onClick={closeAlert} style={primaryBtnStyle}>
                  Okay
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {confirmData && (
        <div style={overlayStyle} role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
          <div style={modalBoxStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  ...iconContainerStyle,
                  backgroundColor: confirmData.isDestructive ? tokens.dangerBg : brand.primarySoft,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                }}
              >
                {confirmData.isDestructive ? (
                  <AlertTriangle size={24} color={tokens.danger} />
                ) : (
                  <Info size={24} color={brand.primary} />
                )}
              </div>

              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.96rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {confirmData.title}
                </h3>
                <p
                  style={{
                    margin: '6px 0 0 0',
                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                    color: tokens.textSecondary,
                    lineHeight: 1.45,
                    wordBreak: 'break-word',
                  }}
                >
                  {String(confirmData.message)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 18 }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isConfirmLoading}
                onClick={closeConfirm}
                style={secondaryBtnStyle}
              >
                {confirmData.cancelLabel || 'Cancel'}
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isConfirmLoading}
                onClick={handleConfirmAction}
                style={{
                  ...primaryBtnStyle,
                  backgroundColor: confirmData.isDestructive ? '#dc2626' : brand.buttonBg,
                }}
              >
                {isConfirmLoading ? (
                  <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} />
                ) : null}
                {confirmData.confirmLabel || 'Confirm'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </AlertContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAlert = () => {
  const context = useContext(AlertContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAlert must be used within an AlertProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';

export type ComplianceMode = 'DEPED_PH';
export type SupportedLocale = 'en' | 'fil';

interface ComplianceContextValue {
  complianceMode: ComplianceMode;
  setComplianceMode: (mode: ComplianceMode) => void;
  toggleComplianceMode: () => void;
  isGlobalMode: boolean;
  locale: SupportedLocale;
  setLocale: (lang: SupportedLocale) => void;
  t: (key: string, fallback?: string) => string;
  term: (altLabel: string, depedLabel: string) => string;
}

const ComplianceContext = createContext<ComplianceContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

export const ComplianceProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const complianceMode: ComplianceMode = 'DEPED_PH';

  const [locale, setLocaleState] = useState<SupportedLocale>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_locale') as SupportedLocale | null;
    return saved && saved in TRANSLATIONS ? saved : 'en';
  });

  const setComplianceMode = useCallback((_mode: ComplianceMode) => {
    localStorage.setItem('attendsure_compliance_mode', 'DEPED_PH');
  }, []);

  const toggleComplianceMode = useCallback(() => {
    localStorage.setItem('attendsure_compliance_mode', 'DEPED_PH');
  }, []);

  const setLocale = useCallback((lang: SupportedLocale) => {
    setLocaleState(lang);
    localStorage.setItem('attendsure_locale', lang);
  }, []);

  const t = useCallback(
    (key: string, fallback?: string): string => {
      return TRANSLATIONS[locale]?.[key] || TRANSLATIONS.en[key] || fallback || key;
    },
    [locale]
  );

  const term = useCallback((_altLabel: string, depedLabel: string): string => {
    return depedLabel;
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo<ComplianceContextValue>(
    () => ({
      complianceMode,
      setComplianceMode,
      toggleComplianceMode,
      isGlobalMode: false,
      locale,
      setLocale,
      t,
      term,
    }),
    [setComplianceMode, toggleComplianceMode, locale, setLocale, t, term]
  );

  return <ComplianceContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ComplianceContext.Provider>;
};

export const useCompliance = (): ComplianceContextValue => {
  const ctx = useContext(ComplianceContext);
  if (!ctx) {
    throw new Error('useCompliance must be used within a ComplianceProvider');
  }
  return ctx;
};

export default ComplianceContext;

/**
 * AttendSure - Global School Settings & Branding Context
 * File: web/src/context/SchoolContext.tsx

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache } from '../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES } from '../api/routes';

export interface SchoolData {
  school_id: string;
  deped_school_id?: string;
  school_name: string;
  short_name: string;
  region: string;
  division: string;
  district: string;
  address: string;
  contact_number: string;
  email: string;

export interface SchoolContextValue {
  school: SchoolData;
  loading: boolean;
  refreshSchool: () => Promise<void>;
  updateSchoolInstantly: (partial: Record<string, unknown> | Partial<SchoolData>) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'attendsure_school_branding_v2';

const EMPTY_SCHOOL: SchoolData = {
  school_id: '',
  deped_school_id: '',
  school_name: '',
  short_name: '',
  region: '',
  division: '',
  district: '',
  address: '',
  contact_number: '',
  email: '',
  principal_name: '',
  principal_title: '',
  academic_year: '',
  latitude: null,
  longitude: null,
  geofence_radius_meters: null,
  geofence_radius: null,
  radius_meters: null,
  school_logo: null,
  left_logo: null,
  right_logo: null,
  is_configured: false,
};

const sanitizeText = (val: unknown, maxLen = 180): string =>
  String(val ?? '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLen);

const pickNonEmpty = (primary: unknown, fallback: string, maxLen = 180): string => {
  const cleaned = sanitizeText(primary, maxLen);
  return cleaned || fallback;
};

const safeLogo = (val: unknown): string | null => {
  const str = typeof val === 'string' ? val.trim() : '';
  return str && isSafeImageUrl(str) ? str : null;
};

const normalizeSchoolPayload = (
  raw: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
  prev: SchoolData
): SchoolData => {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return prev;

  const resolvedId = pickNonEmpty(
    raw.school_id || raw.deped_school_id || raw.code,
    prev.school_id,
    40
  );
  const resolvedName = pickNonEmpty(raw.school_name || raw.name, prev.school_name, 180);
  const resolvedShort = pickNonEmpty(raw.short_name, prev.short_name, 40);
  const resolvedRegion = pickNonEmpty(raw.region, prev.region, 100);
  const resolvedDivision = pickNonEmpty(raw.division, prev.division, 120);
  const resolvedDistrict = pickNonEmpty(raw.district, prev.district, 120);
  const resolvedAddress = pickNonEmpty(raw.address || raw.school_address, prev.address, 240);
  const resolvedContact = pickNonEmpty(
    raw.contact_number || raw.school_contact,
    prev.contact_number,
    60
  );
  const resolvedEmail = pickNonEmpty(raw.email || raw.school_email, prev.email, 120);
  const resolvedPrincipal = pickNonEmpty(
    raw.principal_name || raw.school_head,
    prev.principal_name,
    140
  );
  const resolvedPrincipalTitle = pickNonEmpty(
    raw.principal_title || raw.school_head_title,
    prev.principal_title,
    100
  );
  const resolvedAcademicYear = pickNonEmpty(
    raw.academic_year || raw.active_school_year || raw.school_year,
    prev.academic_year,
    30
  );

  const parsedLat =
    raw.latitude !== undefined && raw.latitude !== null && raw.latitude !== ''
      ? Number(raw.latitude)
      : prev.latitude;
  const parsedLng =
    raw.longitude !== undefined && raw.longitude !== null && raw.longitude !== ''
      ? Number(raw.longitude)
      : prev.longitude;

  const rawRad = raw.geofence_radius_meters ?? raw.geofence_radius ?? raw.radius_meters;
  const parsedRad =
    rawRad !== undefined && rawRad !== null && rawRad !== ''
      ? Number(rawRad)
      : prev.geofence_radius_meters;
  const cleanRad = typeof parsedRad === 'number' && Number.isFinite(parsedRad) ? parsedRad : null;

  const schoolLogo =
    raw.school_logo !== undefined || raw.school_logo_url !== undefined
      ? safeLogo(raw.school_logo_url ?? raw.school_logo)
      : prev.school_logo;

  const leftLogo =
    raw.left_logo !== undefined || raw.left_logo_url !== undefined
      ? safeLogo(raw.left_logo_url ?? raw.left_logo)
      : schoolLogo || prev.left_logo;

  const rightLogo =
    raw.right_logo !== undefined || raw.right_logo_url !== undefined
      ? safeLogo(raw.right_logo_url ?? raw.right_logo)
      : prev.right_logo;

  const isConfigured =
    typeof raw.is_configured === 'boolean'
      ? raw.is_configured
      : Boolean(resolvedId || resolvedName);

  return {
    school_id: resolvedId,
    deped_school_id: resolvedId,
    school_name: resolvedName,
    short_name: resolvedShort,
    region: resolvedRegion,
    division: resolvedDivision,
    district: resolvedDistrict,
    address: resolvedAddress,
    contact_number: resolvedContact,
    email: resolvedEmail,
    principal_name: resolvedPrincipal,
    principal_title: resolvedPrincipalTitle,
    academic_year: resolvedAcademicYear,
    latitude: typeof parsedLat === 'number' && Number.isFinite(parsedLat) ? parsedLat : null,
    longitude: typeof parsedLng === 'number' && Number.isFinite(parsedLng) ? parsedLng : null,
    geofence_radius_meters: cleanRad,
    geofence_radius: cleanRad,
    radius_meters: cleanRad,
    school_logo: schoolLogo,
    left_logo: leftLogo,
    right_logo: rightLogo,
    is_configured: isConfigured,
  };
};

const readWarmSchool = (): SchoolData => {
  try {
    const cachedSettings = peekApiCache<Record<string, unknown>>(API_ROUTES.school.settings);
    if (cachedSettings) {
      return normalizeSchoolPayload(cachedSettings, EMPTY_SCHOOL);
    }
    const cachedPublic = peekApiCache<Record<string, unknown>>(API_ROUTES.school.publicBranding);
    if (cachedPublic) {
      return normalizeSchoolPayload(cachedPublic, EMPTY_SCHOOL);
    }
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return EMPTY_SCHOOL;
    return normalizeSchoolPayload(JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, unknown>, EMPTY_SCHOOL);
  } catch {
    return EMPTY_SCHOOL;
  }
};

const SchoolContext = createContext<SchoolContextValue>({
  school: EMPTY_SCHOOL,
  loading: false,
  refreshSchool: async () => {},
  updateSchoolInstantly: () => {},
});

export const SchoolProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [school, setSchool] = useState<SchoolData>(readWarmSchool);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !school.school_name);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const updateSchoolInstantly = useCallback(
    (partial: Record<string, unknown> | Partial<SchoolData>) => {
      if (!partial || typeof partial !== 'object') return;
      setSchool((prev) => {
        const next = normalizeSchoolPayload(partial as Record<string, unknown>, prev);
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
        } catch {
          // Ignore storage quota limits
        }
        return next;
      });
    },
    []
  );

  const refreshSchool = useCallback(async () => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;

    const hasToken = Boolean(
      localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token') || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_access')
    );

    try {
      const endpoint = hasToken ? API_ROUTES.school.settings : API_ROUTES.school.publicBranding;
      const res = await apiClient.get<Record<string, unknown>>(endpoint, {
        params: { nocache: 1 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted || !res.data) return;

      setSchool((prev) => {
        const next = normalizeSchoolPayload(res.data, prev);
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
        } catch {
          // Ignore storage quota limits
        }
        return next;
      });
    } catch {
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      if (hasToken) {
        try {
          const fallbackRes = await apiClient.get<Record<string, unknown>>(
            API_ROUTES.school.publicBranding,
            { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal }
          );
          if (!controller.signal.aborted && fallbackRes.data) {
            setSchool((prev) => {
              const next = normalizeSchoolPayload(fallbackRes.data, prev);
              try {
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
              } catch {
                // Ignore storage quota limits
              }
              return next;
            });
          }
        } catch {
          // Retain last known branding when offline
        }
      }
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshSchool();
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [refreshSchool]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleCustomUpdate = () => {
      void refreshSchool();
    };
    window.addEventListener('attendsure:school-updated', handleCustomUpdate);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('attendsure:school-updated', handleCustomUpdate);
    };
  }, [refreshSchool]);

  return (
    <SchoolContext.Provider value={{ school, loading, refreshSchool, updateSchoolInstantly }}>
      {children}
    </SchoolContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useSchool = (): SchoolContextValue => useContext(SchoolContext);

/**
 * AttendSure - Theme Context & CSS Variable Engine
 * File: web/src/context/ThemeContext.tsx
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  THEME_PALETTES,
  BRAND_COLORS,
  FONTS,
  RADIUS,
  createStyles,
  type ThemeMode,
  type ThemeTokens,
} from '../theme/tokens';

interface ThemeContextValue {
  mode: ThemeMode;
  setThemeMode: (mode: ThemeMode) => void;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  tokens: ThemeTokens;
  brand: typeof BRAND_COLORS.light;
  fonts: typeof FONTS;
  radius: typeof RADIUS;
  ui: ReturnType<typeof createStyles>;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextValue | undefined>(undefined);
const STORAGE_KEY = 'attendsure_theme_mode';

export const ThemeProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ThemeMode>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) as ThemeMode;
    return saved && THEME_PALETTES[saved] ? saved : 'light';
  });

  const setThemeMode = useCallback((nextMode: ThemeMode) => {
    setMode(nextMode);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, nextMode);
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage quota errors
    }
  }, []);

  const toggleTheme = useCallback(() => {
    setMode((prev) => {
      const order: ThemeMode[] = ['light', 'dark', 'high-contrast'];
      const next = order[(order.indexOf(prev) + 1) % order.length];
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, next);
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage quota errors
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const tokens = THEME_PALETTES[mode];
  const brand = BRAND_COLORS[mode];
  const ui = useMemo(() => createStyles(tokens, brand), [tokens, brand]);

  // Sync CSS variables onto <html> so CSS files and common components automatically change color
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', mode);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-app', tokens.bgApp);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-canvas', tokens.bgCanvas);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-surface', tokens.bgSurface);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-surface-subtle', tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-input', tokens.bgInput);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-primary', tokens.textPrimary);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-secondary', tokens.textSecondary);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-muted', tokens.textMuted);
    root.style.setProperty('--on-primary', tokens.onPrimary);
    root.style.setProperty('--dark-surface', tokens.darkSurface);
    root.style.setProperty('--dark-text', tokens.darkText);
    root.style.setProperty('--border-subtle', tokens.borderSubtle);
    root.style.setProperty('--border-input', tokens.borderInput);
    root.style.setProperty('--border-strong', tokens.borderStrong);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-primary', brand.primary);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-button-bg', brand.buttonBg);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-success', brand.success);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-warning', brand.warning);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-danger', brand.danger);
    root.style.setProperty('--success', tokens.success);
    root.style.setProperty('--warning', tokens.warning);
    root.style.setProperty('--danger', tokens.danger);
    root.style.setProperty('--success-bg', tokens.successBg);
    root.style.setProperty('--warning-bg', tokens.warningBg);
    root.style.setProperty('--danger-bg', tokens.dangerBg);
    root.style.setProperty('--card-shadow', tokens.cardShadow);
    root.style.setProperty('--font-sans', FONTS.sans);
  }, [mode, tokens, brand]);

  // Keyboard shortcut: Alt + T cycles color themes
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 't') {
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleTheme();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [toggleTheme]);

  const contextValue = useMemo<ThemeContextValue>(
    () => ({ mode, setThemeMode, toggleTheme, tokens, brand, fonts: FONTS, radius: RADIUS, ui }),
    [mode, setThemeMode, toggleTheme, tokens, brand, ui]
  );

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useTheme = (): ThemeContextValue => {
  const ctx = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useTheme must be used inside ThemeProvider');
  return ctx;
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Zero-Lag SWR Data Hook (Instant Cache Hydration + Keep-Previous-Data)
 * File: web/src/hooks/useApiResource.ts
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache, subscribeApiCache } from '../api/client';
import { extractApiError } from '../api/routes';

export function useApiResource<T>(
  endpoint: string,
  initialValue: T,
  params?: Record<string, unknown>
) {
  const paramsKey = JSON.stringify(params || {});
  const stableParams = useMemo<Record<string, unknown> | undefined>(
    () => (paramsKey === '{}' ? undefined : JSON.parse(paramsKey)),
    [paramsKey]
  );

  const initialCached = useMemo(
    () => peekApiCache<T>(endpoint, stableParams),
    [endpoint, stableParams]
  );

  const [data, setData] = useState<T>(() =>
    initialCached !== undefined ? initialCached : initialValue
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => initialCached === undefined);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const hasDataRef = useRef<boolean>(initialCached !== undefined);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return subscribeApiCache(endpoint, stableParams, (freshPayload) => {
      hasDataRef.current = true;
      setData(freshPayload as T);
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    });
  }, [endpoint, stableParams]);

  const reload = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const warmHit = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<T>(endpoint, stableParams) : undefined;
      if (warmHit !== undefined) {
        hasDataRef.current = true;
        setData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
      } else if (!silent && !hasDataRef.current) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }

      setError(null);

      try {
        const reqParams = bypassCache
          ? { ...(stableParams || {}), nocache: 1 }
          : stableParams;
        const res = await apiClient.get<T>(endpoint, {
          params: reqParams,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        hasDataRef.current = true;
        setData(res.data);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') return;
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Unable to load records.'));
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [endpoint, stableParams]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void reload(hasDataRef.current, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [reload]);

  return { data, setData, loading, refreshing, error, reload };
}

/**
 * AttendSure - Debounced & AbortController-Safe Live Field Availability Hook
 * File: web/src/hooks/useFieldAvailability.ts
 */

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES } from '../api/routes';

export type AvailabilityFieldName =
  | 'username'
  | 'email'
  | 'employee_id'
  | 'contact_number'
  | 'lrn'
  | 'subject_code'
  | 'room_name';

export interface FieldAvailabilityOptions {
  enabled: boolean;
  field: AvailabilityFieldName;
  value: string;
  minLength?: number;
  formatError?: string;
  fallbackMessage?: string;
  excludeId?: number;
  excludeUserId?: number;
  excludeTeacherId?: number;
  debounceMs?: number;
}

export interface FieldAvailabilityState {
  checking: boolean;
  error: string;
  isTaken: boolean;
  verified: boolean;
}

const IDLE_STATE: FieldAvailabilityState = {
  checking: false,
  error: '',
  isTaken: false,
  verified: false,
};

export function useFieldAvailability({
  enabled,
  field,
  value,
  minLength = 2,
  formatError,
  fallbackMessage,
  excludeId,
  excludeUserId,
  excludeTeacherId,
  debounceMs = 300,
}: FieldAvailabilityOptions): FieldAvailabilityState {
  const trimmed = String(value || '').trim();
  const shouldFetch = enabled && !formatError && trimmed.length >= minLength;
  const requestKey = shouldFetch
    ? JSON.stringify([
        field,
        trimmed,
        excludeId ?? null,
        excludeUserId ?? null,
        excludeTeacherId ?? null,
      ])
    : '';

  const [asyncResult, setAsyncResult] = useState<{
    key: string;
    state: FieldAvailabilityState;
  }>({ key: '', state: IDLE_STATE });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!requestKey) return;

    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      setAsyncResult({ key: requestKey, state: { ...IDLE_STATE, checking: true } });
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.validateField, {
          params: {
            field,
            value: trimmed,
            exclude_id: excludeId,
            exclude_user_id: excludeUserId,
            exclude_teacher_id: excludeTeacherId,
            nocache: 1,
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const taken = Boolean(res.data?.is_taken);
        setAsyncResult({
          key: requestKey,
          state: {
            checking: false,
            error: taken ? String(res.data?.message || fallbackMessage || 'Already in use.') : '',
            isTaken: taken,
            verified: !taken,
          },
        });
      } catch {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setAsyncResult({ key: requestKey, state: IDLE_STATE });
        }
      }
    }, debounceMs);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [
    requestKey,
    field,
    trimmed,
    fallbackMessage,
    excludeId,
    excludeUserId,
    excludeTeacherId,
    debounceMs,
  ]);

  if (!enabled) return IDLE_STATE;
  if (formatError) {
    return { checking: false, error: formatError, isTaken: false, verified: false };
  }
  if (!requestKey) return IDLE_STATE;
  return asyncResult.key === requestKey ? asyncResult.state : IDLE_STATE;
}

/**
 * AttendSure - Unified Print, PDF, Excel, Word, CSV & JSON Export Hook for Official DepEd Reports
 * File: web/src/hooks/useOfficialReportExport.ts
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { RefObject } from 'react';
import { exportToCsv } from '../components/common/Pagination';
import {
  DEFAULT_DEPED_LANDSCAPE_SETUP,
  resolvePaperDimensionsInches,
} from '../components/reports/ReportViewerShell';
import {
  buildAuditStamp,
  exportElementToExcel,
  exportElementToLocalPdf,
  exportElementToWord,
  exportReportJson,
  logOfficialReportAudit,
  saveBlobWithOptionalPicker,
  type AuditStampMeta,
} from '../utils/reportExporters';
import { useAlert } from '../context/AlertContext';
import type { PageSetupConfig } from '../types/pageSetup';

export interface OfficialReportExportOptions<TReport> {
  formCode: 'SF1' | 'SF2' | 'SF4';
  reportData: TReport | null;
  reportRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  schoolId?: string;
  sectionId?: string | number;
  getBaseFilename: () => string;
  buildCsvData: () => { headers: string[]; rows: Array<Array<string | number>> };
  initialPageSetup?: PageSetupConfig;
}

const FORMULA_PREFIX_RE = /^[=+\-@\t\r|]/;

const escapeCsvCell = (val: unknown): string => {
  const raw = String(val ?? '');
  const safe = FORMULA_PREFIX_RE.test(raw.trimStart()) ? `'${raw}` : raw;
  return `"${safe.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
};

export function useOfficialReportExport<TReport>({
  formCode,
  reportData,
  reportRef,
  schoolId,
  sectionId,
  getBaseFilename,
  buildCsvData,
  initialPageSetup = DEFAULT_DEPED_LANDSCAPE_SETUP,
}: OfficialReportExportOptions<TReport>) {
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const [isExportingPdf, setIsExportingPdf] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [auditMeta, setAuditMeta] = useState<AuditStampMeta>(() => buildAuditStamp(formCode));
  const [pageConfig, setPageConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(initialPageSetup);
  const [isPageSetupOpen, setIsPageSetupOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const { widthIn: pageWidthInches, heightIn: pageHeightInches } = useMemo(
    () => resolvePaperDimensionsInches(pageConfig),
    [pageConfig]
  );

  const refreshAuditMeta = useCallback(
    (schoolIdOverride?: string) => {
      const next = buildAuditStamp(formCode, schoolIdOverride || schoolId);
      setAuditMeta(next);
      return next;
    },
    [formCode, schoolId]
  );

  const logAudit = useCallback(
    (action: 'VIEW' | 'PRINT' | 'PDF' | 'EXCEL' | 'WORD' | 'CSV' | 'JSON', meta: AuditStampMeta) => {
      void logOfficialReportAudit({
        reportName: formCode,
        trackingId: meta.trackingId,
        printedAt: meta.printedAt,
        action,
        sectionId,
      });
    },
    [formCode, sectionId]
  );

  const stampView = useCallback(
    (schoolIdOverride?: string) => {
      const meta = refreshAuditMeta(schoolIdOverride);
      logAudit('VIEW', meta);
      return meta;
    },
    [refreshAuditMeta, logAudit]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforePrint = () => {
      refreshAuditMeta();
      setIsPrinting(true);
    };
    const handleAfterPrint = () => {
      setIsPrinting(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
    window.addEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
      window.removeEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    };
  }, [refreshAuditMeta]);

  const handleDirectPrint = useCallback(() => {
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    logAudit('PRINT', meta);
    setIsPrinting(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      window.print();
      setTimeout(() => setIsPrinting(false), 400);
    }, 180);
  }, [refreshAuditMeta, logAudit]);

  const handleExportPdf = useCallback(
    async (usePicker = false) => {
      if (!reportData || !reportRef.current) return;
      const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
      logAudit('PDF', meta);

      setIsExportingPdf(true);
      setIsPrinting(true);
      try {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
        await exportElementToLocalPdf({
          element: reportRef.current,
          filename: `${getBaseFilename()}.pdf`,
          pageWidthInches,
          pageHeightInches,
          orientation: pageConfig.orientation,
          pageColor: pageConfig.pageColor,
          pageless: pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless',
          usePicker,
        });
      } catch {
        showAlert({
          title: 'Opening Print Dialog',
          message: 'Choose "Save as PDF" in your browser print dialog.',
          type: 'info',
        });
        handleDirectPrint();
      } finally {
        setIsPrinting(false);
        setIsExportingPdf(false);
      }
    },
    [
      reportData,
      reportRef,
      refreshAuditMeta,
      logAudit,
      getBaseFilename,
      pageWidthInches,
      pageHeightInches,
      pageConfig.orientation,
      pageConfig.pageColor,
      pageConfig.layoutMode,
      showAlert,
      handleDirectPrint,
    ]
  );

  const handleExportCsv = useCallback(
    async (usePicker = false) => {
      if (!reportData) return;
      const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
      logAudit('CSV', meta);
      const { headers, rows } = buildCsvData();
      const filename = `${getBaseFilename()}.csv`;

      if (usePicker) {
        const csvString =
          '\uFEFF' +
          [headers.map(escapeCsvCell).join(','), ...rows.map((r) => r.map(escapeCsvCell).join(','))].join(
            '\r\n'
          );
        const blob = new Blob([csvString], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
        await saveBlobWithOptionalPicker(blob, filename, 'text/csv', 'csv', 'CSV Spreadsheet (*.csv)');
      } else {
        exportToCsv(filename, headers, rows);
      }
    },
    [reportData, refreshAuditMeta, logAudit, buildCsvData, getBaseFilename]
  );

  const handleExportExcel = useCallback(
    async (usePicker = false) => {
      if (!reportData || !reportRef.current) return;
      const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
      logAudit('EXCEL', meta);
      await exportElementToExcel(reportRef.current, getBaseFilename(), meta, usePicker);
    },
    [reportData, reportRef, refreshAuditMeta, logAudit, getBaseFilename]
  );

  const handleExportWord = useCallback(
    async (usePicker = false) => {
      if (!reportData || !reportRef.current) return;
      const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
      logAudit('WORD', meta);
      await exportElementToWord(reportRef.current, getBaseFilename(), meta, usePicker);
    },
    [reportData, reportRef, refreshAuditMeta, logAudit, getBaseFilename]
  );

  const handleExportJson = useCallback(
    async (usePicker = false) => {
      if (!reportData) return;
      const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
      logAudit('JSON', meta);
      await exportReportJson(getBaseFilename(), meta, reportData, usePicker);
    },
    [reportData, refreshAuditMeta, logAudit, getBaseFilename]
  );

  return {
    auditMeta,
    isExportingPdf,
    isPrinting,
    pageConfig,
    setPageConfig,
    isPageSetupOpen,
    setIsPageSetupOpen,
    pageWidthInches,
    pageHeightInches,
    refreshAuditMeta,
    stampView,
    handleDirectPrint,
    handleExportPdf,
    handleExportCsv,
    handleExportExcel,
    handleExportWord,
    handleExportJson,
  };
}

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP, MARGIN_PRESETS, PAPER_SIZES } from '../types/pageSetup';
import type {
  HeaderRepeatMode,
  LayoutMode,
  MarginPresetKey,
  PageOrientation,
  PageSetupConfig,
  PaperSizeKey,
} from '../types/pageSetup';

const GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY = 'attendsure_page_setup_default';
const HEX_COLOR_RE = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/;

const clampMargin = (val: unknown, fallback: number): number => {
  const num = Number(val);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num) || num < 0 || num > 4) return fallback;
  return num;
};

const sanitizePageSetup = (raw: unknown): PageSetupConfig => {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP;
  const r = raw as Partial<PageSetupConfig>;

  const layoutMode: LayoutMode =
    r.layoutMode === 'pages' || r.layoutMode === 'pageless'
      ? r.layoutMode
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.layoutMode;

  const orientation: PageOrientation =
    r.orientation === 'portrait' || r.orientation === 'landscape'
      ? r.orientation
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.orientation;

  const paperSize: PaperSizeKey =
    r.paperSize && r.paperSize in PAPER_SIZES
      ? r.paperSize
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.paperSize;

  const marginPreset: MarginPresetKey =
    r.marginPreset && r.marginPreset in MARGIN_PRESETS
      ? r.marginPreset
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.marginPreset;

  const headerRepeat: HeaderRepeatMode =
    r.headerRepeat === 'all_pages' || r.headerRepeat === 'first_page_only'
      ? r.headerRepeat
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.headerRepeat;

  const pageColor =
    typeof r.pageColor === 'string' && HEX_COLOR_RE.test(r.pageColor.trim())
      ? r.pageColor.trim()
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.pageColor;

  const rawMargins = r.margins || DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins;
  const margins = {
    top: clampMargin(rawMargins.top, DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins.top),
    bottom: clampMargin(rawMargins.bottom, DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins.bottom),
    left: clampMargin(rawMargins.left, DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins.left),
    right: clampMargin(rawMargins.right, DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins.right),
  };

  return {
    layoutMode,
    orientation,
    paperSize,
    pageColor,
    marginPreset,
    margins,
    headerRepeat,
  };
};

export const usePageSetup = (reportKey: string = 'general') => {
  const specificKey = `attendsure_page_setup_${reportKey}`;

  const loadInitial = useCallback((): PageSetupConfig => {
    try {
      const specific = localStorage.getItem(specificKey);
      if (specific) return sanitizePageSetup(JSON.parse(specific));

      const globalDefault = localStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY);
      if (globalDefault) return sanitizePageSetup(JSON.parse(globalDefault));
    } catch {
      // Ignore malformed storage values
    }
    return DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP;
  }, [specificKey]);

  const [config, setConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(loadInitial);

  // Sync state if localStorage changes from another tab/window
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => {
      if (e.key === specificKey || e.key === GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY) {
        setConfig(loadInitial());
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
  }, [specificKey, loadInitial]);

  const saveConfig = useCallback(
    (newConfig: PageSetupConfig, setAsGlobalDefault: boolean = false) => {
      const safe = sanitizePageSetup(newConfig);
      setConfig(safe);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(specificKey, JSON.stringify(safe));
        if (setAsGlobalDefault) {
          localStorage.setItem(GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY, JSON.stringify(safe));
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage quota issues
      }
    },
    [specificKey]
  );

  return { config, saveConfig };
};

const SAFE_RASTER_DATA_URI = /^data:image\/(png|jpeg|jpg|webp);base64,/i;

export const isSafeImageUrl = (url?: string | null): boolean => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  const clean = trimmed.toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || clean === 'null' || clean === 'undefined' || clean === 'none') return false;
  if (
    clean.startsWith('javascript:') ||
    clean.startsWith('vbscript:') ||
    clean.startsWith('file:') ||
    clean.startsWith('blob:') ||
    clean.startsWith('data:text/') ||
    clean.startsWith('data:image/svg')
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (clean.startsWith('data:')) {
    return SAFE_RASTER_DATA_URI.test(trimmed);
  }
  if (clean.startsWith('/media/')) {
    return !clean.includes('..');
  }
  if (clean.startsWith('/')) {
    return !clean.startsWith('//') && !clean.includes('..');
  }
  return clean.startsWith('http://') || clean.startsWith('https://');
};

export const sanitizeText = (text: string, maxLength = 150): string => {
  return String(text || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Centralized Clipboard Utility & Copy Feedback Hook
 * File: web/src/utils/clipboard.ts
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export const copyTextToClipboard = async (text: string): Promise<boolean> => {
  const cleanText = String(text || '').trim();
  if (!cleanText) return false;

  if (
    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' &&
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText &&
    (typeof window === 'undefined' || window.isSecureContext)
  ) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(cleanText);
      return true;
    } catch {
      // Fall through to offscreen textarea copy on non-HTTPS LAN origins or denied clipboard permissions
    }
  }

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
    textArea.value = cleanText;
    textArea.setAttribute('readonly', '');
    textArea.style.position = 'fixed';
    textArea.style.left = '-999999px';
    textArea.style.top = '-999999px';
    document.body.appendChild(textArea);
    textArea.focus();
    textArea.select();
    let copied: boolean;
    try {
      copied = document.execCommand('copy');
    } catch {
      copied = false;
    }
    textArea.remove();
    return copied;
  }

  return false;
};

export function useCopyFeedback(timeoutMs = 2000) {
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    if (timerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = null;
    }
    setCopiedKey(null);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
        timerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const markCopied = useCallback(
    (key = 'default') => {
      setCopiedKey(key);
      if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setCopiedKey((prev) => (prev === key ? null : prev));
        timerRef.current = null;
      }, timeoutMs);
    },
    [timeoutMs]
  );

  const copy = useCallback(
    async (text: string, key = text): Promise<boolean> => {
      const ok = await copyTextToClipboard(text);
      if (ok) {
        markCopied(key);
      }
      return ok;
    },
    [markCopied]
  );

  return {
    copiedKey,
    copied: copiedKey !== null,
    copy,
    markCopied,
    reset,
  };
}

/**
 * AttendSure - Centralized Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Permission Matrix
 * File: web/src/utils/permissions.ts
 *
 * Enforces the exact 5-profile visibility & action matrix across the Web Portal:
 *  - ADMIN (System Administrator)
 *  - PRINCIPAL (School Principal)
 *  - DEPT_HEAD (Department Head)
 *  - TEACHER (can_handle_classes = true  / Teaching Staff & Homeroom Adviser)
 *  - TEACHER (can_handle_classes = false / Non-Teaching School Staff)
 */

export type StaffRole = 'ADMIN' | 'PRINCIPAL' | 'DEPT_HEAD' | 'TEACHER';

export type WebTabId =
  | 'dashboard'
  | 'classroom-scanner'
  | 'my-classes'
  | 'advisory-monitor'
  | 'geofence'
  | 'students'
  | 'gate-passes'
  | 'teachers'
  | 'dtr'
  | 'reports'
  | 'impact'
  | 'schedules'
  | 'users'
  | 'settings';

export interface PermissionUser {
  role?: string | null;
  can_handle_classes?: boolean | null;
  can_teach?: boolean | null;
  teacher_id?: number | string | null;
  is_superuser?: boolean | null;
}

const VALID_ROLES: ReadonlySet<StaffRole> = new Set([
  'ADMIN',
  'PRINCIPAL',
  'DEPT_HEAD',
  'TEACHER',
]);

export function normalizeRole(user?: PermissionUser | null): StaffRole {
  if (user?.is_superuser) return 'ADMIN';
  const raw = String(user?.role || '').trim().toUpperCase() as StaffRole;
  return VALID_ROLES.has(raw) ? raw : 'TEACHER';
}

export function isTeachingStaff(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  const role = normalizeRole(user);
  if (role === 'ADMIN' || role === 'PRINCIPAL' || role === 'DEPT_HEAD') {
    return true;
  }
  if (user?.can_handle_classes !== undefined && user?.can_handle_classes !== null) {
    return Boolean(user.can_handle_classes);
  }
  if (user?.can_teach !== undefined && user?.can_teach !== null) {
    return Boolean(user.can_teach);
  }
  return true;
}

export function isSystemAdmin(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  return normalizeRole(user) === 'ADMIN';
}

export function isAdminOrPrincipal(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  const role = normalizeRole(user);
  return role === 'ADMIN' || role === 'PRINCIPAL';
}

export function isSchoolLeader(user?: PermissionUser | null): boolean {
  const role = normalizeRole(user);
  return role === 'ADMIN' || role === 'PRINCIPAL' || role === 'DEPT_HEAD';
}

const TAB_ACCESS_BY_ROLE: Record<StaffRole, ReadonlyArray<WebTabId>> = {

const NON_TEACHING_TEACHER_TABS: ReadonlyArray<WebTabId> = [
  'dashboard',
  'geofence',
  'gate-passes',
  'dtr',
];

export function getAllowedTabs(user?: PermissionUser | null): WebTabId[] {
  const role = normalizeRole(user);
  if (role === 'TEACHER' && !isTeachingStaff(user)) {
    return [...NON_TEACHING_TEACHER_TABS];
  }
  return [...TAB_ACCESS_BY_ROLE[role]];
}

export function canViewTab(user: PermissionUser | null | undefined, tabId: string): boolean {
  return getAllowedTabs(user).includes(tabId as WebTabId);
}

/**
 * Add or Edit Student / Change Enrollment:
 * - ADMIN & PRINCIPAL: Full access across all sections
 * - DEPT_HEAD: Read-only (returns false)
 * - TEACHER (teaching): Allowed ONLY for sections where they are the assigned Homeroom Adviser
 * - TEACHER (non-teaching): Hidden (returns false)
 */
export function canManageStudents(
  user?: PermissionUser | null,
  advisedSectionIds?: ReadonlyArray<number> | null,
  targetSectionId?: number | null
): boolean {
  if (isAdminOrPrincipal(user)) return true;
  const role = normalizeRole(user);
  if (role !== 'TEACHER' || !isTeachingStaff(user)) return false;
  if (!advisedSectionIds || advisedSectionIds.length === 0) return false;
  if (targetSectionId !== undefined && targetSectionId !== null) {
    return advisedSectionIds.includes(Number(targetSectionId));
  }
  return true;
}

export function getCurrentUserFromStorage(): PermissionUser {
  try {
    const role = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'TEACHER';
    const rawTeach = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_can_teach');
    const teacherId = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_teacher_id');
    const isSuper = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_is_superuser') === 'true';
    return {
      role,
      can_handle_classes: rawTeach === null ? true : rawTeach === 'true',
      can_teach: rawTeach === null ? true : rawTeach === 'true',
      teacher_id: teacherId ? Number(teacherId) : null,
      is_superuser: isSuper,
    };
  } catch {
    return { role: 'TEACHER', can_handle_classes: true, can_teach: true };
  }
}

export interface AuditStampMeta {
  printedAt: string;
  trackingId: string;

export const buildAuditStamp = (formCode: string, schoolId?: string): AuditStampMeta => {
  const now = new Date();
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  const dateFormatted = now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
  });
  const timeFormatted = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    second: '2-digit',
    hour12: true,
  });
  const dateStamp = `${now.getFullYear()}${pad(now.getMonth() + 1)}${pad(now.getDate())}`;
  const timeCode = `${pad(now.getHours())}${pad(now.getMinutes())}${pad(now.getSeconds())}`;
  return {
    printedAt: `${dateFormatted} at ${timeFormatted}`,
    trackingId: `DOC-${formCode.toUpperCase()}-${schoolId || 'SCH'}-${dateStamp}-${timeCode}`,
  };
};
