export const triggerBlobDownload = (blob: Blob, filename: string): void => {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
};

export const saveBlobWithOptionalPicker = async (
  blob: Blob,
  suggestedName: string,
  mimeType: string,
  extension: string,
  description: string
): Promise<void> => {
  if ('showSaveFilePicker' in window) {
    try {
      const picker = (
        window as unknown as {
          showSaveFilePicker: (opts: unknown) => Promise<{
            createWritable: () => Promise<{
              write: (b: Blob) => Promise<void>;
              close: () => Promise<void>;
            }>;
          }>;
        }
      ).showSaveFilePicker;
      const handle = await picker({
        suggestedName,
        types: [{ description, accept: { [mimeType]: [`.${extension}`] } }],
      });
      const writable = await handle.createWritable();
      await writable.write(blob);
      await writable.close();
      return;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if ((err as { name?: string })?.name === 'AbortError') return;
    }
  }
  triggerBlobDownload(blob, suggestedName);
};

/**
 * Detects whether a captured canvas slice contains visible non-background ink
 * so completely blank trailing slices are never added as empty PDF pages.
 */
const canvasHasVisibleInk = (
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  width: number,
  height: number,
  bgRgb: [number, number, number]
): boolean => {
  if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return false;
  try {
    const sampleStepX = Math.max(1, Math.floor(width / 120));
    const sampleStepY = Math.max(1, Math.floor(height / 120));
    const data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, width, height).data;
    let nonBgCount = 0;
    for (let y = 0; y < height; y += sampleStepY) {
      for (let x = 0; x < width; x += sampleStepX) {
        const idx = (y * width + x) * 4;
        const a = data[idx + 3];
        if (a < 10) continue;
        const dr = Math.abs(data[idx] - bgRgb[0]);
        const dg = Math.abs(data[idx + 1] - bgRgb[1]);
        const db = Math.abs(data[idx + 2] - bgRgb[2]);
        if (dr + dg + db > 24) {
          nonBgCount += 1;
          if (nonBgCount >= 6) return true;
        }
      }
    }
    return false;
  } catch {
    return true;
  }
};

const hexToRgbTuple = (hex?: string): [number, number, number] => {
  const clean = String(hex || '#ffffff').replace('#', '').trim();
  if (clean.length === 3) {
    return [
      parseInt(clean[0] + clean[0], 16) || 255,
      parseInt(clean[1] + clean[1], 16) || 255,
      parseInt(clean[2] + clean[2], 16) || 255,
    ];
  }
  if (clean.length === 6) {
    return [
      parseInt(clean.slice(0, 2), 16) || 255,
      parseInt(clean.slice(2, 4), 16) || 255,
      parseInt(clean.slice(4, 6), 16) || 255,
    ];
  }
  return [255, 255, 255];
};

const fillPdfPageBackground = (
  doc: { setFillColor: (r: number, g: number, b: number) => void; rect: (x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, style: string) => void },
  wIn: number,
  hIn: number,
  bgRgb: [number, number, number]
) => {
  if (bgRgb[0] === 255 && bgRgb[1] === 255 && bgRgb[2] === 255) return;
  doc.setFillColor(bgRgb[0], bgRgb[1], bgRgb[2]);
  doc.rect(0, 0, wIn, hIn, 'F');
};

/**
 * Generates a crisp, zero-cut, zero-blank-page PDF locally using html2canvas + jsPDF.
 * - Discrete pages (`[data-print-page="true"]` / `.sf*-sheet-page` / `.csc-print-page` / `.print-pack-page`)
 *   are each captured individually and scaled proportionally to fit cleanly inside the target sheet,
 *   guaranteeing exact page count with zero clipped footers and zero blank trailing pages.
 * - Pageless mode exports one seamless continuous sheet sized to content height.
 * - Continuous multi-page content slices cleanly and automatically discards blank remainder pages.
 */
export const exportElementToLocalPdf = async (opts: {
  element: HTMLElement;
  filename: string;
  pageWidthInches: number;
  pageHeightInches: number;
  orientation: PageOrientation;
  pageColor?: string;
  pageless?: boolean;
  marginsInches?: [number, number, number, number];
  usePicker?: boolean;
}): Promise<void> => {
  const [{ default: html2canvas }, { jsPDF }] = await Promise.all([
    import('html2canvas'),
    import('jspdf'),
  ]);

  const finalName = opts.filename.endsWith('.pdf') ? opts.filename : `${opts.filename}.pdf`;
  const [mTop, mRight, mBottom, mLeft] = opts.marginsInches || [0, 0, 0, 0];
  const pageBg = opts.pageColor || '#ffffff';
  const bgRgb = hexToRgbTuple(pageBg);
  const availW = Math.max(1, opts.pageWidthInches - mLeft - mRight);
  const availH = Math.max(1, opts.pageHeightInches - mTop - mBottom);

  const captureNode = async (node: HTMLElement): Promise<HTMLCanvasElement> => {
    const prevShadow = node.style.boxShadow;
    const prevBorder = node.style.border;
    const prevMarginBottom = node.style.marginBottom;
    const prevRadius = node.style.borderRadius;
    node.style.boxShadow = 'none';
    node.style.border = 'none';
    node.style.marginBottom = '0px';
    node.style.borderRadius = '0px';
    try {
      return await html2canvas(node, {
        scale: 2,
        useCORS: true,
        allowTaint: false,
        logging: false,
        scrollX: 0,
        scrollY: 0,
        backgroundColor: pageBg,
      });
    } finally {
      node.style.boxShadow = prevShadow;
      node.style.border = prevBorder;
      node.style.marginBottom = prevMarginBottom;
      node.style.borderRadius = prevRadius;
    }
  };

  const discreteSelector =
    '[data-print-page="true"], .sf1-sheet-page, .sf2-sheet-page, .sf4-sheet-page, .csc-print-page, .print-pack-page';
  const rawNodes = opts.element.matches(discreteSelector)
    ? [opts.element]
    : Array.from(opts.element.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(discreteSelector));
  const pageNodes = rawNodes.filter((el) => el.offsetHeight > 8 && el.offsetWidth > 8);

  let doc: InstanceType<typeof jsPDF>;

  if (opts.pageless) {
    const canvas = await captureNode(opts.element);
    const naturalHIn = canvas.width > 0 ? (canvas.height / canvas.width) * availW : availH;
    const totalPageH = Math.max(opts.pageHeightInches, naturalHIn + mTop + mBottom);
    const orientation: PageOrientation = opts.pageWidthInches >= totalPageH ? 'landscape' : 'portrait';
    doc = new jsPDF({
      unit: 'in',
      orientation,
      format: [opts.pageWidthInches, totalPageH],
      compress: true,
    });
    fillPdfPageBackground(doc, opts.pageWidthInches, totalPageH, bgRgb);
    const imgData = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.96);
    doc.addImage(imgData, 'JPEG', mLeft, mTop, availW, naturalHIn, undefined, 'FAST');
  } else if (pageNodes.length > 0) {
    doc = new jsPDF({
      unit: 'in',
      orientation: opts.orientation,
      format: [opts.pageWidthInches, opts.pageHeightInches],
      compress: true,
    });

    let addedPages = 0;
    for (const node of pageNodes) {
      const canvas = await captureNode(node);
      if (canvas.width <= 2 || canvas.height <= 2) continue;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
      if (ctx && !canvasHasVisibleInk(ctx, canvas.width, canvas.height, bgRgb)) continue;

      if (addedPages > 0) {
        doc.addPage([opts.pageWidthInches, opts.pageHeightInches], opts.orientation);
      }
      fillPdfPageBackground(doc, opts.pageWidthInches, opts.pageHeightInches, bgRgb);

      // Scale-to-fit inside printable bounds so content is NEVER cut off or spilled to a blank page
      const scale = Math.min(availW / canvas.width, availH / canvas.height);
      const drawW = canvas.width * scale;
      const drawH = canvas.height * scale;
      const offsetX = mLeft + Math.max(0, (availW - drawW) / 2);
      const offsetY = mTop;

      const imgData = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.96);
      doc.addImage(imgData, 'JPEG', offsetX, offsetY, drawW, drawH, undefined, 'FAST');
      addedPages += 1;
    }
  } else {
    const fullCanvas = await captureNode(opts.element);
    doc = new jsPDF({
      unit: 'in',
      orientation: opts.orientation,
      format: [opts.pageWidthInches, opts.pageHeightInches],
      compress: true,
    });

    const pxPerInch = fullCanvas.width / availW;
    const sliceHeightPx = Math.max(100, Math.floor(availH * pxPerInch));

    // If total content fits within 106% of 1 page, scale neatly to 1 crisp uncut page
    if (fullCanvas.height <= sliceHeightPx * 1.06) {
      fillPdfPageBackground(doc, opts.pageWidthInches, opts.pageHeightInches, bgRgb);
      const scale = Math.min(availW / fullCanvas.width, availH / fullCanvas.height);
      const drawW = fullCanvas.width * scale;
      const drawH = fullCanvas.height * scale;
      const offsetX = mLeft + Math.max(0, (availW - drawW) / 2);
      doc.addImage(fullCanvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.96), 'JPEG', offsetX, mTop, drawW, drawH, undefined, 'FAST');
    } else {
      let yOffset = 0;
      let pageIndex = 0;
      while (yOffset < fullCanvas.height) {
        const remaining = fullCanvas.height - yOffset;
        if (remaining < 14) break;
        const currentSliceH = Math.min(sliceHeightPx, remaining);

        const sliceCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        sliceCanvas.width = fullCanvas.width;
        sliceCanvas.height = currentSliceH;
        const sliceCtx = sliceCanvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
        if (!sliceCtx) break;
        sliceCtx.fillStyle = pageBg;
        sliceCtx.fillRect(0, 0, sliceCanvas.width, sliceCanvas.height);
        sliceCtx.drawImage(
          fullCanvas,
          0,
          yOffset,
          fullCanvas.width,
          currentSliceH,
          0,
          0,
          fullCanvas.width,
          currentSliceH
        );

        if (canvasHasVisibleInk(sliceCtx, sliceCanvas.width, sliceCanvas.height, bgRgb)) {
          if (pageIndex > 0) {
            doc.addPage([opts.pageWidthInches, opts.pageHeightInches], opts.orientation);
          }
          fillPdfPageBackground(doc, opts.pageWidthInches, opts.pageHeightInches, bgRgb);
          const drawHIn = currentSliceH / pxPerInch;
          doc.addImage(
            sliceCanvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.96),
            'JPEG',
            mLeft,
            mTop,
            availW,
            Math.min(availH, drawHIn),
            undefined,
            'FAST'
          );
          pageIndex += 1;
        }
        yOffset += currentSliceH;
      }
    }
  }

  if (opts.usePicker) {
    const pdfBlob = doc.output('blob');
    await saveBlobWithOptionalPicker(
      pdfBlob,
      finalName,
      'application/pdf',
      'pdf',
      'PDF Document (*.pdf)'
    );
  } else {
    doc.save(finalName);
  }
};

/**
 * Opens a clean hidden iframe print dialog respecting PageSetupConfig paper size,
 * orientation, margins, and paper tint with zero blank trailing pages and zero cut cards.
 */
export const printHtmlWithPageSetup = (opts: {
  title: string;
  bodyHtml: string;
  pageConfig: PageSetupConfig;
  extraCss?: string;
  auditFooter?: AuditStampMeta;
}): void => {
  const paper = PAPER_SIZES[opts.pageConfig.paperSize] || PAPER_SIZES.a4;
  const isLandscape = opts.pageConfig.orientation === 'landscape';
  const widthIn = isLandscape ? paper.height : paper.width;
  const heightIn = isLandscape ? paper.width : paper.height;
  const { top, right, bottom, left } = opts.pageConfig.margins;
  const pageBg = opts.pageConfig.pageColor || '#ffffff';

  const footerHtml = opts.auditFooter
    ? `<div class="print-audit-foot">Document ID: ${escapeHtml(opts.auditFooter.trackingId)} &bull; Printed: ${escapeHtml(opts.auditFooter.printedAt)}</div>`
    : '';

  const fullHtml = `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <title>${escapeHtml(opts.title)}</title>
  <style>
    @page {
      size: ${widthIn}in ${heightIn}in;
      margin: ${top}in ${right}in ${bottom}in ${left}in;
    }
    html, body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: ${pageBg};
      color: #000000;
      font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
      -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
      print-color-adjust: exact;
    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; page-break-inside: auto; }
    thead { display: table-header-group; }
    tr, .qr-card-item, .sig-block, .id-pass-card { break-inside: avoid; page-break-inside: avoid; }
    .print-pack-page, [data-print-page="true"] {
      width: 100% !important;
      min-height: 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
      border: none !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
      background: ${pageBg} !important;
    }
    .print-pack-page:not(:last-child), [data-print-page="true"]:not(:last-child) {
      page-break-after: always;
      break-after: page;
    }
    .print-pack-page:last-child, [data-print-page="true"]:last-child {
      page-break-after: avoid;
      break-after: avoid;
    }
    .print-audit-foot {
      margin-top: 8px;
      font-size: 8.5px;
      color: #475569;
      text-align: right;
      break-inside: avoid;
    }
    ${opts.extraCss || ''}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  ${opts.bodyHtml}
  ${footerHtml}
</body>
</html>`;

  const blob = new Blob([fullHtml], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });
  const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
  iframe.style.position = 'fixed';
  iframe.style.right = '0';
  iframe.style.bottom = '0';
  iframe.style.width = '0';
  iframe.style.height = '0';
  iframe.style.border = '0';
  iframe.src = blobUrl;

  iframe.onload = () => {
    try {
      iframe.contentWindow?.focus();
      iframe.contentWindow?.print();
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (iframe.parentNode) iframe.parentNode.removeChild(iframe);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
      }, 2000);
    }
  };
  document.body.appendChild(iframe);
};

/**
 * AttendSure Web - Teacher Time In/Out & Class Period Alarm Sound + Reminder Engine
 * File: web/src/utils/scheduleAlarms.ts
 *
 * Uses built-in Web Audio API synthesis (zero external audio files or CDN calls)
 * plus optional browser desktop alerts to ring when it is time for:
 * 1. Teacher TIME IN (start of school duty)
 * 2. Teacher TIME OUT (end of school duty)
 * 3. Scheduled Class Period start
 */

export type AlarmKind = 'TIME_IN' | 'TIME_OUT' | 'CLASS_PERIOD';

export interface ActiveAlarmEvent {
  id: string;
  kind: AlarmKind;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  timeLabel: string;
  detail: string;
  actionLabel: string;
  targetTab: 'classroom-scanner' | 'geofence' | 'dtr';
}

export interface AlarmClassSlot {

  subject_code: string;
  subject_title: string;

  grade_level?: string;
  room_number?: string;

export interface AlarmScheduleSnapshot {

const ALARM_ENABLED_KEY = 'attendsure_web_alarms_enabled';
const ALARM_DISMISSED_PREFIX = 'attendsure_web_dismissed_alarms_';

let sharedAudioCtx: AudioContext | null = null;
let alarmLoopHandle: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

function getAudioContext(): AudioContext | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    const AudioCtx =
      window.AudioContext ||
      (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtx) return null;
    if (!sharedAudioCtx || sharedAudioCtx.state === 'closed') {
      sharedAudioCtx = new AudioCtx();
    }
    if (sharedAudioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
      void sharedAudioCtx.resume().catch(() => {});
    }
    return sharedAudioCtx;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function unlockWebAlarmAudio(): void {
  getAudioContext();
}

const MELODIES: Record<AlarmKind, { freqs: number[]; noteSec: number; gapSec: number; wave: OscillatorType }> = {
  TIME_IN: {
    freqs: [587.33, 739.99, 880, 1174.66],
    noteSec: 0.16,
    gapSec: 0.05,
    wave: 'triangle',
  },
  TIME_OUT: {
    freqs: [1046.5, 880, 783.99, 523.25],
    noteSec: 0.18,
    gapSec: 0.05,
    wave: 'sine',
  },
  CLASS_PERIOD: {
    freqs: [880, 1108.73, 880, 1318.51, 1318.51],
    noteSec: 0.15,
    gapSec: 0.05,
    wave: 'triangle',
  },
};

export function playWebAlarmChime(kind: AlarmKind): void {
  const ctx = getAudioContext();
  if (!ctx) return;

  try {
    const pattern = MELODIES[kind] || MELODIES.CLASS_PERIOD;
    let cursor = ctx.currentTime + 0.02;

    for (const freq of pattern.freqs) {
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = pattern.wave;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, cursor);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, cursor);
      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.22, cursor + 0.02);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, cursor + pattern.noteSec);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);

      osc.start(cursor);
      osc.stop(cursor + pattern.noteSec + 0.01);
      cursor += pattern.noteSec + pattern.gapSec;
    }
  } catch {
    // Browser autoplay policy may block before user interaction
  }
}

export function startWebAlarmLoop(kind: AlarmKind): void {
  stopWebAlarmLoop();
  playWebAlarmChime(kind);
  alarmLoopHandle = setInterval(() => {
    playWebAlarmChime(kind);
  }, 3400);
}

export function stopWebAlarmLoop(): void {
  if (alarmLoopHandle) {
    clearInterval(alarmLoopHandle);
    alarmLoopHandle = null;
  }
}

export function sendBrowserDesktopAlert(title: string, body: string): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('Notification' in window)) return;
  try {
    if (window.Notification.permission === 'granted') {
      new window.Notification(title, { body, silent: false });
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore restricted desktop notification contexts
  }
}

export async function requestBrowserAlertPermission(): Promise<NotificationPermission | 'unsupported'> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('Notification' in window)) return 'unsupported';
  try {
    return await window.Notification.requestPermission();
  } catch {
    return 'denied';
  }
}

export function getWebAlarmsEnabled(): boolean {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(ALARM_ENABLED_KEY);
    return raw === null ? true : raw === 'true';
  } catch {
    return true;
  }
}

export function setWebAlarmsEnabled(enabled: boolean): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(ALARM_ENABLED_KEY, enabled ? 'true' : 'false');
  } catch {}
}

export function getLocalDateStamp(dateObj: Date = new Date()): string {
  const y = dateObj.getFullYear();
  const m = String(dateObj.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const d = String(dateObj.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}

export function getDismissedAlarmIds(dateStamp: string): Set<string> {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(`${ALARM_DISMISSED_PREFIX}${dateStamp}`);
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    return new Set(Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : []);
  } catch {
    return new Set();
  }
}

export function markAlarmDismissed(dateStamp: string, alarmId: string): void {
  try {
    const current = getDismissedAlarmIds(dateStamp);
    current.add(alarmId);
    localStorage.setItem(`${ALARM_DISMISSED_PREFIX}${dateStamp}`, JSON.stringify(Array.from(current)));
  } catch {}
}

export function parseTimeToMinutes(hhmm: string | undefined): number | null {
  if (!hhmm) return null;
  const parts = String(hhmm).trim().split(':');
  if (parts.length < 2) return null;
  const hours = Number(parts[0]);
  const mins = Number(parts[1]);
  if (!Number.isFinite(hours) || !Number.isFinite(mins)) return null;
  if (hours < 0 || hours > 23 || mins < 0 || mins > 59) return null;
  return hours * 60 + mins;
}

export function formatMinutes12h(totalMins: number): string {
  const h24 = Math.floor(totalMins / 60) % 24;
  const m = totalMins % 60;
  const ampm = h24 >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const h12 = h24 % 12 || 12;
  return `${h12}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')} ${ampm}`;
}

export function periodRunsToday(dayOfWeek: string | undefined, jsDay: number): boolean {
  const isoDay = jsDay === 0 ? 7 : jsDay;
  const clean = String(dayOfWeek || 'ALL_WEEKDAYS').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (clean === 'ALL_WEEKDAYS' || clean === 'ALL' || clean === 'MON-FRI' || clean === 'WEEKDAYS') {
    return isoDay >= 1 && isoDay <= 5;
  }
  if (clean === 'MWF') return isoDay === 1 || isoDay === 3 || isoDay === 5;
  if (clean === 'TTH') return isoDay === 2 || isoDay === 4;
  if (/^[1-7]$/.test(clean)) return Number(clean) === isoDay;
  return isoDay >= 1 && isoDay <= 5;
}

export function evaluateDueWebAlarm(
  snapshot: AlarmScheduleSnapshot,
  now: Date = new Date()
): ActiveAlarmEvent | null {
  const dateStamp = getLocalDateStamp(now);
  const dismissed = getDismissedAlarmIds(dateStamp);
  const nowMins = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
  const jsDay = now.getDay();
  const isWeekday = jsDay >= 1 && jsDay <= 5;

  // 1. Teacher TIME IN reminder (weekdays, if not timed in yet, within [start, start + 2 min])
  const startMins = parseTimeToMinutes(snapshot.dutyStartTime);
  if (isWeekday && startMins !== null && !snapshot.isTimedInToday) {
    const alarmId = `TIME_IN_${dateStamp}_${snapshot.dutyStartTime}`;
    if (!dismissed.has(alarmId) && nowMins >= startMins && nowMins <= startMins + 2) {
      return {
        id: alarmId,
        kind: 'TIME_IN',
        title: 'Time to TIME IN',
        subtitle: 'Teacher Duty Hours Starting',
        timeLabel: formatMinutes12h(startMins),
        detail:
          'School duty is starting now. Record your Teacher Time In inside the school campus boundary.',
        actionLabel: 'Open Campus Geofence',
        targetTab: 'geofence',
      };
    }
  }

  // 2. Teacher TIME OUT reminder (weekdays, if timed in, within [end, end + 2 min])
  const endMins = parseTimeToMinutes(snapshot.dutyEndTime);
  if (isWeekday && endMins !== null && snapshot.isTimedInToday) {
    const alarmId = `TIME_OUT_${dateStamp}_${snapshot.dutyEndTime}`;
    if (!dismissed.has(alarmId) && nowMins >= endMins && nowMins <= endMins + 2) {
      return {
        id: alarmId,
        kind: 'TIME_OUT',
        title: 'Time to TIME OUT',
        subtitle: 'Teacher Duty Hours Ending',
        timeLabel: formatMinutes12h(endMins),
        detail:
          'School duty hours have ended. Please record your Teacher Time Out before leaving campus.',
        actionLabel: 'View My DTR',
        targetTab: 'dtr',
      };
    }
  }

  // 3. Class Period start reminder (for classes scheduled today, within [periodStart, periodStart + 2 min])
  for (const cls of snapshot.classes) {
    if (!periodRunsToday(cls.day_of_week, jsDay)) continue;
    const pStart = parseTimeToMinutes(cls.start_time);
    if (pStart === null) continue;
    const alarmId = `PERIOD_${dateStamp}_${cls.id}_${cls.start_time}`;
    if (!dismissed.has(alarmId) && nowMins >= pStart && nowMins <= pStart + 2) {
      const pEnd = parseTimeToMinutes(cls.end_time);
      const range = pEnd !== null ? `${formatMinutes12h(pStart)} – ${formatMinutes12h(pEnd)}` : formatMinutes12h(pStart);
      return {
        id: alarmId,
        kind: 'CLASS_PERIOD',
        title: `Class Period Now: ${cls.subject_title || cls.subject_code}`,
        subtitle: `${cls.grade_level ? `${cls.grade_level} - ` : ''}${cls.section_name}`,
        timeLabel: range,
        detail: `Room: ${cls.room_number || 'Assigned Room'} • Open the Classroom QR Scanner to record student attendance.`,
        actionLabel: 'Open Classroom Scanner',
        targetTab: 'classroom-scanner',
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

export function buildTestWebAlarm(kind: AlarmKind): ActiveAlarmEvent {
  const now = new Date();
  const timeLabel = formatMinutes12h(now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes());
  if (kind === 'TIME_IN') {
    return {
      id: `TEST_TIME_IN_${Date.now()}`,
      kind: 'TIME_IN',
      title: 'Time to TIME IN',
      subtitle: 'Teacher Attendance Reminder (Test Alarm)',
      timeLabel,
      detail: 'Your teacher duty starts now. Record your Teacher Time In inside the school campus circle.',
      actionLabel: 'Open Campus Geofence',
      targetTab: 'geofence',
    };
  }
  if (kind === 'TIME_OUT') {
    return {
      id: `TEST_TIME_OUT_${Date.now()}`,
      kind: 'TIME_OUT',
      title: 'Time to TIME OUT',
      subtitle: 'Teacher Attendance Reminder (Test Alarm)',
      timeLabel,
      detail: 'Your teacher duty ends now. Record your Teacher Time Out before leaving the campus boundary.',
      actionLabel: 'View My DTR',
      targetTab: 'dtr',
    };
  }
  return {
    id: `TEST_PERIOD_${Date.now()}`,
    kind: 'CLASS_PERIOD',
    title: 'Class Period Starting Now',
    subtitle: 'Classroom Student Attendance Reminder (Test Alarm)',
    timeLabel,
    detail: 'Your scheduled class period is starting. Open the built-in camera QR scanner to record student attendance.',
    actionLabel: 'Open Classroom Scanner',
    targetTab: 'classroom-scanner',
  };
}

const prefetchTabResources = (tab: NavItemKey): void => {
  if (hoverPrefetchTimer) clearTimeout(hoverPrefetchTimer);
  hoverPrefetchTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    const currentUser = getCurrentUserFromStorage();
    if (!canViewTab(currentUser, tab)) return;
    const now = new Date();
    const allowSf4 = checkCanViewSf4(currentUser);

    switch (tab) {
      case 'dashboard':
        void loadDashboard();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard);
        break;
      case 'impact':
        void loadImpact();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.reports.sdgImpact);
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.reports.dropoutRisk);
        break;
      case 'classroom-scanner':
        void loadScanner();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, { summary: 1 });
        break;
      case 'my-classes':
        void loadMyClasses();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes);
        break;
      case 'advisory-monitor':
        void loadAdvisory();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.attendance.adviserMatrix);
        break;
      case 'students':
        void loadStudents();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.students.metrics);
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.students.list, { page: 1, page_size: 25 });
        break;
      case 'teachers':
        void loadTeachers();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.accounts.teachers, { page: 1, page_size: 25 });
        break;
      case 'users':
        void loadUsers();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.accounts.users, { page_size: 'ALL' });
        break;
      case 'gate-passes':
        void loadGatePasses();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses);
        break;
      case 'schedules':
        void loadSchedules();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.school.periods, { page_size: 500 });
        break;
      case 'dtr':
        void loadDtr();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.reports.dtr, { month: now.getMonth() + 1, year: now.getFullYear() });
        break;
      case 'geofence':
        void loadGeofence();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.campus.overview);
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.campus.loafing);
        break;
      case 'reports':
        void loadSf1();
        void loadSf2();
        if (allowSf4) {
          void loadSf4();
        }
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.school.sections);
        break;
      case 'settings':
        void loadSettings();
        prefetchApiGet(API_ROUTES.school.settings);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }, 120);
};

        const d = res.data;
        const rawPhoto = d.photo_url || d.photo || null;
        const photo = isSafeImageUrl(rawPhoto) ? rawPhoto : null;
        const name = String(d.full_name || d.teacher_name || d.username || '').trim();
        const role = String(d.role || d.system_role || session.role || 'TEACHER').toUpperCase();
        const userId = Number(d.id || d.user_id || 0);
        const teacherId = d.teacher_id ? Number(d.teacher_id) : null;
        const superFlag = Boolean(d.is_superuser);
        const teachFlag =
          d.can_handle_classes !== undefined && d.can_handle_classes !== null
            ? Boolean(d.can_handle_classes)
            : d.can_teach !== undefined && d.can_teach !== null
              ? Boolean(d.can_teach)
              : role === 'TEACHER';

        setUserPhoto(photo);
        if (photo) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', photo);
        else localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_user_photo');

        if (name) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_teacher_name', name);
        localStorage.setItem('attendsure_role', role);
        if (userId) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_id', String(userId));
        if (teacherId) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_teacher_id', String(teacherId));
        else localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_teacher_id');
        setIsSuperuser(superFlag);
        localStorage.setItem('attendsure_is_superuser', String(superFlag));
        setCanTeach(teachFlag);
        localStorage.setItem('attendsure_can_teach', String(teachFlag));

        const nextPermUser: PermissionUser = {
          role,
          can_handle_classes: teachFlag,
          can_teach: teachFlag,
          is_superuser: superFlag,
        };
        if (!checkCanViewSf4(nextPermUser)) {
          setSelectedReport((prev) => (prev === 'sf4' ? 'sf1' : prev));
        }

        if (d.is_profile_completed === false) setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen(true);

        setSession((prev) =>
          prev ? { ...prev, user_id: userId || prev.user_id, teacher_name: name || prev.teacher_name, role } : null
        );
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (!active || controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string; response?: { status?: number } };
        if (anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!anyErr?.response) setIsServerOnline(false);
        else if (anyErr.response?.status === 401) handleAuthExpired();
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [session?.token, handleAuthExpired, refreshSchool]);

  const retryConnection = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsCheckingServer(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.health.db, { params: { nocache: 1 } });
      setIsServerOnline(true);
    } catch {
      setIsServerOnline(false);
    } finally {
      setIsCheckingServer(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // Unlock Web Audio API on first user click or keypress so scheduled alarms ring reliably
  useEffect(() => {
    const unlock = () => unlockWebAlarmAudio();
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlock, { once: true });
    window.addEventListener('keydown', unlock, { once: true });
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', unlock);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', unlock);
    };
  }, []);

  const triggerWebAlarm = useCallback((ev: ActiveAlarmEvent) => {
    setActiveAlarm(ev);
    startWebAlarmLoop(ev.kind);
    sendBrowserDesktopAlert(ev.title, `${ev.timeLabel} — ${ev.detail}`);
  }, []);

  const handleDismissAlarm = useCallback(() => {
    stopWebAlarmLoop();
    if (alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current);
      alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    const current = activeAlarmRef.current;
    if (current && !current.id.startsWith('TEST_')) {
      markAlarmDismissed(getLocalDateStamp(), current.id);
    }
    setActiveAlarm(null);
  }, []);

  const handleSnoozeAlarm = useCallback(() => {
    stopWebAlarmLoop();
    const current = activeAlarmRef.current;
    setActiveAlarm(null);
    if (!current) return;
    if (alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current);
    }
    alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current = null;
      if (getWebAlarmsEnabled()) {
        triggerWebAlarm({ ...current, subtitle: `${current.subtitle} (Snoozed)` });
      }
    }, 5 * 60 * 1000);
  }, [triggerWebAlarm]);

  const handleToggleAlarms = useCallback((next: boolean) => {
    setAlarmsEnabled(next);
    setWebAlarmsEnabled(next);
    if (!next) {
      stopWebAlarmLoop();
      if (alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current);
        alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current = null;
      }
      setActiveAlarm(null);
    } else {
      unlockWebAlarmAudio();
    }
  }, []);

  const handleTestAlarm = useCallback(
    (kind: AlarmKind) => {
      unlockWebAlarmAudio();
      triggerWebAlarm(buildTestWebAlarm(kind));
    },
    [triggerWebAlarm]
  );

  // Sync teacher duty schedule + today's class periods and ring alarm when due
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session?.token || !alarmsEnabled) {
      stopWebAlarmLoop();
      return;
    }
    let active = true;
    const controller = new AbortController();

    const refreshAlarmSchedule = async () => {
      try {
        const [campusRes, classesRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
          apiClient.get<{
            duty_start_time?: string;
            duty_end_time?: string;
            teacher_list?: Array<{
              teacher_id?: number;
              user_id?: number;
              is_clocked_in?: boolean;
              time_in?: string | null;
              time_out?: string | null;
            }>;
          }>(API_ROUTES.campus.overview, { signal: controller.signal }),
          canViewTab(permissionUser, 'classroom-scanner')
            ? apiClient.get<AlarmClassSlot[] | { results?: AlarmClassSlot[] }>(
                API_ROUTES.attendance.classes,
                { params: { summary: 1 }, signal: controller.signal }
              )
            : Promise.resolve({ data: [] as AlarmClassSlot[] }),
        ]);

        if (!active || controller.signal.aborted) return;

        let dutyStartTime = '';
        let dutyEndTime = '';
        let isTimedInToday = false;

        if (campusRes.status === 'fulfilled' && campusRes.value?.data) {
          const campus = campusRes.value.data;
          const savedTeacherId = Number(localStorage.getItem('attendsure_teacher_id') || 0);
          const currentUserId = Number(session.user_id || 0);
          const ownTeacher = Array.isArray(campus.teacher_list)
            ? campus.teacher_list.find(
                (t) =>
                  (savedTeacherId > 0 && Number(t.teacher_id) === savedTeacherId) ||
                  (currentUserId > 0 && Number(t.user_id) === currentUserId)
              )
            : undefined;

          if (ownTeacher || userRole === 'TEACHER') {
            dutyStartTime = String(campus.duty_start_time || '');
            dutyEndTime = String(campus.duty_end_time || '');
            isTimedInToday = Boolean(
              ownTeacher?.is_clocked_in || (ownTeacher?.time_in && !ownTeacher?.time_out)
            );
          }
        }

        let classes: AlarmClassSlot[] = [];
        if (classesRes.status === 'fulfilled' && classesRes.value?.data) {
          const raw = classesRes.value.data;
          classes = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : Array.isArray(raw.results) ? raw.results : [];
        }

        alarmSnapshotRef.current = {
          dutyStartTime,
          dutyEndTime,
          isTimedInToday,
          classes,
        };
      } catch {
        // Ignore transient network errors during background alarm refresh
      }
    };

    const checkAlarmTick = () => {
      if (!active || activeAlarmRef.current || !getWebAlarmsEnabled()) return;
      const due = evaluateDueWebAlarm(alarmSnapshotRef.current, new Date());
      if (due) {
        triggerWebAlarm(due);
      }
    };

    void refreshAlarmSchedule().then(() => checkAlarmTick());
    const syncHandle = setInterval(() => void refreshAlarmSchedule(), 5 * 60 * 1000);
    const tickHandle = setInterval(checkAlarmTick, 15 * 1000);

    return () => {
      active = false;
      controller.abort();
      clearInterval(syncHandle);
      clearInterval(tickHandle);
      stopWebAlarmLoop();
      if (alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current);
        alarmSnoozeTimerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [session?.token, session?.user_id, alarmsEnabled, permissionUser, userRole, triggerWebAlarm]);

  const pageTitle = useMemo((): string => {
    const safeTab = isAllowed ? activeTab : 'dashboard';
    const prefix = school.school_name ? `${school.school_name} • ` : '';
    switch (safeTab) {
      case 'dashboard':
        return `${prefix}Dashboard`;
      case 'impact':
        return 'SARDO Early-Warning & Campus Safety';
      case 'classroom-scanner':
        return 'QR Scanner';
      case 'my-classes':
        return 'My Classes & Class Lists';
      case 'advisory-monitor':
        return 'Advisory Attendance & Cutting Matrix';
      case 'students':
        return 'Students';
      case 'teachers':
        return 'Teachers Directory';
      case 'users':
        return 'User Accounts & Roles';
      case 'gate-passes':
        return 'Exit & Travel Passes';
      case 'schedules':
        return 'Academic Setup & Class Schedules';
      case 'dtr':
        return userRole === 'TEACHER'
          ? 'My Daily Time Record (CSC Form 48)'
          : 'Monthly Time Records (CSC Form 48)';
      case 'geofence':
        return 'Geofence & Loafing Monitor';
      case 'reports':
        return effectiveReport === 'sf1'
          ? 'DepEd School Form 1 (School Register)'
          : effectiveReport === 'sf2'
            ? 'DepEd School Form 2 (Daily Attendance)'
            : 'DepEd School Form 4 (Monthly Movement)';
      case 'settings':
        return 'System Settings & Audit Logs';
      default:
        return 'AttendSure Portal';
    }
  }, [activeTab, isAllowed, school.school_name, effectiveReport, userRole]);

  const renderTab = () => {
    if (!isAllowed) {
      return null;
    }

    switch (activeTab) {
      case 'dashboard':
        return (
          <DashboardView
            isServerOnline={isServerOnline}
            userRole={userRole}
            onManualRefresh={retryConnection}
            onNavigateTab={(tab, report) => {
              handleTabSelection(tab as NavItemKey);
              if (report) {
                handleSafeReportSelection(report);
              }
            }}
          />
        );
      case 'impact':
        return (
          <div style={{ padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)', maxWidth: 1380, margin: '0 auto' }}>
            <EnterpriseSDGWidget />
          </div>
        );
      case 'classroom-scanner':
        return (
          <div style={{ padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
            <ClassroomScanner />
          </div>
        );
      case 'my-classes':
        return <MyAssignedClassesTab />;
      case 'advisory-monitor':
        return (
          <div style={{ padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
            <AdvisorySubjectMonitor />
          </div>
        );
      case 'students':
        return <StudentsTab />;
      case 'teachers':
        return <TeachersTab />;
      case 'users':
        return <UsersTab />;
      case 'gate-passes':
        return <GatePassesTab />;
      case 'schedules':
        return <SchedulesTab />;
      case 'dtr':
        return <DTRTab />;
      case 'geofence':
        return <GeofenceTab />;
      case 'reports':
        return (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%', width: '100%', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            {effectiveReport === 'sf1' && (
              <SF1ReportTab activeReportId="sf1" onSelectReport={handleSafeReportSelection} />
            )}
            {effectiveReport === 'sf2' && (
              <SF2ReportTab activeReportId="sf2" onSelectReport={handleSafeReportSelection} />
            )}
            {effectiveReport === 'sf4' && canViewSf4 && (
              <SF4ReportTab activeReportId="sf4" onSelectReport={handleSafeReportSelection} />
            )}
          </div>
        );
      case 'settings':
        return <SettingsTab />;
      default:
        return <DashboardView isServerOnline={isServerOnline} onManualRefresh={retryConnection} />;
    }
  };

  const resolvedSchoolLogo = school.school_logo || school.left_logo || null;

  return (
    <>
      <SplashScreen loading={isSchoolLoading} minDurationMs={0} />

      {!session ? (
        showStaffLogin ? (
          <LoginView
            onBackToShowcase={() => setShowStaffLogin(false)}
            onLoginSuccess={(nextSession) => {
              clearApiClientCache();
              const nextTeach = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_can_teach') !== 'false';
              const nextSuper = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_is_superuser') === 'true';
              const savedPhoto = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user_photo');
              setCanTeach(nextTeach);
              setIsSuperuser(nextSuper);
              setUserPhoto(isSafeImageUrl(savedPhoto) ? savedPhoto : null);
              setSession(nextSession);
              setActiveTab('dashboard');
              setSelectedReport('sf1');
            }}
          />
        ) : (
          <StartupShowcasePage
            onOpenSignIn={() => setShowStaffLogin(true)}
            onDemoLoginSuccess={(nextSession, targetTab = 'dashboard') => {
              clearApiClientCache();
              const nextTeach = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_can_teach') !== 'false';
              const nextSuper = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_is_superuser') === 'true';
              const savedPhoto = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user_photo');
              const nextUser: PermissionUser = {
                role: nextSession.role,
                can_handle_classes: nextTeach,
                can_teach: nextTeach,
                is_superuser: nextSuper,
              };
              setCanTeach(nextTeach);
              setIsSuperuser(nextSuper);
              setUserPhoto(isSafeImageUrl(savedPhoto) ? savedPhoto : null);
              setSession(nextSession);
              setActiveTab(canViewTab(nextUser, targetTab) ? targetTab : 'dashboard');
              setSelectedReport('sf1');
            }}
          />
        )
      ) : (
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            height: '100vh',
            width: '100%',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgApp,
            padding: 'clamp(6px, 1vw, 12px)',
            gap: 'clamp(6px, 1vw, 12px)',
            boxSizing: 'border-box',
          }}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              height: '100%',
              borderRadius: 16,
              overflow: 'hidden',
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderStyle: 'solid',
              borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
              boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}
          >
            <Sidebar
              activeTab={activeTab}
              onSelectTab={handleTabSelection}
              onPrefetchTab={prefetchTabResources}
              session={session}
              userPhoto={userPhoto}
              isCollapsed={isSidebarCollapsed}
              onToggleCollapse={() => setIsSidebarCollapsed((p) => !p)}
              schoolName={school.school_name}
              schoolId={school.school_id}
              schoolLogo={resolvedSchoolLogo}
              canTeach={canTeach}
              allowedTabs={allowedTabs}
            />
          </div>

          <div
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              minWidth: 0,
              height: '100%',
              borderRadius: 16,
              backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderStyle: 'solid',
              borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
              boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              overflow: 'hidden',
            }}
          >
            <Header
              title={pageTitle}
              isSystemOnline={isServerOnline}
              session={session}
              userPhoto={userPhoto}
              schoolName={school.school_name}
              schoolId={school.school_id}
              schoolLogo={resolvedSchoolLogo}
              alarmsEnabled={alarmsEnabled}
              onToggleAlarms={handleToggleAlarms}
              onTestAlarm={handleTestAlarm}
              onLogout={handleAuthExpired}
              onNavigateTab={handleTabSelection}
              onOpenProfile={() => setIsProfileModalOpen(true)}
            />

            <main
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                minHeight: 0,
                overflowY: activeTab === 'dashboard' || activeTab === 'reports' ? 'hidden' : 'auto',
                overflowX: 'hidden',
                position: 'relative',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
              }}
            >
              <ErrorBoundary featureName={pageTitle} resetKeys={[activeTab, effectiveReport]}>
                <Suspense fallback={<SubtleSkeletonFallback />}>{renderTab()}</Suspense>
              </ErrorBoundary>

              {!isServerOnline && (
                <div
                  onClick={retryConnection}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    inset: 0,
                    zIndex: 35,
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(15,23,42,0.68)',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                  }}
                >
                  <div
                    style={{
                      display: 'inline-flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      gap: 10,
                      padding: '10px 20px',
                      borderRadius: 9999,
                      backgroundColor: tokens.darkSurface,
                      color: tokens.darkText,
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      fontSize: '0.82rem',
                    }}
                  >
                    <WifiOff size={16} color={brand.secondary} />
                    {isCheckingServer ? 'Reconnecting...' : 'Server offline. Click to reconnect.'}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </main>

            <Footer
              schoolName={school.school_name}
              schoolId={school.school_id}
              divisionOrCity={school.division}
              isDatabaseConnected={isServerOnline}
              isGateSystemOnline={isServerOnline}
            />
          </div>

          <ProfileModal
            isOpen={isProfileModalOpen}
            onClose={() => setIsProfileModalOpen(false)}
            onProfileUpdated={(updated: ProfileUpdatePayload) => {
              const name =
                typeof updated.full_name === 'string' && updated.full_name.trim()
                  ? updated.full_name.trim()
                  : undefined;
              if (name) {
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_teacher_name', name);
                setSession((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, teacher_name: name } : null));
              }
              if (updated.photo !== undefined || updated.photo_url !== undefined) {
                const candidate = (updated.photo_url as string | null) ?? updated.photo ?? null;
                const nextPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(candidate) ? candidate : null;
                setUserPhoto(nextPhoto);
                if (nextPhoto) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', nextPhoto);
                else localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_user_photo');
              }
            }}
          />

          <CompleteProfileModal
            isOpen={isCompleteProfileModalOpen}
            onCompleted={(updatedUser: CompletedProfileUser) => {
              setIsCompleteProfileModalOpen(false);
              const name = String(updatedUser.full_name || updatedUser.username || '').trim();
              const rawPhoto =
                (typeof updatedUser.photo_url === 'string' && updatedUser.photo_url) ||
                (typeof updatedUser.photo === 'string' && updatedUser.photo) ||
                null;
              const photo = isSafeImageUrl(rawPhoto) ? rawPhoto : null;
              if (name) {
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_teacher_name', name);
                setSession((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, teacher_name: name } : null));
              }
              if (photo) {
                setUserPhoto(photo);
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', photo);
              }
            }}
          />
          <ScheduleAlarmModal
            alarm={activeAlarm}
            onDismiss={handleDismissAlarm}
            onSnooze={handleSnoozeAlarm}
            onNavigateTab={handleTabSelection}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export const App: React.FC = () => (
  <ThemeProvider>
    <ComplianceProvider>
      <SchoolProvider>
        <AlertProvider>
          <AppContent />
        </AlertProvider>
      </SchoolProvider>
    </ComplianceProvider>
  </ThemeProvider>
);

export default App;

/**
 * AttendSure - Instant-Mount Application Entry Point
 * File: web/src/main.tsx
 */

import React from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client';
import App from './App';
import './index.css';
import { BRAND_ASSETS } from './components/branding/BrandAssets';

// Mount React immediately on Frame 1 before running optional favicon work
const rootElement = document.getElementById('root');
if (rootElement) {
  ReactDOM.createRoot(rootElement).render(
    <React.StrictMode>
      <App />
    </React.StrictMode>
  );
}

// Generate circular high-contrast favicon only when main thread is idle
const applyAppFavicon = () => {
  try {
    const img = new Image();
    img.decoding = 'async';
    img.src = BRAND_ASSETS.attendsureLogo;
    img.onload = () => {
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = 64;
        canvas.height = 64;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) return;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(32, 32, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.drawImage(img, 10, 10, 44, 44);

        const pngDataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
        document.querySelectorAll("link[rel*='icon']").forEach((el) => el.remove());

        const link = document.createElement('link');
        link.type = 'image/png';
        link.rel = 'icon';
        link.href = pngDataUrl;
        document.head.appendChild(link);
      } catch {
        // Keep inline SVG icon from index.html
      }
    };
  } catch {
    // Non-blocking fallback
  }
};

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  const idle = (window as unknown as { requestIdleCallback?: (cb: () => void) => void }).requestIdleCallback;
  if (idle) idle(applyAppFavicon);
  else setTimeout(applyAppFavicon, 600);
}

# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:

```js
export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...

      // Remove tseslint.configs.recommended and replace with this
      tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked,
      // Alternatively, use this for stricter rules
      tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked,
      // Optionally, add this for stylistic rules
      tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked,

      // Other configs...
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

You can also install [eslint-plugin-react-x](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-x) and [eslint-plugin-react-dom](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-dom) for React-specific lint rules:

```js
// eslint.config.js
import reactX from 'eslint-plugin-react-x'
import reactDom from 'eslint-plugin-react-dom'

export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {

      // Other configs...
      // Enable lint rules for React

      // Enable lint rules for React DOM
      reactDom.configs.recommended,
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import type { ServerResponse } from 'http';

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  resolve: {
    alias: {
      '@': path.resolve(__dirname, './src'),
    },
  },
  server: {
    port: 5173,
    host: true,
    strictPort: false,
    allowedHosts: [
      '.attendsure.com.ph',
      '.trycloudflare.com',
      'localhost',
      '127.0.0.1',
    ],
    fs: {
      allow: [path.resolve(__dirname, '..')],
    },
    proxy: {
      '/api': {
        target: 'http://127.0.0.1:8000',
        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: false,
        timeout: 10000,
        configure: (proxy) => {
          proxy.on('error', (_err, _req, res) => {
            if (res && 'writeHead' in res && typeof res.writeHead === 'function') {
              const httpRes = res as ServerResponse;
              if (!httpRes.headersSent) {
                httpRes.writeHead(502, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
                httpRes.end(
                  JSON.stringify({
                    error: 'The school server is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.',
                  })
                );
              }
            }
          });
        },
      },
      '/media': {
        target: 'http://127.0.0.1:8000',
        changeOrigin: true,
        secure: false,
      },
    },
  },
  build: {
    chunkSizeWarningLimit: 1200,
    sourcemap: false,
    rollupOptions: {
      output: {
        manualChunks(id: string) {
          if (id.includes('node_modules')) {
            if (id.includes('react') || id.includes('react-dom')) {
              return 'vendor-react';
            }
            if (id.includes('lucide-react')) {
              return 'vendor-icons';
            }
            if (id.includes('axios')) {
              return 'vendor-network';
            }
          }
        },
      },
    },
  },
});

# AttendSure v3 — Pure-Software DepEd Attendance, Campus Safety & SARDO Early-Warning System

> **Every Teacher On Duty. Every Student Accounted For. Pure Software — Zero Extra Devices Required.**  
> Built for Philippine public and private schools using everyday teacher laptops, PC webcams, and mobile phones — paired with official DepEd **SF1**, **SF2**, **SF4**, and **CSC Form 48 (DTR)** workflows.

---

## Why AttendSure Exists

Many schools still track student attendance and teacher time records using paper logbooks and manual spreadsheets. Paper records make it hard to spot students who arrive in the morning and skip later class periods, delay early support for students at risk of dropping out (**SARDO**), and take hours of manual encoding at the end of every month.

**AttendSure replaces paper logbooks with a pure-software school platform** that runs on devices teachers already own:

| Everyday School Need | Paper Logbooks & Manual Sheets | AttendSure v3 |
|---|---|---|
| **Extra Equipment Cost** | High printing & manual clerical cost | **\$0 extra devices** (runs on existing teacher laptops, webcams, and phones) |
| **Period-by-Period Student Check** | Hard to compare across subjects | **Built-in camera QR scanning** (`jsqr` webcam & `expo-camera` phone back camera) with signed student QR IDs |
| **Offline Reliability** | Lost or late sheets during outages | **Local offline queue** on web and mobile that syncs automatically when internet returns |
| **Teacher Duty Verification** | Handwritten logbooks open to proxy entries | **On-device face/fingerprint/PIN check** + **1-to-1 phone binding** + **campus GPS boundary** |
| **Teacher Loafing & Student Cutting Alerts** | Discovered days or weeks later | **Automatic weekday-aware alerts** for teacher loafing outside campus, students cutting class, and expired exit passes |
| **Official DepEd Reports** | Hours of manual monthly counting | **Print-ready DepEd SF1, SF2, SF4 & CSC Form 48 (DTR)** with submission and approval |
| **Emergency Evacuation Check** | Slow paper headcounts | **1-Click Emergency Roll-Call** of every student and teacher verified on campus today |

---

## Core Features Built Into the Repository

1. **Built-In Camera Student Attendance (`QR` + Manual Class List)**
   - Teachers scan HMAC-SHA256 signed student QR ID cards (`ATTENDSURE:...`) using their laptop/PC webcam (`jsqr` in the web portal) or phone back camera (`expo-camera` in the mobile app).
   - Every scan checks the teacher's assigned classes, prevents forged or unsigned QR badges, and saves to a local offline queue (`localStorage` on web, `AsyncStorage` on mobile) whenever school Wi-Fi drops, syncing cleanly through `POST /api/v1/attendance/offline-sync/`.
   - Homeroom advisers monitor period-by-period attendance in the **Adviser Matrix**, filtered strictly to class periods scheduled on that weekday (`ALL_WEEKDAYS`, `MWF`, `TTH`, or single days `1`–`7`).

2. **Teacher Campus GPS Check-In & Adaptive Duty Tracking**
   - Inside the AttendSure mobile app on their own phone, teachers verify their identity using their phone's built-in **face unlock, fingerprint sensor, or screen-lock PIN/pattern** (`expo-local-authentication` + `expo-secure-store`) before clocking in or out.
   - **Zero raw face photos or biometric templates** are ever sent to or stored on the server — only a public SHA-256 key ID (`biometric_key_id`) and a 1-to-1 phone ID (`bound_device_id`) are stored.
   - Server-side Haversine boundary checks reject mock GPS, impossible coordinates, and weak GPS readings (> 250 m accuracy). While clocked in during duty hours, the app sends adaptive **45-second campus GPS pings** and automatically opens or resolves outside-campus alerts unless an approved **Official Locator Slip / Exit Pass** is active.

3. **5-Role Staff Access Control (Synchronized Across Backend, Web & Mobile)**
   - **`ADMIN`** (System Administrator): Full school setup, user account management, teacher directory CRUD, device lock reset, campus boundary editing, and audit logs.
   - **`PRINCIPAL`** (School Principal): Full school visibility, student management, campus boundary editing, device lock reset, loafing resolution, SF4, and audit logs (view-only on Academic Setup and Teacher Directory).
   - **`DEPT_HEAD`** (Department Head): Department oversight, classroom QR scanning, DTR approval, exit pass / locator slip approval, loafing resolution, and SF4.
   - **Teaching `TEACHER` (`can_handle_classes=True`)**: Assigned classroom QR scanning, class lists, adviser matrix, student exit passes, SF1/SF2 for assigned classes, personal campus GPS check-in, and personal DTR. Homeroom advisers can also add/edit students in their own advised section.
   - **Non-Teaching `TEACHER` (`can_handle_classes=False`)**: Focused view for non-teaching school staff (Dashboard, personal Campus GPS Check-In / Geofence, personal Official Locator Slips / Exit Passes, and personal DTR), with student class lists and classroom QR tools hidden.

4. **Official DepEd Forms, SARDO Early-Warning & Campus Safety**
   - Print-ready **DepEd SF1** (School Register), **SF2** (Daily Attendance Report of Learners), **SF4** (Monthly Learner Movement and Attendance), and **CSC Form 48 (Daily Time Record / DTR)** with teacher submission and Department Head approval.
   - **DepEd Division Data Export** (`JSON` / `CSV`) with optional personal ID masking.
   - **30-Day SARDO Risk Tracker** identifying `CRITICAL_SARDO` and `EARLY_WARNING` students from recent absences, cutting-class alerts, and late arrivals.
   - **1-Click Emergency Roll-Call** (`/api/v1/campus/roll-call/`) listing every student and teacher verified on campus today with live assembly-point safe checkboxes.
   - **Language Support (`EN` / `FIL`)** and **3 Color Modes** (`Light`, `Dark`, `High-Contrast`) across the web portal.

---

## Strict 3NF Database Structure

AttendSure stores school records in **6 focused Django apps** with zero duplicated columns and database-level integrity constraints:

- **`accounts`**: `UserProfile` (role + 5-strike login lockout), `Department`, `PositionTitle`, `TeacherProfile` (name, email, and active flag stay strictly in `auth.User`; stores 1-to-1 `bound_device_id` and public SHA-256 `biometric_key_id`), and `AuditLog`.
- **`school`**: `SchoolYear`, `AdministrativeDivision`, `SchoolSettings`, `SchoolHoliday`, `Building`, `Room`, `GradeLevel`, `Subject`, `Section`, and `ClassPeriod` (with shared weekday helpers `expand_schedule_days` and `period_runs_on_weekday`).
- **`students`**: `AddressLocation` (normalized `barangay`, `municipality_city`, `province`), `Student` (personal info + plain-text guardian details for SF1; never duplicates section or grade level), and `Enrollment` (links `Student` + `Section`, deriving school year and grade level from `Section`).
- **`attendance`**: `DailyAttendance` (unique per `Enrollment` + `attendance_date`), `ClassAttendance` (unique per `Enrollment` + `ClassPeriod` + `attendance_date`, plus `client_scan_uuid` for duplicate-safe offline sync), and `ExitPass` (enforces the `ck_exitpass_xor_bearer` database check constraint so every pass belongs to either a `STUDENT` enrollment or a `TEACHER`, never both, and computes `pass_status` dynamically).
- **`campus`**: `CampusBoundary`, `TeacherDailyAttendance`, `TeacherLocationPing` (stores raw GPS coordinates and computes `distance_meters` and `is_inside` dynamically), `LoafingIncident` (derives display names and distances from joined tables), and `MonthlyTimeRecord` (CSC Form 48 submission and approval workflow).
- **`reports`**: Read-optimized selectors and print/export engines for Dashboard, SF1, SF2, SF4, DTR, SARDO risk, campus impact summary, and Division Data Export.
- **`common/`**: Shared helpers for role permissions (`permissions.py`), HMAC QR signing (`qr_signer.py`), Haversine GPS checks (`gps.py`), audit trails (`audit.py`), image validation (`media.py`), phone formatting (`phone.py`), security headers (`security.py`), and request logging (`request_logger.py`).

## Repository Structure

```text
AttendSure_V3/
├── backend/                     # Django 6 + DRF + SimpleJWT + Celery + Redis + PostgreSQL/SQLite
│   ├── apps/
│   │   ├── accounts/            # Staff roles, TeacherProfile, 5-strike lockout, AuditLog, tests
│   │   ├── school/              # School settings, sections, schedules, weekday rules, demo seeder
│   │   ├── students/            # Student directory, AddressLocation, Enrollment, signed QR IDs
│   │   ├── attendance/          # Signed QR scan, offline sync, adviser matrix, cutting detector, exit passes
│   │   ├── campus/              # Campus boundary, Haversine GPS pings, teacher check-in, loafing, roll-call
│   │   └── reports/             # SF1, SF2, SF4, CSC Form 48 (DTR), 30-Day SARDO Risk, Division Export
│   ├── common/                  # Permissions, HMAC QR signer, GPS math, audit helpers, image & phone checks
│   ├── config/                  # settings.py, urls.py, legacy_urls.py, wsgi.py, asgi.py, celery.py
│   ├── Dockerfile               # Non-root Python 3.12 production container
│   └── gunicorn.conf.py         # Gunicorn worker configuration
├── web/                         # React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 8 web portal
│   └── src/
│       ├── components/dashboard/# Live Dashboard + SARDO Risk & 1-Click Emergency Roll-Call panel
│       ├── components/scanner/  # Built-in webcam QR scanner (jsqr) with offline local queue
│       ├── components/tabs/     # Students, Teachers, Schedules, Geofence, Exit Passes, SF1/SF2/SF4/DTR, Users, Settings
│       ├── components/showcase/ # School portal overview & environment-gated role preview launcher
│       ├── context/             # ThemeContext (Light/Dark/High-Contrast), ComplianceContext (EN/FIL), AlertContext, SchoolContext
│       └── utils/permissions.ts # 5-profile Web access control matrix
├── mobile/                      # Expo (SDK 58) + React Native 0.88 staff companion app
│   ├── AGENTS.md                # Mobile architecture, navigation, theme tokens, and security guide
│   └── src/
│       ├── navigation/          # AppNavigator (@react-navigation/native-stack) + 5-tab MainTabNavigator
│       ├── screens/             # Dashboard, Scanner/Check-In, Geofence, Passes, Account, Matrix, Reports, DTR, Calendar, Settings
│       ├── services/            # biometricService, deviceService, telemetryService, backgroundLocation, offlineQueue
│       ├── theme/tokens.ts      # Centralized palette & font tokens (re-exported by constants/theme.ts)
│       └── utils/permissions.ts # 5-profile Mobile access control matrix
├── deploy/                      # Nginx config + Blue-Green zero-downtime switch scripts (switch.sh / switch.ps1)
├── docs/
│   ├── ARCHITECTURE_AND_SECURITY.md # System topology, 3NF schema, RBAC, anti-spoofing & RA 10173 privacy
│   └── COMPETITION_PITCH_PACK.md    # 10-slide presentation guide, live walkthrough script & Q&A prep
├── scripts/
│   ├── audit_codebase.py        # 8-gate automated codebase, RBAC, UI token, vocabulary & schedule auditor
│   └── database/                # Database check, index optimization, and seeding utilities
└── docker-compose.yml           # PostgreSQL 16 + Redis 7 + Blue/Green Gunicorn + Nginx + Celery
```

## Quickstart (Local Development)

### 1. Backend Setup & Demo Data

```bash
cd backend
python -m venv venv

# Windows PowerShell:
.\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
# macOS / Linux:
# source venv/bin/activate

pip install -r requirements.txt
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py seed_competition_demo
python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000
```

> **Seeded Staff Preview Accounts** (password: `AttendSure2026!`):  
> `demo_admin` (System Administrator) · `demo_principal` (School Principal) · `demo_dept_head` (Department Head) · `demo_teacher` (Teacher / Class Adviser)  
> One-click role preview buttons on the landing page work only when `DEBUG=True` or `ENABLE_JUDGE_DEMO=True`, and return `HTTP 404` when disabled in production.

### 2. Web Portal

```bash
cd web
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open `http://localhost:5173` in your browser.

### 3. Mobile App (Expo)

```bash
cd mobile
npm install
npx expo start
```

### 4. Production Deployment (Blue-Green Zero-Downtime Docker)

```bash
cp backend/.env.example backend/.env   # Set SECRET_KEY, DB_PASSWORD, REDIS_PASSWORD, DEBUG=False
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose exec web_blue python manage.py migrate --noinput
docker compose exec web_blue python manage.py collectstatic --noinput

# Subsequent zero-downtime updates:
# Windows:     .\deploy\switch.ps1
# Linux/macOS: ./deploy/switch.sh
```

---

## Verification & Automated Audit

Run the backend test suite and the 8-gate repository auditor:

```bash
# 1. Run all Django unit and integration tests
cd backend
python manage.py check
python manage.py test --verbosity=2

# 2. Run the 8-gate master codebase auditor (migrations, routes, 184 RBAC checks, dialogs, colors, vocabulary, schedules)
cd ..
python scripts/audit_codebase.py
```
